Hello, Toby, said the turtle slowly. What are you doing today? I am trying to count my stripes, but they keep moving when I wiggle! said Toby with a little pout. The turtle chuckled and said, Do not worry, little tiger. Why do not we use a magic mirror? The turtle handed Toby a shiny, flat river stone that acted just like a mirror. Toby held the stone up and looked at his reflection. There he was, looking back with his bright amber eyes. Now I can see them all! cheered Toby. He pointed his paw at the mirror and began to count very carefully. One, two, three stripes on his forehead. Four, five, six stripes on his cheek. Seven, eight, nine stripes running down his back like a fuzzy ladder! Toby counted every single stripe until he reached twenty. Wow, I have twenty stripes! gasped Toby, amazed. That is so many! Just to be sure, he decided to count his toes next. One, two, three, four soft pink toes on his left foot. Five, six, seven, eight toes on his right foot. Toby laughed out loud because counting made him feel so silly and happy. The turtle smiled and shared a sweet red apple with him. Munch, munch, crunch! They sat together under the leafy tree, enjoying the peaceful afternoon. Toby realized that whether he had ten stripes or twenty stripes, he was still the happiest little tiger in the whole wide jungle. He hugged his friend goodbye and scampered off to show his mommy his newly counted stripes.

stories.title: Toby Tiger Wakes Up
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, in the bright green jungle, lived a little tiger named Toby. Toby had soft orange fur, big black stripes, and a very wiggly tail. Good morning, jungle! said Toby with a big, wide yawn. He stretched his front paws way up high into the warm air. Big stretch! time to wake up! Toby shook his furry body from his head to his toes. Shake, shake, shake! Today was a very special day because Toby wanted to find his very best friends for a game of hide and seek. First, Toby tiptoed softly through the tall green grass. Tip-toe, tip-toe, went his soft paws. He hid behind a big, leafy bush and covered his eyes with his paws. Are you ready? he called out softly. Suddenly, a little green frog hopped right onto a big brown log near the river. Ribbit, ribbit! smiled the frog. I see you, Toby! Toby giggled a happy tiger giggle. He loved playing games in the warm sunshine. Next, Toby bounced over to a tall banana tree where his monkey friend was swinging. Swing high, swing low! shouted the monkey. Can you climb this tree, Toby? Toby shook his striped head. Tigers do not climb high trees, but we can stomp on the ground like big giants! Stomp, stomp, stomp went their feet. The jungle ground felt bouncy and fun. Toby felt so happy. He loved running and playing with all his animal friends from morning until the afternoon sun started to go down. The day was full of bright colors and fun sounds. Soon, a little butterfly with blue wings fluttered gently right onto Toby's nose. Flutter, flutter, go away, little butterfly! whispered Toby with a smile. The butterfly flew up high into the golden sky. Toby rubbed his tummy because it was starting to rumble. Time for some yummy leaves and a nice, cool drink of water by the sparkly river. After his drink, Toby felt nice and cozy. The sun was going down behind the tall green trees, painting the sky in pink and orange. Toby gave one last big yawn. Ahhh-coo! Time for sleep, little tiger. He curled up into a soft, warm ball in his cozy bed of leaves. Good night, jungle. Good night, Toby.

stories.title: Toby Tiger Finds a Yellow Ball
stories.text: One bright afternoon, Toby Tiger was exploring near the edge of the sparkling blue river. The sun was shining warmly, and the little birds were singing happy songs in the trees. Tweet, tweet! went the yellow birds. Toby wagged his long, striped tail back and forth. Suddenly, something bright and round caught his big brown eyes. Look! What is that? wondered Toby. It was a big, bouncy, bright yellow ball! The ball was resting right in the middle of a patch of green clover. Toby walked over slowly, making soft stepping sounds in the grass. Tap, tap, tap went his paws. He gave the yellow ball a gentle little nudge with his wet black nose. Boing! The ball rolled a little bit to the left. Toby giggled. That is so fun! He decided to play soccer all by himself in the jungle clearing. Toby tapped the ball with his left paw. Then he tapped it with his right paw. Tap, tap, kick! The yellow ball flew through the air, right over a little log. Whee! shouted Toby, running as fast as his little legs could carry him. He chased the ball through the flowers and around the big palm trees. Just then, his friend Ellie the elephant came walking by. Hello, Toby! What are you playing? asked Ellie with a friendly trumpet sound. Hello, Ellie! I am playing with this magical bouncy ball! Do you want to play too? asked Toby happily. Yes, please! said Ellie. Ellie used her long trunk to gently push the ball back to Toby. Whoosh! The ball rolled all the way across the grass. Toby ran after it as fast as a flash of lightning. He stopped the ball with his tummy and laughed out loud. Playing together was so much better than playing alone. They played with the yellow ball for a long, long time until the sky turned a pretty shade of purple. The birds flew back to their nests, and the jungle grew quiet and peaceful. Toby picked up the yellow ball with his mouth and carried it back to his resting spot. Thank you for a wonderful game, ball, whispered Toby. He hugged the ball tight, closed his heavy eyes, and drifted off to a sweet, happy sleep.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Rainy Day
stories.text: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter! The rain began to fall softly on the big green leaves of the jungle. Toby Tiger peeked his head out from his cozy cave. Oh, no! It is raining today! said Toby. He loved playing outside in the warm sunshine, but today the sky was filled with big gray clouds. Splash, splash went the raindrops into little puddles on the ground. At first, Toby felt a little bit sad because he could not run through the tall grass. But then, Toby remembered something very important. Rainy days are wonderful for indoor adventures! Toby smiled his biggest tiger smile. First, he decided to build a wonderful fort using big green leaves and soft moss inside his dry, cozy cave. He stacked the leaves high like building blocks. One, two, three, four green leaves! The fort looked strong and safe. Next, Toby invited his stuffed monkey toy to come inside the fort for a pretend tea party. Would you like some yummy jungle juice, little monkey? asked Toby in his nicest voice. He pretended to pour water from a coconut shell into two tiny acorn cups. Clink! went the acorn cups. Toby and his toy friend sat together and drank their pretend tea while listening to the cozy sound of the rain falling outside. Pitter-patter, tap, tap, splash! It sounded like a sweet lullaby playing just for them. After their tea party, Toby practiced his roaring. Roar! went Toby, but not too loud because it was a quiet, gentle roar. Just a little baby tiger roar! The rain started to slow down, and soon, a single ray of golden sunshine peeked through the clouds. Look! The rain is stopping! shouted Toby happily. He crawled out of his leaf fort and stepped outside into the fresh, clean air. The jungle smelled like wet earth and sweet flowers. Toby saw a big, beautiful puddle right in front of him. He looked down and smiled. Can I jump in it? Oh, yes! Splash, splash, splash went Toby's paws in the big puddle. Water drops flew everywhere in the bright sunlight. Toby laughed and shook his wet fur. What a fantastic rainy day it had been.

stories.title: Tilly Tiger Goes to Sleep
stories.text:
Once upon a time, in a bright green jungle, lived a little tiger named Tilly. Tilly had soft orange fur and big black stripes. She had a tiny pink nose and a long, swishy tail. It was almost bedtime in the jungle, but Tilly was not sleepy at all. She wanted to play hide and seek with the butterflies.

First, Tilly tiptoed to the tall banana tree. 'Can you see me?' she whispered to a blue butterfly. The butterfly fluttered its wings and danced in the air. Tilly giggled and gave a little hop. Next, Tilly bounced over to the muddy puddle. She loved to watch the little frogs go splash, splash, splash. 'Ribbit, ribbit!' said the frogs. Tilly tried to copy them. 'Roar, roar!' she said, but her roar sounded more like a cute little squeak.

As the sun began to hide behind the big green mountains, the jungle started to get dark. The golden sun turned into a pretty purple sky, filled with twinkling stars. Tilly’s big orange eyelids started to feel very, very heavy. Yawn! Tilly opened her mouth wide and let out a big tiger yawn. 

Her mama tiger walked over and gave her a warm, cozy hug. 'Time for bed, my little stripey star,' Mama Tiger purred softly. Mama led Tilly to their soft bed made of fluffy green moss. Tilly curled up tight into a little orange ball. She tucked her long tail around her toes to keep them warm. 

Mama Tiger sang a sweet lullaby about the jungle moon. Tilly closed her eyes and listened to the gentle sounds of the night. The crickets chirped a soft song: chirp, chirp, goodnight. The wind whispered through the tree leaves: swoosh, swoosh, sleep tight. Tilly thought about all the fun things she would do tomorrow. But for now, her little paws were resting. With a final soft sigh, Tilly drifted off to dreamland, sleeping soundly until the morning sun would shine again.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Big Red Ball
stories.text:
Deep in the sunny jungle, a happy little tiger named Toby was having a wonderful morning. Toby had bright orange fur, bold black stripes, and a very bouncy personality. Today, Toby had a brand new toy. It was a big, shiny, bright red ball that bounced up and down, boing, boing, boing!

Toby loved his red ball so much. He rolled it with his nose. Boop! He tapped it with his paw. Tap, tap! He chased it all around the big bamboo tree. As Toby chased the ball, it rolled right past his friend, Sammy the Monkey. 'Hello, Toby!' chattered Sammy from a high branch. 'Can I play too?' 

'Yes, Sammy!' purred Toby happily. 'Catch the ball!' Toby gave the big red ball a gentle kick with his paw. Whoosh! The ball sailed through the air, right toward Sammy. Sammy clapped his hands and caught the ball with a big monkey grin. Then, Sammy threw the ball back down to Toby. Up and down, back and forth went the bright red ball.

Suddenly, oh no! The ball rolled a little too fast. It rolled down a grassy hill and right into a patch of tickly yellow flowers. Toby and Sammy ran as fast as their legs could carry them. 'We are coming, red ball!' shouted Toby. When Toby reached the flowers, he poked his nose right into the petals. The flowers tickled his nose so much that he sneezed. Ah-choo!

Sammy laughed and picked up the red ball. He handed it back to Toby with a cheer. Toby hugged the ball tightly against his fuzzy tummy. Playing with friends was even more fun than playing alone. Toby, Sammy, and the big red ball spent the rest of the sunny afternoon playing games, sharing giggles, and having wonderful jungle adventures together until it was time for a tasty snack.

stories.title: Tommy Tiger's Toothbrush
stories.text:
Good morning, little ones! It is time to wake up with Tommy Tiger. Tommy was a cheerful little tiger who lived in a cozy cave with his family. Today was a very special day because Tommy was going on a big jungle picnic with his best friends. But before he could eat any yummy morning berries, Tommy had a very important job to do.

Tommy ran into the bathroom and looked in the shiny mirror. He opened his mouth wide and said, 'Ahhh!' Inside his mouth, he had lots of strong, white teeth. But wait, what was that? After eating his sweet bedtime honey last night, Tommy had a tiny bit of sticky green leaf stuck right on his front tooth. 

'Time to brush!' said Papa Tiger, handing Tommy a bright yellow toothbrush with soft, tickly bristles. Tommy squeezed a little blob of minty toothpaste onto the brush. It looked just like a fluffy white cloud. Tommy started to brush his teeth. Chomp, chomp, brush, brush! Up and down went the little toothbrush. Scrub, scrub, scrub went the back teeth. 

Tommy made lots of funny bubbly foam in his mouth. He looked just like a funny white-bearded tiger wizard. He giggled, and some bubbles popped on his nose. Pop, pop, pop! Next, Tommy rinsed his mouth with a big cup of cool, sparkling water. Swish, swish, spit! 

Tommy opened his mouth and looked in the mirror again. His teeth sparkled and shone like bright little pearls in the morning sun. 'All clean!' cheered Tommy, giving a happy little tiger roar. His teeth felt fresh, and his smile was brighter than ever. Now Tommy’s tummy was ready for breakfast, and his smile was ready for a happy day of jungle fun with all his favorite animal friends.

stories.title: Toby Tiger Wakes Up
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, in the bright green jungle, lived a little tiger named Toby. Toby had soft orange fur and big black stripes that zigzagged all the way from his twitchy nose to the tip of his wiggly tail. Yawn! Toby opened his big amber eyes and stretched his front paws way up high into the warm air. Big stretch, little tiger! Toby loved his cozy jungle bed made of soft green moss and fallen leaves. Today was a very special day because Toby was going on a big exploring adventure with his jungle friends. First, Toby needed to fill his tummy with a healthy breakfast. He padded softly on his squishy, padded paws across the damp grass to the sparkling river. Slurp, slurp, slurp! Toby drank some cool, refreshing water. Then, he found a crunchy red jungle apple hanging low from a twisty tree branch. Crunch, crunch, yum! With a happy tummy, Toby was ready to play. He saw his best friend, a little green monkey, swinging from a vine. 'Hello, monkey!' purred Toby, making a friendly tiger sound. 'Roar! Just kidding, it's only me!' The monkey giggled and tossed a yellow banana down. Toby bounded forward, hopping over a mossy log and ducking under a curtain of fern leaves. He loved to run and jump in the sunshine. Along the way, he met a colorful parrot who squawked a cheerful tune and a busy little ladybug crawling on a leaf. Toby walked gently so he would not scare the tiny bug. The jungle was full of wonderful sights, smells, and sounds. Toby felt so happy to be alive and growing bigger every single day. As the warm afternoon sun began to dip low in the sky, Toby felt a little sleepy. He trotted back to his cozy leaf bed, curled up into a soft, striped ball, and closed his eyes. 'Goodnight, jungle,' whispered Toby as he drifted off to dream sweet, orange-and-black dreams.

stories.title: Toby Tiger Goes Splash
stories.text: It was a hot, sticky afternoon in the jungle, and little Toby Tiger was feeling very warm. Phew! The sun was shining brightly in the blue sky, and all the leaves were drooping from the heat. Toby needed a way to cool down. 'I know!' thought Toby, swishing his striped tail. 'I will go to the muddy watering hole!' Toby trotted through the tall green grass, making happy little paw-print steps all the way. When he arrived at the edge of the cool water, he poked his wet nose out to test the temperature. Brrr! It felt wonderfully refreshing. Without waiting another second, Toby leaped right into the shallow water. Splash! Water droplets flew everywhere like sparkling diamonds in the sunlight. Toby giggled and splashed his front paws up and down. Splash, splash, splash! A little frog popped up from a lily pad and croaked a friendly hello. 'Ribbit!' said the frog, and Toby giggled even louder. Toby loved the water. He wiggled his toes and kicked his back legs, floating gently on his tummy. Then, Toby had a wonderful idea. He rolled around in the soft, squishy mud at the edge of the pond. Squish, squash, squish! The cool mud felt so nice on his warm orange fur. He scooped up some mud with his paw and gave himself funny mud whiskers, just like a silly artist painting a picture. A passing butterfly fluttered down to see what Toby was doing, resting gently on his nose. Toby crossed his eyes to look at the pretty butterfly, making himself laugh. After playing in the water and mud for a long time, Toby was wonderfully cool and completely relaxed. He climbed out of the pond and shook his fur, sending a spray of water droplets flying into the air. Shake, shake, shake! Toby licked his paws clean and trotted back to his favorite resting spot under a shady green tree. With a contented sigh, he curled up in the cool shade and fell fast asleep, dreaming of splashing in the cool blue water.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Big Roar
stories.text: Deep in the green and leafy jungle, little Toby Tiger was practicing his very best big-boy roars. Toby was growing bigger every day, and he wanted to have a strong, impressive roar just like his papa. He puffed out his little furry chest, planted his four paws firmly on the soft ground, opened his mouth as wide as it could possibly go, and let out a sound. 'Squeak!' went Toby. Oh dear, that didn't sound like a fierce tiger at all! That sounded more like a tiny mouse. Toby giggled and tried again. He took a deep breath, puffed out his chest even more, and tried his loudest voice. 'Meow!' went Toby. That sounded just like a little kitty cat taking a nap on a porch. Toby sat down in the grass and scratched his head with one paw. How could he make a big tiger sound? Just then, his wise old papa tiger walked over, nuzzled Toby gently with his warm nose, and purred a soft, comforting sound. 'Do not worry, little one,' said Papa Tiger in a deep, rumbling voice. 'A big roar does not come from your mouth alone. It comes from a brave and happy heart.' Toby smiled. He took a deep breath of the sweet jungle air, thought about all the things he loved—his cozy bed, his splashing pond, and his wonderful family—and felt a warm, brave feeling grow right inside his tummy. He stood up tall on his tiptoes, opened his mouth wide, and let it all out. 'ROAR!' It wasn't the loudest roar in the whole world, but it was strong, and it was fierce, and it was all his own. All the jungle animals cheered and clapped their paws. Toby beamed with pride, swishing his striped tail happily. He was a real tiger, and he was ready for any adventure that came his way.

stories.title: Tilly Tiger's Tiptoe Day
stories.text: Once upon a sunny jungle day, little Tilly Tiger woke up and stretched her paws. Big stretch! Yawn! Today was a special day because Tilly wanted to play a very quiet game. She wanted to play tiptoe tag with her jungle friends. Tilly had soft orange fur with big black stripes, and her paws were as soft as fluffy marshmallows. She stepped out of her cozy leaf bed and whispered, 'Time to tiptoe!' First, Tilly saw Sammy Monkey swinging from a green vine. Sammy was eating a yummy yellow banana. Tilly wanted to surprise Sammy, so she put one orange paw down very, very softly. Tip. Tap. Then she put the other paw down. Tip. Tap. She crept behind a big fern bush and waited. Suddenly, Tilly popped out and said, 'Boo!' Sammy Monkey giggled and did a silly little flip. 'You found me, Tilly!' he chattered happily. Next, Tilly tiptoed down the mossy path toward the sparkling blue river. Who was splashing in the water? It was Benny Hippo! Benny was making big splashy bubbles with his nose. Glub, glub, pop! Tilly crept behind a tall reed and walked on her tiptoes. Tip, tap, tip, tap. She went right up to the water's edge and whispered, 'Hello, Benny Hippo!' Benny turned around with a big, wide smile and splashed a tiny drop of water right on Tilly's nose. Boop! Tilly giggled. It felt so cool and refreshing. After that, Tilly tiptoed through the tall grass until she found her mama. Mama Tiger was resting under a shady mango tree. Tilly walked up behind Mama and gave her a giant, warm hug. 'Mama, I played tiptoe tag all morning!' said Tilly proudly. Mama Tiger purred a deep, rumbling purr that sounded like a happy motor. 'You are the best tiptoer in the whole jungle, my sweet little tiger,' said Mama, giving Tilly a gentle nose kiss. The sun began to go down, painting the sky pink and orange, just like Tilly's fur. Tilly yawned a big tiger yawn. Playing all day made her very sleepy. She curled up right next to her mama, closed her eyes, and dreamed about tiptoeing through the happy jungle. Goodnight, Tilly Tiger.

stories.title: Tommy Tiger's Lost Stripe
stories.text: Tommy Tiger loved his stripes. He had one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight lovely black stripes painted right across his bright orange coat. They made him look very handsome. One morning, Tommy woke up and looked down at his tummy. Oh, no! One stripe was missing! Where could it be? Tommy looked under his leaf pillow. It was not there. He looked inside his coconut cup. It was not there either. Tommy began to worry. 'I cannot be a proper tiger without all my stripes!' he said. Just then, his friend Penny Parrot flew down from the canopy. 'Hello, Tommy! Why do you look so sad?' asked Penny, tilting her colorful head. Tommy sighed. 'I lost one of my black stripes, Penny. Have you seen it anywhere?' Penny blinked her bright round eyes. 'Let us look together!' So off they went on a big stripe hunt. They walked past the tall bamboo stalks. They looked under the big rubber tree leaves. They even checked inside a hollow log where a grumpy old turtle lived. But the stripe was nowhere to be found. Tommy sat down on a soft patch of grass and felt like he might cry a little tear. 'Don't give up, Tommy!' cheered Penny. Suddenly, a tiny voice called out from above. 'Excuse me, Mr. Tiger! Are you looking for this?' Tommy and Penny looked up. There was little Pip the Squirrel sitting on a branch, wearing Tommy's missing stripe right on his head like a silly top hat! Pip giggled and did a little spin. 'I found it blowing in the wind, and it makes a wonderful hat!' Tommy could not help but laugh. His tummy rumbled with joy. 'I am glad you like it, Pip, but that stripe belongs on my back.' Pip hopped down and carefully placed the stripe right back onto Tommy's orange fur. It stuck right back on with a little magic tickle. Tommy looked down and smiled his biggest smile. All eight stripes were back where they belonged! 'Thank you, little squirrel,' said Tommy happily. He gave Penny and Pip a friendly wave and skipped all the way home to dinner, feeling completely stripey and wonderful.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Big Roar
stories.text: Toby Tiger was a very little tiger with a very big dream. More than anything in the whole wide world, Toby wanted to have a big, booming, scary tiger roar. But whenever Toby opened his mouth to roar, all that came out was a tiny, funny sound. 'Squeak!' said Toby. He tried again. 'Meow!' said Toby. He shook his head and sighed. His big sister Tessie Tiger had a roar that could shake the leaves right off the trees. 'Rooaaar!' Tessie would shout, and the birds would fly up into the sky. Toby wanted to do that too. Today was the day of the jungle talent show, and Toby wanted to roar on stage. He practiced all morning long. He puffed out his little orange chest. He opened his mouth as wide as a giant cave. He pushed out all his breath and tried his very hardest. 'Squeak-squeak!' went Toby. The little butterflies fluttered around him, thinking he was just being playful. Toby sat down on a rock and drooped his furry tail. 'I will never have a big roar,' he whispered sadly. Just then, wise old Barnaby Bear walked by. Barnaby was big and fluffy, and he had a very deep, rumbly voice. 'What is the matter, little Toby?' asked Barnaby kindly. Toby looked up with big, round eyes. 'I want to roar like the big tigers, but I only make squeaky noises.' Barnaby Bear smiled warmly. 'Ah, Toby. A great roar doesn't come from being big. A great roar comes from being brave in your heart, and it takes time to grow!' Barnaby gave Toby a comforting pat on the head. Toby thought about what Barnaby said. He stood up tall on his little paws. He thought about how much he loved his jungle home, how much he loved his friends, and how brave he felt inside. He took a deep breath, opened his mouth wide, and tried once more. 'ROAR!' went Toby. Well, it wasn't quite as loud as Tessie's roar, and it had a little tiny squeak at the end, but it was strong and bold! Tessie Tiger clapped her paws together loudly. 'Hooray, Toby! That was a wonderful roar!' All the jungle animals cheered and clapped for Toby. Toby felt like the tallest, bravest tiger in the whole world. He smiled a big, toothy grin and gave one more happy little roar. The end.

stories.title: Toby Tiger Goes To Sleep
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a bright green jungle, lived a little tiger named Toby. Toby had soft orange fur and big black stripes. He also had a very soft tail that liked to swish, swish, swish back and forth in the warm breeze. Today, Toby had been playing all day long. He chased colorful butterflies. He jumped over bouncy mushrooms. He even splashed in a cool, bubbly puddle with his froggy friends. Ribbit, ribbit went the frogs! Splash, splash went Toby's paws! But now, the bright sun was starting to go down. The sky turned from blue to pink, and then to a sleepy purple. Toby let out a big yawn. Yaaaaawn! His little eyelids felt very, very heavy. 'Time for bed, little tiger,' whispered Mama Tiger, coming over to give him a big, cozy cuddle. Toby purred a happy rumble deep in his tummy. Purr, purr, purr. It sounded like a little motorboat. But first, Toby needed to find his favorite sleeping blanket. It was bright yellow and felt as soft as a cloud. He nuzzled his blanket with his nose. Sniff, sniff. Then, Toby curled up in his warm bed of green leaves. He closed his big brown eyes and dreamed about chasing shooting stars across the night sky. Goodnight, butterflies. Goodnight, bubbly puddle. Goodnight, little frogs. Goodnight, sweet Toby Tiger. Sleep tight until the morning sun comes up to play again.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Big Stomp
stories.text: Good morning, little jungle! The sun is peeking over the tall green trees, saying hello to the world. And who is waking up? It is Toby Tiger! Toby stretches his front paws way out high. Oooooh, big stretch! He wiggles his tail one, two, three times. Then, Toby decides it is time for a morning adventure. He wants to see how many sounds he can make in the jungle. First, Toby walks on the soft grass. Can you walk like Toby? Tap, tap, tap go his little paws. Then, Toby sees a big, muddy puddle right in the middle of his path. Should he walk around it? No way! Toby loves mud. He stomps right in the middle. Squish, squash, squelch! The mud bubbles up around his toes, and Toby giggles. Next, Toby finds a fallen log. He climbs right up to the very top and balances with his arms out wide. Balance, balance, oh! He wobbles like jelly, but he does not fall down. 'Roar!' says Toby, trying out his fierce tiger sound. But it is not a scary roar. It is a silly, friendly roar. 'Rooar-hee-hee!' All the little green frogs in the bushes laugh and jump up and down. A blue parrot in the tree squawks and flaps its colorful wings. Toby is so happy to have so many wonderful friends in the jungle. He dances a little happy jig, shaking his stripes from his head to his toes. What a wonderful day to be an active, happy tiger!

stories.title: Toby Tiger Finds a Friend
stories.text: Deep in the green jungle, Toby Tiger was looking for someone to play with today. He trotted along the dirt path, sniffing the sweet flowers. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Smelled like yummy mangoes! Up ahead, sitting under a big banana tree, was a little monkey named Milo. Milo had a long, curly tail and a bunch of yellow bananas. But Milo looked a little bit sad. His shoulders were slumped, and he was making a little sighing sound. Toby walked over quietly on his soft, padded paws. 'Hello, Milo,' said Toby in his kindest voice. 'Why are you sitting all by yourself?' Milo looked up and blinked his round brown eyes. 'I lost my favorite red bouncing ball,' said Milo sadly. 'It rolled away into the tall grass, and now I cannot find it anywhere.' Toby smiled a big, toothy tiger smile. 'Do not worry, Milo! I have a very good nose for finding things.' Toby put his nose right down to the ground. He sniffed to the left. He sniffed to the right. Then, he spotted a little flash of bright red shining near some green ferns. 'Aha! Found it!' barked Toby playfully. He trotted over and tapped the ball with his nose, rolling it right back to Milo's feet. Milo clapped his hands together and jumped up with joy. 'Yay! Thank you, Toby!' They played catch together all afternoon, tossing the bright red ball back and forth through the sunny jungle. Toby learned that helping a friend makes your own heart feel warm and happy inside.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Tickly Tail
stories.text: Once upon a sunny day in the bright green jungle, there lived a little orange tiger named Toby. Toby had big black stripes, shiny white whiskers, and a very long, very wiggly tail. Toby loved to play hide and seek with his jungle friends. Today, Toby wanted to play. He crouched low in the soft green grass. He whispered, 'Roar!' But his tail would not stay still. It went wiggle, wiggle, wag! Little Monkey was sitting up high in the banana tree. Little Monkey giggled and pointed. 'I see you, Toby! I see your wiggly tail!' Toby popped up from the grass and laughed. 'You found me!' Then, Toby saw Sammy Snake slithering by a big rock. Toby wanted to surprise Sammy. He tiptoed very softly. Pad, pad, pad went his little paws. But Toby's tail gave him away again! It swished back and forth, swish, swish, swish. Sammy turned around and smiled. 'Hello, Toby! I see your happy tail waving at me!' Toby sat down and hugged his tail. 'My tail has a mind of its own!' he said. Just then, Mama Tiger walked over with a basket of juicy red berries. 'Time for a snack, my little tiger,' she said warmly. Toby scampered over to his mama. He ate three sweet berries. Yum, yum, yum! After his snack, Toby felt very sleepy. He curled up in a cozy patch of warm sunlight. Mama Tiger wrapped her big, soft tail around Toby to keep him safe and warm. Toby closed his bright eyes and purred a happy little tiger purr. Goodnight, sweet Toby. Sweet dreams in the jungle.

stories.title: Tara Tiger's Muddy Adventure
stories.text: Deep in the whispering jungle, a little tiger cub named Tara woke up with a big yawn. 'Good morning, sun!' she said. Today was a very special day because it had rained all night long, and that meant one thing: puddles! Tara loved puddles. She scampered out of her cozy cave and looked around. The jungle was sparkling with bright raindrops. Tara bounced on her little paws. Boing, boing! She ran down the muddy path until she found the biggest, splashiest puddle in the whole wide world. It was brown, bubbly, and calling her name. Tara walked right up to the edge. She dipped one little paw into the water. 'Ooh, squishy!' she whispered with a giggle. Then she dipped her other paw. Squish, squach! Tara could not wait any longer. She jumped right into the middle of the puddle with a giant SPLASH! Mud flew up into the air like little brown fireworks. Mud got on her nose, her tummy, and even the tip of her ears. 'Look at me, I am a mud monster!' shouted Tara happily. Soon, her friend Benny the baby elephant came walking by. Benny had a long gray trunk. 'Can I play too, Tara?' asked Benny. 'Yes, come on in!' cried Tara. Benny scooped up cool water in his trunk and sprayed it high up into the sky. It made a wonderful rain shower over the puddle. Splash, splash, splash went their feet. They danced and giggled until the sun came out and dried up the puddles. Tara was very tired and very muddy. She trotted back to her mama, who smiled and gave her a warm bath with a wet leaf sponge. Scrub, scrub, scrub. Soon, Tara was clean, fluffy, and ready for a nice long nap.

stories.title: Timmy Tiger's Lost Stripe
stories.text: Timmy Tiger was a very happy little tiger who lived near a sparkling blue river. He had orange fur and lovely black stripes. One morning, Timmy woke up and looked down at his tummy. He blinked once. He blinked twice. Oh no! One of his black stripes was missing! Timmy looked on his bed. No stripe there. He looked under his pillow. Just a soft green leaf. 'Oh dear,' whimpered Timmy. 'How can I be a proper tiger without all of my stripes?' He decided to go on a big adventure to find his lost stripe. He walked down the jungle path and met Ellie the gentle elephant. 'Hello, Ellie. Have you seen my black stripe? It looks like a wiggly line.' Ellie shook her big gray head. 'No, Timmy, I have not seen it. But let's look together!' They walked past the tall bamboo trees and asked Polly the green parrot. Polly squawked, 'Squawk! I saw something black and wiggly blowing in the wind near the berry bush!' Timmy and Ellie hurried over to the big berry bush. Timmy looked behind the green leaves. Guess what he found? It was not a stripe at all! It was a funny little black butterfly with lovely wings. The butterfly landed right on Timmy's nose and fluttered gently. Timmy laughed and sneezed a tiny tiger sneeze. Ah-choo! As he laughed, he looked down at his paws again. Wait a minute! All of his stripes were right there, safe and sound on his furry coat. They had just been hiding while he rolled in his sleep. Timmy did a happy little dance. 'Found them!' he cheered. He thanked his good friends Ellie and Polly, and skipped all the way home for a delicious cup of warm milk with his loving family.

stories.title: Timmy Tiger Tries New Shoes
stories.text: Once upon a time, deep in the bright green jungle, lived a little tiger named Timmy. Timmy had very soft orange fur, dark black stripes, and a very happy tail that liked to swish, swish, swish from side to side. One sunny morning, Timmy woke up and found a big red box right outside his cozy leaf bed. 'What is this?' whispered Timmy, his whiskers twitching with excitement. He opened the box with his paw and gasped. Inside were two shiny yellow shoes with big blue laces. 'Shoes!' cheered Timmy. He decided right then and there that he wanted to wear his new yellow shoes for a big walk through the jungle. First, Timmy tried to put the left shoe on his right ear. 'Silly Timmy!' giggled a tiny green frog sitting on a lily pad. 'Shoes go on your feet!' Timmy laughed a big tiger laugh. 'Oh! Of course!' So, Timmy picked up the yellow shoe and gently slid it onto his big front paw. Then he put the other shoe on his other front paw. He stood up tall, but wobbled, wibble-wobble, wibble-wobble. 'Stomp, stomp, stomp!' went the yellow shoes on the soft dirt path. Timmy felt like the fanciest tiger in the whole wide world. He walked past the tall bamboo stalks and waved to his friends. 'Hello, monkey!' called Timmy. The monkey swung down from a branch and pointed at Timmy's feet. 'Ooh ooah! Look at those bright yellow shoes!' Timmy did a little happy dance. Spin, hop, jump! But wait. *Squeak, squeak, squish.* The yellow shoes made funny noises every time Timmy took a step. *Squeak, squeak, squish!* Timmy thought the noise was the funniest sound he had ever heard. He stomped louder. *STOMP, STOMP, STOMP!* He giggled so hard he fell right onto a soft patch of moss. The sun was getting warm, and Timmy started to feel very sleepy. He realized that running around in shiny shoes was super fun, but his paws missed the cool, squishy mud. So, Timmy untied the blue laces and slipped the shoes off. He wiggled his bare toes. Ahh, much better! Timmy put the yellow shoes neatly back in their big red box for another day. Then, with a big yawn and a cozy stretch, little Timmy Tiger curled up for a nice, long afternoon nap.

stories.title: Tari Tiger Counts the Stars
stories.text: Nighttime had finally come to the sleepy jungle, painting the sky a deep, sparkly indigo. Little Tari Tiger sat on top of her favorite mossy rock, looking straight up into the big, beautiful sky. Tari loved the daytime, but nighttime was her absolute favorite because that was when the glowing stars came out to play. Tari's mother sat right beside her, wrapping her warm, furry tail around Tari to keep her snug. 'Mama,' whispered Tari softly, her big amber eyes wide with wonder, 'how many stars are twinkling up there in the dark sky?' Mama Tiger smiled a warm, gentle smile and nuzzled Tari's ear. 'There are more stars than all the stripes on your back, my little one,' Mama whispered back. Tari looked down at her own furry paws, then back up at the sky. She decided right then that she was going to count every single star she could see before bedtime. 'One little star, shining so bright,' whispered Tari, pointing a tiny paw straight up at the heavens. 'Two little stars, twinkling all night.' A friendly little owl flew down from a high branch, landed softly on the rock, and hooted a sweet melody. 'Hoo-hoo,' sang the owl, 'let us count together!' Tari clapped her paws together with glee. 'Three little stars, high in the sky! Four little stars, flying so high!' The jungle was wonderfully quiet around them. The crickets were playing their nighttime violin music, rubbing their legs together to make a gentle *chirp, chirp, chirp* sound. Tari kept counting. Five, six, seven, eight! The stars seemed to dance and wink just for her. They looked like little pieces of glittering gold sprinkled across a giant velvet blanket. Tari let out a very long, very loud tiger yawn. *Yaaaawn!* Her eyelids felt as heavy as giant boulders. The stars began to blur together into one big, beautiful, glowing cloud of sleepy dust. Mama Tiger pulled Tari closer, resting her chin gently on Tari's head. 'You did a wonderful job counting today, my sweet little star,' Mama purred softly. Tari closed her heavy eyes, feeling safe, warm, and deeply loved. As she drifted off to dreamland, she imagined herself floating up among the sparkling lights, sleeping on a soft cloud made of pure, golden starlight. Good night, Tari Tiger. Sleep tight.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Big Bubble Trouble
stories.text: It was a wonderful, breezy Tuesday afternoon, and Toby Tiger was having the best time playing in his backyard garden. Toby loved bubbles more than anything else in the whole world. His friend Penny Penguin had given him a special bottle of magical bubble liquid and a red plastic wand shaped like a star. Toby dipped the star wand deep into the soapy water, pulled it out very slowly, and puffed his cheeks out like two big red balloons. *Huuuuuuuh...* Then, with a gentle *whoosh*, Toby blew a breath of air right through the wand. *POP!* Out came a giant, shimmering bubble that shimmered with all the colors of the rainbow. Pink, green, blue, and gold swirled around the surface of the bubble as it floated gently into the warm air. 'Look at you go!' squealed Toby, clapping his paws together. The bubble drifted past a yellow sunflower, bounced gently off a friendly ladybug's back, and floated higher and higher toward the sky. Toby chased after it, running on his tiptoes so he wouldn't pop it by accident. *Tip-toe, tip-toe, pounce!* But Toby was just a little too excited. He took a big leap forward to catch the bubble, tripped over his own striped tail, and tumbled head over heels into a patch of soft, green grass. *Whoops-a-daisy!* Toby sat up, blinking his big brown eyes, expecting to feel sad. Instead, he started to giggle. A whole bunch of tiny bubbles landed right on his nose! *Pop, pop, pop!* went the soapy bubbles, tickling his fuzzy black-and-orange snout. Toby crossed his eyes to look at his nose, making himself look wonderfully silly. A butterfly fluttered down to see what all the fuss was about. Toby grabbed his star wand again, dipped it back into the soapy water, and blew another huge cloud of bubbles just for his new insect friend. The garden was filled with floating, shimmering spheres of joy. Toby played until the sun began to sink low behind the trees, painting the sky in shades of purple and orange. With a happy sigh, Toby washed his paws in a cool puddle, packed up his bubble wand, and trotted happily back inside his den, ready for sweet dreams of bubbles.

stories.title: Toby's Orange Stripes
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a bright green jungle, lived a little tiger cub named Toby. Toby had fuzzy orange fur and big black stripes. Every morning, Toby woke up with a big stretch. Yawn! He wiggled his little pink nose and blinked his bright green eyes. Today was a very special day because Toby was going to learn how to pounce! His mama, a big gentle tiger, smiled down at him. 'Are you ready, my little stripe?' she asked. Toby nodded his head very fast. 'Yes, Mama! I am ready!' First, Toby had to practice walking softly. He tiptoed across the soft grass. Tip-toe, tip-toe, went his tiny paws. Not a single leaf made a crunch sound! Next, Toby had to hide behind a big green fern leaf. He tucked his tail in and made himself super duper small. He waited for Mama Tiger to walk by. One, two, three—POUNCE! Toby leaped out from behind the leaf and landed right on a squishy pile of moss. 'Rawr!' squeaked Toby in his highest, silliest voice. Mama Tiger laughed and scooped Toby up in a big furry hug. 'Oh, what a fierce little tiger you are!' she purred, giving him a warm lick right on his forehead. Toby giggled and snuggled close to her warm tummy. It was so much fun being a little tiger in the green jungle. But soon, Toby's tummy began to rumble. Time for breakfast! Mama and Toby walked together to the cool river to take a sip of water. Slurp, slurp, went their pink tongues. Then they found a yummy patch of sweet jungle berries. Munch, munch, munch! After they ate, Toby started to feel a little bit sleepy. The warm sun was shining down through the tall trees, making everything feel cozy and nice. Mama Tiger curled her big body into a soft circle, and Toby curled up right inside. He closed his heavy eyes and listened to the gentle sound of the jungle birds singing lullabies. Toby smiled in his sleep as he dreamed all about his very first pounce. Goodnight, little Toby.

stories.title: Tara's Jungle Adventure
stories.text: Deep in the leafy jungle, a baby tiger named Tara woke up from her nap. Tara loved adventures more than anything else in the world. Today, she wore her favorite imaginary explorer hat on her fuzzy head. She looked around and whispered, 'Let's go find something wonderful!' Tara stepped out of her cozy cave and blinked at the bright yellow sunshine. First, she hopped over a tiny log. Hop, hop, went Tara! Then, she crawled under a big green vine. Creep, creep, went Tara! As she walked down the winding dirt path, she heard a funny sound. Chitter-chatter, chitter-chatter! Tara stopped and looked up high into the leafy branches of a tall banana tree. Who could that be? Peeking out from behind a yellow banana was a funny little monkey with a long curly tail. The monkey waved a paw and made a silly face at Tara. Tara giggled and waved her paw right back. 'Hello, monkey friend!' she called out happily. The monkey swung from branch to branch, showing Tara how high he could go. Tara tried to swing her little tail just like the monkey, but she tripped on her own paws and tumbled right into a soft patch of yellow flowers. Achoo! Tara sneezed a big tiger sneeze. A butterfly with sparkling blue wings fluttered down and landed right on the tip of Tara's nose. Tara crossed her eyes to look at the pretty butterfly. It tickled so much! The butterfly danced away into the bright blue sky. Tara skipped along the path until she reached a sparkling blue waterfall. Splash, splash, went the cool water as it tumbled down the rocks. Tara dipped one furry paw into the water. Brrr, it was so cool and refreshing! She splashed a tiny bit of water and laughed out loud. The jungle was full of so many amazing things to see and do. But soon, the sun began to sink low in the sky, painting the clouds pink and orange. Tara's little legs felt very tired. She turned around and trotted all the way back to her cozy jungle home. Her mama was waiting with open paws. Tara snuggled up tight, feeling so happy about her wonderful day of adventure.

stories.title: Timmy Tiger's Lost Toy
stories.text: Timmy Tiger loved his favorite toy more than all the other toys in the jungle. It was a little stuffed monkey named Coco that was super soft and squeaked when you squeezed his tummy. One sunny afternoon, Timmy was playing hide and seek with his animal friends near the muddy riverbank. 'Ready or not, here I come!' shouted Timmy, covering his eyes with his paws. He counted to ten and then went looking for his friends. He looked behind the tall green bushes. He looked under the big flat rocks. But nobody was there! Instead, Timmy found a trail of sticky honey drops on the ground. Oh, yummy! But wait—where was Coco? Timmy reached for his pocket, but it was completely empty. Oh no! His favorite toy monkey was gone! Timmy's big green eyes filled up with tears. He let out a little whimpering sound. 'Oh, where is my dear Coco?' he cried softly. Just then, Sammy the Squirrel popped out from behind a tree holding the little squeaky monkey high up in the air. 'Surprise!' cheered Sammy. 'We found him floating near the water!' Timmy wiped away his tears and let out a huge gasp of joy. He ran as fast as his little legs could carry him and gave Sammy a giant tiger hug. 'Thank you, thank you!' squealed Timmy happily. He took Coco the monkey and squeezed his tummy. Squeak, squeak! went Coco, sounding happier than ever. Timmy held his favorite toy very tightly so he would never lose him again. All the jungle animals gathered around to celebrate, dancing in a circle around Timmy and his toy. They played silly games together until the stars came twinkling out in the night sky. Timmy climbed into his bed with Coco tucked safely under his paw. He hugged them both close and closed his eyes with a happy heart. What a wonderful day it turned out to be for Timmy Tiger and his best friend.

stories.title: Timmy Tiger's Soft Pajamas
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a cozy jungle nook, lived a little tiger named Timmy. Timmy had bright orange fur and big, brown stripes that looked just like wiggly chocolate roads. Now, Timmy was a very happy tiger, but when the big yellow sun went down behind the tall green trees, Timmy did not want to go to sleep. Oh no! Timmy wanted to play. He wanted to leap over logs. He wanted to chase the fluttery fireflies. He wanted to roar at the moon. But Timmy's mommy tiger knew that little tigers needed lots and lots of rest to grow big and strong. Mommy Tiger gently scooped Timmy up in her warm, furry paws. 'It is time for bed, my sweet little cub,' she whispered, booping his wet black nose. Timmy let out a tiny yawn. *Yaaawn!* It was a very big yawn for a very small tiger. Mommy Tiger carried Timmy to their cozy sleeping den. The den was filled with soft moss and fluffy green leaves that made the best bed in the whole wide world. But wait! Timmy needed his special bedtime helper. He needed his silly bedtime pajamas! Mommy Tiger brought out the pajamas. They were bright blue with little yellow stars all over them. Timmy wiggle-waggled his right leg into the pants. One, two! Then he wiggled his left leg. Three, four! Next, he put his paws through the sleeves. Pop, pop! Timmy looked down at his paws. He looked like a starry night sky. 'Roar!' whispered Timmy, but it was a sleepy, quiet roar. Mommy Tiger tucked a big green leaf blanket right under Timmy's chin. She softly stroked his orange head and sang a sweet jungle lullaby about sleepy monkeys and resting rivers. Timmy closed his big brown eyes. He thought about his fun day and his starry pajamas. He felt safe, warm, and oh so sleepy. Slowly, Timmy drifted off to dreamland, ready for another big adventure when the morning sun woke up. Goodnight, Timmy Tiger. Goodnight.

stories.title: Timmy Tiger Finds a Red Ball
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! Today was a bright and beautiful day in the jungle, and Timmy Tiger was ready to play. Timmy bounded out of his cozy leaf bed, stretched his front paws way out high, and let out a bouncy, happy bounce. *Boing! Boing!* Timmy trotted down the twisty jungle path, looking for something fun to do. He looked under a large fern. He looked up at a tall coconut tree. Then, rolling right out of the bushes, came a big, round, shiny red ball! *Boing, bounce, roll!* Timmy stopped and blinked his big brown eyes. What could this shiny red thing be? It was not a banana. It was not a coconut. It was round like the sun and red like a sweet jungle strawberry. Timmy reached out one paw and gave the ball a little tap. *Boop!* The ball rolled away, giggling a funny bouncing sound. Timmy chased after it! *Tap, tap, go!* He trotted fast on his little paws, his orange tail swishing back and forth in the warm breeze. He ran past a friendly green frog sitting on a lily pad. 'Ribbit, ribbit, go Timmy!' croaked the frog. Timmy ran past a sleepy monkey hanging by his tail. 'Ooh-ooh, catch the ball!' chattered the monkey. Timmy giggled. He loved playing games. He trotted a little faster, zoomed around a big muddy puddle, and pounced right on top of the red ball with a soft *thud!* He held the ball tight with his front paws so it could not run away anymore. Timmy nuzzled the red ball with his nose. It was smooth and bouncy and so much fun. Timmy decided to share his new game with all his jungle friends. He rolled the ball to the green frog, who kicked it back with a splash. Then he rolled it to the monkey, who tossed it high in the air. Timmy clapped his paws together and let out a happy tiger roar. Playing together was the best part of the whole day.

stories.title: Timmy Tiger's Splish-Splash Day
stories.text: Phew! It was a very hot day in the jungle. The big yellow sun was shining bright in the blue sky, and Timmy Tiger was feeling hot, hot, hot. His orange fur felt warm, and his tongue was hanging out just a little bit. *Pant, pant, pant.* Timmy needed to cool down. He trotted through the tall green grass until he heard a wonderful sound. *Splash, splash, gurgle, gurgle!* It was the cool jungle river! The river water sparkled like a million little diamonds in the sunshine. Timmy hurried as fast as his little paws could carry him right to the muddy edge of the water. He peeked down at the river and saw his own fuzzy reflection looking right back up at him. Timmy gave a little wave with his paw. The reflection waved back! Timmy stepped one front paw into the water. *Ooh!* It felt so cool and refreshing on his toes. He stepped his other front paw in. *Ahhh!* Timmy smiled a big tiger smile. He waded a little deeper until the water tickled his tummy. Then, Timmy decided it was time for some real fun. He splashed the water with his paws! *Splash, splash, splash!* Water droplets flew everywhere like shiny rain. A little yellow duck swimming nearby quacked happily. 'Quack, quack! Splash with me!' Timmy ducked his head down and made bubbles in the water. *Bloop, bloop, bloop!* He practiced swimming like a big brave tiger, kicking his back legs softly. *Kick, kick, glide.* Timmy felt like he was flying through the cool blue river. After a long time of splashing and playing, Timmy climbed out onto the soft, warm riverbank. He shook his fur from the tip of his nose to the end of his tail. *Shake, shake, shake!* Water flew everywhere, making a rainbow in the air. Timmy curled up in a patch of warm sunshine to dry off. He closed his eyes and listened to the gentle river flowing by. He was cool, he was dry, and he was completely happy. What a wonderful day to be a little tiger.

stories.title: Tilly Tiger's Tiptoe Day
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a bright green jungle, lived a little tiger named Tilly. Tilly had soft orange fur, dark black stripes, and a very wiggly tail. Every morning, the sun would peek through the tall trees and say, 'Good morning, Tilly!' Today, Tilly woke up with a big stretch. Stretch your arms up high like Tilly! 'Roar!' whispered Tilly, but her roar was so tiny it sounded like a little kitten. 'Squeak!' laughed her friend, a little monkey swinging from a vine. Tilly wanted to play hide-and-seek. 'Can you find me?' she called out. Tilly tiptoed softly on her big paws. Tip-toe, tip-toe, tip-toe! She hid behind a big, green fern. She tucked her orange tail in very carefully so no one could see it. Monkey swung up high. 'Where is Tilly?' asked Monkey, scratching his head. Monkey looked under a leaf. No Tilly! Monkey looked behind a rock. No Tilly! Then, monkey heard a little giggle coming from the fern. 'Aha! I see stripes!' shouted Monkey. Tilly jumped out with a happy grin. 'Boo!' she cried, and they both giggled. Next, Tilly felt very hungry. Her tummy went grumble, rumble, tummy-rumble! 'Time for breakfast,' said Mama Tiger, who came walking through the trees with a big bowl of yummy jungle berries. Tilly gobbled up the red berries and drank some cool water from the sparkling stream. Slurp, slurp, ahh! After breakfast, Tilly felt a little bit sleepy. The warm sun was shining down, making her feel cozy and safe. Mama Tiger wrapped her warm, soft tail around Tilly and hummed a sweet jungle lullaby. Close your eyes, little tiger. Goodnight, Tilly. Sweet dreams in the jungle.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Lost Stripe
stories.text: Deep in the whisker-waving woods, a little tiger named Toby was getting ready for the big Jungle Dance. Toby loved to dance. He could twist, he could turn, and he could shake his fuzzy tail. But today, Toby looked in the puddle mirror and gasped. Oh no! One of his wonderful black stripes was missing! Toby touched his orange side. Where did stripe number three go? 'Oh dear,' whispered Toby. 'How can I dance without all my stripes?' Just then, his best friend Bella the butterfly fluttered down. 'What is the matter, Toby?' asked Bella. 'I lost my stripe!' cried Toby. 'Let us look for it together,' said kind Bella. They searched under the big mushrooms. No stripe there. They looked up in the coconut trees. No stripe there either! Toby felt like crying, but then he saw a little squirrel hopping nearby. The squirrel was wearing something funny on his head. It was long, dark, and looked awfully familiar! 'Excuse me, little squirrel,' said Toby politely. 'Is that my stripe?' The squirrel giggled. 'I thought it was a very fancy scarf!' The squirrel handed the stripe back to Toby. Toby smiled a big, happy smile. He stuck the stripe right back onto his fuzzy orange tummy. Sticky-stuck! Now Toby was ready for the party. The music started playing. Boom, boom, beat! All the jungle animals gathered around in a circle. Toby did a spin. He did a jump. He shook his tail and stomped his feet. Left, right, twist, and turn! The monkey clapped. The parrot squawked with joy. Toby was the happiest tiger in the whole wide world, dancing with all his friends until the stars came out to twinkle in the night sky.

stories.title: Timmy Tiger Paints the Jungle
stories.text: Timmy Tiger loved bright colors. He loved yellow bananas, blue sky, and green grass. One sunny afternoon, Timmy found a big box of finger paints left by a friendly jungle explorer. The box had red paint, blue paint, and sunny yellow paint! Timmy dipped his paw right into the red paint. Squish, squash, squosh! 'Look what I can do!' said Timmy. He pressed his red paw print onto a large, smooth rock. Stamp, went his paw! Then, Timmy washed his paw in the sparkling river. Splash, splash, clean! Next, Timmy dipped his paw into the bright yellow paint. Squish, squash, squosh! He stamped a yellow paw print right next to the red one. Wow, it looked like a glowing sunshine! His friend Ellie the elephant walked by and trumpeted, 'Toot, toot! That is so pretty, Timmy!' Timmy wanted to make a big picture for everyone to see. He used all his paws. Red on the left, yellow on the right, and a little splash of blue in the middle. The jungle looked like a rainbow of happiness. All the animals came running to see Timmy's colorful artwork. The little monkeys clapped their hands together. The birds sang a happy painting song. Timmy felt so proud and joyful. When the sun began to set, painting time was over. Timmy washed his paws in the cool river until they were clean and soft again. He curled up in his cozy den with Mama Tiger, ready for a good night's rest after such a creative and wonderful day in the colorful, beautiful jungle.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Stripey Day
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a bright green jungle filled with tall banana trees and big leafy ferns, lived a little tiger named Toby. Toby had soft orange fur and big, bold black stripes. Every morning, Toby would wake up, stretch his front paws way up high, give a big tiger yawn, and say, 'Good morning, jungle!' Today was a very special day because Toby wanted to find his favorite thing in the whole wide world: crunchy, sweet yellow mangoes! Toby hopped out of his cozy leaf bed and bounced on his soft little paws. He walked down the twisty-turny path until he met his friend Sammy the Monkey. 'Good morning, Sammy!' chirped Toby. 'Good morning, Toby!' giggled Sammy. 'Are you ready for a big jungle adventure?' Toby nodded his head. 'Yes! I am looking for yummy mangoes for my breakfast.' Sammy pointed up into the sky. 'Follow me, Toby! I know just where the biggest and sweetest mangoes grow.' So, away they went, skipping and hopping through the warm sunshine. They walked past a sparkly blue river where little pink fish leaped and splashed. Splash, splash, go the fish! Toby giggled. They walked past a sleepy green frog who went hop, hop, hop. Soon, they reached a giant tree with leaves as big as umbrellas. And right at the very top hung three round, golden-yellow mangoes. 'Oh boy!' cheered Toby. But oh dear, the tree was much too tall for Toby to reach. He jumped up, but he was just a little too short. Oh no! What should Toby do? Sammy the Monkey smiled a big monkey smile. 'Don't worry, Toby! I am the best tree climber in the jungle.' Up, up, up went Sammy, swinging from branch to branch like a happy little acrobatic star. He picked the three big mangoes and tossed them gently down. Catch! Toby caught one in his paws. They sat down together on the soft green grass and took a big, juicy bite. Crunch, munch, yum! The mangoes were so sweet and delicious. Toby felt so happy. He had his best friend Sammy, a tummy full of yummy fruit, and a wonderful jungle to explore. As the warm afternoon sun began to dip behind the tall trees, Toby gave another big tiger yawn. It was time for a nice, long tiger nap. Toby curled up in his cozy bed, closed his eyes, and dreamed sweet dreams about stripes, sunshine, and mangoes.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Lost Toy
stories.text: Deep in the green and leafy jungle, where the flowers bloom in bright pinks and yellows, lived a sweet little tiger named Timmy. Timmy loved to play games, but his absolute favorite thing in the whole world was his cuddly red ball. It was round, it was bouncy, and it made a happy squeak every time Timmy squeezed it with his paws. One sunny morning, Timmy woke up and shouted, 'Time to play with my squeaky red ball!' He reached under his big leafy blanket, but the ball wasn't there. He looked behind the log. He looked under a big fern. But the red ball was gone! Timmy let out a little sad tiger sniffle. 'Oh no, where could my ball be?' Just then, his friend Bella the Butterfly fluttered by. 'Why are you sad, Timmy?' she asked gently. 'I lost my squeaky red ball,' Timmy whispered. Bella smiled and flapped her colorful wings. 'Don't you worry! We will look high and low until we find it.' So off they went on a grand search. First, they hopped over to the sparkly blue stream. 'Hello, Mr. Frog,' called Timmy. 'Did you see a round red ball?' The green frog blinked his big round eyes and said, 'Ribbit! No, I haven't seen a ball, but I did see something red bouncing near the berry bushes.' Timmy and Bella thanked the frog and hurried over to the berry bushes. They peeked through the leafy green branches. Guess what they saw? There was Benny the Bunny, playing gently with the squeaky red ball! 'Boing, boing!' went the ball. Benny saw Timmy and his ears drooped. 'Oh, hello Timmy. I found this wonderful bouncy ball, and I wanted to play too.' Timmy smiled a big, warm tiger smile. He wasn't mad at all. 'We can share it, Benny!' Benny squealed with joy. 'Really? Yay!' So, the three happy friends played together all afternoon. Timmy rolled the ball to Benny, Benny bounced it back to Timmy, and Bella danced all around them in the warm sunshine. Timmy realized that sharing made playing even more fun than playing all by himself. As the sun began to set, painting the sky in shades of pink and orange, Timmy hugged his squeaky red ball tight. He trotted home with a very happy heart, ready for a cozy night's sleep in his jungle bed.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Rainy Day
stories.text: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter, went the raindrops on the big green leaves of the jungle. Little Tara Tiger woke up, opened her big bright eyes, and looked outside her cozy den. The sky was filled with big gray clouds, and the ground was covered in puddles of water. 'Oh no,' sighed Tara. 'It is raining outside. Now I cannot run and play in the sunny meadow.' She sat down on her soft rug and felt a little bit grumpy. But then, her wise mama tiger walked over and nuzzled Tara's soft cheek. 'A rainy day is not a sad day, my little stripey cub,' Mama whispered softly. 'A rainy day is a magical day for indoor adventures.' Tara perked up her furry ears. 'Magical adventures?' Mama nodded with a smile. 'Let us pretend our den is a pirate ship sailing on a stormy sea.' Tara clapped her paws together. 'Yes! Let us do that!' Suddenly, the cozy den wasn't just a den anymore. It was a big wooden ship. Tara put on a leaf hat and stood tall at the front of the ship, pretending to steer the wheel. 'Ahooyyy!' she roared in her loudest, proudest tiger voice. 'Look out for big waves!' Pitter-patter went the rain outside, sounding just like the ocean splashing against their boat. Next, Tara and her mama played jungle hide-and-seek. Tara hid behind a big pile of soft blankets, covering her eyes with her paws. Mama walked around making funny little stomping noises. 'Where is my little tiger?' Mama wondered out loud. Tara popped up and shouted, 'Roar! Here I am!' Mama pretended to fall over in surprise, and Tara giggled until her tummy hurt. After all the fun games, the rain slowly stopped falling. Pitter-patter, pitter, pat, stop. A bright, beautiful rainbow stretched right across the sky, shining with red, yellow, green, and blue light. Tara ran outside on her little paws and splashed right into a big, sparkly puddle. Splash, splash, go the puddles! The air smelled so fresh and sweet. Tara looked up at the rainbow and smiled a big, happy smile. She realized that rainy days could be just as wonderful as sunny days, especially when you have imagination and a loving mama to play with.

stories.title: Toby Tiger Goes To Sleep
stories.text:
Once upon a time, in a bright green jungle, there lived a little tiger named Toby. Toby had soft orange fur, big black stripes, and a very wiggly tail. It was almost bedtime, but Toby was not tired at all! He wanted to play hide-and-seek with his jungle friends.

First, Toby tiptoed over to the tall bamboo trees. 'Can you see me?' whispered Toby. Suddenly, a little green frog hopped by and said, 'Ribbit! I see your wiggly tail, Toby!' Toby giggled. 'You found me!' 

Next, Toby bounced over to a patch of big, leafy ferns. He curled up into a little orange ball, hiding his face in his paws. A friendly monkey swung down from a vine, chattering softly, 'Ooh-ooh-aah-aah! I see your furry ears, Toby!' Toby laughed and jumped up. 'You are too good at this game!'

By now, the sun was beginning to go down. The sky turned a pretty pink and purple. Toby started to yawn. *Yaaaawn!* His eyes felt very heavy, like they had little rocks on them. 

Momma Tiger walked over and gave Toby a warm, cozy nuzzle. 'Time for bed, my little stripey cub,' she whispered gently. She led Toby to their soft bed made of fluffy moss and sweet-smelling leaves. Toby crawled right in and snuggled deep down.

Momma Tiger sang a sweet lullaby about the gentle jungle breeze. Toby closed his eyes. He thought about his fun day playing hide-and-seek with the frog and the monkey. He gave one last little yawn, let out a soft purr, and drifted off to a wonderful, peaceful sleep. Good night, Toby Tiger. Sweet dreams.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Big Splash
stories.text:
It was a hot, sunny morning in the jungle, and little Toby Tiger was feeling very warm. The sun was shining brightly, and the air felt like a big, warm hug. Toby wiped his furry forehead with his paw and said, 'Phew! It is so warm today!' 

Momma Tiger smiled and pointed through the trees. 'Why don't we go visit the cool jungle river, Toby?' she suggested. Toby's eyes lit up. He loved water! 

*Pitter-patter, pitter-patter!* Toby bounded through the tall grass, his stripes blurring as he ran. When they reached the river, the water sparkled like diamonds in the sun. Little fish were swimming back and forth, making tiny bubbles at the top. 

At first, Toby dipped just one toe into the water. *Brrr!* 'It is nice and cool!' he giggled. He stepped in a little further, up to his ankles. Then up to his tummy. 

Suddenly, a mischievous little monkey threw a small splash of water right at Toby! *Splash!* 'Got you!' chattered the monkey. Toby grinned from ear to ear. 'Oh yeah? Take this!' 

Toby stomped his paws in the water, sending a giant, sparkling wave into the air. *Splash-splash-splash!* Water droplets flew everywhere, catching the sunlight and turning into tiny rainbow sprinkles. Toby laughed out loud, splashing and kicking until he was completely soaked from his head to his tail. 

When they were all finished playing, Toby shook himself off just like a wet puppy. *Shake, shake, shake!* Water flew everywhere. He felt so refreshed and happy. Snuggled safely next to Momma Tiger on the warm riverbank, Toby smiled. Water play was simply the best.

stories.title: Toby Tiger Shares A Toy
stories.text:
Little Toby Tiger had a brand new shiny red ball. It bounced very high when he pushed it, and it rolled super fast through the green grass. Toby loved his new ball more than anything in the whole wide world.

One sunny afternoon, while Toby was playing near the big watering hole, his friend Lily the lion cub walked up. Lily had a friendly smile and a fluffy mane. She looked at the shiny red ball and said, 'Hi Toby! That is a very nice ball.' 

For a split second, Toby pulled the ball a little closer to his tummy. He didn't want to share his favorite toy! But then, he remembered how much fun it was to play together. 

Toby took a deep breath, smiled, and said, 'Hi Lily! Do you want to play catch with me?' Lily's eyes widened with joy. 'I would love to, Toby!' 

Toby rolled the shiny red ball across the grass. *Roll, roll, roll!* Lily stopped it gently with her paw and rolled it right back. *Roll, roll, roll!* 

They played back and forth for a long, long time. Sometimes the ball rolled crookedly into the bushes, and they both had to crawl in and find it together, laughing the whole time. Sharing made the game twice as fun!

When they were all done playing, Toby and Lily sat side by side in the warm grass, resting their paws. Toby felt a warm, fuzzy feeling in his tummy. Sharing his shiny red ball didn't make him sad at all; it made him a wonderful new friend. And that was the best prize of all.

stories.title: Toby Tiger Wakes Up
stories.text:
Once upon a sunny morning, in the middle of the bright green jungle, lived a little tiger named Toby. Toby had soft orange fur with big, beautiful black stripes. He had a pink nose, two fuzzy ears, and a long tail that liked to swish, swish, swish back and forth. Today was a very special day because Toby was going on a big adventure to find his favorite thing in the whole wide world: crunchy, sweet yellow bananas? No! Silly Toby, tigers do not eat bananas! Toby was looking for a big, mud puddle to splash in!

Toby stretched his front paws way, way up high. Oooooh, big stretch! He let out a tiny little yawn. Roar! Well, it sounded more like a squeak, but Toby thought it was a very fierce tiger sound. He hopped right out of his cozy leaf bed and started to walk down the winding jungle path. Tap, tap, tap went his little paws on the soft dirt.

Along the way, Toby met his very good friend, Mimi the monkey. Mimi was swinging from a hanging vine. 'Good morning, Toby Tiger!' chattered Mimi. 'Where are you going today?' Toby stopped and wiggled his stripes. 'I am looking for a muddy puddle to splash in! Do you want to come with me?' Mimi clapped her hands. 'Yes, yes! Let us go find some mud!'

Toby and Mimi walked together, skipping and hopping through the tall grass. They saw colorful butterflies flutter by. Flutter, flutter, go the wings! They heard green parrots singing in the trees. Squawk, squawk, go the birds! Toby looked high and low. He looked behind big bushes and under giant fern leaves. Where could that muddy puddle be?

Suddenly, Toby smelled something wet and squishy. Sniff, sniff, sniff went his pink nose. 'Aha!' shouted Toby. He dashed around a huge bamboo stalk, and right there in the middle of the path was the biggest, squishiest, mud puddle ever! It was shimmering in the warm sunlight.

Toby could not wait another second. He ran right up to the edge and jumped right in. Splash! Mud went up, mud went down, mud went all over Toby’s orange fur! 'Wheee!' giggled Toby, making big mud pies with his paws. Mimi monkey laughed and cheered from a safe, clean branch. Toby Tiger was the happiest tiger in the jungle. He played and splashed until the sun began to go down, painting the sky in pink and purple. It was time for bed, but Toby knew tomorrow would bring another wonderful day of jungle fun.

stories.title: Toby Tiger Counts the Stars
stories.text:
The sun was finally saying goodbye to the jungle, turning the fluffy clouds into soft pillows of pink and gold. Little Toby Tiger finished eating his yummy dinner and licked his paws clean. Slurp, slurp, slurp! It was almost time for sleep, but Toby was not quite ready to close his eyes yet. He loved the quiet nighttime in the jungle when all the daytime animals went to rest and the nighttime magic began.

Toby padded softly outside his cozy den and looked up at the big, dark blue sky. Pop, pop, pop! Little dots of light began to sparkle and shine. They were twinkling stars, blinking just like sleepy eyes. 'Hello, stars!' whispered Toby in his softest, sweetest voice. He decided right then and there that he wanted to count every single star in the sky before he went to sleep.

Toby sat down on a soft patch of moss and pointed his paw at the very first star he saw. 'One star shining bright,' he whispered softly. Then he looked a little bit to the left. 'Two stars twinkling in the night.' Mimi monkey, who was curling up in a nearby tree for sleep, opened one sleepy eye and smiled down at her striped friend. Toby kept on counting, wagging the very tip of his long tail.

'Three stars, four stars, tickle, tickle, glowing,' Toby counted on his little furry fingers. A gentle night breeze blew through the jungle trees, making the leaves whisper a soft lullaby. Swish, swish, went the green leaves. The jungle was getting very quiet, and Toby’s eyelids were starting to feel very, very heavy. Counting stars was wonderful, but sleeping was starting to sound even better.

He rubbed his eyes with his paw. Yawn! Toby let out a big, sleepy tiger yawn. He looked up at the sky one last time. There were millions and trillions of stars twinkling like diamonds on velvet. 'Goodnight, star number five hundred,' mumbled Toby, whose counting had gotten a little bit silly by the end.

Toby crawled back into his warm, cozy bed of soft leaves. He curled his tail snugly around his nose just like a fluffy orange blanket. He closed his brown eyes and let the twinkling stars watch over him. The jungle fell fast asleep, and Toby dreamed sweet dreams of flying high up into the glowing sky to play tag with the friendly stars until the morning sun came back to say hello.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Lost Stripe
stories.text:
It was a bright and busy Tuesday morning in the jungle, and Toby Tiger was running around playing hide-and-seek with his jungle friends. He ran through the tall grass, zigged past the tall bamboo stalks, and ducked behind a large green leaf. 'Ready or not, here I come!' trumpeted Ellie the baby elephant, searching for her striped buddy.

Toby popped out from his hiding spot with a playful growl. 'Roar! You found me, Ellie!' But as Ellie looked at Toby, she blinked her big, wide eyes and tilted her head in confusion. 'Wait a minute, Toby,' said Ellie, tapping her trunk. 'Something looks a little bit different about you today. Are you feeling okay?'

Toby looked down at his paws. He looked at his tummy. He looked at his long tail. He felt his head and patted his fuzzy ears. 'I feel great!' said Toby with a big smile. 'Why do I look different?' Ellie pointed her trunk right at Toby's side. 'Look right there! One of your lovely black stripes is missing! Where did it go?'

Toby gasped a little tiger gasp. Oh no! A missing stripe? A tiger without all of his stripes was just a plain orange kitty! Toby knew he had to find his lost stripe right away. 'Come on, Ellie, let us go look for it!' Together, the two friends retraced Toby’s steps from the morning. They walked back to the big mud puddle where Toby had splashed earlier that day.

'Did you drop your stripe in the mud, Toby?' asked Ellie, peering into the brown water. Toby peered in too. He saw his reflection, but no stray black stripes were floating around. Then, a little green frog popped its head out of the water and croaked, 'Ribbit! I saw something black and wiggly bounce away toward the berry bushes!'

Toby and Ellie thanked the frog and hurried over to the bright red berry bushes. And guess what they found? Hanging right on a prickly berry branch was Toby’s missing stripe! It had gotten caught when Toby was running past earlier. Toby gently reached up with his paw and pulled his stripe free. He pressed it right back onto his furry side, where it stuck like magic. Toby did a happy little dance. 'Yay! I am all striped again!' He gave Ellie a big tiger hug, and they went back to playing their fun jungle game.

stories.title: Toby Tiger's Stripey Day
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a bright green jungle, lived a little tiger named Toby. Toby had soft orange fur and big, bouncy paws. Every morning, Toby woke up with a big stretch. Stretch, stretch, go Toby's arms! Today was a very special day because Toby wanted to play hide-and-seek with his jungle friends. 'Where is Toby?' giggled Mia the monkey, hiding her face in her furry hands. Toby crept very quietly through the tall green grass. Tip-toe, tip-toe, went his soft paws. He had black stripes just like the shadows of the bamboo stalks. Can you see Toby? He crouched down low behind a big green leaf and whispered, 'Roar! But a tiny, gentle roar just for fun.' Mia jumped up and down from a branch. 'I see you, Toby!' she cheered. Next, they looked for Benny the baby elephant. Benny was splashing in a cool, muddy puddle. Splish, splash, splosh! Toby loved the water, but today he wanted to keep his orange fur nice and dry. 'Hello, Benny!' called Toby, waving his long tail. Benny trumpeted happily, 'Toot-toot! Hello, Toby!' The sun began to climb high up into the warm sky. It was time for a little rest. Toby curled up under a big, shady banana tree. He yawned a giant tiger yawn. Yaaawn! His tummy rumbled softly. Time for some yummy leaves and berries. Toby’s mama came over and gave him a big, warm tiger hug. 'You are my sweet little stripey cub,' she purred softly. Toby closed his eyes, feeling safe and happy in the cozy jungle. He dreamed of bouncy paws and bright green leaves. Goodnight, Toby Tiger. Sleep tight until the morning sun wakes you up for more jungle fun.

stories.title: Tara Tiger's Big Red Ball
stories.text: Deep in the sunny jungle lived a friendly tiger named Tara. Tara had the shiniest orange coat and the happiest smile you ever did see. One bright morning, Tara found a big, round, shiny red ball sitting right in the middle of the path. It was as red as a ripe strawberry! 'Oh, what a wonderful toy!' purred Tara, batting the ball gently with her soft paw. Boing, boing, went the big red ball. Tara chased after it with a hop and a skip. She bounced it to Sammy the squirrel. Sammy chattered happily and tapped the ball with his tiny foot. Tap, tap, tap! The ball rolled over to Ellie the gentle elephant. Ellie gave the ball a friendly little nudge with her trunk. Whew! The ball rolled all the way down the grassy hill. Tara ran as fast as her little legs could carry her. Zoom, zoom, went Tara Tiger! She caught the ball with both paws and hugged it tight. 'I got it!' she cheered, doing a little happy dance. All her jungle friends clapped their paws and hooves. Playing together was so much fun. Soon, the golden sun began to sink low, painting the sky in pink and purple colors. It was time to say goodbye to the big red ball. Tara gave it one last gentle pat and rolled it back to her cozy den. She snuggled down into her soft bed of leaves. Tara hugged her favorite stuffed toy and smiled. What a wonderful day of playing with friends. She closed her eyes and drifted off to sleep, ready for more adventures when the morning light returned to the happy jungle.

stories.title: Timmy Tiger Learns to Jump
stories.text: High up on a grassy hill lived Timmy Tiger. Timmy was a little tiger cub with bright, curious eyes. Every day, Timmy watched the little green frogs jump over the logs. Boing! Boing! went the happy little frogs. Timmy wanted to jump just like them, but his paws felt so heavy. 'Can I jump like a frog, Mama?' asked Timmy, looking up with a hopeful smile. His mama smiled down and purred, 'Of course you can, little one. Just bend your knees and try your best!' Timmy wiggled his bottom. He bent his front knees down low. He scrunched up his whiskers. Then, with all his might, he pushed off the soft ground. Up, up, up he went! Whoosh! Timmy flew through the air like a fluffy orange cloud. He landed with a soft, giggly thud right in a patch of soft clover. 'I did it!' shouted Timmy, clapping his paws together in pure delight. 'I jumped like a frog!' His mama cheered, 'Hooray for Timmy!' Timmy tried again. He jumped over a little yellow flower. He jumped over a smooth grey pebble. Boing, boing, went Timmy Tiger all around the meadow. He felt so light and free, like the gentle wind blowing through the trees. When he got tired, Timmy flopped down onto the green grass and rested his head on his paws. His little tummy felt full of joy. The sun shone warmly on his back, making him feel sleepy and cozy. Timmy closed his eyes with a happy sigh. What a wonderful day of jumping and playing. Goodnight, jumping Timmy Tiger.

stories.title: Timmy Tiger's Tiptoe Day
