He had a tiny baby sister named Mia, and Leo loved her so much. 'Are you ready to be my big helper today, Leo?' Mommy asked with a warm smile. Leo nodded his head eagerly. 'Yes! Big helper!' he cheered, patting his chest proudly. First, it was time to change baby Mia's diaper. Mommy asked Leo to bring a clean diaper from the basket. Leo tiptoed over, his little legs moving as fast as they could. He reached high up and grabbed the soft, fluffy diaper. 'I got it, Mommy!' he said, handing it over carefully. Mommy clapped her hands. 'Thank you, Leo! You are such a fast helper.' Next, Mia needed to pick out her outfit for the day. It had little yellow ducks on it, just like Leo's favorite blanket. Leo gently touched the soft cotton shirt. 'Look, Mia, ducks!' he giggled, making a quacking sound. Mia cooed and kicked her tiny feet in the air, smiling right back at her big brother. When the diaper change was all done, Leo gently helped place the dirty diaper into the big bin. 'All done!' Leo said, washing his hands with lots of bubbly soap at the sink just like a big boy. Mommy gave Leo the biggest hug in the whole wide world. 'I am so proud of my helpful big boy,' she whispered. Leo felt warmth bubble up inside his heart. Being a big brother was hard work, but it was also the most fun job in the whole world. He gave baby Mia a gentle kiss on her tiny forehead, and Mia closed her eyes, happy and safe with her big brother watching over her.

stories.title: Maya's Storytime Surprise
stories.text: The afternoon sun peeked through the nursery window, painting soft yellow patches on the soft rug. It was quiet time in the house, which meant it was time for Maya to be a super helper. Maya's little brother, Toby, was sitting on the big rocking chair, rubbing his sleepy eyes. He wanted a story, but Mommy's hands were busy folding warm laundry. 'Maya, my love, would you like to choose a book and read to Toby?' Mommy asked gently. Maya's eyes lit up like bright stars. 'Yes! I am the story reader!' she exclaimed happily. Maya hurried over to the low bookshelf where all her favorite board books lived. She ran her tiny fingers along the spines until she found the very best one: the story about the little green frog who loved to jump. Holding the book carefully with both hands, Maya marched over to the rocking chair and climbed up beside Toby. Toby snuggled close, resting his soft head right on Maya's shoulder. Maya opened the book wide, pointing her finger at the big pictures. 'Look, Toby, a frog!' she said in her most expressive storytelling voice. Toby pointed a tiny finger at the page and made a happy gurgling sound. Maya turned the pages one by one, very slowly and carefully, just like Mommy taught her so the paper wouldn't tear. She made funny frog noises—'Ribbit, ribbit!'—which made Toby burst into a fit of adorable giggles. Maya laughed too, feeling so proud and important. When the story was finished, Maya closed the cover with a gentle thud. 'The end,' she whispered softly. Toby yawned a big, sleepy yawn and rested his eyes. Mommy walked over and kissed the top of Maya's head. 'You are the most wonderful big sister and reader,' Mommy praised softly. Maya smiled, feeling as cozy and warm as a bug in a rug, knowing she was Toby's favorite helper.

stories.title: Sam's Toy Rescue Mission
stories.text: The living room floor was covered in a colorful sea of plastic blocks, rolling cars, and soft plush animals. It was time to clean up before lunch, and Sam had a very important mission. Sam was a big brother to baby Charlie, who was crawling around on the rug, exploring the world. 'Mission Control calling Big Brother Sam,' Daddy said with a playful, silly voice. 'Can we work together to rescue the toys and make a safe path for baby Charlie?' Sam puffed out his chest and put his hands on his hips. 'Yes! Super Sam is on the case!' he declared bravely. Sam grabbed his favorite red toy wagon and parked it right in the middle of the room. His mission was clear: pick up every single toy so baby Charlie wouldn't trip. Sam bent down and scooped up three blue blocks, marching them over to the toy box. 'One, two, three, splash in the box!' he counted aloud, giggling as the blocks tumbled inside. Baby Charlie watched his big brother with wide, curious eyes and crawled over to help. Charlie picked up a soft yellow duck and handed it to Sam. 'Good job, Charlie! You found a duck!' Sam cheered, taking the toy and placing it neatly on the shelf. Working together as a team made cleaning up feel like a fun game. Soon, every single block, car, and stuffed animal was put away safely in its proper home. The floor was completely clear and ready for safe playtime. Daddy clapped loudly. 'Look at this clean room! Thank you, Super Sam, for being such an incredible big brother helper!' Sam beamed with pride. He gave baby Charlie a gentle high-five, feeling so happy to take care of his little brother every single day.

stories.title: Leo's Special Diaper Duty
stories.text: Good morning, big boy Leo! Today is a very sunny day, and Leo has a very important job. Baby sister Lily is awake and making happy little coos from her cozy crib. 'Good morning, Lily!' says Leo in his softest, kindest voice. Mommy is getting ready, and she looks at Leo with a big, proud smile. 'Leo,' says Mommy, 'can you be my super-duper helper today?' Leo puffs out his chest. Yes, he can! He is a big sibling helper! First, it is time for Lily's diaper change. Mommy asks Leo to fetch a clean diaper from the basket. Pitter-patter goes Leo's feet. He runs over and picks up the soft, fluffy diaper. 'Here you go, Mommy!' says Leo, handing it over with two hands just like a gentle helper. Mommy says, 'Thank you so much, my wonderful helper.' Lily kicks her tiny toes and giggles, making the room feel so warm and happy. Next, Mommy needs a baby wipe. Leo knows just what to do! He reaches up and grabs one fresh wipe, holding it carefully. 'Good job, Leo!' cheers Mommy. Being a big brother is so much fun because Leo gets to help take care of his favorite baby girl in the whole wide world. When the diaper is all clean and fresh, Lily reaches out her little hands to touch Leo's fingers. Leo gently holds her tiny hand and smiles a big, proud smile. He gives Lily a sweet kiss on her soft forehead. 'Good job, big brother!' says Mommy, giving Leo a big squeeze and a hug. Leo feels warm inside, like a glowing sunshine. He is big, he is helpful, and he loves his baby sister so, so much. What a wonderful start to the day for our big sibling helper!

stories.title: Mia's Music Time Magic
stories.text: The afternoon sun is shining through the playroom window, and little brother Sam is feeling a little bit grumpy. He is rubbing his eyes and letting out a tiny whine. Oh, no! Sam needs a helping hand to feel better. Big sister Mia hears him right away. Mia is four years old, which means she is very big, very smart, and a wonderful big sibling helper! Mia walks over to her toy box and thinks hard. What can make Sam smile? I know! Music! Mia carefully picks up her favorite yellow rattle and a red tambourine. She marches over to Sam like a happy little marching band. Tap, tap, go the tambourine. Shake, shake, goes the rattle. Mia dances a silly little duck dance, waddling across the soft rug. 'Quack, quack, Sam!' she says with a giggly voice. Sam stops crying and his big round eyes open wide. Then, a tiny smile creeps onto his little face. He lets out a cute little giggle! 'Yay!' cheers Mia, clapping her hands together happily. 'You did it, Mia! You are such a helpful big sister,' says Daddy from the doorway, clapping along too. Daddy asks if Mia can help Sam pick up his blocks now. Mia nods eagerly. 'Of course, Daddy!' Together, Mia and Sam pick up the red block, the blue block, and the green block, dropping them back into the big toy bin with a loud thump and a cheer. Mia shows Sam how to stack two blocks together. Sam tries his best and places one block on top. 'High five!' says Mia, gently tapping her little brother's hand. Sam beams with joy, feeling so proud of his tower. Mia feels so happy inside her heart. Being a big sibling helper means sharing joy, playing together, and making little brothers smile every single day.

stories.title: Noah's Bedtime Book Buddy
stories.text: The moon is peeking out in the dark blue sky, and it is almost bedtime in the little yellow house. Big brother Noah is getting ready for sleep in his cozy dinosaur pajamas. But wait! Baby brother Toby is still in the rocking chair, rubbing his sleepy eyes. Toby is having a hard time settling down for sleep. Mommy looks tired, too. Noah knows just what to do because he is a superstar big sibling helper! Noah tip-toes over to the bookshelf with quiet, gentle steps. He scans all the colorful books and picks Toby's absolute favorite story: the one about the sleepy little brown bear. Noah holds the book securely against his chest with both arms, walking very carefully so he does not trip. He climbs up onto the big rocking chair right next to Mommy and little Toby. 'I brought the book, Mommy!' whispers Noah softly so he does not wake up the quiet night. 'Thank you, my sweet helper,' whispers Mommy with a gentle kiss on Noah's hair. Toby rests his heavy head right on Noah's shoulder, feeling safe and cozy. Noah opens the book to the very first page and points his finger at the big picture of the moon. 'Look, Toby, the moon,' Noah says in a soothing, quiet voice. Toby stares at the picture, blinking his sleepy eyes slower and slower. Noah helps turn the thick paper page, being very careful not to rip it. Turn, turn, go the pages. The story is calm and peaceful, just right for sleepytime. When the story is all done, Toby gives a big yawn and closes his eyes tight. He is fast asleep! Noah beams with pride. He helped his little brother relax and fall into dreamland. Mommy whispers, 'You are the best big brother in the whole world, Noah.' Noah smiles warmly as he snuggles into his own bed, feeling like a true nighttime hero and a wonderful big sibling helper.

stories.title: Leo's Special Diaper Duty
stories.text: Leo was a big boy now. He was three years old, and he had a tiny baby sister named Mia. Mia was so cute, but she wore squishy diapers all day long. One sunny morning, Mommy was holding crying Mia in the rocking chair. 'Oh dear,' said Mommy with a tired smile, 'Mia needs a fresh diaper, but my hands are full!' Leo clapped his hands together. 'I can help, Mommy! I am a big boy helper!' Mommy beamed. 'Thank you, sweet boy. Can you bring me a clean diaper and a wipe from the basket?' Leo dashed across the soft rug as fast as his little legs could carry him. He zoomed like a fast red race car right over to the basket. He grabbed one soft white diaper and one cool, wet wipe. 'Delivery for baby Mia!' whispered Leo proudly. He carefully handed them to Mommy, making sure not to drop a single thing. Mommy changed Mia's diaper while Leo sang his favorite silly monkey song to make the baby giggle. Mia stopped crying and kicked her tiny toes in the air, smiling a big gummy smile right at her big brother. 'Look, Leo, she loves your song!' said Mommy. Leo felt warmth bubble up inside his chest. He stood up very tall and felt so proud to be such a wonderful big brother. Helping Mommy and taking care of baby Mia was the best job in the whole wide world. When Daddy came into the room, Leo shouted happily, 'I am a diaper helper!' Daddy gave Leo a big, warm bear hug and a kiss right on top of his head. 'You are the best big helper in the whole family,' Daddy said. Leo smiled from ear to ear, ready for whatever adventure came next in his busy day.

stories.title: Maya's Gentle Lullaby
stories.text: The sun was starting to set, painting the sky in pretty pink and orange colors. It was almost bedtime in Maya's house, and her little baby brother, Toby, was rubbing his sleepy eyes. Toby was cranky and fussing because he was so tired, but he just could not fall asleep in his crib. Mommy looked a little bit tired too. Maya, who was four years old, walked over very softly on her tiptoes. 'Can I help Toby sleep, Mommy?' asked Maya in her quietest, sweetest whisper. Mommy nodded and smiled. 'Of course, sweet Maya. You are such a gentle helper.' Maya knew just what to do. She tiptoed to the bookshelf and picked out Toby's absolute favorite bedtime story about a sleepy little brown bear. She climbed up onto the cozy armchair right next to Mommy and opened the book. 'Look, Toby, the bear is going to sleep,' Maya pointed her tiny finger at the pictures. She used her softest storytelling voice, speaking nice and slowly. Toby stopped crying and blinked his heavy eyelids, listening to the comforting sound of his big sister's voice. When the story was all done, Maya gently stroked Toby's soft, curly hair just like Mommy did. Then, she sang a quiet lullaby about twinkling stars in the night sky. Toby yawned a huge, sleepy yawn and closed his eyes tight. He was finally fast asleep in Mommy's arms. Mommy whispered, 'Thank you, my darling helper. You brought peace to our bedtime.' Maya beamed with pride, feeling like a magical bedtime fairy. She whispered back, 'Goodnight, baby Toby.' She climbed down from the chair and tiptoed to her own bed, feeling so happy and cozy inside.

stories.title: Oliver's Toy Cleanup Train
stories.text: The playroom floor was covered in a mountain of colorful plastic toys. There were yellow blocks, red cars, and fuzzy stuffed animals scattered everywhere. Little baby sister Lily was crawling around, and she tried to put a tiny toy wheel right into her mouth! 'Uh-oh! Stop, Lily!' said Oliver, who was almost four years old. Oliver knew that little babies put everything in their mouths, and he wanted to keep his baby sister safe. Oliver puffed out his chest and put his hands on his hips. 'I am the big brother safety helper!' he declared proudly. He looked at the messy floor and had a brilliant idea. He did not just pick up the toys; he turned cleanup time into a fun game. 'Choo-choo! All aboard the toy train!' Oliver shouted happily, making loud chugging noises with his mouth. He zoomed a big green dump truck right over to the block pile. 'Load up the cargo!' he giggled, tossing plastic blocks into the back of the truck. Lily thought Oliver's funny noises were hilarious, and she started clapping her chubby hands together and laughing out loud. Inspired by her big brother, Lily even grabbed a soft yellow duck and handed it to Oliver. 'Good job, Lily! You are a helper too!' praised Oliver. Together, the two of them chugged around the room, picking up every single toy until the floor was completely clean and safe. Mommy walked in and gasped in surprise. 'Look at this wonderfully clean room! Did my two amazing helpers do this?' Oliver nodded eagerly. 'We did it together, Mommy!' Mommy wrapped her arms around both of them in a giant group hug. Oliver felt so proud and happy to share his special superhero helper powers with his baby sister.

stories.title: Leo's Special Diaper Duty
stories.text: Good morning, big boy Leo! Today is a very special day because Leo has a very important job. Baby sister Mia is waking up with a little squeak. 'Good morning, Mia!' whispers Leo, patting his soft hands together. Mommy smiles and says, 'Leo, can you be my biggest helper today?' Leo puffs out his chest and nods very high. 'Yes, Mommy! I a big helper!' First, it is time for Mia's fresh diaper. Mommy needs a wipe, but where is it? 'I get it!' cheers Leo. He toddles over to the basket and brings back a nice, cool wipe. 'Thank you, my sweet helper,' says Mommy. Leo feels so proud, he does a little happy dance on his tippy-toes. Next, Mia needs her cozy pink socks. Leo gently picks up a tiny pink sock with fuzzy toes. He holds it up to Mia's foot. 'On goes the sock!' giggles Leo. Mia kicks her tiny legs and claps her hands, making happy baby noises. 'Look, Mommy, Mia is clapping!' says Leo with a giant smile. Being a big brother is the most fun thing in the whole wide world. Mommy gives Leo a warm, squeezy hug and a big kiss on his nose. 'You are the best big brother helper ever,' she whispers. Leo beams from ear to ear. He helps pick out a book for Mia to look at, sitting right beside her on the fluffy rug. He turns the pages very softly so Mia can see the ducks and the puppies. 'Quack quack, Mia,' Leo says softly. Mia reaches out to pat the page with her tiny hand. Leo holds her hand and feels so happy inside his heart. Helping Mommy and baby sister makes Leo feel tall, strong, and so very loved. When Daddy comes in to say hello, Leo shouts, 'Daddy! I helped change the diaper and put on the sock!' Daddy claps his hands and says, 'Hip, hip, hooray for Leo!' What a wonderful morning for a wonderful big brother.

stories.title: Maya's Magic Toy Pickup
stories.text: The living room is full of colorful toys. There are blocks stacked high like tall towers, yellow rubber ducks swimming on the carpet, and soft teddy bears resting everywhere. 'Time to tidy up!' sings Daddy, clapping his hands together. Maya, who is three whole years old and a super-duper big sister, knows just what to do. 'I can help!' says Maya brightly. She has a big green basket just for her little brother Toby's toys. Toby is a crawling baby who loves to put everything right into his mouth. Maya knows that keeping the floor safe is a very important big sister job. 'Ready, set, go!' whispers Maya to herself. She zooms over to the red block like a speedy little race car. Vroom! She picks up the red block and drops it plop right into the green basket. 'One block!' she counts proudly. Then she spots a blue dinosaur toy hiding behind the sofa. 'Found you!' giggles Maya. She scoops up the dinosaur and gently tucks him into the basket too. Toby crawls over on his hands and knees, making happy little baby chatters. 'Ba-ba!' says Toby, reaching for a rattle on the floor. 'Good catch, Toby!' says Maya. She hands the rattle to her little brother with a very gentle touch. Toby shakes it, making a happy jingle sound. Maya smiles big because working together is so much fun. Daddy walks over and gives Maya a high-five. 'Thank you, Maya! You are such a helpful big sister. The room looks wonderful!' Maya feels warm and cozy inside, like a cup of hot cocoa on a rainy day. She puts the very last toy, a soft yellow duck, right on top of the pile. The living room is neat and clean, ready for more playtime later. Maya stands tall and feels like a true superhero of tidying up. She gives Toby a gentle hug, and Toby pats her cheek with his soft little hand. Being a helper makes Maya's heart feel full of sunshine.

stories.title: Sam's Bedtime Song
stories.text: The stars are peeking out in the dark blue sky, and the moon is glowing like a nightlight. It is time for sleepy snuggles, and four-year-old Sam is ready to be the best big brother helper in the whole house. Baby brother Noah is rubbing his tired eyes. He lets out a little yawn that goes, 'Yaaaaawn!' Mommy is rocking Noah in the big armchair, but Noah needs his favorite sleepytime bunny to help him drift off to dreamland. 'Sammy, can you find Bunny for Noah?' whispers Mommy softly. Sam nods his head. 'I can do it, Mommy!' Sam tip-toes quietly across the bedroom floor so he does not wake up any of the sleepy shadows. He looks under the yellow rocking chair. No bunny there. He looks on the toy shelf next to the wooden train. Still no bunny. Then, Sam looks behind the big fluffy pillows on the bed. 'Aha! Found him!' whispers Sam in an excited voice. He gently pulls out the floppy-eared grey bunny by his soft paw. Sam carries Bunny very carefully, holding him close like a precious treasure. He walks back to Mommy and hands the bunny to Noah. 'Here is your bunny, Noah,' Sam says in his quietest, gentlest voice. Noah snuggles the soft bunny right up to his cheek and gives a happy sigh. 'Thank you, Sam,' whispers Mommy with a sweet smile. Sam climbs up onto the footstool next to Mommy and Noah. He reaches out a gentle hand to stroke Noah's tiny toes. 'Time to sleep, little brother,' Sam whispers lovingly. Noah closes his eyes tight, listening to the gentle sound of the room. Sam feels so proud and happy to help his baby brother fall asleep. Mommy leans over and whispers in Sam's ear, 'You are the most wonderful, caring big brother in the whole world.' Sam beams in the dim light, feeling like a very important part of the family bedtime team. He knows that tomorrow brings a brand new day full of more fun and more helping.

stories.title: Leo's Diaper Duty
stories.text: Leo stood very tall. He puffed out his chest. Today, Leo was a big helper! His little sister, Maya, was sitting on the big rug. She needed a fresh diaper. Mommy smiled and looked right at Leo. 'Can you help me get ready, big helper?' she asked in a soft, happy voice. Leo nodded very hard. 'Yes, Mommy!' he cheered. First, Leo tiptoed over to the shelf. He reached out his little hands and grabbed a clean diaper. He held it tight against his tummy like a precious treasure. Then, he waddled back to Mommy and Maya as fast as his little legs could go. 'Here is your diaper, Maya!' Leo whispered gently. Maya giggled and clapped her hands together. Next, Mommy asked for the wet wipes. Leo scurried to the basket again. He picked up the box of wipes and handed them over with a proud grin. 'Good job, Leo!' Mommy said, giving him a warm hug. Maya reached out and gently touched Leo’s nose. 'Boop!' she squeaked. Leo laughed out loud. He felt so warm and happy inside. Being a big brother was the very best job in the whole wide world. When Mommy finished, she clapped her hands. 'All done! Thank you for being such a super helper, Leo!' Leo beamed from ear to ear. He gave Maya a gentle pat on her soft curly hair. They were a wonderful team, working together every single day. Leo decided he was ready for any other big jobs Mommy had waiting.

stories.title: Mia's Storytime Song
stories.text: The afternoon sun peeked softly through the bedroom window. Little baby Toby was rubbing his sleepy eyes. He was feeling a little bit fussy and ready for a nap. Big sister Mia knew just what to do. Mia was four years old, and she was the best helper in the house. 'Don't worry, Toby, I am here,' Mia whispered softly. She walked over to the cozy rocking chair where Mommy was holding the baby. Mia reached down into the basket and carefully picked out Toby's favorite soft bunny toy with the floppy ears. She held it out to her little brother with a gentle smile. Toby blinked his big brown eyes and reached out to hold the bunny’s soft ear. He started to calm right down. 'Now it is time for a lullaby song,' Mia said proudly. She climbed up onto the footstool next to Mommy and took a deep breath. Mia began to sing her favorite gentle song about little yellow ducks swimming in a pond. Her voice was sweet and quiet, just right for sleepytime. Toby yawned a big toddler yawn. His eyelids fluttered down as he listened to Mia's sweet voice. Mommy wrapped her arms around both of her children, smiling with so much love. 'You have such a magical singing voice, Mia. You are the sweetest big sister,' Mommy whispered. Mia felt like her heart was glowing with sunshine. She gently stroked Toby's tiny hand until his breathing became slow and deep. Toby was finally fast asleep. Mia smiled proudly, knowing she helped her baby brother drift off to dreamland.

stories.title: Noah Pushes the Trolley
stories.text: The grocery store was big, bright, and very busy. Noah walked right beside Mommy with his hand resting gently on the side of the shopping trolley. Noah was three years old now, and today he had a very important job. He was Mommy’s official big helper! 'Noah, can you help me find the bright red apples?' Mommy asked, pointing down the produce aisle. Noah’s eyes lit up with excitement. 'Yes, I can!' he called out happily. Noah marched down the aisle, looking at all the colorful fruits and vegetables. There were green cucumbers, orange carrots, and round, shiny red apples sitting in a big wooden bin. Noah reached out and carefully picked up one big, shiny red apple. He cradled it safely in both hands like it was a fragile bird egg. Then, he walked carefully back to the trolley and placed it inside with a gentle thud. 'Great job, helper!' Mommy cheered, giving his shoulder a friendly squeeze. Noah felt so proud and strong. Next, Mommy needed a box of yummy oatmeal. Noah spotted the orange box on the bottom shelf right away. He crouched down on his knees, stretched out his arm, and slid the box out. He carried it proudly to the trolley all by himself. 'Thank you, Noah. You make shopping so much fun,' Mommy said with a big smile. Noah puffed out his chest and held onto the trolley handle with both hands. He helped steer the wheels all the way to the checkout counter. Being a big helper made Noah feel like he could do anything in the whole world.

rhymes.title: Diaper Duty Helper
rhymes.text:
Time to change the little one,
Helping out is so much fun!
Bring a diaper, nice and clean,
Best big helper ever seen.

Wipes are ready in a row,
Watch the happy baby grow.
Sing a song and clap your hands,
Following the helpful plans.

Toss the old one in the pail,
Helper power does not fail!
Give a rattle, make a smile,
Sit and play a little while.

Baby laughs and claps today,
You are helping all the way!
Kiss the baby, soft and sweet,
Doing such a job complete.

rhymes.title: The Gentle Touch Song
rhymes.text:
Baby brother is so small,
Does not walk or run at all.
Use your gentle hands to touch,
Baby loves you very much.

Stroke his fingers, oh so light,
Keep the little baby bright.
Softly pat his little head,
While he rests upon his bed.

When he cries, we sing a song,
Helping mommy all day long.
Quiet voices, calm and low,
Watch the happy baby grow.

Gentle hugs and kisses too,
Baby looks right up at you.
Best big sibling in the land,
Holding little baby hand.

rhymes.title: Toy Pickup Time
rhymes.text:
Time to share the toys around,
Put them safely on the ground.
Baby wants to play and see,
Sharing toys with you and me.

Pick a block up off the floor,
Put it by the bedroom door.
Show the rattle, shake it fast,
Make the happy moments last.

Baby giggles with delight,
Everything is feeling right.
Put the teddy bear in place,
Put a smile on baby's face.

Being big is such a treat,
Making daily tasks complete.
Share your toys and play along,
Singing out a happy song.

rhymes.title: Stroller Walk Parade
rhymes.text:
Let us take a little walk,
Look around and softly talk.
Push the stroller, nice and slow,
To the sunny park we go.

Hold the handle, grip it tight,
On this afternoon so bright.
Wave hello to passing cars,
Shining brighter than the stars.

Point to birds up in the tree,
Show the baby what to see.
Leaves are dancing in the breeze,
Whispering among the trees.

Time to turn and head back home,
No more need today to roam.
Big helper has done so well,
Stories of the day to tell.

rhymes.title: Bedtime Lullaby Helper
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the sky,
Time to sing a lullaby.
Get the blanket, warm and red,
Tuck the baby in his bed.

Bring the pacifier near,
Whisper in the little ear.
Turn the quiet music low,
Watch the sleepy eyelids slow.

Tip-toe softly on the floor,
Close the bedroom nursery door.
Turn the sleepy nightlight on,
Rest until the coming dawn.

Big helper has worked all day,
Now it is time to rest and play.
Sleepy hugs and sweet goodnight,
Morning brings another light.

rhymes.title: Diaper Duty Helper
rhymes.text:
Time to help the baby now,
Bring a diaper, show me how.
Wipes are ready in a row,
Watch the happy baby go!
Get a fresh one off the stack,
Lay it gently on her back.
Lift the legs up in the air,
Doing such a helpful share!
Take the powder, nice and sweet,
Tickle, tickle, little feet.
Now the tabs go side to side,
Baby smiles so full of pride.
All finished, look at that!
Give the baby's tummy a pat.
You are such a helper true,
Big kid hugs and kisses too!

rhymes.title: Gentle Touch Song
rhymes.text:
Baby brother is so small,
Doesn't walk or talk at all.
Let us use a gentle hand,
Best big sibling in the land.
Stroke his little silky head,
Tuck him safely in his bed.
Softly pat his tiny knee,
Sing a happy melody.
Keep the noisy toys away,
While the baby takes a play.
Share your blanket, warm and bright,
Hug him very, very tight.
Say good morning, say hello,
Watch the little baby grow.
We are proud of what you do,
Baby loves big sibling too!

rhymes.title: Cleanup Playtime Time
rhymes.text:
Time to put the toys away,
We are done with games today.
Baby sister wants to crawl,
Pick up blocks both big and small.
Put the teddy in his chair,
Brush his fuzzy little hair.
Cars go driving in the box,
Pick up all the baby socks.
Roll the big ball on the floor,
Put it by the closet door.
Every puzzle piece is found,
Nothing left upon the ground.
Sister claps her little hands,
 Happiest in all the lands.
Now the room is shining bright,
Helper did a job just right!

rhymes.title: Feeding Time Helper
rhymes.text:
Baby is so hungry now,
Let us help her, me and thou.
Bring the bowl of yummy peas,
Say the magic word of please.
Tie the bib around her neck,
Make a happy baby check.
Hold the spoon and give a scoop,
Careful with the yummy soup!
Wipe a little sticky chin,
Let the giggles all begin.
Water in the tiny cup,
Drink it all and bottom up!
Now her tummy is so full,
Time to pull the wagon wool.
Such a helper, bright and sweet,
Standing on your big-kid feet!

rhymes.title: Stroller Parade
rhymes.text:
Get the stroller rolling fast,
We are going out at last.
Grab the jacket, put it on,
We will walk across the lawn.
Push the handle nice and slow,
Where is little baby to go?
Point to birdies in the tree,
Sing a happy song with me.
Watch the fluffy puppy pass,
Sitting on the greenest grass.
Stop and look at flowers red,
Sun is shining overhead.
Turn around and head back home,
No more places we will roam.
Park the stroller by the wall,
Best big helper of them all!

rhymes.title: Diaper Duty Hero
rhymes.text:
Time to help the baby now,
Let us show you how, oh how!
Bring a diaper, nice and clean,
Best big helper ever seen.

Wipes are ready in a row,
Watch the happy baby grow.
Tickle toes and make a smile,
We will help for just a while.

Fold it up and toss it out,
Give a happy little shout!
Wash our hands and sing a song,
Helping baby all day long.

Now the baby is so dry,
No more tears and no more cry.
High-five, helper, you are great,
Helping out is simply-great!

rhymes.title: Gentle Hands and Soft
rhymes.text:
Baby is a little dove,
Needs our gentle, gentle love.
Pat the back and softly say,
We will play another day.

Bring a rattle, shake it slow,
Watch the baby's eyes aglow.
Softly sing a lullaby,
While the clouds go floating by.

Big kid power, strong and kind,
Best big sibling you can find.
Share a toy and share a grin,
Let the happy times begin.

Touch the baby soft and sweet,
From their head down to their feet.
You're a helper, kind and true,
Baby loves the world of you!

rhymes.title: Stroller Push and Roll
rhymes.text:
Get the stroller out the door,
We are ready to explore!
Hold the handle, step so neat,
Walking down the sunny street.

Baby sits and looks around,
Listening to every sound.
Big kid pushes with such care,
Fresh and lovely morning air.

Stop at corners, count to two,
Look at what big kids can do!
Keep the stroller rolling slow,
That's the way we like to go.

Home again, we park the cart,
You played such a helpful part.
Take a bow and clap your hands,
Best big sibling in the lands!

rhymes.title: Toy Time Share and Play
rhymes.text:
Blocks are tumbled on the floor,
Time to play and so much more!
Hand the baby one red block,
Spin it round just like a clock.

Share your treasures, big and bright,
Make the baby's morning bright.
Not in mouth, we always say,
Safe and happy toys to play.

Build a tower, tall and high,
Reaching all the way to sky.
Crash it down with giggle sounds,
Joy is bouncing all around.

When we're done, we put away,
For another happy day.
Good job, helper, shining star,
Best big sibling near and far!

rhymes.title: Bedtime Lullaby Helper
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the west,
Time for baby bird to rest.
Bring the blankie, soft and blue,
Just the thing for sleepy-do.

Turn the music nice and low,
Help the sleepy feelings grow.
Whisper shh and give a hug,
Snuggle in the cozy rug.

Kiss the baby on the head,
Tuck them nicely in their bed.
Turn the tiny glowing light,
Say a quiet, gentle night.

Walk on tiptoe, silent feet,
Job is finished, complete-neat.
Time for rest, you did so well,
Magical as any spell.

rhymes.title: Diaper Duty Hero
rhymes.text:
Time to help the baby now,
Bring a diaper, show me how!
Grab a wipe and bring it near,
Big kid helper, you're a dear!

Baby smiles and claps her hands,
 Happiest in all the lands.
Now we throw the trash away,
 Hip hooray for helping day!

Wash your hands with bubbly soap,
 You're our biggest source of hope!
Dry them on the fluffy blue,
 Proud of all the things you do.

Give the baby rattle toys,
 Make some happy, gentle joys.
Big kid, you are shining bright,
 Helping out from morn till night!

rhymes.title: Stroller Push and Song
rhymes.text:
We are going for a walk,
Babies love to coo and talk.
Hold the handle nice and slow,
That is how we watch him grow.

Step by step we walk outside,
Filled with such a helper pride.
Look at birdies in the tree,
Sing a little song with me!

Push the stroller down the street,
Marching with your little feet.
Keep the baby safe and sound,
Best big sibling all around.

Time to turn and head back home,
No more places now to roam.
Park the stroller by the door,
Ready now to help for more!

rhymes.title: Toy Pickup Train
rhymes.text:
All the blocks are on the floor,
Time to help out more and more!
Chugga chugga, hear the train,
Picking up is quite a game.

Put the teddy in his bed,
Pat him gently on the head.
Drop the puzzle in the box,
Match up all the fuzzy socks.

Baby tries to help us too,
Showing her just what to do.
Put the books back on the shelf,
Doing such a job yourself!

Room is tidy, floor is clean,
Best helpers we've ever seen.
Give a high five, count to three,
Happy as can ever be!

rhymes.title: Gentle Lullaby Time
rhymes.text:
Baby sister wants to sleep,
Let us make a promise keep.
Talk in whispers, soft and low,
Watch the sleepy baby grow.

Bring her blankie, warm and sweet,
Cover up her tiny feet.
Turn the music nice and mild,
Soothing our sweet little child.

Rock the cradle back and forth,
South and west and east and north.
Give a gentle pat and kiss,
Filled with so much gentle bliss.

Close your eyes and slumber deep,
While the stars their watches keep.
Big kid tiptoes out the door,
Quiet on the wooden floor.

rhymes.title: Feeding Time Team
rhymes.text:
Time to feed the baby now,
Get the high chair ready, chow!
Tie the bib around her chest,
Our big helper is the best.

Fetch the spoon of yummy squash,
Use the napkin for a wash.
Baby eats with happy grin,
Food is on her little chin!

Take a sip of water cup,
Drink it all and bottom up.
Now she's finished with her meal,
Look at how excited we all feel!

Wipe the tray until it shines,
Drawing happy smiley signs.
Big kid helper, strong and grand,
Clap your happy little hand!

rhymes.title: Diaper Duty Hero
rhymes.text:
Time to help the baby now,
Let us show you how, oh how!
Bring a wipe and bring a toy,
Fill the room with so much joy.
Little sister gives a smile,
We will help her for a while.
Get the diaper nice and clean,
Best big helper ever seen!
Pat her tummy, tickle toes,
Wipe the powder from her nose.
Now she feels so fresh and sweet,
From her head down to her feet.
Give a hug and give a cheer,
Big sibling is standing near!
Clap your hands and sing aloud,
Mom and Dad are very proud.

rhymes.title: Gentle Hands and Soft
rhymes.text:
Baby brother is asleep,
So we walk without a beep.
Softly, softly on the floor,
Do not slam the bedroom door.
Use your gentle hands to touch,
Cuz we love him very much.
Stroke his hair so smooth and light,
Everything is calm and bright.
When he wakes up from his nap,
He can sit right on your lap.
Give a rattle, shake it slow,
Watch his happy feelings grow.
You are growing big and tall,
Best protector of them all.
Smile and whisper in his ear,
Glad that you are living here.

rhymes.title: Stroller Push and Roll
rhymes.text:
Get the stroller out the door,
We are ready to explore!
Hold the handle, grip it tight,
Pushing baby left and right.
Walk along the sidewalk street,
Marching with your little feet.
Look at birdies in the tree,
Sing a happy song with me.
Baby looks around and grins,
That is where the fun begins.
Watch the wheels go round and round,
Making not a single sound.
Turn the corner, heading home,
No more places left to roam.
Park the stroller in the hall,
You are great at helping all!

rhymes.title: Sharing Toy Time Fun
rhymes.text:
Toys are scattered on the rug,
Give the teddy bear a hug.
Baby wants the yellow block,
Tick-tock goes the happy clock.
Share your toys and share your care,
Love is floating in the air.
Hand the rattle nice and neat,
Watch the baby kick her feet.
Playing together is so grand,
Hand in tiny little hand.
Take turns rolling up the ball,
Playing games both big and small.
You are patient, kind, and sweet,
Making every playtime neat.
Put the blocks back in the bin,
Let the happy smiles begin!

rhymes.title: Bedtime Lullaby Helper
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the sky,
Time to sing a lullaby.
Get the blankie off the chair,
Straighten up the pillows there.
Bring the baby's fav'rite book,
Come and take a cozy look.
Turn the lights down nice and low,
Watch the sleepy feelings grow.
Give a kiss upon the head,
Tuck her safely in her bed.
Whisper softly, sleep till morn,
Cutest baby ever born.
Turn the music box to play,
We are finished for the day.
Big sibling did such a chore,
Time to rest and sleep some more.

rhymes.title: Diaper Duty Dynamo
rhymes.text:
Baby brother needs a wipe,
Time to help and do it right!
Fetch a diaper from the box,
Take off baby's little socks.
Bring the powder, soft and sweet,
Tickle baby's tiny feet.
Now the tape goes sticky-snap,
Baby sitting in my lap.
I am big and I am strong,
We can sing a happy song.
Wipe the cream upon his nose,
Tickle all his little toes.
Baby smiles and claps his hands,
Happiest boy in all the lands.
Give a hug and give a kiss,
Being a big helper is bliss!

rhymes.title: Stroller Push and Song
rhymes.text:
Sister's buggy starts to roll,
Helping out is now my goal!
Hold the handle, nice and tight,
Walking in the morning light.
Watch for bumps and watch for stones,
Listen to the happy tones.
Sister chatters in her seat,
Happy little baby feet.
We are going to the park,
Before it gets too dark.
Push her gently down the street,
Step-by-step our two small feet.
Park the buggy by the slide,
Time for her to take a ride.
We are helpers, proud and tall,
Having the best time of all!

rhymes.title: Toy Pickup Train
rhymes.text:
Choo-choo train is on the floor,
Let us tidy up some more!
Blocks are scattered all around,
Pick them up from off the ground.
Put the teddy in his bed,
Pat him gently on the head.
Baby sister drops her ball,
Catch it safely in the hall.
Sort the colors, red and blue,
Tell the baby what to do.
Put the puzzle in the box,
Put away the fuzzy socks.
Room is shiny, bright, and clean,
Best big sibling ever seen!
Give a cheer and shout out loud,
Mom and Dad are very proud.

rhymes.title: Gentle Lullaby Time
rhymes.text:
Baby sister wants to sleep,
Let us not make any beep.
Fetch her bunny, soft and white,
Everything is calm and right.
Dim the lights down very low,
Watch the sleepy shadows grow.
Sing a little sleepy tune,
Underneath the shining moon.
Hush-a-bye and do not cry,
Big sibling is standing by.
Stroke her cheek so soft and sweet,
Pull the blanket to her feet.
Close your eyes and drift away,
Rest until another day.
Quiet steps upon the floor,
Close the bedroom nursery door.

rhymes.title: Sharing Snacks and Smiles
rhymes.text:
Time for snacks upon the tray,
Sharing food is fun today!
Wash our hands before we eat,
Sitting on the booster seat.
Hand a cracker, round and flat,
Baby sister smiles at that.
Pour some water in her cup,
Drink it all and bottom up!
Share a berry, sweet and red,
Nod a happy, gentle head.
Use a napkin for her face,
Wipe away the sticky trace.
We are partners, you and I,
Eating snacks and waving hi.
Being helpful every day,
Makes us happy in our play!

rhymes.title: Diaper Duty Helper
rhymes.text:
Time to change the little one,
Helping out is so much fun!
Bring a wipe and bring a toy,
Fill the room with so much joy.

Take the diaper, throw it out,
Hear the baby laugh and shout!
You are growing big and tall,
Best big helper of them all.

Wipe the hands and tickle toes,
Look right at the tickly nose.
Sing a happy little song,
While we help the whole day long.

Baby smiles and claps for you,
Look at all the work you do!
Give a hug and give a cheer,
Best big brother, oh so dear.

rhymes.title: The Gentle Stroller Push
rhymes.text:
Put your sneakers on your feet,
Time to walk down on the street!
Baby's stroller needs a hand,
Best big helper in the land.

Hold the handle nice and slow,
That is how we learn to go.
Watch the wheels go round and round,
Listen to the happy sound.

Keep the pace so calm and sweet,
Walking down the sunny street.
Baby looks at you and beams,
Just like in the happy dreams.

Stop at corners, count to three,
Look how helpful you can be!
Now we are back inside the door,
Ready for some playing more.

rhymes.title: Storytime Sharer
rhymes.text:
Time to pick a storybook,
Come and take a little look.
Baby wants to sit with you,
See what reading we can do.

Hold the pages nice and wide,
Sit right here and close beside.
Point to pictures on the page,
Show the kitten in a cage.

Baby pats the furry cat,
Look at all we learned from that!
Turn the page and read it slow,
Watch the little baby grow.

Soft and quiet is the voice,
Making such a happy choice.
Story time is done for now,
Take a bow and say meow!

rhymes.title: Toy Pickup Parade
rhymes.text:
Toys are scattered on the floor,
Time to tidy up some more!
Baby wants to help you too,
Let us see what you can do.

Pick a block and put it in,
Put a smile upon your chin!
Blocks go in the yellow box,
Time to pick up little socks.

Find a rattle, find a bear,
Put them neatly on the chair.
You are strong and you are fast,
Cleaning up is almost past.

Every toy is in its place,
Look upon the baby's face!
Clapping hands for what you do,
Big helper, we are proud of you!

rhymes.title: Lullaby Songbird
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the sky,
Time to sing a lullaby.
Baby is a sleepy head,
Time to tuck them into bed.

Speak in whispers, very low,
Watch the sleepy eyelids go.
Pat the blanket, soft and light,
Say a gentle, sweet goodnight.

You are such a gentle friend,
Care is what you always send.
Step away upon your toes,
Baby sleeps in sweet repose.

Close the door and turn the light,
Everything is calm and bright.
You are now off duty, friend,
Time for your own day to end.

rhymes.title: Diaper Duty Helper
rhymes.text:
Little brother needs a wipe,
Time to make the crying stop.
Fetch the diaper nice and neat,
Bring it on your speedy feet.

Time to grab the powder too,
Show him just what you can do.
Throw the stinky one away,
You are helping out today!

Wash your hands and sing a song,
Now the diaper's on all strong.
Big kid helper, proud and tall,
Best big brother of them all!

Give a hug and give a kiss,
Helper days are full of bliss.
Smile and cheer, the task is done,
Helping babies is so fun!

rhymes.title: Gentle Touch Song
rhymes.text:
Baby sister is so small,
Does not walk or talk at all.
Use a gentle, loving hand,
Softest touch in all the land.

Stroke her little tiny toes,
Touch her button of a nose.
Pat her back to help her sleep,
Quiet now, don't make a peep.

When she giggles, you can smile,
Sit and cuddle for a while.
Big kid hugs are warm and tight,
Keep the baby safe and bright.

Share your favorite rattle toy,
Fill the room with so much joy.
Gentle hands and caring heart,
You have done the sweetest part!

rhymes.title: Stroller Push Parade
rhymes.text:
Time to take a walk outside,
Baby gets a bumpy ride.
Grab the stroller by the bar,
We can travel very far!

Push it slowly down the street,
Moving with your happy feet.
Watch the doggies running by,
Look up at the sunny sky.

Hold the handle nice and tight,
Keep the baby's blanket right.
Watch the sidewalk as you go,
Walking fast and walking slow.

We are a parade today,
Singing all along the way.
Big kid helper leading track,
Bring us safely right back back!

rhymes.title: Bedtime Lullaby Helper
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the sky,
Time to sing a lullaby.
Baby brother needs his rest,
Being quiet is the best.

Bring his favorite sleepy bear,
Place it gently by his chair.
Tuck the blankets nice and warm,
Keep him safe from any storm.

Whisper softly, do not shout,
Put the little lights right out.
Creep on tippy-toes away,
Rest until the coming day.

You are growing strong and wise,
Watching with your loving eyes.
Big kid helper, shining star,
Oh how wonderful you are!

rhymes.title: Toy Cleanup Team
rhymes.text:
Blocks are scattered on the floor,
Time to tidy up some more.
Baby sister wants to chew,
Let us pick them up, you two!

Red and yellow, blue and green,
Make the playroom nice and clean.
Put them in the plastic box,
Right beside the fuzzy socks.

Sing a happy cleanup tune,
We will finish very soon.
Every toy is in its place,
Look at mama's smiling face!

High five for the helper star,
Look how capable you are!
Cleaning up is fun and sweet,
Now the playroom looks complete!

rhymes.title: Diaper Duty Time
rhymes.text:
Little baby makes a sound,
Time to gather things around.
Bring a diaper, clean and neat,
Tickle baby on the feet.
Wipe the tummy, wipe the toes,
Wipe the tiny button nose.
Slide the diaper underneath,
Big kid helps without a grief.
Snaps go here and snaps go there,
Baby kicks up in the air.
Throw the dirty one away,
Good job helping out today!
Wash your hands and sing a song,
Helping baby all day long.
You are such a helper star,
Best big sibling near and far!

rhymes.title: The Stroller Push
rhymes.text:
Time to take a little walk,
Baby makes a happy talk.
Grab the handle, hold it tight,
Guide the stroller to the right.
Step by step we walk along,
Singing out a happy song.
Watch out for the bumpy street,
Move your little walking feet.
Baby smiles and claps her hands,
 Happiest in all the lands.
Stop at crossing, look around,
Not a single scary sound.
Push the wheels so nice and slow,
That is how big helpers go.
Home again, we did it right,
Hugs and kisses, what a sight!

rhymes.title: Gentle Toy Share
rhymes.text:
Baby wants a toy to hold,
Something shiny, bright and bold.
Pick a rattle off the floor,
Hand it through the nursery door.
Give it gently, nice and slow,
Watch the happy baby glow.
Share a block and share a bear,
Showing how much you can care.
Baby drops it with a plop,
Pick it up and do not stop.
Pat the head and say hello,
You are quite a helpful pro.
Playing games is twice as fun,
Sharing with the little one.
Put the toys back in the bin,
Big kid helper, you just win!

rhymes.title: Bath Time Bubbles
rhymes.text:
Baby tub is getting filled,
Hope no water gets here spilled!
Bring the yellow rubber duck,
Give the baby's toes a pluck.
Wash the hair with bubbles bright,
Make the little crown look white.
Hand a towel soft and warm,
Keep the baby safe from harm.
Wrap her up and hold her tight,
Getting ready for the night.
Pj's on and buttons snap,
Time for bed and time for nap.
Help to dry the floor up clean,
Best big helper ever seen.
Now we whisper quiet sounds,
Peace and quiet all around.

rhymes.title: The Big High Five
rhymes.text:
Baby tries to eat a pear,
Food is flying everywhere!
Grab a napkin from the stack,
Wipe the tummy, wipe the back.
Pick the spoon up from the floor,
Ask if baby wants some more.
Drink the water, sip a cup,
Help to clean the baby up.
High chair tray is wiped and neat,
Time to jump up on your feet.
Give the baby big applause,
Cheering for the little cause.
Give a gentle high-five now,
Take a happy helper bow.
Being big is so much fun,
Helping out the little one!

rhymes.title: The Diaper Duty Dance
rhymes.text:
Time to help the baby now,
Bring a diaper with a bow.
Wipes are ready in a row,
Watch our little helper go!

Fetch the powder, soft and sweet,
Tickle baby's tiny feet.
Throw the old one in the bin,
Look at that big helper grin!

Baby smiles and claps her hands,
 Happiest in all the lands.
You are growing big and strong,
Singing out our helper song.

Pat the back and give a kiss,
Helper days are full of bliss!
Now we wash our hands up high,
Wave a happy, cheerful bye!

rhymes.title: Stroller Push and Song
rhymes.text:
Get the stroller out the door,
We are ready to explore.
Hold my hand and stay right near,
Walking with our baby dear.

Push the wheels along the floor,
We will find adventures more.
Baby giggles in her seat,
Watching little helper feet.

Stop at corners, look around,
Listen for each pretty sound.
You are driving, you are guide,
Keeping baby safe inside.

Home again from our great walk,
Ready for a little talk.
Greatest helper in the town,
Put the stroller safely down!

rhymes.title: The Gentle Playtime Train
rhymes.text:
Choo choo train is rolling by,
Building blocks up to the sky.
Share a toy and give a smile,
Sit and play a little while.

Baby wants the yellow block,
Tick-tock goes the playroom clock.
Give it gently, nice and slow,
Watch the happy baby grow!

Stack them high and knock them down,
Not a single angry frown.
Pick up pieces off the floor,
Open up the sharing door.

Toy box closing with a snap,
Time to take a cozy nap.
Such a helper, sweet and true,
Baby loves to play with you!

rhymes.title: Feeding Time Cheers
rhymes.text:
Spoon is ready, bowl is too,
Here is what we get to do!
Tie the bib around his chest,
Big kid helper is the best.

Mash the banana, squash the pea,
Feed the baby 1, 2, 3.
Wipe the chin and catch a drip,
Holding tightly to the cup.

Drink the water, take a sip,
Swallowing a tiny drip.
All done eating, bowl is clean,
Best big sibling ever seen!

Wash the table, clean the floor,
We don't need to eat no more.
Clap your hands and give a cheer,
Mealtime is so joyful here!

rhymes.title: Lullaby and Gentle Night
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the west,
Baby needs a little rest.
Turn the quiet music low,
Rock the baby to and fro.

Fetch the blanket, soft and warm,
Keep our little baby from harm.
Shh, shh, shh, the shadows creep,
Baby falling fast asleep.

Whisper softly in the room,
Sweep away the daytime gloom.
Walk on tiptoe, silent feet,
Resting in the cozy sheet.

Helper did a wondrous job,
Not a single tear or sob.
Close your eyes and slumber deep,
Angels watch you as you sleep.

stories.title: Sammy's Sparkly Smile
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Sammy finished eating a yummy bowl of oatmeal with sticky banana slices. Sammy patted his tummy and said, "All done!" Then, Mommy smiled and pointed to the big bathroom mirror. "Time to visit the sink, Sammy! It is time to make our pearly whites shine bright." Sammy hopped down from his big chair and waddled to the bathroom. He looked up and saw his special blue toothbrush waiting for him. Mommy put a tiny, pea-sized blob of strawberry toothpaste right on top of the soft bristles. It smelled so sweet and yummy! Sammy picked up his toothbrush with both hands. "Ready, set, brush?" asked Mommy. Sammy nodded with a big, happy grin. He opened his mouth wide, like a happy little hippo. Ahhhhh! Sammy moved his brush round and round. Up and down went the bristles, tickling his teeth. He brushed the top teeth, saying, "Hello, top teeth!" Then he brushed the bottom teeth, saying, "Hello, bottom teeth!" He even brushed the very back teeth where the crunchy crackers liked to hide. Sammy giggled as the strawberry bubbles tickled his tongue. Brushing teeth was so much fun! After a little bit, it was time to rinse. Sammy scooped some cool water into his bright red cup. He took a tiny sip, swished it all around his mouth like a washing machine, and spit it out into the sink. Whoosh! Mommy clapped her hands together and cheered. "Look at that!" she said. Sammy looked in the mirror and flashed a huge, wide smile. His teeth sparkled just like tiny stars in the night sky. "Great job, Sammy!" Mommy gave him a warm, cozy hug. Sammy felt so proud of his clean, shiny pearly whites. He was ready for a wonderful day of play.

stories.title: Bella Bear's bedtime Brushing
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, painting the sky in pretty shades of pink and orange. Little Bella Bear had a very busy day playing blocks and chasing butterflies. Now, the sleepy moon was peeking through her bedroom window. But before Bella could snuggle into her soft bed with her favorite teddy bear, it was time for a very important bedtime job. Bella needed to help her pearly whites get ready for sleep! Bella walked into the warm, brightly lit bathroom and climbed up onto her safe little stepstool. There was her shiny green toothbrush, waiting just for her. Daddy walked in and gave her a gentle squeeze. "Let's get those teeth sparkly clean, little bear," Daddy whispered softly. Bella picked up her green toothbrush. Daddy helped her squirt a stripe of minty toothpaste that looked like fresh snow. Bella opened her mouth wide. She made a happy growling sound like a friendly bear: Grrrr! She gently moved the toothbrush in little circles all over her teeth. Circle, circle, on the left. Circle, circle, on the right. She brushed the front teeth where she ate her crunchy carrots, and she brushed the back teeth where she munched her yummy broccoli. Bella sang her favorite little brushing song while she worked. Up and down, left and right, making all her teeth feel bright! When she was all done, Daddy helped her rinse with a splash of water from a yellow cup. Bella spat the water into the sink. Splish, splash, splash! She wiped her mouth with a soft towel. Bella opened her mouth wide and showed Daddy her teeth. They looked so clean and gleamed in the bathroom light. "Such wonderful pearly whites, Bella Bear!" Daddy praised with a big smile. Bella felt so happy and accomplished. Her mouth felt cool, minty, and fresh. She gave Daddy a sweet goodnight kiss, climbed into her cozy bed, and drifted off to sleep with a sparkling smile.

stories.title: Leo's Magic Toothbrush Adventure
stories.text: Ring-a-ling, time to brush! Leo heard the cheerful timer go off on the kitchen counter. Leo was a brave space explorer today, and every space explorer needed strong, shiny teeth to go on big adventures. Leo zoomed like a rocket ship right into the bathroom, making spaceship noises: Whoosh, zoom, beep-boop! Grandma was already waiting for him with a big smile and his favorite yellow rocket-ship toothbrush. "Ready for launch, Captain Leo?" asked Grandma with a twinkle in her eye. Leo nodded eagerly, his eyes wide with excitement. "Ready, Grandma!" Grandma put a tiny dot of bubblegum-flavored toothpaste onto the brush. It smelled just like sweet bubblegum blowing in the wind. Leo grabbed the handle with a firm grip, just like a real pilot holding the steering wheel. He stood tall on his stepstool and looked in the mirror. "Activating sparkle shields!" Leo announced. He opened his mouth nice and wide, ready for action. Up went the brush to clean the upper galaxy of teeth. He brushed side to side, tickling the top row. Then down went the brush to explore the lower galaxy. He brushed round and round, making sure not a single tooth was left behind. Grandma cheered him on, clapping her hands. "Keep it up, Captain Leo! You are doing a stellar job!" Leo made zooming sounds as he brushed away all the little sugar bugs that tried to hide after his afternoon snack. After counting all his clean teeth, it was time to splash. Leo took a sip of water from his favorite green cup, swished it round and round his cheeks until they puffed out like a chipmunk, and spit it into the sink. Pfft! Grandma wiped his chin with a fluffy towel. Leo looked in the mirror and smiled his biggest, brightest smile. His pearly whites gleamed like shiny space rocks. "Mission accomplished!" cheered Grandma. Leo felt so proud and happy. His teeth were clean, healthy, and ready for whatever fun adventure came next.

stories.title: Sammy Starfish Brushes His Teeth
stories.text: Down at the bottom of the sparkly blue ocean, little Sammy Starfish was getting ready for bed. The moon was glowing like a nightlight, and the tiny fish were tucked into their cozy seaweed beds. Sammy gave a big, sleepy yawn. But wait! What did Sammy need to do before he closed his eyes? Brush his pearly white arms! Sammy had five little arms, and right in the middle of each one was a shiny white tooth. He zoomed over to his bathroom made of smooth pink shells. He picked up his favorite toothbrush, which was made from a soft green sea-sponge. He squeezed a tiny, pea-sized blob of minty toothpaste right onto the bristles. It smelled just like sweet peppermint bubbles! Sammy started with his very first arm. Up and down, round and round, went the little brush. He sang a happy underwater song as he worked. 'Brush, brush, brush your tooth, make it clean and bright!' Then he moved to his second arm. Round and round, sweeping away any bits of yummy kelp-cake he had eaten for dinner. Then the third arm, the fourth arm, and finally the fifth arm! Sammy looked in his shiny clam-shell mirror and smiled a big, glowing smile. His teeth twinkled like little stars in the deep sea. 'Splendid!' cheered Sammy. Now his mouth felt super fresh, tingly, and clean. He rinsed his mouth with a little cup of ocean water and spat it out with a bubbly *whoosh*. Sammy climbed into his cozy bed made of soft sand and fluffy sea sponges. He pulled up his blanket and closed his sleepy eyes, knowing his pearly white teeth were safe, clean, and happy all through the night. Goodnight, Sammy!

stories.title: Pip the Puppy Counts His Sparkles
stories.text: The sun was peeking over the green hills, and golden retriever puppy Pip woke up with a big wiggle and a tail wag. *Thump, thump, thump* went his tail against the floor! Pip stretched his front paws way out, gave a loud puppy yawn, and scampered into the bright bathroom. Today was a very special day because Pip was learning to make his smile super shiny. He hopped right up onto his little puppy stool so he could see in the big mirror. There was his friendly reflection wagging back at him! Pip’s human brought out his special doggy toothbrush with soft bristles and tasty chicken-flavored toothpaste. Pip licked the brush with a happy *mlem!* Yum, delicious! Now it was time to brush his pearly white teeth. Pip opened his mouth wide: 'Aaaaah!' His human gently guided the brush along his top teeth. Back and forth, tickle, tickle, tickle. Pip giggled because it felt like a tiny massage for his mouth. Then they brushed the bottom teeth. Up and down, sweeping away any crumbs from his morning crunchy biscuits. Pip counted along in his head: one, two, three, four, all the way to the back! Every single tooth got a turn to sparkle. When they were all done, Pip rinsed his mouth with a tiny sip of fresh water from his blue bowl. He looked in the mirror again and flashed a wide, proud puppy grin. His teeth gleamed just like little pearls in the morning sun. 'Good boy, Pip!' whispered his human, giving him a gentle scratch behind his floppy ears. Pip trotted off to the kitchen for breakfast, feeling proud, happy, and ready for a fun-filled day of play with a wonderfully clean and healthy smile!

stories.title: Luna's Magical Moonlit Brushing
stories.text: High up in the cozy treehouse, little Luna was getting ready for her dreamland adventure. The night sky was velvet-dark, and the silver moon was shining softly through her bedroom window. But before Luna could hop into her dream cloud, she needed to take care of something very important. Her pearly white teeth needed a special bedtime polish! Luna tiptoed into her bathroom, which smelled like lavender and sweet berries. She turned on the warm water and grabbed her sparkly purple toothbrush. Then came the magical part: adding the toothpaste! It was glittering paste that looked just like moonbeams. Luna put a tiny dab on her brush, no bigger than a ladybug. She stood on her little yellow step stool so she could see her smiling face in the mirror. 'Time to make those pearly whites shine like stars!' whispered Luna to herself with a giggle. She placed the brush gently against her back teeth. Up and down, tickle and swish, making tiny circles just like a little drawing. She brushed the tops, she brushed the fronts, and she even tickled the backs where her favorite crunchy apple snack might be hiding. She hummed a sweet bedtime lullaby while she worked. *Swish, swish, bubble, bubble.* She made a funny face in the mirror, showing all her top and bottom teeth. They were looking brighter and shinier with every single brush stroke. When she finished, Luna rinsed her mouth with a cup of cool water and spat out the bubbly magic into the sink. She wiped her mouth with a soft towel and flashed the mirror her biggest, brightest grin. Her teeth sparkled like diamonds. Luna felt so proud and refreshed. She scampered back to her bed, snuggled deep under her starry quilt, and drifted off to sleep with a happy, healthy smile.

stories.title: Sammy's Sparkly Toothbrush Adventure
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Sammy finished eating a yummy, crunchy apple for a healthy afternoon snack. Sammy rubbed his tummy and smiled big in the bathroom mirror. 'Uh oh,' whispered Sammy. 'I see a tiny apple piece hiding on my tooth!' Just then, Sammy's special blue toothbrush with soft, tickly bristles winked from the cup. 'Hello, Sammy! It is time for our fun daily game of Counting Pearly Whites!' cheered the toothbrush in a gentle, bubbly voice. Sammy giggled and squeezed a tiny, pea-sized blob of strawberry toothpaste onto the brush. It smelled just like sweet summer strawberries! Sammy opened his mouth wide, making a big 'Ahhh' sound like a sleepy little bear. The toothbrush started to dance a happy little wiggle-waggle dance across the front teeth. Up and down, side to side, making friendly little swishy sounds. 'Let's count together!' sang Sammy. 'One, two, three, four, five shiny teeth at the top!' Then down to the bottom row they went. 'Six, seven, eight, nine, ten happy teeth at the bottom!' Every single pearly white was getting a magical bubble bath. The bubbles tickled Sammy's gums, making him laugh a happy little giggle. 'Bubbles, bubbles everywhere, washing away the sticky sugar bears!' whispered Sammy's mommy, who came in to give him a warm, encouraging hug and cheer him on. When the brushing was all done, Sammy rinsed his mouth with fresh, cool water and spit it out into the sink with a proud 'Whoosh!' He looked in the mirror again and flashed a huge, bright grin. His teeth looked like rows of shining little stars twinkling in the night sky. They felt so clean, smooth, and fresh. Sammy gave his toothbrush a high-five and whispered, 'Good job, team.' Mommy kissed Sammy's forehead and said, 'You took such wonderful care of your strong, healthy smile today, my big helper.' Sammy felt so proud, happy, and ready for a cozy, sweet-dream bedtime.

stories.title: Bella Bear's Morning Shine
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! The golden morning sunbeams danced right through Bella Bear's bedroom window, tickling her furry little nose. Bella stretched her paws way up high into the soft morning air and let out a big, sleepy yawn. 'Good morning, world!' chirped Bella. Today was a very special day because Bella was growing bigger every single day. She hopped right out of her cozy bed and scampered into her bright yellow bathroom. Today was the day to make her teeth shine brighter than the morning sun! Bella climbed up onto her safe little stepstool so she could see herself clearly in the mirror. There waiting for her was her favorite yellow toothbrush with green polka dots. 'Time for Counting Pearly Whites!' whispered Bella excitedly. She gently dipped her toothbrush under the warm water tap, watching the water swirl around. Then, she added a little dot of minty-fresh toothpaste that tasted just like cool peppermint leaves. Bella opened her mouth wide like a roaring little lion. 'Rrrrroarrr!' Then she began to brush with the softest, gentlest circles. Round and round went the brush on the top teeth. 'One, two, three, four, five friendly top teeth!' sang Bella in a sweet, happy voice. Then round and round went the brush on the bottom teeth. 'Six, seven, eight, nine, ten strong bottom teeth!' Every single tooth was getting a gentle morning massage. The minty bubbles made her mouth feel so cool and awake. Bella's daddy walked into the bathroom, clapping his hands softly and whispering, 'Look at my big girl taking such wonderful care of her sparkly smile! I am so proud of you, Bella Bear.' Bella felt a warm, fuzzy feeling glow deep inside her tummy. She finished up, rinsed her mouth with fresh water, and wiped her face with a fluffy towel. She looked in the mirror and gave the biggest, brightest smile she could possibly make. Her teeth gleamed like polished pearls. Bella skipped out of the bathroom, ready to play, learn, and share her gorgeous smile with everyone she met all day long.

stories.title: Pip's Bedtime Starry Smile
stories.text: The sleepy moon was hanging like a glowing silver banana in the deep blue night sky. Little Pip the bunny had just finished his warm bath and put on his softest star-patterned pajamas. Pip rubbed his sleepy eyes and let out a soft little yawn. But before he could hop into his warm bed for sleep, it was time for his most important nighttime routine. It was time for Counting Pearly Whites! Pip hopped into the bathroom and jumped up to the sink. Waiting for him was his shiny green toothbrush, ready for action. Pip put a tiny drop of bubbly bubblegum toothpaste on his brush. It smelled like a sweet carnival treat! Pip opened his mouth wide, just like a little baby bird waiting for a yummy snack. He gently brushed the backs, fronts, and tops of every single tooth. 'Scrub, scrub, little brush, let's not rush,' hummed Pip softly to himself. He began to count his teeth in a whisper. 'One, two, three little teeth in the front... four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten wonderful teeth hiding all around!' The fruity bubbles tickled his pink tongue and made him smile. Brushing away the daytime sugar bugs was so important so his teeth could stay strong and healthy while he slept. Pip's big sister hopped in and gave him a gentle pat on the head, whispering, 'You are doing such an amazing job, Pip. Your smile is shining like a whole constellation of stars!' Pip felt so encouraged and happy. He rinsed his mouth with a mouthful of fresh water, splashing it out with a cheerful little gurgle. He dried his whiskers with a fluffy towel and flashed a wide, dazzling grin in the mirror. His teeth were so clean, sparkly, and ready for sweet dreams. Pip crawled into his cozy bed, pulled up his patchwork quilt, and closed his eyes with a happy sigh, knowing his healthy pearly whites were resting safely until the morning sun.

stories.title: Sammy Squirrel's Nutty Brush
stories.text: Once upon a time, high up in the leafy green oak tree, lived a little squirrel named Sammy. Sammy had a very busy day. He scampered up trunks, played hide-and-seek with his squirrel friends, and munched on crunchy green acorns and sweet, juicy berries. Yum, yum, yum! But when the big golden sun started to sink behind the hills, it was time for Sammy to get ready for bed. 'Time to check our pearly whites, Sammy!' called Mama Squirrel with a warm, gentle smile. Sammy hopped down to the bathroom branch and looked at his reflection. He opened up his mouth wide. Ahhhh! 'Let us count them,' said Mama, handing him a sparkly blue toothbrush with soft, tickly bristles. 'One, two, three, four shiny teeth at the front!' Sammy giggled as the toothbrush tickled his gums. Up and down went the little brush, sweeping away all the sleepy little berry bits. 'Brush the top, brush the bottom, make them shine like little stars,' hummed Mama Squirrel, encouraging him every step of the way. Sammy spit out the bubbly toothpaste into the leaf sink and flashed a huge, bright grin. 'Look, Mama! My pearly whites are sparkling just like the night sky!' Mama gave him a big, cozy hug. 'You did a wonderful job, my sweet little squirrel. Your teeth are clean, strong, and ready for sweet dreams.' Sammy crawled into his acorn-shell bed feeling so proud and happy, knowing he took the very best care of his smile. Goodnight, Sammy!

stories.title: Leo Lion's Morning Roar
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! The golden rays peeked into the cozy jungle cave where little Leo Lion was waking up. Stretch went his front paws, yawn went his sleepy mouth. 'Roar!' whispered Leo softly. But before he could give his big, happy morning roar to the jungle, Mama Lion gently nudged him toward the sparkling stream. 'Good morning, my brave little lion. Before we greet the day, we must make sure our pearly whites are ready to shine,' purred Mama. Leo loved his teeth. They helped him chew yummy bananas and crunch on sweet melon. He sat on a smooth river rock and picked up his bright yellow toothbrush, which had a little lion tail on the end. Mama put a tiny pea-sized drop of minty toothpaste on it. 'Let us count your strong, happy teeth, Leo,' Mama said cheerfully. 'One, two, three, four, five!' Leo counted along, opening his mouth wide like a big, majestic king of the jungle. Round and round went the brush, tickling his gums and making lots of happy bubbles. 'Great job brushing the back teeth! Fantastic job on the front teeth!' cheered Mama, clapping her paws softly. Leo rinsed his mouth with fresh, cool water and let out a huge, sparkling grin. His teeth looked as bright as the morning sun. 'Now I am ready!' beamed Leo. He took a deep breath and let out his biggest, brightest, cleanest morning roar across the whole jungle. All the animal friends smiled back because they knew Leo had the happiest, healthiest pearly whites around!

stories.title: Bella Bunny's Bedtime Routine
stories.text: Twinkle, twinkle, little stars began to dot the evening sky in the soft meadow. Little Bella Bunny hopped gently into her cozy burrow. It was almost time for bed, but first, she had an important job to do. Bella bounced over to her little wooden vanity mirror and touched her cute pink nose. 'Time for our magical tooth-cleaning adventure!' whispered Papa Bunny, handing her a lovely lavender toothbrush with soft, bunny-ear bristles. Bella loved this part of the night. She hopped up onto her little stool and opened her mouth wide. Ahhh! Papa smiled encouragingly and squeezed a dab of strawberry-flavored toothpaste onto her brush. 'Let us count our pearly white rabbit teeth, Bella,' said Papa softly. 'One, two big top teeth, and one, two big bottom teeth!' Bella giggled as the soft bristles danced across her teeth. Up, down, side to side, brushing away all the bits of yummy clover and sweet carrot from dinner. 'You are doing such an amazing job, little one. Your smile is getting brighter and brighter,' praised Papa, giving her a gentle stroke on her long, floppy ears. Bella rinsed her mouth with a tiny cup of water and spat out the bubbly foam. She looked in the mirror and blinked in surprise. Her teeth were sparkling like little pearls in the moonlight! 'All clean and ready for sleep,' cheered Bella happily. Papa wrapped her up in her softest blanket and tucked her in tightly. Bella closed her eyes, feeling safe, cozy, and so very proud of her sparkling pearly whites. Sweet dreams, little bunny!

stories.title: Sammy's Sparkly Tooth Song
stories.text:
Once upon a time, little Sammy finished eating a yummy bowl of oatmeal with fresh blueberries. He wiped his little mouth and smiled wide in the big bathroom mirror. Guess what? It was time to visit the magical land of Counting Pearly Whites! Sammy loved this special part of his bedtime routine.

His mommy handed him his favorite blue toothbrush with soft, tickly bristles. Sammy squeezed a tiny, pea-sized blob of sparkling strawberry toothpaste right onto the brush. It smelled just like summer fields! Mommy smiled warmly and gave him a gentle high-five. 'Are you ready to make your teeth shine like twinkling stars, Sammy?' she asked.

Sammy nodded excitedly. He opened his mouth wide, just like a roaring little dinosaur. Ahhhh! He placed the soft bristles on his bottom teeth. Up and down went the brush, tickling his gums and making cheerful bubbles. As he brushed, Mommy sang a sweet, gentle song about little white helpers keeping Sammy's smile healthy and strong.

'One, two, three, four, look at the pearly whites galore!' Mommy sang softly. Sammy giggled as the bubbles tickled his tongue. He brushed the top teeth, making little circles on each one. Round and round went the blue brush, sweeping away all the sleepy food crumbs from dinner.

After a thorough brushing, Sammy rinsed his mouth with a big cup of cool water. He swished it around and spit it into the sink with a proud plop! Then, he grinned a huge, gleaming grin into the mirror. His teeth looked so shiny and bright, they practically sparkled in the bathroom light.

'Great job, buddy!' Mommy cheered, wrapping him in a big, cozy hug. Sammy felt so proud of his sparkling clean mouth. He knew that taking care of his teeth every single day kept them strong for chewing yummy snacks, laughing, and smiling big every morning. With a happy yawn, Sammy climbed into his cozy bed, ready for sweet dreams with his brand new, pearly white smile.

stories.title: Bella Bunny's Brushing Adventure
stories.text:
The sun was setting behind the green hills, and little Bella Bunny was getting very sleepy. But before she could hop into her warm bed, she had one very important job to do. It was time to brush her pearly whites! Bella loved her bedtime routine because it made her feel like a sparkling princess.

Daddy Bunny hopped into the bathroom and set down a bright yellow stepping stool so Bella could reach the sink. Bella hopped right up and looked at her reflection. She wiggled her little pink nose and flashed a cute rabbit grin. 'Time to make our teeth shine bright like diamonds!' Daddy whispered with an encouraging smile.

Bella picked up her sparkly pink toothbrush. She squeezed a tiny dot of minty toothpaste onto the bristles. It smelled so fresh and clean! She opened her mouth wide like a friendly little hippopotamus. Up and down, left and right, went the toothbrush, making a soft swishing sound.

'Let's count our happy little helpers,' Daddy said cheerfully. 'One, two, three, four, brushing every single tooth some more!' Bella giggled as the bubbly foam tickled her lips. She made sure to brush the backs of her teeth, the fronts of her teeth, and even gave a gentle tickle to her tongue.

Brushing your teeth is a super important superpower, Bella thought to herself. It chases away the sugar bugs so they don't cause any trouble while she slept. She felt so responsible and proud doing it all by herself.

With a final rinse of fresh water, Bella spit into the sink and smiled. Her teeth looked wonderfully white and felt wonderfully clean. Daddy clapped his paws together and gave her a warm, loving snuggle. 'You did a fantastic job tonight, my sweet bunny,' he praised. Bella crawled under her soft quilt, smiling a bright, healthy smile as she drifted off to dreamland.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Morning Shine
stories.text:
Good morning, sunshine! Little Leo Lion stretched his arms high up into the air and let out a big, sleepy yawn. Roarrr! It was a brand new day full of fun games, building blocks, and yummy breakfast. But before Leo could eat his crunchy morning toast, he had to take care of his most valuable treasures: his strong, pearly white teeth.

Leo bounded into the bright yellow bathroom and hopped onto his special stepping stool. He looked in the mirror and practiced his best lion grin. Mommy Lion walked in, holding a cool green toothbrush and a tube of bubbly orange toothpaste. 'Good morning, my brave little lion! Ready to make your smile gleam?' she asked encouragingly.

Leo roared a happy yes! He squeezed a tiny, sweet-smelling drop of toothpaste onto his brush. Then, he opened his mouth wide and started brushing. He moved the soft bristles in little circles on his top teeth, then his bottom teeth. He made sure to brush the front, the back, and all the corners where breakfast crumbs might try to hide.

Mommy cheered him on with a cheerful rhyme. 'Brush them left, brush them right, keeping every pearly white clean and bright!' Leo smiled around the toothbrush, loving the fizzy bubbles that popped softly inside his mouth. He felt like a champion taking care of his body.

When he was all done, Leo scooped up some water in his paws, rinsed his mouth, and spit it neatly into the sink. He flashed a dazzling, sparkling smile in the mirror. His teeth looked like rows of shiny white pearls!

'You are growing up so fast, Leo. What a wonderful job keeping your teeth healthy,' Mommy praised, giving him a big, fuzzy hug. Leo felt so proud and happy. With his mouth fresh and clean, he was ready to conquer the day with a big, bright, confident smile.

stories.title: Sammy Squirrel's Nutty Brush
stories.text: Once upon a time, high up in the leafy green oak tree, little Sammy Squirrel woke up with a big, wide yawn. Good morning, sleepyhead! Today was a very special day because Sammy was going on a big woodland adventure. But before he could chase butterflies or munch on crunchy acorns, Sammy had something very important to do. He had to make sure his pearly whites were shining bright! Sammy scampered to his tiny bathroom and hopped up on his little wooden stool. He picked up his favorite bright blue toothbrush, which had soft bristles just like fluffy dandelion seeds. Next came the toothpaste, smelling all yummy like sweet strawberries. Sammy squeezed a tiny, pea-sized dot right onto the brush. Are you ready, Sammy? Let us count them! One, two, three, four, five sparkling teeth in the front! Sammy opened his mouth wide. Ahhhh! He started brushing the top teeth with tiny little circles, just like spinning wagon wheels. Round and round they went, sweeping away the sleepy-time dust. Then he brushed his bottom teeth, moving his brush side to side like a little train chugging down the track. Choo-choo! Next, it was time to tickle the back teeth. Sammy giggled as the brush tickled his molars. Back and forth, cleaning away the yummy bits of yesterday's snacks. After brushing, Sammy took a big cup of fresh water, took a sip, and swished it all around his cheeks. Swish, swish, spit! Down the drain went the bubbly water. Sammy looked in the shiny mirror and gave the biggest, brightest smile ever. His teeth twinkled like little stars in the night sky. He did it! Sammy’s pearly whites were clean, healthy, and ready for a wonderful, happy day of play. Hooray for brushing!

stories.title: Bella Bear's Shiny Smile
stories.text: Deep in the whispering woods, a gentle little bear named Bella was waking up from her cozy nap.
