Toby counts along: one, two, three, four, making sure every passenger gets a turn to shine. The toothpaste makes a wonderful, frothy cloud that feels like brushing with a soft, warm blanket of bubbles. The train moves carefully around the curves, brushing the front teeth until they gleam like polished silver. Then, the train dips down to the lower tracks. Down, down, down it goes, chugging along the bottom row with a gentle, rhythmic motion. Toby makes tiny engine noises in his throat: 'Chug-chug-choo!' The train stops at the very back teeth to give them an extra-special polish. All the sleepy sugar bugs pack their bags and scurry away because they cannot stay where the Toothpaste Train is running! When the track is completely clean, Toby parks his toothbrush by the faucet. He takes a cup of water, rinses away the bubbly foam, and wipes his chin with a fluffy towel. He looks in the mirror and gives a giant, proud grin. His teeth are sparkling bright! Mama wraps her arms around him and kisses his forehead. 'Wonderful job, Toby. Your teeth are ready for sweet dreams.' Toby smiles contently, knowing he is the best train conductor in the whole world.

stories.title: All Aboard the Toothpaste Train
stories.text: Choo-choo! Clickety-clack! Hear that sound? That is the Toothpaste Train getting ready to leave the station in the bright pink bathroom. Little Leo rubs his sleepy eyes and smiles. It is time for his favorite nighttime adventure. 'All aboard!' whispers Mama, holding up Leo’s favorite blue toothbrush. Leo giggles and climbs up onto his big step stool so he can see the mirror. He holds his toothbrush tightly, just like a real train conductor holds his steering wheel. The Toothpaste Train needs special fuel to chug across his teeth and chase away the sticky sugar bugs that stayed behind after dinner. Mama gently squeezes a pea-sized dot of minty-fresh toothpaste onto the bristles. 'Look, Leo! A fluffy white cloud for our engine!' The train is ready to roll. Leo opens his mouth wide like a tunnel. Here it comes! Choo-choo! The little blue toothbrush chugs along the top row of teeth, chugging left and right, making a soft brushing sound. Up, down, round and round. The minty bubbles tickle Leo’s tongue, and he lets out a happy giggle. 'Next stop, the bottom tracks!' says Mama encouragingly. The train zooms down to the bottom teeth, clicking and clacking along the back molars where the chewy raisins like to hide. The Toothpaste Train works so hard, polishing every single tooth until they sparkle like little stars in the night sky. Now, it is time for the tunnel to clear. Leo takes a big sip of water from his red cup, swishes it around his cheeks like a washing machine, and spits it out into the sink with a big WHOOSH. 'Great job, conductor Leo!' cheers Mama. Leo wipes his mouth with a fluffy towel and feels so proud. His teeth feel extra smooth, clean, and strong. The Toothpaste Train pulls safely into the station and parks for the night, ready for sweet dreams and another fun ride tomorrow.

stories.title: The Sparkle Express Nightly Journey
stories.text: The stars are twinkling outside the window, which means it is time for Mia’s special nighttime journey. Mia stretches her arms up high and gives a big yawn. 'Is it time for the Sparkle Express?' she asks Daddy. Daddy nods with a big smile. 'You guessed it, Mia! The Sparkle Express is waiting on the green sink counter.' Mia hops down from her bed and tip-toes into the bathroom, feeling very excited. The Sparkle Express is no ordinary train; it has a bright yellow handle and super soft bristles that love to dance across teeth. Daddy picks up the toothpaste tube, which smells just like sweet strawberries. He squeezes a tiny, berry-scented dot right onto the brush. 'A sweet strawberry cloud for our journey!' he says cheerfully. Mia opens her mouth wide, making a shape just like a big 'O'. 'Ahhh!' she says. The Sparkle Express starts its engine. Choo-choo! Toot-toot! It gently chugs along the front teeth, visiting the smile station. Then, it chugs all the way to the back, chugging past the sleepy molars. Mia helps steer the train by holding Daddy’s hand over the brush. She moves it in happy little circles. Round and round go the strawberry bubbles, sweeping away all the little crumbs from her afternoon crackers. The train goes up the hills and down into the valleys, making sure every tooth gets a shiny coat of sparkle. 'You are doing such a wonderful job keeping your smile bright, Mia,' says Daddy, giving her a gentle hug. Mia feels the warm encouragement and brushes even better. When the journey is finished, it is time to clear the tracks. Mia takes a sip of cool water, rinses her mouth, and does a bubbly spit into the basin. Splish, splash! She wipes her chin and looks in the mirror. Her teeth are glowing and bright, ready for a restful sleep. The Sparkle Express whispers goodnight, resting peacefully by the faucet until the next big adventure.

stories.title: The Morning Minty Caboose
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! The sun is peeking through the curtains, and Toby is already wide awake. Today is a brand new day full of play, and Toby knows just how to start it right. He marches straight into the bathroom for the most important morning ride: the Minty Caboose! Toby’s big sister, Maya, is there to help him be the best train conductor in the whole wide world. 'Are you ready to brush, Toby?' asks Maya. Toby nods enthusiastically and points to his green dinosaur toothbrush. 'Ready!' he says proudly. Maya puts a tiny, dot of foaming toothpaste on the brush—just the right amount for a little boy. The toothpaste smells cool and fresh, like a crisp morning breeze. Toby climbs onto his orange step stool and flashes a big morning grin. The Minty Caboose is ready to chuff-chuff across the tracks. Toby opens his mouth wide like a cave. Here we go! The toothbrush chugs along the top teeth, brushing away the sleepy-time germs. Chug-chug-chug, whee! Toby loves making train noises while he brushes. He moves the brush side to side, making sure to tickle the front teeth and the chewing teeth in the back. Maya cheers him on, 'Look at those wheels go! You are brushing like a true professional, Toby!' Toby feels so happy and encouraged by her kind words. He brushes the bottom teeth next, making sure the minty freshness reaches every single corner. When the train ride comes to an end, it is time for the water splash. Toby cups his little hands, scoops up some water, and rinses his mouth. Swoosh, swoosh, spit! The sink sparkles, and Toby’s smile sparkles even brighter. He rinses his dinosaur toothbrush and puts it back in its holder. 'What a fantastic ride,' says Maya, high-fiving her little brother. Toby feels ready to take on the day with a healthy, happy, and super clean smile!

stories.title: All Aboard the Minty Express!
stories.text: BEEP! BEEP! Toot! Toot! Time to get ready for bed, little Leo! It was almost time for sleep, but first, Leo had a very important job to do. It was time for the Toothpaste Train! Leo ran into the bright bathroom and hopped up on his little step stool. There sat his shiny blue toothbrush, looking just like a sleek train engine waiting at the station. 'Choo-choo!' whispered Leo with a big, happy grin. Mom smiled and picked up the special toothpaste. 'Shall we load the passenger car, Engineer Leo?' she asked gently. 'Yes, please!' cheered Leo. Squeeze, squeeze went the tube. A tiny, pea-sized dot of bubbly mint toothpaste slid right onto the bristles like a cozy little passenger hopping onto a train seat. 'All aboard!' sang Mom. Leo carefully picked up his toothbrush and held it just like a steering wheel. First stop: the top mountain teeth! Chugga-chugga, chugga-chugga, choo-choo! Leo moved his brush in gentle little circles, tickling his teeth and making lots of happy bubbles. The minty train zoomed across the top track, saying hello to his back molar tunnels. 'Great driving, Leo!' cheered Mom. Next stop: the bottom valley teeth! Chugga-chugga, choo-choo! The little minty train went back and forth, cleaning away all the sticky dinosaur snacks from dinner. Leo giggled as the bubbles tickled his lips. He was doing such a wonderful job keeping his teeth strong and sparkly. 'Now, time to go through the sparkling waterfall tunnel!' said Mom. Leo opened wide and rinsed his mouth with a cup of cool water, swish, swish, spit! Wow, just look at those shiny tracks! They gleamed like freshly polished silver in the bathroom light. Leo gave himself a huge hug in the mirror. He was the best Toothpaste Train engineer in the whole wide world! With sparkling clean teeth and a happy tummy, Leo was ready to climb into his cozy bed for sweet dreams. Goodnight, little engineer! Toot-toot!

stories.title: Mia and the Sparkly Caboose
stories.text: The morning sun was shining brightly through Mia’s bedroom window. Good morning, Mia! Time to stretch high up to the sky and get ready for a brand-new day of fun adventures. But before Mia could eat her crunchy morning toast, she had a very special mission. It was time to visit the bathroom station for the Toothpaste Train! Mia skipped all the way to the sink and climbed up to her special mirror spot. 'Good morning, teeth!' whispered Mia. Her toothbrush was pink and sparkly, just like a magic wand. Dad walked in holding a tube of strawberry-flavored toothpaste that smelled like summer berries. 'Ready to start the engine, Captain Mia?' Dad asked warmly. Mia nodded with excitement and held out her brush. Squeeze, squeeze went the tube, putting a sweet little dab of pink toothpaste right on top. 'The strawberry caboose is ready to roll!' giggled Mia. She placed the brush against her back teeth and started to move in gentle circles. Chugga-chugga, choo-choo! The strawberry train zoomed along the tracks, making the teeth super clean and bright. Mia brushed the front teeth, making a big, silly smile at herself in the mirror. She brushed up, down, and all around, singing a little train song. 'Wooo-wooo!' she whispered softly. Dad clapped his hands. 'Look at those wonderful brushing skills, Mia! You are taking such good care of your smile.' Mia felt so proud and happy inside. Brushing her teeth was like playing a fun game every single morning. She rinsed her mouth with a little cup of water and splashed her face to wake herself up completely. She opened her mouth wide and showed Dad her sparkling white teeth. They shined like little stars! 'All tracks are clear and sparkling clean!' announced Dad. Mia hopped down from her step stool, ready to chug right into the kitchen for her yummy breakfast. Her smile was ready to shine all day long!

stories.title: The Nighttime Journey of the Bubble Express
stories.text: The stars were twinkling outside, and the moon was glowing like a big silver nightlight. Time for little Toby to wind down for bed. But wait! The day wasn't quite finished yet. There was one magical adventure left to do before storytime. It was time to ride the Toothpaste Train! Toby trotted into the bathroom with his favorite green dinosaur toothbrush in his hand. The dinosaur looked very friendly and ready for a night ride. Mom was waiting with the bubble-mint toothpaste, which tasted like cool peppermint breezes. 'Ready for the bedtime express, conductor Toby?' asked Mom with a gentle smile. 'Ready!' said Toby softly. Squeeze, squeeze, a tiny green dot of toothpaste landed softly on the bristles, looking like a little sleeping dragon on a train car. Toby turned on the faucet and got his brush just a tiny bit wet. Then, the nighttime journey began! Chugga-chugga, chugga-chugga, choo-choo! The green dinosaur train chugged slowly across the top teeth. Up and down, round and round, tickling every single tooth to sleep. Toby concentrated so hard, making sure no sleepy tooth was left behind. The minty bubbles started to grow bigger and fluffier, looking just like white clouds in the sky. 'Oh, look at those fluffy clouds!' whispered Mom. Toby giggled as a tiny bubble popped on his nose. Next, the train chugged down to the lower track, going beep-beep as it cleaned away all the crumbs from snack time. Toby was doing such a fantastic job. Brushing his teeth made his mouth feel so fresh and clean, like a cool spring morning. 'Time to wash away the clouds,' said Mom softly. Toby took a sip of water, swished it all around his cheeks, and gently spat into the sink. Swish, swish, splish! He looked in the mirror and flashed a brilliant, gleaming smile. The dinosaur train was parked back in the station, resting until tomorrow. Toby felt so cozy and relaxed. With his sparkly clean teeth, he was ready to hop into bed, cuddle his favorite teddy bear, and drift off to dreamland. Sweet dreams, conductor Toby!

stories.title: All Aboard the Toothpaste Train!
stories.text: Choo-choo! Hear that sound? It is time for Leo to get ready for bed. The bathroom is the station, and Leo is the very best train conductor in the whole wide world! Leo marches into the bathroom with his big boots on, stomping his feet. Tap, tap, tap! Next comes the shiny blue toothbrush. It is the engine of the Toothpaste Train, ready to roll down the tracks. Leo holds his toothbrush high in the air and makes a happy whistle sound. Woo-woo! Now, it is time for the magical cargo. Mommy helps Leo squeeze a little dot of minty toothpaste right onto the bristles. Look at that! It looks like a fluffy white cloud resting on the tracks. 'All aboard!' whispers Leo with a giant smile. The Toothpaste Train rolls slowly into the tunnel of Leo's mouth. Chug-a-chug, puff-puff! The little train visits the top teeth first. Up, up, up go the wheels, brushing away all the sticky bits of dinner. Then the train chugs down to the bottom teeth. Down, down, down! It tickles a little bit, but Leo giggles instead of making a fuss. He brushes the front teeth, the side teeth, and way in the back where the sleepy molars live. The minty bubbles tickle his tongue like fizzy water. 'Great job, conductor!' says Daddy, giving Leo a warm hug. Leo rinses his mouth with cool water and spits the sparkly bubbles into the sink. Swoosh! Down the drain they go. Leo’s teeth look so bright and shiny. They sparkle in the bathroom light just like stars in the night sky. Leo feels so proud of his shiny, clean smile. He hangs his toothbrush back on its hook to rest until tomorrow. The Toothpaste Train stops chugging, and the station is quiet and peaceful. Leo washes his hands and climbs into his cozy bed, ready for sweet dreams. Goodnight, little conductor! Goodnight, sparkly teeth!

stories.title: Mia and the Minty Caboose
stories.text: Ring-ring! The bedtime bell is ringing in Mia’s house. Mia knows exactly what that means. It is time for her favorite evening adventure: riding the Toothpaste Train! Mia bounces on her tiptoes all the way to the brightly lit bathroom. She looks in the mirror and gives her reflection a big, happy wave. Hello, Mia! Tonight, Mia’s toothbrush is painted pink, and it is the fastest engine on the tracks. Mia holds it tightly in her small hand, ready for the journey. Daddy steps in with the special toothpaste tube. 'Do you want a pea-sized dot, engineer Mia?' he asks gently. 'Yes, please!' Mia chirps. Squeeze-squeeze! Out comes a striped ribbon of sparkly paste. It smells just like sweet peppermint and sunshine. 'Time to start the engine,' whispers Daddy. Mia opens her mouth wide, like a tunnel waiting for a big train to pass through. Chug-a-chug, choo-choo! The pink toothbrush begins its journey. It visits the left side of the track first, making tiny circles like spinning wheels. Round and round they go! Then the train chugs across the front bridge. Toot-toot! Mia makes happy train noises as she brushes. The minty bubbles start to grow bigger and bigger. They look like fluffy white clouds sitting on top of the toothbrush bristles. Mia brushes the top, the bottom, and even gives her tongue a little tickle ride. 'Look at you go!' cheers Daddy, clapping his hands softly. Mia feels so proud and strong. She loves taking such wonderful care of her growing teeth. When the journey is finished, Mia takes a cup of water, takes a little sip, and swishes it all around her mouth. Swish, swish, spit! The sparkly bubbles disappear down the drain. Mia opens her mouth wide in the mirror and flashes a brilliant, sparkling smile. Her teeth are shining brighter than new coins. Mia puts her toothbrush back in its cup and climbs into bed, feeling cozy, clean, and ready to sleep.

stories.title: Sammy’s Sparkly Nighttime Journey
stories.text: The sun is hiding behind the trees, and the stars are coming out to play. That means it is time for Sammy to wind down and get ready for sleep. But wait! There is one very important stop before bed. The Toothpaste Train station is open! Sammy skips down the hallway, making happy jumping steps. Hop, hop, hop! In the bathroom, Sammy finds his green toothbrush waiting patiently on the counter. The green toothbrush is a speedy bullet train, ready to zoom across the tracks. Sammy’s big sister helps him squeeze a tiny button of fresh toothpaste onto the bristles. It looks like a little marshmallow pillow. 'Are you ready, engineer Sammy?' asks his sister with a smile. Sammy nods eagerly, his eyes sparkling with excitement. He opens his mouth wide like a cave opening up for an explorer. Here comes the train! Chug-a-chug, choo-choo! The green train glides smoothly along the top teeth, brushing away the sleepy dust of the day. Up and down, back and forth, the bristles dance a merry jig. Then the train swoops down to the bottom tracks. Zoom-zoom! It tickles the gums just a little bit, making Sammy giggle around the brush. He brushes his left side, his right side, and reaches all the way to the back. Every single tooth gets a special visit from the sparkly train. The minty foam creates a bubbly wonderland inside Sammy’s mouth. 'You are doing such a fabulous job, Sammy,' says his sister, rubbing his back. Sammy feels so happy and grown-up. He finishes brushing, rinses his mouth with fresh water, and spits the bubbles into the sink. Splash! The teeth look amazingly bright. Sammy grins a huge, wide grin in the mirror. His smile is so shiny it could light up a dark room! He neatly puts his green train away in its cozy holder. Sammy washes his face, gives his sister a big hug, and walks happily to bed. The Toothpaste Train rests until tomorrow, leaving Sammy with a mouth full of happy, healthy teeth.

stories.title: All Aboard the Toothpaste Train!
stories.text: BEEP! BEEP! Toot! Toot! All aboard the Toothpaste Train! Leo was getting ready for bed, and his favorite toothbrush was the shiniest engine in the whole wide world. It was bright blue with soft, bouncy bristles that were ready for a big adventure. Leo zoomed his toothbrush through the air. Zoom, zoom, zoom! 'Time to brush our teeth, little engineer,' said Mommy, holding up a tube of sparkly mint toothpaste. Leo gave a happy clap. He knew just how this game worked. Mommy squeezed a tiny, pea-sized dot of toothpaste right onto the brush. It looked just like a fluffy white cloud resting on a green hill. 'Chugga-chugga, chugga-chugga, choo-choo!' Leo sang softly as he guided his train toward his mouth. First stop, the top teeth! The Toothpaste Train chugged slowly across the front mountains. Up and down, up and down, making everything sparkle like fresh snow in the morning sun. Next stop, the back station! The train zoomed around the sleepy molars, tickling away all the little crumbs from dinner. Leo giggled because the minty bubbles felt like tiny tickly fairies dancing on his tongue. He scrubbed left, he scrubbed right, making sure every single tooth got a fun, bubbly ride. 'Look at that super-duper brushing, Leo!' cheered Mommy. Leo smiled his biggest, brightest smile into the mirror. He rinsed his mouth with sparkly water and spit out the frothy waterfall. The Toothpaste Train rolled back into its little cup parking lot, resting peacefully until the next morning. Leo hopped into his cozy bed feeling proud, happy, and ready for sweet dreams with his sparkling clean teeth.

stories.title: The Minty Fresh Journey
stories.text: Rise and shine, little sleepyhead! Morning had arrived, and Mia was rubbing her eyes as the sun peeked through her yellow bedroom curtains. 'Good morning, Mia!' whispered Daddy. 'Is it time for a morning adventure?' Mia asked excitedly. 'It sure is,' Daddy smiled, leading the way to the bright bathroom. 'It is time for the Toothpaste Train!' Mia clapped her hands together. She grabbed her favorite pink toothbrush with the sparkly handle. It was ready for a brand-new day of fun. Daddy picked up the toothpaste tube. It had a picture of a smiling star right on the front. Squeeze! Out came a lovely ribbon of sparkly red-and-white toothpaste that smelled just like strawberries and mint. 'Whoosh, go the wheels!' Mia whispered as she brought the brush to her mouth. She opened wide like a big friendly tunnel. The Toothpaste Train chugged gently along the bottom tracks. Left and right, round and round, singing a happy brushing song. Mia scrubbed the front teeth, making them shine like pearls. Then she zoomed the train up to the top tracks. Brushing up, brushing down, making sure no sleepy germs stayed behind. The strawberry bubbles started to foam up, making a fun, fluffy beard around Mia's mouth. She looked in the mirror and giggled at her funny reflection. 'All clear!' shouted Mia, pretending she was the train conductor. She swished some water in her mouth and spat it out with a big splash. Daddy wrapped a warm towel around her hands. 'What a magnificent ride! Your teeth are super strong and ready to take on the day.' Mia beamed with pride, feeling fresh, wonderful, and ready to play.

stories.title: The Nighttime Tracks
stories.text: The moon was glowing softly outside, sprinkling silver starlight across the bedroom floor. Oliver had finished his bedtime story, and now it was time for his very favorite part of the evening routine. The Toothpaste Train was waiting on the bathroom counter, engine revving and ready to go! Oliver washed his hands all by himself, splashing a little bit of water in the sink. 'Are you ready for the night express, Oliver?' asked Grandma, holding up a tube of gentle bubblegum toothpaste. Oliver nodded eagerly. He picked up his green dinosaur toothbrush. Grandma added a sweet, bubbly dot of paste right onto the bristles. It looked like a cozy little pillow of foam. Oliver opened his mouth wide like a sleepy cave. 'Chugga-chugga, choo-choo!' he whispered softly so he would not wake the night. The Toothpaste Train rolled gently onto the bottom tracks. It chugged back and forth, tickling the teeth and sweeping away all the sticky remnants of crackers and juice. Next, the train climbed the steep hill to the top tracks. Up, up, up it went, making sure every single tooth received a sparkling polish. Oliver made little train noises in his throat as he moved the brush with care. Left, right, circle, and sweep! The bubblegum bubbles tasted sweet and delicious. 'You are doing a marvelous job keeping your smile healthy,' Grandma whispered lovingly. Oliver rinsed his mouth with a big gulp of water and spat it cleanly into the basin. He wiped his face with a soft towel. The Toothpaste Train was tucked safely away in its holder, resting until tomorrow. Oliver climbed under his warm covers, closing his eyes with a happy heart and a mouth full of shiny, clean teeth.

rhymes.title: The Morning Toothpaste Train
rhymes.text:
Time to wake and time to shine,
Line right up behind the line!
Here comes Engine Number Two,
Chugging right in front of you.

Grab your brush and hold it tight,
Make those pearly smileys bright!
Choo-choo goes the minty steam,
Chugging down the toothpaste stream.

Up and down the tracks we go,
Fast at first and then quite slow.
Scrub the front and scrub the back,
Stay right on the brushing track!

Now we rinse and now we spuck,
Look at that, you had good luck!
Shiny teeth are strong and grand,
Bestest smile in all the land.

rhymes.title: All Aboard the Minty Express
rhymes.text:
Hear the whistle blow so loud,
Make the little helpers proud.
Toothpaste Train is at the gate,
Hurry up, don't be late!

Squeeze a blob of frosty white,
Hold your handle shining bright.
Wheels are rolling round and round,
Making not a single sound.

Scrub the top and scrub the low,
Watch the foamy bubbles grow.
Tickle left and tickle right,
Keep those little bumpers white.

Now the train is pulling in,
Big bright smile upon your chin.
Rinse away the little foam,
Time to start the day from home!

rhymes.title: Nighttime Toothpaste Journey
rhymes.text:
Stars are peeping from the skies,
Rub the sleep right from your eyes.
Bedtime story time is near,
Brush your teeth, my little dear.

Toothpaste Train begins to creep,
While the world is falling sleep.
Peppermint and bubblegum,
Roll it round your little gum.

Scrub away the supper crumbs,
Tickle all your little thumbs.
Up and down the tunnel goes,
Right down to your tippy toes.

Station's closed and tracks are clear,
Morning time will soon be here.
Kiss the brush and put it down,
Sweetest dreams in sleepy town.

rhymes.title: The Speedy Bubble Track
rhymes.text:
Ready, steady, off we run,
Brushing teeth is such great fun!
Here comes speedy bubble car,
Driving near and driving far.

Stripes of red and stripes of blue,
Squeezing just a dot for you.
Up the mountain, down the hill,
Try your best to hold quite still.

Back and forth the bristles slide,
Taking every tooth for a ride.
Giggle giggle, hee hee hee,
Smile so big for all to see.

Wash the station nice and clean,
Freshest mouth you've ever seen!
Wave goodbye now to the train,
Till we brush and ride again.

rhymes.title: The Shiny Smile Caboose
rhymes.text:
Little caboose at the end of the line,
Keeping your teeth so healthy and fine.
Open your mouth like a big old cave,
Be so happy, bold and brave.

Swish the water, swish it round,
Not a single crumb is found.
Spit it out with a little splash,
Cleaning up in a happy flash.

Brush the molars way back deep,
While the little teddies sleep.
Tickle the tongue with a gentle sweep,
Counting sheep from one to ten.

Now you're ready for the day,
Off to laugh and off to play!
Toothpaste train has parked the car,
Little star, you shine so far.

rhymes.title: The Morning Station
rhymes.text:
Time to wake the sleepy head,
Time to jump right out of bed.
Here comes little Toothpaste Train,
Chugging down the track again!

Grab your brush and hold it tight,
Make those pearly grinders white.
 Toot-toot! Hear the whistle blow,
Watch the bubbly engine go!

Up and down the bridge we ride,
Scrubbing every single side.
Round and round the wheels will spin,
Let the morning fun begin!

 Spit the bubbles in the bowl,
Brushing is a happy goal.
Now your smile is bright and grand,
Best young traveler in the land!

rhymes.title: Minty Choo-Choo
rhymes.text:
The little brush is in my hand,
Ready for the morning band.
Here is minty Toothpaste Train,
Chugging through the sleepy rain.

Down the tracks of upper teeth,
And the lower ones beneath.
Choo-choo, hear the engine roar,
Rolling right across the floor!

Back and forth and left and right,
Making every molar bright.
Give a whistle, give a shout,
Watch the bubbles rolling out.

Rinse your mouth and shake your head,
Time to conquer day ahead.
Shining teeth and happy grin,
Let the awesome day begin!

rhymes.title: The Bedtime Express
rhymes.text:
Stars are peeping from the skies,
Rubbing sleepy toddler eyes.
Time to board the night express,
Time to wash and softly dress.

Squeeze a dot of paste so sweet,
For a very special treat.
Toothpaste Train is on the track,
Never looking turning back!

Scrub the front and brush the back,
Chugging down the shiny track.
Up and down the mountains go,
Moving very fast and slow.

Swish the water, rinse it clean,
Freshest engine ever seen.
Off to dreamland we will creep,
While the train goes fast asleep.

rhymes.title: The Sparkle Conductor
rhymes.text:
I am the conductor brave,
Watch my little toothbrush wave!
Toothpaste Train is pulling in,
Ready for a happy grin.

Peppermint and bubblegum,
Tickles every little gum.
Choo-choo-choo, the wheels go round,
Making not a single sound.

Brush the top and brush the down,
Best conductor in the town.
Polishing the ticket bright,
Shining like the morning light.

Spit the foam into the sink,
Faster than a nod and wink.
Now your teeth are strong and fine,
Look at how they gleam and shine!

rhymes.title: The Speedy Caboose
rhymes.text:
Sun is shining, skies are blue,
Toothpaste Train is waiting too!
Hop aboard the bathroom floor,
Rolling right up to the door.

Squeeze the paste so white and neat,
Making little smiles complete.
Choo-choo goes the engine strong,
Singing out a happy song.

Reach the back and reach the front,
Doing such a clever stunt.
Brushing till the job is done,
Every single minute's fun.

Rinse the brush and set it down,
No more sleepy sort of frown.
Sparkling teeth and happy face,
Ready for the daily race!

rhymes.title: The Morning Toothpaste Train
rhymes.text:
Open up your little station,
Time to start the celebration!
Grab the brush and hold it tight,
Make your pearly white teeth bright.

Here comes the toothpaste train,
Chugging down the tracks again!
 Toot-toot, chugga, chugga, choo,
Just for me and just for you.

Up and down the gentle hills,
Chasing all the sugar spills.
Round and round the happy track,
Forward now and then right back.

Spit the bubbles, wipe your face,
Leave the bathroom clean and grace.
Now your smile is shining grand,
Ready for a happy land.

rhymes.title: Choo Choo Brush
rhymes.text:
Sun is up and sky is blue,
Time to brush the teeth anew.
Get the toothbrush, nice and red,
Shake the sleep right out your head.

Choo choo, hear the whistle blow,
Watch the foamy engine go!
Right across the bridge so wide,
See the minty paste inside.

Scrub the molars in the back,
Keep them on the shiny track.
Tickle front and tickle side,
Open up your tunnel wide.

All aboard, the trip is done,
Spit the water, wasn't fun?
Now you sparkle, now you gleam,
Captain of the toothpaste team.

rhymes.title: Minty Magic Chug
rhymes.text:
Time for brushing, time for play,
Let us chase the sleep away.
Squeeze a little dot of paste,
Not a single bit to waste.

Fast train, slow train, chugging round,
Making not a single sound.
Up the mountains, down the hill,
Keep the little engine still.

Brush the top and brush the down,
Best sweet smile in all the town.
Make it bubbly, make it sweet,
From your head down to your feet.

Rinse your mouth and swish it out,
Give a happy little shout!
Teeth are clean and teeth are strong,
Now you sing your morning song.

rhymes.title: The Bedtime Station
rhymes.text:
Stars are peeking from the sky,
Time to wave the day goodbye.
One last stop before we sleep,
While the quiet shadows creep.

Nighttime train is rolling by,
Reaching all the way up high.
Scrub the sticky sweet away,
Left over from all the play.

Little bristles tickle gums,
Catching crumbs and yummy plums.
Round and round the circle goes,
Right down to your little toes.

Spit the bubbles in the sink,
Have a little sip to drink.
Snuggle tight in cozy bed,
Sweet dreams to your sleepy head.

rhymes.title: Sparkle Track Express
rhymes.text:
Grab your brush and join the fun,
We are sparkling, every one!
Put the paste upon the tip,
Take a little gentle sip.

Here it comes upon the track,
Never stopping, looking back.
Engine red and wheels so blue,
Bringing shiny smiles to you.

Tick-tock, tick-tock, left and right,
Making every corner bright.
Brush away the sleepy frown,
Best little engine in the town.

Rinse it clean and wash it out,
Do a happy little shout.
Teeth are gleaming in the light,
Time to say a sweet good-night.

rhymes.title: The Morning Toothpaste Train
rhymes.text:
Time to wake and time to shine,
Line right up, it's washing time!
Here comes choo-choo, bright and new,
Bringing shiny smiles to you.

Grab your brush and hold it tight,
Make those pearly teeth so white.
Up and down and round we go,
Watch the bubbly rivers flow.

Chug along from side to side,
Take a happy morning ride.
Scrub the back and scrub the front,
That's the little toothbrush stunt.

Now we rinse and spit it out,
Give a happy little shout!
Shiny clean from ear to ear,
Ready for the day, my dear.

rhymes.title: All Aboard the Bubble Express
rhymes.text:
Evening comes and stars appear,
Bedtime stories soon are near.
First we need a shiny smile,
Let us travel for a while.

Hear the engine start to hum,
Rub your tummy, yum, yum, yum.
Squeeze the paste, a little dot,
Put it on the brushing spot.

Choo-choo train is moving fast,
Making sure no germs can last.
Tickle left and tickle right,
Brushing up with all your might.

Spit the bubbles in the cup,
Wash the sleepy feeling up.
Now you're ready for your bed,
Rest your happy little head.

rhymes.title: The Minty Magic Caboose
rhymes.text:
Step inside and take your seat,
Keeping little teeth so neat.
Minty magic on the track,
Moving forward, moving back.

Round and round the molars go,
Making bubbles white as snow.
Brush the top and brush the low,
Watch the sleepy monsters go.

 Toot-toot goes the little horn,
Freshest smile that e'er was born.
Up the mountain, down the hill,
Keep your little hand right still.

All aboard, the trip is done,
Brushing teeth is so much fun!
Spit the water in the sink,
Clean and sparkly, just a blink.

rhymes.title: The Sparkle Station Journey
rhymes.text:
Sun is up and sky is blue,
Time to brush for me and you.
Sparkle Station is the stop,
Time to make the bubbles pop.

Grab the brush with bristles soft,
Hold the little handle aloft.
Swipe it left and swipe it right,
Making every tooth a light.

Choo-choo, hear the whistle blow,
See the minty helpers go.
Cleaning corners, big and small,
Happiest engine of them all.

Rinse the mouth and shake your head,
Time to leave the sleepy bed.
All done with the train today,
Now it's time to run and play.

rhymes.title: The Bedtime Brushing Track
rhymes.text:
Moonlight shines upon the floor,
Time to close the bedroom door.
One more stop before we sleep,
Counting teeth like little sheep.

Toothpaste train is pulling in,
With a happy little grin.
Squeeze the paste so soft and sweet,
Making little smiles complete.

Scrub away the sticky juice,
Give the happy train a boost.
Up and down the tunnels deep,
While the quiet shadows creep.

Wash it down and wipe your face,
Ready for a resting place.
Clean and cozy in the night,
Sleep until the morning light.

rhymes.title: The Morning Station
rhymes.text:
See the little toothpaste train,
Chugging down the bathroom lane!
Pick your brush up off the track,
Click the cap and click it back.

Squeeze a blob of shiny white,
Shining sparkly in the light.
Chug-a-chug and puff-a-puff,
Now we have enoughy stuff.

Up and down the stations go,
Scrubbing fast and scrubbing slow.
Tickle left and tickle right,
Make those little pearlers bright.

Time to wash the train away,
Ready for a happy day!
Spit and rinse and give a cheer,
Best little brusher here!

rhymes.title: Choo-Choo Minty Fresh
rhymes.text:
Hear the whistle go choo-choo,
Time to brush the teeth for you!
Grab the toothbrush in your hand,
Best conductor in the land.

Stripe of blue and stripe of red,
Resting on the bristly bed.
Wheels are turning round and round,
Making not a single sound.

Scrub the molars in the back,
Staying right upon the track.
Front teeth shining in the sun,
Look at you, you're having fun!

Swish the water in your cup,
Drink it down or spit it up.
Now the engine goes to sleep,
Clean and shiny, safe and sweet.

rhymes.title: The Bedtime Caboose
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the sky,
Moon and stars are floating high.
Time to end the busy day,
Put our favorite toys away.

Now it's time to ride the train,
Down the minty bathroom lane.
Grab your brush and hold it tight,
We will make your smile bright.

Squeeze a tiny dot of paste,
No amount is goint to waste.
Round and round the circles go,
Catch the bubbly foam below.

Wash the engine clean and neat,
Rest your weary little feet.
Into bed and off to snooze,
All aboard the night caboose!

rhymes.title: Bubble Gum Express
rhymes.text:
Jump into the bathroom chair,
Smell the bubbles in the air.
Here comes the express today,
Chugging down the milky way.

Pink and sweet and smelling grand,
Best toothpaste in all the land.
Put it on the bristles now,
Watch me show you how, and how!

Scrub the top and scrub the down,
Best young engineer in town.
Bubbles popping on your tongue,
Song of brushing softly sung.

Rinse the tunnel nice and clean,
Smilng like a little queen.
Off you go to play and run,
Brushing time is so much fun!

rhymes.title: The Sparkle Locomotive
rhymes.text:
Little engine on the move,
Getting in the morning groove.
Grab the handle, grip it fast,
This is going to be a blast.

Squeeze the paste out with a plop,
Watch it settle at the top.
Chugger-chugger goes the brush,
No need ever for a rush.

Tickle teeth from left to right,
Making every corner bright.
Swipe the bottom, swipe the top,
Never want the train to stop!

Splish and splash and rinse it clean,
Freshest face you've ever seen.
Wave goodbye and shout hooray,
Teeth are ready for the day!

rhymes.title: The Morning Station
rhymes.text:
Wake up, little sleepy head,
Time to jump right out of bed.
Sun is shining bright and clear,
Morning magic time is here.

Now it is a special game,
Listen closely to the train.
Chugga chugga, chugga choo,
I have got a job for you.

Grab your brush of colored blue,
Squeeze a little dot of goo.
Minty fresh and shining bright,
Make your smile a happy sight.

Up and down and all around,
Listen to the happy sound.
All aboard the brushing train,
Ready for the day again!

rhymes.title: Shiny Tracks
rhymes.text:
Time to brush your teeth today,
Swipe the sleepy crumbs away.
Upstairs, downstairs, left and right,
Make your pearly smile so bright.

Here comes zooming down the track,
Never stopping, looking back.
Choo-choo train is big and strong,
Singing out a happy song.

Toothpaste is the engine fuel,
Brushing teeth is super cool.
Circles round and circles wide,
See the bubbly foam collide.

Spit it out and rinse it clean,
Best routine you've ever seen.
Now your teeth are shining white,
Ready for the morning light!

rhymes.title: The Minty Caboose
rhymes.text:
Little brush, go take a ride,
Scrubbing deep on every side.
Top and bottom, front and back,
Staying right upon the track.

Toot toot goes the whistle loud,
Making all the grown-ups proud.
Chugga chugga in the mouth,
Going north and going south.

Bubbles popping in the air,
Minty freshness everywhere.
Brush the back teeth, don't be slow,
Watch the sparkling engine go.

All finished with the daily drive,
Keeping every molar alive.
Wipe your face and give a grin,
Time to let the day begin!

rhymes.title: Fast As Lightning
rhymes.text:
Sun is up in skies of blue,
Time to brush the teeth for you.
Get the toothbrush from the cup,
Lift the shiny handle up.

Squeeze a ribbon soft and sweet,
Make the morning routine neat.
Chugga chugga, hear the train,
Racing down the track again.

Scrub the molars, make them gleam,
Like a shiny morning beam.
Tickle tongue and brush it slow,
Watch the bubbly river flow.

Rinse the cup and wash it down,
Happiest kid in the town.
Teeth are clean and sparkly bright,
Shining with a morning light!

rhymes.title: The Nighttime Express
rhymes.text:
Stars are peeping through the skies,
Rubbing sleepy little eyes.
Before we jump into our bed,
Stories read and prayers said.

Nighttime train begins to roll,
Brushing teeth is our main goal.
Chugga chugga through the night,
Making every grinder white.

Left and right and round we go,
Watch the bubbly river flow.
Spit it out into the sink,
Faster than a rapid blink.

Now your mouth is fresh and clean,
Sweetest dreams you've ever seen.
Climb beneath the covers deep,
Time to gently go to sleep.

rhymes.title: The Morning Station
rhymes.text:
Wake up, wake up, little bear,
Time to brush and comb your hair!
First we find our special brush,
No need for a hurry rush.

Here comes the toothpaste, shiny and white,
Squeezing out with all our might.
Choo-choo, choo-choo, hear the sound,
Watch the train go round and round.

Up and down the station track,
Moving forward, moving back.
Tickle, tickle on the side,
Open up your mouth so wide.

Spit the bubbles in the cup,
Now our morning train is up!
Smile a happy, shiny grin,
Let the brand new day begin!

rhymes.title: All Aboard the Minty Express
rhymes.text:
Little hands go grab the brush,
Time to make a gentle hush.
Evening time is almost here,
Let's get ready, never fear.

Pop the cap and squeeze it tight,
Make the little bristles bright.
Choo-choo goes the train of green,
Making every molar clean.

Scrub the front and brush the back,
Chugging down the bathroom track.
Round the corners, beep, beep, beep,
Before we go to fall asleep.

Rinse it out with water clear,
Wipe away a sleepy tear.
Now your teeth are shining bright,
Sweet dreams, little train, goodnight!

rhymes.title: The Sparkle Train
rhymes.text:
Time to brush your teeth today,
Let us sing a happy lay.
Get the toothbrush from the cup,
Lift your little chin right up.

Stripe of paste, oh look at that,
Sitting like a little cat.
Choo-choo comes the sparkle train,
Chugging through the summer rain.

Brush the top and brush the low,
Watch the bubbly rivers flow.
Tickle gums and tickle teeth,
Every single one beneath.

Wash the brush and put it away,
For another brand new day.
Now your smile is shining grand,
Bestest smile in all the land!

rhymes.title: Chugging to Bedtime
rhymes.text:
Pajamas on and toes are warm,
Safe and cozy from the storm.
Now it's time to scrub them clean,
Bestest teeth we've ever seen.

Squeeze a pea of minty paste,
Not a single drop to waste.
Choo-choo train is on the way,
Ending off a busy day.

Scrub a dub from left to right,
Making every pearl so white.
Up the mountain, down the hill,
Hold the little train so still.

Swish the water, swish it out,
No more talking, no more shout.
Climb into your little bed,
Pillow resting for your head.

rhymes.title: The Bubble Caboose
rhymes.text:
Hop along and jump around,
Listen to the happy sound.
Bathroom time is so much fun,
Come along, my little one.

Pick a brush of pink or blue,
I can share the paste with you.
Choo-choo goes the engine fast,
Making shiny bubbles last.

Tickle bottom, tickle top,
We are never going to stop!
Round and round the wheels will spin,
Right upon your little chin.

Bubble mustache, silly face,
Wipe it in the proper place.
Show your mommy, show your dad,
Bestest train you ever had!

rhymes.title: The Morning Station
rhymes.text:
Wake up, wake up, time to rise,
Rub the sleep right from your eyes.
March into the bathroom door,
Feet go marching on the floor.

Here comes the toothpaste, nice and bright,
Squeeze a dot of snowy white.
Put the cap back on so neat,
Making toothbrushing a treat.

Choo-choo train is on the track,
Moving forward, moving back.
Scrub the top and scrub the low,
Watch the sparkling bubbles grow.

 Spit it out and give a grin,
Let the happy day begin!
Clean and shiny, fresh and bright,
Ready for the morning light.

rhymes.title: The Minty Caboose
rhymes.text:
Time to brush before we play,
Starting off a brand new day.
Get the toothbrush in your hand,
Wave to all the bathroom band.

Find the paste and squeeze it out,
No more sleepy pouting pout.
Line the bristles up so straight,
Brushing teeth is feeling great!

Chug-a-lug and chug-a-loo,
Watch the engine whistle blow.
Round and round the molar lane,
Ride the little toothpaste train.

Rinse the mouth with water cool,
Off you go to play and school.
Shiny teeth for girls and boys,
Filled with happy morning joys.

rhymes.title: The Bedtime Express
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the west,
Time to give your teeth a test.
Pajamas on and hair is combed,
Ready now to stay at home.

Grab the brush with colors red,
Before we tuck you into bed.
Squeeze a blob of paste so sweet,
Clean from head down to your feet.

Choo-choo goes the nighttime train,
Riding down the gumdrop lane.
Up and down and left and right,
Making every tooth so bright.

Swish the water, spit it out,
Hear the happy bedtime shout.
Snuggle in and close your eyes,
Dreaming underneath the skies.

rhymes.title: The Bubbling Track
rhymes.text:
Open wide and say hello,
Watch the sleepy feelings go.
Time to brush your teeth today,
In a very cheerful way.

Squeeze the paste with gentle care,
Floating up into the air.
Place the brush upon your tooth,
Spreading minty bubbles sooth.

Fast and slow the engine goes,
Up and down your little nose.
Scrub the front and scrub the back,
Chugging down the bathroom track.

Wash the brush and put it down,
Best small brusher in the town.
Smile a wide and happy grin,
Let the afternoon begin!

rhymes.title: The Sparkle Journey
rhymes.text:
Little shoes are neatly stored,
All aboard the bathroom board!
Grab your brush and hold it tight,
Make your teeth look clean and white.

Squeeze the paste, oh do not drop,
Right upon the bristles top.
Now the train begins to roll,
Reaching for a shiny goal.

 Toot-toot goes the little horn,
Best routine since you were born.
Left and right and side to side,
Enjoy the minty bubble ride.

Spit the water in the sink,
Faster than a nod or wink.
All done now and feeling grand,
Cleanest teeth in all the land.

rhymes.title: The Morning Station
rhymes.text:
Time to wake up, sleepy head,
Time to jump right out of bed!
See the shiny train of white,
Chugging in with morning light.

Squeeze a little dot of blue,
Just enough for me and you.
Hold the handle nice and tight,
Brush the teeth with all your might!

Up and down and round we go,
Making bubbles soft and slow.
Chug-a-chug and chew-chew-chew,
Now your smile is bright and new!

Wipe your face and rinse it clean,
Best routine you've ever seen!
Wave goodbye to toothpaste train,
See you back here home again!

rhymes.title: All Aboard the Minty Express
rhymes.text:
Hear the whistle go choo-choo,
Time to brush the teeth for you!
Grab your brush and hold it high,
Watch the morning shadows fly.

Here comes zooming down the track,
No more sleepy feeling back.
Squeeze the paste into a row,
Ready, steady, here we go!

Scrub the front and brush the side,
Open up your mouth up wide.
Little circles, left to right,
Making every pearl shine bright.

 Spit the bubbles in the sink,
Faster than a happy blink.
Clean and fresh and ready now,
Take a happy toddler bow!

rhymes.title: The Bedtime Caboose
rhymes.text:
Stars are peeping in the sky,
Moon is sailing way up high.
Time to end the busy day,
Put away our toys and play.

Night-time engine comes in view,
Bringing shiny smiles to you.
Squeeze a berry-flavored sweet,
For a cozy, clean retreat.

Scrub the sugar bugs away,
That were hiding all the day.
Up and down the bridge we glide,
With the water close beside.

Swish and spit and rinse it out,
No more reason left to pout.
Climb into your little bed,
Sweet dreams to your sleepy head.

rhymes.title: Up the Mountain, Down the Valley
rhymes.text:
Get your ticket, grab your gear,
Brushing time is finally here!
Toothpaste train is on the floor,
Waiting by the bathroom door.

Up the mountain, nice and tall,
Careful now so you don't fall.
Down the valley, smooth and green,
Making every corner clean.

Tickle, tickle, goes the brush,
No need for a hurry-rush.
Sing a little brushing tune, 
Underneath the sleepy moon.

Rinse your mouth with water clear,
Give a happy little cheer.
Now your teeth are shining bright,
Ready for a happy night!

rhymes.title: The Bubble Caboose
rhymes.text:
Little brush and shiny paste,
Not a single minute waste!
Here is engine number ten,
Ready for the job again.

Load the cargo, squeeze it slow,
Watch the foamy river flow.
Brush the molars in the back,
Clicking on the railway track.

Bubbles popping on your nose,
Tickling down to little toes.
Laughing as the sparkles gleam,
In this little toddler dream.

Splish and splash, we wash away,
All the crumbs from yesterday.
Now your mouth is clean and sweet,
That's the toothbrush service feat!

rhymes.title: The Morning Station
rhymes.text:
Wake up, wake up, little bear,
Time to brush your shiny hair!
Run into the bathroom bright,
Everything is feeling right.

Here comes the Toothpaste Train,
Chugging down the track again!
Squeeze a blob of minty blue,
Just enough for me and you.

Choo-choo, chug along so sweet,
Make those pearly whites complete!
Brush the top and brush the low,
Watch the sparkling bubbles grow.

Spit it out and rinse it clean,
Bestest smile you've ever seen!
Now you're ready for the day,
Hip, hooray, go out and play!

rhymes.title: Chugga Chugga Brush
rhymes.text:
Sun is shining in the sky,
Wave a happy morning 'hi'.
Time to scrub the sleep away,
Start another sunny day.

Look who's chugging down the track,
Carrying a shiny pack!
It's the Toothpaste Train so grand,
Rolling right into our hand.

Chugga chugga, choo, choo, choo,
We have got a job to do!
Scrub the front and scrub the back,
Staying right upon the track.

Rinse your mouth with water clear,
Shout a happy morning cheer!
Teeth are gleaming, oh so bright,
Ready for a pure delight.

rhymes.title: The Minty Caboose
rhymes.text:
Evening stars begin to peep,
Time to slowly drift to sleep.
First we have a task to do,
Little child, I'm calling you.

Toot, toot, hear the whistle blow,
Watch the Toothpaste Engine go!
Rolling on the little brush,
In a happy, sleepy hush.

Up and down the tunnels wide,
See the bubbly engine ride.
Tickle, tickle on the tooth,
That is just the honest truth.

Swish the water round and round,
Not a single crumb is found.
Climb into your cozy bed,
Sweet dreams to your sleepy head.

rhymes.title: All Aboard the Brush
rhymes.text:
Grab your stool and step right up,
Get your little rinsing cup.
Look into the looking glass,
Watch the morning shadows pass.

Engine number shiny white,
Making every molar bright!
Load the minty passenger,
Hear the happy engine stir.

Chug along the upper floor,
Then go down and check some more.
Left and right and round we go,
Making bubbles start to show.

Gargle, gargle in the sink,
Water pink as berry drink.
Now your smile is looking grand,
Fairest one in all the land.

rhymes.title: The Nighttime Express
rhymes.text:
Pajamas on and stories read,
Time to snuggle in your bed.
Wait a minute, stop right there,
Toothbrush waiting on the chair!

Here comes the Express tonight,
Shining like a little light.
Stripe of red and stripe of white,
Making sure the teeth are right.

Choo-choo goes the little brush,
Moving in a gentle rush.
Scrubbing fast and scrubbing slow,
Watch the sleepy driver go.

Spit the water with a splash,
Back into the bed in a flash!
Close your eyes and slumber deep,
Angels guard you while you sleep.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Bubbles
stories.text: The sun was setting behind the green hills, and little Benny Bear was playing with his wooden blocks. It had been a big day of digging in the soft mud and running through the tall, tickly grass. Benny's paws were dusty, and his brown fur had little bits of leaves stuck right behind his fuzzy ears. Mommy Bear walked into the warm playroom with a big, happy smile and gave a gentle, loving hug. She whispered, 'Time to wash away the day, my sweet little cub! Let's go make some magic in the tub!' Benny clapped his paws together with pure joy and scampered right to the bathroom. He loved the bathroom because it always smelled like sweet lavender and warm water. Mommy turned on the silver handles, and the big white tub began to fill up with nice, warm water. Benny stood on his fluffy yellow stool and watched as Mommy poured in a special bottle of bubble bath liquid. Whoosh! Swish! Suddenly, big, shiny, rainbow-colored bubbles started floating up, up, up toward the ceiling. Benny giggled a happy giggle. 'Look, Mommy! Clouds in the tub!' he shouted. Benny carefully stepped into the warm water, feeling it wrap around his tired little toes like a cozy blanket. He sat down and scooped up a big handful of soapy foam, putting it right on top of his head like a silly crown. 'I am King Bubble!' he declared proudly. Mommy laughed and gently washed Benny's furry back with a soft, blue washcloth. She washed his arms, his tummy, and his little paws, singing a sweet little bedtime song while she worked. Benny helped by washing his own knees, rubbing them until they squeaked with cleanliness. 'You are doing such a wonderful job, Benny,' Mommy praised, giving him a warm, encouraging high-five. Washing up was so much fun when you had good friends like soap and water. When it was time to get out, Mommy wrapped Benny in a giant, hooded towel that made him look just like a fluffy white sheep. She dried him off from head to toe, rubbing his back until he felt warm and snuggly. Benny looked in the foggy mirror and wiped a little circle clear with his finger. He saw a happy, clean little bear smiling right back at him. Mommy gave him one last cuddle and kissed his forehead. 'Ready for sweet dreams, my clean little cub?' she asked softly. Benny nodded happily, feeling ready for a wonderful night of sleep.

stories.title: Pip the Penguin's Splish-Splash Adventure
stories.text: Deep in the cozy igloo, little Pip the Penguin was having the time of his life painting bright pictures with blue and red fingerpaints. He painted squiggly lines, happy fish, and big orange suns. But oh dear! Pip had paint on his flippers, paint on his tummy, and even a tiny dab right on the tip of his beak! Daddy Penguin waddled into the room and chuckled a warm, rumbling chuckle. 'Well, hello there, little artist! It looks like you made a masterpiece, both on the paper and on yourself!' Daddy said gently. Pip looked down at his colorful flippers and gave a cheerful chirp. 'Bath time?' Pip asked, tilting his head. 'Bath time!' Daddy agreed with a happy nod. Pip waddled as fast as his little webbed feet could carry him right to the warm bathroom. Daddy had already filled the big white tub with the coziest, warmest water you ever did feel. Pip loved the water; it always made him feel like he was swimming in the great blue sea, even inside his own cozy house. Daddy poured in some foaming soap, and instantly, a mountain of fluffy white bubbles popped up to greet them. Pip gasped in delight. He jumped right in with a joyful little splash—splish, splash, splosh! Water droplets danced in the air like tiny diamonds. Pip grabbed his favorite yellow rubber ducky and set it right on top of a big bubble mound like a captain on a ship. 'Sailing away!' Pip quacked happily. Daddy picked up a soft orange sponge and squeezed warm water over Pip's head, being extra careful to keep the soapy suds away from Pip's big, bright eyes. Pip tilted his head back just like Daddy showed him, being so brave and strong. Then, Pip took the sponge and washed his own tummy, rubbing in little circles until the colorful paint swirled away down the drain. 'Look, Daddy! All clean!' Pip cheered, holding up his sparkling flippers. Daddy smiled proudly and clapped his hands. 'You are a super bather, Pip! So independent and wonderful!' After their fun splashing adventure, Daddy lifted Pip out of the tub and wrapped him in a snuggly, striped towel. Daddy rubbed him dry, making sure every single feather was warm and cozy. Pip felt fresh, relaxed, and wonderfully sleepy. Daddy tucked Pip into his little bed, pulling the quilt up to his chin. Pip closed his eyes, holding his rubber duck tightly, dreaming of the next big adventure.

stories.title: Daisy's Daringly Delightful Bubble Mountain
stories.text: Daisy the little bunny rabbit had spent the entire morning running, jumping, and playing hide-and-seek in the community garden. She had crawled through pumpkin patches, tumbled down grassy hills, and chased friendly yellow butterflies. By lunchtime, Daisy was a very busy, very tired bunny with dusty paws and tickly fur. Grandma Bunny hopped into the hallway and sniffed the air playfully. 'Sniff, sniff! I smell a little bunny who needs a sparkling clean-up!' Grandma said with a warm, twinkling smile. Daisy rubbed her eyes and yawned a big, sleepy rabbit yawn. 'Can we make a giant bubble mountain, Grandma?' Daisy asked hopefully. 'We sure can, my little cotton-tail,' Grandma replied, taking Daisy's soft paw in her own. They hopped into the bathroom together, where a lovely, warm bath was already waiting. Grandma poured in a special strawberry-scented bubble bath, and within seconds, millions of tiny bubbles rose up to form the biggest, fluffiest mountain Daisy had ever seen in her whole life. Daisy clapped her paws together in sheer delight. 'It's Mount Bubble-Top!' she squealed happily. Daisy carefully stepped into the warm water, letting the soothing heat relax her tired little legs. She climbed right in and sat down, immediately burying her front paws in the bubbly foam. She gave herself two giant bubble ears, making her look just like a funny, bubbly monster. Grandma giggled and used a soft, pink washcloth to gently wash Daisy's face, her long ears, and her busy little feet. Daisy helped by washing her own arms, rubbing the gentle soap until it made happy, sudsy sounds. 'You are doing such a fantastic job taking care of your body, Daisy,' Grandma encouraged, giving her a sweet kiss on the cheek. Daisy felt so proud and happy. Cleaning up felt just like playing a wonderful game. When all the fun splashing was done, Grandma pulled the plug, and the water swirled down the drain with a funny gurgling sound. Bye-bye, bubbles! Grandma wrapped Daisy in a warm, plush towel with bunny ears on the hood. She rubbed Daisy dry until she was as toasty and warm as a fresh-baked muffin. Daisy put on her cozy flannel pajamas and snuggled deep into her soft bed. With a happy sigh, Daisy drifted off to sleep, knowing she was clean, cozy, and loved.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Adventure
stories.text: The sun is hiding behind the sleepy hills, and the stars are starting to twinkle in the big blue sky. It is time to wind down from a wonderful day of play. Benny Bear has been running, jumping, and painting all afternoon, and now his paws are a little bit dusty. 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, Benny!' says Mama Bear with a warm, cozy smile. Benny claps his paws together with pure joy. He loves tub-time! First, Benny helps gather all of his favorite bath toys. There is Sammy the yellow rubber duck, a floating red boat, and a squishy green frog. 'All aboard the bubble ship!' giggles Benny as he drops his boat into the water. Mama Bear turns the silver faucet. Warm water fills the big white tub, making a gentle swooshing sound. Next comes the best part of all: the bubbly magic! Mama pours a stream of sweet-smelling lavender soap right under the running water. Whoosh! Up pop millions of soft, fluffy bubbles. They stack up high like snowy mountains and fluffy clouds right inside the bathroom. Benny reaches out his little paw and scoops up a big handful of bubbles. 'Look at my bubble beard, Mama! Ho, ho, ho!' he laughs, pretending to be a friendly winter wizard. Mama gently washes Benny from his furry head down to his toes. Benny tilts his head back, closes his eyes tight like a sleeping puppy, and lets Mama rinse his fur with warm, comforting water. Not a single drop gets in his eyes! 'You are doing such a super-duper job staying still, Benny,' praises Mama, giving him a gentle hug. When the bath is all done, the water goes down the drain with a funny gurgling sound. Sloop, sloop, bye-bye water! Benny steps out of the tub and onto his soft, fluffy yellow towel. Mama wraps him up like a little burrito and gives him warm squeezes. Now Benny is squeaky clean, smelling sweet, and feeling so very cozy. He puts on his soft star-print pajamas and climbs into his warm bed, ready for sweet dreams. Goodnight, clean little bear. Sleep tight and rest well.

stories.title: Pip and the Squeaky-Clean Stars
stories.text: Ding-dong! The little clock chimes, and it is evening time in the cozy little treehouse. Pip the bunny stretches his long ears and yawns a big, sleepy yawn. 'Yaaawn! Good evening, moon!' whispers Pip. Today, Pip painted pictures with bright red paint, climbed the backyard slide, and dug in the soft dirt for wiggly worms. His little bunny nose has a smudge of dirt, and his paws are covered in playful fingerprints. 'Let us wash away the day, little bunny,' says Papa, holding up a fluffy towel with bunny ears. Pip hops right into the bathroom, feeling very excited. Papa turns on the warm water, and the tub fills up with a soothing, comforting warmth. Then, Papa holds up a bottle of sparkling star soap. 'Ready for the bubble galaxy, Pip?' asks Papa cheerfully. 'Yes, yes, yes!' cheers Pip, hopping up and down. Papa squirts the soap into the water, and instantly, a mountain of bright, bubbly foam blooms across the top of the tub. Pip carefully steps in one fuzzy foot, then the other. It feels so nice and warm against his toes. Pip pretends the bathtub is a vast, magical ocean, and he is a brave captain sailing his ship. He takes his washcloth and gently washes his tummy. Rub-a-dub-dub, right in the tub! 'Look, Papa, I am washing away the paint spots!' says Pip proudly. Papa smiles and gently washes behind Pip's long, floppy ears. 'You are growing up to be such a big, responsible bunny, Pip. Look how shiny and clean you are getting!' Pip feels so proud hearing those encouraging words. He practices holding his breath like a diving fish, blowing gentle bubbles into the water. Blub, blub, blub! When it is time to dry off, Papa wraps Pip in the warm towel, patting him dry until he is extra snuggly. Pip brushes his teeth, gives Papa a giant goodnight hug, and snuggles under his polka-dot blanket. He feels so fresh, so happy, and so ready for a wonderful night of peaceful sleeping.

stories.title: Mia's Magical Bubble Kingdom
stories.text: The daytime toys are resting in their toy box, and the moon is glowing softly outside the bedroom window. It is time for Mia to get ready for dreamland. Mia has played so hard today, building tall wooden towers and running through the green garden. Now her little hands are ready for a lovely, relaxing bath. 'Splish, splash, time for a bubble bath, Mia!' sings Grandma, walking into the warm bathroom with a fluffy pink towel. Mia giggles and does a little happy dance on the bathroom rug. Grandma turns on the faucet, and the water makes a happy rushing sound as it fills the tub. Grandma opens a bottle of strawberry-scented bubble soap and pours it right under the swirling water. Abracadabra! Instantly, a mountain of pink, fluffy bubbles rises up, tickling the edges of the tub like a crown of clouds. Mia climbs carefully into the warm, comforting water. Ahh, it feels just like a warm hug! She picks up her sponge shaped like a friendly star and starts to wash. She washes her arms, her elbows, and her knees. 'Scrub, scrub, scrub goes the star,' sings Mia softly to herself. Grandma helps wash Mia's shiny brown hair with gentle, tear-free shampoo that smells like sweet summer berries. Mia tilts her head back, looking up at the ceiling where she pretends the fluffy bubbles are floating planets in outer space. 'You are doing amazing, Mia! Such a brave girl closing your eyes while we rinse,' cheers Grandma. Mia beams with a big, bright smile. She loves how encouraging Grandma is. When the fun bath is finished, Grandma pulls the plug, and the water swirls down the drain with a funny little whirlpool sound. Slurp, slurp, goodbye, bubbles! Grandma lifts Mia out of the tub and wraps her securely in the warm pink towel, rubbing her back until she is completely dry. Mia puts on her fuzzy bunny slippers, drinks a tiny sip of water, and climbs into her cozy bed. Surrounded by her favorite stuffed animals, Mia closes her eyes with a happy sigh, feeling clean, safe, and deeply loved.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Journey
stories.text: The sun is hiding behind the sleepy hills, and the stars are starting to twinkle in the evening sky. It is time for Benny Bear to wind down from his big day of playing in the honey forest. But wait! Before cozy pajamas and sweet dreams, it is time for a splish-splash bubble bath! Benny’s furry paws have a little bit of sticky honey and garden dirt on them. 'Let's go make you sparkling clean, little bear,' says Mama Bear with a warm, loving smile. Benny claps his paws together and does a happy little wiggle. He trots right to the bathroom, ready for his favorite part of the evening. Mama Bear turns the silver faucet. Whoosh! Warm water fills the big white tub. Then comes the most magical part. Mama pours in a big bottle of strawberry-scented bubble bath, and suddenly, mountains of fluffy, white bubbles grow and grow right before Benny’s eyes. They look like soft clouds floating in a warm ocean. Benny steps in carefully. One foot, then the other. 'Ooh, it feels so nice and cozy!' he giggles. Mama hands him a soft, yellow washcloth. Benny gently washes his tummy, swirling the cloth around in big circles. Then he washes his arms and his little brown toes. You are doing such a wonderful job keeping yourself clean, Benny! Now, it is time to rinse. Mama pours a cup of warm water over his back, and Benny closes his eyes tight. He is so brave! When he opens them, he wears a fluffy crown of bubbles right on top of his head. He looks like the King of the Bubble Kingdom. 'Roar!' he says softly, making Mama laugh. The water drains away with a happy gurgle, and Mama wraps Benny in a big, warm, hooded towel that looks just like a bear cub. She gives him a giant bear hug. Benny feels warm, smells like sweet strawberries, and is wonderfully relaxed. 'Good night, bathtub,' whispers Benny, ready for a peaceful night's sleep.

stories.title: Pip and the Sailing Duck
stories.text: Splish, splash, went the water drops! Pip the little penguin waddled down the hallway, dragging his favorite yellow rubber duck behind him. Outside the window, the moon was glowing like a nightlight, reminding everyone that bedtime was near. 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, my little explorer!' chirped Papa Penguin, opening the warm bathroom door. Pip loved his baths. He chirped happily and dropped his rubber duck right into the empty tub. Papa turned the handles, and the water rushed in, feeling just right—not too hot and not too cold. Then, Papa scooped up a handful of green apple bubbly soap. Abracadabra! A mountain of green, bubbly foam popped up, smelling fresh and clean like a spring orchard. Pip hopped into the water with a joyful splash! He scooped up the bubbles in his flippers and blew gentle puffs. 'Look, Papa, I am making a bubble beard!' Pip squealed, patting white foam right under his beak. Papa smiled and cheered, 'What a handsome bubble beard for a clever little penguin!' Next came the fun task of washing up. Pip took his little sea-sponge and scrubbed behind his flippers. He washed his feathers, making sure every speck of playground sand was washed away. You are so independent and take such good care of your body, Pip! When it was time to rinse, Papa used a little green pitcher to pour clean water over Pip’s head. Pip blinked his bright little eyes and shook his feathers just like a real ocean bird. Plip-plop, went the water droplets. Papa pulled the plug, and the water swirled down the drain in a fun whirlpool. Papa lifted Pip out of the tub and wrapped him snugly in a striped towel that kept him as warm as toast. Pip felt fresh, clean, and ready for sweet dreams. He kissed his rubber duck goodnight and snuggled into bed with a happy yawn.

stories.title: Mia's Magical Bubble Kingdom
stories.text: Ding-dong! The play day is over, and the moon is clocking in for duty. Little Mia rubs her sleepy eyes. She built tall block towers today and painted a lovely picture of a butterfly, which means her hands are full of colorful paint smudges. 'Ready for a splish-splash bubble bath adventure, Mia?' asks Grandma with a twinkle in her eye. Mia nods excitedly and skips to the bathroom, carrying her favorite floating star toy. Grandma fills the tub with lovely, warm water. Then comes the best part—the magic bubble potion! Grandma pours a stream of lavender-scented bubbles into the water, and instantly, a fluffy sea of white foam covers the top of the tub. Mia steps in one small, careful foot at a time. 'It’s a magic cloud bath!' Mia whispers in wonder. Grandma hands her a soft pink washcloth filled with gentle soap. Mia washes her hands first, watching the colorful paint swirl away into the bubbles. Then she washes her arms, her legs, and her knees. You are doing such a fabulous job, Mia, making sure you are sparkling clean from head to toe! Grandma helps her wash her hair with gentle shampoo that doesn't sting, and Mia pretends she is a brave mermaid swimming in a deep blue sea. She holds her star toy high up in the air like a lighthouse guiding ships home. 'Look at my shiny hair!' Mia says, admiring her reflection. When it's all done, Grandma pulls the silver plug, and the bubbly water swirls away. Grandma wraps Mia in a giant, fluffy towel with bunny ears on the hood. Mia giggles as Grandma gives her a cozy, butterfly-soft drying off. She puts on her star-printed pajamas and feels so fresh, relaxed, and happy. Mia climbs into her warm bed, ready to dream big dreams after such a wonderful splish-splash bubble bath.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Party
stories.text: The sun is going down, and the stars are coming out to peek through the window. Benny Bear has been playing outside all day long. He chased golden leaves, dug in the soft dirt, and painted a picture with bright blue paint. Now, Benny has a little bit of blue paint on his nose and some friendly dirt on his furry paws. "Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, Benny!" says Mama Bear with a warm, cozy smile. Benny gives a happy little wiggle because he loves bath time! He trots right into the bathroom where the big tub is waiting. Mama Bear turns the handles, and warm water swirls around, filling the tub with a soothing, gentle sound. Squeak! In goes Benny’s favorite yellow rubber ducky, floating right on top of the water. Then comes the magic part. Mama pours in a special bottle of bubbly soap, and poof! A mountain of fluffy, white soap bubbles grows taller and taller, looking just like soft clouds right in the bathroom. Benny climbs up the little step and steps carefully into the warm water. Ahh, it feels so wonderful on his tired paws. He scoops up a handful of bubbly clouds and puts them on his head like a silly white crown. Look at King Benny! He giggles and splashes his feet, making tiny waves that gently rock his ducky friend. Mama Bear gently washes Benny’s furry back with a soft sponge, singing a sweet little song about the stars. Benny washes his tummy, splashing a tiny bit of water, which is okay because water loves to play too. When it is time to get out, Mama wraps him in a big, fluffy blue towel that hugs him tight like a giant bear hug. Benny feels so clean, so warm, and so fresh. He snuggles into his soft pajamas, ready for sweet dreams. Goodnight, clean little bear!

stories.title: Lily Ladybug's Sparkling Soak
stories.text: Ring-ring, goes the tiny clock. It is evening time in the garden, and little Lily Ladybug has had a very busy day. She flew across the big green lawn, helped her friends roll a round red berry, and played hide-and-seek under the clover leaves. Now, Lily has a tiny speck of dust on her shiny red shell and a little smudge of mud on her tiny boots. Her antenna are starting to droop because she is wonderfully sleepy. "Ready for a bubbly bath, little bug?" asks Papa Ladybug, holding up a fluffy green towel. Lily does a happy little spin and flies right over to the bathroom sink, which makes the most perfect little bathtub for a ladybug. Papa fills the basin with nice, warm water that feels just right. He adds one single drop of gentle lavender soap, and instant magic happens! A wonderful cluster of tiny, sparkling bubbles pops up like little pearls. Lily carefully steps into the bubbly water, going tiptoe-tiptoe. She lets out a soft sigh of relief. The warm water tickles her little toes and makes her feel completely relaxed. Papa uses a tiny, soft cotton swab to gently wash the dust right off her shiny red shell. Lily watches the bubbles float in the air like tiny glass balloons. She practices making gentle ripples with her hands, splash, splash, splash! It is so much fun to watch the water dance. When her bath is all done, Papa lifts her out and wraps her up in the warm, cozy green towel. He rubs her back gently until she is as dry as a daisy. Lily puts on her favorite star-printed nightshirt and gives Papa a big, squeezy hug. She climbs into her leaf-shaped bed, feeling fresh, bright, and wonderfully clean. Sweet dreams, tiny ladybug!

stories.title: Sammy Starfish's Cozy Sea Bath
stories.text: Deep in the blue sea, the little lights are turning on one by one. Sammy Starfish has had a wonderful, adventurous day swimming through the coral reefs, playing tag with the tiny silver minnows, and building castles out of pink sand. By the time the moon says hello, Sammy has a little bit of sea-sand tucked in his cozy little arms and some happy salt-water shine on his skin. "Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, Sammy!" whispers Grandma Starfish, waving a friendly fin. Sammy gives a cheerful little wave with all five of his arms. He loves getting ready for bed when a warm bath is part of the plan. Grandma fills a pretty sea-shell tub with wonderfully warm water. She adds a splash of bubbly coconut soap that smells like sweet summer islands. Suddenly, a cloud of soft, foamy bubbles rises up, floating on the water like sea foam under the moonlight. Sammy slides right into the middle of the bubbles. They tickle his tummy and make him laugh a bubbly laugh. He hugs his favorite floating plastic whale toy, letting it dive up and down through the soapy waves. Grandma uses a soft sea-sponge to gently wash each of Sammy’s five arms, singing a lovely lullaby about the ocean tides. Sammy helps wash his own face, splashing just a tiny bit of water with a happy grin. Bath time is such a happy, cozy place to be. When the water starts to cool down, Grandma lifts Sammy out and wraps him in a giant orange towel shaped like a starfish hug. He dries off until he is completely snug and warm. Sammy puts on his striped sleeping cap and gives Grandma a gentle goodnight kiss. He curls up in his bed of soft seaweed, feeling squeaky clean and ready for sleep. Sleep tight, little starfish!

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Party
stories.text: The sun was going down, and the stars were coming out to play in the big blue sky. Little Benny Bear had spent the whole day playing outside in the warm dirt, digging deep holes and building towers with shiny pinecones. Now, Benny was covered in dusty paws and happy little smudges of mud from his head all the way down to his fuzzy toes. Mommy Bear walked over with a big, fluffy yellow towel and said, 'Time for our splish-splash bubble bath, sweet Benny Bear!' Benny clapped his paws together and gave a happy little wiggle. He loved tub time because it felt so cozy and warm. He trotted down the hallway and hopped right into the big white bathtub. Mommy turned on the shiny silver faucet, and out came the warm water. Then, she poured in a special bottle of soap that smelled just like sweet strawberries. *Whoosh!* Up rose a giant mountain of fluffy, white bubbles! Benny giggled and reached out his paw to touch the soft foam. 'Look, Mommy! A cloud inside my tub!' he cheered. Benny grabbed his favorite squeaky yellow duck and plopped him right on top of a big bubble mountain. *Squeak, squeak!* went the duck. Mommy gently washed Benny's furry arms and his tummy, singing a happy bath-time song. Benny helped by washing his knees and splashing his toes. He was learning how to keep himself fresh and clean, and he felt so proud. When all the dirt was washed away down the drain, Mommy wrapped Benny in his big, warm yellow towel. She gave him a giant bear hug and whispered, 'You did such a wonderful job in the bath tonight, Benny.' Benny felt warm, cozy, and ready for sweet dreams. He snuggled into his soft bed, closing his eyes with a happy little yawn, knowing he was clean, safe, and loved very much.

stories.title: Mia Mouse Makes a Splash
stories.text: Pip-squeak, pip-squeak went little Mia Mouse as she danced around her bedroom. She had been painting bright yellow stars and green vines on paper all afternoon, and now she had little specks of paint on her nose and tiny paws. Daddy Mouse peeked in through the door with a bright green frog towel draped over his shoulder. 'Are you ready for your splish-splash bubble bath, little Mia?' he asked with a gentle smile. Mia squeaked with joy and did a happy little twirl. 'Yes, Daddy! Let's make lots of bubbles!' She scampered into the bathroom where the little green tub was already waiting. Daddy filled the tub with nice, warm water and added a pump of bubbly soap that smelled like lavender blossoms. *Fizzy-bubble-pop!* Millions of tiny, sparkling bubbles popped up and danced all around the water's edge. Mia carefully climbed up the little step stool and hopped right into the water. *Splash!* went her tiny feet. She picked up a floating red boat and sailed it across the bubble sea, pretending she was a brave mouse captain exploring a distant land. Daddy used a soft, gentle washcloth to wash behind Mia's furry little ears and scrubbed the paint right off her nose. Mia helped by washing her own little hands and splashing the water just a tiny bit. 'Look, Daddy, I'm sparkling clean!' she giggled, holding up her paws. Daddy smiled proudly and said, 'You are doing such a fantastic job taking care of your body, Mia.' When bath time was all done, Daddy pulled the plug and watched the water swirl down the drain. He wrapped Mia up in the cozy green frog towel, pulling the hood with the cute little frog eyes right over her head. Mia felt warm, fresh, and so happy. She gave Daddy a big hug, ready to hop into her cozy nest for a wonderful night of sleep.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Sparkly Mane
stories.text: Roar! Well, more like a tiny, gentle *roar* because little Leo Lion was just getting ready for bed. Leo had been busy all day building tall block castles and running across the green living room rug. His golden mane was a little messy, and he had a tiny smudge of chocolate pudding right on his chin. Mama Lion walked into the room carrying a soft, fluffy orange towel that looked just like a tiger's stripes. 'Time for our splish-splash bubble bath, brave little Leo!' she purred gently. Leo wagged his tail and bounded into the bathroom, eager for the fun to begin. Mama turned on the warm water, and it filled the tub with a soothing, comforting steam. She poured in a capful of bubbly soap that made the bathroom smell like sweet honey and warm sunshine. *Bloop, bloop, bloop!* A giant sea of fluffy white bubbles popped up to the top of the tub. Leo stepped inside and sat right down in the warm, bubbly water. He picked up his plastic blue whale and made it dive deep under the foam before spraying water up into the air. *Pshh!* went the whale. Mama Lion used a soft sponge to gently wash Leo's golden mane and scrub his paws until they were super clean.
