Leo loved how the warm water felt against his skin, and he practiced washing his own tummy all by himself. 'Good job, big helper!' Mama praised, giving him a gentle pat on the head. Leo felt so proud of growing up and learning how to stay clean and healthy. When bath time was over, the water drained away with a happy *glug-glug-glug*. Mama wrapped Leo in the cozy orange towel and tickled his tummy until he giggled. Clean, cozy, and full of sleepy snuggles, Leo walked back to his bed, ready to dream big lion dreams.

stories.title: Bears Big Bubbles
stories.text: Barnaby Bear had a very busy day playing in the warm sunshine. He dug in the soft dirt, chased flutterby butterflies, and built a tall tower of wooden blocks that went crash-boom-bang! By the time the big yellow sun started to go to sleep behind the green hills, Barnaby felt a little bit sticky and very, very tired. Mama Bear smiled and gave him a big, warm hug. She said, 'It is time for our favorite splish-splash bubble bath, little one!' Barnaby clapped his paws together and said, 'Yay! Bubbles!' He trotted happily into the bathroom where the big tub was already waiting. Plip-plop went the water as Mama Bear poured in some special lavender soap that smelled like sweet honey and sleepy dreams. Woosh! Out popped a mountain of fluffy, white bubbles that tickled the edge of the tub. Barnaby stepped in one fuzzy foot at a time. Ooh, it felt so warm and cozy against his tired toes. 'Look at my fluffy white beard!' giggled Barnaby, scooping up a handful of soapy foam and placing it right on his snout. He pretended he was a wise old wizard with a snowy beard. Mama Bear washed behind his furry little ears, making sure to gently rinse away all the daytime adventures. Barnaby splashed his hands, making tiny waves that went swish, swosh, swish against the sides. He sang a happy little bathtime song to his yellow rubber ducky, who floated proudly on top of the bubbly waves. When it was time to get out, Mama Bear wrapped him up in a big, fluffy hooded towel that made him look just like a snuggly polar bear. She rubbed his back and whispered how proud she was of her clean, sweet-smelling cub. Barnaby felt fresh, relaxed, and so very happy. With a final yawn, he climbed into his cozy bed, ready for sweet dreams.

stories.title: Penny Pig's Polka Dot Bath
stories.text: Penny Pig loved adventures of all shapes and sizes. Today, she had painted a picture with bright red and blue paint, and somehow, most of the paint ended up on her little pink snout and trotters! 'Oink-oink!' giggled Penny as she looked in the mirror at her colorful self. Papa Pig chuckled and scooped her up. 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath to wash away those artistic spots!' The bathroom was warm and smelled like juicy strawberries. Papa Pig turned the shiny silver handles, and warm water filled the tub. Then came the most magical part: the sparkly bubble soap! Papa poured it in, and presto, a sea of pink, shimmering bubbles bubbled right up to the top. Penny hopped into the water with a joyful little bounce. Splash went the water on the yellow bath mat! She grabbed her squeaky green frog and made it leap right over the bubbly waves. Ribbit-ribbit, splash! Penny scooped up a big double handful of bubbles and put them right on her head like a sparkling crown. 'I am Queen Penny of Bubble Land!' she declared happily. Papa Pig gently washed the red and blue paint away from her little pink ears, singing a cheerful bathtime tune. Penny practiced making funny fish faces under the water, blowing gentle bubbles that popped with a soft tickle on her nose. She loved how the warm water made her whole body feel so relaxed after such a busy day of creating art. When the bath was all done, Papa pulled the plug, and the water swirled down the drain with a funny gurgling sound. Bye-bye, water! Papa wrapped Penny in a big, warm, sunshine-yellow towel and gave her a tickle on her tummy that made her oink with laughter. Clean, cozy, and tucked in tight, Penny smiled as she drifted off to sleep.

stories.title: Sammy Starfish's Starry Bath
stories.text: Sammy Starfish had been running and jumping all day long in the backyard garden. He helped plant tiny seeds in the dirt and chased bouncing red balls until his little legs felt wonderfully heavy. When the twinkling stars started to peek out in the evening sky, Mommy Starfish called out, 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, my little star!' Sammy loved the bathroom because Mommy always made it feel like a magical sea adventure. She filled the deep tub with wonderfully warm water and poured in coconut-scented bubble bath that swirled into soft, dreamy clouds. Sammy jumped right in with a joyful cheer! Whee! The warm water hugged him like a cozy blanket. He grabbed his floating blue sailboat and steered it through the soapy white waves. Toot-toot! Went the little boat. Mommy gently washed his arms and legs, singing a lullaby about ocean waves and sleepy fish. Sammy looked up at the ceiling where glow-in-the-dark stars were stuck, shining softly just for him. He took a deep breath and blew gentle bubbles across the water, watching them float away like tiny spaceships. 'I am swimming in the milky way!' whispered Sammy with wide, happy eyes. He loved feeling so fresh and clean. When it was time to say goodbye to the bubbles, Mommy helped him step out onto the warm, fluffy bath rug. She dried him off from head to toe, wrapping him up snugly like a little burrito. Sammy felt warm, safe, and ready for bed. He gave Mommy a big goodnight kiss, knowing that every day ends wonderfully with a cozy splish-splash bubble bath.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Journey
stories.text: The sun is hiding behind the sleepy hills, and the stars are starting to twinkle in the evening sky. It is time for Benny Bear to get ready for bed, but first, it is time for his favorite part of the evening: the splish-splash bubble bath! Benny loves warm water. Mommy Bear runs the tap, and a big, cozy mountain of fluffy white bubbles grows higher and higher. Benny gathers his favorite rubber ducky and climbs right into the warm, bubbly tub. 'Quack, quack!' says the duck. Benny smiles a big, happy smile. 'Time to wash our paws, Benny Bear,' says Mommy gently. Benny takes his soft washcloth with a little bit of lavender soap and gently washes his furry paws. One, two, three, four paws all clean! Next, it is time to wash his tummy. Benny rubs the washcloth in big circles on his round tummy. Squeaky clean and smelling like sweet honey! 'Look at my bubble hat!' giggles Benny, placing a big fluff of bubbles right between his bear ears. He looks just like a snowy mountain peak. Mommy Bear claps her paws and cheers, 'Wonderful job, Benny! You are doing so wonderfully with your bath!' When all the washing is done, Benny plays gently for a few more minutes, making little waves with his hands. Splish, splash, go the happy water drops. Then, Mommy pulls the big silver plug. Bye-bye, bathwater! Benny helps rinse off with a gentle stream of warm water from the pitcher. He steps out of the tub and wraps himself in a big, fluffy, warm towel that hugs him tight like a bear hug. Benny feels so fresh, so cozy, and so very proud of himself. He is ready for sweet, happy dreams.

stories.title: Luna's Starry Splash
stories.text: Little Luna loves to play outside all day long. She chases butterflies, digs in the sandbox, and builds tall towers with her blocks. By the time evening arrives, Luna has little specks of dirt on her knees and happy dust on her toes. 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, Luna starbeam!' says Daddy with a warm, loving smile. Luna skips to the bathroom because she knows how wonderful the warm water feels. Daddy fills the tub to the brim with bubbly magic. Poof! Millions of shiny bubbles float in the air like little white clouds. Luna steps in, one little foot at a time. Ooh, it is so nice and warm! 'Hello, bubbles!' whispers Luna. She has a magical yellow sponge shaped like a little star. First, Luna washes her busy fingers and tiny toes. She sings a happy little song while she scrubs away the daytime adventures. 'Wash, wash, wash your hands, make them clean and bright!' Daddy sings along. Next, Luna washes her knees. Those knees ran so fast today! Daddy gently helps wash Luna's shiny brown hair with special no-tears shampoo that smells like fresh apples. Luna closes her eyes tight like a sleeping kitten. 'All done!' says Daddy. Luna opens her eyes and splashes her hands in the water. Splish, splash, splash! Water dances all around the tub. Daddy wraps Luna in a bright yellow towel with a little hood that has bunny ears. Luna hops like a happy bunny into her bedroom. She looks in the mirror and gives herself a high-five. 'I did a great job washing today!' whispers Luna, feeling proud, relaxed, and ready for a wonderful night of sleep.

stories.title: Pip the Penguin's Warm Wave
stories.text: Pip the Penguin had a very busy day waddling around the icy playground. He built snow castles and slid down the big blue slide. Even penguins get a little bit messy! When the moon says hello to the sky, Daddy Penguin says, 'Pip, my little ice cube, it is time for a warm splish-splash bubble bath!' Pip loves the big white tub because it is his very own indoor ocean. Daddy turns on the warm water, and the whole bathroom fills with cozy steam. Plop! Pip hops into the tub, right into the middle of a giant mountain of bubbles. 'Wee!' cheers Pip. He has a little red boat that floats right on top of the bubbly waves. Pip takes his blue washcloth and dips it into the warm water. Time to wash his little flippers! He gently wipes his left flipper and then his right flipper. Swish, swish, swish. Next, he washes his tummy, making little circles with the soap. Daddy helps wash Pip's head with gentle, loving hands. Pip pretends he is a brave sea captain sailing through a sea of soapy clouds. 'Ahoy, bubble captain!' laughs Daddy. Pip giggles and splashes his feet softly in the water. Splish, splash, goes the happy bathwater. When playtime is over, Daddy pulls the plug, and the water swirls down the drain. 'Bye-bye, water!' says Pip happily. Pip stands up and stretches his wings. Daddy wraps him in a big, soft green towel that keeps him as warm as toast. Pip feels so clean, so relaxed, and so very happy. He gives Daddy a big hug and whispers, 'I love my bubble bath time.'

stories.title: Max Makes a Splash
stories.text: Ring, ring! Goes the little yellow duck. It is time for a fun splish-splash bubble bath! Max hears the warm water running into the big tub. Woosh, woosh, goes the tap. Max knows just what to do. First, he picks up his blue towel and puts it right on the warm chair. Then, he takes off his muddy boots and his bright red shirt. Off go his socks, one, two! Max is ready for bath time. He steps into the cozy, warm water. Ahhh, it feels so good on his toes. Mommy pours in the bubbly soap. Phew! A giant mountain of fluffy white bubbles pops right up. Look at them float! Max giggles and claps his hands together. 'Pop, pop, bubbles!' he sings out loud. Time to wash up. Max takes his green washcloth and gives his belly a gentle rub. Rub-a-dub-dub, right in the tub! Next comes his back, and then his arms. Max is doing such a wonderful job keeping himself clean and fresh. He washes behind his ears just like a big boy. Now, it is hair-washing time. Max tilts his head way back and looks up at the ceiling. He spots a little star sticker on the wall and counts it. One, two, three! Wow, look how brave Max is. Mommy pours a cup of warm water, rinsing away all the suds. All clean! For the grand finale, Max plays with his floating boat. It sails across the bubbly waves, making happy splashing sounds. Splish, splash, splish! Max feels so proud of himself for washing up so nicely. Bath time is so much fun when you are a big boy. Mommy lifts Max out of the water and wraps him up tight in his fluffy blue towel. She gives him a big, cozy squeeze. Max is warm, dry, and ready for sweet dreams. Good night, little duck.

stories.title: Lily and the Soap Suds
stories.text: The sun is going down, and the stars are peeking out. That means it is time for Lily's favorite part of the day: the splish-splash bubble bath! Lily marches right into the bathroom with a big smile on her face. 'Time to wash!' she says happily. Daddy turns on the silver faucet. Warm water fills the tub, making soft splashing noises. Lily helps Daddy pour in the sparkly strawberry bubble bath. Swish, swish, goes the water. Suddenly, magical white bubbles grow and grow until they look like giant fluffy clouds. Lily claps her hands together with joy. She reaches down and scoops up a big handful of bubbles. Look! She has a white bubble beard on her chin, just like Santa Claus. Ho, ho, ho! Lily laughs a sweet, happy giggle. Now it is time to wash away the day's adventures. Lily takes her yellow sponge and dips it into the water. She squeezes it, and water squirts out. Squish! She gently washes her hands and her knees. She washes her elbows, too. Lily is being so independent and taking such good care of her body. Daddy washes her hair with gentle baby shampoo that smells like sweet honey. Lily closes her eyes tight and pretends she is a sleepy little kitten resting in the sun. When her hair is all rinsed, she looks in the mirror and makes a funny face at her wet curls. Time to play! Lily's pink rubber pig goes for a swim across the bubble sea. Oink, oink, goes the pig as it bobs up and down. Lily makes happy wave sounds with her hands. Splish, splash, go the waves! Lily had the best time in her bath tonight. Daddy pulls out the big orange towel and gently wraps Lily up like a burrito. She is as snug as a bug in a rug. Lily gives Daddy a big hug, smelling like fresh strawberries and clean skin. She is ready for bed.

stories.title: Bear Cub's Evening Bath
stories.text: The little brown bear cub has been playing in the dirt all afternoon. He dug big holes and chased golden butterflies. Now his paws are dusty, and his fur is messy. 'Yawn!' goes Bear Cub. It is time for a warm splish-splash bubble bath to wash the day away. Mama Bear gets the big tub ready. She tests the water with her paw to make sure it is just right—nice and cozy. Bear Cub walks to the bathroom and climbs the little wooden step-stool all by himself. Up, up, up he goes! He takes off his dirty overalls and drops them in the hamper. Good job, little cub! Bear Cub steps into the warm water. Ahhh, he sighs a happy little bear sigh. Mama Bear squirts some bubbly soap into the water. Woosh! A thick blanket of soft, sweet-smelling bubbles covers the top of the water. Bear Cub uses his paw to make a bubble crown on his head. He looks like a sleepy king of the forest. Now it is time to get sparkling clean. Mama Bear takes a soft washcloth and dips it in the warm water. She gently washes Bear Cub's furry nose, his cheeks, and his paws. Bear Cub rubs his tummy with the cloth. Rub-a-dub, scrub-a-dub! He is doing such a wonderful job helping Mama keep him clean. Next, Mama pours a gentle cup of warm water over his head to rinse his fur. Bear Cub blinks his big brown eyes and shakes his head just like a real bear, sending tiny water droplets flying everywhere. Splish, splash! For a few minutes, Bear Cub plays with his floating wooden sailboat. The wind blows the sails as Bear Cub makes happy motorboat noises. Brrrr-mmm! Bath time is so relaxing and joyful. When the water drains away, Mama wraps Bear Cub in a big, soft forest-green towel. She rubs him dry until he is warm and fuzzy all over. Bear Cub snuggles close, feeling fresh, happy, and ready for a wonderful night of sleeping under the stars.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Party
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, and little Benny Bear had spent the whole day playing outside in the mud. His furry paws were covered in sticky brown spots, and his tummy was rumbling for dinner. Mommy Bear walked into the playroom with a big, warm smile and said, 'It is time for our magical splish-splash bubble bath, Benny!' Benny clapped his paws together because tub-time was his absolute favorite part of the evening. He marched right into the bathroom, ready for fun. Mommy turned on the silver faucet, and warm water filled the tub. Swish, swish, went the water. Next came the best part of all: the sparkly bubble soap! Mommy squeezed a big dollop of soap into the running water, and poof! A mountain of fluffy, white bubbles puffed up over the edge of the tub. Benny giggled a happy bear giggle. 'Look at the clouds, Mommy!' he cheered. Benny gently stepped into the warm water. Ahh, it felt so cozy on his tired legs. He grabbed his favorite yellow rubber ducky and floated it across the soapy waves. Quack, quack, went the duck. Then, it was time to get clean. Benny took his washcloth and gently washed his tummy. Scrub-a-dub-dub, right in the tub! He washed his arms and his legs, making sure all the mud was washed away down the drain. Mommy washed his furry ears with extra care, and Benny closed his eyes so no soapy water would get in. He did such a wonderful job being brave and still. 'You are shining like a star, Benny,' Mommy whispered, giving him a gentle hug. When it was time to get out, Mommy wrapped Benny in a big, fluffy blue towel that felt just like a warm hug. She dried him from head to toe until he was completely warm and dry. Benny put on his softest star-patterned pajamas and gave Mommy a big goodnight kiss. His room smelled like lavender soap, and his bed felt so inviting. Benny curled up under his quilt, feeling proud, clean, and ready for the sweetest dreams.

stories.title: Penny Penguin's Splashy Adventure
stories.text: Penny Penguin loved to waddle. She waddled through the snow, she waddled across the ice, and tonight, she was waddling straight to the bathroom for her splish-splash bubble bath. Today, Penny had been building snow castles all afternoon, and her feathers were a little bit chilly and full of frosty glitter. Daddy Penguin had the warm water waiting, and it was sending up cozy little clouds of steam. 'Ready for a swim, little chick?' Daddy asked gently. Penny let out a happy little penguin chirp and flapped her flippers. She dipped one webbed foot into the water. 'Ooh, nice and warm!' she decided. Step by step, Penny hopped into the big white tub. Splash went the water, splashing tiny droplets onto the bathroom tiles. Daddy added the bubble bath, pouring in a stream of berry-scented soap that smelled just like strawberries. Suddenly, the tub was full of big, round bubbles that floated up like balloons. Penny reached out her flippers and popped a bubble. Pop! It tickled her beak. She loved her bubble hat, which made her look just like a queen penguin. It was time to wash away the day's adventures. Penny took her pink sponge and rubbed her tummy. Scrub-a-dub-dub, in the bubbly tub! She cleaned her wings and her cute little tail feathers. Daddy helped her wash under her chin, and Penny stayed very still, singing a quiet little penguin song. Bath time was such a happy, relaxing time. When the water started to swirl down the drain, Daddy reached for the big, fluffy orange towel. 'Time to wrap up our little penguin,' Daddy said with a smile. He dried Penny until she was fluffy and warm from her beak to her toes. Then, Penny slipped into her cozy flannel sleepers with little penguins on the feet. She felt so fresh, clean, and wonderful. Daddy tucked her into her cozy bed and turned on her starry nightlight. Penny closed her eyes, smiling as she thought of all the fun bubbles floating in her happy tub.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Cozy Clean-Up
stories.text: The moon was peeking through the bedroom window, and Leo Lion was getting very, very sleepy. But before bed, there was one very important stop to make: the bathroom! Leo had been painting with bright green and blue fingerpaints all afternoon, and his paws were covered in colorful streaks. 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, my little lion cub,' Grandma Lion said warmly, holding out a fluffy towel. Leo let out a soft rawr of excitement. He loved the warm water. Grandma filled the tub to the brim with nice, warm water that swirled around like a river. Then came the magical bubbles! Grandma poured in a bottle of honey-scented bubble bath, and instant fluffy mountains of bubbles rose up like giant marshmallows. Leo climbed up the little step stool and hopped right into the tub. Splash! A wave of water tickled his toes. He sank down into the warm water, letting out a big sigh of comfort. His painted paws felt so good resting in the warm bath. Leo took his soft green washcloth and got to work. He rubbed the soapy cloth over his painted paws. Scrub-a-dub-dub, in the bubbly tub! The blue paint washed away, and the green paint washed away, swirling down the drain in a colorful spiral. Leo washed his shoulders and his back, taking his time to enjoy the cozy bubbles. Grandma washed his mane with gentle, soothing circles, making sure he was extra clean. Leo tilted his head back, closing his eyes, feeling safe and loved. When bath time was over, Grandma wrapped Leo in a big, golden lion-mane towel with a hood. She rubbed him dry until he was warm and glowing. Leo put on his striped pajamas and brushed his teeth. He felt so fresh, relaxed, and ready for sleep. Grandma tucked him in tight, kissed his forehead, and whispered, 'Sweet dreams, my clean little lion.' Leo yawned, snuggled his stuffed bear, and drifted off to sleep.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Party
stories.text: The sun is going down, and little Benny Bear is getting ready for bed. But first, it is time for his favorite part of the evening: the splish-splash bubble bath! Benny runs into the warm bathroom, his little fuzzy paws pat pat patting on the tile floor. 'Time for bubbles, Benny!' says Mama Bear with a big, warm smile. Benny claps his paws together and gives a happy little wiggle. He helps Mama turn the silver handles, and out rushes the lovely, cozy water. It feels just right—not too hot and not too cold. Now comes the most magical part of all. Mama pours in the special bubble soap, and swish, swish, swish go her hands. Suddenly, a mountain of fluffy, white bubbles pops up in the tub! They look just like soft marshmallow clouds floating on top of a warm ocean. Benny gasps with delight. He carefully steps one big foot into the water, then the other. Ooh, it feels so nice! Benny sits down and lets out a long, relaxed sigh. He picks up his bright yellow rubber ducky and makes it swim right through the bubble mountains. Quack, quack, goes the ducky, sailing over the bubbly waves. Next, Benny takes his soft washcloth. He gently washes his tummy, tickling himself and giggling out loud. 'Clean tummy!' he says proudly. Then he washes his arms and his little brown nose. Mama gently rinses his fur with a tiny green cup of water, making sure no soap gets in his bright eyes. Benny closes his eyes and tilts his head back like a good boy. When it is time to get out, Mama wraps him up in a big, fluffy blue towel that smells like sunshine and lavender. Benny rubs his eyes because playing in the bath made him wonderfully sleepy. He gives Mama a big, wet hug. 'All clean and cozy,' whispers Mama. Benny smiles a sleepy smile, ready for sweet dreams in his warm, soft bed. Goodnight, sweet bubble-bath bear!

stories.title: Pip the Penguin's Floating Adventure
stories.text: Splish, splash, splosh! Today is a very special day for Pip the Penguin. Even though penguins love swimming in the big, cold ocean, tonight Pip gets to have his very own warm, bubbly bath right at home! Pip waddles into the bathroom, flapping his little flippers with pure excitement. 'Bath time, Pip!' chirps Papa Penguin, holding up a fluffy green towel. Pip lets out a joyful peep. Papa turns on the faucet, and the tub fills up with soothing, warm water. Then, Papa adds the strawberry-scented bubble bath. Whoosh! Bubbles begin to grow and grow until they fill the tub to the brim. They smell like sweet summer strawberries and tickle Pip's beak. Pip hops right in with a joyful hop. Wheee! He sits down in the warm water, and the bubbles pop all around him like tiny, happy fireworks. Pip loves his bath time. He has a red plastic boat and a blue plastic whale waiting for him. He picks up the red boat and pushes it through the foam. 'Sails up!' squeaks Pip, guiding his boat across the bubbly sea. Papa gently washes Pip's back with a soft, soapy sponge, singing a silly song about flying penguins. Pip giggles and splashes his flippers, making a few droplets dance in the air. When every feather is super clean, Papa lets the water drain away with a funny gurgling sound. Down, down, down goes the water! Pip stands up and shakes his feathers just like a real little bird. Papa wraps him up snugly in the green towel, rubbing him dry until he is as warm as toast. 'You did a wonderful job in the tub tonight, Pip,' says Papa, giving him a gentle nuzzle. Pip feels so fresh, so clean, and so happy. He climbs into his cozy pajamas and snuggles deep under the covers. Sleep tight, little swimming penguin!

stories.title: Daisy Bunny's Bubbly Nose
stories.text: Hop, hop, hop goes little Daisy Bunny down the hallway. It is nighttime, which means the stars are twinkling outside and the bathtub is waiting inside! Daisy has been painting and playing in the garden all day long, so she has a little dirt on her paws and a smudge of green on her cheek. 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, my little bunny,' says Grandma Bunny with a sweet chuckle. Daisy’s long ears wiggle with happiness. She loves bath time because of the mountains of foam. Grandma fills the tub with lovely warm water and pours in a big capful of bubble bath that smells just like sweet apples. Puff! A giant cloud of fluffy white bubbles rises up, covering the water completely. Daisy peeks over the edge of the tub and gives a happy little bounce. She steps in, one paw at a time. Ooh, the water hugs her fur like a warm hug. Daisy sits down and scoops up a big handful of bubbles. She holds them right in front of her nose, and suddenly, she has a funny white bubble beard and a big bubble mustache! 'Look at me, Grandma, I am a wise old bunny wizard!' laughs Daisy. Grandma giggles and claps her paws. Next, Daisy takes her little pink sponge and washes her floppy ears, her paws, and her tummy, making sure she gets every single bit of garden dirt washed away. Grandma pours a cup of clean, warm water over her back to rinse away all the soap. Daisy closes her eyes tight so no water tickles her face. When the bath is all finished, Grandma pulls the plug and says goodbye to the water. Daisy steps out and is wrapped in a thick, pink towel with bunny ears on the hood. Grandma rubs her dry until she is fluffy and warm. Daisy puts on her polka-dot pajamas, gives Grandma a huge cuddle, and climbs into bed with a happy yawn. Goodnight, clean little bunny!

stories.title: Bears Big Bubbles
stories.text: Barnaby Bear was having so much fun playing with his wooden blocks. He built a super tall tower that reached almost to the ceiling! But then, mommy bear walked into the room with a big smile. 'Time for your splish-splash bubble bath, Barnaby!' she said softly. Barnaby let out a little sigh because he loved his blocks, but mommy gave him a warm, gentle hug. 'Come on, let us go make some magic suds together,' she whispered. Barnaby held her big, cozy paw as they walked down the hallway to the warm bathroom. The big porcelain tub was already filling up with lovely, warm water. 'Can I help?' Barnaby asked eagerly. 'Of course you can!' mommy replied, handing him a sparkly bottle of berry-scented soap. Barnaby squeezed the bottle and watched as thick, fluffy bubbles began to pop up, rising higher and higher like a soft white mountain. 'Whee!' giggled Barnaby, his happy mood returning completely. He carefully took off his yellow shirt and cozy socks, placing them in the hamper like a big boy. Then, with a gentle one, two, three, he stepped right into the tub. Ooh, the water felt like a warm hug on his toes! Barnaby scooped up a huge handful of bubbles and placed them right on top of his head like a silly fluffy hat. He looked in the mirror and laughed out loud at his funny reflection. Mommy washed his back with a soft, green washcloth while singing his absolute favorite nursery rhyme. Barnaby washed his tummy and his little toes all by himself, showing just how independent he was becoming. When it was time to let the water drain away, Barnaby waved bye-bye to the swirling water without any fuss at all. Mommy wrapped him up in a big, fluffy blue towel that smelled just like sunshine. She rubbed him dry and gave him a snuggly cuddle. Barnaby felt fresh, cozy, and ready for a wonderful night of sweet dreams. Bath time was truly the best adventure ever!

stories.title: Lily and the Floating Duck
stories.text: The sun was beginning to set outside, painting the sky in lovely shades of pink and orange. Little Lily was busy drawing pictures of happy yellow ducks with her big crayons. Suddenly, daddy peeked around the corner with a playful grin. 'Guess what time it is, Lily-bug? It is splish-splash bubble bath time!' Lily clapped her little hands together because she loved the water. She gently put her crayons away in their special box, showing wonderful responsibility. Daddy led the way to the bathroom, where the tub was already waiting, filled with cozy, inviting water. Lily eagerly climbed onto the little safety stool and tested the water with her fingertips. 'Just right!' she declared with a big happy smile. Daddy poured a capful of lavender bubble bath into the stream, and instantly, millions of tiny, shimmering bubbles danced to the top. Lily squealed with delight as the room filled with a sweet, calming smell. She slipped off her slippers and climbed into the tub, feeling the soothing water wrap around her like a cozy blanket. Her favorite yellow rubber duck was already floating peacefully in the middle of the bubbles. 'Quack, quack!' Lily said, making the duck do a little swimming dance across the soapy waves. Daddy gently washed her hair with special no-tears shampoo while Lily closed her eyes tight just like a brave little bunny. She rinsed off with a cup of warm water, blinking her bright eyes open with a cheer. 'All clean!' daddy announced proudly. Lily practiced washing her arms and legs, rubbing the soapy suds until they disappeared into the water. When the fun bath was over, daddy opened the drain, and the water made a happy gurgling sound as it went down. Daddy scooped Lily out and wrapped her in a warm, plush pink towel with bunny ears on the hood. She looked in the mirror and patted her clean, shiny hair. Feeling relaxed, happy, and so very loved, Lily padded off to her bedroom for story time, ready for a peaceful, cozy night.

stories.title: Pip the Puppy's Clean-Up
stories.text: Pip the puppy plush toy was tuckered out from a very busy day of chasing bouncing balls in the sunny backyard. His little human friend, Leo, was just as tired. Mama smiled and said, 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath for my big helper, Leo!' Leo loved splashing, so he eagerly nodded and ran to fetch his favorite floating boat toy. Mama turned on the faucet, and the warm water rushed into the tub, making a nice rushing sound. Leo watched carefully as Mama poured in a stream of green apple bubble bath. Within seconds, a huge forest of fluffy white bubbles popped up, looking just like soft cotton clouds. Leo carefully undressed, putting his dirty play clothes in the basket, showing what a wonderful big boy he was. With a joyful hop, Leo stepped into the warm tub. 'Ahhh,' he sighed happily as the water warmed his tired legs. He placed his little red toy boat right in the middle of the bubbly ocean and pushed it gently. 'Sail away, little boat!' Leo cheered as the boat drifted across the foam. Mama used a soft yellow sponge to gently wash away the outdoor dirt from his knees and elbows, while Leo sang a silly song about frogs. Then, Leo washed his own hands, making funny soap bubbles on his fingertips like magic rings. He rinsed his face with a damp washcloth, keeping his big brown eyes wide and bright. Bath time was so relaxing and fun! When all the bubbles were gone, Mama pulled the plug and watched the water swirl away down the drain. Leo stepped out onto the fluffy bath mat and Mama wrapped him in a big, warm striped towel. She gave him a gigantic tickle hug that made him laugh out loud. Fresh, clean, and smelling of sweet apples, Leo put on his cozy pajamas and smiled, knowing that getting clean was a wonderful part of every happy day.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Journey
stories.text: The sun is setting, and the stars are starting to twinkle in the big blue sky. Benny Bear has been playing outside all day long. He chased the bright orange butterflies, climbed up the grassy green hill, and painted a pretty picture with red and yellow finger paints. Now, Benny has a little smudge of blue paint right on his nose and some sticky honey on his fuzzy paw. It is time for a nice, cozy bath! Benny's mother fills the big white tub with warm, comforting water. She pours in some special bubble bath soap that smells just like sweet strawberries. Swish, swish, swish go the bubbles! Soon, big, fluffy white mounds are floating all around like soft clouds. Benny loves clouds! He gently steps one big furry foot into the warm water. Ooh, it feels so good on his tired paws. He giggles and sits all the way down, making a big splash! Splash, splash, splash! Benny takes a yellow sponge and gives his tummy a gentle scrub. He washes his little toes one by one. One, two, three, four, five! Next, Benny holds a big fluffy soap cloud right on top of his head. Look at me, Mama! I am King Benny with a bubble crown! His mother claps her hands and smiles a big, warm smile. You are doing such a wonderful job keeping yourself clean, Benny Bear, she says lovingly. Benny feels so proud and happy. When it is time to rinse, a gentle cup of warm water washes the bubbles away. Benny steps out of the tub and wraps himself in a big, fluffy green towel that feels just like a warm hug. He rubs his arms until they are dry and cozy. He puts on his soft yellow pajamas with little moons on them. Benny looks in the mirror and gives his clean nose a little wiggle. Bath time is so much fun, and Benny is ready for sweet, happy dreams.

stories.title: Daisy Duck's Floating Friends
stories.text: Quack, quack, quack! Little Daisy Duck is ready for her evening routine. Today, Daisy had a grand adventure building mud pies in the backyard and digging for wiggly worms in the garden. Her feathers are a little bit dusty, and her webbed feet are quite muddy. Her favorite yellow duckling bath is waiting for her. The bathroom is warm and filled with the gentle, calming scent of lavender. Daisy’s big sister turns the faucet, and the water rushes into the tub, making a nice rushing sound. Plip, plop, plip go the drops. Sister squeezes a bottle of bubbly soap, and presto! A mountain of fluffy white bubbles appears, looking like a snowy winter day in the middle of spring. Daisy flaps her wings with joy. Yahoo! It is bubble time! She steps into the warm water and lets out a happy sigh. The water wraps around her like a warm blanket. Daisy grabs her favorite toy, a squeaky green frog, and a shiny red plastic boat. She places the red boat right on top of a big bubble mountain. Sail away, little boat! she cheers. Daisy gently washes under her wings with a soft washcloth. She wipes her beak until it shines like the morning sun. You are shining like a star, Daisy, her big sister encourages her with a gentle stroke on her back. Daisy feels so loved and relaxed. The warm water tickles her tummy, making her giggle out loud. When the fun bath is all done, the plug is pulled, and the water swirls down the drain with a funny little gurgle noise. Bye-bye, water! Daisy waves. She steps onto a soft, pink bath mat and her mother wraps her in a cozy, warm towel with duck ears on the hood. Daisy rubs her face and snuggles in close. She feels fresh, clean, and ready for a peaceful night of sleep.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Mighty Mane Wash
stories.text: Roar! Well, a tiny, quiet roar because it is almost bedtime in the jungle house. Little Leo Lion has had a very busy day running through the tall grass and playing hide-and-seek with his monkey friends. His golden mane is a little bit messy, and there is a tiny leaf stuck right behind his fluffy ear. Mama Lion smiles and says, Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, my little king! Leo loves the bathroom because it always smells like fresh coconut and sunshine. Mama fills the tub with lovely, warm water. Leo watches in amazement as she pours in the bubbly soap. Poof! A huge sea of bubbles rises up, covering the whole surface of the tub. Leo places his little paws on the edge of the tub and peeks over. Wow, look at all those bubbles! He dips his tail in first. Swish, swish! Then, Leo hops right into the warm, bubbly water. It feels so nice on his tired muscles. He takes a cup and gently pours warm water over his golden mane. He pretends he is a brave captain sailing on a soapy sea. Mama hands him a soft, sponge shaped like a friendly star. Leo uses the star sponge to wash his strong arms and his strong little legs. Look at me, Mama, I am getting so clean! Mama cheers, You are doing fantastic, Leo! You are the cleanest lion in the whole wide world! Leo beams with pride. He practices blowing soft bubbles into the water. Pfft, pfft, pfft! The bubbles dance all around him like little floating balloons. When bath time is finished, Mama lets the water out. Leo steps out onto a soft, striped rug. He wraps up in a big orange towel that makes him look like a warm little sunbeam. He brushes his teeth, gives his parents a big good-night hug, and climbs into his cozy bed. Leo closes his eyes, feeling fresh, relaxed, and ready for wonderful morning adventures.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Adventure
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, and little Benny Bear was very tired after a whole day of running, jumping, and playing outside. Mama Bear walked into the living room with a big, warm smile. 'Come along, my sweet Benny,' she whispered softly, 'it is time for your splish-splash bubble bath!' Benny clapped his paws together with joy. He loved tub time! First, they walked into the warm, cozy bathroom. Mama turned on the shiny silver faucet, and water swirled into the big white tub. Swish, swish, went the water! Then came the very best part. Mama squeezed a big dollop of strawberry-scented soap right under the running water. Poof! Pop! Thousands of fluffy, white bubbles puffed up into the air like soft clouds. Benny giggled as a tiny bubble landed right on the tip of his furry nose. 'Boop!' laughed Mama. Benny climbed carefully into the warm tub. Ahh, it felt so good on his tired paws. He sat down and scooped up a handful of soapy bubbles. He pretended they were little white fluffy sheep jumping over a fence. One, two, three, jump! Next, it was time to wash. Benny took his yellow rubber ducky and gave it a good scrub under its wings. Then he used his soft blue washcloth to wash his tummy, his arms, and his little bear toes. 'Look at me, Mama, I am shining clean!' he cheered proudly. Mama washed his furry head gently, making sure no soapy water got into his bright brown eyes. Benny closed his eyes and sang his favorite bathtime song. When all the washing was done, Mama pulled the plug. Wheee! The water swirled down the drain with a happy gurgle. Benny stood up, and Mama wrapped him in a giant, fluffy, yellow towel that smelled just like sunshine. She gave him a big, cozy squeeze. 'You did a wonderful job getting clean today, Benny Bear,' she whispered. Benny felt warm, happy, and so very ready for sweet dreams in his cozy bed.

stories.title: Mia's Magical Bathtime Bubbles
stories.text: Ding-dong! The little Ben-grandfather clock in the hallway chimed. That meant it was almost bedtime for Mia the little bunny. But first, Mia had a very important mission: the splish-splash bubble bath! Mia hopped into the bathroom, her long floppy ears twitching with excitement. Papa Bunny was already waiting for her, holding a big bottle of lavender bubble bath. 'Are you ready to make some magic, Mia?' Papa asked with a twinkle in his eye. 'Yes, Papa! Magic bubbles!' Mia cheered, clapping her little paws. Papa filled the tub with nice, warm water. Then, he poured in the bubbly soap and swished the water around with his big hand. Abracadabra! Suddenly, the tub was full of big, round, rainbow-colored bubbles that floated all around like tiny balloons. Mia climbed into the warm water with a happy sigh. It felt like a warm hug all over her soft bunny fur. She gently scooped up a big crown of bubbles and placed it right on top of her head. 'Look, Papa! I am the Queen of Bubble Land!' she declared, standing up tall in the tub. Papa chuckled and bowed. 'Your Majesty, it is time to wash your royal paws.' Mia giggled and grabbed her pink washcloth. She scrubbed her paws, her cheeks, and her long bunny ears, making sure she was extra clean. Then, she washed her pink button nose. Splash, splash, went the water as she kicked her feet gently. Papa handed her a little floating sailboat. Mia blew on the sailboat, and it sailed across the tub right through a mountain of bubbles. 'Go little boat, go!' she cheered. When playtime was over, the water drained away with a happy whoosh. Papa lifted Mia out and wrapped her in a snuggly pink towel with bunny ears on the hood. She rubbed her eyes, feeling so relaxed and cozy. 'You are such a big girl, Mia, and you did a fantastic job tonight,' Papa praised. Mia gave Papa a big hug, ready for a wonderful night's sleep.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Sparkly Mane
stories.text: Roar! Well, not a loud roar, just a tiny, sleepy roar from little Leo Lion. The stars were twinkling in the night sky, and Leo had just finished his yummy dinner. Mama Lion gave him a gentle nudge toward the bathroom. 'Time for our favorite routine, little cub. Let's go get nice and fresh with a splish-splash bubble bath!' Leo loved his bath time because the bathroom always smelled like sweet coconut and sunshine. He trotted happily behind Mama, dragging his favorite green bath frog behind him. Mama filled the tub until the water was just the right temperature—nice and cozy. Then came the magical soap! Mama squeezed a big squirt of bubbly soap under the faucet. Whoosh! Bubbles bubbled up, up, up until they looked like a fluffy white mountain right in the middle of the tub. Leo hopped right in, making a fun splash that sent tiny water drops dancing into the air. 'Whee!' shouted Leo. He sat right in the middle of the warm water and looked at his golden mane in the mirror. 'Time to wash the lion's mane!' Mama said with a smile. Leo took his green bath sponge and gently washed his golden fur. He washed behind his furry ears, his shoulders, and his little paws. Mama helped him wash his mane, making soapy mohawks and funny bubble beards. Leo looked down at the water and laughed because he looked like a silly wizard with a beard made of foam. He rinsed off with a cup of warm water, pouring it gently over his back. All the soap washed away, leaving his fur extra soft and shiny. When it was time to get out, the water went down the drain with a friendly gurgle. Mama wrapped Leo in a big, soft green towel that wrapped all the way around him like a leafy cocoon. She rubbed his back and gave him a big kiss on his forehead. 'You are the cleanest, most wonderful lion in the whole jungle,' Mama whispered lovingly. Leo curled up, feeling clean, warm, and ready for a peaceful night.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub Time Adventure
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, and little Benny Bear felt very sleepy after a long day of playing outside in the dirt. His paws were muddy, and his fur had little sticks in it. Mommy Bear smiled and said, 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, my sweet little cub!' Benny clapped his paws together because he loved tub time. Mommy turned on the warm water, and it made a lovely rushing sound. Phew, the bathroom felt so cozy and warm. Then, Mommy poured in the special bubble bath soap. Whoosh! Up rose a giant mountain of fluffy, white bubbles that looked just like snowy clouds. Benny hopped right into the big tub. Plop! Warm water splashed all around. Benny took a big handful of bubbles and put them on his head like a fluffy white hat. 'Look, Mommy, I am a snowy mountain!' he giggled happily. Mommy washed Benny's furry arms with a soft washcloth. She gently scrubbed behind his little bear ears, singing a silly song about bubbles floating away. Benny practiced taking deep breaths and blowing bubbles. Pop, pop, went the tiny soap bubbles in the air. When it was time to rinse, Mommy used a little cup to pour clean water gently over Benny's back. 'All clean!' cheered Mommy. Benny stepped out of the tub onto his fluffy blue bathmat. Mommy wrapped him up in a big, warm towel and gave him a giant bear hug. Benny felt so fresh, clean, and happy. He rubbed his eyes and yawned a big, sleepy yawn. It was time for sweet dreams, knowing he was clean and cozy from his head down to his toes. The bathroom was quiet again, waiting for the next bubbly adventure tomorrow.

stories.title: Mia's Magical Tub Boat
stories.text: Ring-ring! It was evening time, and Mia was busy playing with her wooden blocks. But her tummy was full of yummy dinner, and her eyelids were feeling heavy like sleepy butterflies. Daddy walked into the playroom with a big smile and said, 'Are you ready for your splish-splash bubble bath, Captain Mia?' Mia cheered loudly and hopped up. She loved sailing her toy boats! In the bathroom, the warm water was already swirling in the tub. Daddy dropped in a squirty yellow duck and Mia's favorite red sailboat. Then came the best part—the bubbles! Squeeeze went the bottle, and mountains of sparkly bubbles piled high in the water. Mia climbed up the little step stool and stepped into the tub. Splash went her toes! 'Welcome aboard, Captain!' said Daddy, handing her a sponge shaped like a starfish. Mia sat down in the warm water, feeling so relaxed. She pushed her red sailboat through the bubble waves. Swoosh, swoosh, went the boat. Daddy washed Mia's shiny brown hair with sweet-smelling strawberry shampoo. Mia squeezed her eyes shut tight just like a good girl while Daddy gently rinsed the soap away. Then, Mia used her starfish sponge to wash her tummy, her knees, and her little toes. She was doing such a wonderful job keeping herself clean! 'Great job, superstar,' praised Daddy, giving her a high-five. When the bath was all done, Daddy pulled the plug, and the water swirled down the drain with a funny gurgling noise. Bye-bye, water! Mia stood up and snuggled into her warm, hooded unicorn towel. She felt so clean and cozy, ready for a wonderful night of sleep.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Sparkly Bath
stories.text: Roar! Well, a very quiet, gentle little roar. Little Leo Lion had spent the whole day painting pictures and digging in the garden. His golden paws had blue paint on them, and his tummy had a smudge of green grass. Grandma Lion chuckled and said, 'Time to wash up, my brave little lion! Let's get you ready for a splish-splash bubble bath.' Leo loved the bathroom because it always smelled like lavender and sunshine. Grandma filled the tub with nice, comfortable warm water. She added a big squirt of foaming bubble soap. Poof! Millions of shiny bubbles popped up, filling the tub to the brim. Leo scrambled up the side and hopped right in. Splash! The water made a happy sound. Leo grabbed a yellow washcloth and pretended he was a big ship sailing on a bubble sea. 'Ahoy, Grandma!' he called out. Grandma gently washed the blue paint off his paws and the green grass off his tummy. She washed his soft mane with gentle soap that tickled his nose. Leo didn't even mind when it was time to rinse; he just looked up at the bathroom ceiling and counted the imaginary stars. 'You are shining like a star, Leo,' Grandma said proudly. Leo felt so relaxed in the warm water that he let out a long, happy sigh. Bath time was truly the best way to wash away the tired feelings of the day. When bath time was over, Grandma wrapped Leo in a fluffy orange towel that had cute little lion ears on the hood. Leo dried off completely and slipped into his cozy pajamas. He felt warm, wonderful, and ready for a peaceful night of sweet dreams.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Journey
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, and little Benny Bear was still zooming around his room. He had zoomed like a rocket ship, crawled like a busy bee, and stomped like a giant dinosaur all afternoon long. Because Benny had played so hard, he was covered in happy little dust spots and outdoor adventures! Mommy Bear walked into the room with a big, warm smile and said, 'Benny Bear, it is time for our very favorite part of the evening. It is time for a splish-splash bubble bath!' Benny clapped his paws together. He loved the water! They trotted into the bathroom together, where the big white tub was waiting. Mommy turned on the handles, and WHOOSH! Warm, cozy water began to fill the tub. Benny watched with wide, happy eyes as Mommy poured in a special bottle of bubble bath liquid. Suddenly, magic happened! Fluffy, white bubbles began to grow and grow and grow, rising up like soft pillows of foam. Benny giggled a happy bear giggle. It was time to get undressed. One by one, Benny took off his muddy socks and his play shirt. He stepped into the warm water with a gentle, happy sigh. Ahhh, it felt so good on his tired little toes! Benny picked up his red rubber ducky and gave it a gentle squeeze. Squeak! Squeak! The rubber ducky floated happily on top of a big mountain of bubbles. Benny scooped up a handful of foam and gave himself a funny white bubble beard. He looked in the mirror and laughed out loud. Mommy washed his back with a soft washcloth, singing a sweet little song about getting clean. Benny washed his paws, splashing just a tiny bit, and felt all the daytime wiggles wash right down the drain. When it was time to get out, Mommy wrapped him in a big, fluffy towel that felt like a warm hug. Benny felt clean, cozy, and ready for sweet dreams. You did a wonderful job in the tub today, Benny Bear! Goodnight, little explorer.

stories.title: Penny Penguin's Splashy Party
stories.text: Way down by the sparkling blue water, little Penny Penguin had spent the whole day building sandy castles and sliding down the snow hills. Her feathers were a little bit messy, and her flippers had traces of yummy berry juice from snack time. Daddy Penguin waddled over with a bright yellow duck towel draped over his shoulder. 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, my sweet little penguin!' he chirped gently. Penny loved bath time more than anything. She waddled as fast as her little feet could carry her right into the warm, steamy bathroom. Daddy had already filled the tub with water that felt just right—not too hot and not too cold. He dropped in some special bath fizzies that turned the water a pretty, swirling shade of light blue. Then came the best part: mountains and mountains of bubbly foam! Penny hopped right into the tub with a happy little splash. Splash, splash, went her flippers! She grabbed her green toy frog and made it leap right over the soapy hills. Daddy washed her tummy with a gentle sponge, tickling her just a little bit so she giggled with joy. Penny helped wash her own flippers, rubbing them together to make soapy bubbles pop in the air. Pop, pop, pop! The bubbles floated up toward the ceiling like little white clouds. Penny felt so relaxed and happy in her warm, bubbly sea. Bath time was such a cozy adventure. When the water started to swirl down the drain, Daddy helped Penny step out into her soft towel. He dried her fluffy feathers until she was as dry as a desert and as cozy as a bug in a rug. Penny felt so refreshed and clean. You are such a big helper at bath time, Penny Penguin! Sweet dreams to you.

stories.title: Sammy Starfish's Starry Bubbles
stories.text: Evening time had arrived in the cozy little house, and Sammy Starfish was winding down from a very busy day of building block towers and painting colorful pictures. There was a little bit of blue paint on his elbow and some cracker crumbs on his lap. Grandma smiled down at Sammy and said, 'Oh, my little star, it is time for a splish-splash bubble bath to wash away our busy day!' Sammy loved the water, and he eagerly reached for Grandma's hand. They walked into the bathroom, where Grandma had already prepared a wonderful surprise. The tub was filled with lovely, warm water, and it was piled high with sweet-smelling, fluffy bubbles that looked just like cotton candy. Sammy climbed up the little step stool and hopped right into the bubbly wonderland. 'Ooh, it is so warm!' Sammy whispered happily. He sat down and let the soothing water wrap around him like a cozy blanket. Grandma gave him a floating boat with a little yellow sail. Sammy pushed the boat through the ocean of bubbles, making tiny waves. Swoosh, swoosh, went the boat! Grandma used a soft, gentle washcloth to wash the paint right off his arm, singing a lullaby about stars in the night sky. Sammy washed his hands and splashed his fingers, watching the shiny water droplets dance in the bathroom light. He felt so peaceful and happy. All the tiredness of the day melted away in the warm, bubbly water. When it was time to say goodbye to the bath, Grandma pulled the plug, and the water swirled away. She lifted Sammy out and wrapped him snugly in a big blue towel with a hood. Sammy felt so warm, clean, and loved. You did a fantastic job getting ready for bed, Sammy Starfish! Sleep tight.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Party
stories.text: Ring, ring! Goes the little yellow duck. It is time for a fun, warm bath, Benny Bear! Benny has been playing in the busy dirt all day long. He built tall mud castles and ran very fast through the green grass. Now, his paws are dusty, and his tummy has a little smudge of chocolate. 'Time for splish-splash, Benny Bear!' says Mama Bear with a big, happy smile. Benny loves his warm water. He walks into the bathroom and sees the big white tub filling up with lots of bubbles. Pop, pop, pop! Goes a little bubble right on his nose. Benny giggles and wiggles his furry toes. Mama pours the bubbly soap, and presto! Benny has a wonderful bubble crown on his head. He looks just like a royal king! 'Look at me, Mama! I am the King of the Tub!' he says proudly. Now it is time to wash. First, we wash the busy paws. Rub, rub, rub. Wash away the dirt! Next, we wash the little round belly. Tickle, tickle, tickle! Benny laughs out loud because it feels so nice and tickly. Then comes the soft washcloth for his fuzzy ears. Benny closes his eyes tight so no water splashes in. He is doing such a wonderful job being big and brave. 'All clean!' says Mama. Benny looks down at his shiny paws. They are so clean and smell like sweet lavender. It feels so cozy to be fresh. Time to let the water go down the drain. Whee! Bye-bye, bubbles! Mama wraps Benny up in a big, fluffy blue towel that feels just like a warm hug. She rubs his back and gives him a big kiss on his forehead. 'You did a fantastic job today, my sweet little bear,' says Mama. Benny feels warm, happy, and so very ready for his sleepytime bed. Goodnight, clean Benny Bear. Sweet dreams to you!

stories.title: Pip the Penguin's Warm Splash
stories.text: Brrr! The wind is blowing outside, but inside the cozy bathroom, the water is warm and waiting. Pip the Penguin loves to swim, but tonight, his feathers need a special super-clean. Pip has been painting with bright blue and red fingerpaints today. Guess what? A little bit of blue paint got right on his tummy! 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, little Pip,' says Papa Penguin. Pip flaps his little flippers with pure joy. He waddles over to the tub as fast as his webbed feet can carry him. Splash! Goes his first little toe in the water. 'Ahhh, so warm and cozy!' says Pip. Papa drops a bright red toy boat into the water. It floats right by Pip's tummy. Pip pushes the boat, and it sails across the tub, making gentle waves. Now it is time for the bubbles! Papa squeezes the bottle, and giant fluffy bubbles float all around. Pip reaches out his little flippers and catches a big bubble. Pop! It tickles his flipper. Time to wash away the paint. Papa puts a dab of bubbles on a soft sponge. We wash the little beak, nice and gentle. We wash the little wings, one by one. And we gently wash the bright blue paint right off his tummy. Scrub-a-dub-dub, in the nice warm tub! Pip helps out by rubbing his own flippers together. He is learning to be such a big, independent penguin. 'Great job, Pip!' cheers Papa. Pip feels so proud. He splashes his feet just a little bit, making happy water music. Splash, splash, splash! When the bath is all done, the water swirls down the drain in a fun little whirlpool. Bye-bye, water! Papa wraps Pip in a snuggly towel with a hood that has cute little penguin eyes. Papa hugs him tight and sings a sweet little lullaby. Pip feels so fresh, so clean, and so very loved. He is ready to snuggle down and dream sweet penguin dreams.

stories.title: Mia Mouse's Sparkly Bath
stories.text: Squeak, squeak! Says Mia Mouse as she bounces into the bathroom. What a busy day Mia has had! She built blocks, chased butterflies, and rolled around in the soft carpet. Now it is time for her favorite part of the day: the splish-splash bubble bath! Mia's big green tub is filled with warm water and smells like yummy strawberries. Mia climbs up the little pink step-stool and peers over the edge. Wow, look at all those shiny bubbles! They look like soft white clouds right in the bathroom. Mia dips her tiny hand into the water. It feels just right. 'Time to get sparkly clean, Mia Mouse!' says Grandma Mouse. Mia steps in with a happy hop. She sits right down and holds her favorite squeaky pink rubber duckie. Squeak! Squeak! Says the duckie as Mia swims it through the bubbles. Grandma brings over a washcloth filled with bubbly soap. First, we wash the little furry face, right behind the whiskers. Mia closes her eyes and keeps them shut tight like a brave little mouse. Next, we wash the tiny pink hands that did so much wonderful drawing today. Rub, rub, rub! Then we wash the little tail, making sure it gets super-duper clean. Mia giggles because the bubbles make her feel like she is wearing a fluffy white coat. She is doing a stellar job staying still and helping Grandma wash. 'You are shining like a star, Mia!' says Grandma. Mia beams with a big, proud smile. She loves feeling so clean and fresh. When bath time is finished, the water splashes away down the drain. Whoosh! Grandma wraps Mia in a warm, fluffy towel with adorable mouse ears on the hood. Grandma rubs her dry and gives her a warm, cozy squeeze. Mia yawns a little yawn because all that playing and bathing makes a little mouse sleepy. She puts on her soft star pajamas and climbs into her comfy bed. Goodnight, sparkly Mia Mouse.

stories.title: Benny Bear's Tub-Time Bubbles
stories.text: The sun was setting behind the big green trees, and little Benny Bear was finishing up his very busy day of building block towers and chasing butterflies. Oh, but Benny Bear was covered in a little bit of sticky honey and quite a lot of happy dirt! Mommy Bear smiled and said, 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, my sweet little cub!' Benny clapped his paws together with joy because he loved the warm, cozy water. He trotted right into the bathroom, ready for fun. Mommy turned on the faucet, and a lovely, warm stream filled the tub. Then came the magic part—the bubbly soap! Squirt, squirt, went the bottle, and soon, mountains of fluffy white bubbles popped up, looking just like snowy mountain peaks. Benny Bear climbed carefully into the tub. Ahh, it felt so wonderful and warm against his furry toes! 'Look at me, Mommy! I am a snowy mountain bear!' he giggled. First, it was time to wash his wiggly fingers. Benny rubbed them together with a little bit of lavender soap, making lots of tiny squeaky sounds. Squeaky-clean fingers! Next came his strong arms and his round tummy. Benny scooped up a big handful of bubbles and put them on his head like a fluffy white crown. He looked in the mirror and roared a tiny, friendly bear roar. 'Roar! I am the king of the bubbly bath!' Mommy Bear cheered for him, saying, 'You are doing such a wonderful job keeping your body healthy and clean, Benny!' When all the washing was done, Benny played gently with his yellow rubber ducky, making it swim across the bubbly waves. Quack, quack! Finally, it was time to let the water drain away. Watch it swirl, down, down, down it goes! Benny stood up, and Mommy wrapped him in a big, fluffy blue towel that hugged him tight like a warm bear hug. He dried his ears, his nose, and his toes. Benny Bear felt so fresh, so relaxed, and so very happy. Ready for sweet dreams in his cozy bed!

stories.title: Pip the Penguin's Squeaky Clean Dive
stories.text: Little Pip the Penguin had been sliding down the icy hills all morning long. He had zoomed so fast that he landed right in a patch of soft, dark mud! Oh dear, Pip was not a black-and-white penguin anymore; he was a brown-and-muddy penguin! 'Time for a splish-splash bubble bath, little flipper,' chirped Daddy Penguin with a warm, loving smile. Pip waddled as fast as his little webbed feet could carry him into the warm bathroom. Daddy had already filled the big tub with lovely, soothing water that felt just right. Pip hopped right in with a happy little hop. Splash! Water droplets danced in the air like tiny diamonds. Daddy pumped a big cloud of strawberry-scented soap into the water. It smelled so sweet! Pip used his flippers to stir the water around and around, making a giant whirlpool of bubbles. 'Look, Daddy, I am swimming in a cloud!' Pip chirped happily. First, Pip washed his little black beak. He gently wiped away the mud with a soft washcloth. Then came his flippers, flapping back and forth to wash off every single speck of dirt. Rub-a-dub-dub, in the warm soapy tub! Daddy washed Pip’s back, singing a sweet little song about the ocean. Pip felt so cozy and relaxed. He practiced floating on his back, looking up at the ceiling like a little star. 'You are learning such wonderful big-kid habits, Pip!' Daddy praised him warmly. Pip felt so proud inside. When the fun bath was finished, Daddy pulled the plug, and the water made a happy gurgling sound as it went down the drain. Bye-bye, bathwater! Daddy wrapped Pip in a giant, fluffy red towel with a hood that had little penguin eyes. Pip dried his tummy, his flippers, and his webbed feet. Now, he was the cleanest, softest little penguin in the whole wide world, ready for a snuggly storytime.

stories.title: Daisy Bunny's Bubbly Splash Adventure
stories.text: Daisy Bunny had spent the whole sunny afternoon planting carrots and jumping over garden hoses. Her long furry ears were floppy, and her pink paws had little smudges of garden soil on them. 'Hop, hop, time to stop!' said Grandma Bunny gently. 'Let us get you ready for a splish-splash bubble bath.' Daisy loved bath time more than anything! She gave a happy hop and bounced straight into the bathroom. Grandma filled the tub with nice warm water, making sure it was just right. Then, Grandma added a big pump of blueberry bubble bath. Poof! A huge mountain of fragrant bubbles rose up to the edges of the tub. Daisy climbed up the little step stool and stepped right into the warm, comforting water. Ahh, it felt like a gentle hug for her tired legs! Daisy grabbed a green washcloth and began to wash her long, floppy ears. 'Wash, wash, wash the ears, making them fresh for all to hear,' she sang softly to herself. Grandma smiled proudly at how independent Daisy was becoming. Next, Daisy washed her twitchy little nose and her soft white paws. She rubbed the soap gently until tiny bubbles made tickly foam on her toes. 'Hee-hee, that tickles!' Daisy giggled, wriggling her toes in the warm water. She played with her floating toy boat, pushing it gently across the bubbly sea. Sail away, little boat! When it was time to finish, Daisy watched the water swirl down the drain, whispering goodbye to the bubbles. Grandma lifted her out and wrapped her in a big, fluffy yellow towel that smelled like sunshine. Daisy dried her paws, her cheeks, and her long ears. She felt so clean, cozy, and ready for a peaceful night's sleep.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to take a bubbly bath,
Splish and splash and start to laugh!
Strip your clothes off, one, two, three,
Climb inside and shout with glee.

Turn the water nice and warm,
Keep away the sleepy storm.
Watch the water swirl around,
Hear the happy splashing sound.

Squeeze the sponge and watch it grow,
Make the soapy bubbles blow.
Wash your tummy, wash your toes,
Wash the little button nose.

Now the bath is done at last,
Wrap up in a towel fast!
Dry the fingers, dry the toes,
Off to put on cozy clothes.

rhymes.title: Bubble Mountain
rhymes.text:
Pour the water in the tub,
Time to give a little scrub.
Bubbles rising high and tall,
Catch a big one as they fall.

Make a hat upon your head,
Better than a sleepy bed.
Put a beard upon your chin,
Let the water games begin!

Wash the arms and wash the legs,
Floating ducks and yellow pegs.
Rub-a-dub from top to toe,
Watch the dirty water go.

Drain the tub and wave goodbye,
Lift the cozy towel high.
Snuggle in a loving hug,
Dry and clean and safe and snug.

rhymes.title: Rubber Duckie's Tune
rhymes.text:
Rubber duckie wants to play,
Splashing all the blues away.
Fill the tub with water blue,
Sing a happy bath time zoo.

Soap the washcloth nice and neat,
Wash the bottom of your feet.
Rub the shampoo in your hair,
Floating bubbles in the air.

Wash behind each little ear,
Splash the water, loud and clear.
Time to rinse the soap away,
Ready for a brand new day.

Wrap you in a furry sheet,
From your head down to your feet.
Now you smell so fresh and sweet,
Ready for a toddler treat.

rhymes.title: Splish Splash Hooray
rhymes.text:
Evening time is coming near,
Bath time magic will appear.
Run the water, make it splash,
Get into the tub in a dash.

Soapy bubbles, round and white,
Shining in the bathroom light.
Scrub the fingers, scrub the toes,
Wipe the sleepy little nose.

Watch the water whirl and spin,
Let the floating boat swim in.
Kick your legs and make a wave,
Splashing is so fun and brave.

Pull the plug and watch it drain,
Sing a happy bedtime strain.
Step out softly to the floor,
Ready to explore some more.

rhymes.title: The Squeaky Clean Song
rhymes.text:
Climb up on the bathroom stool,
Bath time water is so cool.
Pour the bubbles on the top,
Watch the soapy water pop.

Wash the fingers, wash the knees,
Scrub the elbows if you please.
Wash the face and wash the back,
Playing with the plastic quack.

Rinse the shampoo from your head,
Time to dry and go to bed.
Wrap the towel round and round,
Best warm hug that can be found.

Now you sparkle, now you shine,
Little darling, you are mine.
Squeaky clean from top to toe,
To your cozy bed you go.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to take a bubbly bath,
Splish and splash and make me laugh!
Toys are ready, big and small,
Rubber ducky, you're the tall.

First we wash our little toes,
Then we scrub our funny nose.
Wash the fingers, wash the hands,
Playing in the soapy lands.

Wash the tummy, nice and round,
Not a single speck is found.
Wash the hair and shampoo high,
Careful not to get in eye.

Now we rinse the suds away,
What a super bath today!

rhymes.title: Bubbles in the Air
rhymes.text:
Warm water filling up the tub,
Time for every kid to scrub.
Turn the handles, watch it flow,
To the bathroom we will go.

Floating bubbles in the air,
Landing softly in my hair.
Catch a bubble on your thumb,
Pop it gently with a drum.

Scrub the knees and wash the back,
Floating on a yellow quack.
Silly washcloth on the head,
Getting ready for our bed.

Drain the water down the drain,
We can do it all again!

rhymes.title: Splish-Splash Fun
rhymes.text:
Splish-splash, splish-splash, hear the sound,
Water splashing all around.
Climb inside the cozy pool,
Where the water feels so cool.

Soap is slippery, soap is sweet,
Washing up from head to feet.
Scrub the elbows, wash the chin,
Let the happy time begin.

Make a mountain on your head,
Like a snowy day instead.
Wash the ears and wash the neck,
Check the little toes and check.

All done splashing, dry off now,
Wrap me in a towel, wow!

rhymes.title: Rubber Ducky's Song
rhymes.text:
Rubber ducky swims along,
Singing out a happy song.
Dive on down and float back up,
Drinking from a tiny cup.

Washing dirt right down the drain,
Sunshine after falling rain.
Scrub the legs and scrub the feet,
Smelling oh so very sweet.

Watch the water swirl and spin,
Time to wash the dirt out, twin.
Splash the water with a kick,
Getting clean is very quick.

Dry the body, warm and bright,
Ready for a cozy night.

rhymes.title: Squeaky Clean and Bright
rhymes.text:
Bath time, bath time, oh what joy,
Every little girl and boy.
Fill the tub with cozy foam,
Bestest room inside our home.

Wash the fingers one by one,
Getting clean is so much fun.
Scrub the shoulders, wash the face,
In our special bathing place.

Watch the bubbles float away,
Ending such a busy day.
Wrap me in a fluffy sheet,
From my head down to my feet.

Squeaky clean and feeling grand,
Now I dry my little hand.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to take a bubbly bath,
Splish and splash and start to laugh!
Strip away the muddy day,
Now it is our soapy play.

Fill the tub up to the brim,
Bring a rubber duck to swim.
Watch the water swirling round,
Not a single grumpy sound.

Squeeze the sponge and make it wet,
Clean the toes and fingers yet.
Wash the tummy, wash the knee,
Happy little toddler, me!

Rinse the bubbles down the drain,
Till we take a bath again.
 Wrap me in a towel so warm,
 Safe and cozy from the storm.

rhymes.title: Bubble Beard
rhymes.text:
Evening time is coming near,
Time for splashing, loud and clear.
Turn the handles, watch it glow,
Warm and bubbly, to and fro.

Scoop the bubbles in your hand,
Spread them through the soapy land.
Put a bubble on your nose,
Tickle all your tiny toes.

Make a funny bubble beard,
Look so silly, quite weird!
Wash the hair and wash the face,
Water splashing every place.

Time to drain the tub of fun,
Bath time is for everyone.
Dry off fast and give a hug,
Snuggling up upon the rug.

rhymes.title: Yellow Duckie's Swim
rhymes.text:
Yellow duckie wants to play,
Splashing all the dirt away.
Climb inside the shiny tub,
Ready for a happy rub.

Pour the water, nice and sweet,
Wash from head down to your feet.
Rub the shampoo in your hair,
Bubbly mountains everywhere.

Make the water gently sway,
Duckie leads the happy way.
Sing a little bathtime song,
Everybody sing along!

All clean now and feeling grand,
Waving with a soapy hand.
Out you step onto the floor,
Ready for a storymore.

rhymes.title: Splashy Toes
rhymes.text:
Hear the water running fast,
Bathtime magic here at last.
Take off shirt and pants and shoes,
No more time to sing the blues.

Dip a toe and test the heat,
Lovely water for your feet.
In you jump with one big bound,
Watch the ripples circle round.

Scrub the elbows, scrub the back,
Floating toys upon the track.
Wash the ears and wash the chin,
Let the happy giggles in.

Now the water's going down,
No one's wearing any frown.
Soft pajamas, sweet and bright,
Time to sleep and say goodnight.

rhymes.title: Soapy Mountain Peaks
rhymes.text:
Soap and water, bright and clean,
Best routine you've ever seen.
Climb up to the bathroom chair,
Strip away what you don't wear.

Build a mountain on your head,
Better than a cozy bed.
White and fluffy up so high,
Reaching almost to the sky.

Splash the water left and right,
Making everything so bright.
Wash the knees and wash the hands,
Traveling to bubble lands.

Pull the plug and watch it spin,
Where did all the water win?
Towel dry and feeling sweet,
From my head down to my feet.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to splash and time to play,
Washing all the dirt away.
Fill the tub up to the brim,
Bring a little yellow duck to swim.

Scrub the tummy, scrub the toes,
Wash the little button nose.
Bubbles floating in the air,
Soapy crowns upon your hair.

Now the water swirls around,
Not a single speck is found.
Drain the tub, watch water go,
Bye-bye bubbles down below.

Wrap you in a towel so warm,
Safe and cozy from the storm.
Snuggly bear and sleepy head,
Time to crawl right into bed.

rhymes.title: Bubble Mountain
rhymes.text:
Pour the water, nice and warm,
Keep away the sleepy storm.
Squeeze the bottle, make it gleam,
Look at all the fluffy cream.

Build a mountain, tall and high,
Reaching almost to the sky.
Puff a breath and watch them fly,
Floating up so very high.

Wash your fingers, wash your knees,
Splash the water if you please.
Wash your shoulders and your back,
Splishing in the bubbly track.

Rinse it off with water clear,
Bedtime is so very near.
Dry you fast and give a hug,
Time to dry the happy rug.

rhymes.title: The Splashy Song
rhymes.text:
Off with shoes and off with shirt,
Time to wash away the dirt.
Climb into the water blue,
Daddy has a boat for you.

Motorboat goes fast and slow,
Where is little ducky's toe?
Wash behind each little ear,
Smile and let me see you cheer.

Sponge is soft upon your arm,
Keeping you so safe from harm.
Watch the water start to spin,
Let the washing now begin.

Pull the plug and watch it drain,
Singing out a happy strain.
Dry you off from toe to head,
Time to snuggle in your bed.

rhymes.title: Twinkle Toes in the Tub
rhymes.text:
Evening time is coming fast,
Splish-splash bath time here at last.
Climb inside the porcelain shell,
Where the soapy bubbles dwell.

Wash your fingers one by one,
Bathing is so much fun.
Wash your face and wash your chin,
Let the splashing now begin.

Make a beard of bubbles white,
Shining in the bathroom light.
Kick your feet and make a wave,
Little baby, bold and brave.

Now the water's going down,
No more splashing in the town.
Wrapped up like a little sweet,
Warm from head to tiny feet.

rhymes.title: Rubber Ducky's Party
rhymes.text:
Rubber ducky loves to quack,
Sitting on your little back.
Water warm and water bright,
Shining like a summer light.

Scrub a dub and wash your hair,
Bubbles floating everywhere.
Wash your elbows, wash your knees,
Splash the water if you please.

Drain the tub and hear it sigh,
Time to say a fond goodbye.
Towel waiting on the chair,
Soft and fluffy, nice and fair.

Pajamas on, so soft and neat,
Resting up your busy feet.
Close your eyes and drift away,
Dreaming of another day.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to take a bubbly bath,
Splish and splash and start to laugh.
Toys are waiting in the foam,
Best little boat in all our home.

Turn the faucet, warm and sweet,
Washing fingers, washing feet.
Scrub the tummy, scrub the toes,
Look at bubbles on my nose!

Wash the shoulders, wash the back,
Floating ducks go quack-quack-quack.
Wash the hair and rinse it out,
Hear the happy little shout.

All so clean and feeling grand,
Wiped away by towel hand.
Jumping up and feeling bright,
Ready for a cozy night.

rhymes.title: Rubber Ducky's Song
rhymes.text:
Rubber ducky loves the water,
Splashing just the way he oughter.
Bring your soap and bring your toys,
Time for girls and time for boys.

Rub-a-dub-dub in the tub,
Give your arms a little rub.
Make a mountain on your head,
Soon it is to curl in bed.

Wash the fingers, wash the knees,
Listen to the evening breeze.
Pour the water, watch it flow,
Watch the soapy bubbles go.

Now the bath is almost done,
Wasn't that so much good fun?
Wrap up cozy, warm and dry,
Give the rubber duck a bye.

rhymes.title: Bubbles in the Air
rhymes.text:
Bubbles floating all around,
Dropping softly to the ground.
Pop them fast and pop them slow,
Watch the soapy water glow.

Time to wash the dirt away,
After such a busy day.
Use the sponge so soft and bright,
Making everything just right.

Wash the ears and wash the face,
In this happy splashing place.
Rinse it off and smile and grin,
Let the cozy times begin.

Water swirling down the drain,
See you next time, gentle rain.
Towel wrapped and snug and sweet,
From my head down to my feet.

rhymes.title: Splashy Toes
rhymes.text:
Kick your feet and make a wave,
Splashing water, strong and brave.
Little bubbles in a row,
Where do all the bubbles go?

Scrub a little, wash a lot,
In this happy little spot.
Shampoo smelling nice and sweet,
Making little kids complete.

Wash the nose and wash the chin,
Let the sudsy fun begin.
Watch them float up to the sky,
Wave to every one goodbye.

Pull the plug and watch it spin,
Wash the dirt outside and in.
Wrapped in flannel, warm and dry,
Time to sing a lullaby.

rhymes.title: The Warm Water Dance
rhymes.text:
Fill the tub with water warm,
Safe away from wind and storm.
Drop the sponge and drop the boat,
Watch the little playthings float.

Washing elbows, washing knees,
Splash the water if you please.
Scrub the fingers, scrub the toes,
Wipe the water from your nose.

Sing a happy bath-time tune,
Shining like the evening moon.
Rinse the soap out of your hair,
Bubbles vanishing in air.

Now the bath is at an end,
Time to dry off, little friend.
Soft pajamas, cozy bed,
Pillow waiting for your head.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to take a bubbly bath,
Splishing down the bathroom path.
Water is so warm and bright,
Making all the bubbles white.

First we wash our tiny toes,
Then we wash our little nose.
Rub the shampoo in our hair,
Blowing bubbles in the air.

Wash the tummy, wash the knee,
Happy as a honeybee.
Rubber ducky swims along,
Singing out a happy song.

Now the water swirls away,
We are finished for the day.
Wrapped up in a cozy towel,
Happy baby, dry and vowel.

rhymes.title: Bubbles in the Tub
rhymes.text:
Splash and splatter on the floor,
Time to open up the door.
Into water we will leap,
While the little duckies sleep.

Scrub the fingers, scrub the thumb,
Listen to the motor hum.
Wash the shoulders and the chest,
Now it is time for a rest.

Floating boats of red and blue,
Swimming in the water too.
Catch a bubble on your nose,
Tickle all your little toes.

Drain the tub and watch it go,
Say goodbye down in the flow.
Dry us off and hug us tight,
Time to sleep and say goodnight.

rhymes.title: Squeaky Clean
rhymes.text:
Turn the handles left and right,
Fill the tub with water bright.
Drop the bath bomb with a fizz,
Look at all the magic whiz.

Wash the arms and wash the legs,
Smooth and round like chicken eggs.
Scrub behind each little ear,
Splash the water, loud and clear.

Watch the bubbles pop and fly,
Reaching up into the sky.
Time to rinse the soap away,
What a super bath today.

Soft pajamas cozy warm,
Safe and snuggly from the storm.
Give a kiss and close your eyes,
Sweetest dreams of butterfly skies.

rhymes.title: The Splashy Song
rhymes.text:
Jump right in and beat the drum,
Hear the happy water strum.
Big white bubbles piled high,
Reaching up to touch the sky.

Wash the face and wash the chin,
Let the water fun begin.
