Scrub the elbows, scrub the back,
Listen to the bubbles crack.

Floating toys go round and round,
Making not a single sound.
Splash your hands and kick your feet,
This is such a lovely treat.

Pull the plug and watch it drain,
See you at the bath again.
Wrapped inside a fuzzy bear,
Dry and brushing through our hair.

rhymes.title: Duckys Bath Time
rhymes.text:
Bring the ducky and the boat,
Watch the yellow playthings float.
Water feels so nice and good,
Just like little duckies should.

Wash the hair with gentle care,
Floating bubbles everywhere.
Wash the neck and wash the hands,
Traveling to fairy lands.

Kick your legs and make a wave,
Look at you, so strong and brave!
Scrub away the dirt and grime,
It is bubbly magic time.

All done now and feeling fine,
Shining like a little dime.
Snuggle in a blanket nest,
Time to give the body rest.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to wash the day away,
Come and join our tubby play!
Water warm and bubbles high,
Reaching up to touch the sky.

First we wash our little toes,
Then we wash our button nose.
Rub the tummy, scrub the knee,
Happy splashing, full of glee!

Wash the fingers, wash the hands,
Playing in our soapy lands.
Wash the shoulders, wash the back,
Floating is our rubber duck quack!

Now the rinsing cup is here,
Pouring water, crystal clear.
All so clean and feeling sweet,
Time for bed and cozy sleep.

rhymes.title: Bubble Mountain
rhymes.text:
Turn the handles, hear it pour,
Water splashing on the floor.
Pump the soap and squeeze it out,
Hear the happy toddlers shout!

Blow a bubble in the air,
Watch it float without a care.
Make a beard upon your chin,
Let the water games begin!

Scrub the elbows, wash the arms,
Safe away from any harms.
Wash the face and wash the ears,
Bye-bye dirt and bye-bye tears.

 Rinse the bubbles down the drain,
Time to dry and warm again.
Wrap you in a towel so bright,
Ready for a starry night.

rhymes.title: Splashy Toes
rhymes.text:
Climb into the cozy tub,
Time for splashing, time to scrub.
Float the boat and ring the bell,
Everything is going well.

Washing hair with fruity soap,
Floating up just like a rope.
Close your eyes and count to three,
Wash the shampoo off with glee!

Splash the water with your feet,
Oh, the bath is such a treat!
Wash the knees and wash the thighs,
Water sparkling like the skies.

Pull the plug and watch it spin,
Wash is over, let's begin
 Drying off from top to toe,
Ready now for bed we go.

rhymes.title: Squeaky Clean
rhymes.text:
Socks are off and shirt is too,
Here is what we're going to do.
Step right in the water deep,
Where the little duckies sleep.

Rub a dub dub in the tub,
Give your little arm a rub.
Make a crown upon your head,
Soon it is a time for bed.

Wash the fingers, wash the thumb,
Hear the happy water strum.
Wash the ankles, wash the feet,
Smelling oh so very sweet.

Splash the water, say good-bye,
To the bubbles floating high.
Wrapped up snug and feeling dry,
Give the happy stars a sigh.

rhymes.title: The Tubby Train
rhymes.text:
Choo choo train is chugging in,
Let the evening bath begin.
Fill the tub with water blue,
Just the place for me and you.

Scrub the fingers, scrub the toes,
Wipe away the tickly nose.
Wash the neck and wash the chin,
Let the soapy fun begin!

Squeeze the sponge and let it drip,
Watch the yellow duckie ship.
Wash the cheeks and wash the hair,
Bubbles floating everywhere.

Drain the water, pop the plug,
Give a giant towel hug.
Clean and cozy, warm and bright,
Time to sleep and say good-night.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to splash and time to play,
Washing all the dirt away!
Fill the tub up to the brim,
Bring a little yellow swim.

Rub-a-dub upon my toes,
Wash a tickly button nose.
Scrub the fingers, scrub the knees,
Splashing water if you please!

Bubbles floating in the air,
Wash the tummy, wash the hair.
Watch the purple bubbles pop,
Right upon the very top.

Now the water swirls around,
Not a speck of dirt is found.
Wrap me in a towel so bright,
Clean and cozy for the night.

rhymes.title: Rubber Ducky's Song
rhymes.text:
Rubber ducky, squeak and quack,
Jump right on my happy back!
Water's warm and water's nice,
Wash me up and wash me twice.

Fingers wiggle in the foam,
Make the bathtub like a home.
Take the washcloth, make it sweet,
Scrub from head down to my feet.

Wash the arms and wash the legs,
Floating just like Easter eggs.
Watch the suds go up so high,
Reaching all the way to sky.

Time to drain the water down,
Put away the shiny crown.
Dry me off and give a hug,
Safe inside the cozy rug.

rhymes.title: Bubble Mountain
rhymes.text:
Pumping soap into the hand,
Building up a bubble land.
Blow a bubble in the air,
Put a crown upon my hair!

Splish and splash and kick the feet,
Bath time makes the evening sweet.
Wash the elbows, wash the face,
Spin around in one sweet place.

Catch a bubble, let it pop,
Never ever want to stop.
Wash the shoulders and the back,
Hear the little rubber quack.

Water spinning down the drain,
Time to dry off once again.
Fresh and clean from head to toe,
Ready now for bed to go.

rhymes.title: Twinkle Toes Tub Time
rhymes.text:
Step right up and climb inside,
Take a little water ride.
Soap is ready, water's deep,
Wash the eyes that want to sleep.

Scrub the fingers, scrub the toes,
Wipe the little soapy nose.
Make a beard of bubbles white,
Shining in the bathroom light.

Splash the water, hear it sound,
Watch the droplets bounce around.
Wash the tummy, nice and wide,
With my ducky by my side.

All done splashing, pull the plug,
Wrap me in a giant hug.
Pajamas on and tucked in tight,
Sleeping softly through the night.

rhymes.title: Squeaky Clean Parade
rhymes.text:
Marching to the bathroom door,
Dropping towels on the floor.
Turn the handles, make it warm,
Safe from any sleepy storm.

Sponge is ready for the fun,
Washing underneath the sun.
Scrub the knee and scrub the heel,
See how happy that can feel!

Blowing bubbles in a row,
Watch them tumble down and go.
Wash the hair and rinse it out,
Give a happy little shout.

Pull the plug and watch it spin,
Let the bedtime peace begin.
Snuggle close and softly say,
Time to dream until the day.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to splash and time to play,
Wash away the dusty day.
Fill the tub up to the brim,
Bring a little yellow duck to swim.

Water warm and water sweet,
Wash the fingers, wash the feet.
Scrub the tummy, scrub the toes,
Watch the soapy bubbles go!

Round and round the washcloth goes,
Washing ears and little nose.
Now you shine just like a star,
Best bath ever, yes you are!

Drain the water down the drain,
Time to dry and play again.
Wrap you in a towel so grand,
Cleanest baby in the land.

rhymes.title: Bubbles in the Air
rhymes.text:
Turn the handle, hear it pour,
Water splashing on the floor.
Pour the bubbles, nice and white,
Make the bathroom feel so bright.

Jump right in and shout hooray,
Splish and splash the dirt away.
Catch a bubble on your nose,
Tickle all your tiny toes.

Wash your hair with baby soap,
Blow a bubble up and hope!
Watch it float up to the sky,
Wave a happy bubble bye.

All done playing, time to dry,
Lift your arms up, way up high.
Cozy pajamas, soft and sweet,
Ready for a slumber treat.

rhymes.title: Little Duck in the Tub
rhymes.text:
Quack, quack, says the yellow duck,
In the water we will truck.
Bring your boat and bring your cup,
Fill the gentle water up.

Scrub the elbows, wash the knees,
Listen to the blowing breeze.
Soap the back and wash the hair,
Floating bubbles everywhere.

Sing a little bathtime song,
Everybody sing along.
Splash the water, make a wave,
Look at you, so big and brave!

Pull the plug and watch it spin,
Where did all the water go? Within!
Dry you off and give a squeeze,
Time for bed now, if you please.

rhymes.title: Soapy Suds and Snuggles
rhymes.text:
Bath time, bath time, come along,
Let us sing a happy song.
Suds are popping, one, two, three,
Splashing for my toddler and me.

Wash the fingers, wash the face,
Make the bathroom such a happy place.
Rinse the shampoo, oh so neat,
From your head down to your feet.

Look into the mirror now,
Make a funny monkey bow!
All refreshed and smelling sweet,
From your head down to your feet.

Snuggle in a towel so warm,
Safe and cozy from the storm.
Goodnight bubbles, time to rest,
Little baby, you're the best.

rhymes.title: Splashy Splashy Day
rhymes.text:
The water's warm, the water's deep,
While the sleepy kittens sleep.
Drop the bath bomb in the tub,
Time to give a gentle rub.

Make a crown of bubbles high,
Reaching all the way to the sky.
Wash the knees and wash the chin,
Let the bathtime fun begin!

Splash the water left and right,
Making everything so bright.
Now the washing all is done,
Wasn't bathtime lots of fun?

Out you hop onto the mat,
Soft and furry like a cat.
Pajama time is coming near,
Sleep tight, my little dear.

rhymes.title: The Happy Tub
rhymes.text:
Time to splash and time to play,
Washing all the dirt away.
Fill the tub up to the brim,
Bring a shiny rubber ducky in!

Splish and splash and feel so fine,
Scrubbing toes that start to shine.
Wash the tummy, wash the knee,
Happy bubbles, one, two, three!

Wash the fingers, wash the toes,
Wipe the water off your nose.
Time to rinse and time to pour,
Water dripping on the floor.

Wrap you in a towel so warm,
Safe and cozy from the storm.
Now you smell like sweet bouquet,
Ready for a brand new day!

rhymes.title: Bubbles in the Air
rhymes.text:
Look at bubbles in the air,
Floating gently everywhere.
Pop them high and pop them low,
Watch the soapy water glow.

Step right in and take a seat,
Wiggle every tiny feet.
Squeeze the sponge and let it drip,
Hold onto your yellow ship.

Wash the arms and wash the face,
In this happy soapy place.
Close your eyes and count to ten,
Splashing in the tub again!

Rinse the soap right down the drain,
No more dirt and no more stain.
Big clean hug and off we go,
To our cozy bed below.

rhymes.title: The Song of the Sponge
rhymes.text:
Grab the sponge and squeeze it tight,
Watch the water sparkle bright.
Time to wash the day away,
In the tub we love to play.

Wash the shoulders, wash the back,
Floating on a rubber quack.
Suds are climbing to your crown,
Making funny hats of brown!

Splash the water left and right,
Everything is clean and bright.
Now the water swirls around,
Making a gurgling washing sound.

Out you jump onto the mat,
Soft and fluffy just like cat.
Dry your hands and dry your head,
Time to snuggle in your bed.

rhymes.title: Ducky's Bath Time
rhymes.text:
Ducky swims in water blue,
Waiting in the tub for you.
Climb on in and shout hooray,
Bath time is the best today!

Rub the soap until it's grand,
Spreading bubbles on your hand.
Make a beard upon your chin,
Let the tickly bath begin!

Wash the elbows, wash the ears,
Chasing off the little fears.
Rinse it off with water clear,
Splashing droplets far and near.

Cozy towel big and wide,
Wrap you up and hug inside.
Now you shine like morning dew,
We are very proud of you!

rhymes.title: Splish-Splash Symphony
rhymes.text:
Sing a song of soapy suds,
Dropping off your dirty duds.
Water warm and water sweet,
Time to wash from head to feet.

Tap your fingers on the top,
Watch the water bounce and pop.
Scrub the knees and scrub the toes,
Tickle on your button nose.

Pour the cup from up above,
Bath time is a time of love.
Swirl the water round and round,
Making not a single sound.

Towel wrap and snuggle tight,
Kiss you softly for the night.
Clean and happy, off to sleep,
Counting little jumping sheep.

stories.title: Teddy's Sleepy Little Bed
stories.text: The sun is hiding behind the big green hills, and the sky is turning a pretty color of sleepy purple. It is almost bedtime for Leo, but wait! What about all of Leo's friends? The room is a little bit messy. Blocks are standing tall, cars are parked on the rug, and Teddy Bear is sitting right in the middle of the floor all by himself. Leo walks over and gently picks up his soft brown bear. 'It is time for sleep, Teddy,' Leo whispers with a big, sweet smile. Where do the toys sleep? They sleep in their own special places so they can rest up for a brand new day of fun! Leo carries Teddy over to the cozy toy box. The toy box is like a big, warm hug for all the toys. Leo tucks Teddy inside right next to his bouncy rubber ball and his favorite spotted puppy. 'Good night, ball. Good night, puppy. Good night, Teddy,' Leo says softly. Then, Leo helps put the shiny red car back into its special parking spot on the bottom shelf. The blocks go back into their round yellow bucket, clickety-clack, one by one. Everything looks so neat and tidy. Leo feels so proud of his wonderful helping hands. Cleaning up is like putting all the toys to bed so they can dream happy little dreams. Now the room is quiet and peaceful. Teddy Bear is resting comfortably, the cars are resting, and the blocks are resting too. Leo gives the toy box one last gentle pat. 'Sleep tight, toys. I will see you in the morning sunshine!' Leo turns off the bright overhead light and leaves on the soft glow of the little star nightlight. Leo walks to his own bed with a happy heart, ready for sweet dreams. You did such a wonderful job helping your toys find their cozy beds, little one. Putting things away makes everyone feel calm and ready for sleep. Tomorrow, the toys will be so excited to wake up and play all over again. Good night, sweet toys, and good night to you too.

stories.title: The Pajama Train to Toy Town
stories.text: Choo-choo! All aboard the Pajama Train! The moon is shining bright like a silver button in the deep blue sky. Mia has brushed her teeth and put on her softest star-patterned pajamas. But before Mia climbs into her own warm bed, she looks around the living room. Oh look! The train tracks are still out, and the little wooden engine is resting on the sofa. Where do the toys sleep when the stars come out? They sleep in Toy Town, right on the bottom shelf of the big white bookcase! Mia kneels down on the soft carpet and gently picks up the little wooden engine. 'Time to ride the sleepy train to Toy Town, little engine,' Mia says in her happiest, softest voice. Choo-choo, chug-chug, clickety-clack! Mia makes a soft train sound as she gently guides the engine back to its home on the shelf. Next, Mia spots the three fuzzy kittens. One, two, three! She scoops them up in her gentle hands and tucks them right beside the engine. 'You look so cozy there,' Mia giggles softly. Even the crayons get to go to sleep! Mia places them safely inside their colorful cardboard box and snaps the lid shut. Pop! Good night, crayons. Good night, little engine. Good night, fuzzy kittens. Every single toy has a wonderful, cozy place to rest. Mia stands up and looks at the tidy room. Doesn't it look wonderful? Putting the toys to sleep is such a kind and helpful thing to do. The toys are resting peacefully, ready to dream about the next big adventure. Mia gives the shelf a gentle wave good night. Now, it is time for Mia to ride her own sleepy train straight to dreamland. She climbs into her comfy bed and pulls up her favorite blanket. You are such a caring helper, just like Mia. Good night to the toys, good night to the room, and sweet dreams to you.

stories.title: Starry Night Lullaby for Toys
stories.text: The wind is whispering softly outside the window, singing a quiet lullaby to the trees. The day is all done, and the stars are twinkling like tiny diamonds in the dark sky. Lucas is ready for sleep, but he remembers something very important. What about his playful animal friends? Dinosaurs, elephants, and monkeys are scattered all across the bedroom floor! Where do the toys sleep when the moon is out? They sleep in the big canvas basket, right in the corner where it is warm and safe. Lucas walks over very quietly so he does not wake up the house. He picks up the big green dinosaur first. 'Time for bed, Mr. Dinosaur,' Lucas whispers, giving him a gentle pat on his bumpy back. Into the soft canvas basket goes the dinosaur, right on top of a fluffy blanket. Next comes the little blue elephant with floppy ears. Up he goes, and plop! He joins the dinosaur for a cozy night of rest. The cheeky little monkey swings through the air one last time before Lucas catches him with a happy giggle. 'Shh, little monkey, it is sleepy time now,' Lucas says. The monkey curls up right next to the elephant. Lucas looks around to make sure no toy is left behind. Ah, the puzzle pieces! Lucas gathers them up and slides them neatly back into their wooden puzzle board. Every piece fits snug and tight. The room is so quiet, and everything is in its proper place. Lucas feels so good inside knowing his toys are tucked in tight. Putting your toys to sleep is a wonderful way to show them you care. The toys whisper a silent thank you to their kind friend Lucas. Now the basket is full of sleepy, happy toys resting until tomorrow's sunshine. Lucas climbs into his own cozy bed, snuggles with his favorite blanket, and closes his eyes. You are so wonderful at helping things rest. Sweet dreams to the toys, and sweet dreams to you, little friend.

stories.title: The Big Red Train's Cozy Garage
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, painting the sky in lovely pink and orange colors. Little Leo had been playing all day long with his favorite Big Red Train. They chugged through the living room mountains and zoomed across the kitchen floor tracks. Choo-choo! But now, the room was getting a little bit quiet, and Leo felt a gentle yawn coming on. Big Red Train sat still on the rug, looking shiny and bright. Mommy smiled and asked, 'Leo, do you know where the toys sleep when the stars come out?' Leo shook his head, his sleepy eyes wide. Mommy gently picked up Big Red Train and said, 'Just like little boys need their warm beds, trains need a cozy garage to rest their wheels after a big day of chugging.' Together, Leo and Mommy walked over to the toy shelf. It was neat, tidy, and waiting just for them. Leo gently placed Big Red Train right inside the soft cubby. 'Goodnight, Big Red Train,' Leo whispered softly. 'Thank you for playing with me today.' The train looked so happy resting in its special spot. Then, Leo helped tuck in the little green wagon right next to it, and the bouncy blue ball found its snug basket home. Every single toy was safe, cozy, and tucked away for a wonderful night's sleep. Leo felt so proud of helping his friends get ready for bed. Mommy gave Leo a warm hug and a sweet kiss on his forehead. 'You did such a wonderful job tidying up, my big helper,' she praised him gently. Hand in hand, Leo and Mommy walked down the hallway to their own cozy beds. Leo snuggled under his favorite blanket, feeling so happy and relaxed. He knew that tomorrow, the sun would rise, and the toys would be rested and ready for a brand new day of fun adventures. Until then, the toys were sleeping peacefully in their very own snuggly home, dreaming sweet little toy dreams.

stories.title: Teddy Bear's Slumber Tree
stories.text: The living room was full of soft shadows as evening time arrived. Maya had spent the whole afternoon playing wonderful games with Barnaby, her fluffy brown teddy bear. They had a lovely tea party with pretend cookies and built tall towers out of wooden blocks. But now, the lamps were turned down low, and Maya was feeling wonderfully sleepy. Barnaby the bear was sitting right on the fluffy rug, looking a little bit tired too. Maya's daddy walked over with a big smile and a gentle voice. 'Maya, playtime is all finished for today,' Daddy said softly. 'Do you know where teddy bears go to sleep so they can have sweet dreams?' Maya thought for a moment and hugged her favorite bear close. 'Where do they sleep, Daddy?' she asked. Daddy pointed to the big armchair in the corner. 'That is Barnaby's cozy slumber tree,' Daddy explained with a wink. 'All the tired bears cuddle up together there to rest their fuzzy paws.' Maya beamed with joy. She carried Barnaby across the rug and helped him climb up onto the big, plush chair cushion. She sat him right in the middle, where it was soft and warm. Then, Maya gathered up the wooden blocks and placed them gently back into their wooden box, one by one, giving each block a little pat. She scooped up her plastic ducks and put them safely in their tub. 'Time for all my toys to go to sleep,' Maya said happily. She tucked a tiny washcloth over Barnaby like a blanket. 'Sleep tight, Barnaby. Sleep tight, little blocks,' Maya whispered, her voice full of love. Daddy hugged her tightly. 'You are such a caring and helpful girl, Maya. You took such good care of all your toys.' Maya felt so warm and proud inside. She washed her hands, brushed her teeth, and hopped right into her own bed. As she closed her eyes, she smiled, knowing her dear teddy bear and all her friends were resting happily in the dark, waiting for morning.

stories.title: The Starry Toy Box Lullaby
stories.text: The moon was peeking softly through the bedroom window, silver and bright. Toby had been zooming his toy rockets all around the rug, flying them high into the clouds. Zoom! Zap! Up, up, up they went! But now, a big, cozy yawn popped right out of Toby's mouth. The rockets were resting on the floor, their shiny plastic wings glowing in the moonlight. Mommy walked in with a gentle smile and a quiet voice. 'It is time for the stars to come out, Toby, and that means it is time for the toys to go to sleep,' Mommy said softly. Toby looked down at his rockets and his stack of colorful rings. 'Where do they sleep, Mommy?' Toby asked, rubbing his sleepy eyes. Mommy pointed to the big wooden toy box painted with sparkly yellow stars. 'That is their sleepy spaceship,' Mommy explained in a magical whisper. 'They love to cuddle up inside and rest their engines until morning.' Toby thought that sounded wonderful. He picked up the biggest red rocket and gave it a gentle kiss. 'Goodnight, Rocket,' he whispered, placing it carefully inside the starry box. Then, he gathered the yellow rings, sliding them together on their post, and tucked them safely beside the rocket. One by one, the bouncy balls and plastic dinosaurs hopped into the big box too, ready for a nice, long rest. The toy box lid closed softly, keeping everyone safe and snug. Toby clapped his hands softly. 'All done!' he cheered in a quiet voice. Mommy wrapped her arms around Toby and gave him a big, loving squeeze. 'You are such a wonderful star helper, Toby. Putting your toys to bed is such a kind and grown-up thing to do.' Toby beamed with pride. He climbed into his own comfy bed, pulling his quilt up to his chin. With a happy sigh, Toby closed his eyes, listening to the quiet night, knowing his toys were sleeping soundly in their starry box, just like he was sleeping in his.

stories.title: Teddy's Cozy Bedtime Hug
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, painting the sky in pretty pink and orange colors. Little Leo knew it was almost time for his own cozy bed. But wait! What about his very best friend, Barnaby Bear? Barnaby was sitting right in the middle of the playroom floor, looking ready for a big sleep. Leo picked up his fluffy bear and gave him a gentle cuddle. 'Where do the toys sleep, Barnaby?' Leo whispered softly. Barnaby did not answer, but Leo knew the answer in his heart. Toys need a cozy place to rest just like little boys and girls do! Leo carried Barnaby down the hallway to his special toy bed. It was a lovely cardboard box lined with the softest, fluffiest blue blanket you ever did see. Leo tucked Barnaby in gently, right up to his fuzzy chin. 'Goodnight, Barnaby Bear,' Leo whispered, giving his furry friend one last little pat on the head. Then, Leo went to his own big-boy bed and snuggled under his covers. As Leo closed his eyes, he felt so happy knowing that Barnaby was safe, warm, and sleeping soundly in his own little bed. Putting toys to sleep was such a wonderful job, and Leo was a wonderful helper. Every toy had a home, and every toy was resting peacefully. Leo smiled in the dark as he drifted off to dreamland, knowing he had done a great job taking care of his favorite things. Goodnight, toys! Goodnight, Leo! Tomorrow would bring a whole new day of fun games, but for now, it was time for sweet, quiet dreams.

stories.title: The Train's Sleepy Station
stories.text: Choo-choo! All aboard for dreamland! Maya loved her shiny red toy train. It could chug all around the living room rug, making the happiest sounds. But now, the living room was getting quiet, and the stars were peeking out of the window. Maya knew that even speedy trains get very tired after a long day of tracks and tunnels. 'It is time for the train to find its sleepy station,' Maya said with a bright, encouraging smile. She gently gathered the engine and the two little passenger cars in her hands. Where do the trains sleep? They sleep in the big wooden toy chest, right next to the colorful wooden blocks! Maya opened the lid of the chest carefully. It was like a big garage made just for toys. She placed the red engine gently on the bottom. Then she lined up the passenger cars right behind it, making sure everyone was comfortable and snug. 'Parked and ready for sleep!' Maya cheered softly. She closed the lid halfway so the train could still breathe fresh night air. Taking care of her toys made Maya feel so proud and grown-up. She washed her hands, brushed her teeth, and hopped into her own warm bed. Her mommy came in to read a lovely story about a flying puppy. Maya listened with heavy, happy eyelids. She knew her red train was resting safely in the toy chest, dreaming of tomorrow's big adventures on the living room rug. Goodnight, little train. Sweet dreams to you!

stories.title: The Basket Full of Dreams
stories.text: The playroom was quiet. The blocks were resting in their bin, and the books were tucked nicely on their low shelf. But wait! What about all the little plastic dinosaurs? They were scattered near the play kitchen, looking ready for a nap. Sam knew just what to do. Sam was a super helper! 'Where do the dinosaurs sleep?' Sam asked himself. Do they sleep under the couch? Oh no, monsters live under there! Do they sleep on the kitchen table? No, tables are for yummy snacks, not for sleeping dinosaurs. Sam walked over and picked up a big, round, yellow basket lined with a soft green towel. This was the magical Dinosaur Sleeping Basket! One by one, Sam picked up the friendly green T-Rex, the long-necked Brachiosaurus, and the little bouncy Triceratops. 'Time for bed, little dinos,' Sam said in a sweet, soothing voice. He placed them gently inside the yellow basket. They all fit together like a big, happy dinosaur family. Sam gently draped another small washcloth over their backs to keep them warm. 'There you go! All tucked in and cozy!' Sam clapped his hands softly so as not to wake them. Helping his toys find their sleepy homes made Sam feel so warm and happy inside. He gave the basket a final loving look, then turned off the playroom light. Now it was Sam's turn to get ready for bed. He brushed his teeth like a big kid and snuggled under his star-patterned blanket. As Sam drifted off to sleep, he knew his dinosaur friends were resting happily in their basket, ready for another fun day tomorrow.

stories.title: The Big Toy Sleepy Time
stories.text: The sun is going down, painted in lovely pink and soft orange. It is time for little Leo to get ready for bed. But wait! What about all of Leo’s favorite friends? The blocks, the cars, and Teddy Bear are still wide awake on the playroom rug. 'Oh, no,' whispers Leo. 'Where do the toys sleep?' Mommy smiles a big, warm smile and gives Leo a gentle hug. 'Every toy has a cozy bed just like you, little one,' she says softly. First, they find the sleepy green toy box. It is soft on the inside, lined with a fluffy blue blanket. Teddy Bear gives a big yawn. 'I am so ready for sweet dreams,' he says. Leo picks up Teddy Bear and tucks him right in the middle. 'Goodnight, Teddy,' Leo whispers, patting his soft brown head. Next come the busy little toy cars. Vroom, vroom! But not right now! The little red car and the yellow truck drive slowly into their special parking garage. 'Shh, cars are resting their wheels,' Leo says. He closes the garage door gently so they can sleep without any loud noises. Then, it is time for the colorful wooden blocks. They love to stack up high during the day, but at night, they want to cuddle together in their low wooden basket. One by one, Leo helps them lie down. Click, clack, snap! All tucked in. Finally, Dolly the doll gets her very own spot on the rocking chair, right under a polka-dot quilt. Leo looks around the room. Every single toy is safe, sound, and sleeping peacefully. Leo feels so proud. He did such a wonderful job helping his friends get ready for bed. Now, it is Leo’s turn to snuggle into his own bed. Mommy turns off the bright lights and turns on the gentle nightlight that glows like a warm star. Leo closes his eyes. He is safe, he is cozy, and all his toys are resting too. Sweet dreams, Leo. Sweet dreams, toys. Tomorrow is a brand new day for more fun adventures together.

stories.title: Starry Night for Stuffy Friends
stories.text: The moon is peeking out from behind a fluffy white cloud, saying hello to the sleepy world. Mia is wearing her favorite star-print pajamas and brushing her teeth. Brush, brush, brush! But wait, Mia hears a little squeak from the floor. It is Bunny! Bunny looks all around the bedroom and asks, 'Mia, where do we sleep when the stars come out?' Mia giggles and claps her hands softly. 'Come on, Bunny! I will show you!' Mia’s bedroom has the coziest places for every single toy. First, they visit the big shelf by the window. That is where Dinosaur lives. Dinosaur is very big and needs a nice long rest after stomping around all day. Mia gently lifts Dinosaur and rests his green tail on the wooden ledge. 'Sleep tight, big friend,' Mia whispers. Next, they look at the bed. But wait, whose bed is that? It is Mia’s bed, of course, but Bunny gets a very special spot right on the big fluffy pillow, right next to Mia’s head. 'You are my best friend, Bunny, so you sleep right here where it is warmest,' Mia says happily. Then, Mia remembers the little finger puppets. They are so tiny! Where do tiny puppets sleep? In a little matchbox bed lined with a tissue. One by one, Mia tucks the tiny elephant, the tiny lion, and the tiny mouse into their tiny bed. They look so cute and cozy. Mia climbs under her own heavy quilt. She feels so happy inside because she took such good care of all her toys. Taking care of friends is a wonderful thing to do. Mia hugs Bunny tightly. The room is quiet and peaceful. The gentle night breeze whispers through the window. Mia yawns a big toddler yawn. Her eyelids feel as heavy as little feather pillows. She closes her eyes and drifts off to sleep, knowing that all her toys are resting happily right beside her in the quiet, starry night.

stories.title: The Toy Train to Dreamland
stories.text: Chugga-chugga, choo-choo! The little toy train is making its very last trip around the bedroom rug. The engineer of the train is Sam, and Sam is getting very, very sleepy. The big living room lights are turned off, and only the soft lamp is glowing. Sam stops the train and looks down at the colorful pile of toys scattered across the floor. 'Time to find your sleepy-beds, little toys!' Sam announces in a sweet, gentle voice. The toy box is waiting with its mouth wide open, looking just like a friendly giant ready for hugs. Sam picks up the bright yellow rubber duck first. 'Quack-quack,' says the duck quietly, ready for bed. Sam places the duck right at the front of the toy box. 'Sleep well, ducky.' Then comes the soft cloth book with pictures of farm animals. Books love to close their pages and rest their covers at night. Sam slides the book carefully onto the bookshelf, right next to the sleepy teddy bear. Next are the building bricks. They come in reds, blues, and greens. Sam scoops them up with both hands—scoop!—and drops them gently into their big canvas bag. Zip! The bag closes tight so the bricks don't roll away in the middle of the night. Sam smiles proudly. Look how clean and cozy the room is! Every toy has a lovely, comfortable home for the night. Now, it is time for Sam to hop into bed, just like the toys. Daddy pulls the striped blanket up to Sam’s chin and gives him a gentle kiss on the forehead. 'You worked so hard cleaning up today, Sam. You are a super star,' Daddy whispers. Sam feels so proud and warm inside. He closes his eyes and listens to the quiet night sounds. All the toys are tucked away safely, and Sam is resting too. Goodnight, little toys. Goodnight, sweet Sam. Sleep tight until the morning sun.

stories.title: The Big Toy Sleepy Mountain
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, painting the sky with pretty pink and orange colors. Little Leo rubbed his eyes. It was almost bedtime! But wait, what about Leo's toys? Teddy Bear was sitting on the rug. Dino was on the chair. Car was resting right in the middle of the hallway. Oh no! They looked very tired, too. Leo’s mommy smiled and asked, 'Leo, do you think our fuzzy friends are ready for bed?' Leo nodded his head. 'Yes, Mommy! Time to tuck them in!' First came Teddy Bear. Teddy loved a cozy spot right at the pillow's edge. Leo picked up Teddy, gave him a big squeeze, and tucked him under a soft blue blanket. 'Goodnight, Teddy,' whispered Leo. Next was Dino. Dino had a long, bumpy green tail, but he promised to be very still all night long. Leo walked Dino over to the big toy basket in the corner. 'Time for bed, Dino. Sleep tight!' Dino rested his head on a pile of plush balls. Finally, it was little Red Car's turn. Red Car drove vroom-vroom all day long, but now its engine needed to rest. Leo gently parked Red Car in the wooden garage shelf. 'Shh, car. Time to recharge your wheels.' Leo felt so proud. He looked around the clean, quiet room. All the toys had their very own cozy beds. They looked so happy and peaceful. Mommy clapped her hands. 'Look at you, Leo! You helped every single toy find their sleepy place. You are such a helpful, caring big kid.' Leo beamed with joy. He knew that taking care of his toys meant they would be ready for fun adventures again tomorrow. With a happy heart, Leo climbed into his own warm bed, ready for a sweet night's sleep. Goodnight, toys. Goodnight, Leo.

stories.title: The Starry Night Toy Train
stories.text: Beep, beep! All aboard the Bedtime Train! Maya loved playing with her toys all afternoon. They built tall towers, flew through the living room clouds, and sang silly songs. But now, the stars were twinkling in the night sky. The moon was shining its soft silver light through the window. It was time for the toys to go to sleep. Maya’s daddy brought out a long, bright yellow toy train. 'Who wants to ride the Sleepy Express?' he asked in a gentle voice. Maya giggled and clapped her hands. 'I do! Let's help the toys get on!' First, Bunny hopped over with her floppy ears. 'Hop on, Bunny!' said Maya, lifting her softly into the very first train car. Bunny curled up with her favorite pink blankie. Next came Robot. Robot beep-booped a little song, but his battery was running low. 'Time to rest your gears, Robot,' Maya said, placing him safely in the middle car. Last came Monkey. Monkey swung from the sofa armrest and landed right in the caboose. 'Climb aboard, Monkey! No more swinging until morning.' The toy train rolled slowly across the rug, making a soft choo-choo sound, until it reached the special parking station right next to Maya's bookshelf. Maya gently took each toy out and tucked them into their cozy sleeping spots. 'Goodnight, Bunny. Goodnight, Robot. Goodnight, Monkey,' Maya whispered softly. Daddy gave Maya a big warm hug. 'You did a wonderful job getting your toys tucked in, Maya. You are so responsible!' Maya smiled proudly. She loved her toys, and keeping them safe and cozy made her feel so happy. Now, it was time for Maya to ride her own dream train into slumber land. Sweet dreams, little train conductor.

stories.title: The Pajama Party Hug
stories.text: The living room was warm and cozy. The lamps were turned down low, and a bedtime storybook was waiting on the shelf. Sam finished building his last block tower and clapped his hands. 'All done!' But his room was full of toys that needed to go to sleep. There was Giraffe with his long, spotted neck, Puppy Dog with his floppy ears, and Duck with his bright orange beak. Sam’s grandma walked over and smiled. 'Sam, do you think our little animal friends are ready for their pajama party in bed?' Sam’s eyes lit up. 'Yes, Grandma! They need hugs!' Sam scooped up Giraffe first. Giraffe was very tall, so Sam had to help him bend his knees just right to fit under the soft quilt. 'There you go, Giraffe. Sweet dreams,' Sam said, smoothing the blankets. Next came Puppy Dog. Puppy loved to cuddle. Sam squeezed Puppy close, whispered a secret goodnight message in his ear, and laid him right beside Giraffe's pillow. They made the best sleeping buddies! Finally, Duck waddled over with Sam's gentle guidance. Duck rested his head on a fluffy yellow cushion. Sam looked around the room. Everything was quiet. Everything was tidy. The toys looked so comfortable in their snuggly spots. Grandma kissed the top of Sam's head. 'You are such a kind helper, Sam. You made sure every toy is warm and safe for the night.' Sam felt a warm, happy glow inside his tummy. Taking care of his friends felt wonderful. Now, it was Sam's turn to get a big hug, slip into his cozy pajamas, and snuggle down into his own bed. Goodnight, Giraffe. Goodnight, Puppy. Goodnight, Duck. Goodnight, Sam.

stories.title: The Sleepy Bear's Bedtime
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, painting the sky in lovely pink and orange colors. Little Leo looked all around his cozy bedroom. His blocks were scattered across the rug, his race cars were parked by the door, and his very favorite stuffed brown bear, Barnaby, was sitting right in the middle of the bed. Leo yawned a big, sleepy yawn. Mama smiled and asked, 'Leo, do you think our toys are feeling sleepy too?' Leo rubbed his eyes and nodded. 'I think Barnaby is very tired, Mama!' Mama gently touched Barnaby's soft, fuzzy ear. 'You know what? Toys love to sleep just like little boys and girls do. When the moon comes out, they need a cozy place to rest so they are ready for fun adventures tomorrow.' Leo loved his teddy bear so much that he wanted him to be super comfy. Together, Leo and Mama picked up the red race car. 'Vroom, vroom, time to park in the big toy box,' whispered Leo, tucking the car gently inside. Next came the shiny blue blocks. One by one, Leo stacked them neatly into their special wooden home. 'Goodnight, blocks!' he said with a happy smile. Finally, it was Barnaby's turn. Leo fluffed up his own soft pillow and laid Barnaby right in the middle. He pulled a little washcloth over the bear like a tiny blanket. 'Sleep tight, Barnaby. See you in the morning!' Mama gave Leo a warm hug and whispered, 'You did such a wonderful job helping your toys find their sleepy spots, Leo. You are a very kind helper.' Leo felt so proud and happy inside. He climbed into his own warm bed, snuggled under his blanket, and closed his eyes. The room was quiet, peaceful, and tidy. Sweet dreams, Leo! Sweet dreams, sleepy toys!

stories.title: Mia and the Starry Toy Box
stories.text: Twinkle, twinkle, little star! Nighttime was arriving in Mia's room, and the little yellow desk lamp cast a warm, friendly glow. Mia was getting ready for bed, wearing her favorite duckie pajamas. But wait! Look at the playroom floor! There was Dolly with her yarn hair, three colorful plastic dinosaurs, and a jigsaw puzzle missing a piece. 'Uh-oh,' said Mia, putting her hands on her hips playfully. 'Are my toys hiding from bedtime?' Papa walked in and chuckled. 'Not hiding, Mia, but they definitely look ready for dreamland. Do you know where toys sleep when the stars come out?' Mia shook her head and looked up at Papa with big, curious eyes. 'They sleep in the magical Starry Toy Box!' Papa whispered. 'It is a safe, cozy place where all the toys close their eyes and dream about rainbows and sliding down giant green hills.' Mia clapped her hands with excitement. 'Let us take them to their bed right now!' First, Mia picked up Dolly. She gave Dolly a gentle hug and whispered, 'Time for bed, Dolly.' She placed Dolly carefully inside the big wooden toy box. Then she scooped up the three dinosaurs. 'Roar... but a very quiet, sleepy roar,' giggled Mia as she tucked them in next to Dolly. The dinosaurs looked so happy resting together. Next, she gathered the puzzle pieces and slid them snugly back into their colorful box. Mia made sure the toy box lid was closed softly. 'Goodnight, toys! Sweet dreams in the Starry Toy Box!' she cheered softly. Papa kissed Mia's forehead and said, 'You are such a responsible superstar, Mia. Your room is so peaceful.' Mia beamed with pride. She hopped into her own bed, pulled up her star-patterned blanket, and smiled as she drifted off to sleep, knowing her toys were resting happily just like her.

stories.title: The Train's Journey to Sleepy Station
stories.text: Choo-choo! All aboard for Bedtime Express! The little wooden train set was still spread all over the playroom carpet. Green tracks curved near the bookshelf, and red train cars were parked haphazardly near the rocking chair. The house was getting very quiet, and the little boy, Toby, gave a long, wiggly stretch. 'Is it time for bed, Daddy?' Toby asked softly. Daddy nodded and smiled. 'It is indeed, Toby. But look at our little train engine. It has been chugging all day long, and now it looks quite tired.' Toby looked down at the shiny blue engine. 'Can we help the train go to sleep?' he asked eagerly. Daddy loved that idea. 'Let us drive the train all the way to its sleepy station in the toy basket!' Toby knelt down on the soft rug. He picked up the blue engine and made a soft, whispered sound. 'Chug, chug, chug... chug, chug, chug...' He gently drove the engine across the carpet until it reached the woven toy basket. 'Phew! We made it to Sleepy Station!' Toby whispered happily. He carefully set the engine down inside. Then, one by one, Toby picked up the red and yellow passenger cars. 'All aboard for dreamland!' he sang out quietly, placing them right behind the engine. He added the curved wooden tracks into a neat stack beside the basket so they wouldn't trip anyone in the dark. 'Goodnight, train. Goodnight, tracks,' Toby whispered, patting the edge of the basket. Daddy wrapped his arm around Toby and gave him a gentle squeeze. 'You took such wonderful care of your toys today, Toby. That was super helpful!' Toby felt warm and cozy all over. He walked proudly to his bedroom, climbed under his soft quilt, and closed his eyes. The toys were resting in their station, and Toby was resting in his bed. Everyone was ready for a wonderful night of sleep.

stories.title: Teddy's Cozy Bedtime
stories.text: The sun is sinking low behind the big green hills, painting the sky with pretty pink and orange brushstrokes. It is almost sleepytime in Leo's cozy bedroom. Leo looks down at the fluffy rug where his toys have been playing all day long. Blocks are piled high like castles, and train tracks wind across the floor. Leo whispers softly, "It is time for bed, my little friends." Teddy Bear yawns a big, wide bear yawn, showing his little felt tongue. Leo picks up Teddy gently and tucks him right into the middle of the big, fluffy pillow. "Goodnight, Teddy. You played so well today," Leo says with a warm smile. Next, Leo finds Dipsy the Dinosaur. Dipsy loves to stomp, but right now, Dipsy is sitting very quietly. Leo gently places Dipsy on the soft blanket right beside Teddy Bear. "You get a nice, cozy rest here, Dipsy," Leo encourages, patting the green dinosaur's head. All the bright red, blue, and yellow blocks need a sleepy home, too. Leo opens the big toy box with a gentle creak. One by one, the blocks slide down into their warm wooden house. "Time for all the blocks to sleep tight," Leo cheers happily, clapping his hands. Finally, the little toy train chugs gently into the corner station. "Choo-choo, time to park for the night," Leo whispers. The room is quiet and peaceful now. Every single toy is tucked in safely, resting up for brand new adventures tomorrow. Leo looks around his tidy room and feels so proud. He gives his toys one last loving wave. Then, Leo climbs into his own snug bed, ready for sweet dreams. You did such a wonderful job helping your toys find sleep today! Putting things in their special spots makes everyone feel so happy and safe.

stories.title: The Great Toy Sleepy Safari
stories.text: Twinkle, twinkle, little stars are beginning to peek out of the evening sky. Mia hears a gentle yawn coming from the rocking chair. Oh look, it is Bunny! Bunny's long floppy ears droop down because she is so sleepy after hopping around the living room all afternoon. Mia scoops Bunny up in a big, gentle hug. "Where do the toys sleep when the moon comes out?" Mia asks with a cheerful giggle. "They sleep in the Toy Treehouse!" Mia walks over to the low wooden cubby shelf that looks just like a little house. It is the best place for toys to rest. Mia places Bunny right on the softest bottom shelf. "Sleep tight, Bunny. You are safe and warm here," Mia whispers, giving her a gentle nose boop. Now it is time for Dolly to rest, too. Dolly's eyes are closing slowly as Mia carries her across the room. Mia lays Dolly down on the plush cushion right next to Bunny. "Time for sweet dreams, Dolly," Mia sings softly. What about the tiny race cars? Zoom, zoom, zoom they went all day, but now their engines are resting. Mia gently rolls each car into the bottom garage compartment. "Parked and cozy!" Mia says with a big, proud grin. Even the bouncy rubber ball gets a soft basket to sleep in so it won't roll away in the dark. Mia looks at the shelves. Every single toy is resting peacefully in its proper home. The room looks so neat and tidy, and the toys look so happy. Mia gives a little happy clap. Cleaning up playtime is such a wonderful adventure! Now, Mia gets to snuggle into her own comfy bed, knowing all her good friends are resting right beside her.

stories.title: Starry Night Lullaby for Toys
stories.text: The lamps in the playroom are glowing with a soft, warm yellow light. The day has been full of building, drawing, and laughing. Now, the clock chimes softly, telling little Noah that it is time for the toys to wind down. Noah looks down at Puppy, who is lying flat on his tummy. "Are you sleepy, Puppy?" Noah asks. Puppy's tail gives one tiny, sleepy wag. Noah knows just what to do. He gently picks up Puppy and carries him over to the big canvas toy bin. The bin is lined with a soft fleece blanket, making it the most comfortable bed in the whole house. Noah tucks Puppy in gently. "Sweet dreams, Puppy. You were the best helper today," Noah says, giving a gentle stroke to Puppy's soft fur. Next come the crayons, marching one by one back into their colorful box. Click, snap, click go the lids, making sure every crayon is tucked in securely. "Sleep well, little colors!" Noah says cheerfully. Then, Noah finds Robot. Robot has flashing lights, but Noah turns the switch to off so Robot can rest his tiny metal gears. Noah places Robot neatly on the bookshelf right next to the storybooks. "You can guard the books tonight, Robot," Noah whispers with a proud nod. The playroom is getting quieter and quieter. All the toys are tucked away in their cozy sleeping spots, resting up for tomorrow's fun. Noah takes a deep breath and looks around the clean, peaceful room. He feels so big and helpful! Helping things find their nighttime home is a wonderful way to end the day. Now, Noah is ready to brush his teeth and crawl under his own covers for a wonderful, restful sleep.

stories.title: The Big Toy Sleepy Mountain
stories.text: The sun is hiding behind the fluffy pink clouds, and the sky is turning a lovely shade of sleepy purple. It is time for little Leo and his very best friends, the toys, to get ready for dreamland. Leo looks around his cozy bedroom. Blocks are scattered like tiny colorful mountains on the rug, and Teddy Bear is sitting right in the middle of the room, looking a little bit tired. 'Come on, my friends,' Leo whispers softly, giving Teddy Bear a warm, gentle hug. 'It is time to find your cozy beds for the night.' First up is big, bouncy Blue Ball. Blue Ball loves to roll and roll all day long, but now his rolling legs are all done. Leo gently guides Blue Ball into his special circular basket. 'Goodnight, Blue Ball. Sweet dreams of rolling in the green grass tomorrow,' Leo says with a big, happy smile. Next, it is time for the shiny red fire truck. Zoom, zoom, went the fire truck all afternoon! But now, the siren is quiet, and the wheels are still. Leo gently parks the fire truck inside the big toy garage. 'Rest well, brave fire truck. You did a wonderful job today,' Leo encourages. Then comes Teddy Bear. Teddy Bear needs a very special tuck-in. Leo lifts Teddy Bear up and places him right in the middle of the fluffy white pillow on the big bed. He pulls a little blue blanket right up to Teddy Bear’s furry chin and gently pats his head. 'Sleep tight, Teddy Bear. You are so loved.' Look at that! Every single toy is tucked in safe and sound. Leo did an amazing job helping his friends get ready for bed. Now, it is Leo’s turn to snuggle into his own warm bed. He takes a deep, cozy breath, closes his big brown eyes, and drifts off to sleep, knowing all his toys are resting happily right beside him. Goodnight, toys. Goodnight, Leo.

stories.title: A Cozy Cove for Every Toy
stories.text: The evening stars are twinkling like tiny diamonds outside the window, and the house is as quiet as a sleeping mouse. Mia rubs her sleepy eyes. It has been a wonderfully busy day of playing, building, and pretending, but now the moonlight is shining gently on the bedroom floor. Mia looks down and sees her dinosaur friend, Steggie, resting on the soft rug. 'Time for bed, Steggie!' Mia says in her sweetest, softest voice. Steggie has a special sleeping spot right inside the green toy box, right next to the picture books. Mia gently picks up Steggie and places him carefully on a soft blanket inside the box. 'Goodnight, Steggie. Rest your spiky tail,' Mia says, giving him a gentle pat of encouragement. Next, Mia spots her favorite doll, Lucy. Lucy’s dress is a little bit crinkled from twirling around in the living room, but she looks so peaceful. Mia carries Lucy over to the little pink doll cradle in the corner. She lays Lucy down, smooths her pretty dress, and tucks a tiny polka-dot quilt all around her. 'Sleep tight, Lucy. You were the best dancing partner today,' Mia whispers. Oh, look over there! A whole family of wooden blocks is still hanging out near the bookshelf. They are all stacked up in a wobbly little tower. Mia carefully takes the blocks down, one by one, and places them neatly inside their canvas storage bag. 'Goodnight, blocks. Time to cuddle up together,' Mia cheers softly. Mia looks around the room. The floor is clean, the toys are resting in their cozy coves, and everything is calm and peaceful. Mia gives her room a proud little nod. What a helpful and caring girl she is! Now, Mommy is opening the door to give Mia a big bedtime hug. Mia climbs into her own warm bed, pulls up her blanket, and smiles as she whispers, 'Goodnight, my sweet toys. See you in the morning sunshine.'

stories.title: The Toy Train to Dreamland
stories.text: Chug-a-lug, chug-a-lug! The little wooden toy train is making its final journey of the day. All aboard the Sleepy Time Express! The living room lights are dimmed, and the moon is smiling kindly down. Toby knows it is time to help all his playful toys find their sleepy-time stations for the night. Toby starts by guiding the wooden train right over to the toy shelf. 'End of the line, little train! Time to park in the station,' Toby says with an encouraging grin. He gently lifts the engine and places it neatly on the wooden shelf, right next to the picture books. 'Rest your wheels, little train. You chugged so far today!' Next, it is time for the fluffy bunny rabbit with the long floppy ears. Bunny has been hopping all around the rug, playing hide-and-seek with Toby. But now, Bunny’s ears are drooping down, and her nose is twitching softly. Toby scoops Bunny up in his arms and carries her over to the toy hammock hanging gently in the corner. He tucks Bunny right into the soft mesh pocket. 'Sweet dreams, Bunny. Time to dream of carrot fields,' Toby whispers gently. Finally, there is the bright yellow rubber duck, who had a wonderful splashy bath time earlier. Toby dries the duck with a soft towel and places him right on the edge of the bathtub shelf. 'Goodnight, ducky. Sleep well!' Toby claps his hands together quietly. Every single toy is tucked into bed, resting peacefully in their favorite spots. Toby’s room looks so neat, tidy, and ready for a quiet night. Toby feels so proud of himself for being such a responsible and kind friend to his toys. Now, it is time for Toby to brush his teeth, put on his star-patterned pajamas, and climb into his own snuggly bed. He hugs his pillow tight, closes his eyes, and drifts off to sleep with a happy heart. Goodnight, toys. Goodnight, Toby.

stories.title: The Big Toy Sleepy Mountain
stories.text: The sun is going down, painted in pretty pink and orange colors outside the bedroom window. The room is quiet, but it is not empty. It is full of friendly little toys! But wait, where do all the toys go to sleep when the little boy and girl go to bed? Let us go on a gentle adventure to find out! First, we look over by the cozy rocking chair. Look! Little Bear is yawning a big, wide yawn. Oh, so sleepy! Bear loves to snuggle right inside the soft velvet basket with a polka-dot blanket. Goodnight, Little Bear. Sleep tight until the morning sun says hello. Next, we tip-toe over to the toy shelf. Vroom, vroom goes the little red truck during the day, but now the engine is resting. The red truck has a special parking garage made of soft blue felt. Drive right in, little truck. Time to rest your wheels and dream of smooth roads. Oh, look down on the warm carpet! The colorful blocks are tired, too. They do not want to tumble down anymore. They want to hold hands and make a flat, cozy bed. One block, two blocks, three blocks, all tucked in a neat little row. You are such a helpful friend for putting your toys in their cozy homes! Tidying up is like giving every single toy a sweet little hug and saying 'see you tomorrow.' The room looks so peaceful now. Every toy has a warm bed. The teddy bear is resting. The truck is parked. The blocks are quiet. Now, it is your turn, my sweet little star. Climb into your big, wonderful bed. Pull your blanket up to your chin. Close your eyes and take a deep, slow breath. The toys are sleeping safely, and you are safe, too. Sweet dreams to the toys, and the biggest, sweetest dreams to you!

stories.title: Starry Night Lullaby for Little Friends
stories.text: Twinkle, twinkle, little stars up in the evening sky! The moon is shining like a giant silver nightlight, whispering a quiet song to the whole world. It is nighttime, and that means playtime is all done. But where do the toys sleep when the moon comes out? Let us peek and see! Over on the fluffy rug, Dinosaur is stretching his long neck and letting out a tiny, sleepy rawr. But this rawr is so quiet, it sounds like a soft sigh. Dinosaur loves to curl up right inside the big green toy box. It is dark and cozy inside, just like a cave for a sleepy dinosaur. Night-night, Dinosaur. Sleep deeply until the morning light. And look over there near the bookshelf! Dolly has her eyes closed tight. She is wearing her favorite striped pajamas. She loves to snuggle on the bottom shelf right next to the picture books. The books keep her warm, like a stack of soft mattresses. You gently pick up Dolly and place her in her spot. What a wonderful job you are doing! You are taking such good care of all your little friends. Now, what about the bouncing rubber ball? Balls love to roll, but at night, they want to stop rolling and just rest. We can put the ball right into the cozy yellow bucket. No more bouncing tonight! The bucket gives the ball a gentle hug. All the toys are tucked in safely now. The room is tidy, clean, and so peaceful. You worked so hard to put everyone to bed. Give yourself a big pat on the back, little one. You are a super star helper! Now it is time for you to snuggle down in your own cozy bed. Close your heavy eyes and let the gentle night wrap around you. The toys are resting, and you are resting. Goodnight, sleep well.

stories.title: The Pajama Party for Playthings
stories.text: Hush, little one, can you hear the night whispering? The day is gently slipping away, and the stars are waking up. It is time for all the toys to find their sleepytime beds. But where do they go? Let us find out together on this quiet evening journey! First, we find the fuzzy puppy dog plushie. His ears are floppy, and his tail is finally still. Where does Puppy sleep? Why, right at the foot of the big toy chest on a plush blue pillow! You gently carry Puppy to his pillow and tuck him in with a tiny tissue blanket. Goodnight, sweet Puppy. May you dream of chasing happy butterflies. Next, we look by the craft table. Oh, look at the crayons! They have been drawing bright yellow suns and green grass all day long. Now, their paper is put away, and they are sliding back into their sturdy little cardboard box home. Click, snap! The box lid closes. Sleep tight, crayons, so you are ready to make more art tomorrow. You are doing such an amazing job cleaning up, piece by piece. Putting toys to bed makes the room feel calm and happy, just like a deep breath of fresh air. Finally, we spot the wooden train engine. Chug-chug, toot-toot is done for today. The train rests on its special wooden tracks right on the floor table, parked at the end of the line. The tracks are tucked in, and the train is fast asleep. Every single toy is tucked into its cozy sleeping place. The room is so neat and ready for sweet dreams. You are growing up so big and responsible, taking such wonderful care of your world. Now, it is your turn to snuggle into your warm, wonderful bed. Let your head sink deep into your soft pillow. Close your eyes and drift away to dreamland. Goodnight, toys. Goodnight, little helper. Sweet dreams.

stories.title: Teddy's Cozy Cloud Bed
stories.text: The sun was starting to say goodnight, casting a soft orange glow through the bedroom window. Little Leo rubbed his eyes. It was almost bedtime! But wait. Leo looked over at the rug. There sat Barnaby Bear, sitting all alone with his fluffy brown ears drooping. "Are you tired, Barnaby?" Leo whispered softly. Barnaby gave a little nod in Leo's imagination. Of course he was tired! Toys play all day long, running, jumping, and riding in toy cars. That is very hard work for a little bear. "It is time for sleep," Leo said with a gentle smile, using his kindest voice. He picked up Barnaby and gave him a big hug. Together, they walked over to the toy box. But the toy box was too dark and lonely. "No, Barnaby needs a cozy bed," Leo decided. He looked at his own toddler bed. It had soft pillows and a warm blanket. But wait, Barnaby had his very own special basket lined with a fluffy yellow blankie right next to Leo’s bed! Leo gently laid Barnaby down on the fluffy blankie. He tucked the corners in, just like Mommy tucked in Leo. "Goodnight, Barnaby Bear," Leo whispered, gently patting the bear's soft tummy. Barnaby looked so peaceful resting there. Next, it was time for the bright red race car. Vroom, vroom! The race car had zoomed across the floor all afternoon. Now, its wheels were still. Leo gently rolled the race car into the bottom shelf of the bookshelf. "Parked for the night," Leo said happily. Finally, Leo spotted his favorite blue bouncing ball hiding under the armchair. "Time for sleep, bouncy ball," Leo sang. He placed the ball gently in the big wicker basket with all the other round balls. Every single toy was safe, cozy, and tucked in tight. Leo felt a wonderful, proud feeling in his tummy. He had taken such good care of his friends! Mommy walked into the room and smiled warmly. "Look at how nicely you put your toys to sleep, Leo! You are such a helpful big kid." Leo beamed with pride. He climbed into his own cozy bed, pulled up his blankets, and closed his eyes. The toys were sleeping, Leo was sleeping, and the whole room was quiet and safe. Goodnight, toys. Goodnight, Leo.

stories.title: The Sleepy Train's Last Stop
stories.text: Choo-choo! All aboard the bedtime train! Mia chugged around the living room rug, making happy train noises. Chug-chug, toot-toot! But soon, the big kitchen clock chimed. Dong, dong! It was time for the toys to wind down and rest their little wheels and paws. Mia stopped her engine and looked down. Her shiny wooden train engine was resting right in the middle of the floor. If someone walked by in the dark, they might stub a toe! More importantly, the little train looked very sleepy. Its headlight flickered off. "Where do the trains sleep when the stars come out?" Mia wondered out loud. She knew just the place. Trains need a nice, safe roundhouse to park in so they can dream about chugging over big green hills. Mia knelt down on the soft rug and picked up the wooden engine in both hands. She walked softly across the room to the low toy shelf. There was a special parking garage made just for vehicles. Mia carefully drove the train into its very own little garage slot. "Parked safely at the station!" Mia whispered with a sweet smile. Next came the fuzzy pink bunny rabbit. The bunny had hopped all over the sofa cushions. Hop, hop, hop! Now, the bunny's long floppy ears were resting against its back. "Time for bed, bunny," Mia said gently. She scooped up the bunny and carried it to the bottom shelf of the bookcase, right next to a pile of soft storybooks. "You can sleep here where it is quiet and warm." One by one, Mia found the other toys. The building blocks went back into their big yellow bucket, snuggling close together like best friends. The crayons went back into their colorful box, ready to draw wonderful pictures tomorrow. Mia worked slowly and carefully, feeling so proud and independent. Daddy popped his head into the doorway and clapped softly. "What a wonderful job tidying up, Mia! You are taking such good care of your toys." Mia gave a happy giggle. She skipped over to her bed and snuggled under her covers. The toys were resting, the room was tidy, and Mia was ready for sweet dreams.

stories.title: Starry Night Lullaby for Toys
stories.text: The moon was shining brightly outside the bedroom window, painting silver patterns on the floor. Noah sat on the edge of his bed, whispering a soft goodnight song to his little stuffed dinosaur, Didi. Didi had a long green tail and soft spikes, and he had helped Noah build a giant block tower today. But now, Didi was yawning a big, wide dinosaur yawn. Rawr-yawn! "Are you ready for sleep, Didi?" Noah asked softly, giving the dinosaur a gentle squeeze. Didi's sleepy eyes seemed to say yes. Noah knew that even brave dinosaurs need a cozy place to rest so they have energy to stomp around again tomorrow. But where do dinosaurs sleep? Not in the cold toy chest! They need something comfortable. Noah looked around his room. He had a special hammock hanging in the corner of his room, made of soft netting just for stuffed animals. Noah stood up, holding Didi safely in his arms. He walked over to the hammock and gently placed Didi inside the soft mesh pocket. Didi nestled right down between a sleepy stuffed puppy and a smiling cloth doll. "Sleep tight, Didi," Noah whispered, gently stroking the green felt spikes. Next, Noah looked at the tall tower of wooden blocks they had built together. The blocks were still piled high on the play mat. Noah knew that blocks love to lie down flat in their big canvas bag when the day is done. One by one, Noah picked up the red block, the blue block, and the yellow block. Thump, thump, plop! They all went safely inside the bag. Noah zipped the bag up almost all the way, leaving just a little peek-hole so the blocks wouldn't get scared of the dark. "Goodnight, blocks," Noah said cheerfully. Grandma walked into the room, wrapped in her cozy sweater, and smiled a big, loving smile. "You are such a responsible boy, Noah. Look how peaceful your room looks because you put your toys to sleep." Noah beamed with happiness. It felt so good to help his friends find their cozy beds. He crawled under his own warm blankets, feeling safe and cozy. The toys were resting in their special spots, and Noah was ready to drift off to sleep. Sweet dreams, little toys.

stories.title: Teddy's Cozy Cloud Bed
stories.text: The sun was starting to go down, painting the sky in lovely shades of pink and orange. Little Leo held his favorite fuzzy brown bear, Barnaby, tightly in his arms. It had been a wonderful day of building tall blocks, zooming race cars across the rug, and painting bright blue skies. But now, the room was getting wonderfully quiet, and a big yawn slipped out of Leo’s mouth. 'It is almost time for sleep, Barnaby,' Leo whispered softly. Barnaby gave a silent, friendly nod from Leo’s arms. But wait, where do all the toys sleep when the stars come out? Do they sleep on the cold floor? Oh no, the floor is too hard! Do they sleep in the big kitchen sink? No, toys do not like water splashing on their fuzzy heads. Leo looked around his bright, tidy bedroom and had a brilliant idea. He gently placed Barnaby right in the middle of his fluffy, soft pillow. 'This is your cozy cloud bed, Barnaby,' Leo said with a big, proud smile. Next, Leo tucked the shiny red race car safely inside the toy box garage, right next to the building blocks, where it was warm and dark. The stacking rings cuddled together on the bottom shelf, making a neat little tower. Leo felt so proud of himself for helping all his playtime friends find their sleepy spots. Mommy walked into the room and gave Leo a warm, gentle hug. 'You did such a wonderful job helping your toys go to bed, sweet boy,' she whispered. Leo smiled happily, climbing under his own cozy blankets. He knew his toys were resting peacefully, just like he was. Tomorrow, they would wake up bright and early for another fun day of play together. Goodnight, little race car. Goodnight, building blocks. Goodnight, sweet Barnaby bear. Sleep tight until the morning light.

stories.title: The Toy Train's Station Dreams
stories.text: Chugga-chugga, choo-choo! The little wooden train engine rolled across the soft nursery rug, making happy engine noises. The clock on the wall chimed softly, letting everyone know that evening time had arrived. Maya scooped up the train and gently gave it a little pat. 'Time to park at the station, little train,' she said in her sweetest voice. Maya knew that toys worked very hard all day long. The dinosaur stomped, the dolls danced, and the puzzles stayed very still. Now, it was time for them to rest their little painted eyes. Where do the toys sleep so they have energy for tomorrow? Maya’s eyes sparkled as she looked at the big, blue toy basket sitting quietly in the corner. That was the grand terminal station where all the toys spent the night! Maya walked over, holding the wooden train carefully in both hands. She gently placed the train right next to the colorful plush dinosaur. 'Goodnight, dinosaur. Goodnight, train,' Maya whispered happily. She picked up the shiny plastic blocks and dropped them one by one into the big green box. Clink, clank, plop! Every single block went home to its cozy container. The soft ragdoll was tucked gently onto the rocking chair so she could watch over the room while everyone slept. Maya clapped her hands together, feeling so happy and helpful. Daddy peeked through the doorway and smiled a very proud smile. 'Look at you, taking such wonderful care of your playroom!' Daddy praised softly. Maya felt a warm, glowing feeling inside her tummy. She gave her toys one last loving wave and climbed into her own snug bed. The room was quiet, peaceful, and ready for sweet dreams. Goodnight, toys.

stories.title: Starry Night in the Toy Box
stories.text: The moon was shining brightly outside the bedroom window, sending a soft, silvery glow across the floor. Toby sat on the edge of his bed, holding his bouncy rubber ball. The day had been filled with so much fun and laughter, but now it was time for the quiet, peaceful night. Toby looked down at the playroom rug. Blocks were scattered here and there, and the stuffed bunny was leaning against the bookshelf. Toby knew it was time for the toys to go to sleep. But do toys get sleepy just like little boys and girls do? Yes, they do! They need a good rest so they are ready for new adventures tomorrow. Toby stood up tall and walked over to the friendly blue toy chest. He opened the lid with a gentle squeak. 'Time for bed, my fuzzy friends,' Toby whispered softly. He picked up the floppy-eared bunny and placed it gently on top of the softest blanket inside the chest. The bunny looked wonderfully comfortable in its plush little bed. Next, Toby gathered the shiny yellow star blocks and neatly stacked them in the corner of the box, building a sturdy sleeping tower. The bouncy ball rolled softly into the center, resting between the books. Toby closed the lid halfway so the toys could peek out and see the friendly night stars twinkling in the sky. 'Sleep well, toys,' Toby said with a gentle pat on the wooden lid. Mommy walked over, kissed Toby on the forehead, and tucked his blankets up to his chin. 'You are such a caring and helpful big boy,' Mommy whispered lovingly. Toby closed his heavy eyes, feeling safe and happy in his cozy bed. He knew his toys were resting happily in their own special places, dreaming of the wonderful games they would play when the morning sun woke them all up.

stories.title: Teddy's Sleepy Hug
stories.text: The sun is sinking low behind the big green hills, painting the sky with pretty pink and orange brushstrokes. It is almost bedtime, which means it is time for little Leo and his very best friend, Barnaby Bear, to get ready for sleep. Leo yawns a big, wide yawn. 'Yaaaaawn!' he goes, rubbing his sleepy eyes. Barnaby Bear looks a little sleepy, too. 'Where do the toys sleep, Daddy?' Leo asks softly. Daddy smiles and takes Leo by the hand. 'Let us look around and find cozy beds for all your friends,' Daddy whispers. First, they find Barnaby Bear's special spot. It is right in the middle of Leo's fluffy white pillows. Leo gently lays Barnaby down and tucks a blue polka-dot blanket right up to his fuzzy chin. 'Goodnight, Barnaby,' Leo whispers, patting his soft head. Next, they find Sammy the shiny red firetruck. Sammy has been driving fast all day, zooming across the carpet and putting out pretend fires. 'Where does Sammy sleep?' Leo asks. Daddy points to the low wooden shelf near the door. 'Sammy sleeps in the fire station garage so he is rested for more fun tomorrow.' Leo gently rolls Sammy into his parking spot, making a soft 'beep-beep' sound. Finally, it is time for Twinkle the Star-Ball to rest. Twinkle goes right into the big toy basket with all the other soft balls. 'Time for all my toys to close their eyes and dream sweet dreams,' Leo says with a proud smile. Daddy gives Leo a warm, gentle hug. 'You did a wonderful job tucking your toys in, Leo. Now it is your turn to find your cozy bed.' Leo feels so happy and safe. He climbs under his own warm covers, knowing his toys are resting right nearby. As Leo closes his eyes, he whispers, 'Goodnight, toys. Sweet dreams.' Daddy strokes Leo's hair as he drifts off to sleep, feeling proud of his big helper.

stories.title: The Pajama Train
stories.text: Chugga-chugga, choo-choo! The big yellow toy train is rolling across the playroom floor, carrying a very special cargo of sleepy friends. Mia is the conductor, wearing her star-patterned pajamas and smiling brightly. The room is growing dim as evening arrives, and the stars are starting to twinkle in the night sky. Mia knows what comes next. 'All aboard the pajama train!' she calls out softly. 'Time to take the toys to Sleepy Town!' First stop is the toy box, a big wooden castle where the blocks and action figures live. Mia carefully places the building blocks back into their colorful drawers. 'Time to rest your little wooden heads,' Mia says with gentle encouragement. The blocks stack neatly, ready for tomorrow's tall towers. Next, the train chugs over to the reading corner where Ellie the Elephant plush toy is sitting. 'Where does Ellie sleep?' Mia asks herself. She remembers that Ellie loves to sleep right at the foot of her bed, keeping watch over the room. Mia picks up Ellie with both hands and carries her carefully, placing her softly on the blanket. 'Sleep tight, Ellie,' Mia whispers, giving her trunk a gentle squeeze. Finally, the little wind-up duck needs a bed. Mia tucks the duck safely on the bookshelf right next to her favorite bedtime stories. 'Quack-quack, goodnight,' Mia giggles quietly. Mommy walks into the room and looks at the tidy playroom and the sleeping toys. She claps her hands gently. 'Look at how wonderfully you put your toys to bed, Mia! You are growing up so much and taking such good care of your things.' Mia beams with pride. She feels warm and cozy inside. Now that all her toys are tucked into their resting places, Mia climbs into her own cozy bed. She hugs her soft pillow and closes her eyes, ready for a wonderful night of peaceful sleeping.

stories.title: Starry Night Lullaby
stories.text: The moon is glowing like a bright silver coin in the deep blue evening sky. Inside the warm nursery, little Noah is finishing his bedtime story with Mommy. The room is quiet and peaceful. Noah looks down at the colorful carpet where his dinosaur toys are scattered about. 'Mommy, the dinosaurs look tired,' Noah observes, resting his chin on his hands. 'They played so hard today.' Mommy nods gently. 'Yes, Noah. Even mighty dinosaurs need to rest so they are strong and ready for new adventures tomorrow. Do you know where they like to sleep?' Noah shakes his head, his curls bouncing. 'Where do they sleep?' Mommy smiles. 'Let us find their sleepy cave.' Noah gets down on his hands and knees, being very quiet so he does not wake anyone. He gently scoops up Greeny, the soft green brontosaurus. 'Your cave is the bottom shelf of the bookcase, Greeny,' Noah whispers. He lays Greeny down on a soft piece of green felt that looks just like grass. 'Sweet dreams.' Next, Noah finds Rexy, the plastic T-Rex. Rexy gets to sleep right next to Greeny, keeping him company in the quiet dark. Noah lines them up side by side, making sure they are comfy. 'Goodnight, dinosaurs,' Noah says, patting their backs. Then, Noah gathers his colorful crayons and slides them back into their sturdy box, clicking the lid tightly shut. 'Time for colors to sleep, too,' Noah says happily. Mommy wraps her arms around Noah in a big, loving embrace. 'You are such a caring and helpful boy, Noah. You made sure all your toys have a cozy place to sleep.' Noah feels very proud and happy. He washes his hands, brushes his teeth, and climbs into his snuggly bed. He looks out the window at the twinkling stars and whispers a gentle goodnight to the moon, to his room, and to all his resting toys. With a contented sigh, Noah closes his eyes and drifts off to sleep.

stories.title: The Big Red Wagon Bed
stories.text: The sun is going down, and the sky is painted in pretty pink and orange colors. It is almost bedtime! Mia looks around her cozy bedroom. Blocks are scattered on the fluffy blue rug, and Teddy Bear is sitting right in the middle of the doorway. Oh, no! Teddy Bear looks so sleepy, but he does not have a bed yet. "Time to tuck everyone in!" says Mommy with a warm, gentle smile. Mia runs over to pick up her favorite fluffy brown teddy. She gives him a big, squeezy hug. "Where do the toys sleep, Mommy?" Mia asks softly. Mommy points to the big red toy wagon near the bookshelf. "Look, Mia! The wagon has soft wheels and deep sides. It is the coziest sleeping car for tired toys tonight." Mia claps her hands with joy. She gently places Teddy Bear inside the wagon. Then, she finds the softest yellow blankie and drapes it right over his furry shoulders. "Sleep tight, Teddy," Mia whispers. Next comes the blue bouncy ball. Balls do not like to roll away when it is nighttime, so Mia tucks it safely in the corner of the wagon next to Teddy. "Goodnight, bouncy ball," she says. All the wooden building blocks want to rest, too. One by one, Mia stacks them neatly like sleepy little soldiers right beside the teddy bear. They are all together and very snug. Mia looks inside the big red wagon. Every single toy is resting quietly, ready for sweet dreams. Mia feels so proud of herself for helping her playthings find a wonderful place to sleep. Mommy gives Mia a loving kiss on her forehead. "You did such a wonderful job tidying up, my sweet helper," Mommy praises. Mia smiles proudly in the dim room. Now that her friends are all tucked in nice and cozy, Mia feels ready to climb into her own warm bed. She crawls under her patchwork quilt, closes her eyes, and drifts off to sleep, knowing her toys are resting happily just like her.

stories.title: The Toy Train Journey
stories.text: Chugga-chugga, choo-choo! The shiny silver toy train is making its very last trip around the living room rug. Leo holds the engine in his hands and makes a happy chugging sound. "All aboard for Slumber Town!" Leo announces. The living room lights are dimmed, and the evening stars are beginning to twinkle outside the window. It is time for all the toys to find their nighttime beds so they can dream big dreams. Leo looks down at the tracks. Plastic dinosaurs, race cars, and action figures are still playing on the floor. "Where do the toys sleep?" Leo wonders out loud. Daddy sits down on the carpet next to Leo and points to the big toy chest with the smiling moon painted on the lid. "Look, Leo. The toy chest is a magical sleeping station. When the day is done, the toys love to rest inside where it is warm and safe." Leo nods his head. That sounds like a wonderful adventure! First, the green plastic dinosaur stomps his feet. "Time for bed, Mr. T-Rex," Leo says gently. He helps the dinosaur hop right inside the toy chest. Next come the speedy race cars. Vroom! They drive right into the bottom drawer, parking side-by-side like good little cars ready for a nap. Leo gently closes the drawer so they will not be disturbed. Then, the cuddly plush puppy dog needs a place to rest. Leo picks up the puppy and cuddles it close to his cheek. "You were such a good playmate today," Leo whispers. He places the puppy right on top of a soft cushion inside the chest. The toy chest lid closes softly with a gentle click. All the toys are snuggled safely inside, resting up for tomorrow's big adventures. Daddy gives Leo a big, encouraging hug. "You are so responsible for taking such good care of your toys, Leo," Daddy says proudly. Leo beams with happiness. He feels so wonderful inside.
