Daddy helped Sammy line up all his toy trains along the wooden floorboards next to the bed so they could sleep close by. When evening arrived, the house grew quiet and cozy. Sammy brushed his teeth, put on his striped conductor pajamas, and gave big hugs and kisses to everyone. Then, it was time to board the train. Sammy climbed into the mattress, which felt like a comfy sleeping car rolling down the tracks. 'All aboard!' whispered Mommy, turning off the bright overhead light and leaving on a gentle nightlight that glowed like a station lamp. Sammy lay down on his pillow, which had a picture of a conductor’s hat on it. He pulled his green blanket up to his chin. The bed didn't have high sides, which made Sammy feel so free and tall. He could look right out across his bedroom at his toy box and his books. He felt like a true big boy, capable and brave. As the house settled into night, Sammy imagined the gentle rocking of a train moving down the tracks, carrying him off to sleep. He smiled in the dark, feeling safe and loved in his wonderful big boy bed.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket
stories.text: Leo has a little white crib with bouncy sides. But today, something wonderful is happening. Leo is growing up tall like a sunflower! Mommy and Daddy have a big surprise in his room. It is a big kid bed! It looks just like a fluffy white cloud waiting for a sleepy little boy. Leo's eyes go wide, and he gives a happy clap. 'Is this my big kid bed?' he asks. 'Yes, Leo!' says Daddy. 'It is all yours for sweet dreams.' Together, they pick out Leo’s very best friends to live on the bed. There is Barnaby Bear with his soft brown ears and a shiny blue dinosaur who loves bedtime stories. Leo gently places Barnaby right in the middle of the fluffy pillows. Then, Leo crawls onto the mattress. Ooh, it feels so squishy and wonderful! He stretches his legs out wide. 'Look, I have so much room!' he giggles. Mommy tucks a cozy quilt right under his chin. It feels like a warm hug from the sun. 'Time for starlight sleep, my sweet rocket ship,' Mommy whispers, kissing his forehead. Leo closes his eyes. He feels safe, cozy, and oh-so-proud. He is sleeping in his big kid bed all through the night. When morning comes, the sun peeks through the window and tickles Leo’s nose. He sits right up and smiles a big, bright morning smile. 'I did it!' shouts Leo happily. 'I slept in my big kid bed!' Mommy and Daddy come in with cheering claps and morning tickles. What a wonderful way to start a brand new day of big kid adventures.

stories.title: Mia's Starry Ship
stories.text: Mia loves her shiny star pajamas. They have pink sleeves and little yellow stars that twinkle when she dances. Tonight, Mia is wearing her star pajamas for a very special adventure. She gets to sleep in her brand-new big kid bed! It has a wooden headboard carved with the shape of a friendly moon. Mia walks over and touches the smooth wood. 'Hello, moon,' she whispers politely. Daddy helps Mia fluff her favorite pink pillow, and Mia lays her head down. It is like resting on a marshmallow! 'Are you ready to sail to Dreamland, Captain Mia?' asks Daddy with a silly pirate grin. 'Aye-aye, Captain Daddy!' giggles Mia, pulling her star blanket up high. The room is quiet and calm, filled with the soft glow of her nightlight. Mia listens to the gentle tick-tock of the clock on the wall. She feels brave and strong. She is a big girl now, sleeping all by herself in her very own big kid bed. Sometimes, big kids might feel a tiny wiggle of worry, but Mia just hugs her soft bunny tight and breathes in deep. Up, up, up goes her tummy; down, down, down it goes. She is safe and warm. The moon outside shines a gentle light through the glass, watching over her. Mia closes her heavy eyes and drifts off on her starry ship. Morning arrives with chirping birds outside. Mia opens her eyes and stretches her arms up to the ceiling. 'Good morning, big kid bed!' she says cheerfully. She hops right out of bed all by herself, ready for breakfast and playtime. She is growing up so fast, and she loves her cozy bed.

stories.title: Oliver's Cozy Train
stories.text: Choo-choo! All aboard the Sleepy Time Express! Tonight, Oliver’s bedroom is the train station, and his brand-new big kid bed is the finest sleeping car on the track. Oliver loves trains that go chug-a-lug down the railway lines. Mommy helps him line up his stuffed animal passengers along the edge of the mattress. There is Elephant in the front seat, Giraffe in the middle, and Monkey right at the back. 'Make sure everyone has their tickets ready!' says Oliver seriously. Mommy laughs and gives him a gentle snuggle. 'Tickets checked, little conductor. Now it is time for the train to rest.' Oliver climbs under the striped duvet. The bed is wide and comfy, giving him plenty of space to roll around like a happy puppy. There are no bars on the sides anymore, just open space and cozy dreams. Oliver feels very proud. He is a big boy, and big boys sleep in big kid beds. He holds his favorite blankie close to his cheek. The room is peaceful, smelling faintly of lavender and bedtime bubbles. Oliver listens to the quiet sounds of the house. He takes a long, slow breath in, and lets it out with a soft sigh. The Sleepy Time Express begins its slow journey into dreamland, chugging along quietly through the night. When the morning sun shines bright yellow on the wall, Oliver's eyes pop open. He sits up and gives a mighty toot-toot sound. 'I stayed in my big kid bed all night long!' he announces proudly. Mommy and Daddy walk in with big high-fives and morning hugs. Oliver beams with joy, ready for another wonderful day of being a big kid.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket
stories.text:
Leo had a little yellow bed with bouncy springs. For a long, long time, he slept in his cozy crib with tall wooden rails. But today was a very special day. Leo was growing up so fast! Mommy and Daddy smiled big smiles and said, 'Leo, you are ready for a big-kid bed!' 

Leo clapped his hands. 'Yay! A big-kid bed!' 

Together, they packed up the crib and unpacked big shiny boxes. The new bed looked like a giant fluffy cloud waiting just for him. Leo helped put on his favorite rocket-ship bedsheets. Zoom! Went the rocket ships across the starry blue fabric. 

'This is your captain’s station,' Daddy said gently, tucking Leo in. 'Time for liftoff into dreamland.' 

Leo snuggled down. It felt so roomy and nice. He didn't even need the rails anymore because he was a big, careful boy. He could stretch his legs all the way out and wiggle his toes. 

'Goodnight, rocket ship,' whispered Leo. Mommy kissed his forehead. Daddy gave him a warm hug. 'We are so proud of you, Leo. Sleeping in your big-kid bed is wonderful.' 

Leo closed his eyes. He felt safe, cozy, and so very proud. As he drifted off to sleep, he imagined flying his rocket past the moon. Sleeping in a big-kid bed was the best adventure ever. Goodnight, brave little astronaut. Sweet dreams!

stories.title: Mia's Magical Sleepy Train
stories.text:
Choo-choo! All aboard the Sleepy Train! Little Mia loved trains. Today, her big girl bed arrived, and it was shaped just like a bright red caboose. 

'Look, Mia!' said Grandma. 'Your very own big-kid train bed! No more baby crib. You are a big girl now.' 

Mia touched the shiny red wood. 'Choo-choo!' she cheered. 

Bedtime came soon after. Mia brushed her teeth, put on her softest pajamas with polka dots, and picked out her favorite teddy bear, Barnaby. Grandma led her into the bedroom. The big-kid bed looked so inviting with its patchwork quilt full of bright colors. 

'Hop on board, engineer Mia,' whispered Grandma, gently lifting her into the cozy covers. 

Mia snuggled Barnaby close. She felt so independent. In the big-kid bed, she could easily roll over and hug her pillow. She didn't have to call for help to see out; she could just peek over the edge. 

'Time to start the engine for dreamland,' Grandma said, turning on the soft star-projector light. Swirls of purple and yellow stars danced on the ceiling. 

'Goodnight, train bed,' Mia murmured with a happy yawn. Grandma kissed her cheek and whispered, 'Sleep tight, my sweet engineer. You did a wonderful job in your big-kid bed tonight.' 

Mia smiled as the sleepy train chugged softly into the night. She was growing up, and her big-kid bed was the coziest place in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Sammy's Starry Canopy
stories.text:
Sammy had a big secret. He was a brave forest explorer! Every day he explored the living room rug and climbed the couch mountains. But tonight, Sammy was going to explore something brand new: his big-kid bed with a magical star canopy. 

'Are you ready for your big-kid bed, Sammy?' asked Papa, carrying in a stack of fluffy pillows. 

'Yes! Explorers are always ready!' Sammy said proudly. 

His old crib was gone, and in its place stood a gorgeous wooden bed draped with glowing fairy lights. It looked like a magical forest fort. Sammy helped arrange his stuffed animals—Fox, Owl, and Bear—in a circle around the pillows. 

When it was time for sleep, Papa tucked Sammy in under a quilt that felt as light as a feather. 'You are growing up so strong, Sammy. This big-kid bed is just right for an explorer like you.' 

Sammy looked up at the twinkling fairy lights. They looked just like real stars shining down through the trees. He felt so cozy and grown-up. He could stretch his arms wide, wide, wide without touching any bars. 

'Goodnight, Fox. Goodnight, Owl,' Sammy whispered. Papa turned off the main lamp, leaving the soft starry glow. 

'Sweet dreams, my little explorer,' Papa said, giving him a gentle kiss. Sammy closed his eyes with a happy sigh. His big-kid bed was warm, safe, and ready for all the sweet dreams the night could bring.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket
stories.text:
Leo was growing up so fast! Today was a very special day. His small crib was moving away, and a brand new big kid bed was taking its place. It looked just like a fluffy white cloud waiting for him in his bedroom.

"Look, Leo!" said Mommy, smoothing the bright blue blanket with little yellow stars. "This is your very own big kid bed. You are big enough and strong enough to sleep here all night long like a big boy."

Leo climbed up. Oh, it was so soft! He bounced gently, giggling as the mattress gave a friendly bounce back. His favorite stuffed bear, Barnaby, sat right in the middle, ready for an adventure.

"Are we a rocket ship, Mommy?" Leo asked with wide, shining eyes.

"We sure are," Mommy smiled. "And when the sleepy stars come out, this rocket will take you to dreamland."

When bedtime arrived, Leo brushed his teeth and put on his cozy dinosaur pajamas. He walked into his room, feeling very brave. He climbed into his big kid bed and tucked Barnaby under his arm. Mommy turned on the soft glowing nightlight that painted gentle green dinosaurs on the ceiling.

"Time for liftoff, little astronaut," whispered Daddy, giving Leo a warm hug and a kiss on his forehead. 

Leo snuggled down deep into the fluffy pillow. He watched the glowing dinosaurs dance softly above him. The bed felt safe, cozy, and wonderfully roomy. He could stretch out his legs all the way to the bottom without touching the sides. It felt amazing to have so much space.

Leo took a big, deep breath, smelling the clean lavender sheets. He felt so proud of himself for sleeping in his big boy bed. With a happy little sigh, his heavy eyelids closed, and his rocket ship drifted softly off to sleep.

stories.title: Maya's Starry Ship
stories.text:
Maya had a shiny new bed. It was low to the floor, painted the color of a sunny morning, and covered in a quilt made of pink and purple patches. It was her very first big kid bed!

"Can I test it out?" Maya asked excitedly, clapping her small hands together.

"Of course you can, sweetheart," Daddy said, sitting beside her on the soft edge. "This is your special sleeping space. When you wake up in the morning, you can get right out and find your slippers all by yourself."

Maya loved that idea. She practiced sitting up and swinging her legs over the side. Her toes touched the fuzzy pink rug on the floor right away. "Ta-da!" she cheered, feeling wonderfully independent.

As evening turned the sky outside a deep, sleepy blue, it was time for bed. Maya put on her favorite bunny pajamas. She brushed her curly hair and picked out her three softest lovies: Luna the bunny, Pip the puppy, and Dot the duck. She arranged them in a neat row right next to her pillow.

Mommy tucked the quilt snugly around Maya's tummy. "You are growing up into such a wonderful, independent girl," Mommy whispered lovingly. 

"My bed is like a cozy boat," Maya whispered back, hugging Luna tight. 

"It is a very safe boat," Daddy agreed, kissing her cheek. "And we are right down the hall if you need us."

Maya felt a warm bubble of pride in her chest. She wasn't a baby in a crib anymore; she was a big kid with her very own ship sailing on the sea of dreams. She watched the shadows play softly on the wall as the house grew quiet. Maya closed her eyes, feeling safe, loved, and exceptionally cozy in her big kid bed.

stories.title: Sammy's Sleepy Train
stories.text:
All aboard the sleepy train! Sammy was the conductor of the brand new wooden bed that Daddy built just for him. It was shaped like a friendly red locomotive, complete with a painted yellow headlight at the front.

"Chugga-chugga, choo-choo!" Sammy whispered, steering an imaginary wheel as Mommy walked into his room holding his favorite striped pajamas.

"Is the sleepy train ready to depart for Dreamville?" Mommy asked playfully, holding up the warm cotton shirt.

"Yes, Mama!" Sammy shouted with a happy giggle. He quickly hopped into his pajamas, ready for his nightly journey.

Sammy walked over to his red train bed. It was low, sturdy, and smelled like fresh wood and sunshine. He climbed in and arranged his three favorite toy cars along the wooden headboard, pretending they were passengers waiting for a fun ride.

Daddy tucked a soft green blanket all around Sammy. "You are doing such a big-boy job sleeping in your train bed, Sammy. We are so proud of your bravery.

"I am a fast train," Sammy told them proudly. 

"The fastest and bestest train in the whole world," Daddy smiled, turning off the bright overhead light and leaving on the warm hallway lamp that cast a golden glow across the floor.

Sammy lay his head down on the squishy pillow. He listened to the quiet sounds of the house. He loved having his own big kid bed where he could curl up just like a little bear cub. He closed his eyes and imagined the train wheels clicking softly along the tracks: clickety-clack, clickety-clack, off to dreamland.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket
stories.text: Leo has a little white crib with bouncy mesh sides. He slept there every single night when he was a tiny baby. But today, Leo is growing up big and tall! Mom and Dad have a very special surprise in his bedroom. It is a brand new big-kid bed! It looks just like a fluffy white cloud waiting for a sleepy little boy. 'Is this for me?' asks Leo, opening his eyes wide. 'It is all for you,' says Daddy with a warm, happy smile. Together, Leo and Mommy carry his favorite cozy blankets over to the big bed. They lay down his snuggly blue blanket right in the middle. Then, they tuck in Barnaby Bear right beside the pillow. Leo climbs up. He bounces once. He bounces twice. Wheee! It feels so soft and wonderful. 'Time for bedtime stories,' says Mommy softly. They read three books about zooming rockets and sleepy moonbeams. Leo yawns a big, wide toddler yawn. His eyelids feel heavy like cozy velvet curtains. 'Goodnight, big-kid bed,' whispers Leo, snuggling deep down into his blankets. Mommy and Daddy kiss his forehead and turn on the gentle yellow star nightlight. Leo feels so safe, so proud, and so happy in his very own big-kid bed. He closes his eyes and dreams he is floating gently through the sleepy starry sky. Goodnight, brave little Leo. Sleep tight until the bright morning sun.

stories.title: Maya and the Starry Quilt
stories.text: Once upon a time, a little girl named Maya had a wonderful, exciting day. She picked out a magnificent new big-kid bed all by herself! It is made of shiny wood that smells like fresh pine trees. Maya’s big-kid bed doesn’t have high bars like a baby crib. It is wide and open, ready for big adventures. 'You are a big girl now, Maya,' says Grandma, helping to fluff the pillows. Maya beams with pride. She arranges her whole family of stuffed animals along the edge. Bunny sits on the left. Puppy sits on the right. Dino hangs out right in the middle to keep guard. When the sun goes down and paints the sky in shades of purple and pink, it is time for sleep. Maya puts on her star-patterned pajamas and brushes her shiny teeth. She walks into her room and climbs into her big-kid bed. The mattress gives a little squish, and her special handmade quilt wraps around her like a warm hug. It is so easy to stretch her legs out long. She doesn't feel squished at all! Maya feels like a sleeping princess in a cozy castle. 'Sweet dreams, my sweet girl,' whispers Mommy, kissing her cheek. Maya hugs her blanket tightly and smiles in the dark. Her big-kid bed is the best place in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Sam’s Superhero Rest
stories.text: Sam is a super-duper superhero! Every superhero needs a mighty headquarters for resting up after saving the day. Today, Sam is moving from his baby crib to his brand new superhero big-kid bed! The bed frame is painted the color of the deep blue ocean, and the headboard looks like a castle shield. 'Ready for launch, Captain Sam?' asks Dad, holding up Sam’s favorite red superhero cape. 'Ready!' shouts Sam proudly. Sam helps carry his glowing dinosaur nightlight over to the shiny wooden nightstand. He places his trusty green dragon plushie right where he can reach it. Bedtime arrives like a gentle breeze. Sam puts on his cape over his pajamas and zooms into his room. He climbs into his big-kid bed with a happy giggle. The mattress is supportive and comfy, just right for resting superhero bones. Dad sits on the edge of the bed and reads a story about a brave little train. Sam listens closely, feeling cozy and warm. When the story ends, Sam pulls the striped superhero blanket up to his chin. 'You did such a wonderful job today, Sam. You are growing up so fast,' says Dad proudly. Sam smiles a sleepy smile in the dim room. His big-kid bed feels like a safe harbor. He closes his eyes, ready to dream up wonderful new adventures for tomorrow morning.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Leo had a very exciting day. It was time to say goodnight to his little white crib with the bars. Guess what? Today, Leo was big enough for a brand new bed! It was a big-kid bed, wide and soft like a cozy cloud. Mommy and Daddy helped Leo put his favorite star sheets on the mattress. They had shiny yellow stars that twinkled in the dark. Leo carried his sleepy teddy bear, Barnaby, and placed him right in the middle. "Is this my rocket ship to dreamland?" asked Leo, his eyes wide with wonder. "It sure is," said Daddy with a warm smile. Leo climbed under the covers. It felt so roomy! He could stretch his arms all the way out and wiggle his toes without touching any cold bars. He rolled to the left, and he rolled to the right. He was free like a happy little star sailing through the night sky. Mommy read a sweet story about a sleepy owl, and then she gave Leo a big hug and a soft kiss on his forehead. "Goodnight, my big boy," she whispered. Leo felt so safe, so proud, and so cozy in his big-kid bed. He closed his eyes and drifted off to sleep, ready for wonderful adventures in his cloud rocket. The room was quiet and peaceful, and Leo slept all the way through the night like a true champion. When the morning sun peeked through the curtains, Leo sat right up and cheered. He did it! He slept in his big-kid bed all night long, and it felt absolutely wonderful. Mommy and Daddy came in with happy claps and proud hugs, ready to start a brand new day of fun.

stories.title: Maya and the Moonbeam
stories.text: Little Maya loved her little pink toddler bed. It had cute bunny stickers on the footboard. But lately, Maya felt like she was growing taller every single day. Her toes were almost peeking off the edge! "Mommy, I think I am growing as tall as a giraffe," giggled Maya. Mommy smiled and nodded. "I think you are right, sweet girl. It is time for a brand new big-kid bed!" Together, Maya and her parents picked out a gorgeous wooden bed painted the color of the ocean. It was sturdy and beautiful. Maya helped smooth down the purple blanket with fluffy polka dots. She tucked in her favorite bunny rabbit and her sparkly unicorn plushie. When bedtime arrived, Maya brushed her teeth, put on her softest pajamas, and hopped into her new bed. It felt so cool and inviting. A gentle beam of moonlight shone through the window, making the room glow like magic. "Look, bunny, the moon is saying hello to our new bed," Maya whispered softly. Mommy tucked the covers snugly around Maya's shoulders. "You are growing up so fast, Maya, and we are so proud of how brave and sweet you are." Maya felt a warm, happy bubble grow right inside her heart. She hugged her unicorn tightly and breathed in the lavender scent of her room. There were no bars holding her back, just wide open space filled with sweet dreams. Maya closed her eyes and floated off to sleep on a soft wave of moonlight, feeling like the happiest big girl in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Sammy's Starry Ship
stories.text: Sammy had a big milestone today. His old bed was getting a little too snug for all his big boy dreams. Today was the day for his very own big-kid bed! It was shaped like a friendly boat that would sail him across the sea of sleep. Sammy was so excited, but he also felt a tiny flutter in his tummy. Change can be a little bit new, after all. Daddy saw the flutter and gave Sammy a reassuring squeeze. "Don't worry, buddy. This ship is cozy, safe, and built just for brave captains like you." Sammy felt better right away. He grabbed his favorite blue blanket and his stuffed puppy, Buster. He arranged them neatly on the mattress, making sure Buster had the best view of the bedroom door. When the lights went dim and the nightlight cast a warm, friendly glow on the wall, Sammy climbed aboard his starry ship. He pulled the covers up to his chin. The bed felt amazing—so spacious and comfortable. Mommy sat beside him and sang his favorite lullaby about sailing the seven seas of slumber. Sammy closed his eyes and listened to the gentle, loving sound of her voice. He felt strong, capable, and ready for this wonderful new step in his life. He was a real big kid now! With Buster resting safely by his side, Sammy drifted off into a deep, happy sleep, sailing smoothly through the night until the bright morning light greeted his brand new adventure.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket Bed
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Leo had a very special bedtime adventure waiting for him. For a long time, Leo slept in a cozy little crib with high wooden rails. But tonight was a super-duper special night. Tonight, Leo was big enough for a brand-new, wonderful big kid bed! His big kid bed looked just like a fluffy white cloud, tucked right against his bedroom wall. Mom and Dad helped Leo place his very favorite starry pajamas on his body. They were soft like cotton candy and glowed a tiny bit in the dark. Next came Leo’s best friend in the whole wide world: Barnaby Bear. Barnaby Bear was a brown teddy bear with one floppy ear and a very friendly smile. 'Is my bed really a rocket ship to dreamland, Daddy?' Leo asked with wide, curious eyes. 'It sure is, champion,' Daddy whispered, kissing Leo right on his forehead. Leo climbed up the side of the mattress all by himself. Up, up, up! He didn't need any help at all. He wiggled his toes deep under the crisp, blue bedsheets. He fluffed his pillow, which felt like resting his head on a giant marshmallow. 'Goodnight, little astronaut,' Mommy said as she gently clicked off the bright overhead light, leaving the warm glowing star nightlight plugged softly into the wall. Leo snuggled close to Barnaby Bear. He felt so proud. He was not a baby anymore; he was a big kid who slept in a big kid bed all through the starry, quiet night. He closed his eyes and drifted off to sleep, ready to float away on his wonderful cloud rocket, dreaming the sweetest, happiest dreams until the morning sun kissed his window.

stories.title: Mia and the Magic Moonbeam
stories.text: The sun was dipping down behind the green hills, painting the sky in lovely shades of pink and purple. It was time for little Mia to get ready for sleep. Tonight was a monumental night because Mia’s old crib was gone, replaced by a gorgeous wooden big kid bed covered in colorful star stickers. Mia loved her new bed so much. It smelled like fresh lavender and warm sunshine. 'Time to hop into your magic moonbeam bed, Mia!' sang Mommy, holding up Mia’s favorite pink fleece blanket with dancing bunnies on it. Mia brushed her teeth until they sparkled like little diamonds. Then, she put on her fuzzy slippers and tiptoed into her bedroom. Her big kid bed sat right in the center of the room, looking very inviting and cozy. Mia climbed in all by herself, feeling very brave and independent. One foot, then the other foot, and then a big, happy wiggle right into the middle of the mattress. She pulled her bunny blanket all the way up to her chin. Mommy tucked her in snug and sound, giving her a gentle nose-eskimo kiss. 'You are going to sleep so wonderfully in your big kid bed, my sweet girl,' Mommy murmured softly. Mia looked up at the ceiling where glow-in-the-dark planets spun slowly in the gentle breeze from the window. She felt safe, she felt cozy, and most of all, she felt like the biggest girl in the whole wide world. She rolled onto her side, hugged her bunny blanket tightly, and let out a long, peaceful yawn. The big kid bed wrapped around her like a warm hug, keeping her safe until the morning birds began to sing their happy wake-up songs.

stories.title: Oliver's Captain Cozy Bed
stories.text: Ahoy, little sailors! Tonight was a grand evening for Oliver. Oliver had grown so tall and strong that his feet almost touched the ends of his old toddler bed. It was time for a grand voyage to a magnificent big kid bed! Oliver’s new bed was shaped just like a mighty wooden pirate ship, ready to sail across the bedroom rug into the sea of sweet dreams. Oliver put on his striped sailor pajamas and brushed his curly hair. 'Are you ready to be the captain of your very own ship, Oliver?' asked Daddy with a big, proud grin. 'Aye-aye, Captain Daddy!' Oliver cheered, giggling happily. He marched proudly into his bedroom and looked at his wonderful big kid bed. Without any help, Oliver climbed right over the low wooden edge and onto the soft, comfy mattress. He arranged his three favorite stuffed animals—a lion, a monkey, and a penguin—right beside him as his trusty crew. Daddy tucked a bright red quilt over Oliver and his animal crew, tucking the edges in nice and tight. 'Sweet dreams, Captain Oliver. Sleep tight and keep watch over your bedroom,' Daddy whispered, turning on the gentle ocean-wave sound machine that made soft, swooshing noises. Oliver lay back on his pillow, feeling like the bravest captain on the high seas. He felt so cozy in his big kid bed. He closed his eyes, listening to the gentle waves, knowing that morning would bring a whole new day of fun and play. He drifted off to sleep with a happy smile on his face, safely anchored in his wonderful big kid bed.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket
stories.text: Leo was growing up so fast. Today was a very special day because Leo was getting a brand-new big kid bed! His old crib was cozy, but his new bed looked like a giant, fluffy cloud waiting just for him. Mama and Papa brought out his favorite rocket ship sheets, covered in bright stars and glowing planets. Leo helped stretch the corners of the fitted sheet. 'Pop! Pop!' went the corners as they snapped into place. 'Ready for launch, Captain Leo?' asked Papa with a big smile. Leo giggled and clapped his hands. 'Ready!' he cheered. Next, they fluffed his favorite pillows. There was Barnaby Bear, looking very soft and sleepy, and a squishy blue star pillow that Leo loved to hug. Leo climbed in, and oh boy, it felt so wonderful. Without the high bars of the crib, Leo could stretch his arms out wide like airplane wings. He could touch the cool carpet with his toes. It felt wonderfully free. Mama tucked him in gently and whispered, 'This is your very own big kid bed, Leo. It is safe, and it is cozy, and we are so proud of you.' Leo looked up at the ceiling where glow-in-the-dark stars twinkled softly. He gave Barnaby Bear a big squeeze. He felt brave, happy, and so grown-up. Closing his eyes, Leo imagined his bed was a gentle rocket ship, ready to sail him off to sweet dreams. He took a deep, slow breath and let out a happy sigh. Goodnight, stars. Goodnight, rocket bed. Goodnight, brave little Leo. Sleep tight until the morning sun.

stories.title: Mia's Cozy Mountain
stories.text: Mia loved her little pink crib, but lately, her toes were starting to peek right through the wooden slats. 'You are growing into such a big girl,' Grandma said one sunny morning. 'It is time for a big kid bed!' Mia squealed with delight. Together, they went shopping for the most magical quilt in the whole wide world. It had patches of purple velvet, shiny pink silk, and little embroidered flowers that looked just like buttercups. When the big bed arrived, Mia's room felt transformed. It looked like a cozy mountain cabin just for her. Mia arranged her whole family of stuffed animals in a neat little row along the headboard. There was Dolly, pink pig, and Mr. Hoppy the frog. 'You all get to sleep in the big bed with me,' Mia whispered importantly. Bedtime came with a warm bubble bath that smelled like lavender, followed by her favorite bedtime story about a bunny who loved the moon. Then came the big moment. Mia climbed up the little step stool and snuggled under her new patchwork quilt. It was warm, heavy in the best possible way, and wrapped around her like a giant hug. Grandma turned on the little star lamp that projected glowing shapes all over the walls. 'Sweet dreams in your big girl bed, my sweet Mia,' Grandma whispered, kissing her forehead. Mia smiled in the dim, starry light. She didn't need any bars keeping her safe anymore because her big kid bed was a safe, happy island of her very own. She closed her eyes and drifted off to sleep, surrounded by her furry friends and her beautiful flowers.

stories.title: Sam's Nighttime Train
stories.text: Choo-choo! All aboard the Sam Express! Today, Sam's room got the most exciting upgrade ever. His crib was packed away, and in its place stood a sturdy, handsome wooden bed shaped just like a train engine. Sam loved trains more than anything in the whole world. He had train pajamas with shiny buttons and a conductor hat to match. When bedtime rolled around, Mama said, 'All passengers with tickets for Dreamland, please board the train!' Sam put on his conductor hat, puffed out his chest like a proud little engineer, and marched right over to his new bed. The mattress was covered in a checkered sheet that looked just like a train track. Sam climbed aboard, making soft chugging sounds with his lips. 'Choo-choo! Chuff-chuff! Toot-toot!' he whispered happily. Papa tucked a cozy blue blanket right up to Sam's chin, making sure the engine driver was snug and warm. 'You did such a wonderful job transitioning to your big kid bed today, Sam,' Papa praised, giving him a gentle high-five. 'You are growing up to be such a responsible little boy.' Sam beamed with pride. He looked around his room. Without the tall crib rails, he felt like he had so much space to dream big adventures. He placed his favorite wooden train right on the nightstand so it could keep watch while he slept. Sam closed his eyes, listening to the quiet hum of the night, and imagined his bed chugging smoothly down the tracks toward morning. He was safe, he was cozy, and he was the happiest little engineer in the world.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket
stories.text: Leo has a little white crib with bouncy mesh sides. But today, Leo is two and a half! He is growing taller and stronger every single day. Mommy and Daddy have a very special surprise waiting for him in his bedroom. It is a brand new, big-boy bed! It looks just like a soft, fluffy white cloud resting right on the floor. Leo gasps and claps his hands together. 'Is that for me?' he asks with a big, happy smile. 'It sure is, sweet boy,' Mommy says, giving him a gentle hug. 'This is your very own big-kid bed.' First, it is time to get ready for sleep. Leo brushes his sparkly teeth until they shine like little stars. Then, he puts on his cozy blue star pajamas. Daddy helps Leo tuck his favorite green dinosaur toy right in the middle of the big bed. 'Time for liftoff!' whispers Daddy. Leo climbs up onto the mattress. Ooh, it is so soft and squishy! He stretches his arms out wide, pretending he is a brave rocket ship ready to explore the sleepy night sky. 'Five, four, three, two, one, blast off into dreamland,' Daddy sings softly. Leo snuggles down under the warm quilt. He feels so cozy and safe in his wonderful big-kid bed. He closes his eyes and thinks about all the fun adventures waiting for him tomorrow. Daddy strokes his hair and whispers, 'Goodnight, my sweet astronaut. Mommy and Daddy love you so, so much.' Leo drifts off to sleep with a happy grin on his face, dreaming of floating gently on a fluffy white cloud.

stories.title: Mia's Magical Castle
stories.text: Princess Mia has been sleeping in her little crib for a long, long time. But tonight is a very special night. Mia is a big girl now, and big girls get to sleep in a big bed fit for royalty! Her big bed has a lovely wooden headboard shaped like a royal castle. Mommy and Daddy put pink and purple star sheets on the mattress, making it look extra magical. 'Welcome to your castle, Princess Mia,' Daddy says with a playful bow. Mia giggles and does a little twirl in her polka-dot pajamas. Before bedtime, Mia helps gather her loyal kingdom of stuffed animals. Teddy the bear gets the best spot on the left pillow, and bunny sits right by her toes. Mia climbs up the little step into her grand castle bed. The blankets smell like fresh sunshine and lavender. It feels so nice and roomy! She can stretch her legs all the way out without touching the sides. 'Are you comfortable in your royal chambers, Your Highness?' Mommy asks, tucking the blankets snug around Mia's shoulders. 'Yes, Mommy! I love my big castle bed,' Mia whispers happily. She feels very brave and independent. Mommy reads her a lovely story about a flying pony, and then they share a sweet bedtime kiss. 'Goodnight, Princess Mia. Sleep tight,' says Mommy. Mia closes her eyes, feeling like the luckiest girl in the whole wide world, ready to rule her dreams with kindness and joy.

stories.title: Sammy's Train to Dreamland
stories.text: Choo-choo! All aboard the bedtime express! Sammy is three years old today, and he has a brand new twin-size bed that looks just like a shiny red train engine. The headboard is painted like the front of a choo-choo train, complete with a bright yellow headlight. Sammy loves trains more than anything else in the whole wide world. Mommy and Daddy say his new big-kid bed is the best train in the station. Sammy puts on his favorite striped railway pajamas and brushes his teeth with his blue toothbrush. Then, he climbs up into the red train bed. It is so big and comfortable! Sammy has plenty of room for his favorite plush puppy, Rusty. 'Is the conductor ready?' Daddy asks, smiling warmly. 'Yes! I am the conductor!' Sammy cheers softly, hugging his puppy tight. Mommy tucks the striped blanket neatly around Sammy and Rusty. The room is quiet and peaceful, filled with a soft glow from his little moon nightlight. 'Your train is ready to roll down the tracks to Dreamland,' Mommy whispers, kissing his forehead. Sammy lies back on his soft pillow. He listens to the gentle hum of the house and feels so proud to be sleeping in his big-kid bed all by himself. 'Goodnight, little conductor,' Daddy says, turning off the lamp. Sammy closes his eyes and dreams of chugging happily through candy-cane forests and starlight valleys until morning comes.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket
stories.text: Leo has a little white crib with bouncy mesh sides. But today is a very special day! Mommy and Daddy have a huge surprise waiting in Leo’s room. It is a brand new, low-to-the-ground bed, made just for a big boy. Leo claps his hands together and lets out a happy cheer. 'Is this my big kid bed?' he asks. 'Yes, Leo!' Daddy says. 'It is ready for you.' Together, Leo and Mommy gather all of his favorite things to make the bed cozy. They lay down a soft rainbow sheet that feels cool like a gentle breeze. They add a fluffy blanket with happy yellow stars. Last of all comes Barnaby Bear, who needs a very good spot right in the middle. Leo climbs up onto the mattress. It is not too high, and it is wonderfully bouncy! He sits criss-cross applesauce and gives Barnaby a big squeeze. 'Look at me, I am in my big kid bed,' Leo whispers proudly. When nighttime comes, the room gets quiet and sleepy. The little moon shines a warm, friendly glow through the window. Mommy reads a sweet story about a sleepy train, and then it is time for sleep. Leo snuggles down under his star blanket. He feels so safe, so warm, and so grown-up. He closes his eyes and imagines his bed is a shiny cloud rocket, ready to float softly into dreamland. 'Goodnight, big kid bed,' Leo sighs happily. Mommy kisses his forehead and whispers, 'Sweet dreams, my wonderful big boy.' Leo drifts off to sleep with a big smile on his face, knowing he can do big things all by himself.

stories.title: Maya and the Moonlit Castle
stories.text: Once upon a time, there was a clever little girl named Maya who loved to read bedtime stories. Maya had grown so tall that her toes almost peeked out of the bottom of her toddler cot. 'Time for a big kid bed, Maya!' cheered Grandma. Maya squealed with delight. They went shopping for a special big bed that looked just like a cozy castle fit for a brave princess. The wood was painted a pretty pale pink, and it had little wooden towers on the corners. Maya helped fluff the pillows. She placed her sparkly pink unicorn on the left side and her snuggly blanket with glowing butterflies on the right. 'This is my castle,' Maya declared, standing proudly with her hands on her hips. 'And I am the queen of the castle!' Bedtime arrived with the twinkling of the first evening star. Maya brushed her teeth, put on her softest pajamas with little dancing ponies, and hopped into her castle bed. The mattress was like a marshmallow—soft, supportive, and perfectly comfortable. Maya pulled her butterfly blanket all the way up to her chin. The room was peaceful and quiet. A soft nightlight cast a warm, comforting glow on the wall, making shadow puppets of happy little bunnies. Maya smiled as she listened to the gentle hum of the night. She didn't need to call for help; she felt so brave and secure in her own special space. She closed her eyes, ready for magical adventures in her dreams. 'Goodnight, castle,' Maya whispered softly into the dark. Her eyelids grew heavier and heavier until she fell fast asleep, resting like royalty until the bright morning sun woke her up for a brand new day.

stories.title: Sammy's Starry Ship
stories.text: Sammy the little puppy was growing up fast. His tail wagged extra fast today because today was the day he got his very own big kid bed! It was shaped like a friendly wooden boat, painted bright ocean blue with a little steering wheel at the top. Sammy carried his favorite blankie—the one with little green dinosaurs—all the way down the hallway. 'All aboard the Big Kid Ship!' barked Sammy in his cutest play voice. Mommy helped him tuck the green dinosaur blankie neatly across the mattress. Sammy climbed right in and grabbed the wooden steering wheel. 'To dreamland!' he giggled, turning the wheel left and right. The bed felt sturdy, wonderful, and entirely his own. When the sun went down and painted the sky in shades of purple and deep indigo, it was time to sail. Sammy brushed his teeth until they sparkled like little pearls and slipped into his striped pajamas. He hopped into his boat bed and curled up tight. Daddy tucked him in and gave him a big hug. 'You are the best captain in the whole wide world, Sammy,' Daddy whispered. Sammy smiled, holding his dinosaur blankie close to his chest. The bedroom was quiet, save for the soft ticking of the clock. Sammy felt the gentle sway of sleep washing over him. He was a big boy now, safe in his captain's quarters, ready to sail across the sea of sweet dreams. 'Goodnight, boat bed,' Sammy whispered into the cozy night air, drifting off into a peaceful, happy slumber.

stories.title: Leo's Cloud Rocket
stories.text: Leo has a little white crib with bouncy mesh sides. Every night, Mom and Dad tuck him in snug like a cozy burrito. But lately, Leo's toes peek way out of the bottom! 'Look at those growing toes,' Mom giggles. 'It is time for a special adventure. It is time for the Big Kid Bed!' Leo gasps. A big kid bed? That sounds gigantic! Together, they walk into Leo’s room. There it is. It looks just like a giant fluffy cloud resting right on the floor. It has star sheets that glow softly in the dark. 'Can I really sleep here?' Leo whispers, touching the soft pillow. 'Yes, you are a big boy now,' Dad says, giving him a warm hug. First, they put on star-print pajamas. Then, they read three books about zooming rockets. Leo hugs his favorite stuffed bear, Barnaby. He climbs under the cool, crisp covers. It feels so open! He doesn't have sides to bump against. He can stretch his arms way out wide, just like an airplane soaring through the sky. 'Goodnight, star pilot,' Mom whispers, kissing his forehead. Leo closes his eyes. He feels safe, cozy, and so very proud. He stays in his wonderful bed all night long, dreaming of flying high among the shining stars. When morning comes, the sun peeks through the curtains, and Leo jumps up with a happy cheer. 'I slept in my big kid bed all night!' he shouts. Mom and Dad clap their hands and give him big morning cuddles. What a wonderful way to start a brand new day of growing big and strong.

stories.title: Maya's Cozy Bear Cave
stories.text: Maya loves her baby crib, but her little brother is going to use it soon. That means Maya gets a shiny new adventure. 'You get to pick your very own Big Kid Bed!' says Grandma, holding up a colorful catalog. Maya points right away. 'That one! The one that looks like a wooden boat!' The bed arrives in a giant cardboard box. Maya helps Dad tighten the screws with a safe toy wrench. Twist, twist, twist! Then, they pile it high with squishy pillows and her favorite patchwork quilt. 'Your bed is ready, Captain Maya,' Dad announces with a salute. Maya climbs inside. It feels a little different than her old crib. It is wide and open, like a pirate ship ready to sail across the blue living room ocean. Maya brings her whole animal family—Teddy, Bunny, and Fox—to sleep with her. They make a great crew. At bedtime, Mom turns on the sleepy yellow nightlight. Maya snuggles deep beneath her quilt. 'It feels like a cozy cave,' Maya whispers to Teddy. She rolls to the left and rolls to the right. She has so much room to wiggle! In the middle of the night, Maya wakes up. For a second, she feels confused. But then she remembers her big girl bed. She pats her soft quilt, closes her eyes, and drifts right back to dreamland. In the morning, Maya wakes up bright and early. She does not cry or call out. She simply sits up, stretches her arms up high, and says, 'Good morning, world!' Mom and Dad come running in with big smiles. 'Look at our independent big girl!' they cheer, lifting her up for a celebratory tickle. Maya beams with pride.

stories.title: Pip's Superhero Sleep
stories.text: Pip has the coolest pajamas in the whole wide world. They are bright red with a big yellow star right on the chest. Pip is a superhero, and superheroes need a powerful headquarters. Today, Mom and Dad have a big surprise in Pip's room. The old crib is gone! In its place is a shiny, low-to-the-ground superhero bed. 'Every great hero needs a proper landing pad,' Dad says with a wink. Pip’s eyes go wide. He steps closer and touches the soft blue blankets. 'Is this really mine?' he asks. 'All yours,' Mom confirms. Pip climbs in to test it out. He does a little superhero pose, lifting his arms in the air. 'Ta-da!' he says. Bedtime arrives like clockwork. Pip brushes his teeth, puts on his star cape, and listens to a story about a flying puppy. When the lights go down, Pip snuggles under the covers. At first, the room looks a little different from this new bed angle. Pip feels a tiny flutter of worry in his tummy. But then he remembers his superhero training. Superheroes are brave! He squeezes his stuffed dinosaur, Rex, and takes three deep, slow breaths. In and out. In and out. The cozy warmth of the bed wraps around him like a hug. He realizes he can easily hop out of bed in the morning to use the potty all by himself, just like a true big kid. That makes him feel super-duper brave. Pip closes his eyes and sleeps soundly through the night. When the sunbeams tickle his nose the next morning, Pip jumps up ready for action. 'I did it!' he shouts happily. Mom and Dad bring in superhero pancakes with banana smiley faces. Pip eats every bite, feeling prouder than ever.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to say goodbye to the crib today,
It is time to pack the bars away.
You are growing big and very tall,
No more baby gates inside the hall.
Now you get a big kid bed to see,
Soft and cozy as can be!
Climb right up and stretch your toes,
Rest your sleepy eyes and nose.
Blankets warm and pillows bright,
Everything is feeling right.
Cuddle up your teddy bear,
Floating on a pillow-cloud up there.
Sleep until the morning sun,
Resting up for daily fun.
Dreaming sweet and sleeping deep,
Into morning you will leap.

rhymes.title: Big Kid Bed Bounce
rhymes.text:
Look at this bed that's wide and grand,
The finest bed in all the land!
No more walls to hem you in,
Let the cozy times begin.
Sit right down and test the springs,
Imagine all the joyful things.
Pull the covers up so high,
Wave the little crib goodbye.
Roll to left and roll to right,
Everything is shining bright.
Place your head upon the rest,
This new bed is simply best.
Stars are shining in the sky,
Singing out a lullaby.
Close your eyes and drift away,
See you at the break of day.

rhymes.title: Pillow Mountain
rhymes.text:
Climb the pillow mountain tall,
Do not fear, you will not fall.
This is not a baby bed,
Rest your big and sleepy head.
Spread the blankets soft and wide,
With your favorite toys inside.
Tuck your blankie under chin,
Let the happy dreams begin.
Mom and Dad are right next door,
Just across the wooden floor.
Feel the mattress nice and strong,
Where big kids belong all along.
Blink your eyes and count to three,
As happy as a bird so free.
Drift away to dreamland now,
Sleeping peacefully, and how.

rhymes.title: Cozy Cloud
rhymes.text:
Out of the crib and onto the floor,
We do not use that cage no more!
A brand new bed is waiting here,
To chase away the nighttime fear.
It is so big and wide and low,
Just the place for you to go.
Sit upon the mattress top,
Bounce a little, then you stop.
Wrap the quilt around your feet,
Isn't this bed cozy, sweet?
Give a hug and give a kiss,
Nights are full of joy and bliss.
Turn off lights and say good night,
Moon is shining round and bright.
Snuggle down and close your eyes,
Till you wake to morning skies.

rhymes.title: Sleepy Stars
rhymes.text:
Big kid bed is neat and cool,
Just like going off to school.
You are growing strong and brave,
All the praise that you will have.
Climb inside the covers deep,
Time to settle down to sleep.
Rest your arms and rest your legs,
Happy as a bird that sings.
Nighttime stories read aloud,
Making all the family proud.
Blow a kiss up to the stars,
Watching over where you are.
Drift into a peaceful sleep,
Counting little fluffy sheep.
Morning brings a sunny day,
Ready for a brand new play.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to say goodbye to crib,
Time to grow up, yes you did!
Little bars are going away,
For a brand new bed today.

Fluffy pillows, blankets bright,
Waiting here to hold you tight.
Climb right in and wiggle round,
Softest place that can be found.

Crib is for a baby small,
Now you are a big kid, tall!
Stretch your arms out, touch the wall,
Have the greatest sleep of all.

Twinkle stars up in the sky,
Wave the little crib goodbye.
Close your eyes and rest your head,
Happy in your big kid bed.

rhymes.title: Jumping In
rhymes.text:
Jump up high and hop right in,
Let the cozy dreams begin!
Big kid bed is soft and wide,
With a teddy bear beside.

Pull the covers up so high,
Watch the sleepy birds fly by.
Teddy stays right on the sheet,
Warming up your sleepy feet.

No more bars to fence you round,
You are safe and safe and sound.
Roll to left and roll to right,
Sleeping snugly through the night.

Morning light will soon appear,
Bringing up a brand new cheer.
Smile and stretch and lift your head,
Loving your new big kid bed.

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Stretch
rhymes.text:
Look at you so brave and proud,
Sing a little bedtime crowd!
Outgrown crib and time to go,
To a bed that rocks the show.

Stretch your fingers, stretch your toes,
Right up to your button nose.
Climb on up, you fit just right,
Ready for a sleepy night.

Turn the lamp down nice and low,
Watch the shadows dance and glow.
Whisper soft and whisper low,
Time for sleepyheads to grow.

Dreaming of a sunny day,
Where you run and laugh and play.
Rest your eyes upon the spread,
King or queen of big kid bed.

rhymes.title: Cozy Cloud
rhymes.text:
Like a fluffy cotton cloud,
Making all the grown-ups proud.
Big kid bed is waiting here,
Chasing every little fear.

Lay your heavy head right down,
Wear your sleepy slumber crown.
Hold your blanket, squeeze it tight,
Everything is feeling right.

Mommy hugs and daddy kisses,
Filled with all the nighttime wishes.
Slip away to dreamland now,
Sleeping peacefully and how.

Morning comes with birds that sing,
Joy and happiness it will bring.
Greet the day with happy tread,
Rising from your big kid bed.

rhymes.title: Bedtime Train
rhymes.text:
Choo choo train goes chugging slow,
To the land of nod we go.
All aboard the big kid train,
Out the window see the rain.

Station stop is right up there,
By the sleepy rocking chair.
Slide into your mattress space,
Such a happy resting place.

Wheels are stopping, brakes are set,
Best bed that you could get!
Snuggle down and catch some Zs,
Swaying gently in the breeze.

Moon is smiling from above,
Sending you a bunch of love.
Rest your body on the spread,
Safe inside your big kid bed.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to say goodbye to blue,
Little crib, we are through!
You are growing big and tall,
No more baby steps at all.
Look across the cozy room,
Chasing off the nighttime gloom.
Here is waiting just for you,
A big bed of shiny blue.
Climb right up and stretch your toes,
Right up to your button nose.
Pillows soft and blankets bright,
Hold you tight throughout the night.
No more bars to peek right through,
Big kid bed is here for you.
Close your eyes and drift away,
Till the golden morning ray.

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Bounce
rhymes.text:
Jump into your brand new bed,
Rest your sleepy little head.
Cozy sheets are snug and neat,
Tickle all your tiny feet.
Roll to left and roll to right,
Everything is feeling light.
No more rails to fence you in,
Let the sleepy time begin.
Pull the covers to your chin,
Let the happy dreams begin.
Stars are shining in the sky,
Singing out a lullaby.
You are growing every day,
In the nicest, sweetest way.
Snuggle down and do not peep,
Time to fall so fast asleep.

rhymes.title: Climb Aboard
rhymes.text:
Climb aboard the sleepy ship,
Ready for a dreamland trip!
This is not a baby bed,
Rest your proud and sleepy head.
Soft pajamas, warm and bright,
Ready for a peaceful night.
Stretching out both arms and legs,
Just like happy little pegs.
Room to wiggle, room to roll,
Safe and happy is your soul.
Mama loves you, daddy too,
Sweetest dreams are waiting you.
Close your eyes and breathe in deep,
Drifting softly into sleep.
Morning time will come around,
Safe inside your sleeping mound.

rhymes.title: My Very Own Space
rhymes.text:
Look at this amazing space,
With a smiling, happy face!
Big kid bed is wide and grand,
Best place in the sleepy land.
Teddy bear is sitting near,
Whispering a word of cheer.
Blanket warm upon your chest,
Time to take a little rest.
No more climbing out of bars,reaching up to touch the stars.
You can stretch out far and wide,
With your blankie by your side.
Proud of you in every way,
Sleeping through until the day.
Close your eyes and softly sigh,
Watch the sleepy dreams go by.

rhymes.title: The Sleepy Train
rhymes.text:
All aboard the sleepy train,
Rolling down the quiet lane.
Passing by the big kid bed,
Where you rest your sleepy head.
Wheels go click and wheels go clack,
Staying right upon the track.
Pillows fluff and blankets fold,
Keeping out the dark and cold.
You are growing strong and sweet,
From your head down to your feet.
Off to dreamland you will go,
Chugging very soft and slow.
Snug and safe until the dawn,
While the quiet night goes on.
Sleep until the morning gleam,
Have a happy little dream.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to say goodbye to cribs today,
We are growing up and ready to play!
Little bars are going out the door,
We don't need them here anymore.

Big kid bed is soft and wide,
With a special blanket by your side.
Hop right in and stretch your toes,
From your head down to your nose.

Cuddly bears can line up neat,
Resting right beside your feet.
Pull the covers up so high,
Time to wave the day goodbye.

Sleepy eyes begin to close,
Sweetest dreams from head to toes.
You are growing big and strong,
Sleep peacefully all night long.

rhymes.title: Leap into Bed
rhymes.text:
Jump up high and take a look,
Time to read our favorite book.
Then it is time to tuck you in,
Let the cozy dreams begin.

Big kid bed is waiting now,
Take a bow and take a bow.
It is wide and it is grand,
Best place in the sleepy land.

Climb right up and wiggle down,
Frowns are turning upside down.
Pillow soft against your head,
Happy in your big kid bed.

Stars are shining in the sky,
Moon is glowing way up high.
Close your eyes and drift away,
See you in the bright new day.

rhymes.title: Stretchy Toes
rhymes.text:
Tiny babies sleep in cages,
We are turning all the pages!
No more walls to block the view,
Big kid bed is waiting you.

Stretch your arms out very wide,
Roll around from side to side.
There is so much room to play,
At the end of every day.

Pat the pillow, make it neat,
Pull the blanket to your feet.
Close your eyes and start to rest,
Big kid bed is truly best.

Mom and Dad are close at hand,
Sleeping in the quiet land.
Dreaming sweet and dreaming deep,
Time for little ones to sleep.

rhymes.title: The Sleepy Train
rhymes.text:
Chugga chugga goes the train,
Running through the sleepy lane.
Passing by the sleepy head,
Landing in the big kid bed.

Stop the engine, time to rest,
Of all places, this is best.
Soft mattress underneath your back,
Resting on the comfy track.

Night-night pajamas, soft and bright,
Keeping you so warm all night.
Hold your favorite teddy tight,
Everything is feeling right.

Morning time will come around,
With a happy, joyful sound.
Till the sun begins to peek,
Sleepyhead is fast asleep.

rhymes.title: King of the Bed
rhymes.text:
Look at you, so brave and tall,
No more baby crib at all!
Walking proudly to your room,
Chasing off the sleepy gloom.

Climb into your big kid bed,
Pillow underneath your head.
Feel the blankets warm and grand,
Finest bed in all the land.

Sing a little lullaby,
While the stars are in the sky.
Close your eyes and breathe in deep,
Sliding softly into sleep.

Morning brings a sunny ray,
Ready for another day.
Proud of everything you said,
Sleeping in your big kid bed.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the crib away,
We are growing every day!
Little bars can now depart,
Time for a brand new start.

See the bed, so wide and grand,
Soft pillows like marshmallow land.
Climb right up and stretch your toes,
Feel the breeze tickle your nose.

No more climbing, no more fuss,
This big bed is made for us.
Pull the covers nice and tight,
Saying to the crib, goodnight.

Now you sleep like stars above,
Wrapped in hugs and cozy love.
Rest your head and close your eyes,
Till the morning sun doth rise.

rhymes.title: Jump Into Dreamland
rhymes.text:
Look at this bed, so big and tall,
No baby bars to fence at all!
You can stretch out left and right,
Sleeping comfy through the night.

Bring your teddy, bring your bear,
Climb upon the fluffy chair.
Lay your head upon the sack,
Roll around upon your back.

It is time to settle down,
No more waking up the town.
Snuggle in the blankets deep,
Floating on the waves of sleep.

Big kid status, hip hooray!
Ready for another day.
Close your eyes and drift away,
Sleeping till the break of day.

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Pillow Parade
rhymes.text:
Hop, hop, hop onto the bed,
Softest cushions for your head.
Baby days are left behind,
Now a big-kid place you find.

Tuck the blankets to your chin,
Let the sleepy time begin.
Stars are shining in the sky,
Lullaby, oh lullaby.

Roll to left and roll to right,
Everything is calm and bright.
Room to wiggle, room to stretch,
Sweetest dreams you soon will catch.

Mama loves you, papa too,
Proud of growing up, are you?
Drift away on slumber's sea,
As happy as a bird is free.

rhymes.title: Stretching Out Wide
rhymes.text:
Cribs are for the tiny tots,
Sleeping in their little spots.
Now you have a giant space,
With a smiling happy face.

Spread your arms up to the sky,
Watch the sleepy feelings fly.
Legs can stretch out all the way,
After such a busy day.

Cozy quilt of red and blue,
Keeps the night time air from you.
Teddy bear is by your side,
On this comfy nighttime ride.

Sleep until the morning gleam,
Having quite a happy dream.
Big kid bed is here to stay,
Hip, hooray, and hip, hooray!

rhymes.title: Nighttime Magic
rhymes.text:
Moon is glowing round and bright,
Saying to the world goodnight.
Time to test your brand new bed,
Softly resting down your head.

No high walls to look around,
Just a cozy sleeping ground.
Pull the covers up so high,
Underneath the starry sky.

Breathe in slowly, breathe out deep,
Sliding down the hill of sleep.
You are growing big and strong,
Singing out a sleepy song.

Morning comes with golden light,
After resting through the night.
Big kid bed is best of all,
Standing ready, proud and tall.

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the crib away,
We are growing up today!
Little bars can now depart,
Time to do a big kid part.

Soft and cozy, wide and grand,
Made just right for sitting and.
Look at all this extra space,
Put a smile upon your face.

Lay your sleepy head right down,
No more baby steps or frown.
Pillows fluffy, blankets bright,
We are staying snug all night.

Stars are shining in the sky,
Sing a happy lullaby.
Big kid bed is here at last,
Baby days are in the past.

rhymes.title: Jump In The Bed
rhymes.text:
Climb right up and take a seat,
Wiggle all your sleepy feet.
Teddy bear is waiting too,
Ready for a dream or two.

Now we stretch out very wide,
Rolling safely side to side.
No more walls to hem us in,
Let the slumber party begin.

Pull the covers to your chin,
See the sleepy moon grinnin'.
Close your eyes and count to ten,
Wake up happy here again.

Mom and Dad are close at hand,
Off we go to slumber land.
Big kid bed is warm and sweet,
Now our bedroom is complete.

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Stretch
rhymes.text:
Look at this big shiny bed,
Time to rest your sleepy head.
Outgrown is the baby space,
Time to claim your special place.

Stretch your arms up to the light,
Everything is feeling right.
Climb on top and give a cheer,
Now you are a big kid here.

Blanket tucked around your toes,
Softly blows the bedtime breeze.
Close your eyes and breathe in deep,
Drifting off to cozy sleep.

Morning comes with yellow sun,
Time for waking up and fun.
Proud of you in every way,
Ready for another day.

rhymes.title: Roll and Snuggle
rhymes.text:
Goodbye crib, you were so small,
Now we are so big and tall.
Step right up and take a look,
Reading our favorite book.

In the big bed we will lay,
Resting after lots of play.
Roll around and find your spot,
Whether cold or whether hot.

Pillow soft beneath your ear,
Nothing in the dark to fear.
Snuggle down and cuddle tight,
Sleep until the morning light.

Big kid bed is comfy-cozy,
Cheeks are turning pink and rosy.
Dreaming sweet and sleeping deep,
Promises the night will keep.

rhymes.title: My Very Own Bed
rhymes.text:
Climb up high into the air,
Leave behind the baby chair.
This bed has no metal bars,
We can reach up for the stars.

Spread your fingers, wiggle toes,
Watch how fast a big kid grows.
Lay your back against the springs,
Listen to what dreaming brings.

Quiet house and shadows fall,
Safe and happy through it all.
Wrap the quilt around your chest,
This is where big kids rest.

Morning light will soon appear,
Showing that a brand new year,
Of big kid fun is on the way,
Starting with a brand new day.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to say goodbye to cribs today,
We are packing all the bars away.
You are growing big and strong and tall,
No more sleepy sleeping in a wall.
Now you have a big kid bed to see,
Soft and cozy as can be.
Climb right up and lay your sleepy head,
Snuggled in your brand new toddler bed.
Pillows fluffy, blankets warm and bright,
You will sleep so cozy through the night.
Teddy bear is waiting by your side,
Ready for a cozy bedtime ride.
Close your eyes and breathe the quiet air,
Dreaming happy dreams without a care.
Morning sun will gently wake you soon,
Dancing in your room beneath the moon.

rhymes.title: Hop In Bed
rhymes.text:
Hop right in your big kid bed,
Rest your sleepy, heavy head.
Pull the covers up so snug,
Give your teddy bear a hug.
Cribs are for the babies small,
You are growing proud and tall.
Legs can stretch out far and wide,
With your favorite toys inside.
It is easy getting out and in,
With a happy little grin.
No more climbing over any rails,
Sailing off on dreamland sails.
Stars are shining in the sky,
Singing you a lullaby.
Drifting off to slumber deep,
Time for little ones to sleep.

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Stretch
rhymes.text:
Stretch your arms up to the sky,
Watch the sleepy stars go by.
Time to test your brand new bed,
Where you rest your sleepy head.
It is wide and it is grand,
Best bed in the sleepy land.
Roll to left and roll to right,
Sleeping cozy through the night.
No more baby gates in sight,
Everything is feeling right.
Pull the quilt up to your chin,
Let the bedtime songs begin.
Dreaming of a sunny day,
While you rest and drift away.
Morning brings a happy cheer,
When your big kid bed is here.

rhymes.title: Pillow Mountain
rhymes.text:
Build a mountain of a pillow tall,
In your big kid bed, you will not fall.
Lay your tummy or your back right down,
Sleepy royalty without a crown.
Blankets soft like feathers in the breeze,
Tickle all your little sleepy toes and knees.
Crib is gone and you are brave and bold,
Listening to stories being told.
Snuggle close and listen to the song,
Nighttime hours are peaceful and so long.
Rest your body, let the day go past,
Big kid bed is wonderful at last.
Close your eyes and let the dreaming start,
With a happy and contented heart.
Sleep until the sun begins to gleam,
Wrapped inside a cozy little dream.

rhymes.title: Jump For Joy
rhymes.text:
Jump for joy because today is grand,
You are moving to a big kid land.
Bed is waiting with a friendly smile,
Waiting for you to sleep a while.
Sit upon the edge and try it out,
Cheer a happy little sleepy shout.
Lie right down and wiggle every toe,
Watch the sleepy shadow puppets go.
Mama tucks you in with tender care,
Daddy gives a kiss and whispers there.
Sleepy eyes are getting heavy now,
Time to rest your little baby brow.
Night has fallen, quiet is the street,
Resting up your busy little feet.
Morning light will shine upon your head,
Happy in your big kid toddler bed.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to say goodbye to cribs today,
We are packing all the bars away.
Look at you so tall and bright,
Ready for a big-kid night.

Soft and cozy pillows glow,
Watch the pretty blankie show.
Climb inside and stretch your toes,
Sleepy time is as it goes.

Mommy hugs you tight and near,
Whispering a word of cheer.
Daddy turns the lamp down low,
Off to dreamland now you go.

Safe and comfy in your place,
With a smile upon your face.
Big kid bed is so much fun,
Sleep until the morning sun.

rhymes.title: Jumping In
rhymes.text:
Hop along and count to three,
Bedtime magic for you and me.
Sit right on the mattress edge,
Resting on your cozy ledge.

Swing your little legs around,
Touch them softly to the ground.
Lift your arms and stretch up high,
Reaching for the sleepy sky.

Slide right underneath the sheet,
Tickle all your tiny feet.
Tuck the blankets nice and neat,
Now the sleepy spell is sweet.

Roll to left and roll to right,
Everything is feeling light.
Close your eyes and breathe so deep,
Off you go into your sleep.

rhymes.title: Starry Night
rhymes.text:
See the stars shine up above,
Sending down a sleepy love.
In your big bed shining bright,
You are growing up just right.

No more bars to fence you in,
Let the bedtime fun begin.
Teddy bear is by your side,
Ready for a dreaming ride.

Pull the covers to your chin,
Let the quiet peace sink in.
Hear the wind blow soft and low,
Watch the sleepy shadows grow.

Dream of castles in the air,
Teddy sleeping on the chair.
Rest your head upon the foam,
Sweetest dreams inside your home.

rhymes.title: Morning Glory
rhymes.text:
When the morning sun appears,
Chasing off all sleepy fears,
In your big bed you will wake,
Happy sounds for you to make.

Throw the covers off your toes,
Scratch the tip of little nose.
Stretch your arms out wide and tall,
Happy morning to us all.

Roll right out with giggle glee,
As happy as a bird so free.
Big kid bed is neat and grand,
Best invention in the land.

Now the day is here anew,
Lots of fun for me and you.
Thank you bed for resting tight,
Until coming starry night.

rhymes.title: Pillow Mountain
rhymes.text:
Pillow mountain, soft and high,
Floating like a cloud so shy.
Climb right up and settle down,
No more crying, no more frown.

Blanket river, warm and blue,
Wrapped around and hugging you.
Close your eyes and count the sheep,
Falling softly into sleep.

Big kid bed is all your own,
Like a castle on a throne.
Rest your weary little head,
Snuggled in your toddler bed.

Moonlight dances on the floor,
Snoring softly by the door.
Dreaming till the morning gleam,
Floating down a golden stream.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the crib away,
We are growing up today!
Little bars can now depart,
Time for a big kid start.

Soft and cozy, wide and grand,
Welcome to the big kid land.
No more climbing, safe and free,
Just as happy as can be.

Bring your teddy, bring your bear,
Climb right up and settle there.
Pull the blankets to your chin,
Let the sleepy time begin.

Blink your eyes and rest your head,
In your brand new big kid bed.

rhymes.title: Jumping Up
rhymes.text:
See the mattress big and white,
Waiting for the starry night.
Sit upon the fluffy edge,
Like a happy feathered hedge.

Bounce a little, wiggle round,
Touching softly to the ground.
Now it is time to lie right down,
Best new spot in all the town.

Stretch your arms out, nice and wide,
With your blankie by your side.
Close your eyes and breathe in deep,
Drifting off to happy sleep.

Morning comes with yellow light,
You did such a super sight!

rhymes.title: Pillow Mountain
rhymes.text:
Pillow mountain, soft and high,
Reaching up into the sky.
Lay your sleepy shoulders down,
Wear your nighttime sleeping crown.

Roll to left and roll to right,
Everything is cozy, bright.
Big kid bed is here for you,
All the whole long evening through.

Tuck the covers nice and tight,
Say a happy, sweet goodnight.
Stars are shining up above,
Filled with family peace and love.

Now you rest until the sun,
Says that a new day has begun.

rhymes.title: Rolling Over
rhymes.text:
Roll around and find your space,
Smiles upon your sleepy face.
No more walls to hem you in,
Let the slumber dreams begin.

Stretch your toes and bend your knees,
Catching pillows in the breeze.
Big kid bed is soft as air,
Peaceful comfort everywhere.

Hear the quiet shadows creep,
Singing you to gentle sleep.
Rest your body, calm your mind,
Best adventure you can find.

When the morning starts to gleam,
You will wake up from your dream.

rhymes.title: Nighty Night Big Kid
rhymes.text:
Nighty night, you growing star,
Look how very big you are.
Climbing in your special place,
Joy is written on your face.

Turn the lamp down nice and low,
Watch the sleepy feelings grow.
Big kid bed is waiting here,
Free from any little fear.

Hug your puppy, kiss your toy,
Mom and Dad's most special boy.
Or your special girl so sweet,
From your head down to your feet.

Now the quiet hours are spread,
Resting in your big kid bed.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Crib
rhymes.text:
Time to say goodbye to cribs,
Growing up for girls and sibs.
Little bars can now depart,
Big kid bed is where you start!

Soft and cozy, wide and low,
Watch your happy body grow.
No more climbing, safe and free,
As happy as a bumblebee.

Lay your heavy head right here,
Mama and papa are staying near.
Pull the blankets to your chin,
Let the sleepy dreams begin.

Twinkle stars up in the sky,
Sing a happy lullaby.
Morning comes with sunshine bright,
Sleep so well and sleep tight!

rhymes.title: Jump Into Bed
rhymes.text:
Jump into the big kid bed,
Rest your tired, sleepy head.
Pillow soft and blanket warm,
Safe from every wind and storm.

Teddy bear is tucked in tight,
Ready for the starry night.
Turn around and snuggle down,
Best new bed in all the town!

Daddy gives a goodnight kiss,
Mommy whispers, oh what bliss.
Close your eyes and count to ten,
Dreaming till the morning then.

Nighty-night, sweet little star,
Look how big and brave you are.
Morning brings a brand new day,
Full of sunshine, full of play.

rhymes.title: The Big Stretchy Bed
rhymes.text:
Look how big your bed is now,
Spin around and take a bow!
Plenty room to roll and stretch,
Every toy is yours to fetch.

Spread your arms out wide and high,
Like an airplane in the sky.
Then curl up into a ball,
Comfy, cozy, that is all.

No more fences keeping guard,
Like a happy castle yard.
You are growing big and tall,
Best big kid among us all.

Dreams are waiting in the dark,
Sailing like a shiny ark.
Close your eyes and float away,
Until comes the golden day.

rhymes.title: Pillow Mountain
rhymes.text:
Pillow mountain, soft and white,
Time to sleep throughout the night.
Climb on up and settle down,
No more waking up to frown.

Quilt is painted red and blue,
Just the proper size for you.
Hold your blanket, squeeze it tight,
Everything is feeling right.

Moonlight dances on the wall,
Hear the sleepy owlet call.
Blink your eyes and count the sheep,
Falling fast and deep asleep.

Big kid bed is fun and grand,
Welcome to the slumber land.
Rest your body, calm your mind,
Sweetest dreams that you can find.

rhymes.title: Morning Sunshine
rhymes.text:
Morning sunshine, peekaboo,
Big kid bed is waiting too.
Waking up with happy smiles,
Running down the hallway tiles.

You stayed in your bed all night,
Acting brave and doing right!
Give yourself a mighty cheer,
Clap your hands and shout it clear.

Sleeping in your bed is great,
Never need to stay up late.
Now the day is fresh and new,
Ready for the things you do.

Eat your breakfast, brush your teeth,
Weary bed is underneath.
Waiting for the setting sun,
When the nighttime sleep is done.

stories.title: Sammy's Sneaker Safari
stories.text: Good morning, little explorer Sammy! Today is a very big day because we are going on a backyard safari. But before we can hunt for roly-poly bugs and shiny green leaves, we need our adventure boots. Look down at your feet! There are two cozy sneakers waiting just for you. One sneaker has a blue stripe, and the other sneaker has a red stripe. Can you find them? Great job! Now, putting on shoes can sometimes be a little tricky, like a playful puzzle. Let us solve the puzzle together, step by tiny step. First, grab the blue shoe. Is it for this foot? Let us check. Oh, wiggle your toes inside. Does it feel happy? Yes! Now, let us try the other one. Uh oh, sometimes shoes get a little bit silly and try to go on the wrong feet. If the shoe feels bumpy on the inside of your foot, that is just a little tickle telling us it belongs on the other side! Let us gently switch them. Ah, perfection! Your left foot loves the blue shoe, and your right foot loves the red shoe. Look at those happy toes, all safe and snug inside their colorful homes. You did it all by yourself, Sammy! That takes so much brain power and strong little muscles. You are a true shoe-putting-on champion. Now, let us stand up tall and practice our stomp. Stomp, stomp, stomp! Wow, what a mighty sound. Your sneakers are ready for the backyard jungle, and so are you. Let us go open the door and see what wonderful treasures are waiting outside for our very first safari step today. Yay for shoes!

stories.title: The Magic Shoe Train
stories.text: Choo-choo! All aboard the Morning Magic Train! Are you the conductor today? I think you are! And every great train conductor needs to get dressed before the big journey begins. Today, our journey takes us all the way to the kitchen for breakfast, and then straight to the living room play area. But beep-beep, hold on! Our feet are still barefoot and need to hop into their passenger cars. Let us look at our shoes sitting right by the rug. They look just like little sleeping puppies waiting to wake up. Can you help them wake up? Pick up the yellow shoe. That is a fast passenger car! Let us see which foot wants to ride in the yellow car first. Is it your left foot or your right foot? Let us try it on. If it slides on smooth and easy like butter on warm toast, you have found the right spot! Wow, look at that smooth glide. Now we need the green shoe for the other foot. Uh oh, look! The green shoe is trying to go on the wrong side. Silly green shoe! Let us gently guide it over to its own special parking spot on the other foot. There it goes, click, just like a puzzle piece snapping into place. You are such a super helper! Look down and wiggle your toes. Can you feel how cozy they are? One, two, shoes are on! You worked so hard to get those shoes onto the correct feet, and that makes me so proud of you. Now, let us rev our engines. Vroom, vroom, choo-choo! Let us make our train sound and drive those brand new shoes all the way to the kitchen. Ready, set, chug along!

stories.title: Penny's Dancing Shoes
stories.text: Rise and shine, dancing queen Penny! Today is a day full of music, jumping, and playing. But before we can dance all around the living room like floating autumn leaves, we have to invite our dancing shoes to the party. Let us go find them by the front door. Ah, there they are! Two sparkly pink slip-ons with shiny little bows. Aren't they just beautiful? Now, shoes love to dance, but they can only dance their very best when they are on the correct feet. Let us play the matching game! Pick up one sparkly shoe. Does it go on this foot or that foot? Let us test it out. Slip it on gently. Oh, how lovely! It fits like a glove made of sunshine. Now grab the second sparkly shoe. Let us see if it fits on the other foot. Wait a minute, does it feel a little bit squishy on the wrong side? Our feet are so smart, they can always tell us! Let us help the shoe switch over to the other foot. There we go, nice and comfy, with plenty of room to wiggle those ten wiggly toes. You did such an amazing job figuring out which shoe goes where all by yourself! That is called being a big kid, and you are growing up so fast. Look at those pretty bows smiling back at you. Now that your left shoe and right shoe are tucked safely onto your feet, you are fully prepared for the grand ballet. Let us put on our favorite song, stand up tall on our shiny shoes, and spin, twirl, jump, and bow. Ready, maestro? Let the dancing begin!

stories.title: Sammy's Sneaker Safari
stories.text: Good morning, little explorer! Today is a very big adventure day. We are going to the park, but first, our feet need their special travel helpers. Can you guess what they are? That is right, your shoes! Let us go on a little shoe safari right here in your bedroom. Look under the bed. Look by the toy box. Ahoy! There they are! Two friendly sneakers, waiting patiently for your happy toes. Let us bring them right over to the cozy blue rug. Now, shoes can be a little bit tricky, just like little puzzle pieces, but I know you are a super puzzle solver. Let us look very closely at them. See those curved insides? When your shoes are sitting nicely side by side, they give each other a big, cozy hug! If they are facing away from each other, oh boy, that means they are looking the wrong way and need to turn around. Let us help them turn. Perfect! Now, let us find your left foot. Give your left foot a gentle wiggle. Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle! Your left foot goes right inside the left shoe. Push your toes all the way to the front. Great job! Now, let us find your right foot. Give your right foot a happy wiggle, wiggle, wiggle! Slide it right into the right shoe. Snug as a bug in a rug! Look down at your feet. Your shoes are smiling up at you because they are so happy to be on your feet. You did it all by yourself, step by step. You are a shoe-putting-on champion! Now those sneakers are ready to run, jump, and skip all the way to the swings. Are you ready? Let us go have some outdoor fun!

stories.title: Penny's Puppy Shoes
stories.text: Ring-a-ding-dong! Good morning, sweet sunshine! Time to get dressed and start our wonderful day. The sun is shining, the birds are singing, and guess what? Your feet are wide awake and ready to hop out of bed. But wait, what do our feet need before they touch the cold floor? They need their warm, cozy walking friends! Let us trot over to the shoe rack together, just like little puppies trotting across the grass. Woof, woof! Look at your shoes. One shoe has a bright red star on the inside, and the other shoe has a matching red star. Do you know what those stars mean? They mean those shoes are best friends who always want to stay together. Let us pick them up and put them right on the soft green mat. Sometimes, shoes get a little bit silly and try to run away from each other. But we can help them.
