rhymes.title: The Happy Feet Parade
rhymes.text:
Time to wake up, little feet,
Walking down the sunny street.
Here is one and here is two,
Let us find your favorite shoe!

Look inside and look around,
Put it flat upon the ground.
Slide it on and wiggle toes,
Up the little ankle goes!

Now the left one is so snug,
Like a cozy little bug.
Time to find the other twin,
Push the right foot right on in!

Buckle strap or velcro tight,
Left shoe, right shoe, doing right!
Ready now to skip and play,
Have a happy, joyful day!

rhymes.title: Red Shoe, Blue Shoe
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Let us dress ourselves just right.
First a sock and then a shoe,
Red shoe, yellow shoe, or blue!

Take the left one in your hand,
Put it where it has to land.
Push your heel down to the floor,
We are ready to explore!

Take the right one, neat and sweet,
Put it on the other feet.
Cinch it up so snug and grand,
Best explorers in the land!

Left shoe, right shoe, side by side,
Now we take a little ride.
Jump up high and shout out loud,
Walking proud and feeling proud!

rhymes.title: Wiggle Wiggle Toes
rhymes.text:
Little toes, oh little toes,
Into shoes the footy goes.
Left shoe first, now don't be late,
Put it on and watch it wait.

Heel goes down and toes go high,
Wave a happy wave goodbye.
Now the right shoe comes along,
Singing out a happy song.

Slide it in and pull the tongue,
Eldest shoe is very young.
Velcro press and laces tied,
Look at you with so much pride!

Left foot, right foot, step away,
Ready for a brand new day.
Marching softly round the room,
Chasing off the morning gloom.

rhymes.title: The Magic Shoe Dance
rhymes.text:
Put your left shoe on the floor,
We are walking out the door.
Push your little toes inside,
Take a lovely little ride.

Now the right shoe has a turn,
So much magic here to learn.
Slide it on and buckle fast,
Morning sleepy time has passed.

Left shoe, right shoe, make a pair,
Dancing softly on the stair.
Spin around and tap the floor,
Let us open up the door!

Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Shoes are on to start the day.
Toddler feet are shining bright,
Left shoe, right shoe, fits just right!

rhymes.title: Step by Step We Go
rhymes.text:
Sitting on the cozy rug,
Giving both your shoes a hug.
Left shoe, right shoe, stand and see,
As happy as can ever be.

Pick the left one off the mat,
Give the toe a little pat.
Push it on your sleepy feet,
Oh, the picture is complete!

Pick the right one off the floor,
We are stepping out the door.
Slide it on and pull it tight,
Making sure the fit is right.

Left foot, right foot, off we go,
Walking fast or walking slow.
Cheer aloud and clap your hands,
Best shoe wearer in the lands!

rhymes.title: Happy Little Feet
rhymes.text:
Time to wake the sleepy feet,
Walking down the morning street.
Here is shoe number one,
Put it on and we have fun!

Push your toes way down inside,
Now we go for a fun ride.
Left shoe on and tied up neat,
Looking happy, looking sweet.

Now find shoe number two,
Waiting here to play with you.
Right foot goes inside the space,
Put a big smile on your face!

Both are snug and both are tight,
Left and right are shining bright.
Jump up high and give a cheer,
Best shoes of the whole wide year!

rhymes.title: The Shoe Dance
rhymes.text:
Put your left foot on the floor,
We are ready to explore!
Grab the shoe that goes right here,
Clap your hands and give a cheer.

Slide it on your tiny heel,
Feel how happy that can feel!
Now the other one is near,
Let us give another cheer.

Right foot gets its cozy shoe,
Red and shiny, looking new.
Push it down and wiggle toes,
Watch how fast our toddler goes!

Left and right are on the track,
Now we marching front and back.
Stomp your feet and dance around,
Hear the happy little sound!

rhymes.title: Left and Right Adventure
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Time to dress and start the flight.
First the left shoe comes along,
Singing out a happy song.

Push the heel and push the toe,
Now we are ready, off we go!
Next the right shoe wants to play,
Making sunshine all the day.

Slide it on the other foot,
Right beside the place we put.
Velcro straps go pull and stick,
Doing all our dressing quick.

Left is ready, right is too,
Walking proudly in the zoo.
High fives all around the room,
Shoe time chases every gloom!

rhymes.title: Marching to the Door
rhymes.text:
Hear the clock go tick-tock-tick,
Time to get our sneakers quick!
Left shoe finds its proper place,
Big old smile upon your face.

Push the foot in nice and deep,
While the little kittens sleep.
Right shoe is the very next,
Nothing makes us feel perplexed.

Slide it on and press it down,
Best dressers in all the town!
Now we have a matching pair,
Walking proudly everywhere.

Left is left and right is right,
Stepping out into the light.
Marching softly to the door,
Ready for a walk and more!

rhymes.title: Toes Go Hide and Seek
rhymes.text:
Little toes go hide and seek,
Playing peek-a-boo all week!
Here comes left shoe, soft and grand,
Waiting right inside your hand.

Slip it on and count to three,
Look how happy you can be!
Now the right shoe takes its turn,
So much clever stuff to learn.

Slide it on the other side,
Open up your eyes so wide.
Press the magic velcro strap,
Ready for a playground lap!

Left and right are dressed and fine,
Everything is looking shine.
Give a wiggle, give a shout,
Now we ready to go out!

rhymes.title: Morning March
rhymes.text:
Time to wake up, time to play,
Let us start a brand new day.
Find your shoes upon the floor,
Waiting right beside the door.

Left shoe goes upon this foot,
Watch the pretty tongue stay put.
Right shoe goes upon that foot,
With a shiny button hook.

Left and right and left and right,
Now the laces tie up tight.
Stomp your feet upon the ground,
Hear the happy stepping sound.

Ready now to run and leap,
While the sleepy kitties sleep.
Left shoe, right shoe, off we go,
Walking in the morning glow.

rhymes.title: The Happy Feet Song
rhymes.text:
Wiggle toes and wiggle knees,
Put on happy shoes with ease.
Look around and you will see,
Two little shoes for you and me.

Here is left and here is right,
Pull them up and pull them tight.
No more running in bare feet,
Now our outfit is complete.

Left shoe walks to park the car,
Right shoe travels very far.
Left shoe hops upon the bed,
Right shoe wears a hat instead.

Clap your hands and shout hooray,
We are ready for the day.
Left shoe, right shoe, shining bright,
Everything is feeling right.

rhymes.title: Little Sneaker Dance
rhymes.text:
Little sneakers in a row,
Where are we so glad to go?
Put your left foot in the shoe,
Look at what you managed to do!

Put your right foot in the shoe,
Now there are a happy two.
Buckle up and pull the strap,
Ready for a happy lap.

Left step, right step, on the floor,
Dancing by the kitchen door.
Left shoe prints upon the mat,
Right shoe dances with the cat.

Spin around and touch the ground,
Hear the happy tapping sound.
Left shoe, right shoe, dancing feet,
Every single step is sweet.

rhymes.title: The Shoe Parade
rhymes.text:
Marching band is starting soon,
Humming up a happy tune.
Grab your shoes and hold them tight,
We will get them fitting right.

Left shoe first, it likes to sing,
Jumping up like anything.
Right shoe next, it loves to hop,
Dancing till we say stop stop.

Left foot, right foot, step and sway,
Marching all along the way.
Left shoe hugs the little toe,
Right shoe tells the heel hello.

Parade is ready, beat the drum,
Look at all the friends who come.
Left shoe, right shoe, in the sun,
Walking is so much fun.

rhymes.title: Ready Set Go Shoes
rhymes.text:
Sun is shining in the sky,
Little bird is flying high.
Time to put our sneakers on,
Before the morning time is gone.

Left shoe goes on foot number one,
Now our job has just begun.
Right shoe goes on foot number two,
Look at what you helpers do!

Tie the bow or stick the patch,
Everything is quite a match.
Left shoe taps the wooden chair,
Right shoe waves up in the air.

Open up the front yard gate,
We are happy and not late.
Left shoe, right shoe, brave and true,
Ready for whatever's new.

rhymes.title: The Morning Shoe Hop
rhymes.text:
Wake up, wake up, time to play,
We have got a busy day!
First we wash our hands and face,
Then we find our happy place.

Look at shoes upon the floor,
Waiting by the bedroom door.
One goes here and one goes there,
Sitting in the morning air.

Pick up shoe number one,
Put it on, oh what fun!
That is your left, nice and neat,
Snuggling up against your feet.

Pick up shoe number two,
Just the thing for me and you!
That is your right, shiny bright,
Now you're ready, walking right!

rhymes.title: Little Feet, Tap Your Beat
rhymes.text:
Little feet upon the rug,
Give your toes a happy hug!
Time to get your shoes on tight,
Making sure they feel just right.

Left foot, left foot, step so high,
Reaching all the way to the sky.
Slide your left shoe on your toe,
Push it down and watch it go!

Right foot, right foot, stomp the ground,
Make a happy rhythm sound.
Slide your right shoe on your heel,
Feel how cozy that can feel!

Velcro straps go pull and stick,
Doing up your shoes so quick.
Left and right are on the run,
Now your morning walk is fun!

rhymes.title: The Shoe Train
rhymes.text:
Chugga chugga, hear the train,
Racing through the shiny pane!
Let us build a walking train,
Out across the bedroom plain.

Here is shoe for the left side,
Ready for a speedy ride.
Push your toes right in the front,
Doing such a clever stunt.

Here is shoe for the right side,
Open up the leather wide.
Slip it on and buckle fast,
Morning sleepy time has passed!

Left shoe, right shoe, beep beep beep,
While the sleepy kittens sleep.
Marching down the hallway floor,
Stepping right outside the door!

rhymes.title: Wiggle Wiggle Toes
rhymes.text:
Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle toes,
Right beneath your button nose!
Time to put your footwear on,
Before the morning sun is gone.

Left shoe waits for left foot dear,
Bring it close and put it here.
Push the heel and wiggle round,
Touching softly to the ground.

Right shoe waits for right foot now,
Give a little toddler bow!
Slide it on with one big cheer,
Glad to have your footwear here.

Tie the laces, snap the snap,
Ready for a happy lap.
Left and right are dressed so neat,
Happy shoes on happy feet!

rhymes.title: Two Little Shoes
rhymes.text:
Two little shoes upon the mat,
Sitting side by side like that.
Can you find the left one first?
Quenched is every morning thirst!

Left shoe goes on left foot shoe,
Just the thing for you to do.
Push it down and wiggle round,
Not a single tumble down.

Now the right shoe comes along,
Singing out a happy song.
Push it on the other side,
Open up your eyes so wide!

Jump up high and shout hooray,
Shoes are on to start the day!
Left and right are doing great,
Come along, we cannot wait!

rhymes.title: The Morning Shoe Hop
rhymes.text:
Wake up sunshine, time to play,
We have places to go today!
Bring your feet, oh bring them here,
Time for shoes, my little dear.

Here is shoe number one,
Putting it on is so much fun.
Slide it over, nice and neat,
On your lovely left-side feet!

Now for shoe number two,
Bright and shiny, just like new.
Push your toes right down inside,
Now you're ready for the ride!

Left shoe, right shoe, on they go,
Marching softly, to and fro.
Jump up high and give a cheer,
Best shoe wearer of the year!

rhymes.title: Happy Little Feet
rhymes.text:
Little toes, wiggle fast,
Shoe time has come at last.
Sit right down upon the rug,
Give your sleepy feet a hug.

Find the left one, off we start,
Pull the tongue up, bless your heart!
Velcro straps go sticky-snap,
Ready for a happy lap.

Find the right one, take a look,
Reading stories from a book.
Push it on and count to three,
Happy little friend are we!

Left shoe, right shoe, side by side,
Take a giant toddler stride.
Off to school or out to play,
Have a super duper day!

rhymes.title: The Shoe Parade
rhymes.text:
Marching band is starting soon,
Singing out a happy tune.
Bring the shoes from off the floor,
We are walking out the door.

Left shoe goes upon the left,
My, you are so clever, deft!
Buckle up and pull it tight,
Making everything just right.

Right shoe goes upon the right,
Shining sparkly and so bright.
Tie the laces, make a bow,
Watch my speedy runner go!

Left shoe, right shoe, stomp your feet,
Walking down the sunny street.
Left shoe, right shoe, hip hooray,
We are marching all the day!

rhymes.title: Silly Shoe Song
rhymes.text:
Oh where, oh where are my shoes today?
Hidden away while we want to play.
Found them hiding by the chair,
Waiting for a toddler pair!

Put the left shoe on the foot,
Where the cozy socks are put.
Clap your hands and shout aloud,
Making all the grown-ups proud.

Put the right shoe on the right,
Tuck the laces out of sight.
Give a wiggle, give a shake,
Look at funny tracks we make!

Left shoe, right shoe, in a row,
Ready, steady, here we go!
Left shoe, right shoe, big and tall,
Happy shoes that never fall!

rhymes.title: Tick-Tock Shoe O'Clock
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock, clock says it is time,
Let us sing a little rhyme.
Find your shoes upon the mat,
Right beside the sleepy cat.

Take the left one, slide it on,
Just before the light is gone.
Push the heel in nice and deep,
While the little kittens sleep.

Take the right one, don't be slow,
Watch it click and watch it go.
Fasten up the buttons fast,
We are ready now at last!

Left shoe, right shoe, dancing beat,
Happy rhythm on our feet.
Left shoe, right shoe, jump and play,
Let us conquer all the day!

rhymes.title: Morning March
rhymes.text:
Time to wake and start the day,
Put our sleepy thoughts away.
Look down at our little feet,
Time to make the outfit neat.
Here's the left one, nice and slow,
In the fuzzy shoe it will go.
Here's the right one, big and bright,
Tucked inside and feeling right.
Left shoe, right shoe, tap your toes,
Up the stairs and off we go.
Jump up high and give a cheer,
Morning time is finally here.
Walking forward, step by step,
Full of energy and pep.
Left shoe, right shoe, side by side,
Ready for a fun-filled ride.

rhymes.title: The Happy Feet Beat
rhymes.text:
Little feet upon the floor,
Ready for a walk outdoors.
Can you find the matching pair?
Let us check and look right there.
Left shoe goes upon the left,
Moving fingers with great deft.
Right shoe goes upon the right,
Holding zippers super tight.
Stomp your left foot on the ground,
Hear the happy tapping sound.
Stomp your right foot next in line,
Everything is looking fine.
Now they're ready, off we run,
 Chasing shadows in the sun.
Left shoe, right shoe, let's awake,
Happy little steps we make.

rhymes.title: Shoe Train Chug
rhymes.text:
Chugga chugga, choo choo train,
Driving through the shiny rain.
Little shoes are on the track,
Moving forward and right back.
Left shoe is the engine car,
Traveling both near and far.
Right shoe is the caboose red,
Following right where we tread.
Put the left foot in its place,
With a big and happy face.
Put the right foot in its nook,
Just like in our storybook.
Now the train is ready now,
Taking heavy bows, wow wow.
Left shoe, right shoe, chug along,
Singing out our choo choo song.

rhymes.title: Twinkle Toes Waltz
rhymes.text:
Twinkle twinkle, little shoe,
I have got a job for you.
Time to put you on my feet,
Walking down the sunny street.
Left shoe first, you softly creep,
While the teddy bears stay asleep.
Right shoe next, you softly slide,
Sitting snugly by your side.
Wiggle all your little toes,
See how fast the movement goes.
Dance around the playroom floor,
Dancing right outside the door.
Left and right are best of friends,
Fun that never, ever ends.
Left shoe, right shoe, spin and twirl,
Every little boy and girl.

rhymes.title: Dinosaur Stomp
rhymes.text:
Big fat dinosaurs stomping around,
Making a heavy and rumbling sound.
Time to get our own feet dressed,
Doing it and doing our best.
Left shoe hugs the left foot tight,
Making sure it feels just right.
Right shoe hugs the right foot too,
Just like happy monsters do.
Stomp like T-Rex, loud and grand,
Walking all across the land.
Left foot stomp and right foot roar,
Let us march right out the door.
No more waiting, time to play,
Conquering the brand new day.
Left shoe, right shoe, big and strong,
Singing our great monster song.

rhymes.title: The Morning Shoe Hop
rhymes.text:
Wake up sunshine, time to play,
We have places to go today!
Bring the sneakers off the floor,
We are walking out the door.

Here is shoe number one,
Put it on and we've begun!
Push your foot right inside,
Going for a happy ride.

Now the other one is here,
Let us give a little cheer!
Left foot, right foot, step and go,
Watch the little sneakers grow.

Tie the laces, make a bow,
Ready, steady, off we go!
Jumping high up in the air,
Happy shoes are everywhere.

rhymes.title: Little Feet, Sweet Feet
rhymes.text:
Morning light is shining bright,
Little feet are doing right.
Time to get your shoes zipped on,
Before the morning sun is gone.

Take the left one, nice and slow,
Help your little toe to grow.
Push it deep inside the space,
Put a smile upon your face.

Take the right one, look at that,
Sitting on the purple mat.
Slide it on and wiggle toes,
Right up to the tiny nose.

Left shoe, right shoe, side by side,
Now we take a little ride.
Stamp your feet upon the floor,
Ready for a day explore.

rhymes.title: The Shoe Train Song
rhymes.text:
Choo choo train goes down the track,
Never looking front or back.
Time to put your shoes on fast,
So the morning fun can last.

Left foot engine, beep beep beep,
Waking up from morning sleep.
Slide it on and buckle tight,
Everything is feeling right.

Right foot caboose, clickity-clack,
Rolling down the living track.
Push your heel right in the back,
Now we have a double pack.

Left shoe, right shoe, hand in hand,
Walking through the happy land.
Marching up and marching down,
Best shoe train in all the town.

rhymes.title: Tickle Toe Shoes
rhymes.text:
Tickle, tickle, little toe,
Where do little sneakers go?
Sitting waiting by the chair,
Waiting for a little pair.

Left shoe finds a happy foot,
Right into the cozy put.
Snug and warm and shining bright,
Left shoe is a lovely sight.

Right shoe finds its partner too,
Just the right size shoe for you.
Strap it down and make it neat,
Look upon your happy feet.

Left shoe, right shoe, jump around,
Make a happy stomping sound.
Ready now to run and play,
Have a super duper day.

rhymes.title: The Magic Shoe Dance
rhymes.text:
Put your left shoe on your foot,
Right inside the leather put.
Zip it up and make it snug,
Give your little toes a hug.

Now your right shoe comes along,
Singing out a happy song.
Slide it on with wiggle flair,
Floating on the morning air.

Left shoe, right shoe, dance around,
Touching lightly on the ground.
Spinning in a circle round,
Happiest boots that can be found.

Now you're ready for the street,
Moving with your dancing feet.
Off we go to laugh and play,
Hip hooray for shoes today!

rhymes.title: The Morning Shoe March
rhymes.text:
Time to wake and time to play,
Let us start our happy day.
Find the shoes upon the floor,
Waiting by the bedroom door.

Here is shoe number one,
Put it on and we'll have fun.
On the left foot goes the blue,
Now you have a happy shoe!

Here is shoe number two,
Looking bright and shiny too.
On the right foot goes the red,
Jump right up and leave your bed.

Left and right, now we stand,
Walking through our wonderland.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
We are ready for the day!

rhymes.title: Little Feet, Happy Feet
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Everything is feeling right.
Time to get our shoes in place,
Put a smile upon your face.

Pick up shoe with shiny lace,
Put it in its proper space.
Left foot gets a hug so tight,
Holding on with all its might.

Now the other little shoe,
Waiting patiently for you.
Right foot slips right in so neat,
Tickle, tickle, little feet!

Left shoe on, right shoe too,
Look at what youchno can do!
Stomp your feet upon the floor,
Let us open up the door!

rhymes.title: The Shoe Train
rhymes.text:
Choo choo train goes down the track,
Never stopping, looking back.
Bring your shoes into the hall,
We are ready, one and all.

Left foot engine starts to go,
In the left shoe, nice and slow.
Push it down and make it fit,
Sit right down and zip a bit.

Right foot carriage joins the train,
Running down the railway lane.
Buckle up and pull it tight,
Everything is looking right.

Left and right are linked as one,
Chugging out to have some fun.
Toot your horn and off we ride,
Happy feet are side by side!

rhymes.title: Dancing Shoes
rhymes.text:
Hear the music in the air,
Dancing shoes are sitting there.
Pick them up and hold them high,
Reach up way up to the sky.

Put the left shoe on the floor,
Slide it through the bedroom door.
Left foot in and wiggle toes,
Watch how fast the ticker goes.

Put the right shoe on the mat,
Pat it gently, pat pat pat.
Right foot in and wiggle too,
Look at what my feet can do!

Left shoe here and right shoe there,
We can dance without a care.
Twirl around and spin and shout,
What this day is all about!

rhymes.title: Two Little Shoes
rhymes.text:
Sun is up and birds are singing,
All the joy that day is bringing.
Let us find our shoes to wear,
Sitting waiting on the chair.

Left shoe first, put it down,
Bestest shoe in all the town.
Left foot slides inside so sweet,
Now it hugs your little feet.

Right shoe next, do not wait,
We will never be too late.
Right foot slips inside with glee,
Happy as a bird is free.

Left and right, both are dressed,
Little shoes that we love best.
Marching out into the sun,
Now the day has just begun!

rhymes.title: Morning March
rhymes.text:
Wake up feet and stretch your toes,
Here is where the morning goes.
Find the shoes upon the mat,
Time to put them on, like that!

Left shoe first, it likes to sing,
Dancing round like any king.
Right shoe next, it loves to hop,
Jumping straight until we stop.

Left foot goes inside the space,
Find a cozy, happy place.
Right foot fits into the shoe,
Now we have a matching two!

Tie the laces nice and tight,
Everything is feeling right.
Stand up tall and give a cheer,
Walking feet are ready here!

rhymes.title: The Happy Shoe Blues
rhymes.text:
Sun is shining in the sky,
Wave the sleepy stars goodbye.
Time to get our outfits neat,
Shoes go on our wiggle feet.

Left shoe has a little smile,
Wait for it a little while.
Right shoe has a shiny lace,
Put a grin upon your face.

Slide the left foot in the door,
Tap it softly on the floor.
Slide the right foot in its nook,
How much better do they look!

Buckle up or Velcro tight,
Walking out into the light.
Left and right are on the go,
Off we march, just watch us grow!

rhymes.title: Twinkle Toes
rhymes.text:
Little shoes are fast asleep,
Time to wake them with a beep!
Grab the left one by the heel,
Tell us how the toes now feel.

Left shoe on the left foot now,
Give a little happy bow.
Grab the right one off the floor,
Ready for another door.

Right shoe on the right foot too,
Look at what we daily do.
Push the heel and wiggle toes,
Watch how well the zipper goes.

Velcro straps go zip and zap,
No more time for morning nap.
Left and right are side by side,
Ready for a giant ride!

rhymes.title: Hop to the Door
rhymes.text:
Jump into the bright new day,
Shoes are waiting for our play.
Pick up shoe number one,
Putting shoes on is so fun.

Left shoe goes on the left side,
Open up the door so wide.
Pick up shoe number two,
Shining brightly just for you.

Right shoe goes on the right foot,
Right beside the cozy root.
Push them on with all your might,
Making sure they fit just right.

Pat the toes and tap the floor,
Walking straight out through the door.
Left and right will never part,
Wearing shoes takes a smart heart!

rhymes.title: The Shoe Dance
rhymes.text:
Time to dance and time to play,
Shoes are ready for the day.
Find the red one, find the blue,
Bring them right in front of you.

Left shoe goes on the left foot,
Sitting cozy in the nook.
Right shoe goes on the right foot,
Look how nice they both now look.

Press the Velcro, make it stick,
Do it neatly, do it quick.
Stomp your feet upon the rug,
Give your sleepy toes a hug.

Now we stand and now we cheer,
Walking down the hallway clear.
Left shoe, right shoe, side by side,
Time to take a happy ride!

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubble Monster
stories.text: Splish, splash, splosh! It was time for Sammy’s evening bath, and Sammy loved the warm water. But sometimes, washing hair could feel a little bit tricky. Mummy turned on the big silver faucet, and out came the warm, soapy water. Suddenly, a little giggle came from the drain. 'Giggle-bubble-pop!' Out popped the Bubble Monster! He wasn't scary at all. He was fluffy and white, made entirely of soft, soapy suds with two big, happy blue eyes made of foam. 'Hello, Sammy!' whispered the Bubble Monster in a tickly, bubbly voice. 'Are you ready for an adventure?' Sammy smiled and clapped his little hands. 'Yes, Bubble Monster! What are we doing today?' The Bubble Monster zoomed around the tub, leaving a trail of fluffy white clouds. 'We are going to wash away the sticky day!' he cheered. First, the Bubble Monster perched right on top of Sammy’s head, giving Sammy a magnificent, super-tall crown made of snowy white bubbles. Sammy looked in the little mirror and laughed out loud. He looked just like a king! 'Off with the dirt!' sang the Bubble Monster, tickling Sammy’s shoulders with a soft, warm washcloth. Sammy learned how to rub his arms and his tummy, making sure every little spot was nice and clean. The Bubble Monster cheered every time Sammy scrubbed, giving gentle, positive cheers. 'Great job, Sammy! You are shining like a star!' When it was time to rinse, the friendly monster gave Sammy a sweet hug and slowly dissolved into the warm water, turning it into a giant, happy wave. Sammy stood up, wrapped in his cozy, warm dinosaur towel, feeling fresh, clean, and so very proud. He hugged Mummy and whispered, 'I washed all by myself!' Mummy smiled and kissed his soft cheek. 'You did it, my big boy. You are a super washer!' Sammy snuggled into his bed, ready for sweet dreams, knowing the Bubble Monster would be waiting for the very next bath time.

stories.title: Leo and the Hand-Washing Bubble Monster
stories.text: Yum, yum, time for lunch! Leo washed his hands before eating, which is a very important rule. He walked into the bright, cheerful bathroom and hopped up onto his little yellow step stool. He looked at the silver sink, but wait! Something bubbly was waiting right by the pink soap pump. It was the Hand-Washing Bubble Monster! He was round like a little lemon and smelled just like sweet strawberries. 'Halt, little friend!' said the Bubble Monster with a friendly wave of his soapy hand. 'Before the yummy food goes in, the sticky germs must go out!' Leo giggled. He loved the Bubble Monster. 'How do we do it, Bubble Monster?' he asked eagerly. 'Easy-peasy, lemon-squeezy!' said the monster. 'One pump of soap, and then we make a mountain of magic foam!' Leo pushed the pink pump down. Squirt! A cool, shiny puddle of soap landed right in his little palms. Then came the most important part: turning on the warm water. Leo rubbed his hands together. Rub-a-dub-dub! The Bubble Monster jumped onto Leo’s fingers. 'Between the fingers!' sang the monster. Leo wiggled his fingers like little wiggly worms, making sure the soap got all the way in. 'Now the thumbs!' chanted the Bubble Monster. Leo gave each thumb a big, happy hug with his soapy hands. 'And now, the super-duper song!' Together, Leo and the Bubble Monster sang the happy hand-washing song while counting to ten. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! The foam grew big and fluffy, trapping all the invisible dirt and germs. 'Time to rinse!' said the monster. Leo held his hands under the warm, comforting stream of water, watching all the bubbles slide down the drain like little racing cars. 'Bye-bye, bubbles!' whispered Leo. He dried his hands on his soft blue towel with the little white clouds. The Bubble Monster gave a happy little squeak from the faucet. 'You have the cleanest hands in the whole wide world, Leo!' Leo felt so proud and happy as he ran to the kitchen. Washing his hands was not just a chore; it was a magical game with his favorite bubbly friend.

stories.title: Mia and the Bedtime Toothbrush Monster
stories.text: The moon was shining bright in the deep blue sky, and little stars were twinkling outside Mia’s bedroom window. It was time to get ready for sleep. Mia walked into the bathroom, carrying her favorite yellow toothbrush with the little green bristles. But look! Who was that sitting right on the edge of the sink, wearing a tiny nightcap made of toothpaste? It was the Bedtime Toothbrush Monster! He was a friendly little fellow with a wide, glowing smile and a gentle, soothing hum. 'Hello, Mia,' whispered the Bubble Monster softly, so as not to wake the sleepy house. 'Are our teeth ready for the nightly sparkle?' Mia nodded sleepily. 'Yes, Mr. Monster. But my arms feel a little bit tired.' The Bubble Monster hopped down gently and landed right on Mia’s shoulder. 'That is okay, little one. We will do it together, slow and steady.' Mia squeezed a tiny pea-sized drop of minty toothpaste onto her brush. It looked like a little green button! 'First, the top teeth!' said the Bubble Monster. Mia gently moved her brush in little circles. *Brush, brush, brush, round and round.* 'Next, the bottom teeth!' whispered the monster. *Up and down, like happy little elevators!* Mia followed along, smiling as the minty foam started to tickle her lips. The Bubble Monster cheered her on with gentle whispers. 'You are doing wonderfully, Mia. Look at that shiny smile!' They brushed the front, they brushed the back, and they even tickled the very back molars where the chewy snacks liked to hide. When they were all finished, Mia rinsed her mouth with cool water and spat it out into the sink, just like a big girl. She wiped her mouth with a soft, fluffy flannel. The Bubble Monster smiled his biggest, brightest smile, glowing in the dim night light. 'Your teeth are shining like little pearls, Mia. Ready for sweet dreams!' Mia hugged her toothbrush and whispered goodnight to her bubbly little friend. She crawled into her cozy bed, feeling so proud of her sparkling teeth, ready to sleep tight until the morning sun.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the happy toes! Bath time is here, and Sammy is ready for a big adventure. The water is nice and warm, just like a cozy hug. Mommy brings out the big red bottle of bubbly soap. Squeeze, squeeze, one, two, three drops go right into the water. Sammy swishes the water with a little hand. Up, up, up rise the magical bubbles! They grow and grow until they look like giant fluffy clouds right in the tub. 'Look at me!' giggles Sammy. 'I am the Bubble Monster!' The Bubble Monster has a big fluffy white beard made entirely of suds. It wobbles when Sammy laughs. But wait! The little yellow rubber ducky is stuck at the bottom of the tub, hiding behind a mountain of bubbles. The brave Bubble Monster knows just what to do. With gentle hands, the monster reaches down to save the ducky. 'Quack, quack! Thank you, Bubble Monster!' says the duck. Now it is time to wash the day away. Sammy washes the little toes, the busy fingers, and the happy tummy. The warm water feels so good. When the bath is all done, Mommy pulls the plug. Down, down, down go the suds, swirling round and round in a bubbly dance. Bye-bye, bubbles! Sammy steps out onto the softest towel in the whole wide world. Mommy wraps Sammy up like a snuggly burrito. 'You did such a wonderful job in the bath today,' whispers Mommy with a warm kiss. Sammy feels so clean, so cozy, and so very proud. It is time for sweet dreams, little Bubble Monster.

stories.title: Leo's Hand-Washing Monster Party
stories.text: Stomp, stomp, stomp! Little Leo has been playing outside all morning long. Building tall towers in the dirt and chasing the friendly butterflies is thirsty and messy work. Now, tummy rumbles mean it is time for a yummy snack! But wait, look at those fingers! They are covered in outdoor dust and tickly dirt spots. What do we do before we eat? It is time for a trip to the sparkly bathroom sink! Leo stands proudly on the big blue stepping stool. The water turns on with a gentle twist—splash, splash, hello water! Leo needs a special superpower to clean those hands. Mommy hands over the pump soap. Squish, squoosh! A big dollop of green apple soap lands right in Leo's palm. Now comes the best part of the day. Rub, rub, rub! Leo rubs the palms together. Then the backs of the hands. Then in between the wiggly fingers. Abracadabra! The soap turns into a mountain of fluffy, scented bubbles. 'Roar!' says Leo. 'I am the hand-washing Bubble Monster!' The suds dance all over Leo's hands, making silly shapes. Leo watches the tiny bubbles pop with a soft tickle. It is so much fun to be clean. Now it is time to rinse away the magic. The cool water washes the bubbles down the drain, taking all the dirt along for the ride. Bye-bye, dirt! Leo turns off the faucet and reaches for the fluffy green frog towel. Pat, pat, pat go the hands until they are completely dry. Leo smells like sweet green apples. 'My hands are super clean!' cheers Leo, clapping them together. Mommy smiles big and gives a high-five. Ready for snacks, ready for fun, Leo is a superstar!

stories.title: Mila Brushes the Sugar Bugs Away
stories.text: Mila finishes a delicious bowl of yummy fruit. Crunch, crunch, crunch went the sweet apples! But wait—little invisible sugar bugs love to hide in teeth after a tasty snack. Who can help make Mila's smile shine bright like a diamond? Mila knows just the helper! It is time for brushing! Mila marches into the bright bathroom and picks up the sparkly pink toothbrush. Squeeze, squeeze goes the minty toothpaste, landing on the bristles like a little cloud. Time to transform! Mila looks in the mirror and opens wide. 'Ahhh!' Today, Mila is the friendly Bubble Monster of the bathroom. The mission is to chase all the silly sugar bugs far, far away. Up and down go the toothbrush bristles. Brush, brush, brush along the top teeth. Brush, brush, brush along the bottom teeth. Mila makes funny little sounds—'Hee hee hee!'—while brushing. The toothpaste turns into lovely, foamy bubbles that tickle the lips. It is like a little party happening right inside the mouth! The Bubble Monster works super hard to clean every single tooth, making sure not to miss a spot. The back teeth get a gentle tickle, and the front teeth get a big shiny polish. When the brushing is all done, it is time for the final magic trick. Mila takes a big cup of cool water, takes a sip, and swishes it all around. Swish, swish, spit! Down into the sink go the bubbly suds and the sleepy sugar bugs. Mila wipes the mouth with a soft cloth and flashes a huge, radiant smile in the mirror. Look at those pearly whites sparkle! 'Great job brushing!' cheers Daddy, clapping his hands. Mila feels so fresh, so bright, and ready to take on the rest of the happy day.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the happy toes! Bath time is here, and little Sammy is ready for a bubbly adventure. The warm water feels so cozy, just like a big hug for his skin. Mom fills the big tub, and squirt goes the gentle, sweet-smelling soap. Swish, swish, swish go the bubbles! Up, up, up they rise, making mountains of fluffy white foam. Look at that! A giant, wiggly Bubble Monster appears right on top of the water! But do not worry, little friends, this Bubble Monster is not scary at all. He is a friendly helper with a very important job. Sammy giggles and claps his hands. 'Hello, Bubble Monster!' he says. The Bubble Monster wants to play a fun game. He wants to help Sammy get sparkling clean from his head down to his tiny toes. First, the Bubble Monster sits right on top of Sammy’s head like a funny, fluffy hat. 'Look at my crown!' laughs Sammy. Then, the Bubble Monster tickles Sammy’s arms. He helps wash away the sticky juice from snack time. Gently, gently, the bubbles tickle and clean. Sammy learns how to wash his own tummy and his strong legs. He is doing such a wonderful job taking care of his body. Mom smiles big and cheers, 'You are growing up so strong, Sammy!' When it is time to say goodbye, the bubbles float up, up, up into the air like magic balloons. Pop, pop, pop go the tiny bubbles! Sammy pulls out the plug, and watching the water swirl down the drain is so much fun. Wrapped up in his warm, fluffy towel like a snuggly burrito, Sammy feels fresh and happy. He did it all by himself, and he is ready for sweet dreams.

stories.title: Mia's Magical Handwashing Journey
stories.text: Ring, ring, goes the tummy! It is almost time for yummy snacks, but wait! What is on Mia's hands after playing outside in the wonderful dirt? Muddy footprints and sticky spots! Before we eat, we must give our hands a super special cleaning. Mia hops onto her little blue stepstool so she can reach the big sink. Turn on the gentle warm water. Ooh, nice and cozy! Now it is time for the magic helper. Pump, pump, goes the soap bottle, and out pops a squishy, slippery soap blob. Rub, rub, rub go Mia's hands together! Suddenly, a magical thing happens. The soap mixes with the water and creates the silliest Bubble Monster ever! This Bubble Monster loves to play hide and seek on Mia's fingers. He hides between her fingers and tickles her palms. Mia sings her favorite handwashing song while she scrubs. Top and bottom, back and forth, cleaning every single finger like little piano keys. The Bubble Monster gets smaller and smaller as he works hard to wash away all the invisible germs. Bye-bye, germs! Bye-bye, dirt! Mia rinses her hands under the lovely running water, watching the bubbly foam slide down the drain. She turns off the water and reaches for her soft, green frog towel. Pat, pat, pat go her hands until they are dry and warm. Mia holds up her clean hands and gives them a proud wiggle. They smell like fresh strawberries and look so shiny. 'All clean!' cheers Mia. Mommy gives her a big, proud hug. Mia is ready for her snack, and she feels so proud of her sparkling clean hands.

stories.title: Leo and the Toothbrush Safari
stories.text: Time for bed is coming soon, but first, there is a fun mission waiting in the bathroom! Little Leo climbs up to the sink. It is time to brush his teeth and chase away the sugar bugs. Leo grabs his special blue toothbrush with the soft, friendly bristles. Mom helps put a tiny, pea-sized dot of minty toothpaste on the brush. It looks like a little white cloud! Leo opens his mouth wide, just like a big, roaring lion. Rawr! Inside Leo's mouth, a mischievous Bubble Monster is trying to hide behind his teeth. This Bubble Monster loves to tickle teeth and make them sparkle like shiny stars. 'Time to brush, Bubble Monster!' says Leo. He moves his toothbrush in little circles, just like a tiny train going round and round the track. Up on the top teeth, chug-chug-chug! Down on the bottom teeth, zoom-zoom-zoom! The toothpaste turns into lots of little bubbly bubbles that tickle Leo’s tongue. It is a big bubble party right inside his mouth! Leo brushes gently, making sure every single tooth gets a turn to shine. He is doing a fantastic job taking care of his smile. When the brushing is all done, it is time for the best part. Leo takes a big gulp of water in a colorful plastic cup, swishes it around, and spits it out into the sink. Whew! The Bubble Monster floats away down the drain, leaving behind a mouth that feels tingly, fresh, and clean. Leo looks in the mirror and flashes a bright, happy smile. Daddy high-fives him and says, 'What a superstar tooth brusher!' Leo climbs into bed, ready for a wonderful night of sweet sleep.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the little toes in the warm, cozy bath water! It is time for evening bath time, and Sammy is getting ready to wash the day away. Mommy turns on the water, and squirts in some strawberry-smelling soap. Swish, swish, swish goes her hand, and suddenly—pop! Puff! Up rises the Bubble Monster! He is a friendly, giggly monster made entirely of shiny, floating bubbles. 'Hello, Sammy!' whispers the Bubble Monster in a tickly, bubbly voice. 'Are you ready for a super-duper fun scrub?' Sammy giggles and claps his hands together. The Bubble Monster gives Sammy a fuzzy washcloth. First, they wash Sammy's little round tummy. Scrub-a-dub-dub, right in the tub! The Bubble Monster makes a funny white beard on Sammy’s chin using a big, fluffy puff of bubbles. Sammy looks in the mirror and roars just like a happy little lion. 'Roar!' Then, it is time to wash the arms and legs, making sure all the playground dirt is washed away down the drain. Sammy is doing such a wonderful job listening and participating in his routine. Mommy wraps Sammy in a big, warm towel shaped like a soft brown bear. The Bubble Monster waves goodbye, popping softly into the air with a happy little *pop*! Sammy feels so clean, cozy, and relaxed. He puts on his soft yellow pajamas, ready for sweet dreams. 'Goodnight, Bubble Monster,' Sammy whispers with a yawn, climbing into his snuggly bed. What a wonderful day of growing up big and strong!

stories.title: Leo's Magic Handwashing Adventure
stories.text: Ring, ring! Time for lunch! But wait, before we eat our yummy ham and cheese sandwiches, what do our hands need to do? That is right, it is time to wash! Leo hops down from his little wooden chair and trots right into the bright yellow bathroom. He steps up onto his sturdy blue stool so he can reach the sink all by himself. Leo turns on the warm water. Ooh, nice and cozy! Next, Mommy helps him pump some foaming green apple soap onto his palms. Rub, rub, rub go Leo's hands! But wait—who is that hiding in the suds? It is the Bubble Monster! He is a bouncy, sparkly monster made of giggly soap bubbles, and he loves clean hands. 'Clap your hands, Leo, let us chase the germs away!' sings the Bubble Monster. Leo claps his hands together, *squish, squish, squish*. The bubbles tickle his fingers and make a fun mountain of foam. They sing the alphabet song while they scrub between the fingers and all around the thumbs. Leo is being so independent and responsible! 'Good job, little helper!' says Mommy with a proud smile. Leo turns off the faucet, saving water just like a big boy. Then, he pulls a soft, green dinosaur towel from the rack and dries his hands completely until they are warm and cozy. His hands smell like sweet green apples, and they are sparkling clean. The Bubble Monster gives one last cheerful pop, cheering for Leo's great hygiene habits. Now, Leo's tummy is rumbling, and he is ready to sit at the table and enjoy his healthy lunch. Hooray for handwashing time!

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Toothbrush Safari
stories.text: The stars are beginning to twinkle outside the bedroom window, which means it is time for Mia’s bedtime teeth-brushing routine. Mia brushes her teeth twice a day to keep her bright smile shining like a star. She walks into the bathroom and picks up her favorite purple toothbrush with the soft, gentle bristles. Daddy helps her squeeze a tiny, pea-sized dot of sparkly mint toothpaste right onto the brush. It looks like a little white cloud! As soon as the water runs and the brushing begins, something magical happens in the mirror. Pop! Up dances the Bubble Monster! He is a friendly, sparkling creature with a big, wide grin made entirely of minty-fresh bubbles. 'Time for a brushing safari, Mia!' cheers the Bubble Monster. Mia brushes the top teeth, going back and forth like a little train chugging along the track. *Chugga-chugga, choo-choo!* Then, she brushes the bottom teeth, up and down like bouncy little bunnies hopping in the grass. *Hop, hop, hop!* She even brushes the back molars where the yummy snacks like to hide. The Bubble Monster blows a tiny bubble hat onto the tip of Mia's nose, making her giggle out loud. Mia is doing an amazing job taking such wonderful care of her strong, healthy teeth. Daddy helps her rinse with a small cup of water, swishing it around and spitting it out into the sink. *Spit!* All done! The Bubble Monster gives a gentle wave and a shiny, minty smile as he floats away into a happy dream. Mia's mouth feels so fresh, clean, and cool. She climbs into her cozy bed, snuggles her favorite teddy bear, and closes her eyes. Sweet dreams, Mia!

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the happy toes! Bath time is here, and little Sammy is ready for a bubbly adventure. The warm water feels so cozy, just like a big hug from head to toe. Mommy pours in the gentle bubble soap, and swish, swish, swish! Up rise the mountains of soft, fluffy suds. Look closely! Out of the biggest white cloud pops the friendly Bubble Monster! He is a very silly monster made entirely of shiny, floating bubbles. 'Hello, Sammy!' giggles the Bubble Monster. 'Can we wash your hair today?' Sammy loves his bubbly friend and nods with a big, happy smile. First, we need to wash Sammy’s busy hands. The Bubble Monster gives Sammy a special, tickly high-five, and all the sticky finger germs float away down the drain. Bye-bye, germs! Next up is Sammy’s strong arms and his wiggly tummy. The washcloth feels warm and nice as it sweeps away the day's adventures. Oh, look at Sammy’s hair! The Bubble Monster gently places a big, fluffy white beard right on Sammy’s chin. Sammy looks in the mirror and laughs out loud. 'Ho, ho, ho! I am the king of the bubbles!' he cheers. Mommy gently rinses the soapy water with a cup of warm, cascading rain. The friendly Bubble Monster waves goodbye as he slowly pops into tiny, sparkling droplets that dance in the air. Sammy is all clean, smelling sweet like fresh lavender and sunshine. Time to wrap up in the big, fluffy dinosaur towel. Sammy feels warm, cozy, and very proud of his super-clean body. Ready for sweet dreams and happy snoozes.

stories.title: Leo's Magic Hand-Washing Monster
stories.text: Ring, ring! Goes the tummy, because it is time for lunch! But wait, stop right there, little Leo. What do we need to do before we touch our yummy sandwiches? That is right! It is time to wash our hands. Leo marches right into the bathroom and hops up on his sturdy little step stool. The shiny silver faucet is waiting. Leo turns the handle, and out flows the wonderful, warm water. It feels just right on his fingers. Now comes the best part of the whole day. Mommy pumps a squirt of bright green soap right into Leo’s palm. It smells like crisp green apples. Rub, rub, rub! Leo rubs his hands together, making a mountain of slippery, soapy foam. Suddenly, right out of the foam appears the amazing Hand-Washing Monster! He has big googly eyes made of soap suds and loves to chase away tiny, invisible dirt bugs. 'Tickle, tickle, between the fingers!' sings the Hand-Washing Monster. Leo giggles as he scrubs between every single finger. He washes the backs of his hands, his thumbs, and even all the way up his wrists. The Monster cheers, 'You are doing a fantastic job, Leo! Germs away for the whole entire day!' Leo watches the colorful bubbles swirl down the drain, taking all the dirt and yucky stuff with them. Mommy hands Leo a fluffy yellow towel to dry his hands until they are as dry as a desert. Leo holds up his clean hands and takes a big sniff. Mmm, apple fresh! Now Leo's hands are clean and ready to clap, play, and eat his lunch. Way to go, Leo! You are a hand-washing superstar.

stories.title: Mia Brushes Away the Sugar Bugs
stories.text: Twinkle, twinkle, little stars, evening time is here. Little Mia has eaten her healthy dinner, and now it is time to get ready for bed. But before her head hits the soft pillow, there is one very important job to do. Time to brush those pearly whites! Mia runs to the bathroom and grabs her favorite pink toothbrush with the sparkling glitter handle. Daddy puts a tiny, pea-sized dot of strawberry toothpaste right on the bristles. Mmm, strawberry! Mia opens her mouth wide, just like a friendly little hippo at the river. Up and down, round and round, go the soft bristles. Swish, swish, go the teeth! Suddenly, a tiny puff of foam appears in the mirror. It is the Toothbrush Monster! He is a bouncy, gentle little creature who loves sparkly clean teeth. 'Hooray for Mia!' cheers the Toothbrush Monster. 'Let us brush away those silly sugar bugs before they throw a nighttime party!' Mia giggles around her toothbrush. She brushes the top teeth, the bottom teeth, and way in the back where the big molars live. The Toothbrush Monster helps guide her hand, making sure every single tooth shines like a bright diamond. Now comes the magical water cup. Mia takes a sip of cool water, swishes it around in her cheeks, and spits it out. Splish! All gone! The Toothbrush Monster gives Mia a huge, proud thumbs-up and dances right into a happy little bubble pop. Mia looks in the mirror and flashes a huge, gleaming smile. Her teeth are sparkling clean and ready for sweet, happy dreams. Great job brushing, Mia! You kept your smile bright and healthy all night long.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the happy toes! Bath time is here, and Sammy is ready for a big adventure. But wait! There is a little problem. Sammy does not like washing hair. Oh no! When the water gets near, Sammy wants to hide. Mommy smiles a warm, gentle smile and reaches for a special bottle. It is magic bubble soap! Mommy pumps out a big, fluffy white cloud right in her hand. Look, Sammy! It is the friendly Bubble Monster! The Bubble Monster is soft and silly. He loves to dance on top of the water. Mommy asks, can the Bubble Monster wear a fluffy crown on your head? Sammy giggles. Let us try! Mommy places the soft soap gently on Sammy's head. Look in the mirror, Sammy! You have a funny white crown made of tiny bubbles! You look just like a happy bubble king. Sammy claps his hands with joy. The scary water does not feel scary anymore because the Bubble Monster is here to play. Mommy pours a cup of warm water to rinse gently. One, two, three, all gone! The silly bubbles float away up to the ceiling, whispering goodbye until next time. Sammy did such a wonderful job being brave today. Mommy gives Sammy the biggest, warmest hug in the whole wide world. You are my superstar, says Mommy. Sammy feels so proud, clean, and happy. Bath time is the best time when you have a good friend to help you out. Time to wrap up in the cozy towel monster and snuggle tight. Goodnight, little bubbles.

stories.title: Leo's Magic Bubble Wand
stories.text: Wash, wash, wash your hands! It is time to make them squeaky clean before lunch. Leo stands on the little blue step stool by the bathroom sink. He turns on the warm water. Ooh, it feels so nice and cozy. But Leo's hands have invisible sticky spots from playing outside with dirt and bright red paint. How do we chase the sticky spots away? Papa knows just what to do! Papa hands Leo a bright green bottle of soap. Pump, pump, goes the soap, and out comes a gooey, slippery puddle. Now, time for the magic! Rub your hands together fast, fast, fast! Leo rubs his palms. He rubs the back of his hands. He tickles his fingers in between. Look, Papa! Look what is growing! Little white mounds of soft soap are getting bigger and bigger. It is the amazing hand-washing Bubble Monster! The Bubble Monster tickles Leo's fingers with bubbly fingers of his own. Leo laughs out loud. The Bubble Monster says, scrub those thumbs and make them shine! Leo swirls his soapy hands round and round, making a mountain of snowy bubbles in the sink. Papa sings a happy washing song. Now, let us rinse the little monsters down the drain, says Papa. Leo holds his hands under the warm running water. Watch them wash away! All the bubbles wave goodbye, and the sticky spots are completely gone. Leo holds up his clean hands proudly. They smell like sweet strawberries. Papa cheers, Yay for Leo! You washed your hands all by yourself! Leo beams with pride. Clean hands are happy hands, ready for a yummy snack.

stories.title: Mia's Bright White Brushing Day
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! It is time to wake up the sleepy teeth. Mia hops out of bed and marches right into the bathroom. She picks up her favorite pink toothbrush with soft, friendly bristles. But wait, her teeth are feeling a little bit shy today. They are hiding behind her lips. Who can help the teeth wake up? The Toothbrush Monster! No, not a scary monster—a friendly, giggly Bubble Monster made of minty-fresh toothpaste! Mommy helps squeeze a pea-sized dot of sparkly blue toothpaste onto Mia's brush. It looks like a tiny blue star. Mia opens wide, just like a little baby bird. Ahhh! The Bubble Monster dances inside the mouth, tickling the top teeth and the bottom teeth. Brush, brush, brush, goes the gentle brush. Up and down, side to side, making lots of bubbly foam! Mia pretends her toothbrush is a choo-choo train chugging along the track. Chug-chug, toot-toot, clean those back molars too! The bubbly foam gets bigger and fluffier, popping with soft little sounds like tiny whispers. Mia giggles around the toothbrush. The Bubble Monster is throwing a tiny party right on her teeth! Mommy counts to ten very slowly. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! All done! Mia spits the bubbly foam into the sink. She rinses her mouth with a tiny cup of cool water. She flashes a big, wide smile in the mirror. Look at those shiny, sparkling pearls! They are glowing bright and clean. Mommy gives Mia a high-five. You took such wonderful care of your smile today, Mia. Mia feels so proud and strong, ready to take on a brand new day of fun and play.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the happy toes! Bath time is here, and Sammy is ready for a wonderful adventure. The warm water feels so cozy on his tummy. Mom turns on the big red faucet, and guess what happens next? A mountain of soft, white bubbles begins to grow right in the middle of the tub! Pop, pop, go the tiny soapy spheres. Sammy claps his little hands together and laughs out loud. 'Look, Mom!' he giggles. 'It is the gentle Bubble Monster!' But this monster is not scary at all. It loves clean skin and tickly toes. 'Can the Bubble Monster give me a funny bubble hat?' asks Sammy. With a gentle sweep of her hand, Mom places a big, fluffy crown of bubbles right on top of Sammy's head. Sammy looks down into the shiny water mirror and smiles. He is a majestic bubble king! Now, it is time to wash up. First, we must wash the busy fingers that love to build blocks. Scrub-a-dub-dub, goes the washcloth. Next, we wash the happy shoulders and the silly knees. The Bubble Monster helps tick away all the dirt from the park. 'Goodbye, dirt!' whispers Sammy as the bubbly water swirls down the big drain. Sammy stands up tall, and Dad wraps him in a big, warm, fluffy blue towel just like a cozy bear hug. Sammy feels so fresh, so clean, and so very proud. He did a fantastic job with his bath today. Goodnight, little Bubble Monster! Time for sweet dreams.

stories.title: Mia and the Hand-Washing Magic
stories.text: Stomp, stomp, stomp! Mia and her puppy have just finished playing outside in the big backyard. They dug in the soft brown dirt and built the tallest mud castle ever seen. Now, Mia's tummy is rumbling because it is time for a yummy snack. But wait! Before we eat, what do our hands need to do? They need a special washing adventure! Mia runs into the bright bathroom and climbs up onto her sturdy blue step stool. She stretches her arms out wide to reach the magical sink. Mom turns on the warm water, just right. First, Mia dips her hands under the soothing stream. Splash! Next comes the best part of all: the pump soap. Squish, squash, goes the green soap bottle, giving Mia a big dollop of slippery, scented soap right in the center of her palms. Now, Mia rubs her hands together. Round and round they go, making a mountain of bubbly white foam. 'Look at my magic Bubble Monster gloves!' she cheers to her puppy, who is watching closely from the fluffy rug. Mia sings her favorite counting song while she scrubs. One, two, three, four, five bubbles on her thumb! Six, seven, eight, nine, ten bubbles on her pinky finger! The Bubble Monster gobbles up all the sticky backyard germs, tickling Mia's skin with soft, bubbly bubbles. When the bubbles are all gone, Mia rinses her hands clean under the warm water. She shakes her hands gently like a wet puppy to get rid of the extra drops. Then, she dries them on a soft yellow towel until they are cozy and warm. Mia's hands smell like sweet strawberries and feel super clean. 'Great job washing your hands, Mia!' praises Mom. Mia smiles a big, happy smile and heads to the kitchen for her well-deserved snack.

stories.title: Leo and the Tooth-Brushing Bubbles
stories.text: Up, down, side to side! The kitchen clock says it is morning time, and Leo is ready to start his brand-new day. But first, we have to wake up our sleepy teeth! Leo marches into the bathroom and picks up his favorite shiny red toothbrush. It has soft bristles that feel like a gentle little brush for a tiny kitten. Dad puts a tiny pea-sized drop of minty blue toothpaste right on top. It looks like a little drop of magic sky. Leo opens his mouth wide. Ahhhh! Like a happy little lion. He places the toothbrush against his shiny white teeth and starts to scrub. Up go the bristles to brush the top teeth, and down they go to tickle the bottom ones. Suddenly, a fizzy, minty Bubble Monster wakes up inside Leo's mouth! It starts making a whole bunch of bubbly foam. Leo giggles because the bubbles feel like tiny tickly feathers dancing on his tongue. He moves his brush in little circles, making sure every single tooth gets a turn to shine. We brush the back teeth where the crunchy apples live, and we brush the front teeth that give the biggest smiles. The Bubble Monster helps wash away all the sleepy-time fuzz, leaving Leo's mouth feeling fresh and cool like a breezy morning wind. When the brushing is all done, Leo takes a little sip of water from his favorite green cup. Swish, swish, swish goes the water in his cheeks, and spit! Right down into the sink. Leo wipes his chin with a soft cloth and looks in the mirror. He flashes a huge, sparkling smile that shines brighter than the morning sun. 'Woohoo! You did amazing, Leo!' says Dad, giving him a high-five. Leo feels so proud of his sparkling clean teeth and is ready to play.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubble Monster
stories.text: Splish, splash, splosh! It was time for Sammy’s evening bath, and Sammy loved the warm water. But sometimes, washing hair could feel a little tricky. Mom turned on the tap, and wonderful, soapy bubbles began to fill the tub. They grew bigger and bigger until they formed the friendly Bubble Monster! 'Roar!' whispered the Bubble Monster softly. 'I am here to help you wash today, Sammy!' Sammy giggled and clapped his hands. The Bubble Monster had a fluffy white beard on his chin and silly bubble horns on his head. 'Can you give me a sparkly bubble crown?' asked Sammy. 'Of course!' said Mom, scooping up a handful of suds and placing them right on Sammy’s head. Now Sammy looked like a real bath-time king. The Bubble Monster gently reminded Sammy that it was time to wash his tummy. 'Scrub, scrub, scrub!' sang Sammy, using his soft washcloth. He washed his arms, his legs, and his tiny toes. Next came the trickiest part: washing his hair. Sammy tilted his head way back, just like the Bubble Monster showed him. Mom poured a cup of warm water over his hair, rinsing the shampoo away safely and easily. 'Yay! All done!' cheered Sammy. The Bubble Monster gave a happy little fizz and popped into a million tiny, sparkling droplets that danced in the water. Sammy stepped out of the tub wrapped in his big, cozy, yellow duck towel. Mom gave him a huge hug and said, 'You did such a wonderful job listening to your body and taking care of yourself tonight!' Sammy felt so proud and clean. He snuggled into his soft pajamas, ready for a cozy night of sweet dreams. Goodnight, Sammy!

stories.title: Leo and the Tooth-Brushing Bubble Monster
stories.text: Brrrring! Morning sunlight peeked into Leo’s bedroom. It was time to wake up, stretch high like a tall giraffe, and get ready for a brand-new day of fun. First stop was the bathroom sink! Leo hopped up onto his little blue step stool so he could see the mirror. He grabbed his favorite green toothbrush, which looked just like a little alligator. But wait—where was the toothpaste? Suddenly, a bubbly, giggly friend appeared right in the bathroom mirror. It was the friendly Tooth-Brushing Bubble Monster! He had sparkling white teeth that gleamed like little stars. 'Hello, Leo!' said the Bubble Monster. 'Are we ready to make our teeth shine bright today?' Leo nodded excitedly. He squeezed a tiny, pea-sized dot of strawberry toothpaste onto his brush. 'Up and down, side to side, brush the monsters out and hide!' sang the Bubble Monster, doing a silly little dance. Leo copied his new friend. He brushed the front of his teeth, then the back, and even gently brushed his tongue. 'Phew, all those sleepy sugar bugs are running away!' laughed Leo as he watched the foamy bubbles swirl around his brush. It was time to rinse! Leo filled a small red cup with fresh, cool water, took a sip, swished it all around his cheeks, and spit it neatly into the sink. Swoosh! Gurgle! Splash! The Bubble Monster clapped his sparkly hands together. 'Brilliant job, Leo! Your smile is shining brighter than the morning sun!' Leo looked in the mirror and beamed a giant, sparkling smile. He felt so proud of his shiny teeth and his wonderful brushing skills. With a happy wave, the Bubble Monster gently faded away, waiting for tonight. Leo skipped out of the bathroom, ready to eat a yummy breakfast and play all day long!

stories.title: Mia and the Hand-Washing Bubble Monster
stories.text: Stomp, stomp, stomp! Mia had just finished playing outside in the wonderful backyard garden. She dug in the warm dirt, planted some bright red strawberry seeds, and built a castle out of twigs. Her hands were very busy and a little bit muddy! 'Time to wash our hands before snack time, Mia!' called Dad from the kitchen. Mia walked over to the bathroom sink, but she wasn't quite sure how to get all the sticky dirt off by herself. Just then, a cheerful splash of water bubbled up in the sink basin. Pop! Out jumped the Hand-Washing Bubble Monster! He smelled like sweet lavender and had big, friendly eyes made of soapy suds. 'Hello, little gardener!' said the Bubble Monster. 'Let us make some magic soap castles together!' Mia smiled and reached out her hands. Dad helped her turn on the warm water. It felt so nice and cozy on her fingers. Next, Mia pressed the soap pump once. Squish! A big glob of slippery soap landed right in her palm. 'Now, rub your hands together like you are trying to keep them warm on a snowy day!' whispered the Bubble Monster. Mia rubbed her palms together, making lots of fluffy white bubbles. She washed between her fingers, scrubbed the backs of her hands, and even cleaned underneath her fingernails where the tiny pieces of dirt were hiding. 'Sing the ABC song while we scrub!' cheered the Bubble Monster. Mia sang, 'A, B, C, D...' all the way until she reached 'Z!' Then, Dad helped her rinse all the bubbles down the drain. Wash, wash, wash went the water, taking all the dirt and germs far, far away. Mia dried her hands on her fluffy bunny towel. They felt so soft, clean, and smelled wonderful. The Bubble Monster gave a happy little wave and whispered, 'Super-duper hand-washing, Mia!' Mia felt so happy and ready for her yummy apple snack.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubble Monster
stories.text: Splish, splash, splosh! It was time for Sammy’s evening bath, and Sammy loved the water. But wait, what was that making a funny sound in the corner? Glug, glug, growl! Out popped the Bubble Monster! Now, some little monsters might be scary, but this Bubble Monster was made entirely of fluffy, sparkly soap bubbles. He had round blueberry eyes and a big, giggly smile. 'Hello, Sammy!' said the Bubble Monster in a soft, bubbly voice. 'It is time to get super clean, and I need your help!' Sammy giggled and clapped his hands. 'How can I help, Bubble Monster?' he asked. 'Well,' said the monster, 'my tummy is full of warm water and gentle soap. Can you wash your tummy just like mine?' Sammy picked up his soft yellow washcloth, dipped it in the warm water, and gently rubbed his tummy. 'Suds, suds, on my tum, washing up is so much fun!' cheered Sammy. The Bubble Monster bounced happily on the water, making more fluffy foam hats. 'Wonderful job!' whispered the friendly monster. Next, it was time for Sammy’s little toes. Sammy carefully washed between each toe, tickling his own feet and laughing out loud. The Bubble Monster cheered, blowing a big cluster of floating soap bubbles that danced in the air like magic balloons. Sammy reached up and popped one gently with his finger. Pop! Pop! Pop! 'Look at me, Bubble Monster! I am washing all by myself!' Sammy said proudly. The gentle monster nodded and gave a happy little shimmy. When the bath was all finished, and the warm towel wrapped snugly around Sammy like a big hug, the Bubble Monster waved goodbye. 'Great job getting clean, Sammy. See you tomorrow!' Sammy smiled, feeling fresh, cozy, and ready for a wonderful night of sweet dreams. Bath time with his bubbly friend was always the best part of the whole day.

stories.title: Leo and the Toothbrush Bubble Monster
stories.text: Brrrring! Morning sunshine peeked through Leo’s bedroom window, painting the walls with golden light. Leo rubbed his sleepy eyes and hopped out of bed. It was a brand-new day full of adventures! But first, Leo knew just what he needed to do. He trotted into the bathroom, climbed up on his little blue stepping stool, and looked in the mirror. Suddenly, a cheerful, tickly voice whispered from the sink. 'Good morning, Leo! Time to chase away the sugar bugs!' Who could that be? Leo looked down and saw a tiny, silly Bubble Monster sitting right on the edge of the sink. He was wearing a crown made of glittering toothpaste foam and holding a bright green toothbrush. 'I am the Toothbrush Bubble Monster!' he giggled. 'Let us make your teeth sparkle like stars!' Leo picked up his own blue toothbrush and squeezed a tiny, pea-sized dot of sparkly mint toothpaste onto the bristles. 'Ready?' asked the Bubble Monster. 'Ready!' said Leo with a big grin. Together, they started brushing. Up and down went Leo’s toothbrush. Back and forth, just like a little train chugging along the track. Choo-choo! The Bubble Monster began to huff and puff, blowing sparkling white bubbles all around Leo’s mouth. Soon, Leo looked in the mirror and laughed out loud. He had a big, fluffy white beard made entirely of toothpaste foam! He looked just like a wise old wizard. 'Look at my bubbles!' Leo cheered. He brushed the front, he brushed the back, and he tickled the tops of his smiling teeth. When they were all finished, Leo rinsed his mouth with cool water and spit into the sink. Swish, spit! His teeth felt wonderfully smooth and looked so shiny and bright. The Toothbrush Bubble Monster gave a happy little bow and popped into a cloud of peppermint freshness. 'Fantastic brushing, Leo!' whispered the fading voice. Leo puffed out his chest, feeling so proud and big. His teeth were sparkling clean and ready for a happy day.

stories.title: Mia and the Hand-Washing Bubble Monster
stories.text: Splash, swish, scrub! Mia and her puppy had just finished playing outside in the wonderful garden. They dug in the rich brown dirt, watered the pretty red flowers, and chased the buzzing bumblebees. Mia’s hands were covered in tiny specks of garden soil. 'Phew! Time to wash up before snack time!' said Mommy with a warm, loving smile. Mia walked to the bathroom sink and climbed onto her pink wooden step. But before she could turn on the silver faucet, a tiny, tickly puff of suds appeared on the soap pump. Pop! Out jumped the Hand-Washing Bubble Monster! He was wearing a hat made of lavender-scented foam and dancing a happy little jig. 'Hello, Mia! Let us make magic bubbles to chase the dirt away!' said the Bubble Monster. Mia giggled and turned on the warm water, feeling it gently wash over her fingers. Then, she pressed the soap pump once, twice. Squirt, squirt! A plump puddle of slippery soap landed right in the center of her palms. 'Rub, rub, rub!' chanted the Bubble Monster. Mia rubbed her hands together, palm to palm. The soap turned into a thick, creamy mountain of white bubbles. She washed the back of her hands, tickled her thumbs, and even cleaned inside her little fingernails where the sneaky dirt liked to hide. The Bubble Monster spun around in circles, blowing sparkling bubbles that floated up toward the bathroom lights. 'Look at my magic suds!' Mia sang out happily. She rinsed her hands under the warm, comforting stream of water, watching all the dirty soap slide down the drain. When she dried her hands on the fluffy pink towel, they smelled like sweet spring flowers and felt as soft as silk. The Bubble Monster gave Mia a cheerful wave and whispered, 'Spotless hands, great job, Mia!' Mia beamed with pride. She was clean, she was fresh, and she was ready for her yummy snack.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the little toes in the warm tub water! Sammy loves the water, but tonight, something very exciting is about to happen. Mommy smiles and pours a special, sweet-smelling bubble soap right under the running faucet. Whoosh! Up, up, up rise the fluffy, white suds, growing bigger and taller until they look like a whole mountain of soft clouds. Sammy claps his hands with joy. 'Look! It is the Bubble Monster!' he giggles. But this Bubble Monster is not scary at all. He is gentle, and he loves to play. Sammy watches as a big, round bubble sits right on top of his washcloth. 'Can we wash your tummy, Bubble Monster?' Sammy asks softly. He takes a gentle scoop of warm water and gives the tub a nice, gentle wipe. Mommy helps Sammy wash behind his ears and between his little fingers, making sure all the dirt from the day washes away down the drain. Every time Sammy does a great job, Mommy gives him a warm hug and says, 'You are doing wonderful, my big helper!' Washing up can sometimes feel a little tricky, but with a cheerful smile and a brave heart, Sammy makes it so much fun. Next, it is time to rinse. Sammy closes his eyes tight while Mommy pours a cup of clean, warm water over his hair. No tears today, just big, brave breaths! The Bubble Monster slowly shrinks, popping with a soft, happy *pop-pop-pop* sound, turning the bathwater into a cozy pool. Sammy reaches for his fluffy yellow duck towel, wrapping himself up snug and warm. He feels so fresh, so clean, and so very proud of himself. As he puts on his soft pajama stars, Sammy knows that taking care of his body is an awesome adventure. Goodnight, little bubbles! Goodnight, Sammy!

stories.title: Leo Wins the Brush-A-Lot Crown
stories.text: Rise and shine, little Leo! Morning sunlight dances across the bedroom floor, and a brand-new day is waiting. But before breakfast, Leo has a very important mission to complete. It is time to visit the bathroom sink and meet the magical Bubble Monster! Leo marches right up to his bright blue stepstool and climbs up safely. He grabs his favorite red toothbrush with the soft, friendly bristles. 'Time to chase the sugar bugs away!' Leo says in his best superhero voice. Daddy puts a tiny, pea-sized dot of sparkly mint toothpaste right on top. Now comes the best part. Leo starts to brush in little circles. Up and down, back and forth, tickling every single tooth. Soon, the toothpaste mixes with water and creates a wonderful, fizzy foam inside his mouth. 'Roar!' Leo giggles, showing his bubbly white teeth in the mirror. 'I am the Bubble Monster today!' The foam tickles his lips, but Leo keeps right on going, brushing the front, the back, and way in the very back corners where the tricky food tries to hide. Daddy counts to twenty out loud, and Leo brushes the whole time like a champion. 'You are doing a fantastic job, Leo! Your smile is shining brighter than the sun!' Daddy cheers, giving him a high-five. When the time is up, Leo spits the bubbly foam into the sink and takes a big sip of water from his favorite green cup to swish and rinse. *Swish, swish, spit!* All clean! Leo looks in the mirror and gives himself a big thumbs-up. His mouth feels so minty-fresh and cool. Brushing his teeth twice a day keeps his smile strong and healthy, ready for lots of happy giggles, delicious snacks, and bright new adventures all day long.

stories.title: Maya and the Hand-Washing Magic
stories.text: Stomp, stomp, paint! Maya has been busy all morning long making a wonderful masterpiece with bright red, yellow, and blue fingerpaints. Her hands are covered in colorful spots, just like a happy little ladybug. But now, Mommy says it is time for lunch, which means Maya’s hands need a special kind of magic. Maya hops down from her little yellow chair and walks right over to the bathroom sink. She climbs onto her sturdy wooden stool and looks at her rainbow fingers. 'Time to wash up!' Maya says cheerfully. Mommy turns on the warm water so it feels just right—not too hot and not too cold. Maya stretches out her hands under the gentle stream. Then, Mommy pumps a big, squishy mound of golden, scented soap right into Maya’s palms. It feels slippery and ticklish! Now the fun begins. Maya rubs her hands together, palm to palm, making mountains of creamy lather. 'Abracadabra, alakazam, let the soapy magic begin!' she sings softly. The soap turns into the friendly Bubble Monster, tickling her wrists and hiding between her fingers. Maya remembers all the important steps. She scrubs the backs of her hands, making sure to get every little painted corner. She sweeps around her thumbs like a little windshield wiper. She even scratches her fingernails gently against her soapy palms to get all the hidden dirt out. Mommy sings a sweet ABC song while Maya works hard, keeping her hands busy and happy. When the song finishes, Maya holds her hands under the running water. Watch the bubbles slide away, carrying all the germs and paint down the drain! *Swoosh!* Maya shakes her hands gently like a wet puppy, letting the sparkling water drop off. She takes a fluffy pink towel and pats her skin until it is dry and cozy. Maya holds up her clean hands and smiles proudly. They smell like fresh strawberries and look ready for a yummy lunch. Taking care of herself makes Maya feel like she can do anything!

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubble Monster
stories.text: Splish, splash, splosh! It was time for Sammy's evening bath, but Sammy was not quite ready to hop in. Suddenly, from inside the warm, soapy water, a funny little sound popped up. Pop! Pop! Pop! Out rose the Bubble Monster! He was not scary at all. He was bright, fluffy, and smelled just like sweet strawberries. 'Hello, Sammy!' giggled the Bubble Monster in a voice as soft as a whisper. 'Are you ready for a grand bubbly adventure?' Sammy’s eyes went big and wide. 'A bubbly adventure?' he asked with a happy grin. 'Oh, yes!' said the Bubble Monster. 'First, we need to wash your hair, but we can wear a special crown.' The Bubble Monster scooped up a big handful of suds and placed them right on top of Sammy’s head. Look at that! Sammy had a tall, magnificent white crown made entirely of shiny bubbles. 'You look like the king of the bathtub!' cheered the Bubble Monster, doing a happy little splash with his soapy toes. Sammy giggled and splashed his hands in the warm water. It was so much fun! Next, the Bubble Monster needed help washing Sammy’s strong arms. Sammy scrubbed with his soft green washcloth, making lots of happy bubbles dance all around. 'Look at you go!' praised the Bubble Monster, clapping his bubbly hands together. 'You are doing such a wonderful job keeping your body clean and healthy.' Sammy felt very proud. He loved being strong and taking good care of himself. When it was time to rinse, Sammy tipped his head back just like a brave explorer, letting the warm water wash all the suds away. The Bubble Monster gave Sammy one last big, warm hug of soapy air before gently floating away into the drain, leaving behind a very clean, very happy little boy. Sammy wrapped up in his cozy, fluffy dinosaur towel, feeling warm, sleepy, and so proud of his wonderful bath-time adventure.

stories.title: Leo and the Toothbrush Bubble Monster
stories.text: Rise and shine, little Leo! It was morning time, which meant it was time to wake up the teeth and brush away the sleepy bugs. But Leo wanted to keep playing with his toy cars. Suddenly, right on top of the blue toothbrush, something magical started to grow. It was the friendly Toothbrush Bubble Monster! He had big, wiggly eyes made of foam and wore a sparkling cape of toothpaste. 'Good morning, Leo!' sang the Bubble Monster in a cheerful, minty voice. 'Are your teeth ready to sparkle like shiny white stars today?' Leo looked at the fun little monster and giggled. 'Can my teeth really sparkle?' he asked. 'The sparkliest in the whole wide world!' said the Bubble Monster. 'Let us go on a brushing quest together.' Leo picked up his toothbrush with a big, determined smile. The Bubble Monster showed him just how to do it. 'Up and down, round and round, tickle the molars without a sound!' they chanted together. Leo moved his brush gently, making lots of bubbly white foam appear. The foam tickled his lips, and Leo laughed out loud. 'Look at all those happy bubbles!' cheered the Bubble Monster. 'You are brushing like a super-star!' Leo brushed the front, he brushed the back, and he even brushed his tongue to chase away any grumpy morning breath. Brushing his teeth felt like playing a wonderful game right there at the sink. When they were all finished, Leo spat gently and rinsed his mouth with a cup of cool water. He flashed a huge, wide grin in the mirror. His teeth looked bright, beautiful, and amazingly clean! 'Great job, Leo!' whispered the fading Bubble Monster, leaving behind a fresh, minty breeze. Leo gave a high-five to the mirror. He was growing up so big and strong, and he loved keeping his smile bright every single day.

stories.title: Maya and the Clean-Up Bubble Monster
stories.text: Playtime was wonderful, but now the living room floor was covered in colorful blocks, soft teddy bears, and puzzle pieces. Mama said it was time to tidy up, but Maya sat down on the rug with a little sigh. Cleaning up felt like such big work for a little girl. Just then, a soft pop sounded near the toy box. Out bounced the Clean-Up Bubble Monster! He was round, bouncy, and danced on tiny, tippy-toe feet made of shimmering soap suds. 'Hello there, champion tidy-upper!' cheered the Bubble Monster. 'Did somebody say it is time to make our room shine bright?' Maya looked up and smiled at her funny new friend. 'I am too little to clean up all these toys by myself,' Maya whispered softly.
