'Oh, you are never too little for a magical bubble mission!' said the Bubble Monster. 'Let us pretend every toy is a bouncy bubble that needs to float right back into its home.' Maya loved that fun idea! She stood up and grabbed her big red toy basket. 'Ready, set, go!' whooped the Bubble Monster. Maya picked up a yellow block and tossed it inside the basket. Clank! That was one bubble safely home. Next came the fluffy brown bear. Maya gave him a gentle hug and tucked him right on the shelf. 'Wonderful job!' clapped the Bubble Monster, swirling around her in a happy circle. 'You are super fast and super smart!' Maya felt a warm glow of happiness inside her heart. She picked up a blue puzzle piece, then a green car, marching them to their special spots just like a helpful little parade. Together, Maya and the Bubble Monster worked as a team, singing a silly clean-up song. Before she knew it, the floor was completely clear and the room looked neat, tidy, and beautiful. 'Mission accomplished!' cheered the Bubble Monster, giving Maya one final, sparkly high-five before turning into a shower of happy, floating soap bubbles that danced toward the window. Maya beamed with pride, feeling so wonderful about taking care of her special space.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the little toes! It is time for Sammy’s evening bath, but Sammy is not quite sure he wants to wash his hair today. Suddenly, out of the warm, swirling water, a funny little sound pops up. Pop! Pop! Pop! It is the Bubble Monster! He is not scary at all. He is round, shiny, and smells just like sweet strawberries. The Bubble Monster gives a gentle wiggle and wears a fluffy hat made entirely of suds right on top of his head. He looks at Sammy and giggles a bubbly giggle. 'Hello, little friend!' says the Bubble Monster in a soft, tickly voice. 'Are you ready to make some magic?' Sammy smiles because the Bubble Monster looks so silly. Together, they scoop up handfuls of warm, soapy water. Sammy makes a giant bubble beard on his own chin. Look at Sammy! He looks just like a wise old wizard! The Bubble Monster claps his soapy hands together, sending tiny floating bubbles dancing all around the bathroom. They float up to the ceiling like twinkling stars. Sammy learns that washing his hair is actually a super fun adventure when the Bubble Monster is around. The gentle water washes away all the dirt from the playground, and Sammy feels warm, cozy, and refreshed. The Bubble Monster gives Sammy one last gentle high-five, whispering that Sammy did a wonderful job getting ready for bed. Sammy wraps up in his favorite warm towel, feeling proud, clean, and happy. Bath time is the best time of all.

stories.title: Leo's Magic Brush and the Sticky Monster
stories.text: Brushing teeth can sometimes feel like a tricky puzzle, but tonight is going to be extra special for little Leo. After eating a delicious dinner, Leo’s teeth need a sparkling clean-up. Suddenly, a tiny creature pops out from behind the faucet. It is the Bubble Monster, holding a toothbrush that sparkles like a rainbow! 'Hooray for bedtime teeth cleaning!' cheers the Bubble Monster. He has sparkly white teeth that shine like little pearls. The Bubble Monster teaches Leo the secret magic song of the brush. Up and down go the bristles, side to side go the gentle circles. Leo opens wide, and the Bubble Monster makes silly funny faces to help Leo laugh. Together, they chase away the sticky sugar bugs that are hiding behind the molars. Every time Leo brushes a tooth, a little puff of sparkly bubble magic appears in the sink. Leo swishes and spits just like a big boy, feeling so proud of his bright, shining smile. The Bubble Monster gives Leo a warm, gentle hug and whispers in his ear that he is a super-duper star. Cleaning teeth is not a chore at all; it is a way to keep his smile healthy and strong for all the new adventures tomorrow will bring. Leo crawls into his soft bed, showing off his clean teeth with a big, happy grin, ready for sweet dreams.

stories.title: Mia's Hand-Washing Bubble Dance
stories.text: After playing outside in the big sandbox all morning, Mia’s hands are covered in tickly sand and mud. It is time to wash up before lunch! Mia steps up to the sink, but the water feels a little chilly. Who is that peeking out from the soap pump? It is the friendly Bubble Monster, waving hello with all four of his slippery, soapy arms. 'Time for a bubble dance!' sings the Bubble Monster, creating a mountain of foamy white bubbles right in Mia's palms. Mia pumps the soap and rubs her hands together. Scrub-a-dub-dub! The Bubble Monster shows her how to wash between her fingers, just like little spider legs crawling up a hill. They sing a silly song about washing the dirt away. Mia watches as the mud turns into funny gray bubbles that slide right down the drain. The warm water rinses her hands clean, making her skin feel soft and fresh. The Bubble Monster blows one enormous, shiny bubble that rests gently on Mia’s finger for just a second before floating up toward the sky. Mia claps her clean hands together and giggles with joy. She did it all by herself! The Bubble Monster gives her a happy thumbs-up, telling her what a great helper she is. With clean hands, Mia is ready to eat her yummy lunch and play safely all afternoon long.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubble Monster
stories.text: Splish, splash, splosh! It was time for Sammy’s evening bath, and Sammy loved the warm water. But sometimes, washing hair could feel a little tricky. Mommy turned on the tap, and wonderful, soapy bubbles began to fill the tub. They grew bigger and bigger until they formed a friendly visitor: the Bubble Monster! Now, this was not a scary monster at all. The Bubble Monster was soft, shiny, and made entirely of fluffy white soap suds. 'Hello, Sammy!' giggled the Bubble Monster in a squeaky, bubbly voice. 'Are you ready for our special cleaning adventure tonight?' Sammy clapped his hands with joy. 'Yes, Mr. Bubble Monster! Let us do it!' First, the Bubble Monster gave Sammy a funny bubble beard on his chin. Sammy looked in the mirror and laughed out loud at his fluffy white chin whiskers. You look magnificent, Sammy! You are the bravest bubble captain in the whole wide world,' whispered the monster. Next, it was time to wash Sammy’s hair. Mommy gently massaged the sweet-smelling shampoo, and the Bubble Monster placed a magnificent crown of soap bubbles right on Sammy’s head. Sammy tilted his head way back just like a brave little explorer looking up at the clouds. He did not mind the water at all because he was playing with his good friend. When the rinse cup poured warm water over his curls, the bubbles gently floated away, carrying all the daytime dirt right down the drain. Sammy felt so clean, so cozy, and so very proud. 'Good job keeping your eyes closed and being so strong,' cheered Mommy, giving him a big warm hug. The Bubble Monster gave one last little pop and whispered, 'Great job today, Sammy. I will see you tomorrow night for more splashing fun!' Sammy wrapped up in his soft dinosaur towel, feeling happy, clean, and ready for a peaceful night of sweet dreams. Bath time was simply the best adventure in the whole wide world.

stories.title: The Bubble Monster Cleans Up the Toys
stories.text: The living room floor was a wonderful, colorful wonderland of toys. There were shiny red blocks, rolling blue cars, and soft cuddly bears sitting everywhere you looked. It was time for Leo to tidy up before dinner, but sometimes picking up everything all by yourself can feel like a big job. Suddenly, Leo heard a happy little giggle near the toy box. Whoosh! A magical breeze blew through the room, and the friendly Bubble Monster appeared with a friendly wave. 'Hello, Leo! It is time for a secret mission,' whispered the Bubble Monster, tickling his tummy with a soft, soapy finger. Leo giggled and hugged his knees. 'What kind of mission, Bubble Monster?' The monster pointed to the red blocks. 'We need to catch the bouncy building blocks before they roll away to sleep! Can you help me?' Leo nodded eagerly. 'I am a super helper!' Down on the soft carpet went Leo, crawling fast like a happy little puppy. He picked up one red block, two yellow blocks, and three green blocks, marching them right back to their cozy home inside the wooden toy box. 'Great job, little builder!' cheered the Bubble Monster. Next, the monster pointed to the toy cars. 'Vroom, vroom! Let us drive the sleepy cars into the garage!' Leo zoomed his favorite fire truck across the floor, parking it right next to the blocks. The Bubble Monster clapped his fluffy hands together. Every time Leo picked up a toy, the monster gave him a gentle high-five, making magical soapy sparks fly in the air. In just a few minutes, the floor was clean, clear, and ready for tomorrow's games. Leo looked around and felt so proud of his shiny, tidy room. 'We did it together!' smiled Leo, giving the invisible monster a gentle hug in the air. Mommy walked in and gasped with happy surprise. 'Oh, Leo, look how wonderful your room looks! You are such a helpful big boy.' Leo beamed with pride, knowing that cleaning up could be an amazing game when you have a bubbly friend to help you along the way.

stories.title: The Bubble Monster Brushes His Teeth
stories.text: Brushing teeth can sometimes be a little bit tricky, but not tonight! Maya stood on her bright yellow step stool in front of the bathroom sink. She squeezed a tiny, pea-sized dot of sparkly strawberry toothpaste onto her brand-new toothbrush. It smelled sweet like summer berries. Suddenly, right in the bathroom mirror, a funny face popped up. It was the friendly Bubble Monster! He had a big, wide smile made of sparkling white soap bubbles. 'Hello, Maya!' said the Bubble Monster. 'Are you ready to chase the sugar bugs away with your magical toothbrush wand?' Maya grinned and nodded. 'Yes! Let us find them!' The Bubble Monster made a silly brushing motion on his own round tummy, making Maya laugh out loud. 'First, we brush the top teeth, way up high where the little clouds live! Up and down, round and round,' sang the Bubble Monster. Maya carefully moved her toothbrush, pretending it was a zooming spaceship cleaning the stars. Up and down went the bristles, making wonderful foaming bubbles. 'Now, let us tickle the bottom teeth! Down low where the grass grows green,' whispered the monster. Maya brushed her bottom teeth with gentle, careful circles, making sure every single tooth felt super clean and shiny. 'Do not forget the back molars, where the munchy snacks like to hide,' reminded her friendly helper. Maya reached her toothbrush all the way to the back and said, 'Aaaaah!' just like a little dinosaur. When she finished, she rinsed her mouth with a cup of cool water and spit it out safely into the sink. She looked in the mirror and showed off a row of sparkling, bright teeth. The Bubble Monster gave her a huge thumbs-up and whispered, 'You did it, Maya! Your smile shines brighter than the morning sun.' Mommy walked in and gave Maya a big kiss on her cheek. 'Look at those gorgeous, clean teeth! You did such a wonderful job taking care of your smile.' Maya felt so proud, happy, and ready for bed, knowing her teeth were clean and strong.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the little toes! Evening time is here, and it is time for Sammy’s warm, cozy bath. Sammy loves the water, but washing hair can sometimes feel a little tricky. Today, Mommy has a wonderful surprise. She squeezes a big squirt of fluffy, scented soap right onto her hand and puffs a gentle breath. Poof! A giant, floating bubble appears right in the air. Sammy giggles with pure delight. "Look!" says Mommy, smiling brightly. "It is the Bubble Monster! But do not worry, little one. This Bubble Monster is friendly, soft, and loves to help us get super clean!" Sammy reaches out with soapy fingers to touch the floating orb. Pop! It bursts into tiny, happy drops. "Hooray!" cheers Sammy. The Bubble Monster wants to play a game. It loves hiding on little elbows, behind pink ears, and right on top of sleepy heads. Sammy watches in the mirror as a big, fluffy white bubble crown rests on his head. He looks just like a bath-time king! Mommy gently washes his hair while telling silly stories about where the Bubble Monster lives. It lives in the land of warm water and squeaky-clean toes! Sammy helps by washing his arms, rubbing gently just like the kind monster shows him. The warm water feels so soothing, washing away all the tiredness of the big day of playing. When it is time to drain the tub, Sammy waves goodbye to his bubbly friends as they swirl down the drain. "Bye-bye, Bubble Monster! Thank you for helping me wash!" Sammy steps out of the bath and wraps up in a big, fluffy towel that feels like a warm hug. He is clean, cozy, and ready for sweet dreams. You did such a wonderful job in the bath today, Sammy!

stories.title: Leo Learns to Brush with the Bubble Monster
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! The sun is peeking through Leo’s bedroom curtains, which means a brand-new day of fun has begun. After a yummy breakfast, it is time for a very important job: brushing teeth! Sometimes Leo likes to keep playing with his blocks instead, but Daddy has a fun trick up his sleeve. Daddy puts a tiny pea-sized drop of sparkly blue toothpaste onto Leo’s little yellow toothbrush. Then, Daddy makes a funny, roaring sound. "Oh no!" whispers Daddy with a playful grin. "The mischievous Morning Bubble Monster has appeared! He is hiding inside your mouth, and he loves to tickle teeth until they shine like bright little stars! Can we find him?" Leo’s eyes go wide with excitement. He opens his mouth wide, just like a roaring little lion. "Ahhh!" Leo says proudly. Daddy gently guides the toothbrush, and together they brush the top teeth, the bottom teeth, and way in the back. As the toothpaste mixes with water, lovely little white bubbles begin to form. "Look at the bubbles!" Leo squeals around the brush. The Bubble Monster is making fizzy magic happen right inside his mouth! Leo brushes back and forth, up and down, making sure every single tooth gets a special visit from the bubbly friend. When they finish, Leo rinses with a big gulp of water and spits it out into the sink with a big, proud splash. He flashes a huge, radiant smile in the mirror. His teeth look so bright and healthy. "Good job brushing away the sleepy germs!" Daddy cheers, giving Leo a high-five. Leo feels so proud of his sparkling smile and his fun helper, the friendly Bubble Monster. Brushing teeth is wonderful!

stories.title: Maya’s Magic Hand-Washing Adventure
stories.text: Muck, muddle, and mud! Maya has been having the most wonderful time playing outside in the garden. She dug deep holes in the dirt, planted shiny red tomato seeds, and built a magnificent castle out of wet mud. Now, her tummy is rumbling for lunch, which means it is time to wash her hands. Maya runs inside, but wait! Her hands look like funny little paws covered in brown mud. "Stop right there!" says Grandma with a warm, loving laugh. "Before we eat our yummy sandwiches, we must call upon the Kitchen Bubble Monster to make our hands sparkling clean!" Grandma helps Maya step up onto her sturdy blue stool so she can reach the silver sink. The warm water runs gently, turning into a soothing stream. Grandma pumps a dollop of sweet-smelling strawberry soap right into Maya’s little palms. "Rub your hands together, Maya!" encourages Grandma. Maya rubs her hands fast, fast, fast. Abracadabra! Out pop the magical bubbles! The soap transforms into a mountain of soft, white foam. Maya looks closely and sees the Bubble Monster playing hide-and-seek between her fingers. She cleans her thumbs, tickles her palms, and washes right up to her wrists. She watches the colorful soap suds swirl around like dancing fairies in the sink. "Wash away the garden dirt!" sings Maya happily. Then, she holds her hands under the warm running water to rinse every single bubble away. Grandma hands Maya a bright green towel with yellow ducks on it. Maya dries her hands thoroughly, smelling her fingers. They smell like sweet strawberries and fresh air! "All done!" Maya beams, showing her clean hands proudly. Grandma claps her hands in delight. Washing hands is such a fun adventure, especially with the help of a friendly Bubble Monster!

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the little toes in the warm tub! It is evening time, and Sammy is getting ready for bed. But wait, what is that floating in the water? Poof! A giant, shiny bubble pops right on Sammy’s nose! Sammy giggles, 'Hello, Bubble Monster!' The Bubble Monster is not scary at all. In fact, he is very silly and loves to play in the water. 'Can you wash Sammy’s hair?' asks Mommy. The friendly Bubble Monster helps make a big, fluffy crown of white soap bubbles right on top of Sammy’s head. Sammy looks in the mirror and sees a funny bubble king! 'Time to rinse, little king,' says Mommy gently. Sammy pours a cup of warm water and says goodbye to the bubbles as they float down the drain. 'Goodnight, Bubble Monster!' whispers Sammy, feeling so cozy and clean. Sammy wraps up in a fluffy green frog towel that feels like a warm hug. Brushing teeth comes next, and Sammy smiles big and bright. Into pajamas go Sammy's arms, one sleeve at a time. Such a great helper! Mommy and Daddy give Sammy big bedtime kisses. Sammy climbs into bed, hugging a soft blanket. The room is quiet and peaceful. As Sammy closes sleepy eyes, the happy memories of the playful Bubble Monster dance gently in the gentle night. Goodnight, Sammy. You did a wonderful job getting clean and ready for sleep today. Sweet dreams!

stories.title: Leo and the Toothbrush Bubble Monster
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! It is a brand new day, and Leo is waking up. After a yummy breakfast, it is time for a very important job: brushing teeth! Leo picks up a blue toothbrush with soft, gentle bristles. 'Roar!' says Leo. But wait, what is that bubbling up in the mouth? It is the friendly Toothbrush Bubble Monster! The Bubble Monster loves to help make teeth sparkly and clean. With a dab of minty toothpaste, the Bubble Monster helps Leo make tiny white bubbles all around. Up and down, side to side, round and round go the bristles. The Bubble Monster hums a happy song while Leo brushes away the sleepies from the teeth. 'Spit, spit, swish!' goes Leo into the sink. Wow, look at that bright, beautiful smile! The mirror shows a very proud little boy. The Toothbrush Bubble Monster gives a gentle wave and says, 'Great job keeping those teeth strong and healthy, Leo!' Leo feels so proud of this big-kid skill. Brushing teeth every morning and every night keeps all the little tooth fairies very happy. Leo washes hands and face, feeling fresh and ready to play blocks and puzzles. What a super start to the day! With a happy heart and sparkling clean teeth, Leo runs off to build a giant tower. You are growing up so fast, Leo, and you do such an amazing job taking care of your wonderful body every single day!

stories.title: Mia and the Hand-Washing Bubbles
stories.text: Before we eat our yummy snacks, what do we need to do? Wash our hands! Mia runs to the bathroom sink, but the water is a little too low to reach. Daddy puts down a sturdy green step stool. Step up, step up, goes Mia! Now Mia is big enough to reach the sparkly handle. Turn it on: warm water goes gush, gush, gush. Time for the magic soap! Pump, pump, goes the soap dispenser, and a squishy blob of pink soap lands right in Mia's palms. Rub, rub, rub go the hands together. Look closely! Out pops the Hand-Washing Bubble Monster! This bouncy little monster loves to tickle fingers and palms. 'Tickle, tickle!' giggle the bubbles as they grow bigger and bigger. Mia counts them: 'One bubble, two bubbles, three bubbles, a whole bunch!' The Bubble Monster helps wash between the fingers and under the thumbnails, where tiny hidden germs like to hide. Mia sings the silly monster song while scrubbing. When the hands are all covered in a lovely, sweet-smelling foam, it is time for the rinse. The warm water washes the Bubble Monster away down the drain, taking all the dirt along for the ride. Mia grabs a soft yellow towel and pats the hands until they are completely dry. 'All clean!' cheers Mia. Daddy smiles and gives a proud high-five. Mia's hands smell like sweet strawberries and are ready for lunch. You are such a helpful, healthy superstar, Mia. Washing hands is so much fun!

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the little toes! Evening time is here, and it is time for Sammy’s warm, cozy bath. Sammy loves the water, but today, Sammy is feeling a little bit shy about getting hair washed. Mommy smiles and says, "Look who is waiting to help us today! It is the friendly Bubble Monster!" Sammy’s eyes grow big and bright. "Where is he, Mommy?" Mommy scoops up a giant handful of soapy, fluffy bubbles and places them right on top of Sammy’s head like a crown. "Roar!" says Mommy in a funny, gentle monster voice. "I am the Bubble Monster, and I love clean hair!" Sammy giggles and claps little hands. The Bubble Monster is not scary at all; he is soft and smells like lavender. "Can I make a Bubble Monster too?" asks Sammy. "Of course you can!" says Mommy. Sammy dips little hands into the warm water, scoops up lots of slippery soap, and presses it onto both cheeks. Now Sammy has big, fluffy bubble cheeks! Looking into the mirror, Sammy smiles a big, happy smile. Together, Sammy and the Bubble Monster wash away the day. They wash the arms, the tummy, and the wiggly toes. Sammy pours water over the soap to help the bubbles pop away. Pop, pop, go the bubbles, tickling all the way down the drain! Sammy feels so fresh, so clean, and so very proud. Mommy wraps Sammy in a big, warm towel hug. "You did such a wonderful job today, my little superstar," whispers Mommy. Sammy gives the towel a squeeze, ready for sweet dreams after a fun bath time.

stories.title: Leo and the Toothbrush Bubbles
stories.text: Rise and shine, little Leo! Morning sunbeams are dancing on the bedroom wall. It is time to start a brand new day of fun and learning. After breakfast, Leo marches right into the bathroom and looks up at the big mirror. It is time to brush those shiny teeth! Leo picks out a bright blue toothbrush with soft, gentle bristles. But wait, what is that hiding inside the minty toothpaste tube? It is the friendly Toothbrush Monster! This monster loves sparkling teeth more than anything else in the whole wide world. Leo squeezes a tiny pea-sized dot of paste onto the brush, just like a little green button. Then, the Toothbrush Monster wakes up with a friendly wiggle. "Hello, Leo! Let us make some magical brushing bubbles together!" whispers the monster in Leo’s imagination. Leo opens the mouth wide and says, "Ahhh!" The toothbrush goes round and round, up and down, making soft little circles on every tooth. Up go the top teeth, down go the bottom teeth, and tickle, tickle go the back teeth. Soon, a funny thing happens. The toothpaste starts to foam up inside the mouth, making a wonderful white beard of bubbles! Leo looks in the mirror and laughs out loud. The Toothbrush Monster is helping create a bubbly masterpiece! "Time to rinse and spit," says Daddy, holding the little plastic cup of water. Leo takes a big sip, swishes it all around, and spits it safely into the sink. Swoosh! Down goes the water. Leo shows Daddy a brilliant, sparkling smile. "Look, Daddy! All the sleepy sugar bugs are gone!" Daddy cheers, "Great job brushing, Leo! Your teeth are sparkling bright." Leo feels so proud and happy, ready to conquer the day.

stories.title: Maya and the Toy Cleanup Monster
stories.text: The playroom is full of fun, laughter, and so many colorful toys! Blocks are piled high like tall castles, soft teddy bears are resting on the play rug, and shiny little cars are parked in a row. It has been a wonderful day of play, but now the big clock says it is time to tidy up before dinner. Maya looks at the messy floor and sighs. There are just too many toys to pick up alone! Mommy kneels down on the floor and gives Maya a warm, encouraging hug. "Do not worry, Maya! We have a very special helper coming to visit us today. Meet the Toy Cleanup Monster!" Maya tilts the head and asks, "Is he hungry?" Mommy nods and says, "Oh, yes! The Cleanup Monster loves to gobble up blocks, bears, and cars, but his tummy only likes toys that belong in the toy box." Maya’s eyes light up with excitement. "I want to feed him!" Mommy opens the big yellow toy box wide. "Roar!" says Mommy, pretending to be the hungry Cleanup Monster with her hands making chomping motions. Maya giggles and grabs a big red block. "Nom, nom, nom!" goes Maya, feeding the block right into the box. Then Maya grabs three furry teddy bears and feeds them to the monster too. "Munch, munch, munch!" The toy box is getting full and happy. Every time Maya puts a toy away, the Cleanup Monster does a happy little wiggle. Maya works super fast, picking up every single crayon, puzzle piece, and book. Within just a few minutes, the floor is completely clean and clear. Mommy claps her hands in joy. "Look at this amazing playroom! You are the best cleaner in the whole world, Maya!" Maya beams with pride, feeling so accomplished and ready for the next fun adventure.

stories.title: Sammy and the Bath-Time Bubbles
stories.text: Splish, splash, go the happy toes! Bath time is here, and little Sammy is ready for a bubbly adventure. The warm water feels so cozy, like a big, gentle hug for his tired little body. First, Mommy pours a tiny bit of special, sweet-smelling soap right under the running tap. Watch, Sammy! Look what happens! Magic happens in the tub as big, fluffy white clouds start to grow and grow. They pop up like little mountains of softness. Sammy claps his hands with joy and giggles out loud. 'Look, Mommy! A Bubble Monster!' he calls out happily. The Bubble Monster is very friendly. He does not scare Sammy at all. Instead, he wants to play! He wears a silly bubble hat right on top of Sammy’s head, making him look like a funny little king. Sammy points to his dirty little toes. 'Oh no, Bubble Monster, my toes are hiding in the dirt!' he says. Together, Sammy and the bubbly water go on a rescue mission. Sammy uses a soft yellow washcloth to gently wash his arms, his tummy, and his playful little legs. The soap makes everything smell like fresh spring flowers. The friendly bubbles tickle his skin, making him laugh and smile even bigger. Sammy is doing such a wonderful job keeping himself clean and healthy. Bath time is not a chore; it is a wonderful, playful game of make-believe. When the water starts to go down the drain, Sammy waves goodbye to his soapy friends. 'Bye-bye, Bubble Monster! See you tomorrow!' he says cheerfully. He steps out of the tub and wraps himself in a big, warm towel that feels like a cozy blanket. Sammy feels so fresh, so clean, and so very proud of his wonderful bath-time adventure. Great job, Sammy! You are a super star at taking care of your growing body every single day.

stories.title: Leo's Magic Hand-Washing Monster
stories.text: Ring, ring! Goes the big clock downstairs, and little Leo knows exactly what time it is. It is time to wash those busy little hands! Leo has been painting, playing outside in the soft dirt, and building tall block towers all morning long. His fingers have worked so very hard. Now, it is time to make them sparkle and shine again. Leo walks proudly into the bright, cheerful bathroom and stands right on his sturdy blue stepping stool. He turns on the warm water with a gentle twist. Ah, nice and cozy! Next, Leo takes the pump bottle and presses down. Squish! Out pops a dollop of slippery, bubbly pink soap that looks just like a tiny cloud. Leo rubs his hands together, fast, fast, fast! Up come the bubbles, growing taller and fluffier with every single rub. 'Hello there, Bubble Monster!' Leo whispers with a giant grin. The Bubble Monster lives right between Leo’s fingers and on the backs of his hands. To make sure the friendly monster goes everywhere, Leo sings his favorite hand-washing song. He scrubs the top of his hands, he scrubs underneath his fingernails where the tiny dirt bugs like to hide, and he gives his thumbs a big squeeze. Scrub-a-dub-dub, in the sudsy tub! Leo is so independent and does such an amazing job all by himself. Mommy and Daddy are watching, and they smile with so much love and pride. Now it is time for the final step. Leo holds his hands under the warm running water and watches all the soapy bubbles slide away down the drain. He dries his hands on a fluffy green frog towel. They smell so fresh and clean! Leo holds up his hands and cheers. Hooray for clean hands! He is ready for his next big toddler adventure.

stories.title: Maya and the Brushing Bubbles
stories.text: Time to brush, little star! Maya hops out of bed and marches right to the bathroom, ready for her favorite morning routine. She grabs her bright purple toothbrush with the soft, friendly bristles. Today is a very special day because the minty toothpaste is going to help her grow strong, shiny teeth. Maya squeezes just a tiny pea-sized drop onto her brush, doing it all by herself. Look at her go! She is such a big girl now. Maya opens her mouth wide, just like a happy little lion. Ahhhh! She gently moves her toothbrush in little circles, tickling her top teeth, her bottom teeth, and the very back ones too. Up and down, side to side, brushing every single one. Suddenly, the minty toothpaste mixes with the water and creates a fun surprise. A friendly Bubble Monster appears right inside Maya's mouth! He is made of bubbly white foam and loves to dance on her teeth. Maya giggles around her toothbrush because the tiny bubbles tickle her tongue. 'Hello, Bubble Monster!' she thinks to herself. She brushes carefully to help her little friend clean away all the sticky sugar bugs that were hiding after breakfast. Maya keeps going, counting to ten in her head. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! What an incredible helper she is. When she is all finished, Maya spits the foamy water into the sink. She rinses her mouth with a cup of cool water and wipes her chin with a soft cloth. She flashes a wide, bright smile in the mirror, showing off her sparkling clean teeth. The Bubble Monster gives a happy wave as he washes down the drain. Maya feels so refreshed and proud of her wonderful daily habit. You did it, Maya! Your bright, healthy smile lights up the whole room and makes everyone around you feel so happy.

rhymes.title: The Tub-Time Bubbles
rhymes.text:
The water is warm and the bathroom is bright,
We splash and we play in the soft soapy light.
Look at the monster, so fluffy and tall,
He’s made of big bubbles that bounce like a ball!

Put soap on your fingers and wash your cute toes,
Then give the big monster a tickle his nose.
He pops with a giggle and floats in the air,
With soapy white clouds in his messy hair.

Scrub up your shoulders and rinse off your back,
While yellow rubber duckies go quack-quack-quack!
The monster gets smaller as water goes down,
He wears a nice bubble right on his crown.

Now dry with a towel, so cozy and warm,
Safe from the splashes and bubbly storm.
The bath is all finished, the monster is gone,
We put our soft pajamas on!

rhymes.title: The Hand-Washing Monster
rhymes.text:
The Bubble Mon-ster loves to play,
To chase the dirty germs away.
He lives beside the bathroom sink,
And blinks his soapy eyes to blink.

Turn on the water, nice and warm,
To help us through the soapy storm.
Pump out the soap, one, two, and three,
And mix it up so happily.

Rub on your palms and in between,
To make your little fingers clean.
Scratch on your nails and wash your thumbs,
While singing catchy toddler hums.

Rinse all the bubbles down the drain,
And shake your hands just like the rain.
The monster smiles because you're bright,
And your clean hands are shining white!

rhymes.title: The Brushing Bubble Beast
rhymes.text:
Open wide and let's say cheese,
Brush the back teeth, if you please.
The monster hides behind your smile,
And stays to help you for a while.

Up and down and round and round,
Making not a single sound.
Brush the top and brush the low,
Watch the foamy bubbles grow!

Tickle the tongue to make it sweet,
From the head down to the feet.
The monster wears a fuzzy coat,
Right down by your little throat.

Spit the bubbles in the cup,
Drink a little water up.
Your teeth are sparkly, clean, and bright,
Ready for a happy night!

rhymes.title: The Clean-Up Bubble Friend
rhymes.text:
The toys are scattered on the floor,
Let's pick them up and count some more.
The Bubble Monster loves to sweep,
And help the little toddlers leap.

Put the blocks inside the bin,
Let the tidy game begin!
Find a puzzle, find a bear,
Put them neatly on the chair.

The monster gobbles blocks like snacks,
And puts them neatly in their stacks.
Pick up crayons, red and blue,
There is work for me and you.

Now the floor is clear and neat,
Ready for our happy feet.
The monster does a little dance,
And gives the room a second glance!

rhymes.title: The Sleepy Bubble Cloud
rhymes.text:
The day is done, the stars are out,
The monster turns himself about.
He changes to a sleepy cloud,
Without a single murmur loud.

Put on your pj's, soft and sweet,
From your head down to your feet.
Climb into your little bed,
And lay your heavy sleepy head.

The monster sings a lullaby,
Beneath the gentle starry sky.
Close your eyes and drift away,
Until the dawning of the day.

Dream of bubbles floating high,
Up into the sleepy sky.
Sleepy hugs and kisses too,
The monster whispers, I love you!

rhymes.title: The Big Bath Bubbles
rhymes.text:
Time to wash and time to play,
Wash the dirt of day away.
Fill the tub with water warm,
Watch the bubbles start to form.

Bubble monster, big and round,
Floating softly off the ground.
Pop a bubble on my toe,
Watch the soapy water glow.

Wash my tummy, wash my knee,
Splish and splash is fun for me.
Scrub the fingers, scrub the toes,
Wipe the water off my nose.

Now the bath is done and dry,
Time to wave a happy bye.
Bubble monster goes away,
We will play another day.

rhymes.title: Brush the Teeth
rhymes.text:
Time to brush your teeth so white,
Morning time and deep at night.
Bubble monster starts to creep,
While the little teeth fall sleep.

Grab the brush and squeeze the paste,
No more time for us to waste.
Up and down and all around,
Hearing such a happy sound.

Brush the molars in the back,
Keep them on a healthy track.
Spit the water in the sink,
Take a yummy sip to drink.

Now your smile is shining bright,
Sparkling in the morning light.
Bubble monster says goodbye,
Time to wave and wave oh high.

rhymes.title: Put On Your Shoes
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Shoes are waiting for my sight.
Bubble monster helps me choose,
Which are my two favorite shoes.

Left foot, right foot, find the way,
Ready for a brand new day.
Push the heel in nice and deep,
While the laces start to sleep.

 Velcro straps go criss and cross,
Today I am the happy boss.
Jump up high and stomp the floor,
Ready now to walk the door.

Shoes are snug and shoes are neat,
Happy walking little feet.
Bubble monster claps his hands,
Dancing in the happy lands.

rhymes.title: Clean Up Time
rhymes.text:
Toys are scattered on the floor,
Time to tidy up some more.
Bubble monster takes a look,
Puts away the picture book.

Blocks go in the yellow bin,
Let the cleaning game begin!
Teddy bear is tucked in bed,
Resting up his fuzzy head.

Crayons in their little box,
Matching up the tiny socks.
Pick up every single toy,
Bring around a lot of joy.

Room is neat and floor is clear,
Glad that cleaning time is here.
Bubble monster gives a cheer,
Best helper of the year.

rhymes.title: Time for Bed
rhymes.text:
Stars are peeking through the sky,
Moon is glowing up on high.
Bubble monster starts to yawn,
Resting till the early dawn.

Pajamas soft and cozy warm,
Safe away from any storm.
Teddy holding tight and deep,
Ready now to fall asleep.

Sing a little sleepy tune,
Underneath the shining moon.
Close your eyes and breathe in slow,
Where the happy dreamlands go.

Sleepy head is on the bed,
Blanket tucked up to the head.
Bubble monster whispers low,
Sweet dreams wherever you go.

rhymes.title: The Tub-Time Bubble Monster
rhymes.text:
Oh look into the water deep,
The Bubble Monster's taking a leap!
He grows so big and fluffy and white,
To make our bath time such a delight.

He has ten arms of sudsy foam,
And in the bathtub he makes his home.
He tickles your toes and washes your nose,
From the very top down to your toes.

Now grab the washcloth nice and soft,
And lift the monster up aloft.
We scrub the tummy and scrub the knee,
As happy as can ever be.

Then splash goes water, goodbye my friend,
The monster washes right down the bend.
Your skin is clean and smelling so sweet,
A bubbly bath is quite a treat!

rhymes.title: The Hand-Washing Bubble Monster
rhymes.text:
When playing outside in the dirt and the play,
The Bubble Monster comes out to play!
He hides on your fingers, he hides on your thumb,
And waits for the water to make a hum.

Turn on the faucet and get things wet,
We'll catch the monster, you can bet!
Pump the soap with a little squeak,
Right on your hands so soft and sleek.

Rub them together, front and back,
We're on the Bubble Monster's track.
Between the fingers and up the wrist,
Not a single bubble will be missed.

Rinse them off with the water clear,
The monster is gone and there is no fear.
Your hands are sparkly and ready to eat,
Now wash those hands and take your seat!

rhymes.title: The Hair-Brushing Bubble Monster
rhymes.text:
The hair-brushing monster is fluffy and bright,
He loves to comb in the morning light.
He sits on your pillow and giggles and beams,
Just like a character out of your dreams.

He brings out a brush that is purple and pink,
To fix up your hair in just a quick blink.
No tangles or knots are allowed to stay,
We brush them all right away and away.

Start at the bottom and work to the top,
We give the little hair monster a hop.
He makes all your curls look so pretty and neat,
From your crown down to your feet.

Give it a twist and give it a bow,
The monster is ready to let you go.
You look so handsome and shine so bright,
Go have a wonderful day and delight!

rhymes.title: The Tooth-Brushing Bubble Monster
rhymes.text:
The tooth-brushing monster loves minty fresh air,
He dances around in your bathroom chair.
He holds up a toothbrush with bristles so blue,
And waits for a happy big smile from you.

Put on some paste like a fluffy white cloud,
The tooth-brushing monster is singing aloud.
Brush all the molars way back in the deep,
While all of the sleepy-time fairies sleep.

Up and down like a little train track,
Moving forward and moving right back.
Brush the front and brush the behind,
The kindest monster you ever could find.

Spit in the sink and rinse with the cup,
The monster helps you to clean it all up.
Your teeth are gleaming and shining so white,
Ready for bed and a sweet goodnight!

rhymes.title: The Dress-Up Bubble Monster
rhymes.text:
The morning is here and the sun is up high,
The dressing-up monster is waving hi!
He lives in the closet behind the red door,
And drops little socks all over the floor.

First find your shirt with the puppy so sweet,
Pull it right down to your tummy and seat.
Next put your legs in the pants one by one,
Getting dressed up is so much fun!

Shoes on the left and shoes on the right,
Tie up the laces to make them so tight.
The monster is clapping his hands with glee,
Because you are dressed as big as can be.

Off to the kitchen for breakfast we go,
The dressing-up monster puts on a show.
You did it yourself and you look so grand,
The very best helper in all the land!

rhymes.title: The Big Bubble Bath
rhymes.text:
Time to splash and time to play,
Wash the dirt and germs away!
Here comes the Bubble Monster, see?
He wants to tickle you and me.

He makes a beard of soapy white,
Sparkling in the bathroom light.
Scrub your toes and wash your knees,
Listen to the monster sneeze!

Pop the bubbles in the air,
Wash the shampoo from your hair.
Twirl around and stomp your feet,
Now you smell so nice and sweet.

Monster leaves with lots of suds,
Time to put on cozy duds.
Clean and happy, off to play,
We had so much fun today!

rhymes.title: Brush With The Monster
rhymes.text:
Open wide and let us sing,
Brushing is a happy thing!
The Bubble Monster loves the paste,
He helps us clean and leaves no waste.

Up and down and all around,
Hear the happy brushing sound.
Tickle teeth from back to front,
That is what the monster wants.

Brush the top and brush the low,
Watch the foamy bubbles grow!
Swish the water, spit it out,
Give a happy monster shout.

Pearls are shining, bright and clean,
Bestest teeth you've ever seen.
Ready now for bed or play,
Have a super duper day!

rhymes.title: Clean Up Monster
rhymes.text:
Toys are scattered on the floor,
Time to tidy up once more!
The Bubble Monster needs a snack,
Put the building blocks right back.

Feed him teddies, feed him cars,
Put the puzzles in their jars.
He is munching with delight,
Making all the playroom bright.

Pick up pillows, stack the books,
Look how nice the carpet looks!
Not a single toy in sight,
Everything is neat and right.

Monster rubs his tummy round,
Happy that no toys are found.
High-five, toddler, look at you,
All the clean-up work is through!

rhymes.title: Wash Those Tiny Hands
rhymes.text:
Time to wash before we eat,
Clean from fingers to our feet!
The Bubble Monster brings the soap,
To wash away the dirt, let's hope.

Rub them fast and rub them slow,
Watch the soapy bubbles grow.
Between the fingers, thumb and palm,
Keep the monster nice and calm.

Turn the water, let it rinse,
Sparkling like a tiny prince!
Grab the towel, dry them tight,
Now your hands are pure and white.

Monster gives a cheerful cheer,
Food time is so very near.
Sit right down and grab your spoon,
We will eat and play real soon!

rhymes.title: Sleepy Monster Night-Night
rhymes.text:
Stars are shining in the sky,
Little toddler, do not cry.
The Bubble Monster yawns and sighs,
Rubbing sleepy monster eyes.

Time to put on PJ's soft,
While the moon is high aloft.
Climb into the cozy bed,
Lay your heavy sleepy head.

Monster tucks you in real tight,
Whispering a sweet goodnight.
Close your eyes and drift away,
Rest until the brand new day.

Dream of bubbles in the air,
Monster guards you right up there.
Sleepy hugs and kisses too,
Night-night, darling, love to you.

rhymes.title: The Big Bath Bubble
rhymes.text:
Time to wash from toes to head,
Before we jump into our bed.
The water sparkles, clean and bright,
We splash around with pure delight.

Look up high and look down low,
Watch the soapy bubbles grow!
Floating gently in the air,
Resting softly in my hair.

Mr. Bubble Monster, please come play,
Help us wash the dirt away.
Scrub the tummy, scrub the knee,
Splish and splash and laugh with glee.

Now the water starts to drain,
Time to dry and rest again.
Fresh and clean from top to toe,
Ready for our beds we go.

rhymes.title: Monster Scrub-A-Dub
rhymes.text:
The Bubble Monster loves the tub,
He gives my little arms a rub.
With soap and water, soft and sweet,
We wash from head down to our feet.

Catch the bubbles in your hand,
Floating through our bathtub land.
Pop them fast and pop them slow,
Watch the sudsy mountains grow.

Wash the fingers, wash the toes,
Wash the funny little nose.
Splash the water, hear it sound,
Happiest boy in all the town.

All the bubbles fade away,
We had so much fun today.
Wrapped up in a towel so warm,
Safe inside our cozy storm.

rhymes.title: The Sudsy Surprise
rhymes.text:
Rub-a-dub and hear the cheer,
The Bubble Monster now is here!
Bringing suds of white and blue,
To wash the messy toddler too.

Pump the soap and make it foam,
Right inside our bathroom home.
Big white hats upon our head,
Time to wash just like I said.

Scrub the elbows, scrub the back,
Floating like a little quack.
Rinse it off with water clear,
No more sticky spots, my dear.

Now the bath time fun is done,
We had lots and lots of sun.
Dry and cozy, snug and bright,
Time to sleep and say goodnight.

rhymes.title: Floating Bubble Magic
rhymes.text:
Listen to the water sing,
Bath time is a joyful thing.
The Bubble Monster brings a crown,
The biggest one in all the town.

Blow a bubble, watch it fly,
Up into the bathroom sky.
Pop! It vanished with a spark,
Leaving us without a dark.

Wash the knees and wash the toes,
Wipe away the soapy blows.
Splash the water in the tub,
Give yourself a happy rub.

Now the skin is soft and sweet,
Clean from head down to my feet.
Pajamas on, we cuddle tight,
Sleep until the morning light.

rhymes.title: The Giggly Suds
rhymes.text:
Here comes the Bubble Monster friend,
He stays with us until the end.
He makes the water bubbly blue,
And cleans up happy toddlers too.

Giggly bubbles in a row,
Where do all the bubbles go?
Catch them quickly, don't let drop,
Make the little bubbles pop!

Wash the hands and wash the face,
Cleanliness is full of grace.
Rinse the soap and wash away,
Ending such a lovely day.

Snuggled in a blanket fort,
Bath time was our favorite sport.
Close your eyes and drift away,
Ready for another day.

rhymes.title: The Big Bath Bubble Monster
rhymes.text:
Splish and splash inside the tub,
Now it is time for a scrub!
Look what's growing in the foam,
Right inside our bathroom home.

A furry monster made of suds,
Tickling all our little buds.
He has arms of soapy white,
Shining in the morning light.

Catch the bubbles on your nose,
Tickle down to tiny toes.
Wash the tummy, wash the knee,
Happy monster, happy me!

Now he shrinks and floats away,
We will see him another day.
Drain the water, time to dry,
Wave the bubble friend goodbye.

rhymes.title: Monster on the Mirror
rhymes.text:
Time to brush your teeth so bright,
Make them sparkle in the light.
Watch out for the bubble beast,
Waiting for a little feast!

He is made of minty paste,
Not a single bit to waste.
Brush the top and brush the low,
Watch the funny monster grow.

Foamy bubbles on your chin,
Let the silly game begin.
Scrub the back and scrub the front,
Doing all the brushing stunt.

Rinse it out and spit it clear,
No more bubble monsters here.
Smile big for everyone to see,
 Sparkling clean as you can be!

rhymes.title: Handwashing Bubble Party
rhymes.text:
Turn the water nice and warm,
Keep away the tummy worm!
Pump the soap and count to three,
Join the bubble jamboree.

Rub your hands up high and low,
Watch the soapy monster go.
In between each little finger,
Where the germs like best to linger.

Scratch your palms and scrub your wrists,
Clap your happy little fists.
Monster bubbles floating high, )
Reaching all the way to the sky.

Rinse them off and shake them dry,
Give the dirty germs goodbye.
Now your hands are fresh and sweet,
Ready for a tasty treat!

rhymes.title: The Laundry Room Bubble Friend
rhymes.text:
Dirty clothes go in the bin,
Let the laundry fun begin.
Where is little bubble pet?
Hiding in the water yet!

Pour the soap and watch it spin,
Wash the clothes and tuck them in.
Bubbles dancing round the glass,
Watch the happy monster pass.

He is wearing socks of blue,
Having lots of washing-up too.
Spinning round and spinning fast,
Cleaining all our clothes at last.

Now the cycle comes to rest,
Clean and dry is what is best.
Fold the shirts and hug the bear,
Bubble freshness everywhere.

rhymes.title: Bedtime Bubble Lullaby
rhymes.text:
Day is done and night is near,
Time to rest, my little dear.
Did you see the sleepy sprite,
Making bubbles in the night?

He is made of pillow down,
Floating softly through the town.
Blow a bubble, count to four,
Drop it gently on the floor.

Close your eyes and breathe in deep,
Bubble monster goes to sleep.
Cover up with blankets warm,
Safe away from any storm.

Dream of bubbles in the sky,
While I sing a lullaby.
Rest your head and softly sigh,
Little bubble friend, goodnight.

rhymes.title: The Big Bath Bubbles
rhymes.text:
Time to wash and time to play,
Wash the dirt and germs away.
Fill the tub up to the brim,
Time for little ducks to swim.

Squeeze the soap and make it foam,
Bubble monsters love to roam.
On your nose and on your toes,
Watch how high the bubbles go!

Pop the bubbles in the air,
Wash the shampoo in your hair.
Rub-a-dub from top to toe,
See the soapy water flow.

Splash around and feel so clean,
Now you are the brightest bean!
Wrap you in a towel so warm,
Safe and cozy from the storm.

rhymes.title: Brush the Teeth
rhymes.text:
Time to brush your teeth today,
Chase the sugar bugs away.
Get your brush and paste so sweet,
Make those little teeth look neat.

Up and down and all around,
Listen to the scrubbing sound.
Brush the top and brush the low,
Watch the foamy bubbles grow!

Spit the bubbles in the cup,
Wipe your happy smiling up.
Now your teeth are shining bright,
Ready for a day of light.

Keep them healthy, keep them strong,
Sing our little brushing song.
Open wide and give a grin,
Let the happy day begin!

rhymes.title: Put On Your Shoes
rhymes.text:
Put your shoes upon your feet,
Ready for a walk downtown street.
Left foot first and then the right,
Tied up nice and snug and tight.

Velcro straps go pull and stick,
Put them on both fast and quick.
Jump up high and touch the sky,
Wave the little birds goodbye.

Run along and skip and play,
Walking down the sunny way.
Tiny shoes are made to tread,
Following where we are led.

When we get back home to rest,
Taking off our shoes is best.
Put them nicely in the hall,
Ready for the fun of all.

rhymes.title: Clean Up Toys
rhymes.text:
Time to put the toys away,
We are done with games today.
Blocks go in the wooden chest,
Time to give the room a rest.

Teddy bear sits on the bed,
Resting up his fuzzy head.
Crayons in their little box,
Fold up all the baby socks.

Pick up yellow, pick up blue,
There is so much work to do.
Work together, hand in hand,
Cleanest room in all the land.

Now the floor is neat and clear,
Glad to see the evening near.
Give a clap and shout hooray,
For a happy cleaning day.

rhymes.title: Bedtime Routine
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the sky,
Birds are singing soft goodbye.
Pajamas on and feeling nice,
Listening to the bedtime advice.

Read a story, dim the light,
Time to say a sweet goodnight.
Tuck the blankets round your chin,
Let the sleepy dreams begin.

Close your eyes and breathe in deep,
Now it is the time for sleep.
Angels watching from above,
Filled with peace and gentle love.

Morning comes with sunny rays,
Starting up our happy days.
Rest your head upon the bed,
Sweetest dreams inside your head.

rhymes.title: The Big Bath Bubbles
rhymes.text:
Time to take a bubbly bath,
Splish and splash and make a laugh!
The bubble monster starts to rise,
Right up to my little eyes.
He wears a hat of sudsy white,
Shining in the bathroom light.
Scrub the fingers, scrub the toes,
Tickle on the sleepy nose.
Wash the tummy, wash the knee,
Happy bubble time for me!
The monster floats up in the air,
Tangled in my washing hair.
Pop him gently with a pat,
Hello, goodbye to Mr. Bat!
Water drains down in the tub,
Time to dry and give a rub.

rhymes.title: Brush the Teeth Bubbles
rhymes.text:
The tooth-brushing monster wakes up with a roar,
Chomping big apples all over the floor.
He loves minty toothpaste, so yummy and bright,
To make all my pearly white grin feel just right.
Up and down, side to side,
Open up your mouth up wide!
Brush the molars in the back,
Clickity-clack and snack-a-sack.
Gargle water in a cup,
Spit it all right safely up!
The monster says thank you for shining my grin,
Now bedtime and sleeping can happily begin.

rhymes.title: Getting Dressed Bubbles
rhymes.text:
The morning is here and the sun is quite high,
A dressing-up monster is ready to fly!
Find the soft socks with the bright yellow heels,
Jumping around like a set of big wheels.
Put on the shirt with the cute little bear,
Brush out the tangles and curls in my hair.
Pants go on legs one and legs two,
Monster is clapping and shouting out woo!
Shoes on the feet, left one and right,
Stepping outside in the morning so bright.
Ready for school and ready to play,
We are so happy to start a new day!

rhymes.title: Clean-Up Time Bubbles
rhymes.text:
The toy-eating monster is hungry for blocks,
And puzzle pieces and mismatched socks.
Pick up the teddy and put him away,
We worked very hard and we had a great day.
Red blocks and blue blocks go into the bin,
Smile as the cleanup is coming to win.
Books on the shelf in a neat little row,
Now where did that little brown puppy go?
Wipe up the table and push in the chair,
The clean-up-time monster is waving hello there.
Everything shiny and everything neat,
Time for a snack and a nice little treat.

rhymes.title: Bedtime Routine Bubbles
rhymes.text:
The sleepy-time monster is ready for bed,
Yawning a yawn with a nod of his head.
Put on pajamas with rockets and stars,
Flying away to the planet of Mars.
Read a nice story of puppies and cows,
Making soft noises like sweet little bows.
Turn off the lights and look at the glow,
Singing a lullaby sweet and so low.
Hug and a kiss for mommy and dad,
Best little bedtime we ever could have.
Close little eyes and drift into dreams,
Floating along on the silvery streams.

rhymes.title: The Morning Bubble Monster
rhymes.text:
Wake up, little sleepy head,
Time to jump right out of bed!
Look who's hiding in the tub,
Ready for a soapy scrub.

It's the Bubble Monster here,
Shouting out a happy cheer!
He loves water, yes it's true,
And he wants to play with you.

Grab the sponge and squeeze it tight,
Make the little bubbles white.
Wash your toes and wash your nose,
Watch how fast the giant grows.

Now rinse off the suds and foam,
Splash a happy little home.
Clean and fresh from head to toe,
Ready for the day to go!

rhymes.title: The Brush-A-Tooth Monster
rhymes.text:
Time to brush your teeth so bright,
Make them sparkle in the light.
Here comes Monster, big and green,
Keeping every molar clean.

Up and down the bristles go,
Scrubbing fast and scrubbing slow.
Catch the bubbles as they fly,
Wave the little bugs goodbye.

Brush the top and brush the down,
Best old monster in the town.
Spit the water in the sink,
Take a happy little drink.

Now your smile is shining wide,
Monster smiles right by your side.
Teeth are healthy, strong, and white,
Ready for a day so bright!

rhymes.title: The Tidying Bubble Monster
rhymes.text:
Time to put the toys away,
We are done for fun today.
Monster comes to lend a hand,
Best helper in all the land.

Blocks go in the big red bin,
Let the counting now begin.
One and two and three and four,
No more toys upon the floor.

Teddy Bear goes on the bed,
Pillow resting for his head.
Monster dances round the room,
Sweeping with a tiny broom.

Everything is neat and square,
Tidy toys are resting there.
Monster gives a cheerful cheer,
Glad to help out every year!

rhymes.title: The Hand-Washing Monster
rhymes.text:
Wash your hands before we eat,
Make them smelling fresh and sweet.
Here is Monster at the sink,
Faster than a happy blink.

Turn the water nice and warm,
Keep away each little germ.
Pump the soap and rub it round,
Make a squeaky little sound.

 между fingers, thumbs as well,
Watch the magic soapy spell.
Rinse the bubbles down the drain,
Sunshine coming out again.

Dry your hands upon the towel,
No more dirt and no more scowl.
Monster gives a high-five sign,
Little hands are looking fine!

rhymes.title: The Bedtime Bubble Monster
rhymes.text:
Sun is setting in the sky,
Time to wave the day goodbye.
Monster yawns a sleepy yawn,
Waiting for the early dawn.

Pajamas cozy, soft, and warm,
Safe from any windy storm.
Climb into the little bed,
Pillow waiting for your head.

Monster whispers sweet goodnight,
Tucks you in and turns off light.
Close your eyes and drift away,
Dreaming of another day.

Sleepy monster guards the door,
Quiet on the bedroom floor.
Stars are shining up above,
Filled with hugs and bedtime love.

rhymes.title: The Big Bath Bubbles
rhymes.text:
Time to wash the day away,
Come and join the bubble play!
Rub the soap until it's white,
Make the little piggies bright.
Look at fingers, look at toes,
Bubbles sitting on my nose.
Scrub the tummy, scrub the knee,
Splish and splash, so wild and free!
Wash the hair and wash the back,
Floating like a yellow duck.
Now the water swirls around,
Not a single speck of ground.
Drain the tub and pull the plug,
Time to get a cozy hug.
Wrapped up warm and feeling sweet,
Clean from head down to my feet!

rhymes.title: Bubble Monster's Brush
rhymes.text:
See the monster in the glass,
Watch the foamy bubbles pass.
Grab the brush with green and blue,
Time to squeeze the minty glue.
Up and down and all around,
Making not a grumpy sound.
Brush the teeth so nice and white,
Make them sparkle in the light.
Little circles on the right,
Left side shining super bright.
Gargle water in a cup,
Spit it all right down and up.
Wipe the mouth and give a smile,
We can sparkle for a while.
Monster teeth are clean and grand,
Bestest monster in the land!

rhymes.title: Dressing Up With Bubbles
rhymes.text:
Bubble monster wants to play,
Getting dressed to start the day.
Find the socks with silly feet,
Pull them up so nice and neat.
Push the arms into the sleeves,
Falling down like autumn leaves.
Button up the yellow shirt,
Ready now to dodge the dirt.
Pull the pants up to the waist,
Moving with a happy haste.
Slip the sneakers on the toes,
Tie the laces in a bow.
Look at monster in the glass,
Watch the happy toddler pass.
Ready for a sunny walk,
Ready for a happy talk!

rhymes.title: Tidy Up The Bubble Toys
rhymes.text:
Bubble monster loves to play,
Now it's time to put away.
Pick the rubber duck up high,
Tell the yellow bird goodbye.
Drop the boats into the bin,
Let the cleanup game begin.
Scoop the cups and stack them tall,
Catch the bouncing plastic ball.
Not a toy left on the floor,
Close the toy box, shut the door.
Monster helps to make things neat,
Doing such a heavy feat.
Wipe the splashes off the tile,
Give a very proud big smile.
Everything is put away,
Time for some more happy play!

rhymes.title: Bedtime Bubble Lullaby
rhymes.text:
Bubble monster starts to yawn,
Stars are waking up the dawn.
Wash the sleepy face with care,
Brush the tangles from the hair.
Put pajamas soft and sweet,
Cover up the tired feet.
Lay the little head down low,
Watch the sleepy shadows grow.
Read a story by the light,
Kiss the pillow and sleep tight.
Whisper soft a sleepy tune,
Underneath the silver moon.
Monster dreams of skies of blue,
Loving little friends like you.
Close your eyes and drift away,
Till the dawning of the day.

stories.title: Sammy's Magic Salon Day
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Sammy woke up and stretched. 'Good morning, sunshine!' said Mama. Today was a very special day. It was time for a magic salon day at home to give Sammy’s happy hands and feet a little refresh. Sammy loved magic. Mama brought out a shiny silver tray with a soft yellow brush, a gentle spray bottle of lavender water, and tiny clippers that looked just like a sleeping ladybug. 'First, let us brush your golden curls,' Mama whispered. Spritz, spritz went the lavender water. It smelled like sweet summer flowers! Sammy closed his eyes and giggled as the soft bristles danced through the hair, smoothing out all the sleepy tangles. 'All done with the hair! Look in the mirror, you look like a royal prince!' Mama cheered. Sammy clapped his hands, feeling very proud. Next, it was time for the fingernails. 'Time for the ladybug to tickle your fingertips,' Mama said softly. Sammy held out his hands, practicing his superhero strength by staying very still. Click, click, went the ladybug. It did not hurt at all; it just tickled a little bit! Mama counted every single finger. 'One, two, three, four, five! High five!' Sammy shouted, bumping his palm against Mama's. Then came the toes. Wiggle, wiggle went the little piggy toes before the ladybug gave them a quick trim, too. When they were all finished, Mama put a shiny gold star sticker on the back of Sammy's hand. 'You were the best little customer in the whole wide world,' Mama praised, giving Sammy a big warm hug. Sammy smiled, twirled around in the bathroom, and ran off to play with his blocks, feeling fresh, clean, and wonderfully happy all day long.

stories.title: Pip the Bear's Cozy Trim
stories.text: Deep in the green woods, a little teddy bear named Pip was getting ready for a fun playdate with his woodland friends. Pip hopped out of his cozy bed and looked in his little wooden mirror. His fluffy brown hair was standing straight up in the air like a funny little mountain, and his claws were getting a bit too long for hugging. 'Oh my,' said Papa Bear with a warm smile. 'Let us get you looking extra cozy for your friends today, little Pip.' Pip trusted Papa Bear more than anyone. Papa sat Pip right up on the big fluffy bathroom stool and tied a bright blue cape around his neck just like a real superhero. First, Papa took a big, fluffy brush. 'Time to tame the wild forest hair,' Papa chuckled gently. Stroke by stroke, the brush smoothed down Pip's fur until it was soft as a cloud and smelled like sweet honey. Pip let out a happy sigh and blinked his sleepy brown eyes. 'Now for the little claws,' Papa said, holding up a small, friendly nail file that looked like a smooth river stone. 'We just want to make them smooth so you can give the best bear hugs.' Pip held his paws out straight and strong. He pretended he was a brave mountain bear holding still for a gentle breeze. Gentle scratch, scratch, scratch went the stone file. Papa counted each paw, making up a silly song about bumblebees and honey pots. Pip giggled through the whole thing. When the very last claw was smooth and neat, Papa gave Pip a high-five with a gentle paw bump. 'You are the coziest, bravest bear in the forest,' Papa whispered. Pip looked at his neat paws and his shiny fur, did a happy little spin, and bounded out the door to share wonderful hugs with all his friends.

stories.title: Luna's Starry Spa Time
stories.text: Evening was coming, and the stars were just beginning to peek out in the night sky. Little Luna was getting ready for her cozy bedtime routine, but first, it was Starry Spa Time! Luna loved Starry Spa Time because it meant extra cuddles and special care from Daddy. Daddy turned on the warm bathroom light, making it glow like a friendly moon. He laid out a soft pink towel that felt as plush as a bunny rabbit. 'Time to brush those lovely locks and keep your fingers dancing,' Daddy whispered softly. Luna climbed up on the big stool and put her hands in her lap like a good little princess. Daddy picked up a pink paddle brush with soft cushion bumps. As Daddy gently brushed Luna’s long hair, he sang a soothing lullaby about twinkling stars. Luna closed her eyes and swayed to the music. Every tangle melted away like a snowflake in the sun. 'Your hair is shining just like the night sky,' Daddy said lovingly. Next, it was time for the tiny fingernails and toenails. Daddy brought out a magical singing nail clipper that played a quiet little tune whenever it clicked. 'Can you show me your butterfly hands?' Daddy asked. Luna held her hands out flat and still, pretending she was a butterfly resting on a flower. Click, click, click went the clippers, shaping her nails so they were neat and tidy. Luna felt so grown-up and peaceful. Daddy gave each toe a gentle tickle as he finished the little toes. When the spa time was all done, Daddy wrapped Luna in the warm bunny towel and gave her a giant kiss on the forehead. 'You are our shining star, Luna,' Daddy said proudly. Luna snuggled into bed, feeling clean, cozy, and ready for the sweetest dreams.

stories.title: Sammy's Salon Day
stories.text:
Once upon a time, a little bunny named Sammy woke up ready for a very special adventure. Today was Sammy's Salon Day! Sammy hopped into the big kitchen chair and waited for the magic to begin. First came the hairbrush. Oh, how Sammy loved the soft bristle brush. Gentle scratch, gentle stroke, smoothing down every fuzzy little brown ear. 'Look at you, Sammy! You look like a fluffy superstar!' Mommy said with a warm, loving smile. Sammy giggled and shook his ears, feeling so fresh and neat.

Next, it was time for the tiny finger wiggle check. Sammy looked down at his paws. The little nails had grown just a tiny bit too long during all his digging and playing. 'Time for a little tidy-up,' Mommy whispered softly. Sammy held out his hand just like a brave little explorer. Snip, snip, went the little blue clippers. They didn't hurt at all! They just made a tiny sound like a little bird chirping. With every single snip, Sammy counted a happy number. One, two, three, four, five! High-five for the left hand.

Then came the right hand. Sammy imagined his fingers were little branches on a tree, staying very still so the gentle wind could blow. Snip, snip, snip. All done! Mommy kissed every single freshly trimmed finger and gave Sammy a sparkly star sticker. Sammy ran straight to the big mirror in the hallway. He twirled around and around. His hair was neat, his nails were short and smooth, and he was ready for a brand-new day of fun. 'Good job, Sammy!' he cheered, patting his own soft head. What a wonderful salon day it had been.

stories.title: Leo's Magical Hair Wash and Clip
stories.text:
Ring-a-ling-ling! It was bath time for Leo the little lion cub. But this wasn't just any ordinary bath—it was the Great Hair and Nail Safari! Leo had a lovely golden mane that loved to catch bubbles. Mommy scooped up a handful of warm, bubbly shampoo that smelled just like sweet strawberries. She gently massaged it onto Leo's head. 'Time to make a bubble crown, Leo!' she cheered. Leo looked in the mirror and roared a happy, bubbly roar. The bubbles tickled his nose, making him sneeze a cute little lion sneeze.

After the bubbly hair wash and a cozy towel dry, Leo's mane was soft as a cloud. But wait! Leo looked down at his paws. His little lion claws were getting a bit long from all his roaring and running through the jungle rug. 'Shall we keep our paws nice and neat for our animal friends?' asked Daddy, bringing out the special orange nail file. Leo nodded bravely. He knew that taking care of his body was an important part of growing up big and strong.

Daddy sat Leo on his lap and sang a sweet lullaby. While the music played, Daddy gently touched each claw. File, file, file, went the soft emery board. It felt just like a gentle tickle on his fingertips. Leo closed his eyes and practiced his deep belly breaths, just like a sleeping lion in the sun. In, two, three. Out, two, three. Before Leo even finished his breathing, Daddy whispered, 'All finished, little lion!' Leo flexed his paws proudly. Not too sharp, just right for gentle high-fives. Daddy and Mommy cheered for their brave boy, giving him the biggest bear hugs in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Mia's Sparkly Star Salon
stories.text:
Mia loved playing dress-up, and today her bedroom was turning into the Sparkly Star Salon! Mia sat down on her pink cushion, holding her favorite teddy bear tight. 'First, we must brush our hair until it shines like the morning sun,' said Grandma, bringing out a shiny red brush with bouncy bristles. Mia closed her eyes and tilted her head just a little bit. Stroke by stroke, the brush glided through her curls. It felt so relaxing, just like a warm summer breeze blowing through the trees. Mia let out a happy sigh and smiled.

'Now comes the magic manicure for our little dancing fingers,' Grandma whispered warmly. Mia held out her hands, palms up, ready to be a good listener. Grandma used a pair of colorful clippers that had little ladybugs painted on the side. Every time Grandma snipped a nail, a ladybug flew a pretend circle in the air. Snip, snip, go the ladybugs! Mia laughed out loud at the funny game. She kept her fingers as still as little sleeping statues.

When the fingernails were all neat and tidy, it was time for the tiny toes. Mia wiggled her toes like happy little wiggly worms. Grandma tickled the bottom of Mia's foot just for fun before gently trimming the toenails too. Snip, snip, little ladybug trip! When everything was all done, Grandma rubbed a dab of sweet-smelling cherry lotion onto Mia's hands. It felt so smooth and cool. Mia clapped her freshly polished hands together and gave Grandma a huge hug. 'Thank you, Grandma! I am sparkly clean and ready to play!' Grandma smiled and kissed Mia's forehead, so proud of her sweet girl.

stories.title: Sammy's Salon Day
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Sammy woke up with messy, curly hair that reached all the way down to his nose! 'Good morning, sweet Sammy,' said Mama. 'Today is our special Gentle Salon Day! Let us make your hair happy and bright.' Sammy loved the sound of that. He sat right up on a soft, cozy pillow chair and put on a shiny yellow cape. It made him feel like a superhero getting ready for a big adventure. Mama brought out a special magic brush with soft, rainbow bristles. First, she started way down at the tips of the curls, gently tickling out any little tangles. 'Be gentle, be kind,' whispered Mama, and Sammy giggled because it felt like a little head massage. 'Phew! All gone!' cheered Sammy as the brush glided smoothly from the top of his head all the way to the bottom. Next, it was time for his fingernails. They had been working so hard building tall block towers and digging in the sandbox that they needed a little spa trim. Mama brought out a tiny, friendly nail clipper that looked just like a sleeping ladybug. 'Tick-tock, clip-clip, let us trim the tips,' sang Mama softly. Sammy held out his hands proudly, watching the little nails float away like tiny confetti. 'Look at those strong, healthy fingers!' praised Mama. When they were all done, Sammy looked in the mirror and flashed a giant, sparkly grin. He clapped his hands together, feeling so fresh, clean, and ready to take on the whole wide world with his brand new day.

stories.title: Leo the Lion's Mane
stories.text: Leo the little lion loved to roar! Roar! Roar! But today, Leo’s golden mane was feeling a little bit sleepy and tangled from all his big dreams. 'Time to brush the lion's mane!' said Papa, holding up a sparkly star-shaped brush. Leo cuddled his favorite stuffed bear tight. 'Will it hurt, Papa?' asked Leo softly. Papa smiled warmly and gave Leo a gentle nose-kiss. 'Not at all, my brave little cub. We are going to make your mane look like a glowing crown.' Papa started at the very bottom of Leo's hair, working his way up with soft, whispering strokes. 'Soft as a feather, smooth as a cloud,' chanted Papa. Leo closed his eyes and pretended he was resting in a warm, sunny meadow. It felt so relaxing! After his hair was brushed into a magnificent golden cloud, Papa said, 'Now for your little lion claws.' Leo held up his hands. His fingernails had been growing so fast because he climbed up the playground slide every single day. Papa used a gentle emery board that made a funny little whispering sound: sss-sss-sss. 'Filing the tips so they do not scratch your friends,' explained Papa. Leo thought that was very polite. When they finished, Leo shook his head and gave his most ferocious, happy little roar. 'My mane is magnificent!' giggled Leo. Papa gave him a high-five with his newly trimmed hand. 'You did a wonderful job sitting so still, Leo. You are the star of the jungle!'

stories.title: Mia's Magic Fingertips
stories.text: Mia was a little artist who loved painting pictures of sparkly unicorns and purple rainbows. But today, Mia noticed her fingernails were getting a bit too long, making it tricky to hold her pink paintbrush just right. 'Mama,' said Mia, 'my fingers need a little manicure adventure!' Mama smiled brightly. 'What a wonderful idea, my little star. Let us make your fingers ready for more art.' Mama laid out a pretty blue towel and filled a tiny bowl with warm, bubbly water. Mia dipped her hands right in. 'Splish, splash, warm and cozy!' she sang, watching the little soap bubbles pop. After a nice, relaxing soak, Mama dried Mia’s hands with the fluffy towel until they were warm and dry. Then came the magical nail clippers, decorated with friendly green frogs. 'Ribbit-ribbit, clip-clip,' went the clippers. Mia watched in wonder as each little nail took a neat, tidy nap in the basket below. 'Are we all done?' asked Mia. 'Almost, my sweet artist!' said Mama. Next came a soft, pink buffer that made Mia’s nails shine like tiny polished pearls. 'Look how they sparkle in the light!' gasped Mia, holding her hands up to the sun. Finally, it was time for her hair. Mama brushed her long locks until they cascaded down her back like a shiny silk waterfall. Mia felt so proud and accomplished. She picked up her pink paintbrush and drew a picture of herself with shiny hair and sparkling, neat fingernails. 'All ready to create!' cheered Mia, giving Mama a big, happy hug with her clean, beautiful hands.

stories.title: Sammy's Salon Day
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Sammy woke up with messy, sleepy hair that reached for the ceiling. 'Good morning, sweet Sammy!' said Mommy. 'Today is a special salon day. Let's make your curls happy and smooth!' Sammy clapped his hands. He loved playing salon. First, they walked to the big bathroom and sat in the tallest chair. Sammy got to wear a shiny blue superhero cape. Mommy brought out a colorful brush with soft, bouncy bristles. 'Beep beep! Here comes the magic brush!' sang Mommy as she gently stroked Sammy's hair. Ouch-free and completely cozy! Sammy closed his eyes and imagined he was a lion whose mane was getting brushed by a kind fairy. Every stroke felt like a gentle massage. 'Look in the mirror, Sammy!' said Mommy. Sammy opened his eyes and gasped. His curls looked like soft golden clouds floating around his happy face. 'All done!' cheered Sammy. Next came the tricky part: little fingernails that liked to tickle people when they grabbed toys. Mommy brought out a tiny musical nail file that buzzed like a friendly bumblebee. 'Buzz, buzz, little bee, trimming fingernails for me,' whispered Mommy. Sammy held out his hand just like a big boy. He watched the tiny sparkles of nail dust fall gently into the sink like snow. 'One, two, three, four, five! All shiny and bright!' counted Mommy, giving Sammy's hand a warm, proud high-five. Sammy hugged his superhero cape tightly. He felt so fresh, so clean, and so ready to conquer the day's big adventures. Mommy smiled and kissed his soft forehead. 'You did a wonderful job sitting so still, my big helper,' she whispered. Sammy beamed with pride. Hair brushing and nail trimming were super fun after all, especially when shared with lots of love and gentle giggles.

stories.title: Bella and the Butterfly Brush
stories.text: The morning sun peeked through the pink curtains, tickling Bella's nose. 'Time to wake up, little butterfly!' whispered Daddy. Bella stretched her arms high up to the sky. Today was a very important grooming day. Bella's hair was tangled into sweet little bird nests from a wonderful night of sleeping. 'Shall we untangle the sleepy knots?' asked Daddy, holding up a pink brush with shiny star stickers. Bella nodded and sat right between Daddy's warm knees. She held her favorite stuffed bunny, Floppy, so Floppy could watch how brave Bella was being. 'Start at the ends and work our way up,' Daddy chanted softly, brushing the very bottom of Bella's hair. It felt like tiny butterfly wings fluttering against her shoulders. Whenever a little tangle whispered back, Daddy used his magic gentle touch to soothe it right out. 'All gone!' cheered Daddy. Bella giggled as her hair cascaded down her back like a silky waterfall. Then, Daddy held up the nail clippers, which Bella called the 'singing snippers.' 'Time to trim our tiny tools so we can draw and build blocks even better,' said Daddy. Bella knew just what to do. She pretended her fingers were sleepy little birds going to bed in their cozy nests. 'Click, click, clip!' went the gentle tool, singing a happy little song as each fingernail became neat and round. Daddy kissed every single fingertip when he was finished. 'Ten happy fingers and ten happy toes!' said Daddy. Bella jumped down from the chair and did a twirl in front of the mirror. Her hair bounced with every spin, shiny and smooth. She gave Daddy a huge hug and whispered, 'Thank you for making me shine like a star, Daddy.' Together, they high-fived, ready to play outside with clean hands and beautiful hair.

stories.title: Leo's Lion Claws
stories.text: Roar! Little Leo was a brave jungle lion waking up from a long, cozy nap in his grassy den. But even fierce lions need to keep their paws neat and tidy! Mommy walked into Leo's room holding a shiny green towel and a basket full of grooming treasures. 'Good morning, King Leo,' smiled Mommy. 'Is it time to groom our majestic mane and trim our mighty claws?' Leo roared a happy, gentle lion roar. 'Yes, Mommy!' First, they played the hair-taming game. Leo sat on a soft stool while Mommy used a wide-toothed comb that felt just like a cool jungle breeze. 'Let's comb out the leaves and twigs from our sleep,' laughed Mommy, gently gliding the comb through Leo's thick brown hair. Leo closed his eyes and pretended he was resting under a shady tree while a warm summer wind blew through his locks. It didn't pull at all; it just felt relaxing and cozy. 'Next stop: the Mighty Claw Spa!' announced Mommy. Leo held out his hands proudly. Mommy brought out a bright yellow emery board that looked like a banana. 'We want our lion claws smooth so we can climb trees and build towering block castles,' explained Mommy. She gently filed each fingernail, counting them out loud. 'One, two, three, four, five!' Leo watched with big, curious eyes, fascinated by how easy and painless it was. Then came his toes, which wriggled like little caterpillars. 'Tickle, tickle, file, file!' giggled Leo, curling his toes with delight. When they were all finished, Mommy placed a shiny gold crown sticker right on Leo's shirt. 'You are the neatest, bravest lion in the whole jungle,' praised Mommy. Leo stood up tall, roared his happiest roar, and ran off to play with his freshly groomed paws and bouncy hair, feeling like a true champion.

stories.title: Sammy's Magic Salon Chair
stories.text: Ring-ring! Good morning, little Sammy! Today is a very special day. It is time for the magical salon chair to appear right in the living room. Sammy loves the salon chair because it means it is hair-brushing time, and Sammy is the brightest star in the whole wide sky. Mommy brings out the soft, fluffy pink brush with bristles that tickle just right. Sammy sits down and holds a favorite fuzzy bear tightly. 'Time to make your hair look like a crown of golden sunshine,' Mommy whispers with a big, warm smile. First, Mommy starts at the very tips of the hair, making tiny, gentle strokes. *Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh.* Sammy giggles because it feels like a soft feather playing hide and seek.
