And it is telling us it is ready for some fuel.' Leo gently held his belly and listened closely. Ding-dong, went the bell again, a little louder this time, asking for yummy food. 'Coming, tummy bell!' Leo said cheerfully. He washed his hands with bubbly soap, scrubbing till they smelled like sweet strawberries. Then, he sat right in his big chair at the table. In front of him was a warm bowl of creamy oatmeal with sweet banana slices arranged like smiley faces, and a cup of cool, refreshing milk. Leo took a big, happy spoonful. It tasted so sweet and cozy! With every bite he chewed slowly and carefully, he could feel his tummy bell getting happier and quieter. 'Yum, yum, thank you, breakfast,' Leo whispered. When his bowl was all clean, his tummy bell let out one last contented sigh. No more ding-dong, just a cozy, full feeling. Leo patted his tummy and gave a big, happy toddler smile. He was ready for a wonderful day of play because he listened so well to his tummy bell!

stories.title: Mia and the Park Picnic Bell
stories.text: The afternoon sun was shining brightly, and little Mia was having the absolute best time at the playground. She climbed up the yellow slide, swished down with a whee, and pushed her favorite green swing high, high, high into the fluffy clouds. Up and away! But right as she was about to run toward the sandbox to build a giant castle, a funny sound tickled her insides. Rrrrring! went her tummy bell. Mia stopped right in her tracks. She put her little hands on her belly and listened. Was it a bird? Was it the wind? No, it was her tummy bell saying hello! Her mommy walked over with a bright red picnic basket and a cozy polka-dot blanket. 'Did your tummy bell ring, Mia?' Mommy asked with a warm, loving smile. Mia nodded excitedly and patted her tummy. 'Yes, Mommy! It went ring-ring!' Mommy giggled and spread the soft blanket right under the shade of a big, leafy green tree. 'That means our fun playtime needs a little pause so we can give our bodies some strong, healthy food energy,' Mommy explained gently. Mia sat down criss-cross applesauce on the blanket. Inside the magic basket, Mommy had packed crunchy apple slices that went crunch-crunch, bright orange carrot sticks, and a delicious cheese sandwich cut into fun star shapes. Mia picked up a star sandwich and took a big, happy bite. 'Mmm, yummy stars!' she cheered. She chewed slowly, tasting the yummy cheese and soft bread, while listening to the birds chirp in the trees above. Her tummy bell felt so warm and happy as it filled up with all the good picnic treats. When she finished every last bite, she wiped her hands on a soft napkin. 'All done!' Mia announced proudly. Her tummy bell gave a gentle, quiet hum, letting her know it was completely satisfied. With a happy hop, Mia gave Mommy a big hug and was ready to zoom back to her playground adventures!

stories.title: Oliver's Bedtime Tummy Bell
stories.text: The stars were twinkling like tiny diamonds in the deep blue evening sky, and the moon was glowing softly outside the window. Little Oliver was tucked into his cozy bed, wearing his favorite blue pajamas with zooming rockets on them. Mommy sat on the edge of the bed and opened a big storybook filled with pictures of sleepy forest animals. Oliver snuggled deep under his warm, patchwork quilt, ready for a wonderful bedtime story. But right as Mommy began to read about a little bear, a soft sound echoed. Cling-clang! went Oliver’s tummy bell. Oliver blinked his sleepy eyes and giggled. He looked down at his tummy underneath his rocket pajamas. 'My tummy bell is ringing again!' he whispered softly. Mommy smiled and gently stroked Oliver’s soft brown hair. 'It sure is, sweet boy,' she said softly. 'Even when the sun goes down and the stars come out, our tummy bells still talk to us. This time, it is telling us it is ready for a quiet, gentle bedtime snack to help us dream sweet dreams.' Oliver sat up and stretched his arms. 'What is for bedtime snack, Mommy?' he asked curiously. Mommy brought a small, comforting cup of warm milk and a plain, crunchy cracker. Oliver held the cup with both hands and took slow, gentle sips of the warm milk. It felt so cozy and soothing going down his throat. Then he nibbled his cracker, crunch, crunch, crunch, chewing it nice and slow. He listened to the quiet house and felt his eyelids getting heavier and heavier. As he finished his snack, his tummy bell gave a very soft, sleepy chime, like a lullaby. 'Thank you, tummy bell,' Oliver whispered softly. Mommy tucked the covers snug around his shoulders and turned on the gentle star-projector nightlight. Oliver closed his eyes, feeling safe, full, and so very happy, ready to drift off to sleep because he listened to his tummy bell.

stories.title: Leo and the Little Rumbly Bell
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, little Leo was busy building a giant tower out of shiny red and blue blocks. He stacked one block, then two, then three more. His tower reached all the way up to his nose! Suddenly, a tiny sound tickled his tummy. Rumbly-rumble-rum! Leo giggled and stopped building. 'What was that?' he whispered to his fuzzy brown bear. His mommy smiled warmly and knelt down beside him. 'That is your tummy bell, sweet boy!' Mommy said gently. 'It is a special little chime inside you that rings when it is time to give your body some wonderful fuel.' Leo gently patted his tummy with both hands. 'Does my tummy bell want to eat?' he asked happily. Mommy nodded. 'It certainly does! When your tummy bell rings, it is telling you it is time to sit at the little wooden table and enjoy some yummy snacks.' Leo loved his tummy bell. He carefully put his blocks back in their colorful box, washed his hands with warm, bubbly soap, and sat right down in his big blue chair. There was a plate of sweet banana slices and crunchy apple wedges waiting just for him. 'Thank you, tummy bell, for telling me!' Leo sang softly. With every juicy bite he took, his tummy felt happier and cozier. When he was all finished, his tummy bell felt quiet and peaceful, ready for more fun playtime. Leo clapped his hands and gave his tummy a gentle pat. Listening to his tummy bell was so easy, and it always helped him grow big, strong, and full of happy energy for the day.

stories.title: Mia and the Playground Tummy Bell
stories.text: Mia was having the most wonderful time at the neighborhood park with her daddy. She zoomed down the yellow slide, soared high on the red swing, and chased a friendly yellow butterfly across the soft green grass. Wheee! Up and down she went, laughing out loud under the warm golden sun. But after a little while, Mia felt a funny little wiggle right inside her belly. Grumbly-grumble-gurgle! Mia stopped running and blinked her big brown eyes. She put her little hands right on her tummy and listened very closely. 'Daddy, listen!' Mia said with a bright smile. 'My tummy bell is ringing!' Daddy walked over and gave her a gentle, loving hug. 'It sure is, my little explorer!' Daddy said cheerfully. 'Your tummy bell is letting you know it has worked very hard on the playground and needs a nice break for some yummy food.' Mia nodded eagerly. She knew that listening to her tummy bell was a super-smart thing to do. She held daddy's big hand as they walked together to the cozy picnic blanket spread out under the leafy green oak tree. Inside the basket, there was a bright orange cup of cool water and a tasty cheese sandwich cut into fun star shapes. Mia sat down cross-legged and ate her snack happily, watching the fluffy white clouds float by in the blue sky. 'Good job, tummy bell!' Mia whispered as she finished her last bite. Her tummy felt warm and happy, and she was ready for more gentle playground adventures with her daddy.

stories.title: Pip the Puppy and the Snack-Time Chime
stories.text: Pip was a very busy little toddler penguin who loved to splash in the cool blue water and waddle around the snowy yard. Today, Pip was helping his papa paint a bright yellow picture of the sun. He dipped his soft brush into the blue paint and made big, happy swirls all across the big white paper. Splash, swish, swirl! Suddenly, a happy little sound echoed from deep inside his tummy. Ring-a-ling, rumblity-rum! Pip dropped his paintbrush with a soft plop and tilted his head. 'Papa, did you hear that?' Pip asked with a wide, curious grin. Papa penguin looked up from his paints and chuckled softly, wrapping a warm wing around Pip. 'That is your very own tummy bell, my little Pip!' Papa explained in a sweet, gentle voice. 'When your tummy bell rings, it is calling you to come and have a healthy snack so you can keep on painting and playing.' Pip patted his soft, round tummy with his flipper. 'My tummy bell is so clever!' Pip said proudly. He knew just what to do. He washed his flippers in the washbasin until they were sparkling clean, then waddled happily over to the cozy kitchen table. Papa had prepared a wonderful plate of bright orange carrot sticks and sweet strawberry slices just for him. Pip sat down nicely in his chair and munched happily. Each bite tasted so delicious. When his tummy bell stopped ringing and felt full and happy, Pip gave a little cheer. Listening to his tummy bell always made him feel his very best!

stories.title: Leo and the Soft Jingling Bell
stories.text: Leo was a busy little boy who loved to build tall towers out of wooden blocks. He stacked red blocks, blue blocks, and big yellow blocks right up to his chin. Crash! Down they would tumble, and Leo would giggle and start all over again. He was having so much fun playing in the sunny living room that he forgot all about everything else. Suddenly, a tiny sound drifted up from his middle. *Ting-ting-ling!* It was Leo’s very own tummy bell! Leo stopped building and patted his tummy with both hands. 'Hello there, tummy bell!' he whispered softly. His mommy walked over with a big, warm smile and knelt down beside him. 'Did your tummy bell ring, sweetie?' she asked gently. Leo nodded and patted his belly again. 'It is ringing for a yummy snack time!' Mommy said. 'When our tummy bell rings, it is our special friend telling us it is time to pause our playing and give our bodies some good food.' Leo felt so proud that he had listened to his little bell. He carefully put his favorite red block inside the toy basket. Then, he washed his hands all by himself with nice, bubbly soap. At the little wooden table, Mommy had prepared bright orange slices and crunchy crackers. Leo took a big bite of an orange slice and smiled happily. 'Good job listening to your tummy bell, Leo,' whispered Mommy, giving him a gentle hug. Leo patted his tummy one more time. The tummy bell was quiet now, which meant it was completely happy and full. Leo felt cozy inside, ready for more gentle play when his tummy was all done resting.

stories.title: Mia and the Morning Meadow
stories.text: The morning sun was shining brightly through Mia’s bedroom window, painting warm yellow patches on her soft pink rug. Mia was wearing her favorite polka-dot pajamas and dancing around the room like a fluttering butterfly. She twirled and spun, pretending she was flying over a magical garden filled with flowers. But right in the middle of a big twirl, Mia heard a funny sound coming from deep inside. *Rumbly-rumble-rum!* It was the sound of her morning tummy bell waking up to greet the brand-new day. Mia stopped spinning and tilted her head, listening closely. *Rumbly-rumble-rum!* She giggled out loud. 'My tummy bell is playing a sleepy morning song!' she said to her teddy bear, Barnaby. Just then, Daddy poked his head through the doorway with a cheerful 'Good morning!' He walked in and scooped Mia up for a gentle cuddle. 'Good morning, my little butterfly. Did you hear your tummy bell ringing?' Daddy asked warmly. Mia nodded and pointed right to her belly button. 'It told me it is ready for breakfast!' Daddy praised her gently. 'Listening to your tummy bell is such a smart thing to do. It helps us know just what our body needs.' Together, holding hands, Mia and Daddy skipped all the way to the kitchen. Mia climbed up onto her big girl chair and looked at the lovely breakfast waiting for her. There was a steaming bowl of warm oatmeal and sweet, sliced bananas arranged in the shape of a smiley face. Mia used her spoon to scoop up a big, delicious bite. 'Yummy,' she whispered happily. Her tummy bell stopped its rumbly song and felt completely peaceful. Mia felt strong, energized, and ready for a wonderful, playful day ahead with her family.

stories.title: Pip the Puppy’s Magic Bell
stories.text: Pip was a happy little toddler who wore shiny yellow shoes with easy velcro straps. Today, Pip was playing the role of a brave little puppy who loved to fetch his soft stuffed bunny across the bedroom carpet. He crawled on his hands and knees, barking a quiet 'Woof-woof!' as he zoomed under the wooden chair. Suddenly, right in the middle of a big puppy stretch, Pip heard a gentle sound. *Ding-dong-ding!* It was his friendly tummy bell, singing a little tune. Pip sat right down on his cozy rug and touched his belly. He knew that sound very well! It meant his tummy bell was calling for some fuel to keep his puppy paws running strong. Grandma walked into the room carrying a plate with warm apple slices and a little cup of water. She smiled lovingly at Pip. 'I heard a little bell ringing. Did your tummy bell call you, little puppy?' she asked. Pip nodded eagerly and gave his tummy a gentle pat. 'It said it is time for a healthy snack break!' Grandma beamed with joy and gave him a soft nose-rub. 'What a wonderful listener you are, Pip. Your tummy bell always tells you the exact right time to rest and eat.' Pip stood up proudly, put his bunny safely in its bed, and walked over to the kitchen counter. He washed his hands with warm water and sweet-smelling soap, watching the bubbles pop. Then he sat down at his little table and ate the sweet apple slices. The gentle *ding-dong-ding* sound faded away, replaced by a warm, cozy feeling inside his tummy. Pip smiled brightly. Listening to his tummy bell made him feel so smart, happy, and ready for his next big toddler adventure.

stories.title: Leo and the Breakfast Bell
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Leo woke up in his cozy bed. The sun was peeking through his curtains, saying good morning with a bright golden smile. Leo stretched his arms up high, way up to the sky, and gave a big, happy yawn. *Yaaawn!* Suddenly, he heard a funny little sound coming from right inside his tummy. *Rrrrr-umble!* Leo giggled and patted his tummy. That was his special tummy bell ringing! It was time to wake up and get ready for a brand new day of fun adventures. Leo hopped right out of bed, ready to listen to his tummy bell. First up on the morning adventure list was getting dressed. Leo put on his favorite blue shirt with the happy dinosaur on the front, and his stretchy yellow pants. He zipped up his shoes all by himself, practicing his strong finger muscles. Then, it was time to brush his teeth so they could sparkle like little stars. Leo brushed up and down, making lots of bubbly toothpaste foam. With a clean smile and a happy heart, Leo walked into the bright kitchen. Mommy was standing by the stove, flipping golden pancakes that smelled like sweet vanilla and warm hugs. *Rrrrr-umble!* went Leo’s tummy bell again, ringing a little louder this time. It was saying, 'Feed me, please!' Leo sat down in his big-kid chair and washed his hands with bubbly soap. Mommy placed a warm plate of pancakes right in front of him with a tiny pat of melting butter. Leo took a big bite. *Mmm, yummy!* Every single bite made his tummy bell so happy and quiet. Eating good food gave Leo all the energy he needed to run, jump, and play all day long. Leo felt so proud of himself for listening to his body and taking good care of it. He finished his yummy breakfast, wiped his mouth with a napkin, and was ready to conquer the day with a big, bright smile.

stories.title: Maya and the Playground Clock
stories.text: The afternoon sun was warm and golden, wrapping the park in a cozy hug. Maya was having the most wonderful time playing outside. She pushed her favorite red doll on the swing, making it go higher and higher into the breezy blue sky. *Wheee!* Then, she built a giant castle in the sandbox, complete with a moat and a sparkly seashell tower. Maya was a busy builder, running and skipping from the slide to the climbing bars with happy little hops. But after a little while, Maya started to feel a strange sensation right in the middle of her tummy. *Grumble-rumble-tummy-rumble!* It was her tummy bell, chiming softly to give her an important message. Maya stopped right in her tracks and gently placed her hands on her tummy. Her tummy bell was telling her that it had worked so hard playing all afternoon, and now it needed a little rest and some yummy fuel to keep going. Maya smiled at Daddy, who was sitting on the nearby park bench with a cheerful wave. 'Daddy,' Maya called out in her sweet voice, 'my tummy bell is ringing!' Daddy smiled warmly and nodded. 'That means it is time for our afternoon snack, my sweet explorer,' Daddy said, opening up his colorful picnic bag. Maya washed her hands carefully with the squeezable water bottle Daddy brought, making sure her fingers were clean and fresh. Then, Daddy handed her a bright red apple sliced into fun little moons and a container of crunchy crackers. *Crunch, munch, crunch!* Maya took a big bite of the crisp apple. It tasted so sweet and refreshing after playing in the warm sun. Her tummy bell let out a contented little sigh as it filled up with all the good energy. Maya felt strong and happy again. Listening to her tummy bell was such a helpful superpower. With a happy giggle, Maya gave Daddy a big hug and ran back to the sandbox, ready for her next fun afternoon adventure.

stories.title: Sammy’s Bedtime Tune
stories.text: The moon was glowing like a soft silver nightlight in the deep blue sky, and the stars were twinkling hello through the bedroom window. It was almost time for sleep, but Sammy was still busy driving his shiny red toy firetruck all across the bedroom rug. *Nee-naw, nee-naw!* went the firetruck as it zoomed over the fuzzy green carpet hills. Sammy was having so much fun playing his quiet night games. But then, a quiet little sound drifted up from deep inside him. *Rumbly-rumble-tumble.* Sammy stopped his firetruck right away. He knew that sound very well. It was his sleepy tummy bell! It didn't mean he was hungry for big meals like breakfast or lunch. Instead, his tummy bell was chiming a sweet, gentle bedtime tune, telling him that his body was getting tired and needed to relax for the night. Sammy carefully parked his firetruck in its special garage box and stood up tall. He walked into the bathroom with Daddy to get ready for dreamland. Sammy brushed his teeth until they were shining bright, then put on his cozy pajamas with the fluffy cloud pattern. Next, it was time to read his favorite bedtime story about a little bear who loved the moon. Sammy cuddled up close in Daddy’s lap, listening to the calm, soothing sound of Daddy’s voice reading the gentle words. *Rumbly-rumble* went his tummy bell one last time, humming a sleepy lullaby. Sammy closed his heavy eyes, feeling so safe, loved, and happy. He listened to his body every step of the way, and now his tummy bell was resting peacefully. With a final cozy yawn, Sammy drifted off to sleep, ready for a whole night of wonderful, sweet dreams.

stories.title: Leo and the Little Rumbly Bell
stories.text: Little Leo was zooming his favorite red car across the rug. Vroom, vroom! He crashed into a soft green pillow. Suddenly, something special happened inside him. *Rumble, rumble, rumble.* Leo stopped and put his hands on his belly. He giggled because it felt like a tiny little bell was ringing right inside his tummy! 'Ding-dong! Feed me, please!' his tummy seemed to say. Leo’s big sister, Mia, smiled and clapped her hands. 'Oh, Leo! Did you hear your tummy bell? That is your body telling you it is time for some yummy food!' Leo nodded happily. He loved his tummy bell because it always let him know when it was snack time. Together, they washed their hands with nice, warm soapy bubbles, making lots of fluffy white clouds. Then, they sat down at the little wooden table. On his plate, Mama had placed bright orange carrot sticks, crunchy apple slices, and a nice cup of cool water. Leo took a big bite of an apple. *Crunch, crunch!* He listened closely to his tummy. After a few bites, his tummy gave a happy little sigh. The rumbly bell stopped ringing and whispered, 'Thank you, Leo, I am all full now!' Leo beamed with pride. He loved taking care of his body and listening to his special tummy bell every single day. It was such a helpful little friend. When snack time was finished, Leo wiped his mouth with a bright yellow napkin and went back to playing with his toys, feeling strong, happy, and full of wonderful energy. The red car zoomed across the rug again, vroom, vroom, as Leo smiled knowing he was growing up big and strong.

stories.title: Maya and the Morning Bell
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! Maya woke up and stretched her arms up high like the tall trees outside her window. She blinked her sleepy eyes and took a big yawn. *Yawn-o-saurus!* Just then, her tummy made a funny sound. *Grumble-rumble-gurgle.* Maya giggled and patted her tummy. 'Good morning, tummy bell!' she whispered. Her mommy walked into the room with a warm smile and a gentle hug. 'Did your tummy bell ring to wake you up today, Maya?' Mommy asked cheerfully. Maya nodded and hopped right out of bed, ready for a brand new day of fun and adventures. Maya knew that listening to her tummy bell in the morning was super important. It meant her body was ready for some delicious breakfast fuel to help her run, jump, and play all morning long. In the kitchen, the smell of warm oatmeal and sweet strawberries filled the air. Maya sat down in her big girl chair and picked up her spoon. *Tap, tap, tap* went the spoon against the bowl. She scooped up a spoonful of creamy oatmeal topped with a bright red strawberry. 'Mmm, so yummy!' Maya said happily. She ate slowly and listened to her tummy as it filled up with goodness. The grumbly sound turned into a cozy, warm feeling right in the middle of her tummy. Her tummy bell chimed softly in her heart, saying, 'Thank you for listening, Maya!' Maya felt so proud of herself for taking such good care of her body. She finished her milk, wiped her face, and skipped off to put on her favorite shiny yellow shoes, ready for a wonderful day.

stories.title: Pip the Puppy and the Picnic Bell
stories.text: Pip was a soft, floppy-eared puppy who loved to play outside in the sunshine. Today, Pip and his best friend Toby were building a tall tower out of shiny wooden blocks. *Clatter, crash!* The blocks tumbled down, and they both laughed out loud. Suddenly, Pip stopped playing. He sat straight up, tilted his head to the side, and gave a little *woof*! His tummy made a loud *rumble-rumble* sound. Toby giggled and pointed his paw. 'Pip! I think your tummy bell is ringing for lunchtime!' Pip wagged his tail furiously. He knew his tummy bell was telling him it was time to take a break from building and have a delicious picnic in the grass. Mommy brought out a basket filled with tasty treats for them to share. There were crunchy peanut butter crackers, sweet banana slices, and fresh water in a shiny red bowl. Pip sat down nicely on the soft green grass and waited patiently while Mommy set out the food. 'Good listening, Pip,' Mommy praised, giving him a gentle pat on his soft head. Pip happily munched on his crackers. *Crunch, crunch, yum!* He listened to his tummy as he ate, making sure not to eat too fast. Soon, his tummy gave a happy little wiggle, and the rumbly bell turned into a quiet, peaceful purr. Pip was completely full and felt ready for a nice afternoon nap. He curled up right next to Toby on the picnic blanket, closing his heavy eyes with a happy sigh. Listening to his tummy bell had made his day wonderful, and he drifted off to sleep dreaming of blocks, snacks, and sunny days.

stories.title: Leo's Little Tummy Bell
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little boy named Leo was busy building the tallest block tower in the whole wide world. Block on top of block went the red square, then the blue triangle, and finally a shiny yellow star right at the very top. "Ta-da!" cheered Leo, clapping his hands together with a big happy grin. Just as he reached for one more green block, a funny little sound tickled his tummy. *Grumble-rumble-gurgle!* Leo stopped and patted his shirt. "What was that?" he whispered with a giggle. His big sister Maya smiled and knelt down beside him. "That sounds like your tummy bell, Leo!" she explained in her softest, sweetest voice. "When your tummy bell rings, it is sending you a very special message. It means your body is working hard and needs some yummy fuel to keep on playing." Leo gently placed both hands right over his tummy button. He closed his eyes and listened very closely. *Grumble-rumble-gurgle!* Went the tummy bell again, sounding like a tiny, sleepy kitten saying hello. Leo knew right away what to do. He gently knocked down his block tower and put all the wooden pieces back into their cozy toy box, taking good care of his things. Then, he washed his hands nice and clean with bubbly soap until they smelled like fresh strawberries. At the kitchen table, a warm bowl of creamy oatmeal and bright orange slices waited just for him. Leo took a big spoonful of the warm oatmeal. "Mmm, so delicious!" he said happily. With every single bite, his tummy bell felt cozier and happier. The rumbling stopped, replaced by a warm, cozy feeling of fullness. Leo smiled big and wide because he listened so well to his body. "Good job listening to your tummy bell, Leo!" cheered Maya, giving him a gentle high-five. Leo felt so proud. He was growing up big and strong, and he knew his tummy bell would always help him take the very best care of himself, all day long.

stories.title: Mia and the Magic Tummy Bell
stories.text: In a cozy pink bedroom filled with fuzzy stuffed animals, a little girl named Mia was having a wonderful time flying her shiny purple toy airplane. *Zoom, swoosh, flippity-flap!* The plane soared high above the bed, diving down to land softly on the fluffy white rug. Mia giggled and made happy airplane noises. Suddenly, a soft little sound came from underneath her polka-dot shirt. *Rumble-tumble-giggle!* Mia paused and looked down at her tummy in surprise. "Hello?" she asked the little sound. Just then, her kind mama walked into the room carrying a basket of soft laundry. Mama smiled warmly and sat down on the rug next to Mia. "Ah, listen to that!" Mama said softly. "That is your tummy bell ringing, my sweet Mia. When you are running, jumping, and playing all day long, your tummy bell rings to let you know it is time to pause, rest, and have a healthy snack." Mia touched her tummy gently. She loved her tummy bell! It was like having a magical little clock inside her that told her when she needed extra energy. "Is my tummy bell hungry?" Mia asked. Mama nodded and kissed the top of Mia's head. "Yes, sweetheart. It is time to listen to your body and give it something wonderful to eat." Mia gently tucked her purple airplane into its special parking spot on the shelf. Then, she skipped happily to the kitchen, holding her mama's hand the whole way. On the counter, a plate of crunchy apple slices and creamy yogurt was ready and waiting. Mia sat in her big chair and took a nice, slow bite of a sweet apple slice. *Crunch!* "It is so yummy, Mama," Mia whispered happily. She chewed slowly and drank a refreshing cup of cool water. With every bite, the funny little rumble melted away into a peaceful, happy feeling. Mia patted her tummy and whispered a thank-you to her magical tummy bell for guiding her so well.

stories.title: Pip's Playground Tummy Bell
stories.text: The afternoon sun was shining brightly over the neighborhood playground, and a little boy named Pip was having the best adventure ever. He climbed up the yellow ladder, reached the top of the green slide, and went *wheee!* all the way down to the soft woodchips. He ran to the red swings and kicked his feet high up into the fluffy white clouds. Pip felt so fast and so strong! But after a little while, right as he was about to chase a friendly butterfly, he heard a funny sound. *Grumbly-rumbl-o!* Pip stopped running and looked down at his bright green shirt. He put his hands on his hips, trying to figure out what that silly noise could be. His daddy walked over, pushing a stroller, and chuckled warmly. "Did you hear that, Pip?" Daddy asked gently. "That was your tummy bell ringing loud and clear!" Pip tilted his head. "My tummy bell?" he asked with a cute little smile. Daddy nodded and scooped Pip up into a big, loving hug. "That's right! Your tummy bell rings whenever you have used up all your super-play energy and need to recharge. Just like our toy truck needs fresh batteries, your body needs a healthy snack to keep on exploring." Pip thought about this for a moment. He wanted to have more energy for the swings later, so he knew listening was a super-smart choice. "Okay, Daddy! Let's go recharge!" Pip said enthusiastically. They packed up their bright blue bucket and spade, walking happily hand-in-hand toward their cozy home. When they walked inside, a lovely snack of cheese cubes and sweet banana slices was waiting on the little wooden table. Pip washed his hands until they were squeaky clean, then sat down to enjoy his delicious food. He chewed slowly and tasted every single bite. The grumpy little rumble in his tummy went away completely, replaced by a warm and happy feeling. Pip cheered quietly. Listening to his tummy bell made him feel so capable and strong, ready for any adventure that came his way.

stories.title: Leo and the Rumbling Drum
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a cozy little yellow house, lived a happy little boy named Leo. Leo loved to play with his colorful blocks, building tall towers that reached all the way up to the couch cushions. He loved zooming his red race car across the soft green rug, making zooming sounds all afternoon. Vroom! Vroom! Crash went the blocks! But suddenly, right in the middle of a big zoom, Leo heard a funny sound coming from his middle. Rumbly-rumble-rum! Rumble-rum-rum! Leo stopped his car and looked down at his tummy with wide, curious eyes. Was there a tiny drum band hiding inside his shirt? He giggled and gave his tummy a gentle pat. Pat, pat, pat! His big sister Mia walked into the room with a warm, sunny smile. 'Hello, Leo,' she said softly. 'Did you hear that? That is your tummy bell ringing! Your body is telling you it is time for some delicious fuel.' Leo nodded his head happily. He knew just what that meant. It was time for a yummy snack! Mia helped Leo wash his hands with bubbly, warm water until they were squeaky clean. Then, they sat together at the little wooden table. On the plate were bright orange carrot sticks and sweet, crunchy apple slices. Munch, munch, crunch! Leo took a big bite of an apple. It tasted so sweet and fresh. With every single bite he took, his tummy bell felt happier and quieter. No more rumbly-rumble-rum! Just a warm, cozy feeling of being full and strong. 'Good job listening to your tummy bell, Leo,' Mia cheered, giving him a gentle high-five. Leo smiled proudly. He loved playing with his toys, but he loved taking care of his body even more. Whenever his tummy made music again, he knew exactly what to do. The end.

stories.title: Maya and the Morning Melody
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! The bright golden sun was peeking through the pink bedroom curtains, waking up all the sleepy toys in Maya’s room. Maya opened her big brown eyes and stretched her arms up high, reaching for the clouds. Big stretch! Big yawn! She hopped right out of bed, ready for a brand new day of fun adventures. She wanted to paint a picture of a blue bird and chase butterflies in the pretty backyard garden. But just as she picked up her yellow paintbrush, her tummy made a happy little chime. Ting-a-ling! Well, it did not sound like a metal bell, but Maya knew her tummy bell was speaking to her. It was saying, 'Good morning, Maya! I am awake and ready for breakfast.' Maya put down her paintbrush and smiled. She loved her tummy bell because it always told her when it was time to eat. Maya walked into the kitchen where her kind mommy was making yummy oatmeal. The kitchen smelled like warm cinnamon and sweet honey. Mommy poured a little bit of milk into a bowl, stirring it round and round. 'Good morning, my sweet girl,' Mommy said. 'Did your tummy bell sing its morning song?' Maya nodded excitedly and patted her tummy. 'It sang a big song, Mommy!' she said in her cheerful voice. Maya sat in her big girl chair and used her spoon to scoop up the warm oatmeal. Blow softly on the spoon—huff, huff, huff! Then into her mouth it went. It tasted so cozy and delicious. With every spoonful, her tummy gave a happy sigh. When she was all finished, she had a funny little oatmeal mustache on her lip, and Mommy laughed a sweet, happy laugh. Maya wiped her face with a soft cloth and felt strong and energized. Now she was ready to paint her blue bird and play all day long. Hooray for the morning tummy bell!

stories.title: Pip the Puppy’s Snack Time
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a little green yard, lived a fluffy little puppy named Pip. Pip had floppy brown ears, a black wet nose, and a tail that wagged from side to side whenever he was happy. Today, Pip was busy playing hide and seek with his favorite stuffed bunny toy under the big oak tree. He would dig in the soft dirt and sniff the lovely red roses. Sniff, sniff, sniff! But suddenly, Pip stopped playing. His little tummy let out a funny growl. Grrr-rumble! Pip tilted his head sideways, looking very surprised. Was that a tiny puppy monster hiding in the grass? He gave a little bark. Woof! But it was not a monster at all. It was his very own tummy bell! His tummy was letting him know that he had played so hard, he needed a little rest and some tasty food. Just then, his favorite human, little Lily, came running across the grass with a blue bowl in her hands. 'Are you hungry, Pip?' Lily asked with a bright, loving smile. Pip gave a happy tail wag. Thump, thump, thump went his tail against the grass. Lily knelt down and placed the bowl on the green lawn. Inside were crunchy brown puppy kibbles and a fresh, cool bowl of water. Pip trotted right over and started to eat. Cronch, cronch, cronch! The food tasted so good after a long morning of playing hide and seek. He licked his chops and drank some nice, cool water. Slurp, slurp, slurp! His tummy felt so warm, calm, and happy. No more growling sounds at all. Lily reached out and scratched Pip right behind his floppy ears. 'Good boy, Pip, for listening to your tummy bell,' she whispered softly. Pip let out a contented puppy sigh and curled up for a short, sweet nap in the warm afternoon sun. He was one very happy puppy.

stories.title: Leo and the Magical Tummy Bell
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a cozy yellow house, lived a little boy named Leo. Leo loved to run, jump, and play with his shiny red blocks. He zoomed his toy cars across the rug and reached up high to touch the clouds. Suddenly, a soft, funny sound echoed from deep inside him. *Rumble-tumble! Gurgle-gurgle!* Leo stopped playing and giggled. 'What was that?' he whispered to his teddy bear, Barnaby. Mommy smiled and walked over, giving Leo a warm, gentle hug. 'That is your special tummy bell, my sweet boy,' Mommy explained softly. 'Your tummy bell rings when it is time to fill it up with yummy, healthy food so you can keep growing big and strong.' Leo touched his soft tummy and nodded. He knew just what to do! Together, Leo and Mommy walked into the bright kitchen. Mommy placed a bowl of warm, steaming oatmeal on the little wooden table, topped with sweet, juicy blueberries and a tiny drizzle of honey. It looked like a colorful rainbow in a bowl! Leo climbed right up onto his big boy chair and washed his hands with bubbly soap. *Splat, splash!* Then, using his bright blue spoon, he scooped up a big bite of oatmeal. It tasted so sweet and comforting! Every time Leo took a bite, he listened closely to his tummy. *Hush-hush,* went the tummy bell, feeling happier and happier with every spoonful. 'All gone!' cheered Leo, showing Mommy his clean bowl. Mommy clapped her hands and smiled proudly. 'Wonderful job listening to your tummy bell, Leo!' With a full and happy tummy, Leo felt strong and ready for more fun playtime. He gave his tummy a gentle pat and whispered, 'Thank you, tummy bell.' You did a super job listening today, Leo. You are growing up so wonderfully!

stories.title: Mia and the Midday Song
stories.text: High up in the bright blue sky, the sun was shining down on a little girl named Mia. Mia was busy painting a picture of a purple cat with polka dots. She dipped her paintbrush into the bright yellow paint and swished it back and forth across the big white paper. *Swish, swish, swish!* Suddenly, right in the middle of her painting, Mia heard a gentle sound from inside her. *Grumbly-rumble!* Mia blinked her big brown eyes and put her paintbrush down safely in its cup. 'Mommy,' Mia called out gently, 'my tummy is making music!' Mommy walked into the sunny art room and knelt down beside Mia's little chair. 'Listen to that!' Mommy whispered with a happy grin. 'That is your tummy bell singing to you, Mia. It sings when it needs a little rest and some delicious fuel.' Mia loved music! She nodded eagerly. 'I want to feed my tummy bell so it can sing a happy song.' Mommy and Mia washed their hands together at the sink, rubbing them with sweet-smelling strawberry soap until they were squeaky clean. In the kitchen, a wonderful plate of sliced green apples, crunchy peanut butter spread on whole wheat toast, and a cup of cool water was waiting. Mia sat down and took a deep breath. She picked up a piece of toast and took a big, crunchy bite. *Crunch!* The food tasted so fresh and yummy. As Mia chewed slowly and swallowed, the funny rumbling sound inside her belly started to quiet down. Instead of a grumble, her tummy felt warm, cozy, and peaceful. 'My tummy bell is dancing now,' Mia whispered happily to Mommy. Mommy kissed the top of Mia's head. 'You are so clever at listening to your body, my little angel.' Mia finished her snack and felt entirely ready to finish her wonderful purple cat painting with bright new energy.

stories.title: Sammy's Playground Adventure
stories.text: The playground was full of fun things to do. Sammy the bunny-rabbit hoodie wearer was swinging as high as the birds! *Wheee!* He climbed up the bright red ladder and slid down the green slide with a big, happy laugh. *Zoom!* But right as Sammy landed in the soft woodchips, he heard a funny little noise. *Rumble-rum-rum!* Sammy paused and put his hands right on his tummy. 'Is that you, tummy bell?' he asked the bright blue sky. Daddy walked over with the green backpack and knelt down on the grass. 'That sounds like your tummy bell ringing, Sammy!' Daddy said in a cheerful voice. 'It is telling you that you have been playing super-duper hard, and now it is time to recharge your energy.' Sammy loved adventures, and he knew that every good explorer needs a pit stop for delicious snacks. 'Time for a picnic!' Sammy cheered. They found a nice shady spot under a big leafy oak tree. Daddy opened the backpack and pulled out a shiny red apple, some bite-sized cheese cubes, and a juice box filled with yummy apple juice. Sammy sat criss-cross applesauce on the soft green grass. He took a sip of his juice box and nibbled on a piece of cheese. *Mmm, so good!* Every time Sammy took a bite, he could feel his energy coming right back into his arms and legs. His tummy bell went from making noisy rumbling sounds to feeling completely calm and satisfied. 'All refueled!' Sammy announced, giving his tummy a happy little pat. Daddy smiled brightly. 'You listened so well to your tummy bell, Sammy. You are growing into such a smart listener!' With a happy heart and a happy tummy, Sammy stood up, ready to explore the rest of the wonderful playground with his Daddy.

stories.title: Leo and the Rumbling Drum
stories.text: Leo was a busy little boy who loved to build tall towers out of wooden blocks. He would stack a red block, a blue block, and a bright yellow block right on top, watching them grow taller than his knees! Sometimes, Leo got so busy building that he forgot all about everything else in the whole wide room. But then, deep down inside his tummy, he heard a funny little sound. Rum-ble, rum-ble, grr-umble! It sounded just like a tiny drum playing a happy song. Leo stopped stacking his blocks and tilted his head. What could that be? His mommy smiled softly and gave him a gentle hug. 'That is your tummy bell, sweet Leo!' she said. 'Your tummy bell is ringing to let you know it is time to give your body some good fuel so you can keep on playing.' Leo patted his tummy and giggled. 'My tummy bell is ringing!' he said happily. He loved the sound of his very own tummy bell. So, Leo gently put his blocks away in their big toy box, washing his hands with nice bubbly soap at the sink. Then, he sat right down at his little wooden table. There waiting for him was a bowl of warm, yummy oatmeal with sweet sliced bananas on top. Every single bite tasted so delicious! As Leo ate, the rumbling drum inside his tummy went away, replaced by a warm, cozy feeling of happiness. 'Good job listening to your tummy bell, Leo,' said Mommy, pressing a soft kiss to his forehead. Leo felt so proud and strong. Whenever his tummy made that funny sound again later in the day, Leo knew exactly what to do. Listening to his tummy bell was so easy, and it helped him grow up big, strong, and ready for all of his wonderful toddler adventures every single day.

stories.title: Mia and the Morning Song
stories.text: The morning sun was shining bright yellow rays right through Mia’s bedroom window, painting pretty patterns on her colorful rug. Mia woke up with a big stretch, reaching her arms all the way up to touch the ceiling. 'Good morning, sunshine!' she whispered to her favorite teddy bear. Mia hopped out of bed and started to dance around her room like a fluttering butterfly. She spun in circles, making her pink skirt twirl round and round. She was having so much fun that she almost missed a very important sound. Ding-dong, went the happy feeling right in the middle of her tummy! It was her tummy bell ringing a sweet little morning song. Mia stopped twirling and put both of her hands right on her tummy. 'Hello, tummy bell!' she whispered with a joyful smile. She knew that her tummy bell was telling her it was time for a tasty breakfast to start her wonderful day. Daddy walked into the room with a big grin and said, 'Did someone hear their tummy bell ringing for breakfast?' Mia nodded excitedly and clapped her hands together. 'I heard my tummy bell sing its morning song, Daddy!' she cheered. Together, they walked into the bright kitchen where two bowls of crunchy cereal and fresh, juicy strawberries were waiting. Mia sat nicely in her big chair and used her spoon to eat every single strawberry. The sweet fruit tasted like sunshine and happiness. Her tummy felt so cozy and full. Listening to her tummy bell made Mia feel like a big girl who knew just what her body needed. She gave Daddy a giant hug and whispered, 'My tummy bell is so smart!' Daddy agreed with a nod. Mia was ready to play, run, and explore all day long, knowing her tummy bell would always take good care of her.

stories.title: Pip and the Playground Pause
stories.text: Pip the puppy loved the playground more than anything else in the whole wide world. He loved to climb up the bright red ladder, zoom down the slippery yellow slide, and swing so high that his toes almost touched the fluffy white clouds. Wheeee! laughed Pip as he zoomed down the slide for the tenth time that morning. He was having a fantastic time playing with all of his friends in the warm sunshine. But after a while, Pip started to feel a little bit tired. His little legs felt heavy, and right inside his tummy, he heard a gentle ring. Ding-dong, went the tummy bell, giving him a friendly reminder. Pip stopped running and sat down right on the soft green grass to rest for a minute. His grandma walked over with a bright blue water bottle and a box of yummy apple slices. 'Did your tummy bell give you a ring, my little explorer?' Grandma asked gently, sitting down beside him. Pip smiled and nodded, taking a nice long drink of cool water. 'Yes, Grandma! My tummy bell told me it is time for a little picnic break,' Pip said proudly. He knew that even though playing was fun, listening to his tummy bell was super important so he could rest and refuel. He ate the sweet, crunchy apple slices, tasting every single bite. The apple gave him a burst of fresh energy, making him feel happy and refreshed. 'All done!' Pip said, giving his grandma a cheerful high-five. Grandma praised him for being so good at listening to his body. With a happy tummy and a rested body, Pip hopped back up to his feet. He was ready to play safely and happily for the rest of the sunny afternoon, always listening closely to his wonderful tummy bell whenever it called.

stories.title: Leo and the Rumbling Raccoon
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Leo was playing with his shiny red blocks. He was building a very tall tower that reached all the way up to the couch cushions. Clack, clack, went the blocks! Suddenly, a funny sound came from underneath Leo's yellow shirt. Rumbly-rumble-rumble! Leo giggled and hugged his middle. "Hello? Is someone hiding in there?" he asked. Mommy smiled and scooped Leo up for a gentle cuddle. "That is your special tummy bell, my sweet boy!" she whispered. "When your tummy goes rumble-rumble, it is ringing to let you know it is time for some yummy fuel. It is telling you that your tummy bell is ready for snack time." Leo nodded, patting his tummy carefully. "Ding-dong, tummy bell!" he cheered. Together, Leo and Mommy walked to the bright kitchen where a plate of crunchy apple slices and warm cheese cubes was waiting on the little wooden table. Leo washed his hands with warm, bubbly soap, singing his favorite hand-washing song. When he sat down, he took a big, happy bite of a juicy apple. Crunch, crunch, went Leo! "My tummy bell is so happy now, Mommy," Leo said with a big, bright smile. Mommy kissed the top of his soft curls. "Listening to your tummy bell helps you grow strong and healthy, Leo. You are so good at listening to your body." Leo finished his snack, feeling full of energy and ready to build an even taller block tower. He gave his tummy one last gentle pat, proud of how well he listened to his wonderful tummy bell all by himself.

stories.title: Mia and the Morning Song
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! Mia woke up with a giant yawn and a big stretch, reaching her arms up high to touch the bedroom ceiling. The sunbeams were dancing happily on her pink polka-dot rug. Mia hopped out of bed to find her favorite fuzzy bunny slippers. Just then, a soft little growl tickled her insides. Grumble-grumble-gurgle! Mia put both hands on her tummy and listened closely. "Good morning, tummy bell!" she whispered to herself. Mia knew just what that special sound meant. It meant her tummy bell was ringing a happy morning song, asking for a yummy breakfast to start the brand-new day. Mia hurried to the kitchen where Daddy was humming a cheerful tune and pouring creamy milk into a blue bowl. "My tummy bell is ringing loudly, Daddy!" Mia announced proudly. Daddy chuckled and hugged her gently. "That means it is time to fill your tummy up with some energy, Mia-bug! What does your tummy bell want today?" Mia thought for a moment. "Warm oatmeal with sweet blueberries and a tiny splash of honey, please!" she said. Daddy helped Mia stir the berries into her bowl until the oatmeal turned a pretty purple color. Mia sat nicely in her big chair and used her spoon all by herself, taking small, careful bites. Every spoonful made her tummy bell quieter and happier. When her bowl was all clean, Mia wiped her mouth with a bright yellow napkin. "All done!" she cheered. Daddy clapped his hands. "Wonderful job listening to your tummy bell, Mia. Now you have all the energy you need to play outside in the garden today!"

stories.title: Pip the Puppy's Hungry Paws
stories.text: Pip was a very busy little toddler who loved to chase colorful butterflies in the backyard. Flutter-flutter went the yellow butterfly, and pitter-patter went Pip's quick feet across the soft green grass. Pip ran and jumped and giggled until he felt a funny, floaty feeling right in the middle of his tummy. Grumbly-rumble! Pip stopped running and sat right down on the grass, tilting his head. He listened to the funny sound inside. "Aha! That is my tummy bell ringing!" Pip said aloud to his stuffed bear, Barnaby, who was sitting under the shade of the big oak tree. Pip remembered what Grandma always taught him: when the tummy bell rings, it is time to stop playing and go eat something yummy. Pip scooped up Barnaby and trotted inside the cool, cozy house. Grandma was standing by the stove, stirring a pot of warm, sweet carrot soup that smelled just like cinnamon and hugs. "Grandma, my tummy bell is ringing a big song!" Pip called out, holding his tummy with both hands. Grandma turned around with a warm, loving smile. "Well, aren't you a super listener, Pip! You listened right to your body's special bell." Grandma washed Pip's hands until they were squeaky clean, and then lifted him up into his high chair. She placed a small bowl of the golden soup and a soft buttered roll in front of him. Pip blew gently on the soup—whoosh, whoosh—just like a soft summer wind. Then he took a careful sip. "Mmm, so delicious!" Pip whispered happily. As he finished his lunch, his tummy felt warm, cozy, and completely full. Pip smiled up at Grandma, feeling so proud of how well he listened to his tummy bell today.

stories.title: Leo and the Soft Rumble
stories.text: Leo was a busy little bee. He was building a giant tower out of shiny red and blue blocks. Up, up, up went the blocks! One, two, three, four. Oh no, the tower wobbled! Crash! All the blocks tumbled down to the cozy rug. Leo giggled and reached for another block. But wait, what was that sound? It was a gentle, quiet sound coming from deep inside his tummy. Rumbly-rumble, went the tummy bell! Leo stopped and patted his belly with his little hand. He giggled because it tickled a little bit. Mommy smiled and walked over, carrying a bright green bowl filled with warm, yummy oatmeal and sweet sliced bananas. Mommy said, 'Listen to that! Your tummy bell is ringing, Leo. It is telling us that it is time to fill your tummy up with good food so you have lots of energy to play.' Leo washed his hands with warm, bubbly soap. Splish, splash! Then, he sat right down in his big red chair. He picked up his spoon, scooped up a big bite of banana, and popped it into his mouth. Yum, yum, yummy! Every single bite made his tummy feel so happy and warm. The little tummy bell stopped its rumbly sound and went quiet. Leo smiled a big, proud smile. He finished his yummy snack all by himself. 'Good job listening to your tummy bell, Leo!' praised Mommy, giving him a gentle hug. Leo clapped his hands together. He knew that listening to his tummy bell was a very smart thing to do. Now, he was ready to build another big tower, and this time, it would touch the sky! He felt strong, happy, and ready for more fun. Goodnight, rumbly tummy bell. See you next time!

stories.title: Maya and the Garden Bell
stories.text: Maya loved playing outside in the warm sunshine. The green grass felt so soft and tickly against her bare toes. She was chasing a fluffy yellow butterfly all around the bright red flowers. Flutter, flutter, go the butterfly's wings! Maya ran and skipped, laughing out loud. Suddenly, she stopped right by the big oak tree. Her tummy let out a little sound. Ting-a-ling, went the tummy bell! Maya put her hands right on her tummy and listened closely. Her tummy was telling her it needed a break. Daddy was sitting nearby on the wooden bench, reading a picture book about cute little puppies. Daddy looked up and smiled a warm, gentle smile. 'Did you hear that, Maya?' Daddy asked softly. 'I think your tummy bell is ringing a little tune.' Maya nodded her head up and down. 'My tummy bell says it is time for a yummy snack, Daddy!' Daddy stood up and held out his hand. Together, they walked inside the cool kitchen. Daddy washed some bright red strawberries and sliced a yummy piece of cheese. Maya sat at the little yellow table and took a big, happy breath. She ate the sweet strawberries one by one. Red, juicy, and oh-so-delicious! She ate the nice cheese, too. As she ate, her tummy felt cozier and cozier. The tummy bell finished its happy song and went fast asleep. Maya wiped her mouth with a soft blue napkin. 'All done!' she cheered happily. Daddy gave her a high-five. 'Wonderful job listening to your tummy bell, Maya. You take such wonderful care of your growing body.' Maya felt so proud and happy inside. She hopped down from her chair and gave Daddy a big squeeze. Now, she was ready to go back outside and play with her butterfly friend again. Her tummy was happy, her heart was light, and she was ready for a brand new adventure in the sunny yard.

stories.title: Sam and the Playground Song
stories.text: Sam was zooming down the yellow slide. Wheeeee! Down he went, landing softly on the squishy green woodchips. He jumped right up and ran over to the red swing. Push, push, push! Sam flew high up into the blue sky, touching the fluffy white clouds. Playing at the park was the best fun in the whole wide world. But after a little while, Sam slowed down the swing. He put his feet on the ground to stop. Right then, his tummy made a funny little noise. Grumble-grumble, went the tummy bell! Sam giggled and looked down at his belly button. Grandma was sitting on the park bench nearby, holding a bright red lunchbox and a cup of cool water. Grandma smiled a loving, gentle smile and waved him over. 'Hello there, my sweet little explorer,' said Grandma. 'Is your tummy bell singing its hungry song?' Sam nodded and ran over to Grandma, his little legs moving fast. 'Yes, Grandma! My tummy bell says it is time to eat!' Grandma opened the lunchbox, and a yummy smell came floating out. Inside, there were soft apple slices, a yummy peanut butter sandwich cut into a fun triangle shape, and a box of cold milk. Sam washed his hands with the wet wipes Grandma handed him. Then, he sat down on the soft grass next to her. He took a big bite of his sandwich. Munch, munch, munch! It tasted so good after all that fast running and swinging. He drank some cool water to wash it down. The rumbly tummy bell grew quieter and quieter until it was fast asleep. Sam patted his tummy and smiled. 'All done, Grandma!' Grandma clapped her hands together. 'You are so smart at listening to your tummy bell, Sam. It helps you grow big and strong.' Sam beamed with joy. He knew that taking care of his body was super important. With a happy tummy, Sam was ready to play safely and happily for the rest of the wonderful afternoon.

stories.title: Leo and the Gentle Tummy Bell
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a cozy blue house, lived a little boy named Leo. Leo loved to run, jump, and play with his shiny red blocks. Today, he was building a tower as tall as his knees. Block by block, higher and higher it went! Suddenly, a tiny, quiet sound chimed from deep inside him. *Ding-dong!* It was Leo’s very own tummy bell! Leo stopped and giggled. He gently patted his tummy. 'Hello, tummy bell!' he whispered. His tummy bell was ringing because it was time for a little break and some yummy snack-time fuel. Mummy smiled and brought over a plate of bright orange carrot sticks and squishy apple slices. 'Is your tummy bell ringing, Leo?' Mummy asked warmly. Leo nodded happily. 'Yes! It went ding-dong!' Leo washed his hands nice and clean, just like a big boy, and sat right down at his little wooden table. He took a big, crunchy bite of an apple slice. *Munch, munch, munch!* As he ate, his tummy bell made a happy, warm, sleepy sigh. 'Thank you for listening to me,' the tummy bell seemed to say. Leo felt so proud. Listening to his tummy bell helped him know when his body needed extra energy to play. He finished his snack, gave his tummy a happy little pat, and went back to his blocks feeling strong, bright, and full of giggles. The red tower grew even taller, all the way up to the sky, and Leo was the happiest little builder in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Mia and the Morning Tummy Bell
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! The golden sun was peeking through the pink bedroom curtains, tickling Mia’s toes. Mia stretched her arms up high like a tall, sleepy giraffe. *Yaaaawn!* Just then, a soft little chime echoed from inside her tummy. *Ring-a-ling!* Mia’s tummy bell was awake and saying good morning too! Mia put her hands on her tummy and smiled. 'Good morning, tummy bell!' she chirped. Listening to her tummy bell was Mia’s favorite morning secret. It told her that her body was ready for a wonderful, brand-new day of adventures. Mia hopped out of bed and tiptoed into the kitchen, where Daddy was making warm, fluffy oatmeal. The kitchen smelled like sweet cinnamon and cozy hugs. 'I heard my tummy bell ring!' Mia announced proudly to Daddy. Daddy clapped his hands. 'That means it is breakfast time, my little star!' Mia sat in her big chair and put her red cloth napkin on her lap. Daddy scooped a spoonful of warm oatmeal into her bowl and topped it with three sweet blueberries. Mia used her spoon carefully, taking nice, slow bites. *Yum, yum, yum!* With every spoonful, her tummy bell chimed a happy little song of thanks. Mia felt so warm and cozy inside. She finished every single bite, washed her face, and put on her sparkly yellow shoes. Because she listened to her tummy bell, she had all the energy she needed to chase butterflies in the garden all morning long.

stories.title: Pip the Puppy’s Tummy Bell
stories.text: Deep in a soft, green meadow, there lived a little plush puppy named Pip. Pip had floppy brown ears and a tail that wagged whenever he was happy. Today, Pip and his best friend, a little girl named Lily, were playing hide-and-seek behind the big oak tree. 'Ready or not, here I come!' Lily called out. Pip scampered through the daisies, his paws going *pitter-patter, pitter-patter*. Suddenly, a sweet little sound popped out from Pip's tummy. *Ting-a-ling-ting!* Pip stopped right in his tracks and sat down in the soft grass. He tilted his head. 'Did you hear that?' Lily whispered, giggling. 'That was your tummy bell, Pip!' Pip gently touched his tummy with his paw. His tummy bell was ringing because it was time to rest and have a little picnic lunch. Even brave little puppies need to listen to their tummies! Lily opened her pretty blue picnic basket. Inside were delicious little cheese triangles and sweet strawberry slices. 'Time for a tummy-bell break, Pip!' Lily said cheerfully. Pip munched happily on a cheese triangle. *Crunch, chew, swallow!* His tummy bell chimed once more, this time sounding peaceful and full. Pip let out a happy little puppy sigh and rested his head on Lily’s sneakers. Listening to his tummy bell was so important because it kept him healthy and strong for all their fun games. After a tiny rest, Pip stood up, gave his tail a big wag, and barked a happy 'Woof!' ready to play hide-and-seek all over again.

stories.title: Leo and the Little Rumbly Tummy Bell
stories.text: Leo was a very busy little boy. He loved to zoom his blue toy car across the living room rug. Vroom, vroom, beep, beep! He loved to build tall towers with his wooden blocks. Crash! Down they would go, and Leo would giggle. But soon, Leo started to hear a funny sound deep inside his tummy. Ring-a-ling! It was a soft, gentle sound, like a tiny silver bell hiding right behind his belly button. Leo stopped zooming his car. He put his warm little hand right on his tummy to listen closer. Ring-a-ling-ling! His tummy bell was ringing a sweet little song. Leo smiled a big, happy smile because he knew what that magical sound meant. It was time for a yummy snack! Mommy walked into the room carrying a plate of bright red apple slices and some tasty cheese cubes. "I hear your tummy bell ringing, Leo!" Mommy said with a warm, loving hug. "It is telling us that your body is ready for some yummy food to help you grow strong." Leo sat right down at his little wooden table. He washed his hands with warm, bubbly soap, just like a big boy. Then, he picked up a crisp apple slice and took a nice, big bite. Crunch! The apple tasted so sweet and fresh. Leo chewed slowly and thoughtfully, feeling his tummy bell get happy and quiet. "Thank you, tummy bell," Leo whispered softly. When he was all finished, he had so much wonderful energy again. He gently picked up his blue car and zoomed it across the rug, ready for his next fun adventure. You are doing such a wonderful job listening to your own body every single day. Mommy and Daddy are so proud of how well you take care of yourself, little one. Eating healthy food gives you the power to run, jump, and play all day long. When your tummy bell rings, you always know just what to do.

stories.title: Mia and the Magic Tummy Bell Song
stories.text: Mia was painting a picture with her favorite pink and yellow paints. Swish, swosh, went her big paintbrush across the paper. She was painting a bright sun and some fluffy white clouds in the sky. Suddenly, Mia heard a quiet sound coming from her tummy. Plip, plop, rumble, rumble! It sounded just like a tiny bell ringing a little morning song. Mia put her paintbrush down safely in its cup. She looked down at her tummy and giggled. "Hello, tummy bell!" she said softly. Her tummy bell was telling her that it was breakfast time. Daddy walked over with a big bowl of warm, cozy oatmeal and some sweet blueberries on top. It smelled so delicious! "Does your tummy bell need a little song answered, Mia?" Daddy asked with a gentle, loving smile. Mia nodded her head happily. "Yes, Daddy! My tummy bell is ringing loud and clear!" Mia climbed up onto her big chair and tucked her napkin neatly on her lap. She took a spoonful of the warm oatmeal. It tasted like sweet honey and cinnamon. Every single bite made her tummy bell feel warm and cozy. Mia ate every last blueberry on her plate, using her spoon like a pro. "All done!" Mia cheered, clapping her hands together. Her tummy bell stopped ringing its little song because it was completely happy and full. Mia felt strong, bright, and ready to finish her wonderful painting of the sun. Listening to your tummy bell is such a smart thing to do. It helps you grow big, strong, and healthy. Every time you listen to your body, you show how much you care for yourself. Daddy and Mommy love watching you grow up into such a wonderful, mindful helper who knows just what her body needs to feel its very best.

stories.title: Toby and the Picnic Tummy Bell
stories.text: Toby was playing outside in the warm, sunny backyard. He chased a friendly butterfly as it fluttered near the green bushes. Flutter, flutter, fly! Toby ran and jumped with joy. But soon, a funny little sound chimed inside him. Ting-a-ling, rumble-rumble! It was his tummy bell, and it was singing a very busy song. Toby stopped running and hugged his tummy with both arms. "I hear you, tummy bell!" Toby called out happily to the open sky. He knew his tummy bell was telling him it was time for a picnic lunch in the soft grass. Grandma walked outside carrying a lovely red-and-white checkered basket. Inside was a delicious sandwich cut into fun star shapes and a juicy orange. "Looks like someone's tummy bell is ringing for a yummy picnic!" Grandma said, spreading out the cozy blanket on the grass. Toby sat down cross-legged, feeling the soft blades of grass beneath him. He washed his hands with a wet wipe that smelled like fresh lavender. Then, he picked up a star-shaped sandwich and took a big, happy bite. Mmm, it was so tasty! The cool breeze blew gently as Toby ate his lunch, listening to the birds chirp in the tall trees above. His tummy bell slowly stopped its rumbly song, feeling completely satisfied and full of love. Toby gave Grandma a big hug and thanked her for the wonderful food. Then, he stood up, feeling refreshed and ready to play in the yard again. Listening to your tummy bell is a wonderful superpower that helps you know when to rest and eat. You are learning so much about how your amazing body works, and that is truly fantastic. Keep listening to your tummy bell whenever it sings, and you will always have all the energy you need for a joyful, happy day filled with fun.

stories.title: Leo's Tummy Bell in the Morning
stories.text: Good morning, little Leo! The sun is peeking through your window, painting your bedroom wall with warm, yellow light. Time to wake up and start a brand new, wonderful day full of fun and games. *Ding-dong!* Oh, what was that soft sound? Did you hear it? That was your very own tummy bell! Your tummy bell is ringing gently, telling you it is time for a yummy breakfast to give you energy for all your big adventures today. Leo stretches his arms way up high, touching the ceiling, and giggles as his tummy gives another happy little rumble. *Gurgle-gurgle, ding!* Mommy is in the kitchen, and she is making warm, fluffy oatmeal with sweet, red strawberries on top, just the way you like it. Leo washes his little hands with bubbly soap, scrubbing between his fingers, and hurries to the table. As the warm spoon touches his mouth, Leo takes a big bite and smiles. Mmm, so delicious! He chews slowly and happily. Every single bite helps his tummy bell feel cozy and peaceful. 'All done!' says Leo, patting his happy tummy. Now his tummy bell is singing a quiet, content song because it is full and strong. With a happy heart and a happy tummy, Leo is ready to put on his shiny red shoes and play outside. You are doing such a wonderful job listening to your body, Leo. You know just what your tummy needs to grow big and strong. Let us have a wonderful day playing and exploring together!

stories.title: Mia and the Midday Tummy Song
stories.text: The afternoon sun is shining brightly outside, and Mia is busy building a enormous tower out of colorful wooden blocks. Red block, blue block, yellow block on top! Oh, look out, here it goes—crash! Down tumbling go the blocks, and Mia laughs out loud, clapping her little hands together. Suddenly, in the middle of all the playful giggles, Mia hears a funny sound. *Rumble-rumble, tummy-bell!* Mia stops and looks down at her tummy with wide, curious eyes. Her tummy bell is ringing a little midday song, letting her know it is time to take a tiny pause from building blocks to get some healthy fuel. 'Hello, tummy bell!' whispers Mia with a sweet smile. Daddy walks into the playroom carrying a bright yellow plate with crunchy apple slices and warm cheese cubes. That looks like the best snack in the whole wide world! Mia carefully puts her blocks back into their cozy toy box, showing what a great helper she is. Then, she washes her hands carefully at the sink, splashing just a little bit of water for fun. Sitting down at her little green table, Mia takes a crunchy bite of a sweet apple slice. Crunch, crunch, crunch! The tummy bell stops its loud rumbling and makes a soft, happy sigh. 'All finished,' Mia says proudly, showing Daddy her empty plate. Your body is so smart, Mia, for telling you when it needs a healthy snack to keep playing. You are growing up so fast, and listening to your tummy bell helps you stay strong, healthy, and ready for more fun afternoon adventures!

stories.title: Oliver's Bedtime Tummy Check
stories.text: The moon is glowing softly in the dark night sky, wearing a gentle, sleepy smile. The stars are twinkling like tiny diamonds, whispering sweet dreams to the world. It is time for bed, little Oliver, but first, we have a very special routine to do together. Oliver puts on his soft blue pajamas with the little white teddy bears on them. He brushes his teeth until they sparkle like stars. Then, Oliver climbs into his cozy bed and pulls his favorite fuzzy blanket right up to his chin. It is time for a bedtime tummy check! Oliver places his warm little hand right on his tummy and listens very closely. Is the tummy bell ringing for a big meal? No, the tummy bell is quiet and calm, humming a soft, sleepy lullaby. *Hush-hush, sleep-sleep.* That means Oliver’s tummy is completely ready for a long, peaceful night of dreaming. Mommy leans down and gives Oliver a soft kiss right on his forehead, whispering, 'I love you to the moon and back, my sweet boy.' Oliver hugs his fluffy stuffed bear, closes his heavy eyelids, and breathes in and out, nice and slow. His tummy rises and falls like a gentle wave on a calm ocean. Listening to your tummy bell helps you know your body is safe, relaxed, and ready for sweet dreams. Sleep tight, little Oliver. Tomorrow is another wonderful day to listen to your body, play, and grow. Good night, sleep tight, until the morning light brings a brand new day of fun!

stories.title: Leo and the Magical Tummy Bell
stories.text:
Once upon a time, in a cozy little yellow house, lived a happy little boy named Leo. Leo loved to zoom around like a fast race car. Zoom, zoom, go! He loved to build tall towers of wooden blocks and crash them down with a big giggle. Crash! 

Suddenly, right in the middle of a fun game, Leo heard a tiny, soft sound. Ring-dong! It was not a doorbell on the front door. It was not a bicycle bell outside. It was the magical Tummy Bell! Ring-dong, went Leo’s tummy. That was Leo’s special belly telling him it was time to take a little rest and have some yummy snacks.

Leo stopped his race car right in its tracks. He put his hands right on his tummy and giggled. "Hello, Tummy Bell! I hear you!" he whispered.

His kind mommy walked into the room with a big, warm smile. She carried a bright red plate with apple slices and yummy cheese cubes. "Did your Tummy Bell ring, Leo?" mommy asked gently.

"Yes!" Leo cheered, clapping his hands together. "It went ring-dong!"

Leo washed his hands with bubbly, warm soap and sat right down at his little wooden table. He took a big, crunchy bite of an apple slice. Crunch, crunch, crunch! The apple tasted so sweet and fresh. Next, he ate a little cube of cheese. 

As Leo ate his healthy snacks, he could feel his tummy getting happy and full. The Tummy Bell stopped ringing its loud ring-dong and started to hum a soft, cozy song. Mm-mm-mm, went the happy tummy.

"All done!" Leo said proudly, wiping his little hands with a soft blue napkin. 

Mommmy scooped Leo up into a giant, loving hug. "Good listening, my sweet boy! You listened so well to your Tummy Bell, and now you have all the energy you need to play again."

Leo smiled a big, proud smile. He loved his magical Tummy Bell, and he loved being such a super listener. With a happy hop, Leo skipped back to his blocks, ready for more wonderful playtime.

stories.title: Mia’s Gentle Tummy Bell
stories.text:
Good morning, sunshine! Today was a very busy day for little Mia. Mia was a brave little explorer. She wore her shiny pink shoes and marched around the living room rug. March, march, march! She pretended the sofa was a big green mountain and the pillows were fluffy white clouds.

After a long time of marching and exploring, Mia felt something special happening deep inside her. Rumbly-rumble, went a soft little sound. It was Mia’s Tummy Bell!

Mia stopped her march right away and looked down at her sparkly shirt. She put her small hand right over her belly button. "Did you hear that, Teddy?" Mia whispered to her favorite stuffed bear.

Teddy bear sat very still, listening closely. Rumbly-rumble, went the Tummy Bell again. It was time to pause the exploring and give the tummy a yummy treat!

Daddy walked into the room holding a warm bowl of creamy oatmeal with sweet banana slices on top. Steam was gently floating up into the air. "Ah, I think I hear a very important bell ringing," Daddy said with a warm, loving grin.

"My Tummy Bell!" Mia announced happily. "It’s telling me it is time for breakfast!"

Daddy helped Mia wash her hands until they were squeaky clean. Then, Mia climbed up into her big girl chair. She picked up her spoon carefully. Scoop, lift, and crunch! Mia took a big bite of the sweet banana and warm oatmeal. It tasted like sunshine and hugs.

With every single bite, Mia could hear her Tummy Bell getting happier and quieter. The rumbly noises turned into gentle, happy sighs. 

"Look, Daddy! My Tummy Bell is resting now!" Mia said, showing him her empty bowl.

Daddy clapped his hands together. "You are such a wonderful listener, Mia! Listening to your Tummy Bell helps your body grow strong and healthy."

Mia beamed with joy. She gave Daddy a big hug and jumped down from her chair, ready to explore her world with a happy, full tummy and a big smile.

stories.title: Sam and the Tummy Bell Song
stories.text:
Once upon a time, in a cozy blue room, a little boy named Sam was painting a picture. He used bright yellow paint, sparkly green paint, and happy blue paint. Swish, swash, went his paintbrush across the big paper.

Suddenly, Sam heard a very familiar sound coming from underneath his shirt. Grumble-rumble! It was his very own Tummy Bell!

Sam carefully placed his paintbrush down inside a cup of water. He wiped his hands on a colorful smock and patted his tummy with a gentle hand. "Hello there, Tummy Bell," Sam said softly. "I hear your song!"

The Tummy Bell was singing a special song to let Sam know it needed some yummy food fuel. Grumble-rumble, went the tummy again, reminding him kindly.

Grandma popped her head into the doorway with a twinkle in her eye. She was carrying a small plate with warm toast and bright orange slices. "Is someone’s Tummy Bell singing a song today?" Grandma asked cheerfully.

"Yes, Grandma!" Sam laughed, pointing to his belly. "It went grumble-rumble!"

Grandma smiled warmly. "Let's go wash up so we can give your Tummy Bell what it needs." Sam washed his hands with lots of soapy bubbles, making sure they were super clean.

Then, Sam sat down at the kitchen table. He picked up a piece of warm toast with strawberry spread. Munch, munch, munch! It was so delicious. Then he ate a sweet, juicy orange slice. 

As Sam ate his healthy snack, the grumble-rumble sound melted away into a quiet, happy hum. The Tummy Bell was completely satisfied and resting peacefully.

Grandma gently kissed the top of Sam’s head. "Such a good listener, my clever boy! You always know just when to listen to your body."

Sam felt so proud and happy inside. He finished his snack, gave Grandma a big cuddle, and went back to his painting with a joyful heart, ready to finish his wonderful artwork.

rhymes.title: The Tummy Bell is Ringing
rhymes.text:
Ring-a-ling, oh hear the sound,
See the tummy jumping round!
Is it hungry? Yes, it is!
Time to fill it up with fizz?
No, no, water in the cup,
Eat your yummy carrots up!
Listen close, what does it say?
Time to fuel our busy day.
Ding-dong, ding-dong, hear it ring,
Make the happy tummy sing!
Spoon goes up and spoon goes down,
Best little eater in the town.
All done now, the bell is still,
Happy tummy had its fill!
Pat your tummy, pat it twice,
Eating healthy is so nice!

rhymes.title: Tummy Music in the Morning
rhymes.text:
Wake up, wake up, time to rise,
 Rub the sleep right from your eyes.
 Hark! A rumble deep inside,
 Nowhere for that sound to hide!
 It's the tummy ringing clear,
 Food is coming, do not fear.
 Grab a bowl and grab a spoon,
 We will eat and play real soon.
 Munch and crunch and chew it slow,
 Watch your little body grow.
 Listen to the tummy bell,
 Telling you that you are well.
 Gulp of milk and bite of toast,
 That is what we love the most.
 Now the little bell is done,
 Time to go and have some fun!

rhymes.title: The Little Food Bell
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock, tick-tock, lunchtime's near,
 Listen for the bell right here.
 Rumba-rumba goes the tum,
 Waiting for a yummy crumb.
 Do you hear the gentle chime?
 Surely it is eating time!
 Wash your hands and sit up tall,
 Big kids listen when it's call.
 Chew it softly, nice and sweet,
 What a super tasty treat!
 Tummy bell is ringing loud,
 Making all the grown-ups proud.
 Swallow nicely, take a breath,
 Happy tummy takes a rest.
 Silence now, the song is through,
 Tummy bells are proud of you!

rhymes.title: Ding-Dong Tummy Bell
rhymes.text:
Listen up, oh listen close,
Tummy bell is like a rose?
No, it rings when food is nigh,
Watch the hungry tummy cry!
Ding-dong, ding-dong, hear the chime,
It is definitely mealtime.
Pile the plate with green and red,
Time to get the tummy fed.
Chomp and chew, and take a bite,
Eating everything just right.
Tummy bell is singing low,
Now it's time to stop and go.
All finished, wipe your face,
Clean up all around the place.
Pat your tummy, soft and neat,
What a wonderful young athlete!

rhymes.title: Sing a Song of Tummy Bells
rhymes.text:
Sing a song of tummy bells,
Listen close to what it tells.
It is speaking just to you,
Saying 'give me something chew!'
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Eating time is here today.
Apple slices, yellow pear,
Yummy food is everywhere.
Chomp it down and make it small,
Listen to the tummy call.
Ding-ding-ding, the bell is clear,
 Glad that breakfast time is here.
 Rub your tummy, make it smile,
 Rest and settle for a while.
Tummy bells are resting now,
We can make a happy bow!

rhymes.title: The Morning Tummy Bell
rhymes.text:
Wake up, little sleepy head,
Time to wiggle out of bed.
Hear the little tummy ring,
Time to eat and time to sing!

Gurgle, rumble, ding-a-ling,
Such a happy sound to bring.
Reach up high and touch your toes,
Then off down the hallway goes.

Sit right down and grab your spoon,
We will eat and play a tune.
Munch a crunch and chew it slow,
Watch your happy tummy grow.

Now you're full and feeling bright,
Ready for a day of light!

rhymes.title: Playtime Tummy Bell
rhymes.text:
Building blocks up to the sky,
Watch the paper airplanes fly.
Wait, what is that funny sound?
Dancing all around the ground?

Tummy bell says time to eat,
Time for a delicious treat.
Wash your hands and make them clean,
Best little helper ever seen.

Apples slice and crackers crunch,
Oh, we love our little lunch!
Swallow every single bite,
Everything is feeling right.

Now back to our games so fun,
Look at what we've just begun!

rhymes.title: The Afternoon Chime
rhymes.text:
Afternoon is here at last,
Time is moving very fast.
Running fast and jumping high,
Reaching up to touch the sky.

Wait, I hear a gentle ring,
Telling us of yummy things.
It's the tummy bell so sweet,
Calling us for some more meat!

Grab a carrot, take a crunch,
This is such a happy bunch.
Chew it softly, chew it deep,
Before we go and count some sheep.

Now your tummy feels so glad,
