stories.title: Sammy’s Starry Crown
stories.text:
Sammy the bunny rabbit hopped into the kitchen where Daddy was making yummy fruit snacks. Sammy stopped hopping because his tummy gave him a little nudge. It was time to pause the fun games and head to the bathroom!

Daddy knelt down to Sammy’s eye level with a loving smile. 'I think it is time for a royal visit, Sammy,' Daddy whispered warmly. 'And look what is waiting for our brave explorer!' Daddy showed him a magnificent blue crown covered in bright yellow felt stars. It was the legendary Potty Crown!

Sammy loved stars. He reached out and touched the soft felt. 'For me?' he asked softly. 'Yes, for you, if you try your best on the potty,' Daddy encouraged him.

Hand in hand, Sammy and Daddy walked down the hallway together. Sammy sat down on his cheerful blue potty chair. Daddy sat nearby, reading a short, silly story about a flying train to keep Sammy company. Sammy relaxed and smiled. In just a little while, Sammy completed his important mission.

'Look at you go, superstar!' Daddy cheered, wrapping Sammy in a big, warm hug. Daddy placed the starry blue Potty Crown securely on Sammy's head. Sammy touched the crown proudly and laughed out loud.

They went to the sink to wash their hands, scrubbing with bubbly strawberry soap until their hands were super clean. Sammy wore his starry crown to the dinner table that evening. Every time he looked in the mirror, he remembered how wonderful it felt to listen to his body and use the potty successfully. Sammy was a happy, growing toddler, ready for any adventure that came his way!

stories.title: Leo and the Magic Potty Chair
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a cozy little house, lived a happy little boy named Leo. Leo was growing up so fast! Today, Leo was playing with his favorite red blocks, building a super tall tower that reached all the way up to the couch. Suddenly, Leo stopped. He felt a little wiggle in his tummy. A potty wiggle! "Uh oh," said Leo with a big smile. Mommy walked over and gave him a gentle, loving hug. "Do you feel the potty calling, Leo?" she asked warmly. Leo nodded his head yes and giggled. "It is time for the Potty Crown adventure!" Mommy cheered. They walked together into the bright, cheerful bathroom. Right there waiting for Leo was his very own special potty chair. It had shiny stickers of happy stars and zooming spaceships all around it. Leo sat right down on his potty chair, feeling very brave and very big. "Time to relax and let go," Mommy whispered softly, rubbing Leo's warm back. Guess what? Splash! Hooray! Leo did it! He used the potty all by himself like a big boy. Mommy clapped her hands together happily and did a silly little victory dance. "You are a Potty Champion, Leo!" she cheered. Leo felt so proud of his tummy and his big accomplishment. He got to flush the potty all by himself, watching the water swirl around and around. Then, it was time to wash their hands with the bubbly, soapy bubbles that smelled just like sweet strawberries. Scrub, scrub, scrub went their hands. Leo dried his hands on a fluffy blue towel and beamed from ear to ear. He looked in the mirror and patted his own head. He truly felt like royalty. His day continued with more block building, feeling so happy, dry, and clean. Yay for Leo!

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Star Crown
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! Today was a very special day for Mia. Mia was wearing her favorite yellow dress with dancing polka dots. She was playing peek-a-boo with her fluffy stuffed bunny, Hopper. Suddenly, Mia made a little face. Her tummy felt warm and bubbly. She stopped playing and whispered, "Bunny, my tummy says it is time!" Daddy heard her and smiled a wonderful, encouraging smile. "I think the potty is calling our sweet girl," Daddy said gently. Mia took Daddy’s big, warm hand, and together they skipped all the way to the bathroom. In the corner sat Mia’s special pink potty, decorated with sparkling gold crowns just for a princess. Mia sat down carefully, feeling as cozy as can be. Daddy handed her a favorite picture book about a little duck who loved to splash. They turned the pages slowly while Mia relaxed. A few moments passed, and then—success! Mia gave a happy little cheer. "I did it, Daddy!" she shouted joyfully. Daddy gave her the biggest, warmest hug in the whole wide world. "You did it, Mia! You used the potty like a wonderful big girl!" To celebrate, Daddy reached for the special reward chart on the wall. Together, they picked out a shiny gold star sticker that sparkled in the light. Mia pressed the star right onto her chart, watching it gleam proudly. Then they went to the sink to wash their hands. They made giant soap mountains on their fingers and washed them all away with warm water. Mia felt so fresh, so happy, and so very proud. She gave Hopper a big squeeze. She was a true potty superstar, ready for all the fun adventures the rest of the day would bring.

stories.title: Oliver's Royal Potty Train
stories.Kitten: Oliver was a busy, busy engine. Chugga-chugga, choo-choo! Oliver the little train zoomed around the living room rug, carrying a load of fuzzy green dinosaurs. But right in the middle of his journey, Oliver stopped his engine. Toot-toot! His tummy gave him a funny little rumble. Oliver knew that rumble anywhere. It was time to make a quick stop at the potty station! Grandma was sitting nearby knitting a cozy blanket. She looked up and beamed a loving smile. "All aboard the Potty Train, Oliver!" she sang out cheerfully. Oliver didn't even need to be asked twice. He stood right up, beeped his pretend train horn, and marched like a brave conductor into the bathroom. There sat his cool blue potty chair, waiting just for him. Oliver sat down securely, pretending his potty chair was the engine cabin of a magnificent express train. Grandma sat on a small stool nearby, cheering him on with soft, gentle clapping. "Choo-choo, go potty, little engine," Grandma hummed happily. Oliver relaxed his tummy muscles, and plop went the magic sounds into the bowl. "Hooray!" shouted Oliver, clapping his hands together in pure delight. Grandma gave him a high-five and a warm kiss on his forehead. "You listened to your body so well, Oliver. I am so proud of you!" Next came the best part: flushing the big handle and watching the water rush away. Then, it was time for the soap station at the sink. Oliver scrubbed his hands with foamy green soap until they smelled like fresh mint. He felt so clean, so proud, and ready to drive his train all over again. Hip, hip, hooray for the potty!

stories.title: Leo and the Magical Potty Crown
stories.text:
Once upon a time, in a cozy blue house, lived a little boy named Leo. Leo was growing up so fast! Today was a very special day because Leo was going to earn his very first Potty Crown. 

In the morning, after eating his crunchy apple slices, Leo felt a little wiggle in his tummy. Uh oh! That was his body telling him it was time to visit the big bathroom. 

"Time to try, Leo!" said Mommy with a warm, gentle smile. 

Leo hurried over to his friendly green potty chair. He sat down and took a nice, deep breath, just like a sleeping bear. He waited patiently and played with his favorite yellow duck toy. 

Plop! Hooray! Leo did it! He used the potty all by himself.

Daddy clapped his hands with joy. "Look at our big boy!" 

Then, Daddy walked over to the shelf and picked up something shiny and bright. It was the Potty Crown, made of golden paper and sparkling star stickers. Daddy placed it gently right on top of Leo's head. 

Leo looked in the mirror and giggled with delight. The crown sparkled in the light, making him feel like a true potty king. He walked around the living room, marching proudly. "Look at me! I am the king of the potty!" 

Whenever Leo felt that little tummy wiggle again all through the day, he remembered his special crown. He always made it to the potty on time. Going to the potty was easy and fun when you were royalty. As the sun began to set and it was time for bed, Leo placed his shiny crown safely on his nightstand, ready to wear again tomorrow. He felt so proud of his wonderful growing body, drifting off to sleep with a happy smile.

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Morning Crown
stories.text:
Good morning, sunshine! Today was a brand new day for little Mia. Mia loved playing with her colorful blocks, building tall towers that reached all the way to the sky. But today, Mia had a very important mission.

While Mia was stacking a red block on top of a blue one, she felt a funny little signal down below. Her tummy gave a tiny squeeze. 

"Mia," said Grandma gently, "do you need to visit your potty chair?"

Mia nodded her head. "Yes, Grandma! Time to try!"

Mia set her blocks down carefully and walked right over to her pink potty chair. She sat down, feeling very cozy and brave. Grandma sat nearby, reading a sweet story about a little bunny who loved to jump.

Splish, splash! Mia cheered as she used the potty just like a big girl. 

Grandma’s eyes lit up. "You did it, Mia! That is wonderful!" 

Grandma reached behind her back and pulled out a magnificent Potty Crown decorated with shiny pink jewels and purple ribbons. Grandma placed the sparkling crown gently on Mia's curly hair.

Mia gasped happily. She touched the soft ribbons and looked down at her sparkly jewels. "My crown!" she whispered with pure delight.

"You earned every single sparkle today because you listened to your body," Grandma praised, giving Mia a warm hug.

Mia wore her crown all morning long while she painted pictures of butterflies and fed her teddy bear pretend soup. Every time she looked in the mirror, she remembered how well she did. Mia learned that listening to her body helps her grow big and strong, and wearing a crown makes every victory feel like a grand celebration.

stories.title: Sam's Castle of Clean
stories.text:
In a cozy yellow bedroom lived a little boy named Sam. Sam loved wearing capes and pretending to be a brave knight protecting his castle. Today, Sam was going on a brand new kind of adventure.

Sam was busy building a pillow fort when suddenly, his tummy gave a familiar rumble. It was time for action! Sam stood up straight and tall, ready for the challenge.

"To the bathroom!" whispered Sam with a determined grin.

He marched down the hallway to his special blue potty chair. As a brave knight, Sam knew exactly what to do. He sat down safely and securely, taking a deep breath and relaxing his shoulders.

One, two, three, success! Sam smiled brightly. He washed his hands with bubbly soap, making lots of giant soap bubbles that floated in the air.

Grandpa was waiting in the doorway with a huge smile. "Hear ye, hear ye!" announced Grandpa in a playful, booming voice. "For bravery and success on the potty today, Sir Sam receives the Royal Potty Crown!"

Grandpa gently placed a silver crown covered in shiny blue gems onto Sam’s head. 

Sam touched the cool silver cardboard and beamed with pride. "I got the crown! I am a potty knight!"

"You certainly are," said Grandpa proudly. "You always know just when to go, and you take such good care of yourself."

Sam wore his sparkly silver crown for the rest of the day, ruling his pillow castle with kindness and joy. He knew that growing up was a great adventure, and earning his Potty Crown made him feel like the happiest knight in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Leo and the Potty Crown
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a cozy little house, lived a happy little boy named Leo. Leo was growing up so fast. Today was a very special day because Leo was going on a big-boy adventure. He was going to find the Potty Crown! Leo's mom smiled warmly and pointed to the bathroom. 'Are you ready, Leo?' she asked gently. Leo nodded with a big, bright smile. 'Yes, Mommy! I am ready!' He walked into the bathroom, feeling brave and strong. Sitting down on the big potty, Leo took a nice, deep breath. He relaxed his little shoulders and waited patiently. Suddenly, he heard a soft tinkle. 'Yay, Leo!' cheered his mom. 'You did it!' Suddenly, out of nowhere, a magical golden crown appeared right on the back of the potty. It shimmered with sparkly blue jewels and twinkled like a star. Leo gasped in pure wonder. He gently picked up the shiny Potty Crown and placed it right on top of his head. It fit him just right. 'Look at me, Mommy! I am the Potty King!' Leo giggled, feeling so proud and tall. His mom clapped her hands with joy and gave him the biggest, warmest hug ever. 'You listened to your body, Leo, and you did a wonderful job.' They danced around the bathroom together, celebrating Leo's big-boy success. Leo realized that using the potty was not scary at all; it was actually a wonderful adventure. From that day on, every time Leo needed to go, he remembered his special golden crown. He felt happy, confident, and ready for whatever came next. Washing his hands with bubbly soap, Leo smiled in the mirror at his royal reflection. He was growing up to be such a big, clever boy, and he couldn't wait to tell his teddy bear all about his royal crown.

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Royal Seat
stories.text: Good morning, sweet Mia! Today was a wonderful day full of sunshine and fun games. Mia was playing with her colorful blocks when she suddenly felt a little rumble in her tummy. Her friend, Teddy the bear, was sitting right beside her. Mia whispered, 'Teddy, my tummy feels like it wants to dance.' Her dad walked over with a gentle, loving grin and asked, 'Does my little princess need to visit the magical potty?' Mia nodded happily. 'Yes, Daddy! Time for the Potty Crown!' Holding her dad's big hand, Mia skipped into the bright bathroom. The little potty was waiting patiently for her, looking very clean and cozy. Mia carefully sat down on the seat, feeling safe and comfy. She took a deep breath in, smelling the lovely flowers, and blew out softly like she was blowing out a birthday candle. Whew! Down below, she heard a happy little sound. Splash! Mia clapped her hands together. 'I did it, Daddy! I went on the potty!' Her dad cheered loudly, 'Hooray for Mia! You listened to your tummy so well!' Right at that moment, a sparkly pink Potty Crown sat glowing on the counter, just for her. Mia reached out and placed the glittery crown gently on her curly hair. She looked in the mirror and beamed with pride. 'I am a potty princess!' she declared happily. Her dad kissed her cheek and praised her hard work. Washing her hands with lovely strawberry soap made her hands smell sweet and clean. Mia felt so proud of herself for being such a big girl. She gave Teddy a high-five and did a little happy dance in the hallway. Wearing her shiny crown all morning long, Mia knew she could do anything she set her mind to. Growing up was so much fun, especially when there were royal rewards for listening to your body.

stories.title: Sam and the Magic Kingdom
stories.text: Deep in a kingdom of toys and blankets lived a little explorer named Sam. Sam loved building tall towers and zooming his race cars across the rug. But today, Sam's tummy gave him a little wiggle-wobble signal. It was time for a very important mission. Sam's grandma smiled kindly and said, 'Sammy, do you feel a wiggle in your tummy? It might be time to find your Potty Crown.' Sam's eyes lit up with excitement. 'Yes, Grandma! My rocket ship needs to visit the station!' With big, proud steps, Sam marched right into the bathroom. He pulled down his dinosaur shorts and sat down carefully on the potty seat. He pretended he was a brave spaceship pilot waiting for countdown. 3, 2, 1, blast off! Sam relaxed and let his body do its natural magic. A few seconds later, he heard a happy little sound. 'Success!' Sam cheered loudly. Grandma rushed in with a proud, loving grin and a shiny green Potty Crown covered in silver stars. 'Look at what appeared for our brave explorer!' she whispered happily. Sam carefully picked up the crown and placed it proudly on his head. It sparkled under the bathroom light. 'I found the Potty Crown, Grandma!' Sam shouted with pure delight. Grandma clapped and cheered, telling him how smart and capable he was. They washed Sam's hands with bubbly blue soap, watching the tiny bubbles pop into the air. Sam dried his hands on a fluffy towel, still wearing his royal green crown with pride. He felt so clean, so happy, and so grown-up. Back in the playroom, Sam placed his crown safely on a shelf, ready for his next big-boy adventure. He knew that whenever his tummy gave him that familiar wiggle, he was strong enough and smart enough to earn his crown all over again.

stories.title: Leo and the Magical Potty Crown
stories.text:
Once upon a time, in a cozy little house, lived a sweet little boy named Leo. Leo was growing up so fast. Today was a very special day because Leo was going on a big-kid adventure. He was going to try the potty all by himself! 

Mommy smiled and held up a shiny, sparkling object. 'Look, Leo!' she said. 'It is the Potty Crown!' The crown shimmered with golden stars and bright blue jewels. It looked fit for a brave little king. 

'Can I wear the crown?' Leo asked, his eyes wide with wonder. 

'Yes, when you do a great job on the potty, this magic crown is all yours to wear,' Mommy cheered softly. 

Suddenly, Leo felt a little wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! It was time. Leo didn't wait. He marched right into the bathroom, feeling as brave as a lion. Up he climbed onto his little blue potty seat. 

'You can do it, Leo,' whispered Mommy, giving him a gentle, loving hug. 

Leo took a deep breath and relaxed. He sang his favorite little song, waiting patiently. Hip-hip-hooray! Success! Leo did it. He used the potty just like a big boy. 

Mommy clapped her hands with joy. 'You did it, superstar!' She gently placed the sparkling Potty Crown right on top of Leo's head. It fit him perfectly. 

Leo looked in the mirror and beamed with pride. He stood up straight and walked into the living room, feeling like royalty. Daddy saw him and gasped happily. 'All hail King Leo, the Potty Champion!' 

Leo giggled and did a happy little dance. Wearing his crown made him feel so proud and happy. He washed his hands with bubbly soap, keeping his crown shining bright. From that day on, Leo knew he could do big things, one happy step at a time. The End.

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Royal Seat
stories.text:
Mia was playing with her favorite pink blocks when she felt a funny little rumble. She stopped and blinked. Her tummy was sending her a very important message. It was time to visit the potty! 

Mia loved her daily routine, but sometimes stopping play was hard. Today, however, Daddy had a wonderful surprise waiting in the bathroom. 

'Come along, Princess Mia,' Daddy sang out softly. 'Your royal throne is ready!' 

Mia skipped into the bathroom. Sitting right on top of the big potty was a special sticker-covered potty seat. And resting right beside it was the most magnificent Potty Crown, made of pink felt and glittering pink sparkles. 

'Is that for me?' Mia asked, clapping her hands together. 

'It is waiting for the bravest princess in the land,' Daddy smiled warmly. 

Mia climbed up onto her cozy seat. She felt safe, happy, and so grown-up. She took a deep breath and waited patiently, hugging her favorite stuffed bunny. Just like magic, everything happened just as it should. Mia cheered, 'Yay! I went on the potty!' 

Daddy cheered even louder. 'Hip-hip-hooray for Princess Mia!' 

Carefully, Daddy picked up the sparkling Potty Crown and placed it gently on Mia's shiny curls. Mia looked at her reflection in the mirror and smiled her biggest, brightest smile. She felt like she could touch the sky. 

After washing her hands with nice, soapy bubbles, Mia wore her crown proudly as she played with her blocks again. She felt so comfortable and so proud of her wonderful achievement. Every time her tummy rumbled after that, Mia knew just what to do to earn her sparkly crown. The End.

stories.title: Toby's Great Potty Adventure
stories.text:
Toby was a busy little explorer. Today, his trusty dinosaur toy, Rex, was coming with him on a very important mission. Toby felt a sudden wiggle in his tummy. That wiggle always meant it was time to pause and check in with his body. 

'Rex, we have a mission,' Toby whispered to his dinosaur. 'It is potty time!' 

Toby walked steadily into the bathroom. Waiting on the counter was something magical. It was the Potty Crown, decorated with green leaves and shiny silver stickers. It looked like something a jungle explorer would wear. 

Grandma was there waiting with a warm, encouraging smile. 'Are you ready to earn your crown, Toby?' she asked gently. 

'Yes, Grandma! I am a fast explorer!' Toby said bravely. 

Toby sat down on his cozy little green potty. Grandma sat nearby, reading a short story about friendly little frogs. Toby listened closely, relaxed his tummy, and let nature take its course. 

Plip, plop! Toby smiled. 'I did it!' he announced proudly. 

'Wonderful job, my sweet explorer!' Grandma cheered, wrapping him in a big, cozy hug. 'You listened to your body so well.' 

Grandma picked up the sparkling Potty Crown and placed it gently on Toby's head. Toby felt so light and happy. He stood tall, holding Rex high in the air. 

'Look at my crown!' Toby told Rex with a big grin. 

They washed their hands thoroughly with foamy soap, keeping germs far away. Toby wore his crown for the rest of the morning, feeling like the happiest explorer in the whole wide world. He knew that listening to his body and using the potty was a wonderful adventure. The End.

stories.title: Leo's Royal Potty Crown
stories.text: Once upon a time, in a bright blue castle with big squeaky doors, lived a little boy named Leo. Leo was a big boy now, nearly three whole years old. Every morning, Leo wore his very favorite yellow shirt and socks with roaring dinosaurs on them. But today, something extra special was waiting on the shiny white throne in the bathroom. It was the Potty Crown! It shimmered with silver glitter and had big red jewels that sparkled whenever the bathroom light bounced off them. Mama smiled warmly and handed the crown to Leo. 'Are you ready to wear your royal crown today, Prince Leo?' she asked gently. Leo clapped his hands together with a loud giggle. 'Yes! I am a potty prince!' he cheered. Just then, Leo felt a familiar little wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! That wiggle meant it was time. With big, brave steps, Leo marched right over to the potty. He pulled down his dinosaur pants and sat down gently, just like a king taking his seat at the grand royal table. 'Deep breath in, big breath out,' Mama whispered softly, rubbing his shoulder. Leo squeezed his hands together and tried his very best. Splash went a tiny drop, and then a little more! Leo’s eyes widened with pure joy. 'I did it! I made a potty drop!' he shouted happily. Mama scooped up the sparkling Potty Crown and placed it right on top of Leo’s curly brown hair. It fit just right. Leo stood up tall, feeling so proud and brave. He flushed the handle with a loud WHOOSH and washed his hands with bubbly, strawberry-scented soap. For the rest of the day, Leo wore his Potty Crown while he played with his blocks, ate his crunchy apple slices, and built towers all the way to the ceiling. Whenever he looked in the mirror, he saw a true potty champion smiling right back at him. Hooray for Leo and his royal crown!

stories.title: Mia and the Magic Bathroom Kingdom
stories.text: Deep in the heart of a cozy house lived a sweet little girl named Mia. Mia loved painting pictures of pink unicorns, reading books about fluffy bunnies, and playing peek-a-boo with her stuffed kitty. Today, Mia had a very important mission. She was going to visit the Magic Bathroom Kingdom! Papa helped her walk down the hallway, holding her tiny hand. Waiting patiently on the potty was a magical surprise—a gorgeous golden Potty Crown adorned with little pink stars and a fluffy white feather on top. Mia gasped, her little hands flying up to her mouth in wonder. 'Is that for me, Papa?' she whispered, her eyes shining bright. 'It certainly is,' Papa said with a loving smile. 'This crown belongs to the bravest princess in the whole wide world—Princess Mia.' Mia felt a warm, happy feeling bubble up inside her tummy. Suddenly, her tummy gave a little rumble. It was a gentle reminder from her body that it was time to visit her royal throne. Mia didn't wait a single second. She hurried over to the potty, lifted her floral skirt, and sat down comfortably. 'You are doing such a wonderful job,' Papa encouraged, gently brushing her hair. Mia relaxed her shoulders and sang her favorite counting song. One, two, three, four, five! And right on cue, plip-plop went the tiny treasures into the potty below. Mia bounced excitedly on the seat. 'Look, Papa! I used the potty like a big girl!' Papa cheered and clapped loudly, his face beaming with pride. Carefully, he lifted the golden Potty Crown and placed it securely on Mia’s head. Mia felt like the luckiest princess in the universe. She washed her hands with soapy bubbles, splashing water playfully. Wearing her shiny crown, Mia spent the rest of the afternoon dancing around the living room, feeling extra tall, extra smart, and completely ready for whatever wonderful adventures came her way next.

stories.title: Sam's Starry Potty Crown
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! Today was a brand new day full of fun for Sam. Sam was a busy toddler who loved zooming red race cars across the rug and building gigantic towers out of wooden blocks. But today, Sam had a super special helper to guide him through his morning routine. Sitting right on the edge of the big porcelain throne was the Starry Potty Crown! It was painted dark blue like the night sky, covered in glowing yellow stars and shiny silver moons. Nana held up the crown for Sam to see. 'Good morning, Captain Sam! Are you ready to captain your ship to the potty today?' she asked in a joyful, singing voice. Sam giggled and nodded his head eagerly. 'Yes, Nana! Let's go zoom!' Just as he reached for his favorite red car, his tummy gave a little wiggle and a nudge. It was the signal! Sam knew just what to do. He zoomed his race car right over to the bathroom parking spot and carefully parked it on the floor. With Nana’s gentle help, Sam hopped up onto the potty seat. He wiggled his toes and took a big, deep breath, pretending to smell a sweet flower. Ahhh! Then he blew out the pretend birthday candle. Whoosh! Almost instantly, he heard a friendly little plop in the bowl. Sam’s face lit up like a bright lightbulb. 'Nana, look! I did it!' he shouted with glee. Nana cheered and clapped her hands together. 'You did it, Sam! You used the potty all by yourself!' Nana proudly picked up the Starry Potty Crown and gently placed it right on Sam’s head, making sure it sat straight. Sam stood up, washed his hands with foamy green apple soap, and splashed a tiny bit of water. Wearing his starry crown, Sam walked back into his room feeling like a true superstar. He knew that growing up big was so much fun, especially when you have a magical crown to celebrate every single success along the way.

rhymes.title: The Potty Throne
rhymes.text:
Time to stop our play today,
We hear the little potty say!
Drop the toys upon the floor,
Let us skip right through the door.
Pull your pants down, nice and low,
Sit right down and watch it grow.
Take a breath and count to three,
Look how happy we can be!
Push it out, a little squeeze,
Doing super well with ease!
Potty time is fun and bright,
Everything is feeling right.
Wipe your bottom till it's clean,
Fit for any little king or queen!
Wash your hands with bubbly soap,
Potty training gives us hope!

rhymes.title: King and Queen of the Seat
rhymes.text:
Hear the royal trumpet sound,
Bestest potty to be found!
Marching down the hallway floor,
Right up to the bathroom door.
Climb on up and take your crown,
Sit so softly, settling down.
 wiggle wiggle, wiggle round,
Happy giggles make a sound.
Time to try, we do our best,
Passing every potty test!
Splash goes water, hear it ring,
Little song we love to sing.
Stand right up and pull things high,
Wave the soggy wipe goodbye!
Wash the germs all down the drain,
Potty royals rule again!

rhymes.title: The Potty Dance
rhymes.text:
Do the little potty dance,
Quickly, quickly, grab the chance!
Hop on one foot, wiggle toes,
Follow where the feeling goes.
Here's the chair so white and neat,
Resting all your little feet.
Drop your trousers, big and bold,
Listen to the stories told.
Wait a minute, count to ten,
Here it comes and out again!
Give a cheer and shout hooray,
Potty wins the day today!
Wipe up nicely, neat and sweet,
Stand right up upon your feet.
Wash your hands so clean and bright,
Ready for a great delight!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diaper
rhymes.text:
Diaper days are done and past,
Big kid underwear at last!
When you feel the signal grow,
Off to potty we must go.
Hurry, hurry, do not wait,
Arriving right here at the gate.
Pull them down and take a seat,
This adventure can't be beat.
Relax your tummy, let it flow,
Watch the yellow river go.
Clap your hands and shout aloud,
Making mommy very proud!
Wipe it up and flush it down,
Wearing proud your potty crown.
Soap and water make it clean,
Freshest kid you've ever seen!

rhymes.title: Potty Magic Time
rhymes.text:
Potty magic in the air,
See it sitting waiting there.
Drop your blocks and start to run,
Bathroom time is lots of fun!
Up you go, a gentle hop,
Waiting for the magic drop.
Deep breath in and let it out,
Hear the happy toddler shout!
All finished now, we look inside,
Filling up with so much pride.
Flush the handle, hear it roar,
Watch it swirl right off the floor.
Pull your bottoms up so tight,
Smile because you did it right.
Scrub your hands with sudsy soap,
Clean and happy is our hope!

rhymes.title: The Potty Kingdom
rhymes.text:
Hear the trumpet, hear the horn,
Today a royal seat is born!
Wash your hands and step right in,
Let the potty time begin.

Take off pants and sit right down,
Time to wear your shiny crown.
Push and squeeze, let it go,
Watch the happy ripples flow.

All finished? Time to wipe!
Grab the paper, nice and bright.
Flush the handle, hear it roar,
Wave goodbye and out the door.

Wash your hands with bubbles high,
Look at you, you touch the sky!
You are brave and you are grand,
Ruling all the potty land!

rhymes.title: King of the Throne
rhymes.text:
Are you feeling like you gotta,
Make a trip down to the potty?
Hurry, hurry, do not wait,
Before it is a little late.

Sit upon the big white chair,
Feel the comfort waiting there.
Breathe in deep and count to three,
Let it out and shout out 'Whee!'

Wipe your tummy, wipe your toes,
Wipe right up to your button nose.
Flush it down, bye-bye-bye,
Watch the little bubbles fly.

Wash your hands with soapy foam,
Now you wander safely home.
You're the king of potty throne,
Biggest boy we've ever known!

rhymes.title: Princess Potty Star
rhymes.text:
Little princess, twinkle star,
Potty is not very far.
Put your toys down on the floor,
Walk right through the bathroom door.

Lift the lid up, sit right down,
Put on now your sparkly crown.
iggle wiggle, give a smile,
Sit and relax for a little while.

Tissue paper, tear one sheet,
 Wipe your bottom, keep it neat.
Flush the magic silver knob,
Such a very splendid job!

Soap and water, rub-a-dub,
Scrub your fingers in the tub.
Stand up tall and dance around,
Happiest girl in all the town!

rhymes.title: The Potty Dance
rhymes.text:
Do the wiggle, do the jiggle,
Feeling like you got a wiggle?
Stop your playing, time to run,
Potty time is full of fun.

Pull your pants down to your knees,
Sit right down and shout out 'Please!'
Breathe out softly like a breeze,
Rocking gently like the trees.

Good job, darling, let's rejoice,
Listen to that happy voice!
Take the paper, wipe up square,
Throw it in with proper care.

Flush the water down the drain,
Smile and do it all again.
Wash your hands and clap your feet,
Potty mission is complete!

rhymes.title: Super Potty Hero
rhymes.text:
Super heroes never cry,
They can make the potty try.
Put your cape on, off you go,
To the little room you know.

Climb right up and take your place,
Put a smile upon your face.
Push it out and let it drop,
Listen to the gurgling pop.

Grab the paper, wipe so neat,
Make the little kingdom sweet.
Push the button, watch it spin,
See the swirling water win.

Wash your hands with bubbly soap,
Never ever give up hope.
You are mighty, brave and strong,
Singing out our potty song!

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Throne
rhymes.text:
Time to go, do not delay,
Put your toys right down away.
Feel the urge, it is so near,
Time to give a little cheer!

Marching to the bathroom now,
Let us take a royal bow.
Lift the seat up, nice and slow,
Ready, steady, here we go!

Sit right down and take your time,
Sing along with this sweet rhyme.
Push it out, oh do not rush,
Now we stand to flush the flush!

Wash your hands with bubbles bright,

Look at you, oh such a star,
You are growing up so far!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diaper

Diaper days are done and past,
Big kid pants are here at last!
Feel the tickle in your tummy?
Time to use the potty, dummy?

Hurry, hurry, do the hop,

Pull your pants down to your knees,
Sit right down and say goodbye please.

Relax your toes, let it flow,

Soap and water, scrub and scrub,
Rub them till they go sky-highbub.
Dry them on a fluffy towel,

rhymes.title: Potty Dance Party
rhymes.text:

Sweep away the diaper gloom.

Drop your pants and sit right down,
Wear your invisible golden crown.
Take a breath and count to three,
Look what made it to the pee!

Splish and splash inside the bowl,
Potty training is our goal.
Wipe yourself or ask for aid,
Look at progress you have made!

Wash the germs right down the drain,
Smile again and skip the strain.
High five, buddy, you are great,
Potty success we celebrate!

rhymes.title: Royal Potty Song
rhymes.text:
Hear the music in the air,
Time to use the big boy chair.
No more diapers, dry and neat,
Marching on our two quick feet.

Up the step and turn around,
Sitting safely safe and sound.
Rest your hands upon your knees,
Let it out with gentle ease.

Plop goes the pip, hear the sound,
Happiest kidble all around.
Grab the paper, wipe it clean,
Best routine you have ever seen.

Scrub with soap, the water flows,
Washing fingers, thumbs, and toes.
Crown of glory on your head,

rhymes.title: Super Potty Hero
rhymes.text:
Super hero, cape and all,
Responding to the potty call!
Run like lightning, fast and free,
Right to where you need to be.

Anchor down and take your seat,
Keep your rhythm on the beat.
Breathe in deep and let it out,
Hear the happy cheering shout!

Flush the handle with a roar,
Watch it circle and explore.
Soap up now from palm to wrist,
Give the germs a heavy twist.

Pat dry with a loving smile,
Stand up proud and stretch a while.
Potty master, brave and tall,
You are mighty after all!

rhymes.title: The Potty Parade
rhymes.text:
Hear the music, hear the band,
Hear the rhythm through the land.
Time to march and time to go,
Potty time is here, you know!

Leave your toys upon the floor,

Pull your pants down, nice and slow,
Ready, steady, here we go!

Sit right down upon the seat,
Feel the comfort on your feet.

Gentle pushes, if you please.

Look! A sparkle! Look! A cheer!
Potty magic happened here!
Wash your hands and give a shout,
That is what the crown's about!

rhymes.title: King of the Crown
rhymes.text:
Every morning, bright and clear,
Little royalty is near.
Time to wear the shiny crown,
Best potty trainer in the town.

Listen to the tummy rumble,
Walk along and do not stumble.
Up the step stool, big and high,
Wave your little friends goodbye.

Push it out and let it drop,

Wipe it clean and flush it down,
Wear with pride your potty crown!
Wash your hands with bubbly soap,

rhymes.title: The Wiggle Worm Dance
rhymes.text:
Wiggle, wiggle, do the dance,

Is there water? Is there a need?

Lift the seat up, nice and wide,

Wiggle left and wiggle right,

You are royal, safe and sound,

rhymes.title: Bippity Boppity Bye
rhymes.text:

Wipe your bottom till it is clean,
Bestest kid we have ever seen.

rhymes.title: The Golden Seat Song
rhymes.text:
Gold and shiny is the seat,

Drop your pants and sit right down,

Poo-poo, pee-pee, in the pot,

High-five all your little men.

Splash the water, wash the hands,

rhymes.title: The Potty Parade

rhymes.title: Crown of Gold

 Shining like a morning dream.

rhymes.title: Royal Potty Time

Marching feet go stomp, stomp, stomp,

Pull your pants down to your knees,

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diaper

rhymes.title: The Potty Parade

rhymes.title: Crown of Gold

Paper in the basket deep,

rhymes.title: King of the Seat

Hippooray, hip-hip hooray!
Pee and poo are washed away.
Wipe the tushie, flush it fast,
Big kid status reached at last!

Wash your hands until they gleam,
Wake up from the baby dream.

rhymes.title: The Golden Throne Song

rhymes.title: Royal Potty Cheers

rhymes.title: The Potty Parade
