stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, Leo! Today is a very exciting day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo sits up in his cozy bed and stretches his arms up high. Today, no more diapers. Today, Leo gets to wear special big kid undies all by himself. Mama brings out a wonderful pair of bright green underwear with a big, roaring T-Rex right on the front. Leo’s eyes go wide with a big, happy smile. 'Rawr!' says Leo, pointing to his new dinosaur friends. Mama and Papa cheer loudly. 'Horray for Leo!' First, Leo goes to the bathroom and sits on the potty. He tries his very best, because that is what big kids do. Then, it is time to put on the dinosaur underwear. Leo pulls them up, up, up his legs, wiggling his little toes. He pulls them all the way up to his tummy. Look at that! They fit just right. Leo feels so strong and so proud. He looks in the mirror and gives a big, proud dinosaur roar. 'I am a big kid now!' Leo says happily. Mama gives him a giant warm hug. Throughout the morning, Leo plays with his blocks, builds a tall tower, and eats his yummy banana for snack time. Every little while, Leo remembers his special mission. He listens to his tummy and stops to use the potty, just like a big boy. 'Good job listening to your body, Leo!' says Papa, clapping his hands. Bedtime comes around, and Leo is tired and happy. He takes off his dinosaur undies and puts on his pajamas, ready for sweet dreams. What a wonderful day of growing up!

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Underwear Adventure
stories.text: Rise and shine, Mia! The sun is peeking through the curtains, and today is a super special day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia jumps out of bed with a giggle. Today is the day she gets to say goodbye to diapers and hello to big kid undies. Papa holds up a drawer full of colorful choices. 'Which ones would you like to wear today, Mia?' Papa asks gently. Mia looks closely and points her finger. 'The rainbow ones with the sparkling stars!' she says happily. Mama helps Mia pick them out. First, it is time to visit the little potty. Mia sits down patiently and reads her favorite bunny book while she tries. When she is finished, she washes her hands with bubbly soap, splash splash splash! Now comes the fun part. Mia steps into her rainbow underwear. One leg goes in, and then the other leg goes in. She pulls them up her tummy, smoothing the soft fabric with her little hands. They are so pretty and colorful. Mia twirls around in a circle, and her rainbow undies dance with her. 'Look at me, Mama! I am wearing big kid underwear!' Mia sings with joy. Mama and Papa clap and cheer. 'You look so wonderful, Mia!' Mia spends the whole day playing games, drawing pictures of fluffy clouds with pink crayons, and helping water the house plants with her tiny green watering can. Every time she needs to go potty, Mia remembers right away and hurries to the bathroom. She is learning how her body works, step by step. When the moon comes up and stars fill the sky, Mia snuggles into bed. She is so proud of her big kid day!

stories.title: Sammy's Superhero Undies
stories.text: Good morning, little Sammy! Wake up, wake up! Today is a very important day in our house. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sammy yawns and rubs his sleepy eyes, then kicks his legs with excitement. Today, Sammy gets to wear big boy underwear, just like his big brother. Mama brings a special package to the bed. Inside are bright blue underwear with a shiny yellow superhero star right in the middle. Sammy gasps. 'Superhero undies!' he whispers, feeling very brave. First things first, Sammy walks proudly to the bathroom. He sits on the potty and tries his best. Even if nothing happens right away, trying is what makes Sammy a true superhero. Mama helps him wash his hands with warm water and sweet-smelling soap. Then, Sammy takes his superhero underwear. He puts his little foot in one hole, and his other foot in the other hole. He pulls them up, up, up, all the way to his waist. Sammy puffs out his chest and puts his hands on his hips. 'Super Sammy to the rescue!' he says in his strongest voice. Mama and Papa cheer and clap. 'You are our favorite superhero!' Sammy wears his superhero undies all day long while he builds tracks for his toy trains and zooms his race cars across the rug. Whenever his tummy gives him a little gentle nudge, Sammy remembers his mission. He pauses his game, walks to the potty, and does a fantastic job. It takes practice to grow up, and Sammy is doing great. As evening falls, Sammy feels wonderfully cozy in his bed. He closes his eyes with a smile, dreaming of his next big adventure.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies Adventure
stories.text: Good morning, Leo! Today is a very special day. Mommy and Daddy have a big surprise waiting on the soft fluffy rug. It is time for Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo jumps right out of bed with a big, happy stretch. Today, diapers are all done, and wonderful big kid undies are here to stay. Let's go take a look at the drawer, Leo. Wow, look at all the colors! There are bright red ones, friendly green ones, and look at these—roaring dinosaur undies with big friendly teeth! Leo claps his hands together and giggles with pure joy. 'I want the dinosaurs!' he says proudly. Mommy helps Leo step into his new dinosaur underwear. One foot goes in, and then the other foot goes in. Up, up, up they go! They feel so soft and cool, just like wearing cozy little clouds. Leo looks down at his tummy and smiles. 'Rawr!' he says to the little green dinosaur printed right on the front. Now, Leo knows it is super important to listen to his tummy and his body. When he feels that funny little wiggle or a tickle that says it is time, what does a big kid do? That is right! A big kid goes straight to the potty. Daddy sets up a little chart on the wall with shiny gold star stickers. Every single time Leo tries his best, he gets to put a star right on the chart. Ten minutes later, Leo feels a little flutter in his tummy. 'Uh oh! Tummy wiggle!' he says. Daddy smiles and gently holds his hand. Together, they walk right over to the bathroom. Leo sits down on the little potty seat. He breathes in deep, smelling the flowers, and blows out gently, blowing out the birthday candles. Yay! Success! Daddy cheers loudly, and Leo claps his hands in excitement. 'I did it! I used the potty!' Time for a shiny gold star sticker. Leo carefully places the star right at the top of the chart. It shines bright and beautiful, just like him. Throughout the rest of the day, Leo plays with his blocks, eats yummy apple slices, and drinks his cool water. Every time he needs to go, he remembers his big kid skills. At bedtime, Leo snuggles under his warm blankets. Mommy and Daddy give him the biggest, warmest hugs. 'We are so proud of you today, Leo. You are growing up so fast.' Leo closes his eyes with a happy heart, dreaming of his roaring dinosaur friends.

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Undies Celebration
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! Today is the most exciting day of the week. Do you know why? Because today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia sits right up in her cozy bed and rubs her sleepy eyes. She gives a big yawn and a happy stretch. 'Are my special undies ready?' she asks. Mommy nods and smiles warmly. 'They are ready and waiting just for you, Mia!' They walk together to the bright sunny bathroom. Laid out on the counter is a brand new pair of rainbow underwear, covered in bright pinks, sunny yellows, and sparkly purples. Mia gasps and claps her hands together. 'So pretty!' she whispers. Wearing big kid underwear is such a wonderful adventure. It means Mia’s body is growing big and strong, just like her big sister. Mommy helps Mia step into the rainbow undies. They pull them up gently over her hips. Mia looks in the full-length mirror and does a little twirl. The colors bounce and sparkle around her. 'I look like a rainbow princess!' she declares happily. Mommy gives her a high-five. 'You sure do, Mia!' Now, being a big kid means paying special attention to our bodies. Sometimes our tummy tells us a secret. It says, 'Mia, it's time to visit the potty!' When Mia feels that little secret bubble up, she knows just what to do. No more diapers, just big kid steps. Later that morning, while Mia is busy building a tall tower out of wooden blocks, she feels that little tummy tickle. She stops right away. 'Tummy tickle!' she says. Mommy is right there to help. They walk over to the potty together, nice and calm. Mia sits down and waits patiently. Look at that—she goes right on the potty! Mommy claps and cheers, 'Hip, hip, hooray for Mia!' Mia feels so proud and happy inside. She gets to pick out a sparkly purple star sticker for her special reward chart. The rest of the day is filled with fun games, singing favorite songs, and sipping yummy strawberry milk. Every single time Mia uses the potty, she earns another sparkly star. By afternoon, the chart is looking amazing. When the sun goes down and the stars come out in the night sky, Mia puts on her softest pajamas. She snuggles up close with Mommy for bedtime stories. Mommy kisses her forehead. 'You did such an amazing job today, Mia. We are so proud of your big kid steps.' Mia drifts off to sleep, dreaming of rainbows and bright shining stars.

stories.title: Oliver's Super-Duper Big Kid Day
stories.text: Good morning, little superhero! Today is a monumental day in our house. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Oliver throws his superhero cape over his shoulders and stands super tall. 'Am I ready?' he asks with a big brave grin. Daddy laughs and nods. 'You are the most ready big kid in the whole world, Oliver!' They march into Oliver’s bedroom where a brand new stack of superhero underwear is waiting. There are blue ones with lightning bolts, red ones with flying stars, and orange ones with zooming rocket ships. Oliver’s eyes grow as big as saucers. 'Rocket ships!' he shouts with joy. Putting on big kid underwear is a super important mission. It means Oliver is growing up to be a big boy, ready for new adventures. Oliver steps his little feet into the rocket ship undies and pulls them up all by himself. Up, up, up! He puts his hands on his hips just like a superhero ready to save the day. 'Super Oliver is ready for action!' he announces proudly. Now, every superhero needs a special power. Oliver’s big kid power is listening to his body. When his tummy gives him a little rumble or a wiggle, that is his signal to fly over to the bathroom. No waiting around! When Oliver feels the signal, he uses his super-speed walk to get to the potty. A little later, while Oliver is zooming his toy fire truck across the living room rug, his tummy gives him a gentle little rumble. 'Rumble rumble!' Oliver says. He drops the fire truck gently and stands right up. 'To the potty!' he calls out. Daddy walks right beside him with great encouragement. Oliver sits down on the potty seat and relaxes. He counts to ten slowly with Daddy. And guess what? Mission accomplished! Oliver did it all by himself. Daddy high-fives him and cheers, 'Way to go, Superhero Oliver!' Oliver gets to place a glowing star sticker right on his mission chart. He beams with pride as he looks at the sticker shining back at him. The day continues with building blocks, drawing funny pictures with chunky crayons, and drinking cups of fresh water. Each time Oliver feels the rumble, he completes his mission successfully. As the evening arrives and the moon peeks through the window, Oliver gets tucked into bed with his favorite teddy bear. Daddy whispers softly, 'You were a true superhero today, Oliver.' Oliver smiles a sleepy smile, feeling proud, cozy, and ready for more big kid adventures tomorrow.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, Leo! Today is a very special day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo jumps right out of his warm, cozy bed. He stretches his arms high up to the sky. Big stretch! Today, diapers are all done. Mommy and Daddy smile big, happy smiles. They bring out a special drawer. Inside are the most exciting things in the whole wide world. They are big kid undies! Leo looks inside and claps his hands with joy. 'Roar!' says Leo. He gets to pick out his very favorite pair. Today, he chooses the bright green underwear with the happy green dinosaur stomping right on the front. 'Go, dinosaur, go!' whispers Leo. Putting on big kid underwear is like putting on superhero capes. First, one foot goes into the hole. Hop! Then, the other foot goes into the other hole. Hop! Leo pulls them all the way up his tummy. Up, up, up! They fit just right. They feel soft and cozy, like a gentle hug. 'Look at me!' says Leo, spinning around in a happy circle. 'I am a big boy now!' Daddy gives Leo a high-five. Mommy gives Leo a gentle squeeze. Going potty is part of being a big kid, too. Leo's potty is waiting right in the bathroom. It has a smiling frog face. Whenever Leo feels a little tickle in his tummy, he knows it is time to visit his froggy friend. 'Bye-bye, diapers! Hello, big kid undies!' sings Leo. He washes his hands with bubbly soap and splashy water. Splash, splash, squeaky clean! Leo is so proud of his dinosaur undies. All morning long, he plays with his blocks, builds a tall tower, and shares his toys. He checks on his dinosaur friend on his tummy. The dinosaur is smiling too. When it is time for a snack, Leo remembers to tell Mommy when his tummy needs the potty. 'Great job listening to your body, Leo!' cheers Mommy. Leo beams with pride. He is growing up so fast. It is the best day ever!

stories.title: Maya's Rainbow Undies
stories.text: Wake up, sunshine! Today is a wonderful day. Maya opens her big brown eyes and smiles. Do you know what today is? It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Maya throws off her soft pink blanket and hops on her tiptoes. Time to say goodbye to diapers and hello to big adventures. Maya walks to her dresser with Mommy. 'Are you ready, Maya?' asks Mommy gently. Maya nods her head fast. 'Yes, I am a big girl!' Today, Maya gets to wear the most colorful big kid underwear. They have red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple stripes. A whole rainbow hiding right under her clothes! Maya gently holds the rainbow undies in her small hands. They feel as soft as a fluffy cloud. Time to put them on. One little leg goes in. Pop! The other little leg goes in. Pop! Maya pulls them all the way up to her waist. Up, up, up! She wiggle-jiggles to make sure they feel good. 'Ta-da!' says Maya, showing off her rainbow. Daddy takes a picture because she looks so wonderful. Being in big kid underwear means Maya is learning how to use the potty like a big kid. Throughout the day, Maya listens closely to her body. When she feels a little dance starting in her tummy, she knows it is time to go. 'Potty time!' Maya says proudly. She hurries to the bathroom and sits right down on her special pink potty seat. She reads her favorite bunny book while she waits. When she is all done, she wipes carefully and flushes the handle. Flush! Whoosh goes the water! Then, it is time for happy handwashing. Scrub-a-dub-dub, get the bubbles all around. Maya feels so fresh and clean. 'I did it!' she cheers, clapping her hands together. Mommy and Daddy clap too. They are so proud of their smart girl. Maya spends the rest of the afternoon painting pictures of rainbows. Every time she looks down at her colorful clothes, she feels warm and happy inside. Big Kid Underwear Day is the most magical day of all.

stories.title: Sam's Starry Undies
stories.text: Good morning, little star! Today is a glowing, shining day. Sam sits up in bed and rubs his sleepy eyes. Today is a big milestone. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam's big brother used big kid underwear, and now it is Sam's special turn. Sam feels so excited his tummy does little fluttery flips. Mommy brings a sparkly basket filled with brand new big kid undies. Sam looks inside and gasps. They are deep blue with shiny yellow stars printed all over them, just like the night sky. 'I want the starry ones!' says Sam. He holds them close to his chest. Putting on starry undies is an adventure. Sam sits down on the rug to get ready. Left foot steps in. Right foot steps in. Up they go, past his knees, past his tummy, all the way up! Sam stands up tall and stretches his arms. He looks down at his glowing star friends. 'Look, Mommy, I am wearing the sky!' he giggles. Mommy kisses the top of Sam's head. 'You look like a shining star, Sam.' Today is all about trying new things and growing bigger. Sam knows that wearing big kid underwear means he is in charge of telling Mommy and Daddy when he needs the potty. Whenever he feels a little warm bubble in his tummy, he listens right away. He walks nicely to the bathroom, sits on his little blue seat, and takes a deep breath. Patience is part of being big! When he is finished, Sam washes his hands with foamy soap. He rubs his hands together to make a mountain of bubbles. Rinse, rinse, all clean! Sam gives himself a big hug. He is doing such a wonderful job. He spends the day zooming his toy cars across the living room rug, making zooming sounds. 'Vrooom! Watch out for the star car!' he laughs. At naptime, Sam keeps his starry undies dry and cozy. He wakes up refreshed and ready for more fun. When Daddy comes home from work, Sam runs to the door. 'Daddy, look at my big kid undies!' Daddy picks Sam up for a giant bear hug. 'You are our biggest hero today, Sam!' It truly is a wonderful day.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, Leo! Today is a very exciting day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo jumps right out of his cozy bed and does a happy wiggle dance. Mommy holds up a special pair of underpants. They are bright green with a mighty green T-Rex right on the front. 'Roar!' says Leo, giving his best dinosaur growl. Today, Leo gets to wear big boy underpants instead of diapers. Leo helps pull them up all by himself, stretching the soft fabric over his knees and hips. Up, up, up they go! He looks down and smiles proudly at his fierce dinosaur friend. 'No more diapers today!' says Leo happily. Daddy sets the potty right in the middle of the bathroom and puts a basket of fun picture books next to it. 'Whenever your tummy tells you it is time, just let us know,' Daddy says with a warm hug. Leo plays with his colorful wooden blocks, building a tall tower that touches the sky. Suddenly, he stops. His tummy gives a little wiggle-woggle signal. Uh-oh! Time to pause the blocks. Leo remembers his special mission. He walks over to the potty, nice and steady, just like a big boy. 'I made it!' cheers Leo as he sits down. Mommy and Daddy clap their hands and cheer loudly, 'Yay, Leo! You used the potty!' Leo beams with joy. Washing his hands with bubbly soap feels extra fun today because he is doing such a wonderful job. After lunch, it is naptime, and Leo wears a fresh pair of blue star underpants. He wakes up completely dry and gives himself a gentle pat on the back. At dinner, Grandma calls on the phone to hear all about his big day. Leo tells her, 'I wear big kid undies now!' He feels so proud, so grown-up, and so very happy. As bedtime arrives, Leo snuggles under his soft blanket, ready for sweet dreams of dinosaurs and big boy adventures.

stories.title: Mia's Sunshine Pants
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! The morning sun is peeking through the window, painting the bedroom with golden light. Today is a magical day because it is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia stretches her arms up high like a tall sunflower. Today, diapers are staying in the drawer, and big girl underpants are coming out to play. Mia picks a pair that is bright yellow with smiling suns all over them. She sits on the rug and wiggles her feet through the leg holes, pulling them up smoothly. 'Look, Mommy! Sunshine pants!' Mia giggles, clapping her hands together. Mommy smiles and gives her a big hug. 'You look ready for a wonderful day, Mia.' To celebrate, Mia gets to wear her shiny sparkly crown while she plays. Throughout the morning, Mia builds a wonderful castle out of fluffy pillows and stuffed animals. Every now and then, she listens to her body's quiet little whispers. When her tummy gives a gentle nudge, Mia does not wait. She stands up from her castle, walks calmly to the bathroom, and tries the potty. Sometimes a little happens, sometimes nothing at all, but Mia always tries her best! Each time she visits the potty, Daddy gives her a high-five and says, 'Super proud of you, Mia!' Mia feels like a true princess. By the afternoon, she has gone the whole day without a single accident. When her friends come over for a playdate, Mia shows them her shiny crown and tells them her secret. 'I am a big girl now!' At bedtime, Mia carefully folds her sunshine pants and places them right next to her bed, ready for another fantastic day of growing up big and strong.

stories.title: Sam's Rocket Ship Ride
stories.text: Good morning, little astronaut! Today is a monumental day in the universe. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam jumps out of bed, eager to start the mission. In his hands are the coolest underpants in the whole galaxy. They are dark blue with zooming red rocket ships and shining yellow stars. Sam steps into his rocket ship underwear and pulls them all the way up to his waist. 'Blast off!' whispers Sam with a grin. Today, the diaper goes bye-bye, and big boy pants take over. Mommy places a special sticker chart on the refrigerator, decorated with shiny gold stars. Every time Sam uses the potty, he gets to put a star right on the chart. Sam zooms around the living room, flying his toy airplane through the clouds. But wait! His tummy gives him a beep-beep warning signal. Mission control is calling! Sam steers his airplane safely to the landing pad and heads straight for the bathroom. He sits down on the potty and waits patiently, counting to ten. Splash, fizz, pop! Success! Sam finishes up, washes his hands with foamy blue soap, and races to the kitchen. 'I did it!' he shouts. Mommy hands him a shiny gold star sticker, and Sam presses it firmly onto the chart, right at the top. The chart is already filling up with sparkling rewards. Throughout the afternoon, Sam plays outside in the sunshine, running through the green grass and feeling like the biggest boy in the world. When evening arrives, the stars come out in the night sky outside his window. Sam looks at his sticker chart one last time before bed and feels a warm glow in his heart. Growing up is such a fun adventure, and Sam is ready for sweet, starry dreams.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text:
Good morning, little Leo! Today is a very exciting day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! No more sleepy diapers. Today, Leo gets to wear special big kid undies all by himself. Leo opens his colorful dresser drawer. Inside, waiting just for him, are the coolest undies in the whole wide world. They are bright green with big, roaring T-Rex dinosaurs all over them! 

"Roar!" says Leo, holding them up with a huge smile. Mommy and Daddy clap their hands and cheer. "Look at those super dinosaur undies!" Daddy says. Leo steps his first little foot through the hole, and then his second little foot. He pulls them up, up, up all the way to his tummy. He gives a happy wiggle. They feel so soft, light, and grown-up!

After breakfast, it is time to play. Leo builds a giant tower out of wooden blocks. Oh, wait! Does Leo feel a little tickle in his tummy? Uh-oh! That is a potty signal! Leo remembers what big kids do. He gently says, "Mommy, I need the potty right now." 

Mommy takes Leo’s hand, and they zoom to the bathroom together like zooming rockets. Zoom! Just in time! Leo sits right down on his little potty seat. Yay! Success! Leo washes his hands with bubbly, soapy water, splashing a little bit just for fun. 

Later that afternoon, Leo puts on his shoes to go outside to the sunny park. He swings super high on the swings, touching the fluffy clouds in the sky. He plays in the sandbox and builds a muddy castle. When he gets tired, he rests on the soft grass. At bedtime, Leo takes off his dinosaur undies and puts on his cozy dinosaur pajamas. He looks in the mirror and gives himself a proud pat on the back. "I am a big boy," Leo whispers happily. Mommy and Daddy tuck him in tight, giving him sweet, warm kisses on his forehead. Sweet dreams, brave dinosaur boy!

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Undies
stories.text:
Good morning, sunshine! Wake up, sweet Mia! Today is a very special day because today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia stretches her arms way up high, touching the ceiling, and gives a big, cheerful yawn. Today, Mia gets to wear her very own big kid undies, just like her big cousin Lily.

Mia tiptoes to her warm, cozy bedroom. Sitting right on her small yellow chair is a brand new pair of undies. They are so pretty! They have sparkling red stripes, sunny yellow dots, and bright blue clouds. Mia gasps with delight. "Rainbow undies!" she squeals happily. 

Daddy helps Mia step into her lovely rainbow undies. She pulls them up all by herself, wiggling her hips left and right. They feel so wonderful and cozy. Mia twirls around in a big circle, making her skirt go swish-swash. 

Suddenly, Mia feels a funny little wiggle dance happening deep inside her tummy. She stops twirling. "Uh-oh, tummy signal!" Mia giggles. She knows exactly what to do. She marches right over to the bathroom, keeping her feet moving fast like a happy little duck. She sits safely on the potty chair and waits patiently, singing her favorite little alphabet song.

Horay! Mia does a fantastic job! She wipes carefully and flushes the big handle, listening to the happy whoosh sound. Then she washes her hands with lots of bubbly soap, blowing gentle bubbles into the air. 

When the afternoon sun starts to shine warmly through her bedroom window, Mia reads her favorite storybook about a sleepy little bear. As evening arrives, Mia changes into her soft moon-and-stars pajamas. She folds her rainbow undies neatly and places them right beside her bed. She climbs under her comfy blanket, feeling so proud and tall. "Goodnight, rainbow day," Mia whispers softly. Mommy smiles and kisses her cheek. Sleep tight, wonderful big girl!

stories.title: Sam's Puppy Undies
stories.text:
Rise and shine, little Sam! Today is a magnificent day. Open your bright brown eyes because today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam sits straight up in his comfy bed and giggles. Today is the day he says goodbye to baby diapers and hello to big boy undies!

Sam walks into the bathroom with Mommy. On the counter sits a neat little stack of surprises. Sam looks down and picks them up. They are bright blue undies with a happy, floppy-eared puppy printed right on the front. The puppy has a little red collar and looks ready to play.

"Puppy undies!" Sam says with great excitement. He steps his right foot in, then his left foot in, and pulls them all the way up. They fit like a glove! Sam pats his tummy and gives a happy wiggle. He feels so grown-up today, just like a superhero.

Time for morning fun! Sam drives his toy red fire truck across the living room rug. *Nee-naw, nee-naw!* Then, right in the middle of a big fire rescue, Sam feels a tiny warm bubble in his tummy. Time out! That is his potty alarm ringing!

Sam jumps up quickly. No time to waste! He hurries to the bathroom like a fast racing car. *Vroom!* He sits down on the big potty seat with the colorful blue stepping stool. He relaxes and waits. Yay, Sam! He did it! 

Sam washes his hands, making mountains of white foam bubbles. He rubs his hands together and rinses them clean under the warm tap water. 

When bedtime finally arrives, Sam takes off his puppy undies and puts on his favorite striped sleeping shirt. He climbs into his snuggly bed, pulling the blanket up to his chin. He smiles in the dark, thinking about what a wonderful, big-kid day he had. Mommy and Daddy whisper, "We are so proud of you, Sam." Sam closes his eyes and drifts off into sweet, happy sleep.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, Leo! Today is a very special day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo jumps right out of bed, stretching his arms high up into the sky like a big, tall tree. Mommy smiles and brings out a special drawer. Inside are the most exciting things in the whole wide world: brand new underwear with big, roaring green dinosaurs on them! Leo gasps and claps his hands together. Wow! Dinosaurs! Leo takes off his diaper and steps into his new big kid underwear, one leg and then the other. Pull them up, up, up, all the way to his tummy! They feel so soft and cool. Leo looks in the mirror and roars just like a T-Rex. Roar! I am a big kid now! Daddy cheers loudly and gives Leo a high-five. Now, it is time to listen to our bodies. Whenever Leo feels that funny little tickle in his tummy that says he needs to go, he knows just what to do. He will tell a grown-up right away. Leo plays with his colorful blocks, building a huge castle. Suddenly, he stops. Uh-oh, that little tickle is here! Leo doesn't wait. He stands right up and says, Mommy, I need the potty! Mommy beams with joy and takes Leo's hand. They walk quickly to the bathroom together. Splash, hooray! Leo does a wonderful job using the big potty just like a big boy. Mommy and Daddy clap and cheer, saying, You are doing amazing, Leo! Leo washes his hands with soapy bubbles, making lots of fluffy white clouds. It feels so wonderful to grow big. As the sun shines brightly outside, Leo feels very proud of his dinosaur undies. Bedtime comes around, and Leo puts on cozy pajamas, feeling like a true superhero. What a fantastic, successful day of growing up!

stories.title: Mia's Sunshine Pants
stories.text: Good morning, sweet Mia! Today the sun is shining extra bright, and today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia stretches her toes and giggles as Daddy tickles her feet. Today is the day we say goodbye to diapers and hello to big kid undies! Mia's eyes grow wide with excitement. She hops down from the bed and dances over to her cozy chair. Sitting right there is a neat little pile of bright yellow underwear decorated with smiling yellow suns. They look so happy and cheerful, just like Mia! Mia picks them up and steps in carefully. Left foot, right foot, and pull them right up to her belly button. They are so soft and comfy! Mia twirls around in a circle, and her yellow suns seem to dance right along with her. Look, Daddy! I have sunshine on my tummy! Daddy smiles warmly and gives her a big hug. You look like a big girl, Mia. Remember, our bodies tell us secret messages. When your tummy or your legs give you a little nudge that means it is time to go potty, you can stop and tell us right away. Mia nods her head firmly. She plays with her fuzzy teddy bear, having a wonderful tea party with imaginary juice. After a little while, Mia pauses. Her tummy gives her a little wiggle signal! Mia puts teddy bear down gently on the soft rug. I need the potty, Daddy! she announces proudly. Daddy rushes over with a proud smile. Off they go to the bathroom together, walking quickly and safely. Success! Mia uses the potty all by herself, just like a big kid. They wash their hands together with sweet-smelling strawberry soap. Mia feels so proud and happy. Wearing big kid underwear is wonderful!

stories.title: Sam's Starry Rocket Undies
stories.text: Rise and shine, little astronaut Sam! Today is a monumental day in our house. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam sits right up and rubs his sleepy eyes. Mommy walks into his bedroom carrying a magical surprise. Today, Sam gets to wear special big kid underwear featuring shiny yellow stars and fast zooming rockets! Sam gasps and reaches out his hands. Wow, rockets! Zoom-zoom! Sam takes off his morning diaper and gets ready for liftoff. He steps his little feet into the star underwear and pulls them all the way up, nice and snug. They feel so light and wonderful! Sam stands up tall and stretches his arms straight up toward the ceiling. Five, four, three, two, one, blast off! Sam giggles as he marches around his bedroom like a brave space explorer. Mommy and Daddy clap their hands and cheer for their wonderful boy. Now, Captain Sam, remember to check in with your rocket ship body. If you feel a little pressure or a funny rumble, that means it is mission-control time to visit the potty! Sam nods seriously. I'm ready, mission control! He sits down on the soft playroom rug to build a towering tower of wooden blocks. A few minutes go by, and Sam suddenly stops placing blocks. He feels that special rumble! Sam doesn't waste a single second. He jumps up and calls out, Mommy, rocket ship needs the potty right now! Mommy smiles proudly and takes his hand. They zoom down the hallway together to the bathroom. Perfect landing! Sam uses the potty like a true champion. They wash their hands with bubbly soap, splashing water gently. Sam looks in the mirror and flashes a giant, happy grin. Being a big kid is the best adventure ever!

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, little Leo! Today is a very special day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Today, Leo gets to say goodbye to diapers and hello to cool, soft big kid underwear. Mama brings out a wonderful surprise from the drawer. They are bright green with friendly orange dinosaurs stomping right across the front. Roar! Leo claps his hands with joy. 'Dinosaur undies!' he cheers happily. Mama gives him a big, warm cuddle and says, 'You are growing up so fast, my sweet boy. These undies will keep you comfy all day long while you play.' Leo steps his little feet into the leg holes. Up, up, up they go, all the way to his tummy. He looks down and giggles at the happy dinosaurs smiling back at him. 'All done!' says Leo proudly, striking a strong dinosaur pose. Now it is time to build a giant block tower. While Leo stacks red blocks and blue blocks, he remembers his new undies. Suddenly, he feels a tiny little tickle in his tummy. Uh-oh! That means it is time to use the potty. Leo does not wait. He stands up super fast and marches to the bathroom like a brave explorer. 'Potty time!' he calls out. Papa is right there to cheer him on. One, two, three, up he climbs. Success! Leo did a fantastic job listening to his body. When he washes his hands with bubbly soap, he looks in the mirror and beams. Wearing big kid underwear makes him feel like a superhero. After lunch, it is time for a quiet rest. Leo tucks in with his favorite blanket, feeling so proud and cozy. When he wakes up, everything is dry and wonderful. 'What a superstar day!' says Mama, giving him a high-five. Leo smiles a huge, happy smile. He loves being a big kid.

stories.title: Mia's Sparkly Star Pants
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! Birds are chirping outside the window, and today is a wonderful milestone. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia stretches her arms up high toward the ceiling and yawns. Today, no more diapers. Today is all about special big kid underwear covered in sparkly silver stars. Papa holds them up, and they catch the morning sunlight, twinkling brightly. 'Do you want to wear the star pants today, Mia?' asks Papa with a loving smile. Mia nods eagerly. ' Yes! Sparkle stars!' she whispers excitedly. She sits down on the cozy rug and puts her feet through. Up they pull, soft and snug against her skin. Mia stands up and does a little twirl around the bedroom. The stars dance as she spins. 'I am a shiny star!' she giggles, clapping her hands together. Papa and Mama cheer, 'Yay for Mia!' Throughout the morning, Mia is busy painting a masterpiece with purple and yellow watercolors. Swish, swish, go the brushes on the big paper. While she paints, Mia listens closely to her tummy. Her tummy gives a little rumble. It is a friendly reminder! Mia puts her paintbrush down gently on the table. 'Time to go potty!' she announces proudly. She walks over to the little yellow potty chair all by herself. Look at her go! When she finishes, she flushes the handle and washes her hands with bubbly lavender soap. 'You are doing such a brilliant job, my big girl,' whispers Mama, planting a gentle kiss on Mia's forehead. Mia feels so warm and happy inside. Afternoon playtime is extra fun because her big kid underwear is so comfortable. At bedtime, Mia snuggles into bed with her soft teddy bear. She looks down at her folded star undies on the chair and smiles. What a magical, successful day of growing up!

stories.title: Oliver's Rainbow Adventure
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! Today is a big, exciting adventure for Oliver. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Oliver sits on the edge of his bed, rubbing the sleep from his eyes. Mama and Papa have a very special drawer open. Inside are soft, stretchy big kid underwear in every color of the rainbow. There is red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple! Oliver points right away. 'I want the rainbow stripes!' he says happily. Papa helps him pull them on. They fit just right, snug and soft against his skin. Oliver looks down and counts the colors out loud. 'One, two, three, four, five, six!' he beams. Mama claps her hands. 'You look so handsome and ready for the day, Oliver!' Today, Oliver and his parents are going to build a mega-train out of cardboard boxes in the living room. Choo-choo! Oliver pushes his train across the soft carpet, making happy engine noises. As he drives the train under the blanket tunnel, his tummy gives a little wiggle. That is his body's special signal! Oliver immediately stops his train engine. 'Brakes on! Potty time!' he says with determination. He scurries right over to the little bathroom, all by himself. Papa follows to give him encouraging cheers. Oliver sits down on the potty chair and waits patiently, breathing in and out like a gentle flower. Ta-da! Everything goes just right. Oliver washes his hands with foamy soap, splashing a little bit of water and laughing. When he walks back to the living room, he feels lighter than a balloon. Wearing rainbow underwear is the best feeling in the whole wide world. As the sun begins to set and the stars come out, Oliver snuggles under his cozy quilt. He closes his eyes with a happy sigh, proud of his big kid day.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, little Leo! Today is a very special day. Mommy holds up a pair of bright green underwear with big, roaring T-Rex dinosaurs all over them. "Are you ready for Big Kid Underwear Day, Leo?" she asks with a warm, happy smile. Leo’s eyes go wide. "Dino undies!" he cheers, clapping his hands together. He has been wearing diapers for a long time, but today he is growing up so big. Mommy helps him take off his fuzzy pajamas. Then, Leo steps one foot into the leg hole. Whoosh! Up goes the left foot. Now, step two! Up goes the right foot. He pulls the stretchy band all the way up his tummy. Look at those happy dinosaurs smiling right back at him! Leo does a little happy stomp. "Roar!" he says, feeling strong and proud. Suddenly, Leo feels a little tickle in his tummy. Uh-oh! It is time to go. He remembers what Mommy and Daddy taught him. No waiting! Leo scurries over to the little green potty in the bathroom and sits right down. Splish, splash! He goes pee-pee in the potty just like a big kid. "Yay, Leo!" cheers Daddy, coming in with a high-five. Leo beams with pride. He washes his hands with soapy bubbles that smell like strawberries. Wearing big kid underwear makes him feel like a superhero ready to save the day. When it is time to play with his blocks, Leo builds a giant tower. He is so busy playing that he almost forgets, but his tummy tells him just in time. Off to the potty he goes again! Success! Changing into big kid underwear was the best choice ever. At naptime, he wears a special dry-night pair, but for the whole day, he wears his super dinosaur undies. Mommy gives him a big, squeezy hug. "I am so proud of you, my big boy," she whispers. Leo smiles and touches his dinosaur friends. Today is the best day ever because Leo is a big kid now, and he can do amazing things all by himself.

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Undies
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! Birds are singing outside the window, and the morning sun is warm and bright. Today is a magical day because today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Daddy walks into Mia's bedroom carrying a brand-new drawer box. "Time to pick your very first big girl underwear, Mia," he sings softly. Mia looks inside and gasps. There are red ones, yellow ones, blue ones, and purple ones. But her absolute favorite is the rainbow pair with shiny silver stars. "The rainbow ones, Daddy! Please!" she requests, reaching out her tiny hands. Daddy helps her take off her cozy night-night diaper. Mia practices balancing like a flamingo on one foot, then the other, as she pulls up her soft cotton rainbow undies. They feel so light, just like wearing a cloud! "Look, Daddy, I have a rainbow on my tummy!" she giggles, spinning around in a happy circle. Her pink skirt flares out. Mia eats her yummy oatmeal breakfast, chewing slowly and listening to the morning sounds. Halfway through her morning puzzle, Mia feels a funny little wiggle in her tummy. She stops playing right away. "Uh-oh, Daddy, potty time!" she says proudly. She hurries to the bathroom as fast as her little legs can carry her, sits down on the pink potty seat, and waits patiently. Clapping echoes in the hallway as Daddy and her teddy bear cheer her on. Success! Mia did it all by herself. Washing her hands is so much fun with the yellow duck soap. Whenever she feels a wiggle all day long, Mia remembers her rainbow undies and makes it to the potty just in time. There are no accidents today, just lots of happy successes and proud smiles. When evening comes and the stars begin to twinkle in the sleepy sky, Mia puts on her pajamas over a fresh night-time pair. She curls up in her comfy bed with her favorite blanket. Mommy tucks her in and kisses her forehead. "You did such a wonderful job today, my big girl," Mommy whispers. Mia closes her eyes with a happy heart, dreaming of rainbows and growing bigger every single day.

stories.title: Sam's Speedy Spaceship Undies
stories.text: Wake up, Captain Sam! Today is a mission of the greatest importance. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam sits up in his bed, rubbing his sleepy eyes. Grandma walks in holding a pair of dark blue underwear covered in glowing yellow stars, zooming rockets, and friendly green aliens. "Are you ready for blast-off into big-boy status, Sam?" Grandma asks cheerfully. Sam gasps with delight. "Spaceship undies! Yes, Grandma!" he shouts, bouncing on the mattress. He climbs out of bed and stretches his arms up high like a rocket ready for launch. Grandma helps him slip his feet through the stretchy leg holes. One, two, zoom! Up the underwear go, resting comfortably on his hips. Sam looks down and watches the little rocket ship right over his belly button. "Three, two, one... blast-off!" he whispers, zooming around the bedroom like a shooting star. Wearing big boy underwear makes him feel fast and brave. After a breakfast of yummy pancakes with syrup, Sam sets up his train tracks across the living room rug. Cho-cho! The blue train goes down the track. Suddenly, Sam feels a familiar rumble in his tummy. Mission control alert! It is time to visit the space station—otherwise known as the bathroom. Sam parks his train carefully and hurries down the hallway. He sits on his special blue potty chair and waits for the countdown to finish. Yay! Success on the potty! Sam does a happy victory dance, shaking his spaceship undies with joy. Grandma comes in with a basket of fresh laundry and gives him a sticker of a shining gold star. Sam sticks it proudly onto his shirt. Throughout the afternoon, Sam plays outside in the yard, building castles in the sandbox. Every time his tummy gives him a little nudge, Sam listens closely, drops his shovel, and makes it to the potty safely. Not a single drop is missed! As the sun begins to set, painting the sky in pink and orange, Sam feels wonderfully tired. He puts on his pajamas over a clean pair of star undies. Grandpa tucks him in and says, "You were a true champion today, Sam." Sam smiles, drifting off to sleep while dreaming of outer space adventures and being a very big boy.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, little Leo! Today is a very exciting day. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo stretches his arms up high, reaching for the sky. 'Yippee!' he giggles. Mommy brings out a special, secret drawer. Inside are the coolest undies in the whole wide world. They are bright green with big, roaring dinosaurs right on the front! Leo touches the soft cotton. 'Roar!' says Leo, giving his green dinosaur undies a happy little tickle. Mommy smiles warmly and says, 'You are growing up so big, Leo. Are you ready to try these today?' Leo nods his head up and down. 'Yes! Big kid undies!' With a little bit of wiggle and a whole lot of giggles, Leo steps one foot into the hole, and then the other. Pull, pull, pull! Up they go to his belly button. Leo looks down at his toes and claps his hands together. He feels just like a fast, strong dinosaur ready for a big adventure. Mommy cheers, 'Look at you! A super big kid!' Leo feels so proud. As they play together in the living room, Leo remembers something very important. He stops building his tall block tower and whispers, 'Mommy, I need to use the potty.' Wow! Off goes Leo, super fast. He sits right down on his little potty chair. Hooray! Success! Mommy gives him the biggest, warmest hug in the whole world. 'You did it, Leo! You listened to your body!' Leo beams with joy. Wearing dinosaur undies is the absolute best. He washes his hands with bubbly soap and splashes a little bit of water. 'All done!' says Leo. He spends the rest of the day playing, running, and feeling like a true champion. When the sun starts to go down and the stars peek out, Leo puts on his cozy pajamas. He folds his dinosaur undies neatly on the chair, ready for another fun day tomorrow. Goodnight, brave dinosaur boy!

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Morning
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! Birds are singing outside the bedroom window, and the sun is making the room all bright and warm. Today is a super special day. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia rubs her sleepy eyes and gives a big, long yawn. Daddy walks in holding a basket filled with colorful surprises. 'Are you ready to say goodbye to diapers and hello to big kid undies, Mia?' asks Daddy with a joyful grin. Mia claps her hands excitedly. 'Yes, Daddy! Rainbows!' She points right at the top pair in the basket. They have bright red, orange, yellow, green, and blue stripes, just like a magic rainbow in the sky. Daddy helps Mia step into her new rainbow undies. Up, up, up they pull, right over her knees, snug and soft against her tummy. Mia looks in the mirror and does a little twirl. Her skirt spins around, and she looks like a shining princess. 'I love my rainbow undies!' she exclaims. Daddy kisses the top of her head. 'You are such a big girl now, Mia.' A little while later, while Mia is painting a picture of a yellow duck, she feels a little tickle in her tummy. It is a gentle reminder! Mia puts her paintbrush down carefully on the tray. 'Daddy, potty time!' she sings out proudly. Together, they walk to the bathroom. Mia sits down and waits patiently, smiling the whole time. When she is all finished, Daddy helps her wipe and flush. Flush go the bubbles! They wash their hands with sweet-smelling strawberry soap. 'High five!' says Daddy. Mia smacks her tiny hand against his big hand. *Slap!* Mia feels so proud and happy inside. Wearing rainbow undies makes her feel like she can do anything. The rest of the day is filled with happy smiles, blocks, and songs. Bedtime comes with sweet lullabies, and Mia dreams of flying over rainbows.

stories.title: Sam's Puppy Pants
stories.text: Good morning, little Sam! The sun is shining a golden light across the bedroom rug. Today is a wonderful day because today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam sits up in bed and stretches like a sleepy-eyed kitty cat. Mommy walks in with a pair of brand-new, super-soft cotton undies. They are blue with a friendly little puppy dog printed right on the side. The puppy has floppy ears and a happy tail. 'Look, Sam! Puppy pants!' says Mommy cheerfully. Sam’s eyes grow wide with wonder. 'Puppy!' he shouts happily. He reaches out his hands and holds the puppy undies close to his chest. 'Puppy helps me be a big boy,' Sam says wisely. Mommy helps him step his little feet through the leg holes. One, two! Up they pull, snug and comfy. Sam looks down and pats the puppy on his tummy. 'Good boy, puppy,' Sam whispers. Mommy smiles with so much love in her eyes. 'You are growing up so fast, Sam. I am so proud of you.' Sam plays with his toy trains, chugging them along the track. *Choo-choo!* Suddenly, Sam remembers how the puppy wants him to stay dry and clean. He stops the train engine. 'Uh oh, Mommy. Potty time!' Sam says, popping right up. He walks quickly to the bathroom, just like a big boy should. He sits on his special potty seat and waits patiently, singing a little song to himself. Soon, he is all finished! Mommy helps him wash his hands with bubbly blue soap, making lots of slippery foam. Sam claps his soapy hands together. *Pop, pop, pop!* 'All clean!' says Sam. He feels so light, happy, and free in his puppy undies. When nighttime comes, Sam snuggles deep under his blankets, holding his favorite stuffed bear. He falls asleep with a big, peaceful smile on his face, ready for more big-boy adventures tomorrow.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies Adventure
stories.text: Good morning, little Leo! Today is a very special day. Mama holds up a pair of bright green underwear with big roaring dinosaurs on them. "Look who is waking up, Leo! It is Big Kid Underwear Day!" Leo gasps and claps his hands together. His eyes go wide with excitement. "Dinosaur undies! Roar!" he shouts happily. Mama helps Leo take off his sleepy-time diaper and gently guides his little toes into the soft, stretchy leg holes. Up, up, up they go, all the way to his tummy. Leo looks down and giggles. The friendly green dinosaur smiles right back at his belly button. "Time to practice listening to our bodies, sweet boy," Mama says, giving him a warm, encouraging hug. "Whenever you feel a little warm bubble in your tummy that tells you it is time to go, just tell me. We are a team!" Leo nods very seriously. After breakfast, Leo builds a tall tower with his red and blue blocks. Suddenly, he stops. He feels that funny little warm bubble! "Mama!" Leo calls out, his eyes shining bright. "My tummy bubble is talking! It is time!" Mama praises him loudly, "You listened so well, Leo! Let's go to the potty right now." Together, they walk proudly to the little white potty chair. Leo sits down and tries his very best. Even though nothing happens this very second, Mama cheers him on. "Just trying is super-duper, Leo! You are learning how to be such a big kid." Leo feels so proud wearing his dinosaur friends. He plays happily for the rest of the morning, keeping his big kid undies dry and clean. At naptime, he hugs Mama tight and whispers, "I love my big kid undies." Mama kisses his forehead. "You did a wonderful job today, my big boy. Tomorrow, we will do it all over again!"

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Undies Sparkle
stories.text: The sun is shining brightly outside, and Mia is waking up with a big stretch and a giant yawn. "Good morning, my sweet sunshine," Papa says, walking into her cozy bedroom holding a very special folded pair of undies. They are covered in bright pinks, sunny yellows, and sparkly purples. "Are those for me?" Mia gasps, her eyes twinkling. "Today is Big Kid Underwear Day, Mia! You are growing up so fast," Papa whispers gently. Mia giggles with delight. She loves rainbows more than anything in the whole wide world. Papa helps her step into the soft cotton fabric. Up they go past her knees, past her hips, resting comfortably right below her belly button. Mia looks in the mirror and does a little wiggle dance. "I am wearing a rainbow!" she cheers. Papa claps his hands. "You look just like a magnificent, glowing rainbow, Mia! And guess what? Wearing big kid underwear means we get to practice using the potty just like the big kids at preschool." Mia nods very seriously, her curls bouncing. "I am a big girl now, Papa." Throughout the morning, Mia plays with her kitchen set, making make-believe soup for her teddy bear. Every now and then, Papa gently checks in. "How are your rainbow undies feeling, Mia? Are they dry and happy?" Mia checks and smiles broadly. "Dry and happy, Papa!" Then, right before lunch, Mia feels a little tickle down below. She drops her toy spoon and stands up quickly. "Papa! My tickle says potty time!" Papa beams with pride. "You noticed the signal! That is amazing!" They hurry over to the bathroom together. Mia sits on her special pink potty seat and tries. "Good job listening to your body, Mia. You are doing wonderfully," Papa encourages her. Mia washes her hands with bubbly soap and feels like a true superhero. When bedtime comes, Mia folds her rainbow undies neatly on the chair, ready for another fantastic day of growing up.

stories.title: Sam's Starry Big Kid Day
stories.text: Wake up, little star! It is time to shine bright today. Grandma stands by Sam’s bed with a brand-new pair of soft blue underwear dotted with shiny yellow stars. "Guess what today is, Sam?" Grandma asks with a loving smile. "It is Big Kid Underwear Day!" Sam sits right up in bed and rubs his sleepy eyes. He spots the starry undies and beams from ear to ear. "Stars! Like the night sky!" Sam exclaims. Grandma helps Sam slip his legs through the leg openings. They pull them up smoothly, making sure the starry band rests nicely on his waist. Sam pats his tummy and feels how soft they are. "No more diapers today, Grandma. I am a big boy now," Sam says proudly. Grandma kisses his cheek. "That is right, Sam! And because you are wearing your big kid undies, we are going to pay close attention to our bodies today. If you feel like you need to tinkle, we will walk right over to the potty together. Grandma will be right beside you every single step of the way." Sam feels brave and happy. He spends the morning painting a beautiful picture of a blue whale with sparkly blue paint. While he waits for his paint to dry, Sam suddenly stops splashing. He remembers Grandma's words and listens to his tummy. "Grandma! My tummy feels full!" Sam announces proudly. Grandma drops what she is doing and gives him an enthusiastic thumbs-up. "Let's go, superstar!" They rush to the bathroom together. Sam sits on the potty and tries his hardest. Even though it is new and a little tricky, Grandma is so encouraging. "Every time you try, you get a little bit better, Sam. I am so proud of your kind heart and your big boy choices." Sam washes his hands with bubbly blue soap and feels like the happiest boy in the whole world. When evening arrives, Sam drifts off to sleep, dreaming of his shiny stars and his very first successful big kid day.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, Leo! Today is a very exciting day. Do you know why? Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo jumps right out of bed with a happy wiggle. He runs to his special basket filled with brand-new, soft cotton underpants. There are green T-rexes, flying pterodactyls, and mighty triceratops right on the fabric. Leo claps his hands together and squeals with joy. 'I want the dinosaur ones!' he says proudly. Mommy and Daddy smile big, warm smiles and cheer for their big boy. Putting on big kid underwear is a big milestone, and Leo is ready. With a little wiggle and a pull, the dinosaur undies are up. They feel snug, soft, and so comfortable. Leo looks down at his toes and giggles as a green T-rex smiles right back at him from his tummy. 'Roar!' says Leo, feeling strong and brave like a dinosaur. Now, it is time to say goodbye to diapers and hello to potty adventures. Mommy helps Leo place his little potty chair right in the bright yellow bathroom. 'Remember, Leo,' Mommy says gently, 'if your tummy feels funny or you need to go, just let us know. We are right here with you.' Leo nods his head. He feels so grown up wearing his special underwear. Throughout the morning, Leo plays with his colorful blocks and builds a giant tower that reaches all the way to the couch. Suddenly, he stops building. He remembers his body's important signal. 'Mommy! I need to go potty!' Leo calls out. He does not wait. He hurries as fast as his little legs can carry him straight to the bathroom. Success! Leo goes right on the potty chair just like a big kid. Mommy and Daddy clap their hands and cheer loudly. 'Hip, hip, hooray for Leo!' they sing. Leo beams with pride. He washes his hands with bubbly blue soap and dries them on a fluffy towel. His dinosaur undies stay completely dry all morning long. Leo learns that listening to his body feels amazing. At naptime, he slips under his cozy blanket, still wearing his favorite dinosaur friends. It is a wonderful, successful Big Kid Underwear Day, and Leo drifts off to sleep with a happy, proud little smile on his face.

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Underwear
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! The morning sun is peeking through the bedroom curtains, painting bright yellow stripes across the floor. Today is a extra-special day because today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia stretches her arms up high toward the ceiling and yawns a big, sleepy yawn. Daddy walks into her room holding a colorful cardboard box. 'Are you ready for a fun surprise, Mia?' he asks with a twinkle in his eye. Mia nods eagerly and bounces on her heels. Inside the box are pairs of underwear covered in bright red strawberries, sunny yellow bananas, and sparkling purple stars. 'Choose your favorite pair!' Daddy encourages. Mia reaches inside her special box and carefully selects the underwear with the sparkling purple stars. They are as soft as a fluffy cloud. Mia steps into them one leg at a time, pulling them up all by herself. 'Look, Daddy! I am a big girl now!' she sings, twirling around in a circle so her rainbow stars dance in the air. Daddy gives her a huge, loving hug. 'You look so wonderful, Mia. We are so proud of you.' The day is filled with fun games, drawing with purple and green crayons, and singing silly songs. Whenever Mia plays with her dollhouse, she pauses for a little check-in with her tummy. 'Are you dry, star undies?' she whispers down to her toes. And the star undies are always dry! Later in the afternoon, while watering the garden flowers with a tiny green watering can, Mia feels a little tickle in her tummy. She remembers her training. 'Daddy, potty time!' she announces happily. They walk together into the house, and Mia uses the potty all by herself. When she is finished, she does a happy victory dance around the rug. Mommy gives her a sparkly star sticker to put on her reward chart on the refrigerator door. Mia adds it right next to the others, admiring how long her sticker line is getting. Wearing big kid underwear makes Mia feel like a shining star. As the sun begins to set and the stars come out in the real night sky, Mia changes into her soft pajamas, knowing she had the best day ever.

stories.title: Sam's Superhero Undies
stories.text: Good morning, superhero Sam! Today is a very important mission. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam jumps out of bed and flexes his arm muscles like a mighty superhero saving the city. On the edge of his bed sits a pair of bright blue underwear with a shiny red cape symbol right on the front. 'Time to suit up!' whispers Sam with a grin. He slips his legs through the leg holes and pulls the superhero undies all the way up. They fit just right, keeping him ready for action. Mommy comes into the room holding a cup of water and cheers softly. 'Look at my big boy! Ready to save the day?' Sam nods bravely. 'Ready, Mommy!' He listens to his tummy. 'Uh-oh, time for a pit stop!' Sam says with a giggle. He speeds over to the bathroom like a race car, making zooming sounds the whole way. He sits down on the big potty with the special child seat. Success! Sam did it all by himself, just like a true superhero. Mommy and Daddy rush over to give him high-fives and proud cheers. 'You are doing such an amazing job, Sam!' they tell him. Sam puffs out his chest with pride. His superhero undies stay wonderfully dry all day long, through lunch, playtime, and storytime. By the time evening arrives, Sam is yawning and rubbing his sleepy eyes. He snuggles into bed with his favorite teddy bear, still glowing with happiness. Big Kid Underwear Day was a total success, and Sam knows he is growing up to be the best big boy ever.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, little Leo! Today is a very exciting day. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo stretches his arms up high, yawns a big dinosaur yawn, and giggles. Scrub-a-dub-dub, make the bubbles pop! When Leo walks back to the living room, he feels like a true dinosaur champion. He kept his T-Rex undies dry and clean all morning long. Mommy gives him a big warm hug and a sticker shaped like a shining gold star. Leo sticks the star proudly right onto his shirt. What a wonderful, happy day for growing up big and strong!

stories.title: Mia's Magical Rainbow Undies
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! Today the sun is extra bright, and the birds are singing a happy morning song. Do you know why today is so special? Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Throughout the morning, Mia plays with her fuzzy stuffed bunny, Hoppy. They have a lovely tea party with make-believe strawberry tea and crunchy crackers. While pouring a cup of tea for Hoppy, Mia feels a little warm wiggle down below. Her tummy gives a tiny flutter. Mia remembers her special routine! She puts down her little pink teapot and says, "Excuse me, Hoppy, I need to go to the potty right now!" She walks quickly and steadily to the bathroom, just like the big girls do. She sits down on the potty seat and waits patiently. Look at that! Everything goes right where it is supposed to go. Mia smiles from ear to ear. She washes her hands with purple lavender soap until her hands smell like flowers. When she returns to her toys, she feels like a magical rainbow princess. Mommy and Daddy cheer for her and give her a giant group hug. Mia is learning and growing every single day, and she is so very proud of herself.

stories.title: Sam's Superhero Undies
stories.text: Good morning, superhero Sam! Today is a magnificent day for a brand-new adventure. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam jumps right out of bed, cape flying behind him, ready to save the day. Mommy walks in holding a pair of brand-new, bright blue underwear with a flying star emblem right on the front. "Are these my superhero undies, Mommy?" Sam asks, his face lighting up with joy. "Yes, Sam! When you wear these, you have super big-kid powers to listen to your body and find the potty all by yourself," Mommy explains gently. Sam puffs out his chest, feels very brave, and steps into his blue superhero undies. He pulls them up high and fast, just like a rocket ship blasting off into outer space. Zoom! Sam spends the morning building a giant spaceship out of couch cushions and pillows. He is flying through the stars, dodging space rocks and meeting friendly aliens. In the middle of zooming around, Sam feels a little signal in his tummy. Zap! That signal is his superhero radar telling him it is time to visit the bathroom station. Sam stops his spaceship right in its tracks. No time to waste! He marches steadily down the hallway to the bathroom like a brave captain on a mission. He sits down safely on the potty and waits for his rocket mission to finish. Success! Sam did it all by himself, just like a true superhero. He washes his hands with bubbly blue soap, scrubbing between his fingers to chase all the germs away. When he steps back out, Daddy is waiting with a shiny silver medal sticker. Daddy places the sticker right on Sam's shirt. "For bravery and doing such a wonderful job today!" Daddy says proudly. Sam beams with happiness. Wearing big kid underwear is the most fun adventure in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies Adventure
stories.text:
Good morning, little Leo! Today is a very special day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo jumps right out of bed with a big, happy wiggle. Today, Mommy and Daddy have a brand new surprise waiting for him in the bathroom. Leo marches in with his big boy steps. Look right there on the counter! A whole stack of soft, colorful underwear. Leo gets to pick his very own pair for the very first time. 

"Roar!" Leo shouts with joy. He has picked the green underwear with the happy green T-Rex stomping across the front. Leo holds them up high. These are not baby diapers anymore. These are big kid pants! With a little bit of help from Daddy, Leo steps one foot in, and then the other foot in. He pulls them all the way up to his tummy. 

"Hooray!" cheers Daddy, clapping his hands together. Leo looks down and pats his tummy proudly. The dinosaur undies feel so soft, light, and cool against his skin. They do not feel bulky like diapers at all. Leo zooms around the living room, pretending to be a fast dinosaur. Stomp, stomp, stomp! 

Then, Mommy gently reminds him, "Leo, remember, our dinosaur friends like to stay dry. If you feel a little tickle in your tummy that means you have to go potty, just tell Mommy or Daddy right away!" 

Leo nods his head very seriously. "I am a big boy. I will tell you!" 

A little while later, right in the middle of building a giant tower out of colorful wooden blocks, Leo feels that familiar little tickle in his tummy. Uh-oh! Time to pause the blocks. Leo stands up quickly and takes Mommy's hand. "Mommy! Tickle in my tummy! Time to go potty!" 

Mommy smiles proudly and walks him to the bathroom. Leo sits right down on the potty and does a great job. When he washes his hands at the sink, he feels like the proudest little boy in the whole wide world. No accidents, just success! Leo dances a happy victory dance. Big Kid Underwear Day is the most fun and exciting day ever.

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Undies Mission
stories.text:
Good morning, sweet Mia! Stretch those little arms up high to the sky and let out a big yawn. Today is a magical day. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia’s eyes pop wide open with excitement. She hops down from her cozy bed and skips all the way to her dresser. Today, diapers stay in the drawer because Mia is growing up so fast. 

Mommy has laid out a sparkly basket filled with brand new training pants. Mia looks inside and gasps. There are red ones, yellow ones, blue ones, and purple ones. They have pretty little rainbows and fluffy white clouds printed all over them. 

"Which ones will you choose today, Mia?" asks Mommy softly. 

Mia reaches in with her tiny fingers and pulls out the brightest pink pair with a shiny rainbow right on the pocket. "This one, Mommy! My rainbow undies!" she says happily. 

Sitting on the soft rug, Mia wiggles her toes and pulls her new rainbow underwear up. They are so cozy and pretty. Mia twirls around in a circle, and her skirt spins right along with her. She feels like a magical rainbow princess. 

Mommy gives her a huge hug and a kiss on her cheek. "You look so wonderful, Mia. You are our big girl." 

Mia eats her yummy oatmeal and drinks her cup of water. While she paints a picture of a yellow sun, she remembers what Mommy taught her. Our rainbow friends want to stay dry and happy all day long! If Mia feels a little warm pressure or a tiny squeeze inside her tummy, that is her special signal to pause and use the big potty. 

Sure enough, after she finishes painting, Mia feels that little squeeze. She drops her paintbrush safely in the cup and stands right up. "Mommy, my tummy says potty time!" 

Mommy beams with pride. "Let’s go, Mia!" Together, they walk to the bathroom, and Mia uses the potty all by herself. When she flushes the handle, she waves bye-bye. Later, when Daddy comes home from work, Mia runs to the door and shows him her rainbow undies with a bright, beaming smile. What a wonderful, successful day!

stories.title: Sammy's Superhero Undies
stories.text:
Rise and shine, superhero Sammy! Today is a legendary day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sammy kicks off his cozy dinosaur blanket and stands right up on his mattress, ready to save the day. Mommy walks into his bedroom carrying a special box wrapped in blue tissue paper. 

"Are you ready for your big mission today, Sammy?" Mommy asks with a warm smile. 

Sammy puts his hands on his hips just like his favorite cartoon superhero. "Yes, Mommy! I am ready!" 

Inside the box are the coolest underwear in the whole universe. They are bright blue with a golden star right on the front, just like a real superhero cape. Sammy’s eyes go wide with wonder. He peels off his old baby diaper and tosses it into the bin. Bye-bye, diaper! 

Sammy steps one leg into the superhero undies, then the other leg, and pulls them all the way up. He puffs out his chest. He feels strong, fast, and completely ready for action. 

"Super Sammy to the rescue!" he whispers with a grin. 

Mommy explains the golden rule of being a superhero in big kid underwear. "Superheroes always listen to their bodies, Sammy. If you feel a little bubble or a warm wiggle down below, that means your body is telling you it is time to zoom over to the potty." 

Sammy nods very bravely. "I will fly to the potty super fast, Mommy!" 

All morning long, Sammy builds tall towers with his plastic bricks and drives his toy fire truck across the rug. He has so much fun playing. Then, right in the middle of rescuing a teddy bear, Sammy feels that little warm wiggle in his tummy. 

"Mission alert!" Sammy says out loud. He jumps up from the floor and zooms down the hallway like a jet airplane. Neee-ow! He reaches the bathroom just in time, laughing and smiling. He climbs onto the potty and does his business like a true champion. 

When he washes his hands with bubbly soap, he looks in the mirror and gives himself a high-five. Big Kid Underwear Day is an absolute triumph. Sammy is growing up to be such a big, smart boy!

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, Leo! Today is a very exciting day. Do you know why? Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo jumps right out of bed with a happy wiggle. Mommy and Daddy smile big, big smiles. 'Are you ready to wear your big kid underwear today, Leo?' they ask. Leo nods very seriously. 'Yes! I am a big boy now!' First, it is time to visit the potty. Splash, plop, go the morning drops. Hooray! Leo did a fantastic job on the potty. Now comes the most fun part. Mommy brings out a special basket. Inside are brand new underwear with zooming, roaring dinosaurs on them! Leo picks his very favorite pair. They are bright green with a mighty T-Rex right on the front. With a little wiggle and a little hop, Leo pulls his dinosaur undies all by himself. Up, up, up they go! He looks down and giggles. 'Roar!' says the T-Rex. Leo feels so cozy and so proud. Next, he puts on his soft yellow shorts over his new underwear. He is ready to conquer the day! 'Time for breakfast, Leo!' calls Daddy. Leo marches into the kitchen like a strong dinosaur. Munch, crunch, goes his yummy toast. Uh oh! Suddenly, Leo feels a little tickle in his tummy. It is a potty signal! 'I need the potty, Daddy!' Leo says quickly. He dashes to the bathroom just in time. Success! Mommy and Daddy clap their hands and cheer. 'We are so proud of you, Leo!' Leo beams from ear to ear. Wearing big kid underwear takes practice, and Leo is doing a super-duper job. He plays with his blocks, builds a tall tower, and stays dry all morning long. At naptime, he keeps his dinosaur undies nice and dry, too. When the sun starts to set, Leo snuggles into bed with his favorite teddy bear. It has been a wonderful, successful Big Kid Underwear Day. Leo closes his eyes with a happy heart, dreaming of green dinosaurs and big boy adventures.

stories.title: Maya's Starry Surprise
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Maya! The sun is peeking through the pink bedroom curtains, saying hello to a brand new day. Maya stretches her arms way up high, touching the ceiling. 'Good morning, sunshine!' whispers Mommy, walking in with a special package. Maya sits right up. 'What is that?' she asks with wide, curious eyes. Mommy opens the box to reveal the softest, prettiest underwear Maya has ever seen. They are covered in twinkling yellow stars and gentle pink clouds. 'Today is Big Kid Underwear Day!' Mommy announces softly. Maya gasps with delight. 'Just like a big girl?' she asks. 'Just like a big girl,' Mommy replies with a warm hug. First things first, Maya tries the potty. She sits down, relaxes, and listens to the little birds singing outside the window. Splish, splash, go the morning drops. Yay, Maya! She wipes, washes her hands with bubbly soap, and gets ready for the big reveal. Maya takes her starry underwear and pulls them up her legs. One little foot, two little feet, and up they go! They feel so soft and comfy, just like a second hug. Maya puts on her flowy purple skirt on top. She twirls around and around, watching the stars spin with her. 'Look at me, Mommy! I am a starry princess!' Throughout the day, Maya plays with her dolls and builds a giant castle out of blocks. Every so often, she listens to her tummy. When she feels a little tickle, she doesn't wait. She walks right to the potty and uses it like a total pro. Mommy and Daddy give her high-fives every single time. 'You are learning so fast, Maya!' Maya feels so warm and happy inside. Afternoon turns into evening, and Maya is still as dry as can be. Before bedtime stories, she puts on her cozy pajamas. As she drifts off to sleep, she whispers to her teddy bear, 'Today was the best day ever.' Sweet dreams, Maya!

stories.title: Sammy's Superhero Capers
stories.text: Bam! Pow! Good morning, Super Sammy! Today is the most heroic day of the week. Do you know what today is? It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sammy throws off his superhero blanket and does a superhero pose. 'I am ready!' he declares in his deepest, bravest voice. Daddy chuckles and hands Sammy a special drawer pull. Inside are the coolest superhero underwear in the whole wide world. They are bright blue with a golden lightning bolt right on the front. Sammy's eyes light up. 'Lightning undies! Awesome!' Before putting them on, Sammy knows what every good superhero must do. He visits the potty station for a quick morning mission. Mission accomplished! The bathroom sink water splashes happily. Now, it is time to suit up. Sammy steps into his blue superhero underwear. He pulls them up, up, up until they sit snugly on his waist. He puts on his red shorts and a cape made from his favorite red towel. Sammy feels strong, fast, and ready for action. 'Time to save the living room, Deputy Daddy!' Sammy marches into the playroom. He builds a fortress of pillows and zooms his toy cars across the rug. Suddenly, Sammy's tummy gives him a little wiggle-wobble signal. 'Uh oh, superhero alert!' says Sammy. He doesn't wait. He zooms like a jet plane straight to the potty and makes it right in the nick of time. 'Woo-hoo! Another successful mission!' cheers Daddy. Sammy washes his hands with bubbly blue soap. He stays dry all morning, all afternoon, and all evening long. Even when he eats his yummy spaghetti dinner, his lightning undies stay safe and dry. At bedtime, Sammy takes off his superhero cape and tucks his lightning undies into the laundry basket. He puts on his soft moon pajamas. As Mommy tucks him in, she kisses his forehead. 'You did it, Sammy. You are our big kid hero.' Sammy smiles a big, sleepy smile, ready for more adventures tomorrow.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies Adventure
stories.text: Good morning, Leo! Today is a very special day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Today, Leo gets to say goodbye to diapers and hello to cool, soft cotton undies with stomping, roaring dinosaurs right on the front. Leo smiles a big, happy smile. Mommy holds up the green dinosaur pair. 'Are you ready to try these on, big guy?' Leo nods his head up and down. 'Yes, Mommy! Roar!' First, Leo goes to the potty. He sits down and tries his very best. Squeeze, push, relax! Nothing happens right now, and that is okay, because practicing makes us stronger. Then, Mommy helps Leo pull up his brand-new dinosaur underwear. They feel so soft and light! Leo looks down at his feet. The little green dinosaur winks up at him. 'Keep me dry!' the dinosaur seems to say. Leo eats a yummy bowl of crunchy cereal for breakfast. Crunch, crunch, crunch. He drinks a big cup of water. Glug, glug, glug. While Leo plays with his colorful wooden blocks, building a super tall tower, he suddenly feels a funny tickle in his tummy. Uh-oh! That tickle means it is time to visit the potty again. Leo jumps up quickly. 'Bye-bye, blocks! Be right back!' He hurries to the bathroom, sits right down on the little potty seat, and cheers. Yay! He does it just in time. Mommy claps her hands together and gives Leo the biggest, warmest hug in the whole wide world. 'Look at you, Leo! You are using the potty like such a big boy!' Leo beams with pride. He is keeping his dinosaur friends happy and dry all day long. Afternoon playtime is so much fun, and Leo checks on his dinosaur undies often. They stay dry, cozy, and clean. When the golden sun starts to sink low in the evening sky, Leo puts on his snuggly pajamas. He feels so proud of his wonderful day. You did it, Leo! You are growing up so fast, and everyone is so proud of your big kid steps today.

stories.title: Mia's Magical Rainbow Undies
stories.text: Wake up, sunshine! Today is a magical day in Mia's house. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia stretches her arms high up to touch the bedroom ceiling. Yaaaaawn! Today, Mia gets to wear real big kid undies covered in bright, beautiful rainbows and fluffy white clouds. Daddy shows Mia the rainbow drawer. 'Which color do you choose today, Mia?' Mia points right to the pink and yellow rainbow pair. 'The happy rainbows, Daddy!' First, Mia washes her hands with bubbly soap, singing her favorite ABC song. Then, it is potty time practice. Mia sits on her special pink potty chair and reads her favorite storybook about a fluffy bunny. She relaxes and tries her best. After a few moments, she stands up and happily steps into her rainbow underwear. They feel so different from diapers—so light and breezy! Mia dances a little wiggle-dance around her bedroom. Jiggle, wiggle, freeze! At breakfast, Mia enjoys sweet sliced bananas and a cup of warm apple juice. Yum, yum! While Mia paints a pretty picture with blue and red fingerpaints, she feels that familiar warm feeling in her tummy. Her body is telling her something important. 'Mommy, I need the potty!' Mia announces proudly. She washes her paint hands super fast and hurries to the bathroom just like a superhero. She sits down on the potty, and success happens! Hooray for Mia! Mommy runs in with a huge smile and a gold star sticker. 'You listened to your body so well, Mia!' The gold star goes right on her shirt, shining like a tiny sun. Mia feels so happy inside.
