Throughout the afternoon, playing with her dolls and building block castles, Mia remembers to keep her rainbow undies dry and clean. As bedtime approaches, Mia snuggles deep under her cozy blanket. She whispers a quiet 'Goodnight' to her rainbows. What a wonderful, successful big kid day it has been!

stories.title: Sam's Super Puppy Underwear
stories.text: Good morning, bright blue sky! Today is a fantastic day for Sam. Guess what? It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam jumps right out of bed, ready for a fun-filled adventure. Grandma has a special surprise waiting on the chair. It is a pair of soft cotton underwear featuring friendly little yellow puppies with floppy ears. Sam gasps in delight. 'Puppies!' he shouts happily. Grandma smiles gently. 'That is right, Sam. These are your special big boy puppy undies.' First things first, Sam walks to the bathroom to try the potty. He sits down patiently and pretends to steer a big red fire truck with his hands. Vroom, vroom! Even though nothing happens right now, Sam is learning how his body works, and that is wonderful. Then, Sam pulls up his puppy underwear all by himself. Pull, tug, up they go! He looks down and sees the happy puppy smiling back at him. Sam eats a yummy breakfast of scrambled eggs and warm toast. He drinks a big cup of milk, too. Slurp, slurp! While Sam zooms his toy cars across the living room rug, vroom-vroom, beep-beep, he suddenly pauses. His tummy gives a little signal. Ah-ha! That means it is time to race to the bathroom. Sam puts his cars safely in the toy box and dashes to the potty like a speedy race car driver. He makes it just in time and giggles with joy. Grandma cheers loudly and gives Sam a high-five. 'High-five, big guy! You are doing amazing!' Sam feels so proud and strong. For the rest of the day, Sam plays outside in the sunshine, sliding down the slide and chasing fluffy butterflies. Every once in a while, he checks on his puppy friends. They stay dry and comfortable all day long. When the stars twinkle in the dark night sky, Sam drifts off to sleep with a happy heart. He is growing into such a big boy!

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, Leo! Today is a very special day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Leo jumps right out of bed and stretches his arms high up into the sky. Today, no more diapers. Today, Leo gets to wear big kid underwear with giant green dinosaurs on them. How exciting is that? Mama holds up the special underwear. They are soft, bright blue, and have the friendliest little T-Rex printed right on the front. Leo’s eyes go wide with a big, happy smile. 'Rawr!' roars Leo, putting his little feet into the leg holes, one, two, and pulling them all the way up. 'Yay! I am a big kid!' he cheers, clapping his hands together. Papa smiles warmly and gives Leo a gentle high-five. 'You look so cool, Leo. Remember, our big kid body gives us clues. When your tummy or your body tells you it is time to use the potty, we just walk right over and try.' Leo nods his head up and down. He eats his yummy morning oatmeal and drinks a big cup of water. He plays with his colorful blocks, building a tall tower that reaches the sofa. Suddenly, Leo stops playing. He wiggles a little bit. His tummy gives him a funny little tap. 'Mama! My tummy says it is potty time!' Leo whispers loudly. Mama beams with pride. 'Let's go, super helper!' They walk to the bathroom together. And guess what? Leo does a wonderful job! He sits on the potty and uses it all by himself. When he is done, he washes his hands with bubbly soap, splashing water gently. 'I did it!' Leo shouts, doing a silly victory dance around the fluffy bathroom rug. Mama wraps her arms around him in a big, cozy hug. 'I am so proud of you, my sweet boy. Wearing big kid underwear and listening to your body makes you grow so strong and smart.' Leo feels so proud, too. He walks back to his toys, standing extra tall, ready for the rest of his happy, dry day.

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Pants
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! The sun is peeking through the pink bedroom curtains, and today is a wonderful day. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia sits up and rubs her sleepy eyes. Grandma walks into the room carrying a brand-new, sparkly box. 'Guess what is inside, Mia?' Grandma asks with a cheerful giggle. Mia hops out of bed. Inside the box are the most magical big kid underwear in the whole wide world. They are covered in bright red, orange, yellow, green, and purple rainbows. Mia claps her hands together with joy. 'Rainbows! My favorite!' she sings out loud. Grandma helps Mia slip into the soft, rainbow cotton pants. They fit just right, hugging her tummy comfortably. 'You are wearing your special rainbow armor today, Mia,' Grandma says with a loving smile. 'And remember, whenever you feel the gentle urge to go potty, your rainbow underwear will help you remember to walk to the bathroom.' Mia nods seriously. 'I am a big girl now, Grandma.' All morning long, Mia plays with her fuzzy stuffed bunny, Hoppy. They have a tea party with imaginary strawberry juice in pink cups. While they are pouring tea, Mia feels a little flutter in her tummy. It is the friendly potty signal! Mia gently sets her teacup down on the little wooden table. 'Hold on, Hoppy, I have to go use the potty like a big girl,' Mia tells her bunny softly. She hurries over to the bathroom, all by herself. Hooray! Mia makes it right on time. She sits down, does her best, and washes her hands with strawberry soap until the bubbles tickle her fingers. Grandma is waiting outside the door with a huge cheering smile. 'You did it, Mia! Look at you go!' Mia twirls around in her rainbow underwear, feeling like a magical princess. 'I keep my rainbow pants dry and clean!' she beams happily. Grandma kisses her forehead, and Mia goes back to her tea party, feeling so proud and brave.

stories.title: Sammy's Starry Rocket
stories.text: Good morning, little astronaut Sammy! Today is a very important day in outer space, and right here at home. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sammy stretches out his arms like airplane wings and zooms out of his cozy bed. Daddy is waiting in the kitchen with a special surprise folded on the counter. They are big kid underwear patterned with shiny yellow stars and zooming rockets. Sammy gasps happily. 'Rocket ship undies! To the moon!' he exclaims, doing a little happy hop on the kitchen tiles. Daddy helps Sammy step into the soft, starry cotton. Sammy pulls them up all by himself, adjusting the waistband just right. 'You look ready for liftoff, Captain Sammy,' Daddy says, giving him a proud thumbs-up. 'Just remember, our rocket ship rule: when you feel that little bubble in your tummy, we fly straight to the potty station.' Sammy salutes his dad. 'Yes, Captain Daddy!' Sammy spends the morning building a giant rocket ship out of cardboard boxes and colorful stickers. He adds a paper plate window and a shiny tin foil nose cone. While he is drawing little star windows with his blue crayon, Sammy feels a familiar little nudge in his tummy. It is time! Sammy gently puts his crayon down in the box. 'Time for a potty pit stop,' he announces to his stuffed bear, Astronaut Bob. He walks steadily down the hallway to the bathroom, remembering his big-kid steps. He sits down on the potty seat, nice and patient. Soon, he is finished! Sammy flushes the handle with a loud, friendly *whoosh!* and washes his hands with foamy green soap. When he steps out of the bathroom, Daddy is there with a shiny gold star sticker. Daddy presses the star right onto Sammy's shirt. 'You did a stellar job today, Sammy. Your starry underwear stayed dry because you listened to your body!' Sammy smiles proudly, patting his star sticker. He feels so big, so smart, and so ready for his next big toddler adventure.

stories.title: Leo's Dinosaur Undies
stories.text: Good morning, little Leo! Today is a very exciting day. It is Big Kid Underwear Day! No more sleepy diapers. Today, Leo gets to wear special big kid undies all by himself. Leo jumps right out of bed with a big, happy stretch. On his dresser are the most wonderful undies in the whole wide world. They are bright green with friendly orange dinosaurs stomping right across the front. Roar! Go dinosaur undies! Mommy holds them open wide. One leg goes in, and then the other leg goes in. Leo pulls them all the way up his tummy with a big wiggle. He looks down and giggles. "Look, Mommy! I look just like a big boy now!" Mommy claps her hands and gives Leo the biggest hug. "You look so handsome, my big boy!" Leo walks to the big bathroom to try his very first big kid potty adventure. He sits down patiently, just like a grown-up. He waits, and then—yay!—he tries his best. Even if accidents happen, Mommy and Daddy always say it is okay because learning takes practice. But today, Leo is doing super-duper well. Every time Leo washes his hands with bubbly, warm soap, he feels so proud. At snack time, Leo munches on yummy apple slices and drinks a cup of water. He is learning to listen to his body. When he feels a little tickle that says it is time to go, he stops his fun puzzle and walks right to the potty. Hooray for Leo! At naptime, Leo wears cozy pajama bottoms, but he is so proud of his dinosaur undies waiting for him in the drawer. When he wakes up, he puts them right back on. Before bedtime, Daddy reads a favorite story about a brave little bear, and Leo snuggles close. What a wonderful, successful day of growing up. Goodnight, sweet dinosaur boy!

stories.title: Mia's Rainbow Undies
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! Today is a super special day filled with sunshine and smiles. Today is Big Kid Underwear Day! Mia stretches her arms high up to touch the ceiling. Yawn! Time to wake up and start a brand-new adventure. Today, Mia gets to wear her very own big girl undies. They are magical because they have a beautiful rainbow painted right on the side, with pink hearts and yellow stars. Mia picks them up and holds them tight. "My rainbow undies!" she whispers happily. With a little wiggle and a little hop, Mia steps into her soft undies and pulls them up all by herself. Look at her go! She twirls around the bedroom like a pretty ballerina, and the rainbow spins right along with her. Daddy smiles big and says, "Look at my big girl! You are growing up so fast." Mia feels as proud as can be. After eating a bowl of warm oatmeal with sweet strawberries, Mia gets ready for her morning playtime. She plays with her pink blocks, building a tall, tall tower. Suddenly, Mia remembers her body's little helper signal. Uh-oh, time to pause the building! Mia stands up quickly and walks—never runs—to the bright pink potty in the bathroom. She sits down and waits patiently, singing her favorite little song about ducks in a pond. All done! Mia claps her hands together with joy. Washing her hands with the foamy soap tickles her fingers, and she giggles out loud. When Grandma comes over for a visit in the afternoon, the very first thing Mia says is, "Grandma, look at my rainbow undies! I am a big girl now!" Grandma gives her a warm, loving squeeze. As the stars come out at night, Mia folds her rainbow undies neatly on the chair, ready for another fun day of growing up big and strong.

stories.title: Sam's Super Speeder Undies
stories.text: Good morning, little Sam! The sun is peeking through the window, saying hello. Do you know what today is? It is Big Kid Underwear Day! Sam throws off his cozy blanket and does a happy morning wiggle. Today is a day for super speeders, because Sam is wearing his brand-new superhero undies! They are bright blue with a golden lightning bolt right on the side. Zap! Zoom! Sam jumps up and down on the soft rug. Mommy holds up the blue superhero undies, and Sam puts his feet right into the leg holes. One, two, pull them up high! Sam strikes a strong superhero pose with his hands on his hips. "I am Super Sam!" he announces in a big, brave voice. Mommy cheers, "To the rescue, Super Sam!" Today, Sam is in charge of his own potty missions. While playing with his shiny red toy truck, Sam feels a little rumble in his tummy. That is his body's alarm bell! Super Sam knows just what to do. He zooms his truck back to the toy box and races to the bathroom like a fast car. Vroom! He sits on the potty and waits like a patient champion. Success! Sam feels so happy and proud. He washes his hands with bubbly blue soap and splashes a tiny bit of water, smiling at his clean fingers. When it is time to go outside to the park, Sam wears his superhero undies under his shorts, feeling extra brave on the big yellow slide. Whee! Down he goes, laughing all the way. At dinnertime, Sam eats every single green pea on his plate because big kids need strong energy. When bedtime arrives, Sam tucks his superhero undies right beside his bed, dreaming of tomorrow's new adventures. Sleep tight, Super Sam!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diapers!
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the diapers away,
We are big and brave today!
No more sticky tabs and glue,
We have something special new!

Soft and cozy, oh so bright,
Picking out the ones just right.
Step one foot right in the hole,
Being big is quite the goal!

Pull them up and wiggle round,
Look at what we just have found!
No more bulky, puffy pack,
We are moving front and back.

Time to do a potty dance,
Give our big-kid pants a chance!
Clap our hands and shout out loud,
Every single one is proud!

rhymes.title: Rainbow Undies
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Everything is feeling right.
Open up the drawer and see,
Colors made for you and me!

Red and yellow, green and blue,
Pick the pair that looks like you.
Legs go in and stretch them high,
Wave the diaper all goodbye.

Pull them up above the knee,
As happy as a bird so free.
Look in the mirror, give a wink,
You are smarter than you think!

Now we're ready for the day,
Ready for some fun and play.
Big kid underwear is here,
Let us give a happy cheer!

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Pull-Up
rhymes.text:
Wake up, wake up, rise and shine,
Everything is looking fine!
Today is special, yes it's true,
We have got a job to do.

Diapers are for babies small,
Now we are so big and tall.
Grab the cotton, soft and sweet,
Put them on our little feet.

Pull them up and give a tug,
Give your teddy bear a hug.
Twirl around and check the view,
Look how shiny brand new you!

Keep on trying, do your best,
Time to pass the big-kid test.
Dry and happy all day long,
Singing out a happy song!

rhymes.title: Hooray for Big Kid Pants!
rhymes.text:
Hip, hip, hooray, let's give a shout,
What is today all about?
It is time for something grand,
Best invention in the land!

Goodbye diapers on the floor,
We do not need you anymore.
Softest cotton on our skin,
Let the mighty day begin.

Step right in and pull them straight,
Oh, this feeling feels so great!
Jump up high and touch the sky,
Wave the baby stage goodbye.

Wash our hands and wear a smile,
We will keep this up a while.
Growing bigger every day,
Hooray, hooray, hooray, hooray!

rhymes.title: Dinosaur Undies
rhymes.text:
Stomp your feet and give a roar,
We are wearing pants galore!
Dinosaurs upon our seat,
Making little kids complete.

T-Rex says it is time to go,
Faster now and not too slow.
Left foot in and right foot too,
Look at all the things we do!

Pull them up and make them fit,
Sit right down and take a bit.
No more padding in the rear,
We have got no time for fear.

Roar like lions in the zoo,
Big kid pants look good on you!
Pat your head and touch your toes,
Off to happy days we go.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Diapers, Hello Big Kid!
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the diapers away,
We are starting a brand new day!
No more sticky tabs and pin,
Let the big kid days begin!

Look at colors, red and blue,
Pick a special pair for you.
Step one leg in, nice and slow,
Pull them up and watch them go!

Soft and comfy, oh so neat,
Look down at your happy feet.
Big kid pants are so much fun,
Let's go cheer for number one!

Waving bye to diapers now,
Give a happy toddler bow!
Stand up tall and shout hooray,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: The Potty Dance
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Everything is feeling right.
Time to change our clothes today,
Throw the heavy guards away.

Hold the underwear up high,
Reach and touch the morning sky.
Put your toes right in the holes,
Now you rock and now you roll!

Pull them up your little waist,
Do it with a happy haste.
Look in mirror, point and smile,
Let us do a potty style!

Wash your hands and dance around,
Best new feeling ever found.
Shout it loud and shout it gay,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: Super Hero Undies
rhymes.text:
Every morning brings a cheer,
Magic moments are right here.
Put the baby days to rest,
Wear your big kid undies best!

Do they have a puppy friend?
Do the funny stripes extend?
Slide them up your little knee,
As proud as a bird can be.

Now you have a cape of might,
Keeping everything just right.
Ready for the slides and swings,
Ready for amazing things!

Twirl around and take a bow,
You are growing up right now.
Clap your hands and hip-hooray,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: Hop Into the Morning
rhymes.text:
Sun is up and birds are singing,
All the joy the day is bringing.
Put away the baby gear,
Something special now is here.

Pick a pattern on the cloth,
Soft as any little moth.
Step right in and pull them higher,
Fueling up your toddler fire!

Snug and cozy on your skin,
That is where the smiles begin.
Walk around and feel so grand,
Best kid in the whole wide land.

Time to play and time to run,
Underneath the golden sun.
Sing a happy little lay,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: Grown-Up Steps
rhymes.text:
Growing up is so much fun,
Let us greet the morning sun.
Leave the fluffy tabs behind,
Leave the baby stuff confined.

Hold your undies by the band,
Stretch them wide with either hand.
Pop your feet right through the door,
Sitting softly on the floor.

Pull them up to meet your tummy,
Eating breakfast, sweet and yummy.
Look at you so brave and tall,
Biggest kid of all of all!

Give a hug and give a cheer,
Best milestone of all the year.
Let us shout a loud hooray,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diapers
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the diapers away,
We are big and brave today!
Take the sticky tabs apart,
Big kid pants are smart, so smart!

Soft and bright and fit just right,
Colors shining in the light.
Step right up and pull them high,
Wave the baby pants goodbye!

Look in mirror, spin around,
Happiest kid in the town.
No more leaks, we are so neat,
Standing proud upon our feet.

Potty time is here at last,
Growing up so very fast!
Cheer aloud and shout hooray,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: Hop Into Pants
rhymes.text:
Sun is shining, skies are blue,
I have got a job to do.
Goodbye diaper, time to go,
Watch my big kid powers grow!

Hold the waistband, nice and wide,
Look who's stepping right inside!
Left foot hop and right foot too,
Look at what I just can do!

Pull them up and give a tug,
Give my teddy bear a hug.
Ready for the day ahead,
Jumping right out of my bed.

Running fast and feeling free,
So much pride inside of me.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Pull
rhymes.text:
Morning comes with cheerful song,
Big kid clothes where they belong.
Diapers rest upon the shelf,
I can dress me by myself!

Here are pants with puppy dogs,
Jumping over lily bogs.
Put my toes inside the holes,
Walking like the busy moles.

Pull them up above my knees,
Doing things with so much ease.
iggle wiggle, twist and shout,
That is what big kids are about!

Now I'm ready for my play,
Having such a joyful day.
Sing a song and shout hooray,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: Colors and Smiles
rhymes.text:
Red and yellow, green and blue,
I have got a treat for you.
Softest cotton you can see,
Just the perfect size for me!

Step one foot and step the next,
Never looking sad or vexed.
Pull them up so nice and high,
Reaching all the way to sky.

Feel so proud and feel so grand,
Best dressed toddler in the land.
Time to use the potty chair,
Doing such a mighty dare!

Flush the water down the drain,
Sunshine coming through the rain.
Dance around and shout hooray,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: Growing Up Fast
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock clock begins to chime,
It is potty training time!
Leave the baby days behind,
Leaving all the fuss attuned.

Pick a pair with racing cars,
Driving underneath the stars.
Legs go in and pull them tight,
Everything is feeling right.

Look at me, I'm growing tall,
Not a baby round this hall.
Smart and strong and oh so sweet,
Standing safely on my feet.

Give a cheer and spin around,
Touching happy, magic ground.
Sing along and shout hooray,
Happy Big Kid Underwear Day!

rhymes.title: Goodbye Diapers
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the diapers away,
We are big and brave today!
No more sticky tabs or glue,
We have something brand new to do.

Look at cars and rockets bright,
Fitting soft and feeling right.
Pull them up and pull them high,
Wave the baby pants goodbye!

Big kid status, look and see,
As happy as a child can be.
Dance around the living room,
Chasing off the potty gloom.

We can do it, yes we try,
Reaching right up to the sky.
Cheer aloud and shout hooray,
Happy big kid underwear day!

rhymes.title: The Rainbow Step
rhymes.text:
Morning sun begins to glow,
Time to shed the baby show.
Pick a pair with smiling frogs,
Sitting on some happy logs.

Slip your little feet right through,
Red and yellow, green and blue.
Pull them up your little waist,
Do it with a joyful haste.

Look in mirror, wave and grin,
Let the potty fun begin!
No more messes on the floor,
Diapers live behind the door.

Proudly walking down the hall,
Biggest toddler of them all.
Clap your hands and sing this way,
Happy big kid underwear day!

rhymes.title: Super Hero Undies
rhymes.text:
Put your superhero cape away,
Listen to what the grownups say.
Undies have a magic power,
Helping us this very hour.

Step your right foot in the ring,
Hear the happy toddlers sing.
Step your left foot right inside,
Wear your undies with such pride.

Pull them to your belly button,
Keep your little steps a-muttin'.
Ready now for games and blocks,
Matching with your favorite socks.

If you feel a little tickle,
Running like a little pickle,
Find the potty right away,
Happy big kid underwear day!

rhymes.title: Hop and Pull
rhymes.text:
Sun is shining in the sky,
Time to give a cheerful cry.
Diapers are a sleepy dream,
Listen to our happy scream.

Hold the waistband in each hand,
Standing in the middle land.
Put your toes into the holes,
Just like little jumping moles.

Hop up high and pull them up,
Drink a happy water cup.
Spin around and watch them sway,
In the middle of the day.

Growing bigger all the while,
Wearing such a lovely smile.
Let us shout a loud hooray,
Happy big kid underwear day!

rhymes.title: The Morning Dance
rhymes.text:
Wake up, toddler, time to prance,
Do the big kid undie dance!
Soft and cozy, fresh and neat,
Ready for your busy feet.

Hold the sides and count to three,
Look how capable you can be.
Up they go above the knees,
Listen to the morning breeze.

Tug them high and tuck them in,
With a bright and shiny grin.
Every day you grow so tall,
Best explorer of us all.

Now the morning routine's done,
Time to play and have some fun.
Sing this little tune and play,
Happy big kid underwear day!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diapers
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the diapers away,
We are big and brave today!
No more sticky tabs to pull,
No more heavy bundles full.

Step right up and take a look,
Right out of a storybook.
Colors bright and patterns grand,
Softest cotton in the land!

Put one leg inside right here,
Give a happy little cheer.
Put the other leg right through,
Look at what big kids can do!

Pull them up and wiggle round,
Feet are happy on the ground.
Ready now to run and play,
Hip-hooray for underwear day!

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Pull-Up
rhymes.text:
Sun is shining in the sky,
Diapers days have floated by.
Time to wear our special gear,
Let's give out a joyful cheer!

Hold the waistband nice and wide,
Look at what is tucked inside.
Dinosaurs and shining stars,
Racing fast in shiny cars.

Toes go in and up we go,
Dancing to our favorite show.
Pull them to your belly button,
Time to jump and time to run.

Feeling cozy, feeling proud,
Let us sing it nice and loud.
Growing up is so much fun,
We are proud of everyone!

rhymes.title: Underwear Dance
rhymes.text:
Morning comes and up we wake,
What a happy choice to make!
Diapers on the shelf must stay,
Underwear is king today.

Hold the fabric in your hand,
Softest cotton in the land.
Find the front and find the back,
Ready for a fun attack!

Left foot in and right foot too,
Watch the magic that you do.
Pull them up with all your might,
Every single seam is right.

Do a wiggle, do a shake,
What a little star you make!
Big kid pants are here to stay,
Hip-hooray and happy day!

rhymes.title: Ready, Set, Grow!
rhymes.text:
Look inside the drawer so sweet,
Something special as a treat.
No more diapers, time to go,
We are helping toddlers grow!

Pick a pair with puppy dogs,
Jumping over shiny logs.
Or a pair with painted flowers,
Ready for our big-kid hours.

Sit right down and stretch them wide,
Slide your little legs inside.
Stand up tall and pull them high,
Touch your fingers to the sky.

Wiggle left and wiggle right,
Fitting cozy, feeling light.
You are growing big and tall,
Best big kid of all!

rhymes.title: Hip-Hooray for Big Kid Pants
rhymes.text:
Hear the tick-tock on the clock,
Time to put away the stock.
Diapers are for babies small,
We are growing big and tall!

Bring the big-kid underwear,
Folded neatly on the chair.
Catch the waistband, hold it tight,
Pull it up with all your might.

Legs go marching, one, two, three,
As happy as a bumblebee.
Smooth them out so nice and neat,
From your head down to your feet.

Clap your hands and shout hooray,
For this wonderful bright day.
You did it all by yourself,
Let us dance upon the shelf!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diapers
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the diapers away,
We are wearing big kid pants today!
No more sticky tabs and tape,
We are shaped like superhero shape.
Step your right foot in the hole,
Keep your steady toddler stroll.
Pull them up your little waist,
Do it with a happy haste!
Look in the mirror, what do you see?
A big kid smiling back at me!
Soft and cozy, bright and neat,
Marching on your little feet.
When you have to go and pee,
Say 'potty time' to you and me.
We are proud and feeling grand,
Walking hand in happy hand!

rhymes.title: Hooray for Big Kid Undies
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Sleepy time is out of sight.
Take the stretchy pants in hand,
Bestest undies in the land!
Dinosaurs and puppies too,
Waiting here to play with you.
Put one leg inside the space,
Put a smile upon your face.
Pull them up and give a shout,
That is what big kids' are about!
Jumping high up in the air,
Look at what you're proud to wear.
Dry and clean all through the day,
Ready for some fun and play.
Wave goodbye to diapers bye,
Watch our big kid rocket fly!
Hip hooray, let's dance and sing,
Undies are a happy thing!

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Pants Dance
rhymes.text:
Wiggle, wiggle, shake your knees,
Put on big kid undies, please!
Colors red and yellow bright,
Fit your little bottom just right.
Hold them low down by your toes,
Right beneath your button nose.
Lift them up and give a tug,
Give your tummy one big hug!
Are you comfy? Yes, indeed!
You are taking the big kid lead.
No more diapers on the floor,
We don't need those anymore.
Listen close and hear the cheer,
Best routine of all the year!
Spin around and watch them sway,
Happy big kid underwear day!

rhymes.title: Ready, Set, Go Big Kid
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock, clock says time to rise,
Open up your sleepy eyes.
Underwear drawer opens wide,
Pick your favorite friend inside.
Maybe stars or rocket ships,
Sing a song with happy lips.
Leg one goes in nice and slow,
Leg two follows, watch it go!
Pull them up so nice and high,
Touch your fingers to the sky.
You are growing big and tall,
Not a baby anymore at all.
Keep them dry and keep them clean,
Smartest toddler ever seen.
Give a clap and shout hurray,
It is big kid underwear day!

rhymes.title: Step Up, Little Star
rhymes.text:
Rise and shine, the morning's here,
Time to cheer a giant cheer.
Diapers rest upon the shelf,
You can dress up all yourself!
Grab the cotton pants so neat,
Drop them down near little feet.
Step right in and pull them tall,
You are doing great, that's all!
Soft and gentle on your skin,
Let the happy day begin.
When you feel a little squeeze,
Tell a grown-up right away, please.
Potty chair is waiting near,
There is nothing here to fear.
Now you're ready for the day,
Hip, hip, hooray, hip, hip, hooray!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diapers
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the diapers away,
We are big kids here today!
No more sticky tabs to pull,
No more bags that get so full.
Step right up and take a look,
Open up our big kid book.
Colorful and bright and grand,
Softest cotton in the land.
Put one leg inside the hole,
Helping is our favorite goal!
Pull them up and give a shout,
That is what big kids' day is about!
Jump up high and shake your feet,
Look at this, a daily treat.
Happy bottom, feeling proud,
Let us sing it nice and loud!

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Pull
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
We are ready, we are light!
Diapers go into the bin,
Let the potty time begin.
Grab the briefs with rockets red,
Time to jump right out of bed.
Slide your toes right down the track,
Pull them up in front and back.
Wiggle, wiggle, make them fit,
Sit upon the little seat.
Wave bye-bye and wash your hands,
Now we join the big kid bands.
Look so cool and feel so dry,
Watch the happy toddler fly!
Cheer aloud for what we do,
Big kid pants look great on you!

rhymes.title: Rainbow Undies Dance
rhymes.text:
Pink and yellow, green and blue,
I have got a pair for you!
Underwear with silly frogs,
Jumping on the floating logs.
Take the waistband in your hand,
Stand right up and look so grand.
Left foot in and right foot too,
See just what a child can do!
Pull them up unto your hips,
Put a smile upon your lips.
Dance around the playroom floor,
We do not need diapers more.
Twirl around and touch your toes,
Feel the breeze blow on your nose.
Sing a happy toddler tune,
We are growing up so soon!

rhymes.title: Step By Step Today
rhymes.text:
Listen to the morning song,
Help the toddler dance along.
Diapers are a baby thing,
Hear the joyful voices sing.
Shiny drawer is open wide,
Pick the pair you keep inside.
Stars and stripes or polka dots,
Free from heavy cotton spots.
Hold them low and bend your knees,
Put them on with gentle ease.
Pull them up so nice and high,
Touch the ceiling, wave goodbye!
Look in mirror, point and grin,
See the big kid looking in.
Wash your hands and pat your head,
Time for daily fun instead.

rhymes.title: Super Kid Pants
rhymes.text:
Capes are cool and shoes are neat,
Undies make the outfit sweet!
Put away the baby gear,
Super toddler time is here.
Grab the pair with dinosaur,-
Roaring loudly on the floor.
Step right in and hold on tight,
Make sure everything fits right.
Up they go with one big tug,
Give yourself a happy hug!
Dry and comfy all day long,
Humming out a happy song.
Ready now to go and play,
Having such a special day.
Cheer for every little stride,
Mom and Dad are full of pride!

rhymes.title: Goodbye Diapers, Hello Pants!
rhymes.text:
Time to do a happy dance,
Pull on up your big kid pants!
Diapers are now put away,
We wear underwear today.

Soft and bright and fit just right,
Colors shining in the light.
Look at dinosaurs so blue,
Jumping up and down with you!

No more bulky, sagging load,
We are on the big kid road.
If you feel a little tickle,
Just like any happy pickle,

Tell a grown-up right away,
We can pause and go and play.
Cheer aloud and shout hooray,
Big kid underwear today!

rhymes.title: The Underwear Hop
rhymes.text:
Put your left foot in the hole,
Like a happy little mole.
Put your right foot in the space,
Put a smile upon your face.

Pull them up and stretch them high,
Reach your fingers to the sky!
Underwear is soft and neat,
Covering your little feet.

Say goodbye to baby things,
Listen how the morning sings.
You are growing big and tall,
Jumping softly like a ball.

Potty time is here and now,
Take a gentle little bow.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Big kid underwear today!

rhymes.title: Bright Colors and Big Smiles
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Everything is feeling light.
Pick a pair with smiling stars,
Or a race car zooming far.

Step right in and pull them up,
Drink a sip from your big cup.
You are growing every day,
Ready for a world of play.

Keep them dry and keep them clean,
You're the happiest you've been.
If you have to go and pee,
Come along and follow me.

Potty time is fast and near,
There is nothing here to fear.
Sing a song and shout hooray,
Big kid underwear today!

rhymes.title: Super Hero Undies
rhymes.text:
Super heroes wear a cape,
Undies keep the proper shape!
Put them on with magic speed,
That is all a hero needs.

Stretch them low and pull them high,
Watch the happy birdies fly.
Feel so comfy, feel so proud,
Singing right out loud and loud.

When your tummy gives a sign,
Everything is going fine.
Walk right to the potty chair,
Sit down calmly waiting there.

Wash your hands and shake them dry,
Wave a happy, cheerful bye.
Cheer aloud and shout hooray,
Big kid underwear today!

rhymes.title: The Morning Stretch
rhymes.text:
Wake up sleepy little bear,
Look at what we're going to wear!
Stripes and dots and puppies too,
Waiting right in front of you.

One leg in and then the next,
Never feeling sad or vexed.
Pull them up around your waist,
Doing it with little haste.

Look at you, so proud and grand,
Best kid in the whole wide land.
Listen to your tummy's cue,
We know what we have to do.

Potty is your special spot,
Whether cold or whether hot.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Big kid underwear today!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diapers
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the diapers away,
Today is a very special day!
No more sticky tabs or pins,
That is where the magic begins.
Big kid underwear is so bright,
Pull them up and squeeze them tight.
Look at dinosaurs on my hip,
Ready for a happy trip!
Say goodbye to baby things,
Look at all the joy it brings.
Running, jumping, feeling free,
Just as happy as can be!
Time to use the potty chair,
Cheering loudly in the air.
We are proud as we can be,
Growing up for all to see!

rhymes.title: Colors and Rockets
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining down,
No more baby clothes around.
Pick a pair of underwear,
Colors shining everywhere!
Red and yellow, blue and green,
Freshest pair you've ever seen.
Hop one leg and then the other,
Smile big at your proud mother.
Rocket ships take off so high,
Reaching upward to the sky.
We can wear them all day long,
Singing out a happy song.
Keep them dry and keep them clean,
Best big kid we've ever seen!
Pat your tummy, give a cheer,
Best adventure of the year!

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Stretch
rhymes.text:
Wake up, toddler, time to rise,
Rub the sleep right from your eyes.
Underwear is soft and neat,
Pull them down around your feet.
Pull them up and stretch them tall,
Now you're not a baby small!
Look at puppies on the side,
Wear them with a tummy of pride.
Listen to the potty chime,
It is potty training time!
Sit right down and count to ten,
Wash your little hands again.
Dry them on a fluffy towel,
Smile so big, you look quite owl.
Big kid pants are here to stay,
Hooray, hooray, hip, hip, hooray!

rhymes.title: Dance in Your Pants
rhymes.text:
Put the baby steps behind,
Look at what we get to find!
Underwear with stripes and stars,
Zooming fast like shiny cars.
Step right in and pull them up,
Drink some water from your cup.
Twirl around and dance a jig,
Look at you, you're getting big!
Feel the breeze upon your knees,
Say thank you and say please.
If you feel the bubble grow,
To the potty you must go!
Sit right down and do your best,
Passing every little test.
Wash your hands and do a dance,
Loving your new big kid pants!

rhymes.title: Super Kid Cape
rhymes.text:
Put on shoes and brush your hair,
Time to wear big kid underwear!
Choose the ones with super bears,
Climbing up the wooden stairs.
Slip them on and tuck them in,
Wear a winning toddler grin.
Like a superhero's cape,
Ready for a brand new shape.
Keep them dry and keep them dry,
Wave the old routines goodbye.
When you feel the gentle squeeze,
Listen carefully, oh please.
Run on over, do not wait,
Potty time is feeling great!
Clap your hands and shout aloud,
Mom and Dad are extra proud!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Diapers!
rhymes.text:
Time to pack the diapers away,
We are big and brave today!
No more sticky tabs and tape,
Time to try a brand new shape.
Soft and snug upon my seat,
Look at me, from head to feet!
Colors bright and patterns grand,
Pull them up with my own hand.
Bouncy steps across the floor,
We don't need those babies more.
Dance around and shout hooray,
Big kid underwear today!
Feel so proud and feel so tall,
Happy camper, one and all.
Time to play and time to sing,
Ready for a happy spring!

rhymes.title: The Big Kid Pull-Up Song
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Sleepy stars are out of sight.
Time to change our morning look,
Let us read our potty book.
Step right up and find the pair,
Big kid underwear is there!
Put one foot and then the other,
Smile big at my happy mother.
Pull them up so nice and high,
Wave the baby pants goodbye.
Jump up high and touch the sky,
Watch the happy toddler fly!
No more messes on the floor,
We are growing more and more.
Clap your hands and shout aloud,
Every single heart is proud!

rhymes.title: Super Hero Undies
rhymes.text:
Super heroes wear their capes,
We wear stars and funny shapes.
Underneath my shiny clothes,
Right down to my little toes.
Special pants for big boys now,
Watch me do a little bow.
Cotton soft and very blue,
Brand new morning, shiny new.
Keep them dry all through the day,
While I run and jump and play.
If I feel the wiggle sign,
Potty time will work just fine.
Quickly walk and do not run,
Potty training is so fun!
Now my hero day is here,
Give a happy toddler cheer!

rhymes.title: Hop Into Your Big Kid Pants
rhymes.text:
Hop, hop, hop into your pants,
Do a little wiggle dance!
One, two, three and up they go,
Look how fast my big kids grow.
Dinosaurs and puppies too,
Waiting right here just for you.
Slide them up your little legs,
Time to put away the pegs.
Snug and cozy, oh so neat,
Wiggle all your little feet.
When you have to go pee-pee,
Call right out and holler me!
Wash your hands with bubbles sweet,
Victory is quite a treat.
Put your favorite t-shirt on,
Now the sleepy mood is gone!

rhymes.title: Hip Hip Hooray for Undies Day
rhymes.text:
Sun is up and so are we,
Happy as a bumblebee.
Throw the diapers in the bin,
Let the special day begin.
Softest cotton you can find,
Leaving baby days behind.
Pull them up and check the view,
Look at what I daily do!
Marching round the living room,
Chasing off the morning gloom.
Dry and clean and feeling great,
At a super steady rate.
Give a twirl and give a spin,
Let the happy games begin.
Hip hip hooray for underwear,
Happy cheers are in the air!

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text:
Ring ring! Goes Sammy’s cute little toy truck across the living room rug. Sammy is playing so happily with his favorite red blocks and his shiny toy cars. But suddenly, Sammy stops. He feels a little warm tickle in his tummy. Uh-oh! That is Sammy’s body telling him it is time to visit the big bathroom! Mommy looks down with a big, loving smile and says, 'Do you need to use the potty, Sammy?' Sammy nods his head up and down. 'Yes, Mommy!' he chimes happily. 

Together, they walk down the hallway to the bright bathroom. Sammy climbs up onto his special little blue potty seat. It is just his size and feels very cozy and safe. Sammy sits down and waits patiently. He relaxes his tummy and takes a nice deep breath. Phew! Out comes the pee-pee, right into the potty bowl. Good job, Sammy! 

Now comes the very next important step in Sammy’s big-boy routine. Sammy stands up carefully and turns around to look down into the bowl. 'Bye-bye, little puddle!' he says. Next, Mommy hands him a soft piece of toilet paper. Sammy wipes his bottom gently, just one, two, three times, to keep himself nice and clean. He drops the used paper right into the bowl. 

Now it is time for the magic part! Sammy reaches up high with his little hand. He pushes the big, shiny silver handle down. Whoosh! Goes the water, swirling around and around, washing everything far away down the drain. Sammy claps his hands together and jumps up and down. 'Yay! I did it!' he cheers with a huge, proud grin. Mommy claps too and gives him the biggest hug ever. 'Hip, hip, hooray for Sammy!' she cheers. Sammy washes his hands with bubbly, soapy water, feeling so proud of his wonderful potty success.

stories.title: Mia's Morning Routine
stories.text:
Good morning, sunshine! Mia stretches her arms up high toward the ceiling and yawns a big, sleepy yawn. The sun is peeking through her pink bedroom curtains, and today is going to be a fun-filled day of play. But before Mia eats her crunchy morning toast and drinks her yummy apple juice, she has a very special job to do. Her tummy feels full, and she knows just what that means. It is time for her morning bathroom trip! 

Mia hops right out of her cozy bed and skips all the way to the bathroom. She climbs up the little wooden step-stool so she can reach the big toilet safely. She sits down comfortably on the seat. The room is quiet and peaceful. Mia waits patiently for a moment. Plop! Goes her morning poo-poo into the potty. Mia giggles softly because her body feels so much lighter and better now. 

'Time to wipe, flush, and cheer!' Mia sings her favorite little bathroom song out loud. She grabs a nice, soft square of white toilet paper from the roll. Carefully and gently, Mia wipes herself clean, just like a big girl. She drops the paper into the water below. 

Now, it is time for the best part! Mia stands up on her tiptoes and reaches for the big silver handle on the side of the toilet tank. She pushes it down with all her might. Whoosh-sh-sh! The water swirls and gurgles, washing everything away. Mia throws her hands up in the air and shouts, 'Hooray! All done!' Daddy walks past the open door, smiling broadly, and cheers, 'Wonderful job, Mia!' Mia washes her hands at the sink with lots of bubbly soap, ready to start her happy day.

stories.title: Leo's Big Boy Bathroom Adventure
stories.text:
Build, build, build! Leo is busy stacking his yellow blocks to make a super tall tower. He places the very last green triangle right on top. 'Look, Daddy! A castle!' shouts Leo with a happy clap. Just then, Leo’s little puppy dog stuffed animal gives him a friendly squeeze, and Leo giggles. But wait—Leo feels a funny little wiggle deep down inside his tummy. That is a reminder message from his body! 

Daddy looks over from the couch and says, 'Does my big boy need to use the potty?' Leo nods his head. 'Yes, Daddy, right now!' So, Leo leaves his block castle safely on the floor and hurries into the bright bathroom. He doesn't want to waste a single second of playtime, but he knows taking care of his body is super important. 

Leo sits right down on his green froggy potty seat. He takes a deep breath and relaxes. Soon, he hears a splash! 'I did it!' Leo tells his froggy seat with a grin. Now comes the rest of the fun bathroom steps. Leo remembers the rule: Wipe, flush, and cheer! He takes a few sheets of soft toilet paper and gently wipes his bottom. He makes sure he is extra neat and clean before tossing the paper into the bowl. 

'Ready for the big flush!' Leo announces proudly. He stretches his arm out and presses the shiny silver flusher button. Whoosh! The water rushes around in a circle, carrying everything away to dreamland. Leo claps his hands together and dances a silly little victory dance. 'Yay, yay, yay!' he cheers out loud. Daddy steps in and gives him a high-five. 'You are such a big boy, Leo!' Leo washes his hands with foamy soap, smiling from ear to ear.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Sammy was playing with his big yellow truck, zooming it across the soft living room rug. Suddenly, Sammy felt a funny little wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! That was a potty signal! Sammy paused and listened to his body. 'Time to go try the potty, Sammy!' said Mommy with a warm, encouraging smile. Sammy gently parked his yellow truck right on the cozy rug. He stood up tall and walked all the way to the bathroom, step by happy step. Up he climbed onto his special little green potty seat. He sat down comfortably and waited patiently. A few moments later, he finished his important business! Sammy felt so much lighter and very proud. Next came a very important part of the bathroom routine. Sammy pulled off a soft piece of toilet paper. He wiped himself gently, just like a big boy. Then, he dropped the paper right into the bowl. Standing up safely, Sammy turned around to face the big white toilet. He reached out and pushed the shiny silver handle down. Whoosh! The water swirled round and round, taking everything far away. Sammy clapped his hands together with pure joy. 'Yay, Sammy! You did it!' cheered Mommy, giving him a big, loving hug. Sammy beamed from ear to ear. Washing his hands with bubbly soap finished the wonderful adventure. He was clean, fresh, and ready to play with his truck again.

stories.title: Daisy's Big Girl Steps
stories.text: Daisy was building a tall tower out of colorful wooden blocks. Suddenly, she stopped building and wiggled her toes. Her body gave her a little reminder. It was time to visit the bathroom! Daisy gently set her blocks down in a safe pile. She hopped up from the floor and skipped happily down the hallway. In she went, ready for action. Daisy climbed up onto her favorite pink potty chair. She took a deep breath and relaxed. In just a few seconds, she was all finished. Now it was time for the best steps of all. Daisy reached for the toilet paper roll. She pulled off a few squares and tore them carefully. She wiped gently, making sure she was super clean. Then, she tossed the paper inside the bowl. Daisy stood up and looked down at the friendly white toilet. She reached up high and pushed the big flush button. Swoosh! The water rushed around and washed everything away in a fun splash of bubbles. Daisy jumped up and down and cheered, 'Hip, hip, hooray!' Daddy clapped from the doorway and said, 'Wonderful job, Daisy! You are growing up so smart and capable.' Daisy felt so proud inside her heart. She washed her hands with foamy strawberry soap, drying them on a fluffy towel. She was ready to finish her block tower.

stories.title: Leo's Bathroom Adventure
stories.text: Leo the little dinosaur was painting a picture of a blue sky with green crayons. All at once, Leo felt a familiar tickle. His tummy was telling him it was potty time! Leo carefully put his green crayon down inside the box. He scampered across the bedroom floor on his tippy-toes. He opened the bathroom door and hopped right up onto his sturdy blue potty seat. He sat very still and waited patiently. Soon, the mission was complete! Leo smiled because he listened to his body so well. Next came the three special steps. First, Leo grabbed a soft piece of toilet paper and wiped himself carefully. He dropped the paper into the bowl. Second, Leo stood up proudly and reached for the big chrome handle. He pushed it down with all his might. Whoosh-sh-sh! The water rushed in a happy circle to clean the bowl. Third, Leo threw his arms up in the air and shouted, 'Yay for me!' Grandma walked in with a warm smile and cheered, 'Hip, hip, hooray for Leo!' She gave him a high-five. Leo felt like a superhero. He washed his hands thoroughly with warm water and sweet-smelling soap. His hands were sparkling clean. With a happy skip in his step, Leo went right back to finish his lovely dinosaur picture.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Sammy the little bear was playing with his wooden blocks. Suddenly, he felt a funny little wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! That was his body's special signal. Sammy put his red block down very carefully. 'Time to go potty!' he said with a big smile. He marched right into the warm bathroom, feeling so brave and tall. Up he climbed onto his little blue potty seat. He sat down and waited patiently, singing his favorite song about happy little frogs. Splash went the potty, and Sammy clapped his hands together with joy. 'Yay, Sammy!' he cheered. Next came a very important job. Sammy reached for the soft, white toilet paper. One square, two squares, just enough to feel nice and clean. He gently wiped himself, just like the big kids do. Then, he stood up and looked down into the bowl. 'Bye-bye, little pee-pee,' Sammy whispered happily. He pressed the big shiny flush handle. WHOOSH! Down it went in a happy swirl of water. Sammy washed his hands with bubbly blue soap, scrubbing between his fingers and singing the ABCs. Bubbles, bubbles everywhere! He dried his hands on his soft duck towel. Sammy looked in the mirror and gave himself a high-five. What a wonderful helper he was today. Mommy walked in and gave him a giant bear hug. 'I am so proud of you, Sammy!' she said. Sammy beamed with pride. He felt so fresh, so clean, and so very happy. Potty time was such a breeze when you know just what to do. With a skip in his step, Sammy went back to his blocks, ready for more fun, knowing his body was growing stronger every single day.

stories.title: Bella's Big Girl Routine
stories.text: Bella the bunny was having a wonderful tea party with her fluffy stuffed animals. Suddenly, her tummy gave a little wiggle-wobble. Bella paused and touched her tummy. 'Excuse me, teddy, nature is calling!' she whispered politely. Bella hopped up from her tiny chair and scurried into the bathroom. She climbed right up onto the big toilet using her sturdy step-stool. She sat safely and comfortably, waiting for her body to do its wonderful work. After a few quiet moments, she was all finished. Now it was time for the best steps of all. Bella reached over and pulled off a few squares of soft toilet paper. She patted herself gently until she was nice and dry. 'Good job, Bella,' she whispered to herself with a gentle smile. She dropped the paper into the bowl, ready for the magic moment. Bella stood up on tippy-toes and stretched her long bunny arms. She pressed the silver flush button down firmly. WHOOSH went the water, swirling everything away in a clean, rushing circle. Bella waved bye-bye to the bowl. Next, she hopped over to the sink to wash away the germs. She turned on the warm water and pumped some strawberry soap. Rub-a-dub-dub, she made lots of soapy pink bubbles on her paws. She rinsed them clean under the gentle stream. Then came the fluffy towel to dry her furry hands until they were cozy. Bella looked at her reflection and gave a proud little hop. 'I wiped, I flushed, and I cheered!' she said out loud. Daddy popped his head in and smiled warmly. 'You did it all by yourself, Bella!' She felt like the biggest bunny in the whole wide world. Back to the tea party she went, feeling proud, fresh, and ready for her next adventure.

stories.title: Leo's Bathroom Adventure
stories.text: Leo the little puppy was painting a picture of a blue dog when his tail started wagging for a different reason. His tummy gave a gentle nudge. 'Yip-yip! Potty time!' barked Leo in his cheerful voice. He washed the blue paint off his paws and trotted as fast as his little legs could carry him into the bathroom. Up he hopped onto his shiny white training seat. Leo sat down and took a deep breath, relaxing just like his big brother taught him. Soon, his tummy felt all light and happy again. 'Time to clean up!' Leo said with excitement. He pulled off some soft toilet paper, careful to use just the right amount. He wiped himself nice and dry, making sure he felt super clean. Then, he dropped the paper right into the bowl. Leo stood up tall and looked at the water. It was time for the mighty flush! He reached up, grabbed the handle with both hands, and pushed down with all his might. WHOOSH! The water swirled around and washed everything away in a fun, rushing sound. Leo giggled and clapped his paws together. 'Hip, hip, hooray!' he cheered loudly. But Leo knew he wasn't quite done yet. Germs wash away, so it's time to play with soap! He squeezed green apple soap onto his paws and rubbed them together to make a mountain of fluffy bubbles. He rinsed them under the warm tap and shook his hands dry. Finally, he wiped them on his green frog towel. Grandma walked in and clapped for him. 'Such a big, responsible puppy!' she praised. Leo grinned from ear to ear. Wiping, flushing, and cheering made him feel like a superhero of the bathroom!

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Ring, ring! Goes the big Ben toy in Sammy's room. Sammy the little bunny is busy playing with his yellow blocks. Suddenly, Sammy stops. He feels a funny wiggle in his tummy. Uh oh! It is time to use the potty! Sammy drops his blocks with a gentle plop. No time to wait, let's hurry, not too late! Sammy does a little bunny hop all the way to the warm bathroom. Up, up, up goes Sammy onto the big, comfy potty seat. He sits very still and takes a big, deep breath. In like a flower, out like a candle. Whew! What a good helper. Sammy waits patiently, singing his favorite song about tiny stars. Soon, he feels all done. Now, it is time for three very important steps! Step one: reach for the soft toilet paper. Sammy pulls gently, crinkle-crinkle-crinkle, just enough to wipe nice and clean. Swipe, wipe, and all fresh! Step two: stand up tall and look down into the bowl. Bye-bye, little puddle! Sammy steps to the side and pushes the big, shiny silver handle down. Woosh! Hear the happy water go round and round. Good-bye, tummy treasures! Step three: the most fun of all. Sammy claps his paws together and gives a big, proud cheer! Yay, Sammy! You did it! Mommy opens the door and gives him a big warm hug. Sammy beams with a proud little smile. Now, it is time to wash those paws with bubbly soap. Squirt goes the soap, bubble, bubble, pop! Sammy rinses them clean under the warm water and dries them on his ducky towel. What a wonderful helper Sammy is today. He is growing so big and smart. Back to the blocks he goes, feeling happy, dry, and clean, ready for more fun play.

stories.title: Daisy Duck's Bathroom Adventure
stories.text: Quack, quack! Says Daisy Duck as she paints a pretty picture with pink paint. Suddenly, Daisy stops painting. Her tummy gives a little rumble-tumble. Oh my goodness, it is time to visit the bathroom! Daisy puts her paintbrush safely down in the cup. She waddles as fast as her little webbed feet can carry her, waddle-waddle-waddle, right into the bright bathroom. Up she climbs onto the special toddler potty seat. Daisy sits down and wiggle-wiggles until she feels cozy. She takes a deep breath in and a slow breath out. Good job, Daisy! She waits patiently while her tummy finishes its work. When she is all done, it is time for the three magic steps. Step one: reach for the soft white toilet paper. Daisy pulls off a couple of squares. She wipes gently, keeping herself nice and clean. Swipe, wipe, freshness bright! Step two: time for the magic flush. Daisy hops down carefully, looks at the bowl, and pushes the handle with her wing. Whoosh-sh-sh! Watch the water swirl around in a happy dance. Bye-bye, puddle! Step three: the celebration cheer! Daisy throws her wings up high in the air and lets out a happy quack-cheer! Hooray for Daisy! Daddy hears the cheer from the kitchen and comes in with a big smile. High five, little duck! But wait, we are not quite finished yet. Germs, germs, go away! Daisy climbs up on her little blue stool to wash her hands at the sink. Squish, squash, soap makes bubbles. She scrubs between her feathers and washes them clean. Rinse, rinse, all done. Daisy dries her hands on her fluffy flower towel. She feels so fresh, so proud, and so very happy. Time to finish that pink painting!

stories.title: Leo Lion's Big Boy Steps
stories.text: Roar! Goes little Leo Lion, pretending to be a brave jungle king. But wait! Leo feels a little tickle down low. That tickle means it is time to stop playing and visit the potty! Leo does a speedy tiger crawl over to the bathroom door. He stands up on his strong little legs and sits right down on his cool blue potty ring. Leo sits comfortably, relaxing his tummy muscles. He pretends he is a sleeping lion under a shady green tree. Breathe in, breathe out, nice and calm. Soon, Leo is all finished. Now, it is time to remember the three magical rules of the potty! Rule one: wipe, wipe, wipe. Leo reaches over to the toilet paper roll. Rip, tear, fold. He wipes gently to stay fresh and clean. Swipe, wipe, squeaky clean! Rule two: flush the handle. Leo stands up tall like a brave lion king. He reaches up and pushes the big chrome flusher down. Rumble and go! The water rushes around, swirling everything away in a fun water slide. Good-bye, little puddle! Rule three: the big celebration! Leo opens his mouth wide and lets out a happy, joyful cheer. Yay for Leo! Hip, hip, hooray! Grandma walks down the hall, clapping her hands for her sweet little lion. You are growing up so fast, Leo! But remember, every great lion needs clean paws. Leo steps up to the sink. Pump goes the soap dispenser, squirting a cloud of bubbly foam. Scrub the front, scrub the back, between the claws. Rinse it away with warm, cozy water. Leo shakes his hands like a wet puppy and dries them on his striped towel. Shining bright and smelling sweet, Leo is ready to roar his way back to his toys!

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Ring, ring! Goes the big Ben toy in the playroom. Sammy stops playing with his shiny red truck. Uh oh! That little tingly feeling in his tummy means it is time to go. Sammy stands up tall and wiggles his toes. He knows just what to do! He walks all the way to the big bathroom with giant steps like a happy dinosaur. Roar! Up, up, up climbs Sammy onto his special little blue potty seat. He sits down nice and cozy. Waiting is easy when you sing a silly song. Sammy sings about monkeys bouncing on the bed. Plop, plop, go the little drops. Hooray! Sammy did a great job. Now comes the very best part of growing big. Sammy takes a soft piece of toilet paper from the roll. One gentle wipe, two gentle wipes, so clean and fresh! He drops the paper right into the bowl, bye-bye paper! Next, Sammy stands up and turns around to look at his work. Time for the magical magic handle. Sammy reaches up high, grabs the shiny silver lever, and pushes down with all his might. Whoosh! Hear the friendly water swirl and swirl, taking everything away down the pipe. Bye-bye, little puddle! Sammy claps his hands together and lets out a loud, happy cheer. Yay for Sammy! Mommy comes running down the hallway with big, open arms. She gives him the biggest squeeze ever. You are growing up so strong, my sweet boy, she whispers. Sammy smiles a big, toothy grin. He washes his hands with soapy bubbles that smell like sweet strawberries. Rub-a-dub-dub, clean little fingers. Sammy feels so proud. He is ready to go back to his red truck, feeling like a big-kid superstar all day long.

stories.title: Daisy Duck's Bathroom Adventure
stories.text: Quack, quack! Daisy Duck is wearing her favorite yellow shoes today. She is building a tall tower out of wooden blocks in the living room. Suddenly, her tummy gives a little wiggle-wobble wiggle. Oh my goodness! Daisy stops right in her tracks. That is the tummy signal! She gently pats her tummy and says, Time to use the potty, Daisy! She dashes across the rug as fast as her little yellow shoes can carry her. In she goes to the bright yellow bathroom. Up she hops onto the big potty with the comfy training ring. Daisy sits patiently, blinking her bright blue eyes. Look at you go, little duck! After a short little wait, she finishes her business. Yay! Now it is time for the three golden rules of the potty kingdom. Rule number one: the gentle wipe! Daisy pulls off a fluffy square of toilet paper. One wipe, two wipes, pat, pat, pat. All clean! She drops the paper into the potty bowl. Rule number two: the big flush! Daisy stands up on her tiptoes and stretches her feathered arm way up high. She pushes the shiny silver button. Swoosh, gargle, gurgle! The water rushes around in a happy circle, washing everything clean away. Rule number three: the happy cheer! Daisy throws her wings up in the air and peeps, Hip, hip, hooray for me! Daddy pokes his head in the doorway and claps his hands together. Good job, my little duckling! Daisy does a happy little dance right there on the bathroom mat. Next comes handwashing time with warm, bubbly water. She makes a mountain of white bubbles on her hands. High five to Daddy, high five to the mirror! Daisy skips out of the bathroom, feeling very proud, very clean, and ready to build an even taller block tower.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Big-Kid Steps
stories.text: Roar! Little Leo Lion is painting a bright yellow sun on a big piece of paper. He uses lots of blue and orange paint. Suddenly, Leo stops painting. His tummy feels full and heavy. He lets out a little giggle because he knows what that feeling means. It is time for Leo to take a potty break! Leo puts his paintbrush down carefully on the tray. He hops off his little yellow chair and walks on his tippy-toes to the bathroom. He feels very brave, just like a brave lion king. Up he steps onto his green potty throne. He sits down and takes a nice, deep breath. He counts to ten while looking at the pretty pictures on the wall. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! Success! Leo smiles from ear to ear. Now, let us do our special routine, Leo whispers to himself. First, he reaches for the white toilet paper. He takes a nice piece and wipes gently, one, two, three. So fresh and clean! He drops the paper into the bowl. Second, it is time for the magic flush. Leo stands up tall, turns around, and pushes the flush handle down. Whoosh! Listen to the water sing its rushing song as it carries everything away. Bye-bye! Third, the best part of all: the celebration! Leo throws his paws in the air and roars a happy, gentle roar. Hooray, hooray, Leo went potty today! Grandma hears him cheering from the kitchen and comes over with a big smile. You are growing up so fast, my brave little lion, she says, patting his soft orange hair. Leo washes his hands with soapy bubbles that make nice squeaky sounds. He dries them on a fluffy green towel. Leo struts back to his art table feeling like the proudest lion in the whole wide jungle.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, little Sammy was playing with his wooden train choo-choo-chooing across the soft blue rug. Suddenly, Sammy felt a funny little wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! Sammy knew that wiggle. It meant it was time to visit the big potty! Sammy dropped his little red train and waddled as fast as his little legs could carry him into the warm, bright bathroom. Up he climbed onto the potty seat. 'Plop, plop, go!' whispered Sammy with a happy little grin. He sat very still and waited patiently, singing his favorite ABC song. Soon, he was all done.
