He reached his little hand up high to press the big, shiny silver flush button. WHOOSH! went the water, swirling round and round, taking everything far away. Sammy clapped his hands together and jumped up and down. 'Yay! Yay! Hip-hip-hooray! I wiped and flushed today!' he cheered, smiling proudly at the bathroom mirror. Sammy washed his hands with bubbly, soapy water, making lots of giant soap bubbles that tickled his fingers. He dried them on a soft yellow towel. He was such a big boy now. With a happy bounce in his step, Sammy skipped back to his room to finish playing with his choo-choo train, feeling so very proud of his wonderful potty adventure.

stories.title: Daisy Bear's Big Girl Steps
stories.text: Daisy Bear was wearing her favorite polka-dot panties today because she was practicing being a very big girl. She was busy stacking her colourful plastic blocks into a tall, wobbly tower when her tummy gave a gentle rumble. 'Time to go!' said Mama Bear with a warm, encouraging smile. Daisy nodded her furry head and marched right into the cozy little bathroom. She climbed up the little blue step stool and sat right down on the potty seat. 'Take your time, sweet little bear,' hummed Mama softly. Daisy took a deep breath and relaxed. Just like that, she finished her business! 'All done!' squeaked Daisy happily. But wait, a big girl's job isn't finished yet. Daisy remembered the special rule: Wipe, flush, and cheer! She reached over and pulled two squares of soft white paper. Dab, dab, wipe! She made sure she was nice and dry. Then, Daisy stepped down safely and turned around to face the magical flushing throne. She stretched out her paw and pushed the handle down. WHOOSH! went the happy water, swirling away like a giant bathtub whirlpool. Daisy threw her paws up in the air and spun around in a circle. 'Yay for me! I wiped and flushed!' she cheered out loud, her little bear ears wiggling with pure joy. Mama Bear clapped her paws and gave Daisy a big, warm hug. 'I am so proud of you, my clever little bear!' After washing her paws with sweet-smelling strawberry soap, Daisy skipped back to her blocks. Her tower was waiting for her, and she felt ready to take on the rest of the wonderful day.

stories.title: Leo's Bathroom Mission
stories.text: Leo the little lion cub was painting a bright yellow sun on a big piece of paper when he felt a sudden wiggle in his tail. He put his yellow paintbrush down very gently on the table. 'My tummy says it is potty time!' roared Leo in his softest, happiest lion voice. He trotted on all fours right into the bathroom. Up he hopped onto the friendly little froggy potty seat. He sat very comfortably, swinging his feet and humming a happy jungle tune. Within a few moments, Leo was completely finished. 'Good job, Leo!' he told himself. Now it was time for the best part of the whole bathroom mission. Leo grabbed some soft tissue. Wipe, wipe, wipe! He cleaned up carefully so his tummy-tush felt as soft as a cloud. Then, Leo stood up on his tiptoes to peek into the bowl. 'Time to make the water dance!' whispered Leo with a mischievous, happy grin. He reached up and pressed the shiny handle. WHOOSH! The rushing water spun around in a big, bubbly circle, washing everything clean away. Leo stood right up tall, threw his hands in the air, and let out his best happy cheer. 'Roar, roar, hooray! I wiped and I flushed today!' he shouted with a huge beam on his face. He washed his hands thoroughly with bubbly soap, rubbing his paws together until they smelled like fresh lemons. He dried them on a fluffy green towel. Leo strutted back to his art desk like the king of the jungle, feeling completely wonderful, clean, and ready to finish painting his masterpiece.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Ring a ring o' roses, Sammy is playing with his big yellow blocks. Suddenly, Sammy stops. He feels a little wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! It is time to use the potty! Sammy smiles because he is a big boy now. He puts his blocks down gently on the soft rug. 'Bye-bye, blocks! I will see you soon!' whispers Sammy. He walks over to the bathroom, step by step, feeling very proud. Mommy helps Sammy pull down his cozy blue pants. Up, up, up he climbs onto his special potty seat. Sammy sits down and relaxes. He takes a big, deep breath in, and lets it out like a gentle wind. Blow, Sammy, blow! Soon, he hears a wonderful plop in the bowl. Yay, Sammy! You did it! Mommy claps her hands, and Sammy beams with joy. Now comes the very best part of the potty adventure. Sammy stands up carefully. He looks down into the bowl and gives a happy wave. 'Bye-bye, potty bubbles!' he giggles. Next, Sammy pulls off a piece of soft white toilet paper. One, two, gentle wipes! He drops the paper right into the bowl. Flush! Sammy reaches up high to push the big shiny silver handle. Whoosh goes the water, spinning everything around and down! Sammy loves watching the water swirl. Finally, it is time for the final celebration. Sammy dances a happy potty dance, shaking his little hips. 'Wipe, flush, and cheer!' sings Mommy. Sammy claps his hands together and shouts, 'Hooray for me!' Washing his hands with bubbly blue soap makes his skin feel super fresh and clean. What a wonderful potty day!

stories.title: Bella Bear Goes Potty
stories.text: Bella Bear is painting a picture of a bright orange sun with her chunky red crayon. Scratch, scratch, go the lines on the big white paper. Suddenly, Bella stops and wiggles her nose. Her tummy is giving her a gentle tickle signal. That tickle means it is time to visit the bathroom! Bella puts her red crayon safely back in the box. 'Time for a potty break, little crayon,' she says warmly. She hops off her little wooden chair and walks tippppy-toe to the bathroom. Daddy is right there to cheer her on. 'You can do it, Bella Bear!' he says with a big smile. Bella climbs up the little steps to her comfy pink potty seat. She sits down softly and feels safe and cozy. Bella relaxes her tummy and waits patiently. Ah, there it goes! Splash goes the magic inside the bowl. Bella giggles because it tickles. 'Good job, sweet bear!' says Daddy, giving her a gentle high-five. Now, it is time for the clean-up crew! Bella reaches for the soft toilet paper roll. She pulls off two squares of fluffy paper. Swipe, swipe, wipe! She drops the paper right down into the water. Time to make it disappear! Bella stands up tall and stretches her arm way up high. She presses the big shiny button. Whoosh! The water rushes around and takes everything away. Bye-bye, little puddle! Bella waves goodbye with a huge grin on her face. 'Wipe, flush, and cheer!' chants Bella and Daddy together. Bella raises her paws in the air and lets out a loud, happy cheer. 'Yay, Bella Bear!' Then, it is time to wash her paws with bubbly strawberry soap. Rub-a-dub-dub, clean little bear hands! Bella is ready to go back to her painting.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Big Kid Routine
stories.text: Roar! Little Leo Lion is building a tall tower out of green blocks. Crash! The blocks tumble down, and Leo laughs out loud. Suddenly, Leo feels a little jump in his tummy. He stops playing right away. A potty sign! Leo knows just what to do. He stands up on his strong lion legs. 'Hold on, green tower, I will be right back!' he tells his toys. Leo walks down the hallway like a brave little lion, marching step by step. When he reaches the bathroom, he sees his friendly yellow potty waiting for him. Leo pulls down his shorts with the cute little monkey pictures. Up he climbs, settling right in. He takes a nice, deep breath and relaxes. Soon, he hears a happy plop. Leo smiles brightly. 'Great job, Leo!' whispers his big brother. Now comes the super fun finish-up routine! Leo reaches over and grabs some soft toilet paper. He folds it nicely. Wipe, wipe, wipe! He drops the paper into the bowl, watching it land softly. Time for the big magic trick! Leo stands up and stretches his arm to reach the flush handle. He pushes it down firmly. WHOOSH! The water rushes round and round, singing a happy bathroom song as it cleans the bowl. Leo claps his paws together and cheers loudly. 'Hip, hip, hooray! Wipe, flush, and cheer!' he shouts with joy. His brother joins in, making a funny cheering sound. Next, Leo steps up to the sink. He pumps a squirt of foamy green soap. Scrub, scrub, between his fingers, wash the tiny lion paws until they smell like fresh mint. Leo dries his hands on a fluffy towel and looks in the mirror at his smiling face. What a fantastic potty adventure!

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Sammy was playing with his big yellow truck, vrooming it across the soft rug. Suddenly, Sammy felt a little tickle in his tummy. Uh oh! That tickle meant his body was ready to use the potty. Sammy stood up gently and whispered to his truck, 'Hold on, little truck, I will be right back!' With happy steps, Sammy hurried to the bathroom. He pulled down his soft dinosaur pants and sat right down on the potty seat. 'Ahhh, that is so comfortable,' Sammy giggled. While he waited, Sammy sang his favorite counting song. One, two, three, four, five! Splash went the little tinkle into the bowl. Sammy clapped his hands together and shouted, 'Yay! I did it!' Next came the very important next step. Sammy reached out and pulled off two soft squares of toilet paper from the big roll. He wiped gently, just like Mommy taught him, to keep his bottom clean and dry. Then, Sammy dropped the paper right into the potty bowl. It was time for the magic part! Sammy stood up and looked down at his big achievement. He reached his hand up high to press the shiny silver flusher handle. WHOOSH! The water swirled around in a big, happy circle, taking everything away to go on a special water adventure. 'Bye-bye, potty bubbles!' Sammy cheered, waving his hand. Finally, Sammy walked over to the little sink. He stepped up on his sturdy blue stool and turned on the warm water. Squirt went the foamy soap onto his hands. Sammy rubbed his palms together, making lots of bubbly white mountains. He washed the front, he washed the back, and in between his fingers, too. He rinsed all the bubbles away with the warm water and dried his hands on his soft kitty-cat towel. Sammy looked in the mirror and gave himself a big, proud smile. He felt so fresh, so clean, and so very proud. Sammy walked back to his living room, picked up his big yellow truck, and whispered, 'Guess what? I am a big kid now!'

stories.title: Mia's Big Girl Mission
stories.text: Mia was building a tall tower out of colorful blocks. Red, blue, green, and yellow! Suddenly, Mia stopped building. Her tummy gave a little wiggle. That was the special signal that her body needed to visit the bathroom. Mia smiled a big, bright smile because she knew just what to do. She patted her block tower and said, 'Stay right there, little tower!' Mia tiptoed into the bathroom, feeling very brave and capable. She lifted the seat lid and hopped right up onto her pink potty ring. 'Time to do my big girl business,' Mia whispered to herself. She took a deep, relaxing breath and waited patiently. Soon, everything was done just right. 'Hooray for Mia!' she cheered softly. Now it was time to finish the job like a superstar. Mia reached over and pulled off a gentle piece of toilet paper. She patted herself clean with care and dropped the paper into the bowl. Then came the most exciting part of all. Mia stood up tall, stretched her arm up high, and pressed the shiny silver flush button. WHOOSH! The water rushed around and around, cleaning the potty completely. 'Whoosh, goodbye!' Mia laughed, clapping her hands together. The bathroom smelled fresh and clean. But Mia was not quite finished yet. She stepped over to the sink, turned on the warm water, and pumped a big squirt of strawberry soap onto her palms. Rub-a-dub-dub, she scrubbed her hands until they were covered in fluffy pink suds. She washed every single finger and rinsed everything clean under the running water. Mia dried her hands on her fluffy bunny towel, feeling extra proud. She walked back into her playroom, picked up her red block, and placed it right on top of her tower. Her tower stayed tall, and Mia stayed clean and happy all day long.

stories.title: Leo's Bathroom Adventure
stories.text: Leo was painting a picture of a blue dinosaur with green polka dots. Dip, dab, paint went his brush! All of a sudden, Leo felt a funny little rumble in his tummy. His body was giving him a friendly reminder. Leo laid his paintbrush down carefully on the paper. 'Be right back, Mr. Dinosaur!' Leo said with a giggle. He walked as fast as his little legs could carry him straight to the bathroom. He climbed up onto his green training potty and got comfy. 'Time for a potty break!' Leo said happily. He relaxed his shoulders and waited for a minute. Splash went his little tinkle into the bowl. Leo smiled from ear to ear because he listened to his body so well. Next came the three special steps to finish up. First, Leo grabbed some soft white toilet paper. He wiped his bottom gently until it felt all clean and dry, just like Mommy showed him. He dropped the paper into the water. Second, Leo stood up and reached for the big silver flusher. He pushed it down with all his might. WHOOSH! The water swooshed and swirled, carrying everything away in a fun, watery spin. 'Bye-bye!' Leo cheered, clapping loudly. Third, Leo needed to wash his hands to make sure all the germs went away. He stood on his star-shaped stool at the sink and turned on the warm water. He added a big pump of blue soap that smelled like fresh rain. Leo rubbed his hands together, making lots of slippery, soapy bubbles. He washed the backs of his hands, his palms, and his thumbs. Then he rinsed all the soap away with the warm water. Leo dried his hands on his puppy dog towel, shaking his hands to make sure they were super dry. He looked at his sparkling clean hands and felt so proud of himself. Leo skipped happily back to his art table, ready to paint more green polka dots on his dinosaur.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Ring! Ring! Goes Sammy's tummy! That is a very special message telling Sammy it is time to go to the potty. Sammy is playing with his big yellow dump truck, but he knows just what to do. 'Bye-bye, truck! I will be right back!' says Sammy with a big, happy smile. He walks right over to the bathroom. Up, up, up climbs Sammy onto his cozy little potty seat. He sits down nice and comfortably. While he waits, Sammy takes a deep breath in through his nose like he is smelling a sweet flower, and blows out through his mouth like he is blowing out a birthday candle. Whew! That helps his tummy relax. Soon, he hears a wonderful splash! 'Yay, Sammy!' cheers his big green frog friend sitting on the shelf. Sammy did it! He used the potty just like a big boy. Now comes the very important next step in the potty routine: 'Wipe, flush, and cheer!' First, Sammy reaches for the soft toilet paper. He pulls off a few squares—one, two, three—and gently wipes himself to stay nice and clean. Down into the potty goes the paper. Next comes the best part! Sammy stands up and turns around. He pushes the big, shiny silver handle down. Whoosh! Goes the water, swirling round and round, taking everything away on a wonderful water adventure. 'Bye-bye, potty!' giggles Sammy. Finally, it is time for the big cheer! Sammy raises his hands high up into the air and does a happy wiggle dance. 'Hooray for me! Hip, hip, hooray!' He feels so proud, fresh, and clean. Mummy comes running in with a huge hug and high-fives. 'I wiped, I flushed, and I cheered, Mummy!' Sammy says proudly. Now, Sammy is ready to go right back to his toys, feeling like a total superstar. Washing his hands with bubbly soap is the final touch before his next big adventure begins.

stories.title: Bella Bunny's Big Bathroom Routine
stories.text: Hop, hop, hop goes Bella Bunny! Bella is wearing her favorite polka-dot dress and painting a picture of a rainbow. Suddenly, her tummy gives a little wiggle. 'Uh-oh!' says Bella, putting down her paintbrush. 'I feel a potty signal!' Bella does not wait. She drops her brush gently and hops as fast as her little bunny feet can carry her straight into the bright, cheerful bathroom. Up onto her special pink potty seat she climbs. She wiggles her bottom to get cozy and comfortable. Bella likes to sing a little song while she waits for her body to do its important work. 'Potty time, potty time, sitting on my seat so fine!' she sings softly. Splash! Goes the sound in the bowl. 'Yay, Bella!' chirps the little yellow duck sitting near the sink. Bella is so proud of her body! Now, it is time to remember the golden rule of the bathroom: 'Wipe, flush, and cheer!' Bella reaches over and gently pulls two soft squares of toilet paper. Carefully and gently, she dabs herself so she feels fresh and dry. Into the bowl goes the paper, right where it belongs. Now it is time to make the water spin! Bella stands up on her tiptoes, reaches for the big flush button, and pushes it down with a firm press. Whoosh-sh-sh! The water swirls in a happy circle, washing everything away. 'Goodbye, little mess!' whispers Bella. And now, the absolute best part: the celebration! Bella stretches her arms up wide, touches the sky, and does a joyful bunny hop right there in the bathroom. 'Hooray, hooray, I did it today!' she cheers out loud. Her big sister walks by and claps her hands. 'Great job wiping, flushing, and cheering, Bella!' Bella beams with joy. She washes her soapy hands until they smell like strawberries and skips back to her rainbow painting with a happy, confident heart.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Big Kid Steps
stories.text: Roar! Well, not a loud roar, just a little whisper roar because Leo Lion is busy building a tall tower out of colorful wooden blocks. Suddenly, Leo stops. He feels a little tickle in his tummy that says it is time to visit the bathroom! Leo stands up tall and shakes his mane. 'Time for a potty break!' he says bravely. He walks steadily down the hallway, marching like a brave little lion. He reaches the bathroom and sits right down on his sturdy blue potty chair. Leo takes a deep breath and relaxes his shoulders. He knows his body knows just what to do. A few moments later, he hears a splash! 'Great job, Leo!' says his friendly blue bathtub toy. Leo smiles a big, toothy lion smile. He did it all by himself! Now, it is time for the most important steps of all: 'Wipe, flush, and cheer!' Leo reaches for the toilet paper roll. He carefully pulls off just enough paper—riippp! He uses it gently to wipe himself nice and clean. Down into the water goes the paper. Next, Leo stands up nice and tall. He stretches his arm out, grabs the shiny flush handle, and gives it a strong push down. Whoosh! The water rushes around in a circle, swirling and swirling until everything is clean and gone. 'Whoosh, go away!' laughs Leo. Now it is time for Leo's favorite part of the whole routine. He puffs out his chest, puts his paws in the air, and lets out a happy, joyful cheer! 'Roar-hooray! I flushed the potty today!' Daddy walks in and gives him a big high-five. 'I wiped, I flushed, and I cheered, Daddy!' Leo announces happily. He washes his hands with bubbly soap, rubs them together until they make squeaky sounds, and heads back to his blocks, feeling like the king of the jungle.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Ring, ring! Goes the big Ben toy in Sammy's room. Sammy stops playing with his shiny red blocks. Uh-oh! Does Sammy feel a little wiggle in his tummy? Yes, he does! Sammy knows right away that it is time to go to the bathroom. He does a happy little waddle all the way down the hallway, stepping lightly on his little tippy-toes. Mommy is right there to help him climb up onto the big, friendly potty seat. Up, up, up goes Sammy! He sits down comfortably and takes a nice, deep breath. He waits patiently, just like a little frog sitting on a green lily pad. Splash, splash, goes the little tinkle in the bowl! 'Yay, Sammy!' cheers Mommy, clapping her hands together with a big, warm smile. Sammy giggles with joy because doing a great job feels so wonderful. Next comes a very important helper step. Sammy reaches out his little hand and gently pulls some soft toilet paper from the roll. One, two squares are just enough! He wipes himself nice and dry, feeling so independent and big. Then, Sammy stands up tall and turns around to look inside the bowl. It is time to say goodbye to his tinkle! He pushes the big, shiny silver handle down. Whoosh! The water swirls around in a happy circle, carrying everything far, far away. 'Bye-bye, tinkle!' says Sammy, waving goodbye with his little hand. Finally, Sammy walks over to the sink to wash his hands with bubbly soap. He rubs his hands together, making lots of fluffy white bubbles that look like puffy clouds. He rinses them under the warm water and dries them on a soft, blue towel. Sammy is all done, feeling clean, proud, and ready to go back to his fun blocks. He is growing up to be such a big boy!

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Bathroom Star
stories.text: Mia is busy feeding her favorite teddy bear some imaginary honey with a little yellow spoon. Suddenly, Mia stops and puts her hand right on her tummy. Her tummy is giving her a gentle little nudge! 'Teddy, I need to use the potty right now,' Mia whispers softly. She gently sets her teddy bear down on the cozy rug. Mia walks quickly and safely to the bathroom, her little pink slippers going patter-patter on the floor. She opens the door and climbs up onto her special purple potty chair all by herself. 'Good job, Mia!' she tells herself with a proud little nod. She sits very still, listening to the quiet sounds of the house. Soon, she hears a little plop! Mia did it! She used the potty just like a big girl. She feels so happy inside, like a bright sunshine is warming up her heart. Now it is time to finish the special potty steps. Mia reaches for the gentle toilet paper. She takes a piece and wipes herself carefully, making sure she is nice and clean. Then, she stands up safely and looks down into the bowl. It is time for the magic flush! She presses the big handle down with her little palm. Whoosh! The water rushes around in a fun, noisy spin, taking the potty contents away. 'Great job, flushing!' says Daddy, walking by with a proud thumbs-up. Mia beams from ear to ear. But wait, we are not quite finished yet! Germs do not like clean hands, so Mia marches right over to the bathroom sink. She turns on the warm water and pumps a dollop of bubbly pink soap onto her palms. Rub-a-dub-dub, she scrubs the tops of her hands, her fingers, and her wrists. The bubbles tickle her skin, making her laugh out loud. She rinses all the soap away with clean water and wipes her hands on a fluffy bunny towel. Mia looks in the mirror and sees a bright, shining star of a girl.

stories.title: Leo's Big Boy Bathroom Adventure
stories.text: Leo is zooming his favorite green race car across the living room rug. Vroom, vroom, vroom! But wait. Leo pauses. His tummy feels a little heavy, and he knows that warm feeling. It is time for a potty break! Leo gently parks his race car in the parking spot he made out of blocks. He stands up and walks to the bathroom like a brave little explorer. Daddy is waiting with a big, encouraging smile. 'Are you ready, Leo?' Daddy asks. 'Yes, Daddy!' Leo replies with a nod. He hops up onto the big toilet with the special little toddler seat on top. He sits down safely and gets comfy. Leo relaxes and takes his time. After a little moment, success! Leo made a tinkle in the potty. 'Hooraaaay!' cheers Daddy, clapping his hands together loudly. Leo smiles a big, proud smile that shows all of his teeth. Next comes the most helpful part of the potty adventure. Leo reaches over and pulls off some soft, gentle toilet paper. He carefully wipes himself, making sure he is clean and fresh. Then, Leo stands up and turns around to look at the toilet bowl. It is time to make the water spin! Leo reaches up and pushes the shiny silver handle down with all his might. Whoosh-sh-sh! The water swirls around in a big, happy whirlpool, washing everything away. Leo waves goodbye to the flush. 'See you later!' he says. But an explorer's job is not done yet. Leo steps over to the sink to wash away all the invisible little germs. He pumps some foamy soap onto his hands. It feels soft and squishy like a cloud. Leo rubs his hands together, singing his favorite little hand-washing song. He rinses them clean under the gentle stream of warm water and dries them on a bright green dinosaur towel. Leo feels so wonderful, clean, and accomplished. He is ready to zoom his race car again!

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Ring a ling! Sammy hears a little tummy rumble. Uh oh! It is time to pause playing with the shiny red firetruck. Sammy walks right over to the cozy little potty chair. Up goes the lid, and down sits Sammy for a lovely potty break. Squeak, squish, wiggle! Sammy waits patiently and gently tries. Hooray! A wonderful tinkle goes plip, plop into the bowl. Potty time is a super job! Now comes the very next important step. Sammy stands up tall and looks down at the big white potty. Time to grab the soft toilet paper! Sammy pulls off a few squares—one, two, three—just enough. With a gentle wipe from front to back, Sammy feels wonderfully clean and fresh. All done! Next, it is time to say goodbye to the potty. Sammy drops the paper right into the bowl. Now for the most exciting part of all! Sammy reaches up high, high, high to find the shiny handle. Push! Whoosh! Down swirls the water, taking everything away on a grand adventure. Bye-bye, potty! Sammy watches the spinning water with big, happy eyes. To celebrate this wonderful success, Sammy gives a big, cheerful cheer and claps tiny hands together. Yay, Sammy! You did it! Washing little hands with bubbly soap comes next. Splash, splash, scrub! Sammy smiles in the mirror, feeling so proud and grown-up.

stories.title: Daisy Dinosaur's Big Girl Routine
stories.text: Stomp, stomp, stomp! Daisy Dinosaur is having so much fun building a tall block tower. Suddenly, Daisy stops and wiggles. Her tummy tells her it is time to use the big bathroom. No need to worry, little dinosaur! Daisy walks gently over to the potty. Down sits Daisy, nice and comfy. While waiting, Daisy sings a sweet little dinosaur song. La la la! Splish, splash, plop! Good job, Daisy! The potty is so happy. Next comes the important bathroom routine. Daisy reaches for the soft toilet paper roll. Rip, pull, tear! Just a few soft squares are all she needs. With a careful little wipe, Daisy is clean and comfortable. Time to put the paper into the bowl. Are you ready for the best part? It is magic flush time! Daisy stretches up on her tippy-toes to reach the handle. Push down! Whoosh-sh-sh! Hear the happy water roar as it cleans the bowl and washes everything away. Bye-bye! Daisy claps her green hands together and does a happy little dance. Hooray for Daisy! We wipe, we flush, and we cheer! Now, those little dinosaur hands need some tickly, bubbly soap. Rub-a-dub-dub, rinse and dry. Daisy looks at her clean hands and gives a roaring big smile of pride.

stories.title: Leo Lion's Potty Adventure
stories.text: Roar! Well, not a big roar, just a tiny one because Leo Lion feels a tickle in his tummy. Time to stop chasing the yellow butterfly and visit the friendly bathroom! Leo trots right over to the potty seat. Up sits Leo Lion, ready for action. He takes a deep breath and relaxes. Phew! A wonderful success fills the potty. Good for you, brave little lion! Now, every big lion knows what comes next in the daily routine. It is time to wipe, flush, and cheer! Leo reaches out his paw for the soft, fluffy toilet paper. He pulls off a gentle square. Tap, dab, wipe! Leo feels as fresh as a daisy in the springtime sunshine. He drops the paper right into the water below. Now, are you ready to make some magic happen? Leo stands up and looks at the shiny silver handle. He reaches up with his strong paws and pushes it down with a click. Whoosh! The water swirls round and round like a happy little river, washing everything away. Splendid! Leo throws his paws up in the air and lets out a joyful, happy cheer. Yay, Leo Lion! You did the potty routine all by yourself! To finish up, Leo visits the sink for some slippery, soapy hand-washing fun. Rub the fingers, wash the palms, and rinse clean. Leo Lion is ready to play again!

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Adventure
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Sammy was playing with his favorite yellow blocks. Suddenly, he felt a funny little wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! That wiggle meant it was time to visit the big bathroom! Sammy dropped his blocks with a gentle clatter and whispered, "Bye-bye blocks, I'll be right back!" Mommy held his hand as they walked down the hallway together. Up, up, up went Sammy onto the little potty seat. He sat very still and listened to the quiet sounds of the house. Soon, he heard a soft splash. Hooray! Sammy did it! Mommy clapped her hands and cheered, "Good job, Sammy! You listened to your body!" Now comes the very best part of the potty routine. Sammy stood up safely and looked down into the bowl. "Time to wipe, flush, and cheer!" said Mommy with a big, happy smile. Sammy reached for the soft, fluffy toilet paper. One gentle wipe, two gentle wipes, and all done! He dropped the paper into the bowl. Next, Sammy stood on his tiptoes to reach the big silver handle. He pushed it down with all his might. Whoosh! The water swirled around in a fun, dizzy circle, taking everything away. Bye-bye, little puddle! Sammy threw his hands up in the air and cheered loudly, "Hip, hip, hooray!" He felt so proud, so clean, and so happy. Washing his hands with bubbly blue soap made the adventure even better. Splish, splash, soap bubbles dancing on his fingers! Sammy dried his hands on a warm towel and gave Mommy a big hug. It was time to go back to his yellow blocks, feeling like a big boy.

stories.title: Leo's Big Boy Helper
stories.text: Leo the little lion was busy painting a masterpiece. Red paint, blue paint, and lots of yellow paint swirled across his big paper. Suddenly, Leo stopped painting. His tummy gave a little rumble. Time to pause the painting and visit the potty! Daddy walked with Leo to the bathroom, singing a happy little marching song. March, march, march to the potty! Leo hopped up onto his comfy seat. He took a deep breath and relaxed. A few moments later, success! Leo smiled brightly. "I used the potty, Daddy!" Daddy gave him a warm, proud high-five. "That is wonderful, Leo! Let's finish our steps." Leo knew just what to do. The rule in his house was always the same: wipe, flush, and cheer! First, Leo grabbed two squares of soft toilet paper. He carefully dabbed himself until he was nice and dry. Thump went the paper into the bowl. Next came the exciting part. Leo reached out and grabbed the shiny silver handle. He pushed it down. Whoosh went the water! It made a friendly rushing sound as it cleaned the bowl completely. Leo clapped his paws together and shouted with glee, "Yay! All gone!" That was his cue to cheer for himself. He jumped up and down three whole times, giggling all the while. Walking over to the sink, Leo turned on the warm water. He pumped the foamy green soap and rubbed his hands together until he made giant soap bubbles. Sing a little song while washing away the germs! Rinse, rinse, rinse, and dry. Leo looked in the mirror at his clean face and sparkling paws. He was growing up so fast, ready to return to his wonderful painting.

stories.title: Mia's Happy Bathroom Routine
stories.text: Mia the little bunny was hopping around her bedroom, playing with her fuzzy teddy bear. Suddenly, Mia stopped hopping. Her tummy felt heavy, and she knew just what her body was telling her. "Teddy, we need to go to the potty!" she whispered. Mia hurried as fast as her little bunny feet could carry her into the bright, cheerful bathroom. Up she climbed onto her pink potty chair. She sat down comfortably and waited patiently, singing her favorite alphabet song in her head. A, B, C, D... pop! Mia finished doing her business. She felt so much lighter! Daddy walked in with a warm smile and cheered, "Way to go, Mia! You are such a big girl!" Now it was time for Mia's favorite part of the bathroom adventure. She remembered the special magic words: wipe, flush, and cheer! Mia reached over and pulled off a piece of soft, white toilet paper. She patted herself gently, making sure she was nice and clean. Down went the paper into the bowl, plop! Then, Mia stood up tall. She reached for the big silver button on the wall. With a joyful push, she made it go click. Whoosh! The water rushed around in a fun, bubbly whirlpool, washing everything away. Mia threw her little paws into the air and squealed with delight, "Hip, hip, hooray! I did it!" Cheering for herself made her feel like a superstar. After finishing up, Mia went to the sink to wash her hands. She scrubbed with strawberry soap, making sweet-smelling bubbles that tickled her nose. She rinsed them away with warm water and dried her hands on her bunny towel. Mia smiled brightly at herself in the mirror, ready to hop back to her teddy bear.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Sammy the little bear was playing with his favorite wooden blocks. Suddenly, he stopped. He felt a funny tickle in his tummy. Sammy knew right away what that tickle meant! It was time to use the big-kid potty. 'Uh-oh, playtime pause!' said Sammy with a happy wiggle. He stood up gently and walked over to the bathroom. Mama Bear was right there to hold his paw. Sammy climbed up onto his special little potty seat all by himself. He sat down and took a deep, relaxing breath. He sang his favorite little song while he waited. Soon, he was all done! 'Good job, Sammy!' cheered Mama Bear. Next came the very important next step. Sammy reached out and pulled off a soft, gentle piece of toilet paper. He wiped himself carefully, just like a big bear. Then, he stood up and looked down into the bowl. 'Bye-bye, potty!' said Sammy cheerfully as he pushed the big, shiny silver handle down. Woosh! The water swirled around and washed everything away. Sammy clapped his hands together and jumped up and down. 'Yay! Wipe, flush, and cheer!' he shouted with a huge smile. Mama Bear hugged him tight and gave him a high-five. They washed their soapy hands together with lots of bubbly bubbles. Sammy felt so proud and clean. He skipped happily back to his blocks, ready to build the tallest tower ever. Learning new things was so much fun, especially when you got to cheer at the end. Sammy couldn't wait to tell Daddy Bear all about his wonderful potty adventure later that day.

stories.title: Pip the Bunny's Big Bathroom Routine
stories.text: Pip the little bunny was hopping around his sunny room, chasing a red rubber ball. Suddenly, his floppy ears twitched. His tummy gave a little rumble. Pip stopped hopping and rubbed his tummy. 'Time to go!' whispered Pip to himself. He hurried as fast as his furry little feet could carry him into the bathroom. Papa Bunny smiled and opened the door. 'Great listening to your body, Pip!' said Papa. Pip hopped up onto the little white potty seat and got comfy. He waited patiently, listening to the birds sing outside the window. In just a little while, he was all finished. Now it was time for the best part of the routine. Pip pulled some soft, fluffy toilet paper from the roll. He wiped his bottom gently, making sure he was nice and clean. Then, he dropped the paper right into the bowl. Pip stood up tall and stretched his paws out. He reached for the shiny silver flusher and pushed it down with a click. Swoosh went the happy water! Pip's eyes went wide with excitement. 'Hooray! Wipe, flush, and cheer!' cheered Pip, doing a little bunny dance right there on the bathroom mat. Papa Bunny clapped and cheered right along with him. They washed their paws with sweet-smelling soap, making lots of squeaky sounds. Pip felt super fresh and ready for more fun. He grabbed his red rubber ball and hopped back to his toys, feeling like the smartest bunny in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Daisy's Happy Bathroom Trip
stories.text: Daisy the kitten was painting a picture of a yellow sun with her chunky crayons. Suddenly, she felt a little wiggle downstairs. Daisy put her yellow crayon down neatly on the table. She knew her body was telling her it was time for the bathroom. 'Excuse me, art supplies, I'll be right back!' said Daisy with a giggle. She trotted over to the bathroom where her pink stepstool was waiting. Grandma Cat was folding fluffy towels nearby. 'Do you need help, sweet kitten?' asked Grandma. 'I can do it, Grandma!' said Daisy proudly. She climbed up the stepstool and sat down on the comfy potty seat. She counted to ten very slowly and blew imaginary birthday candles to help her relax. Pop, fizz, all done! Daisy smiled a big, bright smile. Next came the steps to keep herself super clean. Daisy reached for the gentle toilet paper. She wiped herself with a soft, careful touch. Then, she stood up safely on her stool. She pressed the big flush button down with her thumb. Whoosh! The water rushed around in a fun, dizzy circle. Daisy clapped her paws together in delight. 'Wipe, flush, and cheer!' she sang out loud. Grandma Cat cheered too, giving Daisy a warm, cozy hug. They washed their paws at the sink, making mountain ranges of bubbly soap suds. Daisy dried her hands on a soft towel and felt so wonderful. She ran back to her art table, ready to finish her sunny painting with a heart full of happy pride.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, little Sammy was playing with his wooden train blocks. Suddenly, he felt a funny little wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! That was his special body signal telling him it was time to visit the big bathroom! Sammy put his toy train safely back in the box. 'Choo-choo! Time to go!' he giggled to himself. He hurried right over to the friendly little potty chair waiting just for him. Down sat Sammy, nice and cozy. He took a deep breath, relaxed his tummy muscles, and let out a happy sigh. Splish, splash, plop! Sammy used the potty just like a big kid. 'Hooray for Sammy!' whispered the bathroom mirror. After he finished, it was time for the very best steps of all. Sammy reached out his hand and pulled off a soft, fluffy square of toilet paper. He wiped himself gently, front to back, keeping his skin clean and fresh. Then, he stood up on tippy-toes and peeked inside the bowl. 'Bye-bye, little puddle!' he cheered. Sammy walked over to the shiny silver handle. He pushed it down with all his might. Whoosh! The water swirled around in a happy circle, washing everything away. 'You did it, Sammy!' cheered Mommy, clapping her hands from the doorway. Sammy beamed with pride, feeling so warm and clean inside. Next, Sammy marched right up to the sink. He grabbed the slippery, bubbly soap and rubbed his hands together, making mountains of white foam. Scrub-a-dub-dub, between his fingers and all around his thumbs! He rinsed the bubbles away with warm water and dried his hands on a fluffy blue towel. Sammy felt so proud and wonderful. He gave Mommy a big hug and went right back to his train tracks, ready for a fun new day of play.

stories.title: Mia and the Magic Flush
stories.text: Mia was busy painting a masterpiece with bright red and yellow finger paints when her tummy gave a little rumble. 'Time to pause, little artist,' Mia said softly to her painting. She washed the paint off her hands and skipped happily to the big bathroom. The bright yellow potty was waiting patiently. Mia hopped right on top. She sat very still, listening to the birds chirp outside the window. Before long, she was all done! 'Good job, Mia!' she whispered to herself. Now came the three important steps to keep her body super healthy and clean. First, Mia reached for the toilet paper roll. She pulled down a soft, gentle square and used it to wipe herself carefully. 'Clean and fresh!' she smiled. Next, she stood up and turned around to look into the bowl. She waved goodbye to what she had made. Then came her favorite part—the magic flush! Mia reached up, grabbed the big silver handle, and pressed it down firmly. Whoosh-sh-sh! The water rushed around and swallowed everything up in a big, bubbly whirlpool. 'Bye-bye!' Mia giggled, clapping her hands together. Finally, it was time to wash away all the germs. Mia climbed onto her little step stool in front of the sink. She pumped a dollop of strawberry-scented soap onto her palms. Rub, rub, rub went her hands, making lots of lovely pink bubbles. She washed the backs of her hands, her palms, and even her wrists. Then came the warm, refreshing water to rinse it all away. Mia dried her hands on a daisy-print towel and looked at her reflection in the shiny mirror. She was a super-duper potty helper! Mia skipped back to her art table, feeling so happy, fresh, and ready to finish her colorful painting.

stories.title: Leo's Big Kid Bathroom Adventure
stories.text: Leo the lion cub plushie was sitting on the floor while Leo the boy built a tall tower of colorful plastic blocks. Suddenly, Leo stopped building. He touched his tummy. 'I think my tummy needs to use the big bathroom!' he announced. Leo stood up tall and walked right to the bathroom door, bringing his little lion friend along for the ride. Up onto the big potty seat climbed Leo. He sat down comfortably and waited patiently, singing a quiet little song about his blocks. Pop! Everything went right into the bowl. 'Yay!' cheered Leo quietly. Step one of the big kid routine was ready: wiping! Leo reached for the soft white toilet paper. He carefully pulled off a gentle square and wiped himself just right. Then, he stood up and turned around to see his wonderful work. Step two: flushing! Leo stretched his arm up high and pushed down the shiny handle with both hands. Whoosh went the water, spinning round and round like a merry-go-round, making everything sparkling clean. 'All gone!' Leo cheered, waving goodbye to the bowl. Step three was the most bubbly step of all: hand washing! Leo stepped up to the sink and turned on the warm water. He grabbed the green apple soap and rubbed his hands together until there were fluffy white suds everywhere. He washed between his fingers and sang his favorite counting song. One, two, three, four, five! Then he rinsed all the bubbles down the drain and dried his hands on a bright yellow towel that felt as soft as a cloud. Leo looked down at his clean hands and smiled a big, proud smile. He picked up his lion cub and went back to his blocks, feeling like the biggest, smartest boy in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Adventure
stories.text:
Once upon a time, little Sammy was playing with his favorite yellow blocks. Suddenly, he felt a funny little wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! Sammy knew what that wiggle meant. It was time to visit the big potty! Sammy put his blocks down very gently and stood right up. 'Bye-bye, blocks! I'll be right back!' he whispered with a big happy smile.

Quickly, Sammy waddled into the bathroom. Up, up, up he climbed onto his special toddler seat. Ah, that felt so cozy and safe! Sammy sat very still and waited patiently. Soon, he heard a happy little plop. Yay! Sammy did it! He used the potty all by himself, just like a big kid.

Now came the very best part. Sammy hopped down and grabbed some soft, fluffy toilet paper. He pulled off a nice square—rip!—and wiped his bottom until he felt fresh and clean. Great job, Sammy! Next, it was time to say goodbye to the potty. Sammy turned around and reached for the big shiny handle. With a little push, down went the handle! Whoosh! Water swirled and swooshed, taking everything far, far away. 'Bye-bye, potty!' giggled Sammy.

Finally, Sammy did his happy victory dance. He threw his arms up in the air and cheered, 'Hooray, hooray, I did it today!' Last but not least, Sammy walked over to the sink. He pumped some bubbly soap onto his hands and rubbed them together. Scrub-a-dub-dub, wash those germs away! He rinsed his hands with warm water and dried them on a soft towel. Sammy looked in the mirror and beamed. He felt so proud, so clean, and so happy. What a wonderful potty adventure!

stories.title: Bella Bear Goes to the Bathroom
stories.text:
Bella Bear was painting a picture of a sparkly rainbow when her tummy gave a little rumble. 'Time to go!' said Bella, putting her paintbrush down in the cup. She marched right into the bathroom, feeling very brave and independent. Bella lifted her skirt, climbed up onto the potty chair, and sat down comfortably. She took a deep breath and relaxed. 

A moment later, she was all finished! Bella smiled from ear to ear. She knew just what to do next. She reached over and pulled off a piece of soft toilet paper. One wipe, two wipes, and she was as clean as a whistle! Bella dropped the paper right into the bowl. 

'Time to flush!' sang Bella. She pressed the silver button with her thumb. Woosh-sh-sh! The water rushed around in a fun, dizzy swirl, washing everything away. Bella clapped her hands together and cheered at the top of her lungs, 'Hip, hip, hooray! Wipe, flush, and away!' 

She wasn't quite done yet, though. Germs didn't like clean bears, so Bella hopped down to wash her hands. She squirted a pump of blue, bubbly soap onto her paws. Bubbles popped up like little balloons! She rubbed the tops of her hands, between her fingers, and all around. Then came the warm water to rinse every single bubble away. Bella dried her hands on her fluffy pink towel. She looked down at her sparkly rainbow painting waiting for her in the other room. Bella skipped back to her art table, feeling fresh, clean, and so very proud of her big-kid skills.

stories.title: Leo's Bathroom Symphony
stories.text:
Leo was zooming his toy firetruck across the living room rug when he felt a strange tickle in his tummy. 'Siren's calling!' giggled Leo. He parked his firetruck safely and zoomed his feet all the way to the bathroom. Up he hopped onto the potty, getting ready for his important mission.

Leo sat very patiently, humming his favorite little tune. Pop! The little mission was a complete success. Leo gave himself a pat on the back. Next came the super important steps of the bathroom routine. Leo pulled some gentle white paper from the roll. He wiped carefully, making sure he was nice and neat. 

Then, he stood up and turned around to face the magical handle. With a strong push, Leo flushed the toilet. Whoosh! The water made a loud, happy roar as it cleaned the bowl. Leo threw his hands up in the air and cheered loudly, 'Yay for the flush! Hip, hip, hooray!' 

No bathroom mission is complete without clean hands, so Leo stepped up to the sink on his little wooden stool. He squirted strawberry-scented soap onto his palms. Rub-a-dub-dub, scrub-a-dub-dub! He made lots of soapy mountains and washed his hands clean. Rinsing with water made the bubbles slide down the drain. Leo dried his hands on a green dinosaur towel. He smiled big at his shiny, clean hands and ran back to his firetruck, ready for his next fun game.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Ring a ling! Sammy hears a little tummy rumble. Uh oh! It is time to pause building his tall block tower. Mommy smiles a big, warm smile and holds out her hand. 'Time to visit the potty, Sammy!' she says gently. Sammy takes her hand and walks into the bathroom. He climbs up onto his special little green potty seat all by himself. Up, up, up! He sits down and waits patiently. He sings his favorite alphabet song. A, B, C, D, E, F, G! Suddenly, he feels a warm trickle. Splash, splash! 'Yay! I did it!' Sammy giggles with pure joy. Mommy claps her hands together. 'Wonderful job, Sammy! You listened to your body!' Next, it is time for step number two. Sammy reaches out and pulls some soft white toilet paper from the roll. One, two squares. He wipes his bottom gently, just like a big boy. Then, he drops the paper into the bowl. Plop! Now comes the most exciting part of all. Sammy stands up and turns around. He pushes the big silver handle down. Whoosh! The water swirls round and round, taking everything away. 'Bye-bye, potty!' Sammy waves happily. Finally, they walk over to the little sink. Sammy climbs onto his stepstool. He pumps the foaming soap. Squish, squish! It tickles his hands. He rubs his hands together, making lots of bubbly white bubbles. Sing a song for twenty seconds while washing clean. Underneath the water, rinse, rinse, rinse! Mommy helps him dry his hands on a fluffy yellow towel. Sammy looks in the mirror and beams with pride. He is growing up so big and strong. Mommy gives him a gigantic bear hug and a sweet kiss on his forehead. 'I am so proud of you, my sweet boy!' Sammy smiles brightly. He is ready to go back and finish his giant block tower, feeling fresh, clean, and wonderfully happy all over.

stories.title: Leo and the Magic Handle
stories.text: The little red fire truck zooms across the playroom rug. Vroom, vroom! Suddenly, Leo stops the truck. He feels a little tickle inside. 'Uh-oh, Leo's tummy needs to go potty!' Leo says out loud. He gently sets his fire truck down on the rug. Papa walks over with a gentle, encouraging nod. 'Let us go try the big potty, Leo!' They walk down the hallway together. Papa helps Leo climb up securely. Leo sits quietly, wiggling his toes. He pretends he is driving a big red fire truck all the way to the station. Honk, honk! A few seconds later, success! A lovely little splash sounds in the bowl. 'Look, Papa! I made it!' Leo cheers loudly. Papa smiles and cheers right along with him. 'Hip, hip, hooray for Leo!' Next, Leo learns the very next important step. He reaches over and grabs two squares of soft, fluffy toilet paper. He wipes carefully and drops the paper into the bowl. 'All clean!' he says proudly. Now it is time for the magic handle. Leo stands up carefully and turns around. He reaches out his little hand and pushes the shiny silver flusher all the way down. Whoosh! The swirling water rushes down with a happy sound, washing everything away. 'Goodbye, little bubbles!' Leo calls out. But wait, we are not quite done yet! Clean hands keep our bodies healthy and strong. Leo hops down and steps right up to the bathroom sink. Papa pumps a dollop of purple, sweet-smelling soap onto Leo's palms. Squish, squish, rub, rub! Leo makes funny soap mustaches on his lip and giggles. He washes his fingers, the backs of his hands, and his wrists. Under the warm water stream, all the bubbles wash away down the drain. Papa hands him a soft blue towel with happy ducks on it. Leo dries his hands thoroughly until they are warm and dry. He jumps down from his stepstool feeling like a true superhero. Papa wraps his arms around Leo for a warm, cozy hug. 'You wiped, flushed, and cheered like a champion today, Leo!' Leo beams from ear to ear, ready to play with his fire truck again.

stories.title: Maya's Clean-Up Routine
stories.text: Maya is painting a pretty picture with pink and yellow finger paints. Swish, swirl, go her little fingers across the paper. Suddenly, she stops. Her body gives her a little reminder. 'Time to use the potty, Maya!' she whispers to her teddy bear sitting nearby. Teddy bear nods wisely. Maya hops off her small wooden chair and trots into the bright bathroom. She climbs up onto her comfy pink potty ring. Up she goes, sitting nice and tall. She closes her eyes and takes a deep, calming breath. Ahhh. Right on time, she hears a wonderful sound. Splash, plop! 'I did it!' Maya claps her hands together in pure delight. Mama hears her from the hallway and comes in with a sunny smile. 'Wonderful job listening to your body, Maya!' Next comes the wonderful wipe. Maya reaches out for some soft paper. One, two gentle pats and wipes, keeping herself fresh and clean. She drops the paper into the bowl where it belongs. Now it is time for the best sound in the world. Maya stands up carefully, turns around, and pushes the shiny chrome flush button. Whoosh! The water rushes around in a circle, swirling everything down, down, down. 'Bye-bye!' Maya sings out a happy wave. But the routine is only just beginning. Clean hands are happy hands! Maya scurries over to the sink and climbs onto her pink polka-dot stepstool. Mama helps her turn on the warm water. Squirt! Green apple soap goes right into her palms. Maya rubs her hands together, making a mountain of white bubbles. She washes between her fingers and sings her favorite bath song. Rinse, rinse, rinse under the running water until every single bubble is gone. Mama hands her a fluffy pink towel with bunny ears. Maya dries her hands completely. She looks at her reflection in the mirror and gives herself a high-five in the air. 'Good job, Maya!' she tells herself. Mama gives her a gentle squeeze and a warm kiss on her cheek. Maya feels so accomplished, clean, and ready to skip back to her colorful finger painting.

stories.title: Sammy's Potty Success
stories.text: Sammy was building a tall tower with his red and blue blocks when suddenly, he felt a funny wiggle in his tummy. Uh-oh! That was his body telling him it was time to use the potty. Sammy put his red block down very carefully. 'Bye-bye, blocks! I'll be right back!' he whispered with a happy giggle. He walked over to the bathroom, pulling down his cozy dinosaur pants all by himself. Up he hopped onto the big potty seat. Sit, sit, sit! Sammy took a big, deep breath and relaxed. Soon, he heard a gentle splash. Yay, Sammy! You did it! He gave his tummy a little pat for doing such a wonderful job. Next came a very important helper step. Sammy reached out his hand and pulled off some soft toilet paper. One wipe, two wipes, all clean and fresh! He dropped the paper right into the bowl where it belonged. Now it was time for the magic moment. Sammy stood up tall and pushed the big, shiny silver handle down. Whoosh! Water swirled around in a fun, happy circle, taking everything away. 'Bye-bye!' cheered Sammy, clapping his hands together. He washed his hands with bubbly blue soap, scrubbing between his fingers until they smelled like sweet strawberries. Sammy looked in the mirror and gave himself a big, proud smile. He walked back to his blocks, ready to play again. Every day, Sammy grows bigger and stronger, learning new things all on his own. Hooray for potty time! You are a superstar, Sammy, keeping your body clean and happy every single day.

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Bathroom Adventure
stories.text: Mia was painting a picture of a yellow sun when her tummy gave a little rumble. 'Time to go!' she sang out loud. Mia hopped off her little yellow chair and hurried to the bathroom like a speedy little bunny. She pulled down her polka-dot shorts and climbed right up onto her special potty chair. She sat comfortably, kicking her feet just a little bit while waiting. Pop goes the bubble! In just a moment, she was all finished. Mia smiled brightly because she knew just what to do next. She reached for the soft, white toilet paper. One gentle wipe, two gentle wipes, and she was as clean as a whistle. Into the potty bowl went the paper. Then, Mia stood up and leaned over. With a happy push, she pressed the shiny flush button. Whoosh-sh-sh! The water rushed around in a big, swirling dance, carrying everything away with a happy gurgle. 'Bye-bye!' said Mia, waving goodbye to the water. But we are not quite done yet! Mia walked over to the sink. She turned on the warm water and pumped some foamy soap onto her hands. Rub-a-dub-dub, she scrubbed the bubbles all around her palms and the backs of her hands. She rinsed them clean under the gentle stream and dried them on a fluffy pink towel. Mia felt so fresh and proud. She gave a little cheer, throwing her hands up in the air. 'Yay for me! Wipe, flush, and cheer!' she sang softly. Her mommy clapped from the doorway, proud of her big girl. Mia skipped back to her painting, ready to add a shiny rainbow to her beautiful sunny picture.

stories.title: Leo's Big Boy Bathroom Routine
stories.text: Leo was riding his favorite green dinosaur toy across the living room rug when he stopped. He felt that familiar little tickle that meant his body was ready. Leo parked his dinosaur right by the sofa and said, 'Wait here for me, Dino!' Then he walked with big, proud steps straight to the bathroom. Up he climbed onto the potty, getting himself settled just right. He waited patiently, listening to the quiet sounds of the house. There it goes! Leo cheered softly in his heart. Now it was time for the three super steps to keep everything clean and bright. First, Leo grabbed the soft toilet paper from the roll. One wipe, two wipes, three gentle wipes to make sure he was fresh and clean. He dropped the paper into the bowl, watching it land with a soft plop. Next came the best part of all. Leo stood up tall, stretched out his arm, and pressed the shiny silver flusher handle. WHOOSH! The water swirled in a big, wonderful circle, washing everything away in a flash. 'Good job, flush!' Leo giggled, clapping his hands together. But wait, we always wash our hands! Leo stepped up to the little stool by the sink, turned on the warm water, and grabbed the green pump of soap. Squeeze, squeeze! Bubbles popped up everywhere as he rubbed his hands together like a busy little bee. He rinsed all the bubbles away with clean water and dried his hands on his star-patterned towel. Leo looked at his sparkling clean hands and gave a happy cheer. 'Hip, hip, hooray!' He walked back to his dinosaur, ready for more fun, feeling like a wonderful big boy.

rhymes.title: The Potty Dance
rhymes.text:
Time to go and time to play,
Put your little toys away.
Sit right down and take your time,
Now we sing a potty rhyme.

When you finish, grab the sheet,
Paper squares that wipe so neat.
Wipe it front and wipe it back,
Drop it right inside the sack.

Now we stand and look inside,
Press the flush button with pride.
Whoosh it goes down in the bowl,
Look at water go and roll!

Clap your hands and shout aloud,
 Mommy and Daddy are so proud!
Wash your hands with bubbles sweet,
Now our potty time is complete!

rhymes.title: Little Wipe and Flush
rhymes.text:
Urge is calling, let us run,
Potty time is full of fun.
Hold the paper, soft and white,
Wipe yourself and do it right.

Wipe the bottom, nice and clean,
Best routine you've ever seen.
Drop the paper in the deep,
Say goodbye, away it'll sweep.

Time to flush the handle down,
Best little helper in the town.
Watch the swirling water go,
Bye-bye poop and bye-bye oh!

Give a cheer, hip-hip-hooray!
You did it the proper way.
Wash your hands and splash the soap,
Clean and happy is our hope!

rhymes.title: The Happy Potty Song
rhymes.text:
Wiggle, giggle on the seat,
Tap your little happy feet.
Doing business, big or small,
Potty is the best of all.

Reach around and take a square,
Wipe it gently with great care.
One more wipe to make it shine,
Everything is looking fine.

Stand up tall and take a look,
Like a hero in a book.
Push the flush and hear the roar,
Water spinning by the floor.

Cheer aloud and jump up high,
Reach your fingers to the sky!
Potty champion, yes indeed,
Doing such a super deed!

rhymes.title: Flush Away
rhymes.text:
Drop your pants and sit right down,
Wear your invisible potty crown.
Push it out and let it go,
Watch the yellow river flow.

Grab the tissue from the roll,
Wipe it round and clean the hole.
Fold it neatly, wipe once more,
Drop it down upon the floor—no, in the bowl!

Time to flush and say goodbye,
Watch the bubbles floating high.
Down it travels out of sight,
Leaving everything so bright.

Raise your arms and give a cheer,
Glad that we are finished here.
Wash the germs right down the drain,
Ready to go play again!

rhymes.title: Cheer For The Flush
rhymes.text:
Morning, noon, and night time too,
Potty time is what we do.
Sit right down and count to ten,
Up and down and up again.

Take the paper, soft and dry,
Wipe the bottom, don't be shy.
Keep it clean from front to rear,
Doing super, never fear.

Push the handle, hear it roar,
Water rushing by the door.
Everything is washed away,
Starting fresh another day.

Time to shout a happy cheer,
Glad we got the potty clear!
Wash your hands with bubbles grand,
Cleanest kid in all the land!

rhymes.title: The Potty Dance
rhymes.text:
Time to go and sit right down,
Never worry, never frown.
Potty time is here at last,
Let us make the magic fast.

When you finish what you do,
Grab the paper, good for you!
Wipe it clean and wipe it right,
Make it sparkle, make it bright.

Time to stand and take a look,
Say goodbye to picture book.
Push the handle, hear the roar,
Watching water swirl and pour.

Now your hands are feeling grand,
Wash them clean in wonderland!
Give a cheer, hip-hip hooray!
Ready for a brand new day.

rhymes.title: Wipe, Flush, and Cheer!
rhymes.text:
Little toes upon the floor,
Knocking softly at the door.
Sit upon the little seat,
Happy hands and happy feet.

All done business, time to check,
Nothing dirty on your deck.
Wipe it gently, side to side,
Doing such a job with pride.

Down the hole it has to go,
Watch the happy waters flow.
Press the button, hear it rush,
Flush it down with such a swish!

 Shout it out so loud and clear,
Give a mighty toddler cheer!
Wash your hands and dry them too,
Look at what you managed to!

rhymes.title: The Flush Song
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Potty time is going right.
Sit up high upon the throne,
Singing out a happy tone.

Tissue paper in your hand,
Best invention in the land.
Wipe it clean and wipe it neat,
Sitting on your little seat.

Drop it in and say goodbye,
As the water rushes by.
Push the button, hear the sound,
Spinning water all around.

Jump up high and shout hooray,
You are growing up today!
Wash the germs right down the drain,
Time to go and play again.

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Potty
rhymes.text:
Hear the call, it is time to go,
Walk along so nice and slow.
Climb up on the potty chair,
Rest your hands and leave all care.

Take the tissue from the roll,
Drop it softly in the bowl.
Wipe until you sparkle clean,
Best little kid we have seen.

Wave bye-bye to what you made,
Watch it circle and cascade.
Flush the handle, watch it drop,
Hear the funny gurgling stop.

Wave your arms up in the air,
Cheering loudly everywhere!
So proud of this happy deed,
Growing up at lightning speed.

rhymes.title: Hip-Hip Hooray for the Potty
rhymes.text:
Busy toddler, stop your play,
Potty calls to you today.
Sit right down and take your time,
Singing out a little rhyme.

Reach around and get the wipe,
Fold it up just like a pipe.
Wipe it softly, one, two, three,
As happy as a honeybee.

Time to flush away the fuss,
Water makes a happy rush.
Down it goes into the deep,
While the little monsters sleep.

Clap your hands and shout it clear,
Time to give a mighty cheer!
Soap and water on your skin,
Now the fun can all begin.

rhymes.title: The Potty Dance
rhymes.text:
Time to go and use the seat,
Stomp your happy toddler feet!
Pull your little pants right down,
Never worry, never frown.
Sit up high and take your time,
Listen to our potty rhyme.
When you finish, do not rush,
Stand right up and flush the flush!
Wave goodbye down the bowl,
Look at you, you reach your goal!
Grab the paper, soft and white,
Wipe it clean and make it right.
Wash your hands with bubbly soap,
That is how we learn, I hope!
Give a cheer, hip-hip hooray!
Ready for a brand new day!

rhymes.title: Wipe, Flush, and Cheer
rhymes.text:
Potty time is here today,
Put your favorite toys away.
Sit right down and count to ten,
We will wash our hands again.
When the tinkle comes out fast,
We are almost through at last!
Take the tissue from the roll,
Drop it gently down the bowl.
Wipe until you sparkle bright,
Everything is feeling right.
Push the handle, watch it spin,
Flush it down and let it grin!
Water swirls around and round,
Making such a happy sound.
Now a cheer for what you did,
You are such a clever kid!

rhymes.title: Bye-Bye Puddle
rhymes.text:
Hear the call of potty chairs,
Run up all the little stairs.
Pull them down and sit so low,
Watch the yellow water flow.
All done now? Let us rejoice!
Use your loudest cheering voice.
Pull the handle, hear it roar,
Watch it disappear and more.
Get the paper, nice and dry,
Wipe the tummy, wave bye-bye.
Clean and fresh from head to toe,

stories.title: The Big Red Juice Spill
stories.text: Leo loved his big red cup. It had cute little yellow ducks all around the bottom. Today, Leo was having yummy apple juice for his snack. He sat right at his little wooden table with his teddy bear, Barnaby. Leo held his cup with both hands. He wanted to take a nice big sip. Oh, dear! Leo bumped his elbow on the edge of the table. Splash! The big red cup tilted over. Red apple juice made a funny puddle right on the table. It even dripped down onto Leo's blue shorts. Leo's eyes got big and round. His bottom lip started to tremble just a tiny bit. He thought he was in big trouble. Mommy walked into the kitchen with a gentle, loving smile. She did not look mad at all. Instead, Mommy knelt down right next to Leo's chair and gave him a warm hug. Mommy said in her softest voice, 'Oh, sweet boy, look at that big splash. Oops, it is okay! Spills happen to everyone, even grownups.' Leo looked at Mommy and blinked his happy brown eyes. 'Really, Mommy?' he asked in a tiny voice. 'Really and truly,' Mommy nodded. 'Accidents just mean we are learning how to do things all by ourselves.' Leo felt the big heavy feeling in his tummy float away like a soft balloon. He did not need to feel sad anymore. Mommy handed Leo a big, fluffy yellow sponge. It felt squishy and nice in his little hands. Leo helped Mommy wipe the table. Squish, squish, wipe, wipe! They worked together as a team. Then, Leo went to the bathroom with Mommy to wash his hands with bubbly blue soap. They watched the bubbles go down the drain. Leo put on a fresh pair of green shorts with pockets. He felt all clean and cozy again. Leo went right back to his table. Mommy poured him a little bit more yummy apple juice. This time, Leo held his cup very carefully with both hands. He smiled a big, proud smile at Barnaby the bear. He knew that if another little oops happened, it would be just fine. Mommy and Barnaby were right there to help him try again.

stories.title: Maya's Tower of Blocks
stories.text: Maya had a big box of wooden blocks. They were painted bright yellow, green, and blue. Maya loved to build things that reached all the way up to the sky. Today, she wanted to make the tallest tower in the whole wide world. She sat down on the soft pink rug in her bedroom. She carefully placed a blue block right on the bottom. Then, she added a green block on top of that. One by one, Maya stacked the blocks. Up, up, up went the tower! It was taller than her little teddy bear. It was almost as tall as her knees! Maya stood up on her tippy-toes to place the very last red block right on the very top. She held her breath and reached as high as she could. Wobble, wobble, went the green block. Shake, shake, went the blue block. Crash! Down came the tower in a big, noisy heap of wood. Thump, rattle, bang! Maya blinked. For a second, she felt a little hot tear in the corner of her eye. Her big tower was gone. Daddy heard the loud noise and popped his head into the room. He saw the scattered blocks all over the pink rug. Daddy did not frown. He gave a happy little cheer and clapped his hands together. 'Wow, look at those blocks go!' Daddy said. He walked over and sat right down on the rug next to Maya. Daddy gave her a cozy hug. 'Oops, it is okay, my little builder. That tower got so super tall, it just wanted to take a little rest on the floor!' Maya giggled through her tears. Daddy was right. The blocks looked like they were ready for a nap. 'Can we build an even better one?' Maya asked, wiping her cheek. 'We sure can,' said Daddy with a big smile. Maya felt her heart feel warm and happy again. Together, Maya and Daddy started to pick up the pieces. They decided to make a wide castle instead of a tall tower. Maya put the blocks down one by one, feeling proud and strong. She knew that whenever something fell down, she could always start again.

stories.title: Sam's Shoes Are on the Wrong Feet
stories.text: It was time to go to the park! Sam loved the park. The yellow slide was his very favorite thing in the whole wide world. Sam rushed to the front door where his bright blue sneakers were waiting for him. He wanted to go outside right this very second. Sam sat down on the little bench by the door. He grabbed his left shoe and shoved his right foot into it. Then, he grabbed his right shoe and pushed his left foot into it. Sam huffed and puffed, pulling the Velcro straps tight. All done! Sam stood up to walk, but something felt very, very silly. His feet felt like they were looking at each other instead of looking at the door. Sam looked down at his blue sneakers. His big toes were bumping into each other in the middle! His shoes were on the wrong feet! Sam let out a loud, funny giggle. He felt like a silly little penguin waddling on the ice. Mommy walked over with her keys in her hand. She looked down at Sam's funny shoes and smiled a big, bright smile. Mommy scooped Sam up into a tickle hug. 'Well hello there, little penguin!' Mommy laughed. 'Oops, it is okay, Sam! Your shoes just got a little mixed up because they were in such a big rush to go to the swings.' Sam giggled even louder as Mommy tickled his tummy. He did not feel silly in a bad way; he felt silly in a fun way. 'Can we fix them?' Sam asked happily. 'Of course we can fix them,' Mommy said. She sat down on the bench with Sam. They took off the blue sneakers together. Slide your foot out, slide your foot in. Mommy helped Sam put the left shoe on the left foot, and the right shoe on the right foot. Now Sam's toes were pointing straight ahead toward the sunshine outside. Sam stomped his feet on the floor. Stomp, stomp, stomp! His shoes felt just right now. Sam grabbed Mommy's hand, ready for his big park adventure. He knew that making a little mix-up was no big deal at all.

stories.title: Pip Spills the Juice
stories.text: Little Pip the bunny loved his special bright yellow cup. It had little green frogs hopping all around the sides. Every morning, Mommy poured sweet apple juice inside it. Pip would sit at his small blue table and drink his juice before going outside to play in the warm sunshine. Today, Pip was very excited. He was wearing his favorite red boots and could not wait to splash in the puddles. He picked up his yellow cup with both paws. Oh, he squeezed it just a little too tight! Splash! The apple juice went everywhere. It made a big, sticky puddle right on the table. It even dripped onto Pip's soft fuzzy lap. Pip's long ears drooped right down. His bottom lip started to tremble. Oh no! He made a big mess. A little squeak of worry came out of his mouth. Mommy walked over with a big, soft smile. She knelt down right beside his chair and gave him a gentle hug. 'Oops, it's okay, Pip!' Mommy said in her warm, cozy voice. 'Spills happen to everyone, even grown-ups. We can clean it up together.' Mommy handed Pip a bright blue sponge. Pip blinked away his worried tears and took the sponge. He squished it in his paw. Squeeze, squeeze, went the sponge! Pip wiped up the apple juice puddle all by himself. It felt a little bit fun to make the table clean and shiny again. Once all the juice was gone, Mommy wiped his lap with a warm washcloth. Pip looked at the clean table and smiled a big, happy bunny smile. He learned that making a mistake is not the end of the world. With a little help and a happy attitude, everything gets fixed right up. Now, it was time for puddle jumping!

stories.title: Leo Builds a Tall Tower
stories.text: Leo the lion cub had a big box of colorful wooden blocks. There were red squares, blue triangles, and yellow rectangles. Leo loved building things that reached all the way up to the sky. Today, he wanted to make the tallest tower in the whole jungle playroom. He carefully placed a red block down on the soft rug. Then, he balanced a blue triangle right on top. Wobble, wobble went the block! Leo held his breath and tapped it gently with his little paw to make it stay still. He added a yellow rectangle, then another red square. The tower was getting so tall! It was almost as tall as Leo himself. Leo stood up on his tiptoes to reach the very top. He held a green cylinder, ready to place it proudly on the summit. He stretched his arm up high. But oh! His elbow bumped against the side of the table. Crash! Bang! Clatter! Down came the wonderful tower. Blocks tumbled everywhere across the floor. Leo sat down on the rug with a loud sigh. His shoulders slumped, and he looked at the scattered pieces with a sad little frown. Daddy Lion walked over, sitting down cross-legged on the floor next to him. Daddy gave Leo a warm, reassuring nuzzle. 'Oops, it's okay, Leo!' Daddy said gently. 'Building tall things is tricky, and sometimes blocks tumble down. That is just part of the fun.' Leo looked at his daddy's kind eyes and felt his sadness melt away. 'Can we build a new one?' Leo asked softly. 'Of course we can!' Daddy smiled. Together, Leo and Daddy started picking up the blocks. This time, they decided to build a wide castle instead of a tall tower. They laughed and stacked pieces side by side. Leo realized that a tumble is just a chance to start something new and even better.

stories.title: Mia Puts on Her Shoes
stories.text: Mia the little bear was getting ready to go to the park with Grandma. The sun was shining brightly, and the birds were singing sweet songs outside. Grandma handed Mia her two pink velcro shoes. 'Time to put on your shoes, my little sweet bear,' Grandma said cheerfully. Mia sat down on the entryway rug and pulled her shoes close. She grabbed her right shoe and tried to push her left foot inside it. Push, push, push went her foot, but it would not fit at all! It felt squished and very uncomfortable. Mia tried to wiggle her toes, but they were bumping into the wrong side. She looked down at her feet and let out a little frustrated grunt. Her shoes were mixed up! She had put her right shoe on her left foot, and her left shoe on her right foot. Mia felt her face grow warm. She crossed her little arms and gave a tiny huff. Grandma knelt down on the rug with a gentle, loving smile. She took Mia's small hands in her own warm paws. 'Oops, it's okay, Mia!' Grandma whispered kindly. 'Shoe feet can be very tricky sometimes. Let's try a little magic switcheroo.' Grandma helped Mia take the pink shoes off and swap them around. This time, when Mia pushed her feet inside, they slid right in smoothly, just like a cozy little bed. Wiggle went her toes, feeling completely happy and comfortable. Mia pressed the pink velcro straps down with a loud, satisfying *rip* sound. She stood up and stomped her feet proudly on the floor. 'All done!' Mia cheered happily. Grandma clapped her hands. Mia learned that getting things mixed up is completely okay. With a gentle reset, everything turns out right in the end, and now she was ready to run and play in the sunshine!

stories.title: Pip Spills the Juice
stories.text: Little Pip the puppy loved his shiny yellow cup. Inside the cup was sweet apple juice, cold and yummy. Pip sat at the little red table with his blocks. He wanted to build a very tall tower. Reach, reach, go the block! Oh, no! Pip's fluffy tail wagged just a little too fast. Thump! The tail hit the yellow cup. Splash, splash, splish! The apple juice spilled all over the table and dripped onto the floor. Pip's ears drooped right down. His bottom lip quivered. He felt so bad. Mommy walked over with a big, soft smile. She knelt down right beside him. 'Oops, it's okay, Pip!' she said softly and gave him a gentle hug. 'Everybody makes spills sometimes. Let's fix it together!' Pip felt a warm wiggle in his tummy. Mommy handed him a bright blue sponge. Squeeze, squeeze, went the sponge as it soaked up the yummy juice. Pip helped wipe the table clean. It felt good to help clean up the little mess. Then, Mommy poured a tiny bit more juice into the cup. Pip held it with both paws very carefully. They smiled at each other. Mistakes happen, but we can always clean them up and try again. Pip finished his juice and went right back to his happy blocks. What a wonderful day!

stories.title: Leo's Inside-Out Shoes
stories.text: Time to go to the park! Leo the lion cub was so excited. He ran to the rug to put on his favorite blue sneakers. He grabbed the left shoe and pushed his foot inside. Then he grabbed the right shoe and pushed hard. Push, push, wiggle, wiggle! Leo stood up to walk to the door. Wait a minute. Something felt very, very silly. Leo looked down at his feet. His big toes were bumping right into each other! The toes of his shoes were pointing inside instead of outside. Leo giggled. His shoes were on the wrong feet! He sat right down on the floor and tried to pull them off. They were stuck tight. Oh, dear. Leo started to feel a little grumpy. Daddy walked over and sat down beside him. Daddy chuckled a warm, cozy chuckle. 'Oops, it's okay, Leo! Everyone gets their shoes mixed up sometimes, even daddies!' Daddy helped Leo wiggle his left foot out, and then his right foot. They switched the shoes around. Left shoe on the left foot, right shoe on the right foot! Leo stood up again. Perfect! No more bumps. Leo jumped up and down. He felt so proud. Daddy high-fived him. Making a mistake is just part of learning how to do big-kid things all by yourself.

stories.title: Maya's Muddy Boots
stories.text: Mila the kitty cat loved wearing her bright pink rain boots. Splash, splash, go the puddles! After the morning rain, the big yard was full of wonderful, squishy mud. Mila stomped her boots. Squish, squash, squelch! It was so much fun. But then Mila tried to jump over the biggest, muddiest puddle of all. She jumped up high, but she didn't jump quite far enough. Oof! Down she tumbled right into the middle of the puddle. Splat! Mud was on her knees, mud was on her paws, and a little splash of mud even landed right on her nose. Mila sat still in the mud and blinked. She looked at her dirty pink boots. For a second, she wanted to cry. Daddy came running over with a fluffy white towel. He didn't look mad at all; his eyes were crinkled with happy laughs. 'Oops, it's okay, sweet Mila!' Daddy cheered, lifting her out of the puddle. 'Mud washes right off, and playing is what yards are for!' Daddy helped her take off the muddy boots at the back door. They played a fun game of spraying the boots with the gentle garden hose. Wash, wash, went the water, making all the brown mud slide away. Mila clapped her hands. Her boots looked brand new again. She gave Daddy a big muddy-free hug. It is always okay to get messy when you are having fun exploring the big world.

stories.title: The Big Red Juice Splash
stories.text: Leo loved his big red cup. It was shiny and bright, and it held yummy apple juice for snack time. Today, Leo sat at the little blue table. He held his cup with both hands.
