By morning, the sun was peeking through the curtains, and Sam woke up feeling rested and proud. He bounded out of bed, ran to Mommy and Daddy, and shouted, 'I slept all night in my big bed, and my magic pocket kiss watched over me the whole time!'

stories.title: The First Day of Preschool
stories.text: Leo woke up with a tiny flutter in his tummy. Today was his very first day at preschool! He looked at his yellow backpack hanging on his chair. He wanted to go play with the blocks, but his feet felt stuck like heavy little logs. 'Oh, Leo,' whispered Mommy, kneeling down. 'Do you know how to take me with you even when we are apart?' Leo shook his head, his big eyes wide with wonder. Mommy smiled softly and cupped her hand. She pressed a gentle kiss right into the center of her palm. Then, she scooped up the invisible kiss and tucked it safely inside the pocket of Leo's little blue overalls. 'Clap your pocket shut,' Mommy whispered. 'That's your Magic Pocket Kiss. Whenever you feel a little lonely or miss my hugs, just pop your hand inside your pocket, squeeze the magic kiss, and pull it right up to your cheek. I will be right there with you.' Leo blinked and pressed his little hand against the fabric. He could almost feel a warm, cozy glow right over his heart. He patted his pocket and gave a brave, happy nod. At preschool, Leo built the tallest tower of wooden blocks he had ever made. But then, a big rumble of thunder shook the window, and Leo felt a little wobble in his bottom lip. He missed Mommy. Quickly, Leo remembered! He slipped his small hand down into his blue overalls pocket. He curled his fingers around the magic kiss and pressed it gently to his cheek. A warm wave of comfort washed over him, just like a real hug. Leo smiled and whispered, 'Hi, Mommy.' He felt so brave and strong all day long. When Mommy came to pick him up, Leo ran into her arms and shouted, 'Mommy! The Magic Pocket Kiss worked all day long!' Mommy beamed and gave him another kiss, right on the nose.

stories.title: The Big Doctor Visit
stories.text: Maya loved playing doctor with her stuffed bear, but going to the real doctor felt a little bit spooky. Today was her yearly checkup, and as she sat on the crinkly white paper table, her fingers twisted together tightly. The nurse smiled warmly, but Maya hid behind Daddy's sleeve. Daddy gently touched Maya's shoulder and whispered, 'Maya bear, do you remember our special secret?' Maya nodded, her eyes shining. 'It's time for a Magic Pocket Kiss!' Daddy cupped his hand, kissed his palm, and pretended to scoop up a glowing, sparkly treasure. He carefully slipped the invisible kiss right into the front pocket of Maya's pink polka-dot dress. 'Zip it shut!' Daddy whispered. Maya quickly patted her dress pocket to lock the magic inside. 'Now, Dr. Sarah is going to check your heartbeat with a cool metal circle. It might feel a little chilly, but your Magic Pocket Kiss will keep you warm and super brave.' When Dr. Sarah came in with her stethoscope, Maya took a deep breath. She reached down, held onto her Magic Pocket Kiss, and squeezed it tightly. She felt a happy bubble of courage pop right inside her tummy. Instead of hiding, Maya said hello! She let Dr. Sarah listen to her chest and even looked at her ears in the little light. 'You are the bravest patient I have seen all day!' Dr. Sarah cheered, handing Maya a shiny star sticker. Maya stuck the sticker right on her shirt, right above her pocket. On the way home in the car, Maya patted her dress and giggled. 'Daddy, the Magic Pocket Kiss made me brave as a lion!' Daddy smiled and said, 'You are always brave, my sweet girl, and I am so proud of you.'

stories.title: Bedtime and the Sleepy Stars
stories.text: The moon was peeking through the bedroom window, painting soft silver patches on the carpet. It was time for sleep, but Toby's eyes were wide open like two bright buttons. He didn't want to close his eyes. He wanted to play with his toy trucks all night long. 'Time for bed, my little sleepyhead,' whispered Grandma, tucking the cozy green blanket up to Toby's chin. Toby let out a little sigh and rolled over. He was worried that if he went to sleep, the dark room would feel too big and quiet. Grandma understood. She sat softly on the edge of the mattress and stroked his soft curls. 'I have a wonderful bedtime secret for you,' she murmured. Grandma leaned down and planted a soft, tickly kiss on the back of Toby's hand. Then, she gently folded his little fingers closed into a tiny fist. 'This is your nighttime Magic Pocket Kiss,' Grandma whispered. 'You can tuck this special kiss right inside your pajama shirt pocket, right over your sleepy heart.' Toby carefully opened his pajama pocket and slipped his little fist inside, letting the warm magic settle right against his chest. 'Now close your eyes, Toby, and imagine the stars are singing you a quiet lullaby. Whenever you feel like opening your eyes, just squeeze your pocket kiss and feel how much Grandma loves you.' Toby squeezed his pocket and let out a long, happy yawn. The room didn't feel big and scary anymore; it felt cozy and safe, like a warm hug from head to toe. Grandma softly hummed a sweet melody as Toby's eyelids grew heavier and heavier. Within just a few minutes, Toby was fast asleep, dreaming of happy trucks and sparkling stars, with his hand resting softly and safely on his magic pocket.

stories.title: The First Day of Preschool Pocket Kiss
stories.text: Leo woke up with a big stretch and a tiny flutter in his tummy. Today was his very first day at preschool! He sat on the edge of his cozy bed and looked at his brand-new yellow backpack hanging on the doorknob. His tummy fluttered a little bit more. Mommy walked into his room with a warm, gentle smile and knelt down right beside him. 'I know big days can feel a little bit scary, Leo,' she whispered softly, 'but I have a very special secret trick just for you.' Mommy cupped her hand, pressed it softly against her own smiling lips to catch a warm, loving kiss, and then gently placed her hand inside the front pocket of Leo’s yellow backpack. 'There!' Mommy said with a proud nod. 'That is your Magic Pocket Kiss. Whenever you miss me, or whenever your tummy feels fluttery, just put your hand right inside your pocket, take out my kiss, and press it right against your cheek.' Leo’s eyes went wide with wonder. He reached out and slipped his little warm hand deep into the pocket. He closed his eyes and imagined Mommy’s warm hug wrapping all around him. The fluttery feeling in his tummy began to shrink away, replaced by a happy, cozy warmth. He zipped the pocket up safe and tight. At preschool, when it was time to paint, Leo felt a little shy. He walked over to his backpack, unzipped the pocket, and took out his magic kiss. He pressed it to his cheek, and a big smile spread across his face. He sat down at the table, picked up a bright blue paintbrush, and painted a huge picture of his mommy and him. When Mommy came to pick him up later that afternoon, Leo ran straight into her arms. 'Mommy! Your magic pocket kiss worked the whole day long!' Mommy hugged him tight, so proud of her brave little boy.

stories.title: The Playground Brave Pocket Kiss
stories.text: Maya stood right at the bottom of the tallest slide in the whole park. She looked all the way up, up, up into the sky. The green plastic slide curved high into the clouds, and from up there, children looked as tiny as ladybugs. Maya took one step backward and held tightly onto Daddy’s hand. 'That slide looks so very big, Daddy,' Maya whispered, her lower lip trembling just a little bit. Daddy knelt down in the soft woodchips so he was eye-to-eye with his brave little girl. He gently patted her jacket pocket. 'It is a very big slide, Maya, and it is completely normal to feel a little bit nervous about trying new things.' Daddy smiled a big, reassuring smile. 'Let’s make sure you have your extra boost of courage.' Daddy placed his hand against his lips, made a little kissing sound, and tucked the invisible magic kiss right inside the pocket of Maya’s pink polka-dot jacket. He zipped it up securely so the magic couldn't escape. 'There! Now you have a Magic Pocket Kiss,' Daddy said cheerfully. 'Whenever you need to feel brave, just touch your pocket and remember how much I love you.' Maya touched the little bump where the kiss was hidden inside her pocket. She felt a warm, tingly feeling travel right down to her toes. She took a deep breath, let go of Daddy’s hand, and started climbing the ladder one sturdy step at a time. Step, step, step. When she reached the very top, she felt a little flutter, so she pressed her pocket again. Suddenly, she felt ready! Maya sat down at the top of the slide, raised her hands high into the air, and zoomed all the way down with a joyful giggle. 'Whee!' she shouted. When she landed safely at the bottom, she ran straight to Daddy. 'I did it! The magic kiss made me fly just like a superhero!'

stories.title: The Bedtime Quiet Pocket Kiss
stories.text: The moon was glowing softly outside the window, painting silver stripes across the bedroom floor. It was time for little Toby to go to sleep, but Toby’s eyes were wide open like two full moons. He rolled over to the left, and then he rolled over to the right. His favorite teddy bear, Barnaby, sat quietly on the pillow. 'My room feels a little too big and quiet tonight,' Toby whispered into the darkness, pulling his fuzzy blue blanket right up to his chin. Grandma walked softly into the room, her slippers making a gentle whispering sound on the rug. She sat down on the edge of the mattress and stroked Toby’s soft brown hair. 'Sometimes nighttime feels very quiet, my sweet boy,' Grandma said with a soothing voice. 'But you are never alone.' Grandma leaned down, kissed the tip of Toby’s nose, and then gently patted the pocket of his striped pajamas. 'I am leaving a special Magic Pocket Kiss right here in your pajamas,' she whispered. 'Even when I go downstairs, this little kiss will stay right here to keep you company all through the night.' Toby looked down at his pajamas and carefully placed his little hand over his pocket. He could almost feel a warm, glowing light shining right from inside the fabric, wrapping him up like a cozy blanket of love. 'Is it safe in there?' Toby asked softly. 'As safe as can be,' Grandma smiled, kissing his forehead one last time before turning off the bedside lamp. Toby closed his eyes, keeping his hand resting gently on his magical pajama pocket. He listened to the quiet nighttime sounds outside, but instead of feeling lonely, he felt completely surrounded by warmth and love. The magic kiss whispered sweet dreams into his heart, and within just a few minutes, Toby drifted off into a deep, peaceful, happy sleep.

rhymes.title: The Morning Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The morning sun is shining bright,
It is time to wake and greet the light.
We put on socks upon our feet,
And find a yummy morning treat.

Before you go outside to play,
To have a happy, sunny day,
I have a secret magic trick,
So open up your pocket quick!

I drop a kiss right in the seam,
As shiny as a golden beam.
Now pat it down so it stays tight,
To keep you safe and feeling bright.

Whenever you feel sad or blue,
Just pop your hand right in for you.
Take out the kiss and squeeze it near,
And know that mommy's always here.

rhymes.title: The Goodbye Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
It's time to head out through the door,
To learn and play and explore more.
Put on your jacket, warm and red,
And brush the tangles from your head.

Now hold my hand and step outside,
With happy jumps and giant stride.
But wait right here, don't walk away,
We need a kiss to start the day!

I press a kiss into your palm,
To keep you happy, sweet, and calm.
Now fold your fingers very fast,
So that the magic spell will last.

At circle time or on the swing,
Just open up and let it sing.
The little kiss will tap your hand,
And help you play across the land.

rhymes.title: The Brave Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Sometimes new things can look so big,
Like dancing like a jumping pig.
Or climbing up the playground slide,
With arms held open wide and wide.

If ever you feel shy or small,
And do not want to try at all,
Just reach inside your pocket deep,
Where little magic secrets sleep.

My special kiss is waiting there,
To float into the open air.
It gives a hug around your thumb,
And whispers, 'Look at what you've done!'

You are so brave, you are so strong,
With cheerful giggles all day long.
So take a breath and count to three,
And feel the love I send to thee.

rhymes.title: The Naptime Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The afternoon is getting cool,
We finish up our play and school.
It's time to rest your sleepy eyes,
Beneath the cozy blanket skies.

Put down your toys upon the floor,
And close your bedroom wooden door.
Lie down upon your pillow soft,
While sleepy clouds float up aloft.

Before I turn the lights down low,
And give a quiet, gentle blow,
I tuck a kiss inside your pocket tight,
To keep you company all night.

So dream of puppies, stars, and gleam,
And float away upon a stream.
The pocket kiss will watch you snooze,
With happy dreams you cannot lose.

rhymes.title: The Anytime Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
No matter where you go today,
At Grandma's house or far away,
You wear a smile upon your face,
The brightest kid in every place.

Whenever you are feeling glad,
Or even if you feel a tad sad,
Remember what we always do,
I left a little gift for you.

Tap on your pocket, one, two, three,
And let the magic magic free.
A happy kiss goes pop, pop, pop,
And makes the tears and worries stop.

So skip along and shout hooray,
We love each other every day!
The pocket kiss is here to stay,
To guide you safely on your way.

rhymes.title: The Morning Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The morning sun is shining bright,
It is time to wake and greet the light.
We put on socks upon our feet,
And make our morning routine sweet.

Before you walk out through the door,
And go to play upon the floor,
I have a secret just for you,
A little magic we can do.

I take my hand and press my thumb,
To get a loving kiss to come.
I place it deep inside your pocket,
Right beside your shiny locket.

Now zip it up and keep it tight,
To keep you safe and feeling bright.
Whenever you are feeling blue,
Your pocket kiss is there for you.

rhymes.title: The Playground Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Out to the park we love to run,
To play all day beneath the sun.
You climb the ladder up so high,
And wave a happy, cheerful hi.

Sometimes a slide can be so steep,
And make you want to softly weep.
That is the time to stop and reach,
To practice what we love to teach.

Just tap your pocket, one, two, three,
And set the magic kisses free.
You pull one out and press it near,
To make the little worries clear.

With extra courage in your shoe,
You know exactly what to do.
You slide right down and shout out 'Whee!',
As happy as a bird so free.

rhymes.title: The Bye-Bye Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
It is time to say goodbye today,
While mommy has to go away.
You give a hug so warm and grand,
And hold my gentle, loving hand.

I give a kiss into my palm,
To keep you happy, sweet, and calm.
I drop it in your pocket deep,
A special treasure you can keep.

When daddy waves and walks away,
You do not need to feel dismay.
Just squeeze your pocket nice and tight,
And everything will feel all right.

The magic travels to your heart,
We never truly are apart.
So smile a smile and shout hooray,
And have a super-duper day.

rhymes.title: The Naptime Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The afternoon is warm and slow,
It is time to let the playtime go.
We snuggle in our cozy bed,
And lay our sleepy little head.

It is hard to close your eyes to rest,
When playing is what you love best.
So let us do our special trick,
To help you settle down real quick.

I find your pocket on your sleeve,
And leave a kiss before I leave.
You hold it close against your cheek,
And let your tired body squeak.

The magic warmth begins to glow,
As soft and sweet as drifted snow.
You drift away to dreamland now,
With sleepy blinks and gentle bow.

rhymes.title: The Brave Little Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Sometimes a bump can make you cry,
When you are learning how to fly.
A scraped up knee or tumbling fall,
Can make you feel so very small.

Do not you worry, wipe your tear,
Because your magic friend is here.
Just check your pocket, look inside,
Where tiny happy secrets hide.

Pull out the kiss and tap your nose,
Right down to your tickly toes.
The magic sparkle makes it better,
Like a warm and cozy sweater.

You stand right up and brush the dirt,
And laugh away the little hurt.
With pocket magic by your side,
You walk along with joy and pride.

rhymes.title: The Morning Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The morning sun is shining bright,
It is time to wake and dress with might.
Mommy folds her hand so small,
And gives a little kiss to all.

She places it inside your pocket deep,
To keep it safe while out of leap.
Now zip it tight so it won't stray,
And carry it throughout the day.

When door is closed and you feel blue,
Just touch the pocket made for you.
Put your finger right inside,
And feel the love begin to slide.

A magic kiss is on your cheek,
Giving you the strength you seek.
So smile big and skip away,
You are ready for the day!

rhymes.title: Goodbye Hug and Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
It is time to say goodbye to bed,
And pat a little sleepy head.
Put on your shoes and pants so neat,
Ready with your dancing feet.

Now cup your hand and catch a prize,
Right before you close your eyes.
A big wet kiss from cheek to palm,
To keep your little spirit calm.

Slip it in your coat so red,
Right beside the woolly thread.
Button up and hold it tight,
Glowing like a guiding light.

Whenever you feel sad or shy,
And feel a little tear drop cry,
Just reach inside and take it out,
And give a happy little shout!

rhymes.title: The Playground Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Out to play upon the grass,
Watching all the birdies pass.
Climbing up the ladder high,
Reaching all the way to sky.

Sometimes knees can give a scrape,
Trying out a monster shape.
Do not worry, do not weep,
We have got a secret keep.

Touch your pocket on your chest,
Where the magic kiss can rest.
Take it out and press it square,
Show it to the sunny air.

Feel the magic make it better,
Light as any feather letter.
Dust your knees and run along,
Singing out a happy song!

rhymes.title: The Naptime Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The afternoon is warm and slow,
Time to watch the shadows grow.
Cozied in your blanket bed,
Pillow underneath your head.

It is hard to close your eyes,
Watching all the lullabies.
So I give a kiss so sweet,
Dropping right down to your feet.

Scoop it up and tuck it in,
Right beneath your little chin.
Hold it close and breathe in slow,
Watch the sleepy feelings grow.

Dream of castles in the air,
Knowing that I am always there.t
Rest your eyes and count to ten,
Wake up bright and fresh again.

rhymes.title: The Brave Day Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
New adventures wait outside,
Where the gentle giants hide.
Take my hand and let us go,
Walking very proud and slow.

If you feel a little shy,
As the big folks wander by,
There is a secret you can use,
That will chase away the blues.

Tap your pocket, one, two, three,
Feel the magic set you free.
Take the kiss and press it fast,
Make the scary feelings past.

You are brave and you are strong,
Nothing in the world goes wrong.
With your magic kiss in tow,
You are ready now to go!

rhymes.title: The Morning Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The morning sun is shining bright,
It is time to wake and greet the light.
We put on socks upon our feet,
And make our morning outfit sweet.

Before you run out through the door,
We need a little magic more.
Open up your pocket wide,
See what special thing's inside.

I press a kiss right in your hand,
The sweetest kiss in all the land.
Now close it tight so it won't stray,
And keep it safe throughout the day.

When you feel lonely at your school,
Just hold your pocket, that's the rule.
Open up and let it out,
And give a happy little shout!

rhymes.title: Goodbye Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
It is time to say goodbye,
No need for a little cry.
We will walk into the hall,
Ready for the day for all.

Mommy gives a squeeze so tight,
Daddy makes it feel just right.
Then we do our special trick,
Magic pocket, do it quick!

Put a kiss inside your coat,
Right beside the zipper float.
Button up and tuck it in,
Let your happy day begin.

If you miss me when I am gone,
Touch your pocket and sing a song.
Feel the love right on your chest,
My little darling, you are the best.

rhymes.title: The Playground Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Out upon the greeny grass,
Watch the happy children pass.
Climbing high upon the slide,
With a giant, joyful stride.

Oh oh oh, a little trip,
Just a tiny stumble skip.
Dust the little knees right off,
Give a happy little cough.

Time to use our magic spell,
So that everything is well.
Reach into your pocket deep,
Where the magic kisses sleep.

Pull it out and put it on,
Watch the hurt go quickly gone.
Now you feel so brave and strong,
Ready to go run along!

rhymes.title: The Naptime Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The afternoon is getting cool,
We are done with morning school.
Time to rest your sleepy head,
In your cozy little bed.

Pull the blanket up so high,
Watch the mobile slowly fly.
Close your eyes and breathe in deep,
Sliding down the hill to sleep.

Sometimes naptime feels so long,
So we sing a quiet song.
Feel your pocket by your side,
Where the magic kisses hide.

Hold it close against your heart,
Even when we are apart.
Dream a sweet and lovely dream,
Floating down a sleepy stream.

rhymes.title: The Evening Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Stars are peeking in the sky,
Moon is shining up so high.
Bathtime splashing in the tub,
Scrub a dub a happy rub.

Pajamas soft and slippers warm,
Safe from any windy storm.
Sitting on the rocking chair,
With your teddy sitting there.

One last kiss before we sleep,
Into your pocket, in a leap.
Zip it up or button tight,
We will keep it safe all night.

Tomorrow we will wake anew,
With all our happy tasks to do.
Sleep until the morning light,
Little pocket kiss, goodnight.

rhymes.title: The Morning Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The morning sun begins to glow,
It is time to start the day, you know!
We stretch up high and touch the sky,
And brush our sleepy eyes so bright and wide.

Before you step outside the door,
We need one little magic thing and more.
I cup my hands and catch a smile,
And hold it safe and warm a while.

I drop it deep inside your pocket tight,
A glowing little spark of pure delight.
Whenever you might feel a little blue,
Just pop your hand right in to find it true.

Your pocket holds a giant hug from me,
To help you grow as happy as can be!
So march along and conquer all the fun,
My darling little superstar, you've won!

rhymes.title: The Goodbye Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
It is time to say goodbye to play,
And start our happy preschool day!
Put on your shoes and zip your coat so warm,
To keep you cozy through the morning storm.

Now open up your pocket for a treat,
A little magic secret, oh so sweet!
I fold a loving kiss and tuck it deep,
A tiny treasure for your heart to keep.

When big adventure comes along your way,
And you are busy having fun all day,
Just slide your fingers down inside the cloth,
And feel the magic take a gentle off.

It whispers that I love you very much,
Until we meet again for a real touch!
So wave bye-bye and give a happy cheer,
Your pocket magic always stays so near.

rhymes.title: The Brave Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Sometimes new places make us feel so shy,
We want to hide our faces and just sigh.
But you are brave and strong in every way,
And ready for the wonders of the day.

Let us make a special pocket charm,
To keep you safe and shield you from all harm.
I take a bouncy kiss and wrap it round,
The sweetest little secret to be found.

I place it in your pocket by your side,
Where all the magic kisses go to hide.
Whenever you feel nervous or unsure,
This cozy pocket charm is quite the cure.

Just squeeze your coat and feel the love inside,
With happiness and courage as your guide!
You go right out and show them what you do,
Because my special love is right with you.

rhymes.title: The Playground Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The slides are high, the swings are flying fast,
We want to make this playtime moment last!
You run and jump across the grassy green,
The happiest explorer ever seen.

If you should take a tumble on the ground,
And shed a little tear without a sound,
Do not forget the treasure in your jeans,
The greatest little helper ever seen!

Just tap your pocket where the magic dwells,
And listen to the little fairy bells.
A brand new kiss is waiting just for you,
To wipe away the tears and start anew.

It heals the bump and makes you feel so grand,
The very best affection in the land!
So up you get to climb and slide and play,
Your pocket magic saves another day.

rhymes.title: The Sleepy Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The stars are peeking out so soft and bright,
It is time to say a cozy, sweet goodnight.
We wash our hands and brush our teeth so white,
And tuck our blankets in before the light.

We empty out our pockets for the bed,
And rest each sleepy little weary head.
We take our magic kisses out to share,
And float them gently through the evening air.

One goes upon your cheek to keep you warm,
Safe away from every kind of storm.
The others stay right here inside your reach,
To teach you all the dreams they have to teach.

Close your eyes and breathe the quiet deep,
As little magic kisses watch you sleep.
Tomorrow brings another brand new start,
With pocket kisses resting on your heart.

rhymes.title: The Morning Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The morning sun is shining bright,
It is time to wake up and start the light.
Mommy bends down with a smile so sweet,
To make my little day complete.

She takes my hand and opens wide,
And tucks a magic kiss inside.
I fold it up and hold it tight,
Just like a little glowing light.

When I go off to nursery school,
I follow every happy rule.
And if I ever start to miss,
I just pop open my pocket kiss.

I feel a warm hug on my cheek,
The very best start of the week!

rhymes.title: The Goodbye Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Put on your shoes and grab your bear,
We have great adventures to share.
Before you walk out through the door,
There is one thing we need much more.

Stretch out your hand and make a cup,
So mommy can fill your magic up.
A tiny kiss goes in your palm,
To keep your little spirit calm.

Zip up your pocket, keep it safe,
Right beside your favorite page.
When you feel sad or feeling blue,
Just remember I love you.

Rub your pocket, feel the glow,
Off to happy days you go!

rhymes.title: The Naptime Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The afternoon is quiet and still,
The sleepy wind blows down the hill.
It is time to rest your heavy head,
And snuggle nicely in your bed.

Before you close your eyes so deep,
And drift away into your sleep,
I drop a kiss inside your pocket low,
Where only happy dreams can go.

Keep your fingers curled up tight,
To hold the magic through the night.
When you wake up feeling fine,
That little kiss will still be mine.

Sleepy baby, rest your head,
Tucked so cozy in your bed.

rhymes.title: The Playground Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Out on the slide and swings so high,
We touch the bottom of the sky.
Run and jump and laugh and play,
Have a super duper day.

If you take a tumble down,
There is no need to wear a frown.
Just reach into your pocket deep,
Where secrets and magic secrets sleep.

Take out the kiss I gave to you,
And watch the boo-boos vanish too.
It makes you brave and makes you strong,
So you can laugh and sing along.

Back to the fun you go, my dear,
With nothing in the world to fear.

rhymes.title: The Bedtime Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The stars are twinkling in the sky,
The sleepy moon is floating high.
Bath is done and teeth are brushed,
Now the noisy house is hushed.

Time to wear your cozy pyjamas red,
And crawl into your little bed.
I give you one more pocket kiss,
A loving little bedtime bliss.

Press it to your cheek so warm,
Safe away from any storm.
Close your eyes and breathe in deep,
As angels watch you fall asleep.

Sweet dreams to you until the dawn,
Our magic kiss will linger on.

rhymes.title: The Morning Magic Pocket
rhymes.text:
When morning sun begins to shine,
It is a brand new day of mine.
Mommy gives a kiss so sweet,
To make my little morning neat.

She presses it right on my hand,
The softest kiss in all the land.
I close my fingers very tight,
To keep the magic feeling right.

I put it safely in my pocket,
Right beside my shiny locket.
When daycare door comes into view,
I know just what I have to do.

I reach inside and take it out,
And give a happy little shout.
The magic kiss is here with me,
As happy as a honeybee!

rhymes.title: The Playground Brave Pocket
rhymes.text:
The slide is high, the swing is wide,
I keep my special kiss inside.
Whenever I am feeling shy,
I watch the fluffy clouds go by.

I tap my pocket on my coat,
Just like a little sailing boat.
My mommy's kiss is waiting there,
To show me how much she does care.

I pull it out and touch my cheek,
And I am brave the very week.
No scary things can bother me,
I play so wild and wander free.

It fills my heart with so much glow,
I dance around and tap my toe.
Thank you, pocket, safe and deep,
The sweetest secret I can keep.

rhymes.title: The Goodbye Wave Kiss
rhymes.text:
It is time to wave goodbye,
No need to make a little cry.
My pocket holds a secret prize,
Right beneath the sunny skies.

A magic kiss is tucked away,
To help me through the busy day.
When teacher sings a happy song,
I clap my hands and sing along.

If ever I feel sad or blue,
I know exactly what to do.
I pat my pocket, warm and bright,
And everything is feeling right.

The kiss is magic, pure and true,
It smiles at me and says hello to you.
I keep it close until the night,
When stars are shining soft and bright.

rhymes.title: The Sharing Pocket Secret
rhymes.text:
My pocket is a special box,
Without a key, without a locks.
It holds a kiss from yesterday,
To help me through my happy play.

My friend is crying on the floor,
Beside the yellow classroom door.
I tell him not to feel so sad,
And make his little spirit glad.

I say I have a magic charm,
To keep us safe from any harm.
I share my pocket secret now,
And make a little happy bow.

He smiles and wipes away a tear,
And whispers that he has no fear.
Our pockets hold our mommy's love,
Sent down from sunny skies above.

rhymes.title: The Bedtime Pocket Return
rhymes.text:
The stars are out, the moon is high,
The sleepy owls begin to fly.
My pocket kept the kiss all day,
While I was busy with my play.

Now bedtime stories are all read,
And I am tucked into my bed.
It is time to let the magic out,
Without a whisper or a shout.

I open up my hand so slow,
And watch the sleepy magic go.
It flies right up to touch my nose,
And tickles down to reach my toes.

Thank you, pocket, for your care,
When mommy cannot be right there.
Tomorrow we will start anew,
With magic kisses, sweet and true.

rhymes.title: The Morning Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The morning sun begins to glow,
It is time to start the day, you know.
We brush our teeth so shiny and bright,
And squeeze a pocket kiss so tight.

Slip it in your pocket, safe and deep,
A little love for you to keep.
When you feel a little sad or blue,
Just remember I am loving you.

Put on your shoes and zip your coat,
With happy feelings in your throat.
March to the door with a big, big smile,
We will be apart for a little while.

But reach in your pocket whenever you please,
And take out a kiss with a magical squeeze!

rhymes.title: The Goodbye Hug and Kiss
rhymes.text:
It is time to wave goodbye today,
As off to school you march away.
Before you go through the big front door,
Let us tap your pocket and add some more.

A magic kiss goes right inside,
Where tiny secrets love to hide.
Button it up so it will not pop,
Keep it right there at the very top.

When you play upon the slide so high,
Or watch the fluffy clouds float by,
If you need a hug from your mommy dear,
Just pop your hand in and find it here.

Feel the warmth right on your hand,
The sweetest magic in the land!

rhymes.title: The Playground Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Out on the playground, swinging high,
Reaching up to touch the sky.
Sometimes knees get a little bump,
Or you take a funny little thump.

Do not worry, do not cry,
Just wipe a tear from your little eye.
Reach in your pocket, quick and neat,
To find a magic kiss a-treat.

Press it gently on your knee,
Watch it make you happy and free.
Back to the swings and the yellow slide,
Running around with joyful pride.

Your pocket kiss is a special friend,
That makes you smile right to the end.

rhymes.title: The Quiet Rest Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Quiet time is here at last,
When all the busy games have passed.
Lie down softly on your mat,
And listen to the sleeping cat.

Sometimes rest can feel so long,
So let us sing a sleepy song.
Touch your pocket on your chest,
To help your body go to rest.

Take the magic kiss you stored,
While you played and jumped and roared.
Hold it close against your heart,
As you drift off and dream apart.

Sleepy eyes begin to close,
Right down to your tiny toes.

rhymes.title: The Evening Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The stars are peeping in the night,
Batting lashes soft and bright.
We washed our face and combed our hair,
And said our nighttime, sleepy prayer.

Before you crawl into your bed,
With a pillow soft beneath your head,
Let us check your pocket one last time,
With a sleepy little nursery rhyme.

There is a magic kiss waiting inside,
Ready to take a gentle ride.
Keep it warm throughout the night,
Until the morning brings the light.

Close your eyes and drift away,
We will find more magic in the day!

rhymes.title: The Morning Magic Pocket
rhymes.text:
When morning sun begins to glow,
It is time to start the show.
Mommy gives a magic kiss,
Just like this and just like this!

Put it deep inside your coat,
Right beside your woolly boat.
Zip it up and hold it tight,
Keep that little kiss in sight.

Walking down the hallway floor,
Stepping right outside the door.
If you miss me while away,
Reach inside and start your day.

Take the magic kiss right out,
Give a happy little shout!
Press it right upon your cheek,
Love is all the strength you seek.

rhymes.title: Goodbye Hug and Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Time to say goodbye at school,
Following the golden rule.
Give a hug and give a squeeze,
Listen to the teacher, please.

Daddy makes a smiling face,
Leaves a kiss in just one place.
Right inside your pocket deep,
Safe and cozy, fast asleep.

When the tears begin to fall,
Or you feel so very small,
Put your hand into your clothes,
Right up underneath your nose.

Find the magic kiss inside,
Wear it with a point of pride.
Feel the love begin to grow,
Off to happy play you go!

rhymes.title: The Playground Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
Running fast upon the slide,
With your arms spread high and wide.
Climbing up the ladder tall,
Never fear a little fall.

Is your courage getting low?
Do you need a little glow?
Check your pocket, do not wait,
Magic kisses feel so great!

Pull it out and toss it high,
Right up to the sunny sky.
Catch it back into your hand,
Best magician in the land!

Press it gently on your heart,
Now you're ready for the part.
Smile and run to join the fun,
Brighter than the morning sun.

rhymes.title: Naptime Pocket Keeper
rhymes.text:
Now the room is dark and still,
Resting on the little hill.
Pull the blanket to your chin,
Let the sleepy time begin.

Did you drop your pocket kiss?
We can never, ever miss!
Keep it hidden in your palm,
Breathing slowly, soft and calm.

Close your eyes and drift away,
Dreaming of another day.
Close your fingers like a shell,
Everything is going well.

Even when you fast asleep,
That sweet kiss is yours to keep.
Morning light will soon appear,
With your loving family near.

rhymes.title: Evening Pocket Treasure
rhymes.text:
Evening stars begin to peep,
Time to wind up from the leap.
Put away your toys and blocks,
Change your shirt and fuzzy socks.

Check your pocket one last time,
Making up a sleepy rhyme.
Is the magic kiss still there?
 floating softly in the air?

Take it out before you creep,
Into bed to fall asleep.
Press it gently on your nose,
Down all the way to your toes.

Now the magic fills your head,
Tucked so safely in your bed.
Tomorrow is another day,
With more magic on the way!

rhymes.title: The Morning Pocket Kiss
rhymes.text:
The morning sun is shining bright,
It time to wake up and feel the light.
We put on socks and shoes so neat,
With happy jumps on both our feet.

Before you go outside to play,
I have a secret for your day.
I pop a kiss inside your hand,
The sweetest kiss in all the land.

Now close your pocket, tight and small,
So it won't ever slip or fall.
Keep it right there close to your chest,
Because you are simply the best!

When you feel lonely at the door,
Just press your pocket and smile more.
Open it wide and let it fly,
Right to your cheek as time goes by!

rhymes.title: The School-Time Hug-Away
rhymes.text:
Goodbye is coming, do not cry,
We have a trick, just you and I.
Hold out your pocket nice and wide,
To see what magic is inside.

A giant kiss goes swoosh and zoom,
Right in your pocket, making room.
Zip it up fast with one, two, three,
To keep it safe for you and me.

When you are painting at the chair,
Remember mommy's love is there.
Just tap your pocket on your knee,
And smile big for all to see.

It whispers that I love you so,
Wherever little feet may go.
So wipe away that little tear,
My pocket kiss is always near!

rhymes.title: The Playground Brave-Heart Charm
rhymes.text:
The big slide looks so tall and high,
Almost reaching up to the sky.
Do you feel nervous? That is okay,
We have a helper for your play.

Reach in your pocket, warm and deep,
Find the little secret we keep.
It is a glowing pocket kiss,
To fill your heart with pure bliss.

Put it right onto your little cheek,
It makes you brave and strong, not weak.
Now climb the ladder, step by step,
With happy bounces in your pep!

Whee goes the slide as down you go,
Cheering loudly, 'Look at me, oh!'
Your pocket kiss did lead the way,
Hopping through a sunny day.

rhymes.title: The Naptime Cozy Cuddle
rhymes.text:
The sleepy stars begin to peep,
It is almost time to go to sleep.
Lie on your blanket, soft and grand,
With sleepy toes and a gentle hand.

Before your eyelids start to close,
I tap a kiss right on your nose.
Then catch it quickly in your palm,
To keep you cozy, sweet, and calm.

Slip it inside your pajama fold,
Worth more than silver or bright gold.
Close your eyes and breathe in deep,
As you drift off into your sleep.

Dream sweet dreams of blocks and toys,
Of jumping frogs and happy joys.
Your pocket kiss is by your side,
While bedtime angels take a ride.

rhymes.title: The Goodbye Wave and Smile
rhymes.text:
The car is waiting by the street,
With rumbling engine and tires neat.
It is time to go to grandma's house,
Quiet and busy like a mouse.

I catch a kiss and make it spin,
Right where your pocket fold begins.
Snap it shut like a turtle shell,
So it can guard your magic spell.

Wave goodbye with a happy hand,
Off you go to a wonderland.
Whenever you miss me just a mite,
Your pocket kiss will make it right.

Tap it gently, feel the glow,
Because I love you more than you know.
A happy day is here for you,
With skies of bright and sunny blue!

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped right out of his cozy bed. Stretch, stretch, stretch went Sam's long furry ears! Sam was growing big, and today was a very special day. Mommy Bunny smiled and said, 'Good morning, Sam! Today we are going to practice saying your name to everyone we meet.' Sam giggled, 'My name is Sam!' He zipped up his bright red jacket all by himself. Zip, zip! You are getting so independent, Sam,' cheered Mommy. Together, they skipped down the pathway to the sunny park. At the sandbox, Sam saw a fluffy bear cub building a tall, sparkly sandcastle. Sam took a deep breath, puffed out his chest, and walked right up. 'Hi! My name is Sam,' he said in a loud, proud, happy voice. The bear cub stopped digging and smiled a big, toothy grin. 'Hello, Sam! My name is Barnaby. Do you want to help me build a big wall?' Barnaby asked. Sam clapped his paws together with absolute joy. 'Yes, please!' he cheered. They worked together, packing wet sand and singing silly little songs. Sam learned that sharing your name is like opening a magic door to new friendships. Whenever Sam felt a little shy, he remembered the warm feeling in his tummy and how nice it felt to say hello. By lunchtime, Sam had two new friends and a gigantic sandcastle. Mommy Bunny gave him a giant hug and whispered, 'I am so proud of you, Sam.' Sam felt as brave as a lion and as happy as a lark. He skipped all the way home, ready for his afternoon nap, dreaming of all the friends he would say hello to tomorrow. What a wonderful day it was for little Sam!

stories.title: Sam's Library Adventure
stories.text: Ding-dong went the little brass bell as Sam and Daddy walked into the big, quiet library. Sam loved the library because it smelled like old paper and held millions of magical picture books. Today, Sam had a very important job to do. 'Remember, Sam,' Daddy whispered gently, 'when we check out our books, we tell the librarian our name.' Sam nodded solemnly. 'Okay, Daddy. My name is Sam!' First, Sam waddled over to the dinosaur section and found a wonderful book about a green T-Rex who loved to dance. He hugged the heavy book tightly against his chest and tiptoed over to the tall wooden desk. Behind the desk sat Mrs. Gable, a kind librarian with sparkly glasses and a warm smile. She peered over her glasses and said, 'Well hello there, little explorer. What book have you found today?' Sam felt his cheeks get a tiny bit warm, but he remembered how good it felt to use his big-boy voice. He stood up tall, smiled brightly, and said clearly, 'Hi! My name is Sam, and I want to read about dancing dinosaurs!' Mrs. Gable clapped her hands together softly. 'What a fantastic choice, Sam! It is so very nice to meet you.' She stamped the inside cover of the book with a loud THUMP-THUMP. Sam giggled at the funny sound. Mrs. Gable handed the book back, and Sam said, 'Thank you so much!' Daddy gave Sam a high-five as they walked back out into the golden afternoon sunlight. Sam held his library book like a precious treasure all the way home. He felt so proud of himself for speaking up clearly and making Mrs. Gable smile. That night at bedtime, as Daddy read the dinosaur book aloud, Sam drifted off to sleep with a happy heart, excited for his next big adventure where he would share his name again.

stories.title: Sam at the Playground
stories.text: The afternoon sun was shining brightly, and the park was filled with the happy sounds of children laughing and playing. Sam stood at the edge of the playground holding his favorite yellow bouncy ball. He wanted to play on the giant red slide, but three other little animals were already taking turns zooming down. Sam took a gentle breath and held his ball tight. He knew that joining in was easy if you just used your words. Mommy gave him an encouraging thumbs-up from the nearby wooden bench. Sam took three brave steps forward until he was right next to the shiny metal steps. A little fox cub with a bushy tail looked down and paused. Sam smiled warmly, remembering his manners. 'Hi! My name is Sam,' he said in a sweet, clear voice. 'Can I please play on the slide too?' The fox cub's face lit up with a big, friendly smile. 'Hello, Sam! I am Felix. Of course you can! You can go right after me!' Felix zoomed down the slide with a wheee! and landed softly in the woodchips with a giggle. Sam climbed up the ladder, rung by rung, feeling very proud and capable. When it was his turn, he sat down at the top, looked out at the sunny park, and slid all the way down with a joyful shout. Wheee! When he reached the bottom, Felix and a little squirrel named Pip cheered for him. Sam rolled his yellow ball to Pip, and they started a fun game of catch. Sam learned that introducing yourself makes everyone feel welcome and happy. When it was time to go home, Sam waved goodbye to his new friends. 'Goodbye! See you next time, I'm Sam!' he called out. Mommy hugged him tight as they walked home together under the evening stars.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello to the Sun
stories.text:
Good morning, little sunshine! Wake up, stretch your arms up high, and wiggle your toes. Today is a brand new day full of fun adventures. Do you know who is ready for a wonderful day? Sam is! Sam sits right up on the edge of the cozy bed and rubs his sleepy eyes. 'Good morning, room!' Sam whispers with a happy little smile. Today, Sam is learning all about introducing himself to new friends and feeling proud of his very own special name. 

First, it is time to get dressed. Sam picks out a bright yellow shirt with a happy puppy on the front. 'Look, Mommy!' Sam says, pointing to the puppy. Mommy claps her hands. 'Great job getting dressed, Sam!' Next, it is time for a yummy breakfast. Sam sits in his big chair and drinks a cup of warm milk. Yummy, yummy in my tummy! 

Ring, ring! The doorbell goes. Oh boy, it is time for playgroup! Sam puts on his red shoes, one and two. He grabs his favorite blue backpack. When Sam and Mommy walk through the big green park gate, they see Maya and Leo building a tall tower out of shiny blocks. Sam takes a deep, brave breath. He walks right up to the block tower with a big, friendly grin. 

'Hi, my name is Sam!' he says in a loud, clear, happy voice. Maya looks up and beams. 'Hi Sam! Do you want to help us build this tall tower?' Leo asks, handing Sam a big red block. Sam takes the block and places it right on the very top. 'Yes, please!' Sam giggles. Introducing himself was so easy and made him feel so proud. 

As the morning sun shines down, Sam plays happily with his new friends. They share the blocks, laugh at silly jokes, and run in the soft green grass. Sam learns that saying hello is the magical key to making wonderful new friends. When it is time to go home, Sam waves goodbye with a joyful wave. 'Goodbye, Maya! Goodbye, Leo! See you tomorrow!' What a truly fantastic day it has been for Sam!

stories.title: Sam at the Park Playground
stories.text:
The afternoon sun is warm and golden, perfect for a trip to the bustling neighborhood park! Sam holds tightly to Daddy’s big warm hand as they skip down the sidewalk. Hop, hop, go Sam's feet! When they reach the playground, Sam's eyes go wide. There are slippery slides, swinging swings, and climbing walls. Sam loves the park so much. 

Daddy helps Sam take off his jacket. 'Go have fun, Sam, but remember to be kind and use your polite words,' Daddy reminds him gently. Sam nods eagerly. He walks right over to the orange slide where a little girl with shiny pigtails is waiting for her turn. She looks a little shy, hugging her teddy bear tight. Sam wants to play together, so he remembers what he practiced at home. 

Sam stands up nice and tall, puts his hands on his hips, and flashes his brightest, warmest smile. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he says cheerfully to the little girl. The girl hugs her teddy bear a little looser and smiles back. 'Hi Sam! My name is Chloe. Do you want to go down the slide with me?' Chloe asks happily. Sam claps his hands together. 'Yes! Let us go!' 

Sam climbs up the ladder, step by step, holding onto the yellow railing. One, two, three steps up! He sits down at the very top, takes a deep breath, and whoosh! Down they go, laughing all the way to the soft rubber ground. Whee! That was so much fun. 

Chloe and Sam spend the whole afternoon playing together. They swing high up into the clouds and dig deep holes in the sandbox to find treasure rocks. Sam feels so happy inside his heart. Saying hello to Chloe turned a quiet afternoon into a wonderful playdate. When it is time to head home for dinner, Sam gives Chloe a friendly high-five. 'Bye-bye, Chloe!' Sam calls out. Sam is getting bigger and braver every single day, and he is so proud of his wonderful name!

stories.title: Sam Meets the Library Dog
stories.text:
Shh, listen! Today is a very special day because Sam and Grandma are visiting the cozy town library. The library is a magical place filled with thousands of colorful picture books about roaring dinosaurs, sleepy bears, and flying rockets. Sam tiptoes inside, making quiet, squeaky shoe sounds on the shiny wooden floor. 

Grandma leads Sam over to the children's reading corner, where a soft blue rug is laid out with lots of big pillows. But wait! Who is sitting on the big blue pillow? It is Barnaby! Barnaby is a very sweet, fluffy golden dog who wears a red vest and loves to listen to stories. Sam gently pets Barnaby's soft golden ears. Barnaby wags his happy tail thump, thump, thump against the rug. 

Next to Barnaby sits a kind librarian named Mr. Paul, holding a stack of books. Mr. Paul looks up and sees Sam standing there. 'Hello there, little reader,' Mr. Paul says with a warm, welcoming smile. Sam remembers to use his brave voice. He stands up straight and looks right at Mr. Paul. 

'Hi, my name is Sam!' Sam announces proudly. Mr. Paul's eyes light up with joy. 'Well, hello, Sam! We are so very happy to have you at our library storytime today. Would you like to sit right next to Barnaby?' Mr. Paul asks kindly. Sam nods his head up and down very fast. 'Oh, yes please!' 

Sam sits down on the comfy cushion right next to the fluffy dog. Barnaby nudges Sam's knee with his wet black nose, and Sam giggles softly. Mr. Paul opens a big book about a little bunny who loses his favorite red balloon. Sam listens closely, turning the thick paper pages ever so carefully. 

After storytime, Sam gets to pick out two books to take home. He thanks Mr. Paul and gives Barnaby one last gentle pat on the head. 'Goodbye, Barnaby! Goodbye, Mr. Paul!' Sam says happily. Walking home with Grandma, Sam holds his new library books tight. He loves being Sam, and he loves making new friends everywhere he goes!

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped right out of his cozy bed. Stretch, stretch, stretch went his long, fuzzy ears! Today was a very special day because Sam was going to the park to meet new friends. Mommy Bunny helped Sam put on his bright yellow t-shirt and his shiny red shoes. Sam looked in the mirror and gave a big, happy smile. 'Good morning, Sam!' he whispered to his reflection. As they walked down the green path, Sam saw Oliver Owl sitting on a low branch. Sam felt a tiny flutter in his tummy, but he remembered to be brave. He took a deep breath, stood up tall, and waved his paw. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he said in a loud, clear, friendly voice. Oliver Owl blinked his big round eyes and smiled right back. 'Hello, Sam! I am Oliver. Do you want to play hide and seek?' Sam jumped up and down with pure joy. 'Oh, yes please!' Together, they played behind the big green bushes, giggling and counting to ten. Sam learned that saying hello is like opening a magical door to a brand new adventure. Whenever he met someone new, he felt so proud. By lunchtime, Sam had made three new friends: Oliver Owl, Bella Bear, and Pip Penguin. They all shared a yummy picnic basket filled with crunchy carrots and sweet berries. Sam patted his tummy and gave a contented sigh. It was such a wonderful feeling to introduce himself and hear everyone say his name. When the golden sun began to dip behind the hills, it was time to go home. Sam waved goodbye to his friends with a happy heart. 'Goodbye, see you tomorrow!' he called out. Snuggle time at home felt extra warm that evening. Mommy Bunny gave him a gentle kiss on his forehead. 'I am so proud of you, Sam, for being brave and saying hello today,' she whispered lovingly. Sam closed his eyes, dreaming of all the friends he would greet tomorrow.

stories.title: Sam at the Library
stories.text: The library was Sam's favorite place in the whole wide world. It smelled like old paper, sunshine, and quiet cuddles. Today, Sam had a special mission to find the biggest book about dinosaurs with the shiny silver spots. He held tightly to Daddy's hand as they walked through the tall wooden doors. Right by the welcome desk sat Librarian Lily, wearing round glasses and a bright purple sweater. Sam wanted to check out the books, but he knew it was polite to introduce himself first. He let go of Daddy's hand for just a moment and walked up to the big desk. Sam puffed out his chest, pointed right to himself, and said with a proud grin, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' Librarian Lily looked down over her glasses and her face lit up like a birthday candle. 'Well, hello there, Sam! It is so very nice to meet you. Welcome to our library!' she said cheerfully. Sam felt a warm, bubbly feeling of happiness spread all the way from his toes to the tips of his ears. He was doing such a big-boy thing! 'Are you looking for a special story today, Sam?' Librarian Lily asked gently. 'Yes, please! I want a dinosaur book,' Sam replied excitedly. Librarian Lily clapped her hands together and led him down the blue carpeted aisle. She pulled out a giant green book that sparkled in the light. It was even better than Sam had imagined! 'Thank you so much,' Sam said politely, holding the heavy book with both of his strong hands. 'You are very welcome, Sam,' Lily smiled warmly. As they sat down in the cozy reading corner, Daddy whispered, 'I am so impressed with how nicely you introduced yourself today, Sam.' Sam smiled proudly and opened the first page of the roaring dinosaur book. Learning his name and sharing it with others made the world feel so friendly, warm, and bright. It was truly a fantastic day for little Sam.

stories.title: Sam's Playground Adventure
stories.text: The afternoon air was warm and smelled like fresh-cut grass as Sam skipped toward the big red slide. The park was buzzing with giggles, running feet, and the gentle swish of the swings. Sam loved the swings the most because they made him feel like he was flying high up into the fluffy white clouds. But today, the big blue swing next to his was already occupied by a little puppy dog wearing a polka-dot bandana. Sam stopped in his tracks. He wanted to swing high, too, and maybe make a new friend along the way. Instead of feeling shy, Sam remembered what Mommy always taught him. He walked right over, stood near the sandbox, and gave a bright, cheerful wave. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he announced proudly. The puppy dog stopped swinging with a gentle squeak and hopped off the seat. Her tail wagged so fast it looked like a happy little windmill. 'Hi, Sam! My name is Daisy,' the puppy barked playfully. 'Do you want to race to the bottom of the slide?' Sam's eyes sparkled with excitement. 'Oh, yes! Ready, set, go!' they cheered together. Pitter-patter went their feet as they scrambled up the wooden steps of the slide. Side by side, Sam and Daisy zoomed down with giant giggles bubbling up from their tummies. Whee! They landed in the soft woodchips with huge grins. They played together all afternoon, building towering castles in the sandbox and sharing colorful plastic buckets. Sam realized that introducing himself was like waving a magic wand that turned strangers into wonderful playmates. When the playground lights flickered on, it was time for dinner. Sam waved happily to Daisy. 'Bye-bye, Daisy! See you next time!' On the walk home, Sam held Daddy's hand and swung his arms back and forth. 'I made a new friend today, Daddy, because I told her my name!' Daddy smiled warmly and squeezed his little hand. 'You are growing up so fast, Sam, and I am so proud of your brave and friendly heart.' Sam smiled all the way home, ready for his next big adventure.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Today is a very special day. Do you know why? Because today is the day we practice saying our name loud and clear, just like our friend Sam! Sam wakes up with a big stretch, reaching his little hands all the way up to the ceiling. Big yawn! Good morning, ceiling. Sam climbs out of his cozy bed and puts on his favorite yellow socks. One sock, two socks, wiggle those toes! Now Sam is ready to start his wonderful day. Downstairs, the kitchen smells like warm toast and sweet bananas. Mommy smiles and says, 'Good morning, sweetie! Who are you?' Sam stands up very tall. He takes a deep breath and says with a big, happy smile, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' Mommy claps her hands together and gives Sam a giant, squeezable hug. 'That is the most wonderful name in the whole wide world, Sam!' Daddy comes in with a cup of juice and asks, 'And who might you be?' Sam puffs out his chest proudly and says again, loud and clear, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' Daddy laughs a happy laugh and gives Sam a high-five. High-five, Sam! You did it! Saying your name is like sharing a little piece of your own special magic with the world. Later on, Sam goes outside to play in the sunny park. He sees a friendly pup wagging its tail and a little girl building a castle in the sandbox. Sam walks right up to the sandbox, takes a deep breath, and says, 'Hi, my name is Sam! Can I play too?' The little girl smiles and hands Sam a shiny red shovel. 'Hi Sam! I am Lily. Let us build a big castle together!' Sam feels so proud and happy inside his heart. He learned that telling people your name is the very best way to make a brand new friend. Every time Sam says his name, it is like opening a door to a new adventure. You are doing such a fantastic job learning how to say your name, too. Give yourself a big pat on the back, just like Sam!

stories.title: Sam's Name Tag Adventure
stories.text: Ring, ring! Goes the little clock. It is time to wake up and shine! Meet Sam. Sam is a happy toddler who loves adventures big and small. Today, Sam and Mommy are going to the community center for a fun music class. Before they walk out the front door, Mommy holds up a shiny, colorful sticker. It is a special name tag! Mommy writes the letters S-A-M right on the shiny paper. 'Look, Sam,' says Mommy softly, 'this sticker tells everyone your name.' Sam looks down at his shirt where Mommy gently presses the sticker. It has bright blue letters and a smiley face right in the middle. Sam touches it with one gentle finger. Smooth! 'My name is Sam,' he whispers with a giggle. Mommy ties Sam's little red shoes and they walk out the door hand in hand. When they arrive at the music class, there are lots of other children playing with drums and shaking colorful maracas. Sam feels a tiny bit shy at first, hiding just behind Mommy's leg. But then the kind teacher, Mr. Tom, walks over with a warm, gentle smile. 'Hello there!' says Mr. Tom. 'Are you new here? What is your name?' Sam remembers his special sticker. He looks down at the letters S-A-M, and then he looks right up at Mr. Tom. Sam takes a deep breath and says in a brave, happy voice, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' Mr. Tom smiles even bigger. 'Welcome to music class, Sam! We are so glad you are here with us today.' Sam feels a warm, cozy feeling bubble up inside his tummy. He marches right over to the big circle and picks up a shiny tambourine. Shake, shake, shake, goes the tambourine! Sam plays music and dances all around the room. He even tells the girl sitting next to him, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' She smiles back and shares her yellow drumstick. Sam learns that telling people your name is easy and fun. You are just like Sam, ready to share your wonderful name with the whole wide world!

stories.title: Sam Meets the Playground
stories.text: The sun is shining brightly in the blue sky, and the little yellow slide is waiting for some fun. Sam and Daddy are at the park! Sam loves the park because there are swings to swing on, grass to run on, and friendly children to meet. Sam runs over to the big green sandbox where a boy is building a tall mountain of sand. Sam wants to play with the sand mountain, but he is not sure how to ask. Daddy kneels down next to Sam and gives him a gentle, reassuring squeeze on the shoulder. 'Remember, Sam,' says Daddy, 'whenever you want to make a new friend, you can just walk up, smile, and say hello and tell them your name.' Sam nods his head. He takes three brave steps toward the sandbox. Step one, step two, step three! The other boy looks up and smiles. Sam takes a big breath, stands up as tall as an oak tree, and says in his happiest voice, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' The boy's face lights up with a giant grin. 'Hi Sam! My name is Leo. Do you want to help me dig a deep tunnel?' Sam claps his hands together with joy. 'Yes, please!' Sam sits down in the warm sand and starts digging with a blue plastic shovel. Dig, dig, dig! They work together as a team, making the best tunnel the park has ever seen. Leo asks, 'Sam, do you want to race down the slide with me?' Sam jumps up, feeling so proud. 'Let us go, Leo!' They run over to the slide together, climbing up the steps one by one. Wee! Down they go, laughing all the way to the soft grass below. Sam feels so happy inside because he was brave enough to use his voice and say his name. Every time you say your name, you are being brave and kind, just like Sam. You are growing up so strong and wonderful every single day!

stories.title: Sam Says Hello to the Sun
stories.text:
Good morning, little sunshine! Wake up, wake up! Today is a very special day because today we are going to learn how to say our name loud and clear. Can you say hello with me? Hello! 

Sam stretches his little arms up high, touching the ceiling. Reach, reach, reach! Sam yawns a big toddler yawn and rubs his sleepy eyes. Time to get out of cozy bed! Mommy and Daddy are waiting in the sunny kitchen, and they have yummy pancakes ready for breakfast. 

Sam puts on his favorite bright yellow shirt. Pop goes his head through the hole! "Ta-da!" giggles Sam. He looks in the mirror and smiles at his happy reflection. He sees two big brown eyes, a button nose, and a super-duper friendly smile. 

At the breakfast table, Daddy pours a cup of milk. "Good morning, little helper," says Daddy with a warm hug. Sam wants to answer back proudly. He takes a deep breath and puffs out his chest. "Hi! My name is Sam!" he says, using his big kid voice. 

Mommy claps her hands together and smiles big. "Good job, Sam! That is a wonderful name!" Sam feels so proud inside, like a glowing star. Saying his name makes him feel strong and brave. 

After breakfast, it is time to put on shoes. Sam finds his blue sneakers with the velcro straps. Press, press, press goes the strap! One shoe is on, and the other shoe is on. Sam is ready for the day. 

Outside, the gentle wind whispers in the trees. Sam walks out the door to play in the soft green grass. A friendly puppy wags its tail nearby. Sam stops, stands up tall, and says with a big grin, "Hi! My name is Sam!" The puppy gives a happy bark. Sam laughs and claps his hands. What a wonderful morning for a little boy with a wonderful name!

stories.title: Sam at the Park Playground
stories.text:
The park is so much fun today! The slide is shiny, the swings go high into the blue sky, and the sandbox is filled with warm, golden sand. Sam loves the park very much. He holds Mommy's hand tightly as they walk through the green gate. 

"Look, Mommy, a big slide!" cheers Sam. He lets go of Mommy's hand and runs over to the wooden steps. One step, two steps, three steps up! Sam holds onto the sturdy railing. Up, up, up he goes until he reaches the very top. He sits down carefully, gives a little wiggle, and wheee! Down he slides, landing on the soft rubber floor with a happy giggle. 

Near the sandbox, another little friend is building a tall, sandy castle. The friend has a red bucket and a blue shovel. Sam wants to say hello and maybe share some toys. Taking turns is a wonderful way to make new friends! 

Sam walks over slowly, stepping softly in the sand. He stands up very straight, just like a tall tree, and takes a big breath. He wants to use his kindest, happiest voice. "Hi! My name is Sam!" he says with a bright smile. 

The other little friend stops digging and looks up. A big smile spreads across the friend's face. "Hi Sam! My name is Lily! Do you want to help me make a moat for my castle?" 

"Yes, please!" says Sam happily. Sam sits down in the warm sand and starts digging with his hands. Scoop, scoop, scoop goes the sand. Together, Sam and Lily build the biggest, bestest castle in the whole wide sandbox. They decorate it with shiny green leaves and smooth round pebbles. 

Mommy watches from the wooden bench and smiles warmly. She gives Sam a gentle thumbs-up. Sam feels so happy inside his heart. Introducing himself was so easy and fun. "I am Sam, and I am a great friend," he whispers to himself. As the afternoon sun begins to set, Sam waves goodbye to Lily. What a marvelous day at the park!

stories.title: Sam's Library Adventure
stories.text:
Shh, listen! Can you hear the quiet whispers of all the wonderful books waiting on the shelves? Today is library day, and Sam is going on a quiet, magical book adventure with Daddy. The library is a big room filled with tall shelves of colorful stories about animals, trucks, and faraway magical kingdoms. 

Sam walks very softly on the carpet. Tip-toe, tip-toe go his little feet. He looks up at the towering shelves filled with books of every color of the rainbow. Red books, blue books, yellow books, and green books! Sam wants to find a story about a flying train. 

At the front desk, a very nice librarian named Mrs. Davis is sitting behind a large wooden counter. She wears sparkly purple glasses and has a basket of colorful star stickers. Sam walks right up to the counter, standing nice and tall. He wants to practice using his polite grown-up voice. 

Daddy holds Sam's hand gently to help him feel extra brave. Sam takes a little breath, smiles his biggest smile, and speaks up clearly. "Hi! My name is Sam!" he says to Mrs. Davis. 

Mrs. Davis's face lights up with joy. She leans down so she is eye-level with Sam. "Well, hello there, Sam! It is so very nice to meet you. Welcome to our library! Are you looking for a special storybook today?" 

Sam nods his head up and down eagerly. "Yes, please! A book about trains!" Mrs. Davis smiles warmly and reaches into her colorful sticker basket. She peels off a shiny gold star sticker and presses it carefully onto Sam's shirt. "For being such a polite young man," she says kindly. 

Sam looks down at his shiny gold star and beams with pride. He touches it gently with his finger. "Thank you, Mrs. Davis!" he says. With Daddy's help, Sam finds the best train book in the whole library. They sit together in a cozy yellow rocking chair to read. Sam turns the pages slowly, feeling so happy and proud to be big boy Sam.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped right out of his cozy bed. Stretch, stretch, goes Sam! Today is a very special day because Sam is going to practice saying his name to all his friends. Sam puts on his bright yellow shirt all by himself. Yay, Sam! You did it! Next, Sam brushes his teeth. Up and down, left and right, making sparkling bubbles in the sink. Splash, splash, goes the water. Sam smiles wide and shows his clean teeth. Now, Sam is ready to go outside and play in the big green yard. First, he sees Bella the butterfly fluttering near the colorful flowers. Sam takes a deep, happy breath. He stands up tall, puts his hands on his tummy, and uses his big, proud voice. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he says with a giant smile. Bella flutters her pretty wings and does a happy little loop-de-loop in the warm air. 'Hello, Sam!' she seems to chirp back. Sam feels so warm and happy inside. Next, Sam waddles over to Oliver the owl, who is sitting on a low tree branch. Sam remembers to stand up tall and use his strong, clear voice. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he says again, waving both of his fuzzy paws. Oliver blinks his big round eyes and hoots softly. 'Hoot-hoot, nice to meet you, Sam!' Sam giggles and claps his hands together. Saying your name is so much fun! It is like opening a magical door to make new friends. When Sam goes back inside for snack time, he tells his mama all about it. Mama gives him a big, loving hug and a warm kiss on his forehead. 'I am so proud of you, Sam,' Mama whispers softly. Sam eats his yummy apple slices and feels like the luckiest little bunny in the whole wide world. Tomorrow, Sam cannot wait to say his name again!

stories.title: Sam at the Park
stories.text: The park is full of wonderful sounds and bright colors today. Sam skips down the pathway, holding tight to Papa's warm hand. There are swings going high, slides going whee, and children laughing everywhere. Sam loves the park! Today, Sam wants to play on the big red slide. But first, he sees another little boy building a tall tower out of shiny wooden blocks in the sandbox. Sam stops and watches for a little moment. The tower looks so cool, wobbling gently in the breeze. Sam takes a deep breath, stands up very straight, and uses his friendly voice. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he says with a bright, sunny smile. The little boy looks up from his blocks and smiles back. 'Hi, Sam! My name is Leo,' the boy says kindly. Sam feels a little spark of joy dance right in his tummy. Making a new friend is wonderful! 'Can I help build the tower?' asks Sam politely. Leo nods and hands Sam a big square block. Together, Sam and Leo stack the blocks higher and higher until... crash! The tower tumbles down into a pile, and both boys laugh out loud. That was so much fun! After playing in the sandbox, Sam and Leo run over to the swings together. Papa pushes them gently, higher and higher into the breezy sky. Up, up, up they go, touching the fluffy white clouds. When it is time to go home, Sam waves goodbye to his new friend. 'Goodbye, Leo!' calls out Sam. 'Bye-bye, Sam!' Leo waves back with a big grin. Walking home with Papa, Sam skips and hums a happy little tune. He learned that introducing yourself opens the door to amazing adventures. Sam curls up in his bed that night, dreaming of all the fun friends he will meet tomorrow.

stories.title: Sam's Library Day
stories.text: Today is Tuesday, which means it is Library Day! Sam loves the library because it is filled with thousands of colorful books about animals, magic, and faraway lands. Sam walks inside hand-in-hand with Grandma, smelling the lovely, paper-y scent of all the stories. There is a special story circle happening on the big soft rug near the front window. Other children are already sitting down, listening to the librarian, Miss Clara, read a book about a friendly dragon. Sam wants to join the circle and listen to the magical story, too. He walks over quietly and finds a cozy spot right between two friendly kids. Miss Clara stops reading for a tiny second and looks at Sam with a warm, welcoming smile. Sam remembers his special greeting words. He takes a brave little breath, stands up straight, and uses his lovely, clear voice. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he announces proudly to the group. All the children turn around and smile brightly at him. 'Hello, Sam!' they chorus together in happy, musical voices. Miss Clara nods warmly. 'Welcome to storytime, Sam! We are so glad you are here today.' Sam sits criss-cross applesauce and listens to the wonderful dragon story, imagining he is flying high above the mountains. After the story is finished, Sam gets to pick out two books to take home. He picks one about a bouncy puppy and another about zooming rockets in space. As Grandma checks out the books at the front desk, Sam proudly tells the librarian his name one more time. 'Thank you, I am Sam!' he says cheerfully. The librarian beams and hands him his books. Sam hugs his new books tightly all the way home. What a wonderful day for Sam!

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped out of his cozy bed. Today was a very special day because Sam was going to the park to meet new friends! Sam washed his furry face with warm water and brushed his soft white teeth until they sparkled like little stars. 'Good morning, mirror!' giggled Sam with a big, happy smile. Next, Sam put on his favorite bright red shirt and tied his shoes all by himself. Thump, thump, went his happy feet. Downstairs, Mama Bunny had made a yummy breakfast of crunchy carrots and sweet berries. Sam ate every single bite, wiping his mouth with a clean napkin. 'All done!' cheered Sam proudly. When it was time to go, Mama and Sam walked down the sunny path to the big green park. At the sandbox, a little duckling was building a wonderful mud castle. Sam felt a tiny flutter in his tummy, but he remembered to take a nice deep breath. He took a brave little step forward, raised his paw, and used his loudest, happiest voice. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he said with a warm, friendly grin. The little duckling blinked his bright blue eyes and quacked happily. 'Hello, Sam! I am Pip!' Together, Sam and Pip filled buckets with wet sand and built the biggest castle in the whole wide park. Sam clapped his paws together. Introducing himself made him feel so brave and strong. When the golden sun began to sink behind the trees, it was time to head home for supper. Sam gave Pip a gentle wave goodbye. As they walked back under the evening stars, Sam held Mama's paw tightly. He whispered, 'Mama, making a new friend is the best feeling in the whole world.' Mama squeezed his paw and smiled. Sam was growing up so fast, learning how to share his wonderful name with everyone he met. And every night before he closed his eyes, Sam whispered a happy little hello to his sweet dreams.

stories.title: Sam's Library Adventure
stories.text: The library clock ticked softly: tick-tock, tick-tock. It was story hour at the cozy neighborhood library, and Sam the little bear was ready for a big adventure! Sam loved books with bright pictures and stories about roaring dinosaurs and flying wagons. He walked through the big wooden doors, holding Papa bear's large, warm hand. The library was full of tall shelves touching the ceiling and colorful rugs on the floor. In the corner, a friendly librarian named Mrs. Paws was reading a book about a squirrel who lost his acorns. Sam wanted to sit right in the front circle on the fluffy green rug. But there was another little bear sitting right next to the big blue cushion. Sam wanted to sit there too. Did he cry or hide behind Papa? No, little Sam knew just what to do! He took a brave breath, stood up tall like a proud little tree, and walked right over. He smiled a big, toothy bear smile. 'Hi, my name is Sam,' he said in a kind and gentle voice. The little bear looked up from her picture book and beamed a bright, sunny smile back at him. 'Hi, Sam! My name is Lily. You can sit right here next to me!' Lily patted the soft blue cushion, making room for her new friend. Sam sat down happily, his furry legs swinging back and forth. They listened to the story together, pointing at the funny pictures and giggling when the squirrel sneezed. After the story ended, Sam and Lily shared a big box of wooden blocks, building a gigantic tower that reached all the way up to their furry noses. When it was time to leave, Sam waved goodbye to Lily and gave Mrs. Paws a big thank-you nod. Walking home with Papa, Sam felt like a superstar. He learned that saying hello opens the door to wonderful new friends and fun adventures.

stories.title: Sam at the Playground
stories.text: The morning breeze whispered through the green leaves as Sam the puppy bounded outside. Today was playground day at the big park down the street! Sam grabbed his favorite yellow bouncy ball and ran down the driveway with happy little yips. When they arrived, the playground was full of joyful sounds. Children were laughing, swings were swooshing back and forth, and the slide was gleaming in the warm sunshine. Sam trotted over to the bright red slide. Another little pup was already at the top, holding a shiny green truck. Sam really wanted to play with the green truck, but he knew he had to use his words. He stood at the bottom of the ladder, looking up with bright, curious eyes. He took a happy breath and called out clearly, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' The puppy at the top of the slide looked down, his floppy ears perking straight up. 'Hi, Sam! My name is Max!' Max zoomed down the red slide, laughing all the way. Whoosh! Max landed right on the soft wood chips with a soft thud. Sam giggled and rolled his yellow bouncy ball right over to Max. 'Do you want to play catch?' Sam asked. Max’s eyes sparkled with joy. 'Oh, yes please!' For a whole hour, Sam and Max took turns sliding down the red slide, tossing the yellow ball, and zooming the green truck through the sandbox. They shared their toys and cheered for each other when they climbed to the very top. When Mama called out that it was time for lunch, Sam and Max gave each other a happy high-paw. 'Goodbye, Max! See you next time!' Sam barked cheerfully. Skipping home, Sam's heart felt warm and full. Introducing himself had turned a stranger into a wonderful new playmate. Sam knew that every single day was a new chance to say hello and make a brand new friend.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped right out of his cozy bed. Stretch, stretch went Sam's long ears! "Good morning, sun!" cheeped a little yellow bird outside the window. Sam smiled a big bunny smile. Today was a very special day because Sam was going to the park to play with all his woodland friends. First, Sam needed to get dressed all by himself. He put on his favorite blue shirt. Pop went his paws through the sleeves! Then, he pulled up his orange shorts. "Yay, I did it!" Sam cheered, doing a happy little dance. Mommy Bunny called from the kitchen, "Sam, time for breakfast!" Sam hopped to the table and ate every single bite of his yummy carrot oats. Now, it was time to put on his shoes. Left shoe, right shoe. Sam tied them up with a big loop-de-loop. He looked in the mirror and patted his fur. Suddenly, Sam realized something important. When he got to the park, how would his friends know who he was? Mommy Bunny gave him a bright yellow sticker that said his name in big, bold letters. Sam gently pressed it onto his shirt. "Who are you?" asked Mommy with a wink. Sam stood up tall, puffed out his chest, and said in a clear, happy voice, "Hi, my name is Sam!" Mommy clapped her paws. "Such a wonderful name for such a wonderful bunny!" Sam grabbed his red bucket and skipped out the front door. At the park, he saw Bella Bear building a tall tower of blocks. Sam took a deep breath, smiled, and walked right up to her. "Hi, my name is Sam! Can I play with you too?" Bella Bear beamed and handed him a shiny red block. "Hello, Sam! I am Bella. Let us build the biggest castle ever!" Sam felt so proud and happy inside. Introducing himself was as easy as one, two, three. They played together all morning long under the golden sun, sharing toys and giggling. When it was time to go home, Sam waved goodbye to all his new friends. "Goodbye, see you tomorrow!" he called out. As they walked home hand-in-hand, Mommy Bunny asked, "Did you have fun today, Sam?"
