Sam nodded eagerly, his little tail wagging. "Yes, Mommy! Saying hi is the best way to make a brand new friend!"

stories.title: Sam at the Library
stories.text: The library was Sam's most favorite place in the whole wide world. Today, the little fox cub named Sam was going on a big adventure to pick out a brand new bedtime storybook. Sam brushed his bushy red tail and washed his paws. "Are you ready, Sam?" asked Papa Fox. Sam nodded, grabbing his little green library card safely in his paw. When they walked inside, the librarian, Mrs. Owl, looked up from her big desk with a warm, twinkling smile. Mrs. Owl wore shiny round glasses and had soft brown feathers. Sam wanted to talk to her, but sometimes meeting new grownups made his tummy feel like it was fluttering with butterflies. Papa Fox gave Sam a gentle, reassuring squeeze on his shoulder. "You can do it, Sam. Just use your friendly voice," whispered Papa. Sam took a nice, deep breath. He walked right up to the front desk, stood up extra tall, and beamed his brightest smile. "Hi, my name is Sam!" he said clearly. Mrs. Owl clapped her wings together gently. "Well, hello there, Sam! It is such a pleasure to meet you. Welcome to the library! Are you looking for a special book today?" Sam felt all his tummy butterflies fly away. He felt so brave and happy! "Yes, please. I like books about zooming rockets and jumping frogs," Sam replied proudly. Mrs. Owl winked and handed him a special sticker shaped like a friendly book. "Follow me, Sam, and I will show you right where those stories live." Sam happily trotted beside her down the quiet, cozy aisles filled with colorful books of every shape and size. He gently touched the shiny spines of the stories as they walked past. Finally, they found a wonderful book about a brave little frog who loved to leap. Sam opened the cover and carefully turned the pages, smelling the nice, papery scent of the brand new story. "This is the one, Papa!" Sam whispered happily. They checked out the book at the front desk, where Sam smiled and said, "Thank you, Mrs. Owl!" As they walked home under the twilight sky, Sam clutched his book tight. He learned that saying hello opens up a whole world of kind friends and magical stories.

stories.title: Sam's Playground Day
stories.text: The afternoon sun was shining brightly, painting the sky in shades of blue and gold. Little puppy Sam was at the neighborhood playground, and his tail was wagging so fast it looked like a fuzzy propeller. Bark, bark! Went a happy sound nearby. Sam trotted over to the big green sandbox, where a little spaniel puppy was digging a deep hole with a purple shovel. Sam wanted to join in the fun, but he had never met this puppy before. He paused for a moment, wondering what to do. Papa dog had told him that the best way to start a fun game is simply to introduce yourself. Sam took a deep puppy breath, planted his paws firmly in the warm sand, and walked right up to the digging pup. He gave a friendly little wave with his paw. "Hi, my name is Sam!" he said in his happiest, friendliest bark. The spaniel puppy stopped digging, looked up, and broke into a huge grin, revealing two floppy ears. "Hello, Sam! I am Toby! Do you want to help me dig all the way to the moon?" Sam's eyes lit up with excitement. "Oh yes, Toby! Let us dig super fast!" Together, Sam and Toby used their paws and shovels to pile up a mountain of sand. They built a towering castle with a moat around it and decorated the top with a shiny green leaf. After they finished their masterpiece, Toby pointed toward the yellow slide. "Race you to the top, Sam!" Away they went, running as fast as their little legs could carry them. Whee! They slid down together, laughing and barking all the way to the soft rubber ground. When it was time to go home for dinner, Toby gave Sam a high-five with his paw. "Let us play again tomorrow, Sam!" Sam nodded eagerly, feeling warm and proud inside. Walking home beside Papa, Sam looked up and said, "Papa, saying hi is magic. It turns strangers into best friends instantly!" Papa smiled down lovingly and patted Sam's head. "You are growing up so smart, my little Sam." Sam fell asleep that night dreaming of all the fun friends he would say hello to tomorrow.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped right out of his cozy bed. Stretch, stretch, stretch went his long, soft ears! Sam looked in the mirror and gave a big, happy smile. Today was a very special day because Sam was going to play at the park with his animal friends. 'Good morning, sunshine!' whispered Mama Bunny, giving Sam a warm, gentle hug. Sam put on his bright red shoes all by himself, left foot and right foot, just like a big bunny. At the park, Sam saw Oliver Owl sitting on a green bench. Oliver looked a little bit shy and hid his face behind his soft wings. Sam remembered what Mama taught him. He took a deep, brave breath, walked right over, and stood tall. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he said in a friendly, cheerful voice. Oliver Owl peeked out and blinked his big round eyes. 'Hello, Sam! My name is Oliver,' the little owl hooted softly. Sam felt so proud inside his tummy. Saying hello is like magic because it turns a stranger into a friend right away! They played together on the yellow swings, pushing back and forth all the way up to the fluffy white clouds. Higher and higher they went, laughing out loud. When it was time to go home, Sam waved his paw high in the air. 'Goodbye, Oliver! See you tomorrow!' Oliver smiled his biggest smile. Sam skipped all the way home, holding Mama’s hand tightly. He learned that being friendly makes the whole world feel bright and warm. You are wonderful just the way you are, and every new friend is waiting to hear your special name, too!

stories.title: Sam at the Library
stories.text: The library was a quiet, magical place filled with towering shelves of colorful picture books. Little Sam tiptoed inside, making soft pat-pat-pat sounds with his sneakers on the shiny floor. Today, Sam was looking for a story all about roaring dinosaurs. But there were so many books! Sam felt a little bit lost in the giant room. Just then, a kind librarian named Miss Daisy walked by wearing a shiny name tag and a gentle smile. She knelt down so she was eye-to-eye with Sam. 'Hello there, little explorer,' Miss Daisy whispered softly. Sam remembered his manners and stood up straight. He took a deep breath and used his kind, clear voice. 'Hi, my name is Sam! I am looking for a dinosaur book, please.' Miss Daisy’s face lit up with joy. 'It is so very nice to meet you, Sam! I know just the right place to find a roaring good story.' She gently took Sam's hand and led him down a cozy aisle with blue rugs. Right there on the bottom shelf sat a big green book with a friendly T-Rex on the cover! Sam’s eyes sparkled with excitement. 'Thank you so much, Miss Daisy,' Sam said politely. She patted his head gently and whispered, 'You are very welcome, Sam. Happy reading!' Sam sat down on a soft beanbag chair and opened the pages. The dinosaurs leaped off the paper in bright yellows and greens. Sam felt so proud that he used his voice to ask for help. Every time you introduce yourself, wonderful adventures begin to unfold. You can do big things, just like Sam!

stories.title: Sam Joins the Art Table
stories.text: Splash, swirl, dab! The art table at toddler preschool was buzzing with busy little bees. Pots of bright blue, sunny yellow, and fiery red paint sat ready for action. Sam walked over with his blue paint smock tied securely around his middle. He wanted to paint a giant spaceship zooming past the stars. But all the chairs around the art table were already filled with his classmates. Lily was painting a purple flower, and Max was making squiggly green worms. Sam felt a little tiny bubble of shyness in his chest. Should he turn around and walk away? No! Sam remembered he was a brave little helper. He took a confident step forward, stood tall like a mighty tree, and cleared his throat gently. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he announced to the table with a bright, encouraging smile. Lily looked up from her paper and beamed. 'Hi, Sam! My name is Lily. You can sit right here next to me!' Max scooted his chair over to make extra room, sharing a cup of sparkly glitter. 'And I am Max! Welcome to the art table, Sam.' Sam felt a rush of happy warmth from his head down to his toes. He sat down and dipped his thick paintbrush into the glowing yellow paint. Together, Sam, Lily, and Max painted a magnificent galaxy filled with shooting stars and smiling planets. Sharing space and introducing yourself makes every activity twice as fun. Sam looked at his new friends and giggled. Introducing yourself is easy, and it opens the door to sharing wonderful moments with wonderful friends!

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped right out of his cozy bed. Stretch, stretch, goes Sam! Today is a very special day because Sam is going to practice saying his name to all his friends. Sam looks in the mirror and gives a big, happy smile. 'Good morning, mirror!' he whispers. Then, Mommy Bunny helps Sam put on his bright yellow t-shirt. Snap, snap goes the button! Sam feels so proud and strong. 'I am ready!' says Sam. Outside, the gentle wind whispers through the green grass. Sam hops down the path and sees Pip the squirrel sitting by the big oak tree. Pip looks up and twitches his bushy nose. Sam takes a deep, brave breath. He remembers what Mommy taught him. He stands up tall, puts a big smile on his face, and uses his loudest, happiest voice. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he says clearly. Pip claps his tiny paws together and does a little happy dance. 'Hello, Sam! It is so very nice to meet you!' chirps Pip. Sam feels a warm, bubbly feeling inside his tummy. Saying his name makes him feel so grown-up and brave. Next, they see Bella the butterfly fluttering softly from flower to flower. Sam waves his paw high in the air. He takes another happy breath and says, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' Bella gently lands on a daisy and flutters her pretty pink wings. 'Hello, Sam! Welcome to the garden!' she sings. Sam giggles and dances in a little circle. By lunchtime, Sam has said his name to a busy bee, a fuzzy caterpillar, and even a friendly ladybug! At the end of the day, Daddy Bunny tucks Sam back into his warm bed. Sam closes his eyes with a happy sigh. He practiced being brave and introduced himself to everyone. 'You did a wonderful job today, my sweet Sam,' whispers Daddy. Sam drifts off to sleep, dreaming of all the new friends he will say hello to tomorrow. Goodnight, Sam!

stories.title: Sam's Big Day at the Park
stories.text: The sun is shining bright in the blue sky, and little Sam the bear is ready for an adventure at the neighborhood park. Today is full of fun, sharing, and making brand new friends! Sam puts on his favorite red sneakers. Tie, loop, pull—his shoes are ready to go. When they arrive at the park, Sam sees a giant yellow slide and a row of bright red swings. But look! There is another little bear sitting in the sandbox, building a tall, wonderful castle with wet sand and shiny green leaves. Sam takes a deep breath, holds his favorite blue bucket tightly, and walks right over. He remembers that the best way to make a friend is to start with a friendly greeting. Sam stands right at the edge of the sandbox, smiles his biggest, happiest bear smile, and says in a clear, cheerful voice, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' The other little bear stops digging and looks up with wide, sparkly eyes. He brushes some soft sand off his furry paws and beams back. 'Hi, Sam! My name is Leo!' says the little bear. Sam feels so happy that his heart does a little happy thump-thump. 'Can I help you build your castle, Leo?' asks Sam kindly. Leo nods excitedly and hands Sam a yellow plastic shovel. Together, they pat down the wet sand, making the castle taller and grander than ever before. They add smooth pebbles for the royal doors and pretty yellow flowers for the rooftop. Building together is so much fun! Later, they take turns going down the slippery slide, shouting 'Wee!' all the way to the soft ground. When it is time to go home, Sam gives Leo a gentle high-five. 'Goodbye, Leo!' says Sam. 'Goodbye, Sam! Let's play again soon!' calls Leo. As they walk home, Mommy holds Sam's paw. 'I am so proud of you for saying hello and making a new friend today,' says Mommy. Sam smiles proudly, swinging their joined hands back and forth. What a wonderful, happy day it has been for Sam!

stories.title: Sam Meets the Library Helpers
stories.text: Tiptoe, tiptoe, little fox! Today, Sam is visiting the magical children's library with Grandma. The library is a quiet, peaceful place filled with tall shelves of colorful books waiting to be read. Sam loves books with shiny pictures of zooming rockets and sleeping kittens. Grandma holds Sam's soft little paw as they walk up to the large wooden desk where the kind librarian sits. Her name is Mrs. Oak, and she wears a sparkly silver star badge on her cozy green sweater. Sam wants to check out three wonderful books to take home for bedtime stories. Grandma gently reminds Sam that this is a great time to use his polite manners and introduce himself. Sam stands up straight, adjusts his collar, and takes a gentle breath. He looks right at Mrs. Oak with his friendly, bright eyes. In his sweetest, softest library voice, Sam says, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' Mrs. Oak beams a gigantic, welcoming smile that crinkles the corners of her kind eyes. She leans down just a little bit so she can hear him better. 'Hello there, Sam! It is an absolute pleasure to welcome you to our library today,' says Mrs. Oak softly. Sam feels so proud and happy inside. He places his three chosen books carefully on the wooden desk: one about a flying puppy, one about a busy farm, and one about a glowing moon. Mrs. Oak gently stamps each book with a special thumping stamp. Thump, thump, thump! 'Here are your wonderful books, Sam,' she says, handing them back. Sam holds them tightly in his arms, feeling like a very important reader. 'Thank you so much,' says Sam politely. As they walk back home along the sun-dappled sidewalk, Sam hugs his books close to his chest. He practiced being polite, used his lovely quiet voice, and made another wonderful friend in his neighborhood. Grandma kisses the top of Sam's furry head. 'You are growing up to be such a polite and brave little fox,' she says lovingly. Sam smiles all the way home, excited to read his new books.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a bright and sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped right out of his cozy little bed. Stretch, stretch, stretch went Sam's long furry arms! Today was a very special day because Sam was going to the park to play with all his woodland friends. Sam bounced into the bathroom to wash his soft face with warm water and brush his sparkling white teeth. Brush, brush, brush, up and down, side to side! Sam looked in the mirror and gave himself a big, happy toddler smile. 'Good morning, Sam!' he whispered to his reflection. Next, Sam picked out his absolute favorite bright red shirt with a shiny yellow star right on the front. He zipped his sneakers all by himself. Zip! Wow, what a clever bunny! When Sam walked outside, he saw Oliver the owl sitting high up in the green oak tree. Oliver fluttered down and said, 'Hoot hoot, good morning little bunny!' Sam stopped, stood up very tall, and remembered his special words. He smiled a big, proud smile and said in a clear, friendly voice, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' Oliver flapped his wings happily. 'Hello, Sam! It is so very nice to meet you!' Sam felt a warm, cozy bubble of joy pop right inside his tummy. Saying hello and sharing his name felt like magic. Sam skipped all the way to the slide, ready to make even more wonderful friends. He knew that introducing himself was the very best way to start a fun day of playing together. Every time he met someone new, Sam took a deep breath, smiled, and proudly said his name. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' And everyone smiled right back at him, making new friends as easy as one, two, three. Sam was learning how big the world was, and how wonderful it was to be seen, heard, and welcomed with a kind greeting. What a wonderful day to be Sam!

stories.title: Sam at the Playground
stories.text: The afternoon sun was glowing warmly in the sky, casting golden light all over the big neighborhood playground. Sam the little bear cub loved the playground more than anything else in the whole wide world. Today, the shiny red slide was calling his name. Sam hurried over, but stopped when he saw a friendly little squirrel sitting near the steps, holding a shiny purple bouncy ball. The squirrel looked up and blinked her big round eyes. Sam wanted to play catch with the bouncy ball, but how could he join in the fun? Sam remembered what he practiced at home with mommy bear. He took a gentle breath, smoothed down his soft fur, and walked right up. He stood nice and tall, just like a big bear. With a bright, cheerful voice, Sam said, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' The little squirrel grinned from ear to ear, showing her tiny teeth. 'Hi, Sam! My name is Nutmeg!' Nutmeg chirped happily. 'Would you like to bounce the ball with me?' Sam clapped his paws together with absolute glee. 'Yes, please!' he answered. Back and forth went the purple bouncy ball. Bounce, catch, toss! Playing together was so much fun, especially now that they were official friends. Sam felt so proud of himself for being brave and saying hello first. It only took a tiny little voice to start a brand new friendship. Soon, a playful puppy ran over to join their game. Sam turned right around, beamed a sunny smile, and said, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' The puppy wagged his tail furiously. 'Arf! Hi, Sam!' The playground was now filled with laughter, bouncing balls, and happy greetings. Sam knew that every single person he met was just a friend he hadn't made yet. And all it took to start was a brave heart and four special words: 'Hi, my name is Sam!'

stories.title: Sam Meets the New Neighbor
stories.text: Ding-dong! A gentle chime rang out near the front door of the little yellow cottage where Sam lived. Sam was busy building a magnificent tower out of colorful wooden blocks. Thump, thump, placed another block right on top! Mommy smiled and said, 'Sammy, honey, we have a brand new neighbor moving in next door. Let's go say hello and welcome them to our street!' Sam loved meeting new people, so he carefully placed his last block down, stood up, and patted his tummy. He walked right to the front door with happy, bouncing steps. Outside on the green porch stood a little duckling wearing a lovely blue hat, holding a box of toys. The duckling looked a little bit shy and hid her bill behind her wing. Sam knew just what to do to make her feel safe and welcome. He stepped forward, planted his feet firmly on the welcome mat, and gave a warm, friendly wave. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he said in his happiest, sweetest voice. The little duckling lowered her wing and blinked in surprise. A lovely, bright smile spread across her little yellow beak. 'Hello, Sam! My name is Daisy,' she whispered softly, her shoulders relaxing. Daisy didn't feel shy anymore because Sam was so kind. Sam invited Daisy right inside to see his amazing wooden block tower. 'Do you want to build a tall castle with me, Daisy?' Sam asked cheerfully. 'I would love that!' Daisy quacked happily. They sat down together on the soft rug, stacking red, blue, and yellow blocks side by side. Mommy brought them each a cup of yummy apple juice. Sam felt so happy inside his heart. Sharing a simple greeting made the whole world feel like a warm, friendly neighborhood. Introducing himself was super easy, and it brought a brand new friend right to his playroom. Sam raised his juice cup and cheered, 'Welcome to our street, Daisy!' And Daisy smiled back, glad she met her wonderful new friend, Sam.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a bright and sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam woke up in his cozy little bed. Stretch, stretch, go Sam's arms! Yawn, yawn, goes Sam's little pink nose. Today is a very special day because Sam is going to the park to play with new friends. Mummy Bunny helps Sam put on his soft yellow t-shirt and his favorite red shoes. 'Are you ready, Sam?' asks Mummy with a warm, loving smile. Sam nods his head. 'Yes, I am ready!' At the park, Sam sees a little bear building a tall tower with shiny blocks. Sam takes a deep breath, walks over slowly, and gives a big, friendly wave. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he says in his happiest voice. The little bear stops building, smiles a giant smile, and says, 'Hi, Sam! My name is Ben. Do you want to build with me?' Sam claps his hands together. Oh, how wonderful that feels! Building tall block towers together is so much fun. Sam shares the blue blocks, and Ben shares the green blocks. They laugh and giggle as the tower grows taller and taller until it reaches all the way up to their furry little ears. When it is time to go home, Sam feels so proud. Saying hello is like opening a magic door to a brand new adventure. 'Goodbye, Ben!' says Sam. 'Goodbye, Sam!' says Ben, waving his paw high in the air. Sam skips all the way home holding Mummy's hand, humming a happy little tune. He learned that being brave and saying his name brings the best surprises. The end.

stories.title: Sam at Storytime
stories.text: The big library clock ticks tick-tock, softly chiming that it is time for Toddler Storytime! Sam holds Daddy's big finger tightly as they walk through the wide, shiny glass doors. There is a cozy circle of colorful cushions on the soft carpet. Other little animals are already sitting down, ready for a fun book. Sam's heart goes thump-thump with a little bit of shy shyness, but Daddy gives his shoulder a gentle squeeze. 'You can do it, little Sam,' Daddy whispers softly. A kind owl librarian with big round glasses looks right at Sam and beams a huge smile. Sam takes a little step forward, holding his favorite stuffed frog. He sits down right next to a friendly little kitty cat. The kitty cat turns her head, wiggles her whiskers, and says, 'Meow! Who are you?' Sam remembers to use his big, brave voice. He sits up straight and smiles. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he says proudly. The kitty cat purrs happily. 'Hi, Sam! I am Lily. Do you want to share this big picture book with me?' Sam's eyes go wide with joy. 'Yes, please!' Together, Sam and Lily look at the beautiful pages filled with leaping frogs and flying stars. They point their tiny fingers at the pictures and giggle out loud. The owl librarian begins to read a magical story about a moon that loves to dance. Sam listens closely, completely enchanted. When storytime is all done, Sam waves goodbye to Lily with a huge grin on his face. He feels so happy inside. Making a brand new friend by simply saying his name is the most magical feeling in the whole wide world. The end.

stories.title: Sam's Grocery Adventure
stories.text: Push, push, squeak, squeak goes the little red grocery cart! Sam is helping Grandma pick out yummy fresh fruits and vegetables at the busy market. The market is full of bright red apples, tall green broccoli trees, and sweet yellow bananas. Sam loves helping Grandma find the best foods for their big family dinner. As they walk down the colorful fruit aisle, they bump into their friendly neighbor, Mrs. Duck, who is holding a basket full of shiny oranges. Mrs. Duck looks down and sees little Sam pushing his little red cart. 'Well, hello there, little helper!' says Mrs. Duck in her warmest, friendliest voice. Sam stops his cart, stands up tall just like a big boy, and takes a breath. He remembers his manners and his very important name. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' he says cheerfully, flashing a bright, glowing smile. Mrs. Duck's feathers fluff up with pure delight. 'Hi, Sam! It is so very wonderful to see you today. You are getting so big!' Grandma beams with pride, patting Sam gently on his fluffy head. 'He is my very best helper today,' Grandma tells Mrs. Duck proudly. Sam helps pick out three round, juicy peaches and places them gently inside the cart. 'Thank you, Sam,' says Grandma. At the checkout counter, Sam waves goodbye to Mrs. Duck. Walking home under the golden afternoon sun, Sam feels like a superhero. Saying his name makes him feel strong, confident, and ready for whatever comes next. What a wonderful day for Sam! The end.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped out of his cozy bed. Today was a very special day because Sam was going to the park to meet new friends. Sam stretched his long ears and wiggled his fluffy nose. 'Good morning, sunshine!' said Mama Bunny. 'Are you ready for your big adventure?' Sam nodded happily, but his tummy gave a little flutter of shyness. 'How do I say hello to someone new?' asked Sam. Mama smiled a warm, gentle smile and gave Sam a soft hug. 'You just take a deep breath, puff out your chest, and say your name with a big smile,' Mama explained. Sam practiced right there in the mirror. He stood up straight and said in a clear, happy voice, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' The mirror bunny smiled right back. Armed with his new superpower, Sam skipped all the way to the playground. At the sandbox, he saw a little bear digging a deep hole with a shiny red shovel. Sam walked over, his heart going thump, thump, thump. He remembered Mama's words. Sam took a deep breath, smiled his brightest smile, and said, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' The little bear stopped digging and looked up. A huge grin spread across the bear's face. 'Hi, Sam! My name is Ben. Do you want to help me build a giant castle?' Sam clapped his paws together with absolute joy. 'Yes, please!' he cheered. They worked together all morning, packing wet sand and decorating the towers with smooth, round pebbles. Making a friend wasn't scary at all; it just started with a friendly introduction. When it was time to go home, Sam waved goodbye to Ben. As they walked back, Sam held his head high and felt so proud of himself. He had introduced himself all on his own. Mama Bunny squeezed his paw and whispered, 'I knew you could do it.' Sam smiled, already looking forward to tomorrow, when he could say hello to even more new friends.

stories.title: Sam's Library Adventure
stories.text: The library was Sam's favorite place in the whole wide world. It smelled like fresh paper and quiet wonder, filled with towering shelves of colorful picture books. Today, Sam was on a special mission to find the biggest book about dinosaurs he could possibly carry. He tip-toed quietly between the shelves, his little sneakers squeaking softly on the shiny floor. Suddenly, Sam spotted it on the very top shelf—a bright green book with a sparkly T-Rex on the cover. Sam reached up on his tiptoes, but his arms were just a tiny bit too short. Oh no! How was he going to reach his favorite book? Just then, a kind librarian wearing sparkly glasses walked by. She had a name tag that read 'Miss Lucy'. Sam wanted to ask for help, but he felt a little shy talking to grown-ups he didn't know very well. He took a gentle breath to steady his nervous fingers. Remember who you are, Sam thought to himself. He stood tall, looked right at the librarian, and said politely, 'Hi, my name is Sam! Can you please help me reach that green dinosaur book?' Miss Lucy's face lit up with a wonderful, kind smile. She bent down to Sam's eye level and said, 'Hello, Sam! I would love to help you.' With a gentle stretch, Miss Lucy reached up and safely pulled the big green book right off the shelf, handing it over to Sam's waiting hands. Sam's eyes sparkled with delight as he hugged the heavy book to his chest. 'Thank you so much!' Sam beamed proudly. Miss Lucy patted his head gently. 'You are very welcome, Sam. Have a wonderful time reading!' Sam carried his treasure over to the cozy reading corner, plopping down onto a giant, fluffy yellow beanbag chair. He opened the cover and began to explore the roaring world of prehistoric creatures, feeling so glad he spoke up. Being polite and sharing his name had opened the door to a magical reading adventure. It was truly a wonderful day at the library.

stories.title: Sam's First Day of Music Class
stories.text: Bright yellow sunshine beamed through the windows of the community center. Inside, little chairs were arranged in a big circle, and the room was buzzing with the joyful sound of tambourines and drums. It was Sam's very first day of music class! Sam clutched his stuffed monkey tightly as he walked through the door with Papa. There were so many new children laughing and playing with colorful shakers. Sam hid behind Papa's leg for a moment, feeling a bit overwhelmed by all the excitement. Papa knelt down and gently rubbed Sam's back. 'You are going to have so much fun making music today, Sam. Would you like to introduce yourself to your new teacher?' Sam peeked out from behind Papa. The music teacher, Mr. Paul, was strumming a cheerful tune on a shiny brown guitar. Mr. Paul noticed Sam and stopped playing for a moment to wave hello. Sam swallowed hard, took a brave little step forward, and remembered his manners. He took a deep breath, lifted his chin, and said clearly, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' Mr. Paul's face lit up like a bright lightbulb. 'Well, hello there, Sam! We are so happy you are here with us today,' Mr. Paul cheered, strumming a happy little greeting chord on his guitar. 'Would you like to pick a musical instrument to play?' Sam's shyness melted away completely, replaced by bubbling excitement. He nodded eagerly and pointed to a pair of shiny wooden rhythm sticks. Mr. Paul handed them over with a wink. Sam sat right down in the circle next to another little girl who was shaking a blue maraca. 'Hi, I'm Lily,' she whispered with a sweet smile. Sam grinned back, tapping his sticks together to the beat. 'Hi, Lily! I'm Sam,' he replied proudly. Together, they made wonderful music, shaking, tapping, and singing through every silly song. Sam realized that trying new things wasn't scary at all when you start with a friendly hello. As Papa clapped from the back of the room, Sam smiled from ear to ear, already loving the rhythm of his wonderful day.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little bunny named Sam hopped out of his cozy bed. Stretch, stretch, go Sam's long fuzzy ears! Today was a very special day because Sam was going to the park to meet new friends. Mommy Bunny smiled and said, 'Good morning, Sam! Remember to use your big, brave voice today.' Sam nodded and gave a happy wiggle. First, Sam ate a yummy bowl of crunchy carrot flakes. Crunch, crunch, munch! Then, he brushed his teeth until they sparkled like little stars. Sparkle, sparkle! Finally, Sam put on his favorite red sneakers. Snap went the velcro! Now, Sam was ready for the big world. At the park, Sam saw a cute little duckling splashing in a puddle. Splash, splash, go the tiny webbed feet! Sam wanted to play too, but how would the duckling know his name? Sam took a deep breath. He remembered Mommy's advice. He walked right up, stood up very tall, flashed a big smile, and said in a clear, friendly voice, 'Hi, my name is Sam! What is your name?' The little duckling stopped splashing and quacked a happy hello. 'I am Ducky!' she chirped. Sam felt a warm, bubbly feeling in his tummy. Saying hello was not scary at all; it was super fun! Sam and Ducky spent the whole morning splashing in puddles, chasing butterflies, and sharing giggles. When it was time to go home, Sam gave Ducky a big hug goodbye. Sam skipped all the way home, holding Mommy's hand tightly. 'Guess what, Mommy?' Sam whispered proudly. 'I said my name and made a brand new friend!' Mommy kissed Sam's soft furry forehead. 'I am so proud of you, my sweet little Sam,' she cheered. That night, as Sam drifted off to sleep under the starry sky, he whispered to his teddy bear, 'Hi, my name is Sam.' And he smiled, knowing that every new day was a wonderful chance to say hello to the world.

stories.title: Sam's Library Adventure
stories.text: Beep, beep! Little Sam zoomed around his living room like a fast red race car. Vroom, vroom! Today was library day, and Sam was so excited. Daddy Bear put on his jacket and said, 'Time to go, Sam! We are going to meet lots of new people today.' Sam parked his imaginary car and grabbed his favorite blue backpack. 'Ready, Daddy!' cheered Sam. At the library, the rooms were filled with tall shelves packed with colorful books. There were shiny books, bumpy books, and books about roaring dinosaurs. Sam saw a friendly librarian wearing sparkly glasses, holding a stack of picture books. Sam wanted to look at the dinosaur books, but they were high up on the shelf. He looked at Daddy, then he looked at the kind librarian. Sam remembered his special greeting. He walked over, stood on his tiptoes, and said in his brightest, happiest voice, 'Hi, my name is Sam! Can you help me find the dinosaurs, please?' The librarian beamed a huge, warm smile down at him. 'Hello, Sam! I would love to help you find the dinosaurs,' she said gently. She led Sam right to the best dinosaur book in the whole library. It had a big green T-Rex on the cover that popped right up when you opened the pages. 'Roar!' whispered Sam softly, being quiet like a good library mouse. The librarian giggled and gave Sam a colorful dinosaur bookmark. Sam clapped his hands together with joy. It felt so wonderful to use his voice and make someone smile. On the way home, Sam cuddled his new book tightly. 'Daddy, I said my name today,' Sam said happily. 'And I found a pop-up T-Rex!' Daddy smiled warmly. 'You are growing up so fast, Sam. Your voice is a wonderful gift.' That evening, Sam read his dinosaur book three whole times, dreaming of all the friends he would say hello to tomorrow.

stories.title: Sam's Playground Day
stories.text: The sun was shining brightly, and little Sam was ready for fun. Today, Sam and Grandma were visiting the big neighborhood playground. Swish, swash, went the wind in the green trees. Sam saw the tallest slide he had ever seen. It was yellow like a big banana. There was already another little pup playing near the sandbox, building a magnificent castle with shiny wet sand. Pat, pat, pat, went the little shovel. Sam wanted to build a giant castle too, right next to the other pup. But how do you start a game? Sam remembered his magic words. He took a brave little step forward, smoothed down his shirt, and said in a cheerful voice, 'Hi, my name is Sam! Can I play in the sandbox with you?' The little pup looked up, brushed some sand off his nose, and broke into a huge, welcoming grin. 'Hi, Sam! I am Leo. Let us build a big castle with a moat!' Leo shouted happily. Sam dropped down to his knees and started digging right away. Scoop, scoop, scoop, went Sam's yellow shovel. They worked together as a team. Sam made the walls strong and tall, while Leo added sparkly pebbles for decoration. Their castle looked like a royal palace for a king! Grandma sat on a nearby bench, watching with a proud smile. She waved at Sam, and Sam waved back with sandy paws. When it was time to pack up their toys, Sam gave Leo a high-five. 'Goodbye, Leo! See you next time,' Sam called out. 'Bye-bye, Sam!' Leo waved back. Sam skipped over to Grandma, feeling as happy as could be. 'Grandma, I made a new best friend today!' Sam cheered. Grandma hugged him tight. 'You are so brave and kind, Sam,' she whispered. Sam smiled all the way home, dreaming of all the fun adventures waiting for him tomorrow.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello
stories.text:
Good morning, little sunshine! Today is a very special day. Do you know why? Because today, we are going to learn all about saying hello and sharing our names! Let's meet a little friend named Sam. Sam is a happy toddler just like you, with big bright eyes and a very wiggly nose. Every morning, Sam wakes up, stretches his arms way up high, and gives a big, happy yawn. Stretch, stretch, stretch! 

Today, Sam is going to the park. At the park, Sam sees a shiny red slide and a friendly little puppy playing with a yellow ball. Sam wants to play too. But how do we make new friends? We use our big-kid voice and say our name! Sam takes a nice, deep breath. He puts a big smile right on his face. He walks right up to the little puppy and says, 'Hi! My name is Sam!' 

Oh, look at that! The puppy wags his tail super fast and barks a happy 'Woof!' That means hello! Sam feels so proud. Saying your name is like opening a door to a brand-new game. 

Now, let's practice together, my sweet friend. Can you tell me your name? Wow, what a beautiful name! Just like Sam, you have a wonderful voice. Whenever you meet someone new, you can wave your hand just like this and say hello with a big smile. You are so brave and wonderful. Sam is clapping his hands for you right now. Yay! Let's remember to use our friendly voices all day long. You can say hi to your teddy bear, your blankie, and even the sunshine outside. Every time you say your name, you shine like a bright star. Good job, superstar!

stories.title: Sam’s Name Tag Adventure
stories.text:
Ring, ring! Good morning, world! Today is Sam's first day at the community playroom, and he is so excited. Mommy helps Sam put on his favorite blue shirt. Then, Mommy holds up a shiny star sticker with big letters on it. 'Look, Sam!' Mommy says. 'This is your special name tag.' Sam looks at the sticker. It spells out S-A-M. Sam loves stars! 

At the playroom, there are blocks to stack, paints to swirl, and lots of new friends to meet. Sam sees a little girl building a giant tower out of red and green blocks. Sam wants to help make the tower touch the sky. But the little girl looks down at her blocks, feeling a little shy. Sam remembers his special star sticker and his friendly voice. He points to his chest and says with a big, happy grin, 'Hi! My name is Sam!' 

The little girl looks up and smiles. 'Hi Sam! I am Mia!' she says. Sam and Mia start working together. They put a blue block on the bottom, a yellow block in the middle, and a wiggly plastic duck right on the very top. Look at that amazing tower! It doesn't fall down at all. Sam gives Mia a high-five. 

Isn't it wonderful to make a new friend? All it takes is a kind hello and sharing your name. You are so good at being friendly, just like Sam. Whenever you wear a smile, you are wearing the best name tag in the whole wide world. Sam is giving you a giant, warm hug right now. Let's take a deep breath in, and let a happy smile out. You are ready for any adventure today!

stories.title: Sam’s Playground Greetings
stories.text:
The sun is shining, the birds are singing, and Sam is ready to play outside! Sam puts on his squeaky red shoes. Squeak, squeak, squeak! He grabs his favorite green bucket and heads out to the sandbox. The sand feels so soft and tickly between his little toes. 

In the sandbox, another toddler is making a wonderful sandcastle with a moat and a little shell on top. Sam walks over, carrying his green bucket. He wants to build a big castle too. But wait, how do we start playing with someone new? We say hello! Sam takes a happy little breath, stands up tall, and flashes his biggest, brightest smile. He waves his hand and says in a clear, friendly voice, 'Hi! My name is Sam!' 

The other toddler stops digging, looks up, and giggles. 'Hi Sam! I'm Leo!' Leo says, handing Sam a shiny pink shovel. Sam takes the shovel and says, 'Thank you, Leo!' Together, Sam and Leo scoop the warm sand, pat it down, and make a mountain so big that a tiny ladybug comes over to check it out. 

Sam feels so happy inside his heart. Sharing your name is like magic. It turns strangers into playmates. You are just like Sam—so kind, so polite, and so wonderful at making friends. Every time you say your name out loud, you show the world how special you are. Let's practice your lovely wave one more time. Wave to the left, wave to the right, and say hello! You did it! What a wonderful day for making new friends.

stories.title: Sam Says Hello to the Sun
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Wakey-wakey, Sam! Today is a brand new day, full of happy adventures just for you. Stretch your arms up high, as high as the fluffy white clouds. Big stretch! Yay! Today, we are going to learn something very special and fun. We are going to practice saying our very own name. Can you say Sam? Let's try it together! Hi, my name is Sam! Wow, what a wonderful, happy voice you have! Your name is so special, just like you are. Every morning when you wake up, you can smile and say hello to the wonderful world. Now, let's wiggle those sleepy little toes. Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle! Time to get out of bed and find our cozy slippers. Look at you go, moving so smoothly and independently. You are growing up to be such a big kid every single day. Walking into the kitchen, Mommy and Daddy are waiting with big, warm hugs. They love you so much! 'Good morning, Sam!' they say with glowing smiles. You smile right back and wave your little hand. When you meet new friends at the playground today, what will you say? You can take a deep breath and use your brave, friendly voice. You can say, 'Hi, my name is Sam! Do you want to play with me?' Making new friends is so exciting, and sharing toys makes everyone feel warm and happy inside. You are so good at being kind and sharing with others. The blocks are ready, the slide is waiting, and the whole wide world is ready to say hello to you. Let's take one more big breath and get ready for a super-duper fun day. You are ready, Sam. You can do anything you put your mind to, because you are clever, sweet, and wonderfully capable. Have the best day ever, sweet Sam!

stories.title: Sam's Super Playground Hello
stories.text: The sun is shining brightly in the blue, blue sky. It is a perfect afternoon for a trip to the park! Sam puts on bright red shoes, tying the laces or pressing the velcro down securely. Step, step, march, march! Down the sidewalk we go, holding Mommy's hand safely. When we arrive at the playground, there are so many fun things to see. There is a tall red slide, a bouncy yellow seesaw, and swings that go high up into the air. Wow, look at all the other children playing and laughing together! Sometimes, meeting new friends can feel a little bit tricky, but Sam is brave and strong. Let's take a deep breath in, and let it out. You can do it! Walk right up to the friendly child in the sandbox who is building a tall, sandy castle. How do we start a brand-new friendship? With a big smile! Stand up tall, look right at your new friend, and use your happy, clear voice. Say, 'Hi, my name is Sam! Can I help you build your castle?' That is such a wonderful and polite way to introduce yourself. The other child turns around, smiles brightly, and says, 'Yes, Sam! You can help me make the biggest tower!' Look at that! You made a brand-new friend all by yourself, just by saying your name. Working together is so much fun. You pat the wet sand, shaping it into lovely little domes and walls. Playing side by side, sharing the shovels and buckets, makes your heart feel so warm and proud. You are learning how to be a wonderful friend, Sam. When it is time to go home, you wave goodbye and say, 'Bye-bye, see you next time!' You skip all the way home with a happy bounce in your step. You are a superstar, Sam!

stories.title: Sam's Library Adventure
stories.text: Shh, listen closely! Do you hear the quiet pages turning? Today, Sam is visiting the magical library, a wonderful place filled with thousands of colorful stories waiting to be read. There are books about roaring dinosaurs, soaring rockets, and fluffy little kittens. Sam walks softly inside, making tiptoe steps on the shiny floor. Tip-toe, tip-toe, tap! A very kind librarian with sparkling glasses and a warm smile looks down from the front desk. She says, 'Hello there, little one! Welcome to our library.' This is the perfect moment to practice our favorite skill. Sam stands up straight, takes a gentle breath, and speaks in a sweet, clear voice. 'Hi, my name is Sam!' The librarian beams with delight and says, 'It is so very nice to meet you, Sam! Are you ready to find a wonderful storybook today?' Oh, yes! Sam nods excitedly. Together, we walk down the tall rows of shelves looking for the brightest, most interesting cover. Look over there! A book about a brave little puppy who loves to chase bouncing red balls. That one looks absolutely fantastic! Sam holds the special book carefully with both hands, hugging it close like a precious treasure. We walk back to the friendly librarian to check the book out so we can read it together at home. When she asks for your name again, you proudly repeat, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' She stamps the inside page with a fun 'thump-thump' sound. You earned a library card all your own! Walking out the door into the golden afternoon sunshine, you feel so proud of yourself. You introduced yourself so politely and bravely today. Reading your new book tonight before bedtime is going to be the absolute best reward. You are growing up so wonderfully, Sam!

stories.title: Sam Says Hello at the Park
stories.text: The sun is shining bright and warm today! Sam wakes up with a big stretch. Yawn! Good morning, little Sam! Today is a very special day because Sam is going to the big, green park to play on the slides and swings. Sam puts on bright red shoes, one and two, all by himself. Wow, what a big kid! Mommy holds Sam's hand as they walk down the path. At the park, Sam sees a little girl digging in the sandbox with a shiny yellow shovel. Sam wants to play too, but how do we join the fun? Mommy smiles and whispers, 'You can say hello and tell them your name, Sam!' Sam takes a deep, brave breath. Little steps go right up to the sandbox. Sam gives a big, friendly smile and says in a clear, happy voice, 'Hi, my name is Sam!' The little girl looks up and smiles a huge, sparkly smile right back. She says, 'Hi Sam! I am Mia. Do you want to share my yellow shovel?' Sam claps hands with pure joy. 'Yes, please!' Together, Sam and Mia build a giant castle out of wet, squishy sand. Pat, pat, pat go their hands, shaping the tallest towers. Sam feels so proud inside. Making a new friend is as easy as saying hello! When it is time to go home, Mia waves goodbye and shouts, 'Bye-bye, Sam!' Sam waves back with a happy heart. Walking home, Sam skips down the sidewalk. What a wonderful day at the park! Saying your name opens the door to wonderful new adventures. You are so good at making friends, Sam. Good job being brave, sweet Sam. Tomorrow is another day full of bright possibilities, kind greetings, and fun new games to play with everyone you meet.

stories.title: Sam's First Day at Preschool
stories.text: Ring, ring! The little clock says it is time to wake up. Good morning, Sam! Today is Sam's very first day at preschool. Sam has a brand-new blue backpack filled with crayons and a special snack box. Sam eats a yummy bowl of crunchy cereal and drinks every drop of milk. Gulp, gulp, yum! Daddy drives Sam to the colorful little schoolhouse. Inside, the room is filled with blocks, paints, and smiling faces everywhere. A very nice teacher named Ms. Anna walks over. She kneels down to Sam's size and says, 'Good morning! We are so happy you are here today.' Sam holds onto Daddy's jacket just a little bit, feeling tiny and shy. Daddy gives Sam a big, warm hug and a kiss on the cheek. 'You are going to have so much fun, Sam. I will be right back after story time,' Daddy says gently. Sam takes a deep breath and remembers how big and brave he is. Ms. Anna points to the block corner where another boy is building a tall tower. Sam walks over, takes a deep breath, and uses his happy voice. 'Hi, my name is Sam! Can I help build the tower?' The boy turns around, grinning ear to ear. 'Hi Sam! I am Leo. Yes, put that big red block right on top!' Sam carefully places the block. Crash! Oh no, the tower tumbles down, and both boys giggle out loud. Building towers together is so much fun. Sam loves preschool already! By the time Daddy comes back, Sam is busy painting a green dinosaur. 'Look, Daddy! I made a friend!' Sam says proudly. You did it, Sam. You were so brave and used your words. Good job, superstar!

stories.title: Sam Meets the Friendly Puppy
stories.text: Drip, drop, goes the afternoon rain against the windowpane. But now the rain has stopped, and the sun is peeking out through the clouds to dry the grass. Sam puts on bright yellow rainboots and steps outside into the backyard. Splash, splash go the boots in the puddles! Suddenly, Sam hears a soft rustling sound near the big green bushes. Out pops a fluffy, wiggly puppy with floppy brown ears and a tail that wags so fast it looks like a fuzzy propeller! Ruff, ruff! barks the happy little puppy. Sam stops and looks down. The puppy trots right over, sniffing gently at Sam's yellow boots. Sam wants to pet the puppy, but remembers to be gentle and kind. Sam kneels down softly in the grass so the puppy won't be scared. With a warm and gentle voice, Sam says, 'Hi, my name is Sam! Who are you, little puppy?' The puppy lets out a happy yip and gives Sam's hand a warm, tickly puppy kiss with a wet pink tongue. Hee-hee-hee! Sam giggles out loud, holding out a hand for the puppy to sniff some more. Just then, neighbor Mrs. Davis walks up to the fence. 'Hello there, Sam! This is Buster, and it looks like he already loves his new friend,' Mrs. Davis says with a smile. Sam gently strokes Buster's soft, warm fur on his back. 'Good boy, Buster,' whispers Sam happily. Playing outside with a furry new friend is the best way to spend an afternoon. Sam feels so warm and happy inside. Saying hello brings wonderful surprises into your world. You are so kind and gentle with animals, Sam. What a wonderful day for making a brand-new furry friend in the sunshine!

rhymes.title: Sam Wakes Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
I am wide awake.
Time to wiggle toes,
Watch the shadows shake.

Stretch up to the sky,
Reach up very high.
Blink your sleepy eyes,
Greet the morning sky.

Throw the covers back,
Jump upon the floor.
Ready for the day,
Stepping out the door.

Smile a happy smile,
Laugh a little cheer.
Sam is up and glad,
Morning time is here.

rhymes.title: Sam Brushes Teeth
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Grab the shiny brush.
Squeeze the bubble paste,
Hear the water gush.

Up and down we go,
Round and round we play.
Brush away the food,
Keep the germs away.

Scrub the molars back,
Tickle every grin.
Now the sparkling teeth
Are ready to begin.

Spit the water out,
Wipe the face so clean.
Sam has got the best
Smile you've ever seen.

rhymes.title: Sam Gets Dressed
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Putting on my clothes.
First my yellow shirt
Going past my nose.

Push my arms right through,
Pull it down so neat.
Now the cozy pants
Cover up my feet.

Left foot in the shoe,
Right foot in the lace.
Zippy-zip the coat,
Smile upon my face.

Ready for the park,
Ready for the street.
Sam is looking smart,
Looking very neat.

rhymes.title: Sam Washes Hands
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Wash the dirt away.
Turn the water on,
Splash and dance and play.

Grab the slippery soap,
Rub it palm to palm.
Sing a little song,
Happy, bright, and calm.

Wash between the thumbs,
Wash the fingers too.
Bubbles floating up,
Red and white and blue.

Rinse the suds right off,
Dry them on the towel.
Sam has got clean hands,
Happy little fowl.

rhymes.title: Sam Goes To Sleep
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Now the day is done.
Time to rest my head,
Say goodbye to sun.

Put on cozy jams,
Hug my teddy bear.
爬 into the bed,
Tucked in with such care.

Close your heavy eyes,
Listen to the song.
Nighttime is for sleep,
Nothing can go wrong.

Dreams are floating by,
Moon is shining deep.
Sam is dreaming now,
Fast asleep.

rhymes.title: Sam Wakes Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
I am up, yes I am!
Open wide my sleepy eyes,
Greet the morning with surprise.

Time to stretch up very high,
Reach my hands right to the sky.
Jump up down upon the floor,
Ready for a day explore.

Now I walk to brush my teeth,
Every tooth above, beneath.
Wash my face and comb my hair,
Look at Sam, he looks so fair!

Happy morning, shiny day,
Sam is ready now to play!
Put my little shoes on neat,
Happy smiles are on repeat.

rhymes.title: Sam Eats Lunch
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Eating yummy jam on yam!
Sit right down into my chair,
Tie my napkin round my hair.

Hold my spoon and take a bite,
Chewing slowly, chewing right.
Carrots orange, broccoli green,
Best lunch that I've ever seen.

Drink my water, sip a cup,
Eat it all and bottoms up!
 Wipe my fingers, wipe my chin,
Lunchtime fun is now a win.

 Push my chair in, nice and slow,
Off to find a place to go!
Sammy has a happy tum,
Rubbing it like a little drum.

rhymes.title: Sam Cleans Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Pick up toys, yes I can!
Blocks go in the big red bin,
Drop the teddy safely in.

Crayons back inside their box,
Time to match my little socks.
Picks up books from off the floor,
Closes up the toy box door.

Working fast and working neat,
Look at this room, what a treat!
 Clap my hands and shout hooray,
Put the clutter all away.

Helping out is so much fun,
Look at what good Sam has done!
 Neat and tidy, clean and bright,
Everything is looking right.

rhymes.title: Sam Takes a Bath
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Splash around like a clam!
Turn the water, nice and warm,
Safe and cozy from the storm.

Rubber ducky swims along,
Singing out a bubble song.
Wash my tummy, wash my toes,
Wash the tip of my cute nose.

Suds are popping in the air,
Wash the shampoo in my hair.
Pour the cup right down my back,
Hear the little duck go quack!

Wrap me in a towel so grand,
Wipe me dry across the land.
Pajamas on, feeling sweet,
Time for bed, from head to feet.

rhymes.title: Sam Goes to Sleep
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Snuggling my fuzzy lamb.
Nighttime stars begin to peep,
Time for Sam to go to sleep.

Read a story, dim the light,
Kiss me mommy, hug me tight.
Daddy whispers, rest your head,
Tucked right in my cozy bed.

Close my eyes and drift away,
Dreaming of the next bright day.
Breathe in slow and breathe out deep,
Sam is fast and sound asleep.

Moonlight shines upon the floor,
Sleepy sounds behind the door.
Quiet night until the dawn,
Sleep until the morning's on.

rhymes.title: Sam Wakes Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
I am wide awake.
Time to wash my face,
For goodness sakes!

Stretch up to the sky,
Reach your fingers high.
Morning light is bright,
Birds are flying by.

Put my slippers on,
Walk across the floor.
Ready for the day,
Opening the door.

Smile a happy smile,
Laugh a little too.
Good morning to the sun,
I am saying you!

rhymes.title: Sam Brushes Teeth
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Grab my little brush.
Squeeze the paste on top,
There is never a rush.

Brush up and down,
Brush all around.
Making sparkly teeth,
With a happy sound.

Spit the water out,
Wash the brush away.
Now my teeth are clean,
Ready for the day!

Open up wide,
Let me take a look.
Shiny white pearls,
Right out of a book.

rhymes.title: Sam Gets Dressed
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Time to find some clothes.
Pull my shirt right on,
Up above my nose.

Put my trousers on,
One leg and then two.
Yellow is my shirt,
And my pants are blue.

Socks upon my feet,
Shoes tied with a bow.
Ready out the door,
Off we want to go!

Spin around and round,
Look at what I wear.
Fashionable Sam,
Standing on the chair.

rhymes.title: Sam Washes Hands
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Time to wash my hands.
Bubbles on my skin,
Like tiny little bands.

Turn the faucet on,
Water nice and warm.
Rub them palm to palm,
Safe from every storm.

Rinse the bubbles off,
Dry them nice and dry.
Germs go far away,
Saying quick goodbye!

Smell so fresh and clean,
Wave hello to you.
Washing up is fun,
Yes it is quite true.

rhymes.title: Sam Cleans Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Time to clean my room.
Put the toys away,
Sweeping with a broom.

Blocks go in the box,
Teddy on the bed.
Every single thing,
In its place instead.

Clap our little hands,
Job is nearly done.
Cleaning up is great,
Playing can be fun!

Now the floor is clear,
Ready for some more.
Happy little Sam,
Smiling at the door.

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Waking Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Eating toast and jam.
Sun is in the sky,
Wave a happy hi!
Stretch up very high,
Touch the morning sky.
Blink your sleepy eyes,
Time to jump and rise!
Put on happy shoes,
No more time to snooze.
Brush your teeth up high,
Watch the bubbles fly.
Wash your little face,
Run to catch the pace.
Ready for the day,
Time to shout and play!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Getting Dressed
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Wearing purple jam?
No, a yellow shirt,
Clean and out of dirt!
Pendulum the pants,
Do a little dance.
One leg goes right through,
Now the other too!
Socks upon my feet,
Looking very neat.
Zip the jacket up,
Grab my drinking cup.
Look into the glass,
Watch the moments pass.
Ready to go out,
Hear me laugh and shout!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Brush Your Teeth
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Scrubbing like a lamb.
Grab the brush so blue,
Squeeze the paste out too.
Brush the teeth up top,
Make the germs all drop!
Brush the bottom row,
Watch the bubbles grow.
Spit into the sink,
Take a little drink.
Smile a shiny smile,
Keep it for a while!
Clean and sparkling bright,
Shining in the light.
All finished and done,
Teething is so fun!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Clean Up Time
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Busy as a clam.
Toys are on the floor,
By the open door.
Pick a block up fast,
Make it be the last?
No, there is one more,
Put it in the drawer.
Teddy bear must sleep,
While the shadows creep.
Trucks go in the bin,
Everybody win!
Room is looking neat,
Standing on my feet.
Clap your hands and cheer,
Glad that cleanup's here!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Bedtime Routine
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Snuggle with my lamb.
Put on pajamas red,
Jump into my bed.
Pull the blankets high,
Look up at the sky.
Twinkle, little star,
Shining from afar.
Read a story book,
At each picture look.
Give a hug so sweet,
From my head to feet.
Close your sleepy eyes,
Under starry skies.
Time to rest your head,
Safe inside your bed.

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Waking Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Happy as a clam!
Sun is in the sky,
Wave a happy hi!
Stretch up very high,
Reach it to the sky.
Time to get out of bed,
Pat my sleepy head.
Put on socks so blue,
Shoes and trousers too.
Brush my teeth so bright,
Sparkling in the light.
Wash my face and nose,
Tickle tiny toes.
Ready for the day,
Hip, hooray, hooray!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Breakfast Time
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
I am fond of jam!
Sit down in my chair,
Tie my flowing hair.
Bowl of yellow oats,
Floating little boats.
Drink my apple juice,
Silky smooth and loose.
Use my spoon just right,
Take a yummy bite.
Chew it all so slow,
Watch my tummy grow.
All done with my treat,
 Clean up tidy, neat.
Ready now to play,
Hip, hooray, hooray!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Getting Dressed
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Busy as a lamb!
Pick a yellow shirt,
Clean away the dirt.
Arms go way up high,
Touching all the sky.
Now my pants go on,
Dancing like a swan.
Zip them up so neat,
Stomp my little feet.
Socks upon my toes,
Up above the hose.
Jacket warm and red,
Hat upon my head.
Ready for the street,
Hip, hooray, so sweet!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Cleanup Time
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Clearing out the jam!
Toys upon the floor,
Near the wooden door.
Pick up blocks of blue,
Red and yellow too.
Put them in the bin,
Let the game begin!
Tidy up the room,
Sweep it with a broom.
Books upon the shelf,
Doing it myself.
Everything in place,
Smile upon my face.
Cabinets are neat,
Hip, hooray, complete!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam! Bedtime Routine
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Cozy in my jam!
Bath is over now,
Time to take a bow.
Pajamas soft and warm,
Safe from any storm.
Brush my teeth again,
Count up to the ten.
Read a story book,
At the pictures look.
Hugs and kisses deep,
Falling fast asleep.
Moo-cow says good night,
Stars are shining bright.
Dreaming in my bed,
Sleepy little head.

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Morning Wake Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Eating toast and jam.
Time to start the day,
Ready now to play!

Sun is shining bright,
Chasing off the night.
Stretch up to the sky,
Wave a happy bye.

Put on cozy shoes,
Shake away the blues.
Brush the teeth so white,
Sparkling all the bright.

Now I am so grand,
Best kid in the land!
Ready for the floor,
Stepping out the door.

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Washing Hands
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Wash away the jam.
Water nice and cool,
Bubbles are so cool!

Rub the fingers round,
Make a soapy sound.
Thumb and pinky too,
Just like grown-ups do.

Scrub until it gleams,
Pop the little seams.
 Rinse the suds away,
Clean for all the day.

Dry upon the towel,
Do not be a growl.
Now my hands are neat,
Victory is sweet!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Cleaning Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Put toys in the jam.
Blocks go in the bin,
Everybody win!

Teddy bear must rest,
That will be the best.
Crayons in their box,
Next to fuzzy socks.

Pick up every toy,
Be a happy boy.
Shelf is looking neat,
Job is almost sweet.

Clap our hands aloud,
We are feeling proud.
Room is clean and bright,
Everything is right.

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Getting Dressed
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Busy as a clam.
Finding clothes to wear,
Smiling everywhere.

Shirt goes right on top,
Arms out like a prop.
Pants go on the feet,
Outfit looks so neat.

Zippy zipper goes,
Right up to my nose.
Socks upon my toes,
Off the river flows.

Ready for the park,
Playing 'til it's dark.
I can do it all,
Even though I'm small.

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Bedtime Routine
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Snuggle with my lamb.
Stars begin to peep,
Time to go to sleep.

Put on pajamas red,
Jump right in the bed.
Read a story book, -
In each magic nook.

Kisses on the cheek,
No more words to speak.
Close your sleepy eyes,
Under starry skies.

Moonlight soft and deep,
While the shadows creep.
Dreams are floating high,
Baby lullaby.

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam!
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is little Sam,
Eating yummy toast and jam!
Morning sun is shining bright,
Everything is feeling right.

Time to wash my sleepy face,
Put my toys in proper place.
Brush my teeth until they shine,
Now I'm doing very fine!

Put my shiny shoes upon,
Sing a happy little song.
Jumping up and jumping down,
Happiest kid in the town!

Ready now to go and play,
Have a super fun-filled day!
Wave hello and shout out, 'Yay!'
Hip hooray, let's start the day!

rhymes.title: Sam Says Hello
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is bouncy Sam,
Louder than a furry lamb!
Waking up with lots of cheer,
Glad that Mommy dear is near.

Stretching arms up to the sky,
Watching little birds fly by.
Now I put my pants on fast,
Time to make the worries last?

No, no, no, we smile and play,
Dancing all the blues away!
Grab my coat and zipper too,
Tell the doggie, 'How do you do?'

Out the door we love to go,
Walking in a happy row.
Hi, my name is Sam, you see,
Won't you come and play with me?

rhymes.title: Sam's Busy Morning
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is joyful Sam,
Running down the stairs I am!
Smelling pancakes in the pan,
Catch me running if you can.

Drinking milk up from my cup,
Growing big and growing up.
Tidy up my cozy bed,
Put a hat upon my head.

Now I grab my yellow bag,
See my funny backpack tag.
Time to march out in the street,
Moving fast my little feet.

Hello trees and hello sky,
Give the friendly clouds a high-five!
Hi, my name is Sam, hooray,
Ready for a brand new day!

rhymes.title: Sam's Routine Song
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is helpful Sam,
Helping Mommy with the pram!
First we brush our hair so neat,
Then we put socks on our feet.

Wash the apples red and sweet,
That is quite a yummy treat!
Now we sit and read a book,
Take a happy little look.

Time to tidy up the floor,
Close the toy box nice and sure.
Wash our hands with bubbly soap,
That is how we wash, I hope!

Singing songs is so much fun,
Smiling at the golden sun.
Hi, my name is Sam, that's me,
Happy as a bumblebee!

rhymes.title: The Adventures of Sam
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is daring Sam,
Brave as any little ram!
Climbing up the little slide,
Taking such a joyful ride.

Time to eat some broccoli green,
Bestest vegetable ever seen!
Drink some water, cool and clear,
Cheering loud with lots of cheer.

Now it's time to rest my head,
Crawling in my little bed.
Close my eyes and count to ten,
Wake up to play once again.

Dreaming of the sky so blue,
All my wishes coming true.
Hi, my name is Sam, goodnight,
Sleeping till the morning light!

rhymes.title: Sam Wakes Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam! I am.
Open up my eyes, oh slam!
Morning sun is shining bright,
Chasing all away the night.

Stretch up high and touch the sky,
Wave a happy morning hi!
Throw the cozy blankets back,
Ready for a fun-filled track.

Time to wiggle every toe,
Where do we begin to go?
Jump right out of little bed,
Nod our sleepy, happy head.

Socks go on my dancing feet,
Walking down the morning street.
Hi, my name is Sam today,
Ready, set, and let's go play!

rhymes.title: Sam Brushes Teeth
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam, you see,
Brushing teeth is fun for me!
Grab my brush of shiny blue,
Squeeze the paste right onto you.

Up and down the bubbles go,
Scrubbing fast and scrubbing slow.
Brush the back and brush the front,
Making funny monkey grumph.

 Spit the water in the sink,
Take a happy little drink.
Now my smile is shining bright,
Sparkling in the morning light.

All clean and fresh for every friend,
This is how the brushing ends.
Hi, my name is Sam, Hurray!
Ready for a brand new day!

rhymes.title: Sam Gets Dressed
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam, let's look,
Finding clothes just like a book.
Yellow shirt goes on my head,
Right beside my little bed.

Pulls my arms right through the sleeves,
Rustling like the autumn leaves.
Step into my trousers blue,
Pull them all the way on through.

Zippity zipper up so fast,
Got my favorite socks at last.
Shoes go on my left and right,
Buckled up and shining bright.

Look at Sam, so neat and fine,
Every button is in line.
Hi, my name is Sam, oh boy,
Getting dressed is such a joy!

rhymes.title: Sam Eats Lunch
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam, yum yum,
Listen to my tummy hum!
Sitting in my little chair,
Eating healthy food with care.

Carrot sticks go crunch and munch,
In my belly for my lunch.
Apple slices sweet and red,
Butter on my piece of bread.

Drink my water, sip by sip,
Never let a droplet drip.
Use my napkin on my face,
Keep a neat and tidy place.

All done eating, plate is clear,
Time to clap and give a cheer.
Hi, my name is Sam, so fed,
Time to take a nap in bed!

rhymes.title: Sam Cleans Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam, let's play,
Put our little toys away.
Blocks go in the wooden box,
Right beside the fuzzy socks.

Teddy bear goes on the shelf,
He can sit up there himself.
Crayons in their little case,
Everything is in its place.

Pick up yellow, pick up blue,
There is so much we can do.
Working hard and singing song,
Helping out the whole day long.

Room is tidy, floor is clean,
Bestest helper ever seen.
Hi, my name is Sam, goodbye,
Waving underneath the sky!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Morning Wake Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
I am wide awake!
Time to jump and wiggle,
For goodness and for sake!

Stretch up to the ceiling,
Touch down to my toes.
Give a happy giggle,
Right upon my nose!

Sun is shining brightly,
Birds begin to sing.
I am feeling ready,
For each and everything!

Clothes are on so cozy,
Shoes tied nice and neat.
Hello, happy morning,
With my happy feet!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Tooth Brushing Time
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Time to brush my teeth!
Scrubbing all the top ones,
Scrubbing underneath.

Up and down and sideways,
Make the bubbles bright.
Spit into the basin,
Sparkling clean and white!

Now my mouth is fresh,
Ready for a smile.
I can keep on brushing,
For a little while.

All done with the toothbrush,
Proud as I can be.
Happy little pearly whites,
Smiling back at me!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Getting Dressed
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Finding what to wear.
Red shirt and blue shorts,
Sitting on the chair.

Put my arms right through,
Pull it over top.
Spin around in circles,
Till I have to stop!

Socks upon my feet now,
One and then the other.
Smiling big and waving,
At my happy mother.

Buttons are so easy,
Zippers go zip-zap.
Ready for the day now,
No more need for nap!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Hand Washing
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Time to wash my hands.
Bubbles on my fingers,
From all different lands!

Turn the water running,
Nice and warm and sweet.
Rub the soapy bubbles,
Isn't this a treat?

Between my little fingers,
On the back and palm.
Wash away the tickles,
Nice and neat and calm.

Dry them on the towel,
Soft and fluffy white.
Now my hands are spotless,
Everything is right!

rhymes.title: Hi, My Name Is Sam - Bedtime Routine
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Stars are out tonight.
Put away my toys now,
Everything is right.

Put on cozy pajamas,
Soft as any cloud.
Sing a quiet lullaby,
Not too loud.

Climb into the bed now,
Tucked in fast and deep.
Time to close my heavy eyes,
Drifting off to sleep.

Dreaming happy dreams now,
Till the morning light.
Sleep well, little teddy bear,
Everybody, goodnight!

rhymes.title: Sam Wakes Up
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Eating yummy jam.
Morning sun is bright,
Everything is light.

Now I stretch up high,
Reaching for the sky.
Time to get out, oh!
Ready, set, and go.

Put on yellow socks,
Step upon the box.
Brush my little teeth,
Up and down beneath.

Happy as can be,
Smiling all for me.
Sam is wide awake,
Ready now to bake!

rhymes.title: Sam Gets Dressed
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Happy as a clam.
Finding clothes to wear,
Brushing up my hair.

First a blue t-shirt,
Safe from any dirt.
Then some comfy pants,
Time to do a dance.

Find my fuzzy shoes,
Nothing here to lose.
Put them on my feet,
Looking very neat.

Jumping up and down,
Best boy in the town.
Sam is dressed so well,
Hear the ringing bell!

rhymes.title: Sam Washes Hands
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Wash just like a lamb.
Walking to the sink,
Quick as just a wink.

Turn the water on,
Watch the germs be gone.
Put the soap in hand,
Best in all the land.

Rub them scrub them clean,
Best you've ever seen.
Blowing bubbles high,
Reaching to the sky.

Rinse them in the stream,
Happy little beam.
Sam is clean today,
Ready now to play!

rhymes.title: Sam Eats Lunch
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Eating eggs and spam.
Sitting in my chair,
Food is waiting there.

Grab the silver spoon,
Sing a little tune.
Munching on a pear,
Flying through the air.

Drink the water cup,
Drink it bottom up.
Wipe my little face,
In my proper place.

Tummy is so full,
Like a gentle bull.
Sam is finished now,
Taking happy bow!

rhymes.title: Sam Goes to Sleep
rhymes.text:
Hi, my name is Sam,
Cozy in my pram.
Stars are in the sky,
Singing lullaby.

Put away the toys,
Quiet make no noise.
Slip into my bed,
Pillow for my head.

Teddy holds me tight,
Through the starry night.
Close your sleepy eyes,
Under painted skies.

Dreaming of the sun,
Day is nearly done.
Sam is sleeping deep,
Counting little sheep.

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Today is a brand new day at preschool, and the big yellow clock says it is almost time for Circle Time! Sammy the little bear loves Circle Time. He scurries over to his cubby and hangs up his fuzzy blue jacket. 'Time to gather, friends!' calls Teacher Mia, giving a happy little wave. Sammy hears the soft, gentle strumming of the classroom guitar. Plink, plink, plonky-plonk! That is the special song that tells everyone it is time to sit together in a cozy circle on the colorful ABC rug. Sammy walks slowly and carefully, keeping his hands to himself. He finds his favorite spot right next to his best friend, Lily. He sits criss-cross applesauce, just like a pretzel! 'Look at you sitting so tall and proud, Sammy,' whispers Teacher Mia with a warm, encouraging smile. Sammy beams with pride. He feels so safe and happy in his special sitting spot. Next, it is time for the hello song. Everyone waves their hands high in the air and sings hello to the sun, hello to the trees, and hello to each other. Sammy waves his paws gently and sings along in his sweet little voice. When we sit together in a circle, we share our smiles and our joy. Teacher Mia holds up a bright yellow sun made of felt. 'Who would like to hold the sunshine today?' she asks. Sammy gently raises his hand, waiting his turn so patiently. 'You are doing a wonderful job waiting, Sammy,' says Teacher Mia, placing the soft yellow sun right in his paws. Sammy holds it close to his heart. Circle Time is a wonderful way to start the morning, full of music, sharing, and friends. Sammy takes a deep breath, feeling ready for all the fun adventures the day will bring. Hooray for Circle Time!

stories.title: Bella's Big Breathing Star
stories.text: Ring-a-ling-ling! Goes the classroom chime. That is the gentle reminder that Circle Time is starting now! Bella the bunny hops over to the bright red circle on the big fuzzy rug. She loves the rug because it is as soft as a cloud. Bella has a little bit of nervous energy today. Her tummy feels like it is full of bouncing little frogs. She takes a deep breath and looks at her kind teacher, Mr. Tom. 'Come find your cozy place, Bella,' Mr. Tom says, tapping the carpet gently next to him. Bella sits down and tucks her feet in, making a nice little circle shape. Mr. Tom holds up a shiny blue star cutout. 'Let's take three big, beautiful breaths together,' he says softly. Bella watches Mr. Tom closely. When he breathes in, she breathes in. She sniffs the air just like a little bunny smelling a sweet flower. Ready? In through the nose... ahhh. Out through the mouth... phew! Bella feels the bouncing frogs in her tummy settle down, one by one. 'Great job using your breathing star, Bella! You are so good at helping your body feel calm,' praises Mr. Tom. Bella smiles a big, toothy bunny smile. She feels proud of herself for taking care of her big feelings. Now it is time to look at the weather board. Mr. Tom asks if anyone sees the sun outside. Bella raises her hand high and points to the window. 'I see big yellow sunshine!' she announces happily. Mr. Tom helps her place the sun icon right on the board. Bella claps her hands with joy. Circle Time is a safe and peaceful place where everyone belongs. Bella feels warm and happy, ready to share her bright sunshine with all her friends for the rest of the wonderful day.

stories.title: Leo Learns the Listening Ears
stories.text: Good morning, little star! The classroom is buzzing with happy morning sounds. Footsteps patter, blocks clack together, and giggles float through the air. Then, the music box plays a magical lullaby melody. Ding-dong, dong-ding! That is the cue for Circle Time! Leo the lion cub loves to play, but sometimes it is hard to stop playing and come to the rug. Today, Leo hears the music and takes a big step toward the circle. 'Time for our morning gathering, little lions,' says Teacher Sarah with open arms. Leo scurries over and sits down right in the front row. He gives his ears a gentle tug. 'Putting on my listening ears!' Leo giggles softly to himself. Teacher Sarah smiles and nods. 'Thank you for getting ready so quickly, Leo. I love how you are paying attention.' Leo puffs out his furry chest, feeling very proud. Today is sharing day at Circle Time! Leo brought his favorite smooth brown pinecone from the park. He holds it carefully in both hands, waiting patiently while his friend Maya talks about her shiny red toy car. Leo practices being a wonderful friend by looking at Maya and nodding his head. When it is his turn, Leo holds up his pinecone. 'I found this under the big oak tree,' Leo says in a clear, happy voice. Everyone looks at him with kind and interested eyes. Teacher Sarah claps her hands, and all the children clap too. 'Thank you for sharing your special treasure with us, Leo!' she says. Circle Time teaches us how to listen, how to share, and how to care for one another. Leo looks around the circle at all his smiling friends and feels his heart fill with warm, glowing sunshine. What a wonderful way to begin the day together!

stories.title: Sammy's Soft-Ground Sit
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! It is time for Circle Time, my favorite part of the whole day. Come along and bring your happy little feet. Tip-toe, tip-toe, hop, hop, hop! Look right over there on the warm rug. A big bright circle is waiting just for you. Sammy the bunny hops right over with a gentle wiggle of his fluffy cotton tail. He looks down at the colorful shapes on the floor. Wow, look at the shiny blue star! Sammy wants to sit right on the star today. Let us practice sitting criss-cross applesauce, just like the big kids do. Cross your little legs, one and two. Put your gentle hands right in your lap. Look at you! You are sitting so still and so tall, like a proud little sunflower reaching up toward the sky. That is wonderful, sweet friend! Sitting together in our circle helps us feel safe, cozy, and ready to learn. When we sit nicely on the rug, we can see all of our wonderful classroom friends smiling right back at us. Wave hello to Maya! Wave hello to Leo! Everyone is here, and everyone has a special cozy spot. Circle time is a time for listening, sharing, and growing together. You are doing such a magnificent job keeping your body calm and ready. Let us take a deep breath in through our little button noses, smelling the sweet morning air, and blow it gently out like a soft birthday candle. Whew! Your body feels so relaxed now. Sitting on the rug is safe, it is fun, and it is a wonderful place to be. Give yourself a big, warm hug because you are a super star sitter today. Let us clap our hands one, two, three, and get ready for the very first fun song of our wonderful morning together. Hooray for circle time!

stories.title: Lila's Listening Ears
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! The morning bell is ringing, ding-dong-ding! That means it is time to gather together on our big rainbow rug for Circle Time. Lila the little lion cub loves circle time more than anything in the whole wide world. But before the stories and songs begin, Lila needs to turn on her magical listening ears. Can you help Lila find her listening ears? Let us reach up high with our fingers, touch the tips of our soft little ears, and give them a gentle twist. Click, clack! Listening ears are turned all the way on! That means our talking mouths are quiet and resting, just like little mice, while our big brown eyes are watching the friendly teacher. Look how wonderfully Lila pays attention. When teacher talks, Lila listens with her whole heart. If someone else is sharing a story about their shiny red truck, Lila listens without interrupting.
