That is such a kind and caring way to be a good friend. Listening is like a superpower. It helps us learn new things, hear silly animal sounds, and understand how our friends are feeling today. Sometimes, we hear the tick-tock of the classroom clock. Sometimes, we hear the pitter-patter of rain outside the big glass window. And sometimes, we hear our teacher whisper a fun secret game. You have got the best listening ears in the whole room, did you know that? Yes, you do! Your ears are little sponges soaking up all the lovely sounds of our happy classroom. Let us cup our hands around our ears and listen closely. Can you hear my gentle voice? I can hear yours too! Thank you for being such a fantastic listener today. You make circle time so peaceful and bright for everyone. Give your ears a gentle pat and smile. You are ready for the magic of our day to begin!

stories.title: Oliver's Sharing Star
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! The sun is peeking through the window, tickling our sleepy noses. It is time for Circle Time, where something very special happens every single day. Today is the day we pass around the Sharing Star! The Sharing Star is bright yellow, soft as a fluffy marshmallow, and sparkles with glitter that catches the morning light. It is currently resting in the gentle hands of Oliver the owl. Oliver looks around the circle with his big, round, happy eyes. It is his turn to hold the star and tell everyone his favorite thing in the world. He holds the star tight against his feathery chest and says in a sweet, quiet voice, 'My favorite thing is sharing bubbles with my best friends.' Then, Oliver uses both of his hands to gently pass the sparkly star to the friend sitting right next to him. Look at how carefully he passes it! He holds it out and says, 'Here you go, friend.' Passing the star takes teamwork, patience, and a whole lot of love. When it is your turn to hold the Sharing Star, you feel so proud and special. You can tell the group about a happy dream you had, your favorite puppy, or just say hello to everyone. And when you are all done, you pass the star along to the next waiting hands. Sharing makes our hearts grow bigger and warmer inside. It is wonderful to take turns and wait patiently while our friends have their special moment in the spotlight. You are so good at sharing, just like a kind and caring leader. Let us clap our hands together for the Sharing Star and for all the wonderful friends in our circle. You are glowing brighter than the star itself, little sunshine. Have a truly wonderful day!

stories.title: Sammy's Magic Star
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! It is time to wake up and get ready for a wonderful day. Sammy the little bunny rubs his sleepy eyes. Yawn! Big stretch! Up to the sky go his fluffy paws. Today is a very special day at preschool because it is Circle Time Sunshine day. Sammy hops out of bed and brushes his teeth. Brush, brush, brush, make those teeth shine bright like the morning sun! Next, Sammy puts on his favorite yellow shirt, bright just like a buttercup. He eats a yummy bowl of oatmeal with sweet berries. Yum, yum, my tummy is full and happy! Now, it is time to put on shoes. Velcro straps go press-clack! Sammy is ready to go. When Sammy arrives at school, his teacher, Ms. Duck, rings a gentle silver bell. Ding-dong! That is the special sound that means it is time for Circle Time Sunshine. Sammy walks over to the cozy rug on the floor. He looks down and finds his very own spot, right on the sparkly star sticker. Sammy sits criss-cross applesauce. He puts his hands quietly in his lap. Wow, what a wonderful listener! Ms. Duck smiles a big, warm smile and gives Sammy a gentle high-five. 'Good job sitting so nicely, Sammy,' she whispers. Sammy feels so proud inside, like a warm little fire. Around the circle, all the other little animals are sitting down too. Benny Bear waves hello, and Lily Lamb giggles softly. Circle Time Sunshine begins with a happy good morning song. Everyone sings together, clapping their hands to the happy beat. Sammy sways from side to side. He loves this safe, cozy time with his friends. Next, it is time for the Sunshine Helper of the Day. Guess who it is? It is Sammy! Sammy's heart does a happy little flip-flop. He gets to hold the big, bright yellow felt sun and place it right in the middle of the flannel board. He reaches up tall on his tiptoes and sticks the sun up high. Everyone claps for Sammy. 'Yay, Sammy!' they cheer. Sammy beams from ear to ear. He sits back down on his star, feeling so happy, so loved, and so ready for all the fun adventures the rest of the day will bring. Good morning, Circle Time Sunshine!

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Yellow Hat
stories.text: Ring-a-ling-ling! The classroom clock says it is almost time for the most favorite part of the whole morning. Do you know what it is? It is Circle Time Sunshine! Mia loves Circle Time Sunshine. She bounces on her little tiptoes as she walks into the bright, cheerful classroom. Today, Mia has a very special secret tucked inside her backpack. It is a bright yellow sun hat, soft as a cloud and glowing like a lemon drop. Mia takes off her little blue jacket and hangs it carefully on her hook. Good job being so independent, Mia! She walks over to the big rainbow rug where all her friends are starting to gather. The rug is soft and warm. Mia looks for her favorite spot, right next to the green velvet pillow. She sits down gently, folding her legs like a butterfly's wings. Criss-cross applesauce! Her hands rest softly in her lap. Mia takes a deep breath in. Smell the flowers! And a slow breath out. Blow out the candle! Now Mia is calm, quiet, and ready. Teacher Sarah sits in the big wooden rocking chair. She smiles a sweet, gentle smile at Mia and all the children. 'Good morning, my little sunbeams,' Teacher Sarah says in her happy voice. 'Good morning, Teacher Sarah!' everyone chimes back together. Mia raises her hand. She wants to share her special hat. Teacher Sarah calls her name softly. 'Would Mia like to show us something sunny today?' Mia nods happily. She opens her backpack and pulls out her bright yellow sun hat. She places it gently on her head. The brim bounces with every little nod. 'Look!' whispers Mia proudly. 'It makes me look like a real sunshine!' All the children clap their hands together. 'So pretty, Mia!' says Leo the lion cub. Mia feels a warm, cozy glow bubble up inside her chest. Sharing makes her feel so happy. Teacher Sarah leads the class in a stretching song. They reach their arms way up high, trying to tickle the ceiling. Then they bend down low to touch their toes. Reach high, touch low, stretch, stretch, go! Mia laughs a bubbly giggle. Circle Time Sunshine is full of so much joy and movement. When the song is finished, Mia gently takes off her hat and places it safely in her cubby. She sits right back down on her rainbow rug, feeling like a bright, shining star. What a wonderful, happy morning.

stories.title: Leo's Big Listening Ears
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! It is a brand new day full of bright possibilities. Little Leo the lion cub stretches out his arms and lets out a tiny, sleepy roar. Roar! Time to get ready for preschool. Leo loves school, especially when the morning bell rings for Circle Time Sunshine. Leo gets dressed in his comfy orange overalls and puts on his bright yellow socks. He eats every single bite of his crunchy banana slices. Nom, nom, nom! My tummy is happy and strong! At the school door, Leo gives his mommy a big, tight hug and a loud kiss. 'Have a wonderful day, my little sunshine,' Mommy whispers. Leo skips happily into the classroom. The room is filled with soft light and the happy chatter of his friends. Suddenly, the soft chime of a singing bowl echoes through the room. Ding-ng-ng... The sound floats in the air like a magical bubble. That means it is time for Circle Time Sunshine! Leo knows just what to do. He walks gently across the room. No running inside, use walking feet! He finds his place on the big yellow circle rug. Leo sits down. He crosses his legs and folds his hands in his lap. Then, Leo turns on his big listening ears. Click-clack! His listening ears are turned all the way up, ready to hear wonderful things. Teacher Maya begins to speak in a soothing, gentle voice. She tells a lovely story about a little bird finding a yellow feather. Leo listens so carefully. He keeps his eyes on the teacher and his body nice and calm. He is doing such a wonderful job! Teacher Maya looks right at Leo and gives him a special thumbs-up. 'Thank you for your super listening ears, Leo,' she says softly. Leo beams with pride. Being a good listener feels so good! Next, it is time for the Sunshine Song. Everyone stands up and sways together like sunflowers in a gentle breeze. Leo spins around once, twice, and giggles as he gently sits back down on the rug. Circle Time Sunshine is a time for peace, for sharing, and for feeling safe and happy with friends. Leo looks around the circle at all his smiling buddies. He feels so warm and cozy inside, just like he is wrapped up in a giant yellow blanket of pure sunshine. What a happy, wonderful start to the day!

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Today is a brand new day at preschool, and the big clock on the wall says it is almost time for Circle Time! Sammy the little bear loves Circle Time very much. He hears the happy chime of the teacher’s tiny silver bell. Ding-dong-ding! That is the special sound that tells all the friends it is time to gather together on the soft yellow rug. Sammy finishes washing his paws and scurries right over. 'Come find your spot, Sammy!' says Teacher Emma with a big, warm smile. Sammy looks down at the colorful carpet. There are circles of red, blue, green, and yellow. Sammy gently sits right down on his favorite yellow circle, crossing his little bear legs and putting his hands nicely in his lap. Look at you go, Sammy! That is wonderful sitting. All around the room, other little friends hurry over too. Lily sits on blue, and Toby sits on red. Soon, everyone is snuggled close together in a giant, cozy circle, just like a warm sunshine hug. Teacher Emma holds up a bright yellow sun cutout made of sparkly paper. 'Good morning, circle sunshine friends!' she sings. Sammy smiles from ear to ear. He loves waving hello to his friends. 'Hello, Lily! Hello, Toby!' he whispers happily. Sitting nicely in circle time helps everyone see each other's friendly faces and share wonderful stories. Sammy raises his hand high when Teacher Emma asks who brought a green toy today. He waits so patiently for his turn to speak, just like a big boy. Taking turns is so much fun, and listening to friends is a kind choice. When the sunshine song begins, Sammy sways gently from side to side, clapping his hands to the beat. Tap, tap, tap go the little hands on the rug. Circle time is such a happy, safe place to learn and grow. Sammy takes a deep breath of the fresh morning air and feels so proud of his wonderful listening ears and his cozy sitting spot. What a super star morning routine!

stories.title: Mia's Magical Morning Song
stories.text: Good morning, bright sunshine! The classroom window lets in golden beams of morning light, warming up the soft floor cushions. It is time for Circle Time! Mia the little bunny loves the morning song the best. When the teacher plays the cheerful tune on her little wooden guitar, strum-strum-strum, Mia knows exactly what to do. She hops over lightly on her tip-toes, right to her spot on the purple circle. 'Great job walking inside, Mia,' says Teacher Sarah, giving her a gentle thumbs-up. Mia beams with pride. She sits down criss-cross applesauce, making her legs look like little butterfly wings. Sitting tall and straight takes strong tummy muscles, and Mia is getting stronger every single day! One by one, all the other children join the circle. There is a lot of happy chatter and giggles floating in the air. Teacher Sarah holds up a big picture book about the morning sky. 'Are we ready for our story?' she asks. Mia nods her head eagerly and opens her eyes wide. Listening means keeping our bodies calm and our voices quiet so our friends can hear every single word. Mia hugs her knees for just a moment to help her body settle down, practicing her deep breathing. In goes the air, out goes the air, just like a sleepy little cloud floating in the sky. When the teacher asks a question about the friendly sun in the picture, Mia raises her hand softly. She waits patiently for her name to be called. 'Yes, Mia?' says the teacher. Mia shares her bright idea about how the sun makes the flowers grow big and tall. Everyone turns to look at Mia with kind, encouraging eyes. Sharing thoughts in circle time is such a magical feeling. When the song starts up again, Mia claps along with a big smile, feeling happy, included, and ready for a wonderful day of play and learning together.

stories.title: Leo's Loving Listening Ears
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine friends! The day has officially begun, and the bright yellow rug in the center of the playroom is calling our names. It is Circle Time! Leo the little puppy loves Circle Time because it is the best place to share news and see his best buddies. When the tambourine shakes—shake, shake, shake—Leo knows it is time to wrap up his block tower and transition to the rug. He gently places his last wooden block in the basket and stands up tall. 'Time for circle, Leo!' says Teacher Jess with a cheerful nod. Leo walks over carefully, making sure not to bump into anyone's art projects. He finds his special green spot on the rug and sits down gently, folding his hands like a book. Look at those wonderful listening ears, Leo! You are doing an amazing job. Soon, the whole group is gathered round, making a big, friendly circle that looks just like a golden sunshine ring. Teacher Jess has a special helper today who gets to hold the weather pointer. Today, Leo is the weather helper! He feels a little flutter of excitement in his tummy. He stands up bravely, walks over to the big weather board, and points right to the smiling yellow sun. 'It is sunny outside today!' Leo announces in a clear, happy voice. All his friends clap their hands and cheer for him. 'Yay, Leo!' they say. Leo feels so proud and happy inside. He walks back to his spot, sits right back down, and listens while his friend takes a turn. Circle time teaches us how to share the spotlight, cheer for others, and listen with our whole hearts. When the final good-morning song plays, Leo sways his shoulders and smiles brightly at everyone. What a wonderful way to start a day full of sunshine, kindness, and big smiles!

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Good morning, little sunbeams! It is time for Circle Time, the happiest part of the whole preschool day. Today, Sammy the squirrel is feeling just a little bit wiggly. His little fuzzy tail wants to wiggle, and his paws want to bounce. But wait! Teacher bear rings the gentle chime, and the soft, colorful carpet sparkles with magic. Sammy takes a deep breath in through his nose, smelling yummy strawberries, and blows out through his mouth like a birthday candle. Puff! He feels so calm. Now, it is time to find his special sitting spot on the yellow star. Sammy criss-crosses his legs, just like pretzel sticks, and puts his hands safely in his lap. Look at him go! That is wonderful, Sammy. Teacher smiles and gives him a big thumbs-up. 'Good sitting, my friend!' she says softly. Sammy beams with pride. Sitting nicely feels so warm and cozy, just like a hug from the morning sun. Around the circle, all his friends are getting ready, too. Lily sits like a swan, and Leo sits like a brave little lion. Together, they hold hands to make a big, friendly circle that goes all the way around the rug. Sammy looks to his left and smiles at Lily, then to his right and smiles at Leo. Everyone is ready for the fun songs and stories to begin. Circle Time is a special place where everyone belongs, and Sammy knows he is doing a super-duper job. He keeps his eyes on the teacher and listens with his big, open ears. When it is time to sing the hello song, Sammy's voice is sweet and clear. He waves his hand happily, feeling so proud of his wonderful listening ears and his cozy sitting spot. Yay for Circle Time!

stories.title: Mia's Magic Listening Ears
stories.text: Ring-a-ling-ling! Hear the happy bell ring? That means it is time for Circle Time Sunshine, my absolute favorite time of the day! Little Mia loves Circle Time, but sometimes it is hard to stop playing with her shiny red blocks. Today, Teacher Sarah holds up her hands and makes giant bunny ears on her head. 'Time to turn on our magic listening ears, little bunnies!' she whispers. Mia giggles. She reaches up, grabs her own cute little ears, and makes a big *click-clack* sound. 'Click! My listening ears are turned all the way up!' Mia says cheerfully. Now, her ears are super-duper big and ready to catch every single sound. She can hear the soft tick-tock of the classroom clock, the rustle of the storybook pages, and Teacher Sarah’s kind, musical voice. When a friend talks, Mia keeps her lips zipped tight like a little purse and listens with all her heart. This is called being a wonderful friend! Teacher Sarah points to the picture chart to show what they will do next. Mia looks closely with her bright, shiny eyes. She practices waiting patiently for her turn to speak, remembering to raise her hand high in the air like a tall green tree. When Teacher Sarah calls her name, Mia beams from ear to ear. She shares her idea about the fluffy white clouds in the sky, and everyone claps for her. Clip-clap, hooray! Listening to others makes Mia feel like she is glowing from the inside out. She gives herself a gentle pat on the shoulder. 'Good job listening, Mia!' she whispers to herself. Circle Time is a magical place of sharing and caring, and Mia’s magic ears make her the best listener in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Leo's Loving Sharing Circle
stories.text: The morning sunbeams are dancing on the polka-dot rug, and that means Circle Time is here! Today is Sharing Day, and everyone has brought something special from home. Little Leo is holding his favorite bumpy blue rubber ball very tightly in his hands. He loves his ball so much. It bounces high, and it feels nice and cool. But guess what? Sharing can be tricky, even for big boys like Leo. Teacher invites Leo to the middle of the circle to show his ball. Leo’s heart beats a little fast—thump, thump, thump. Can he share his favorite toy? Yes, he can! Leo takes a deep, brave breath. He gently rolls the bouncy blue ball across the soft rug toward his friend Maya. 'Here you go, Maya!' Leo says in his kindest, sweetest voice. Maya catches the ball with a squeal of pure joy. 'Thank you, Leo!' she says, and she rolls it right back to him. Leo catches it safely in his hands. A warm, happy feeling spreads all through his tummy. Sharing makes his heart feel as big as the sky! Teacher claps her hands together. 'Such wonderful sharing, Leo! You are a superstar friend!' Leo smiles a huge, proud smile, showing all his shiny teeth. Around the circle, everyone takes turns passing the ball, saying kind words, and waiting patiently. Leo practices patience by keeping his hands in his lap and cheering for his friends. When it is someone else's turn, he watches happily and claps his hands. Circle Time Sunshine is all about sharing love, kindness, and fun with the people we care about. Leo knows he is safe, he is loved, and he is doing an amazing job today. Hooray for sharing!

stories.title: Good Morning, Yellow Circle!
stories.text:
Good morning, little sunshine! It is time to wake up and get ready for a wonderful day. First, we stretch our arms way up high, touching the sky like tall, green trees. Reach, reach, reach! Great job! Now, let us wiggle our tiny fingers and stomp our happy feet on the cozy rug. Thump, thump, thump! It is almost time for Circle Time Sunshine at preschool, and everyone is so excited to see your bright, smiling face.

Now, it is time to put on your favorite socks. Slide one foot in, and then the other. Yay! You did it all by yourself! Independence makes you glow just like the morning sun. Next, we put on our softest sweater. Arms through the holes, and pop! Your head comes right out the top, ready to greet the world. You are looking so handsome and ready for fun.

Let us walk to the kitchen for a yummy breakfast. Crunch, crunch goes the healthy apple. Sip, sip goes the cool water. Eating good food gives your body super-duper energy for running, jumping, and playing games with your best friends today. You are growing so strong and tall!

Now, grab your favorite little red backpack and march to the front door. Click goes the door handle, and outside we go. The sun is shining warm and bright, just for you. Look at the fluffy white clouds floating by in the blue sky. Listen to the sweet little birds singing their happy morning song. 

As you walk into the classroom, your teacher smiles and calls your name. It is time for Circle Time Sunshine! We all sit down together on the big, colorful rug, crossing our legs and making a nice, big circle. You raise your hand to share your favorite toy, and everyone claps because you are such a wonderful friend. You did a fantastic job getting ready today. Give yourself a big hug, little star. You are ready to shine all day long!

stories.title: The Sunshine Song and Sharing Spot
stories.text:
Rise and shine, sleepyhead! The golden morning sun is peeking right through your bedroom window, saying hello to you. Open your big, beautiful eyes and let out a happy little yawn. Ahhh! Today is a very special day because we get to go to school for Circle Time Sunshine, where we sing songs, read fun stories, and play with all of our kind friends.

First, let us brush those sparkling white teeth. Up and down, left and right, scrubbing away the sleepy bugs! Now, let us wash your face with nice warm water and pat it dry with a fluffy towel. Look in the mirror—who is that cute little person? It is you! You look so fresh and ready for a brand new adventure.

Time to pick out your clothes. Would you like the blue shirt with the happy dinosaur or the red one with the zooming spaceship? The spaceship! Awesome choice. Push your arms through the sleeves, pull down the hem, and wiggle your wiggle-toes into your shoes. Look at you getting dressed like a big kid! That is something to be super proud of.

In the kitchen, a bowl of warm, yummy oatmeal is waiting. Blow gently on the spoon. Whoosh! Now taste it. Delicious! Your tummy is full and happy, giving you all the power you need to have the best day ever.

We put on our bright yellow jacket and head out into the fresh morning air. The wind whispers hello through the trees, and a yellow butterfly dances past. You skip happily all the way to the classroom door.

Inside, everyone is gathering on the soft carpet. The teacher strums the guitar, and it is time for Circle Time Sunshine! You find your special spot on the green square, sit criss-cross applesauce, and clap your hands to the rhythm. You share your yellow block with a friend who needs it, earning the biggest smile. Sharing makes your heart feel as warm as the sun. You are doing such an amazing job today!

stories.title: A Sunny Hello to My Friends
stories.text:
Good morning, sunshine! The day is starting with a bright, beautiful glow, and so are you. Stretch those sleepy arms out wide, wider, wider, and reach for the ceiling. Now touch your toes! Touch them gently. Wonderful! You woke up with so much energy today, and that makes everyone smile from ear to ear.

Now it is time to brush your hair so it looks neat and tidy. Stroke, stroke, stroke goes the gentle brush. Look at that shiny hair! Next, let us slip into your cozy pants and your favorite yellow shirt. Pull them up, pull them down, and give a little wiggle to make sure they fit just right. You look like a ray of sunshine ready to brighten up the whole room.

Let us go have a yummy breakfast to fuel our fun. Munch on some sweet strawberries and take a big gulp of milk. Gulp, gulp, gulp! Your tummy says thank you for the tasty food. You are fueled up and ready to conquer the day with kindness and joy.

Put on your walking shoes and zip up your jacket. Zip-zzzzt! Off we go down the pathway. The sunbeams are dancing on the pavement, making little golden patches everywhere. You hop over each one like a happy little frog. Hop, hop, hop! What a fun way to travel to school.

We arrive at the classroom, where the door is open wide. Teacher Sarah is welcoming everyone with open arms. It is time for Circle Time Sunshine! You walk inside, take off your jacket, and hang it neatly on your hook. Wow, what a helpful and independent choice!

You walk over to the circle of friends sitting on the floor. You sit down softly and cross your legs. When it is your turn to speak, you say hello to your neighbor in a sweet, clear voice. Everyone waves back and says hello to you, too. You feel so cozy, loved, and happy sitting right there in the circle. You are a bright, shining light in our world today!

stories.title: Sammy's Magic Star Song
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Wake up, stretch high up to the sky, wiggle your fingers, and wiggle your toes. Today is a very special day at preschool because it is time for Circle Time Sunshine! Sammy the bunny hopped through the classroom door with a big, happy smile. He hung up his tiny blue backpack on his very own hook. 'Great job, Sammy!' said Teacher Jen. Sammy felt so proud inside. He walked over to the cozy rug where all his friends were sitting. The rug was soft like a big cloud. 'Come sit criss-cross applesauce, little sunshine,' whispered Maya, patting the bright yellow spot right next to her. Sammy sat down gently. Now, it was time to sing the morning welcome song. 'Hello, friends, hello friends, how are you today?' sang Teacher Jen while strumming her bright red ukulele. Sammy clapped his hands to the happy music. Clack, clack, clack! He smiled big at every single friend in the circle. Next, it was time to share. Teacher Jen held up a shiny golden star wand. 'Who would like to share a happy thought today?' she asked kindly. Sammy raised his hand straight up into the air. 'I am holding my yellow star high,' he said softly. 'Thank you for sharing, Sammy,' praised Teacher Jen. She gently tapped his shoulder. Then, it was time for the stretching game. Everyone reached up to touch the sky and then touched their toes, just like sleepy little flowers waking up in the morning sunshine. Sammy giggled as he tickled his own knees. Circle Time Sunshine was the best part of the whole day. It made Sammy feel warm, loved, and ready to play and learn with all his wonderful friends.

stories.title: Leo's Bright Yellow Spot
stories.text: Ring-a-ling! The friendly classroom chime sounded softly, signaling that it was time to gather together. Leo the lion cub loved this sound because it meant Circle Time Sunshine was about to begin! Leo finished putting away his colorful wooden blocks on the shelf. He stacked them neatly, one on top of the other, just like a tall castle tower. 'Look at you being such a big helper, Leo!' cheered Nurse Sarah. Leo beamed with pride. He trotted over to the bright circle rug on the floor. The rug had big shapes of red, blue, green, and a glowing yellow sun right in the middle. Leo knew just where he wanted to sit. He sat right on the warm yellow sun spot, crossing his little legs and putting his hands gently in his lap. His friend Lily sat down beside him, wearing her favorite sparkly shoes. 'Good morning, Lily,' whispered Leo with a bright grin. 'Good morning, Leo!' she whispered back. Teacher Maria sat down on her low wooden stool holding a basket of colorful feeling cards. 'Good morning, sweet sunshine friends,' Teacher Maria said in a soothing voice. 'How is everyone feeling today?' One by one, the children took turns picking a card. When it was Leo's turn, he picked the happy sun card. 'I feel happy because I am sitting with my friends in the sunshine circle!' said Leo proudly. Teacher Maria clapped her hands. 'That is wonderful, Leo.' Then, they practiced deep breathing together. In through the nose like smelling a sweet flower, and out through the mouth like blowing out a birthday candle. Leo took a big breath in and blew it out. He felt so calm and ready for the fun day ahead.

stories.title: Mia's Morning Hello
stories.text: The morning sun peeked through the classroom window, casting a warm, golden glow all across the colorful playroom floor. 'Good morning, sunshine!' whispered Mia to her favorite teddy bear left safely in her cubby. Mia put her cubby door click-shut and skipped happily toward the center of the room. It was time for Circle Time Sunshine, her absolute favorite daily routine. The other children were already gathering on the big circular rug, chatting softly and giggling together. Mia looked for a nice spot to sit. She found a lovely spot right next to the green polka-dot cushion. She sat down smoothly, making her legs cross just like a pretzel. 'Hooray for Circle Time!' thought Mia. Mr. David, the lead teacher, smiled warmly at Mia as she joined the group. 'Welcome to our sunshine circle, Mia,' he said gently. Mia felt a warm, happy flutter in her tummy. Today, it was Mia’s special job to be the weather helper. Mr. David handed her the wooden sunshine pointer. Mia stood up carefully, walked over to the giant flannel weather board, and pointed right at the big smiling sun. 'The weather today is bright and sunny!' announced Mia in a clear, joyful voice. All her friends clapped their hands and cheered, 'Yay for the sun!' Mia beamed from ear to ear, feeling so proud of her important job. She skipped back to her spot on the cozy rug and sat down. Next, everyone joined hands in a big circle and sang a song about sharing and caring. Mia squeezed her friend's hand gently. Circle Time Sunshine always filled Mia's heart with so much joy, making her feel safe, happy, and ready to explore the wonderful world around her all day long.

stories.title: Sammy’s Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Wake up, stretch your arms up high, and wiggle your toes. Today is a very special day at preschool because it is time for Circle Time Sunshine! Sammy the bear loves Circle Time Sunshine so, so much. Sammy gets out of his cozy bed, brushes his soft little teeth, and puts on his bright yellow shirt. 'Today is going to be a wonderful day,' whispers Mama Bear. Sammy hops all the way to the big colorful rug at school. The teacher, kind Teacher Sarah, rings a gentle chime. Ding-dong! That is the happy sound that means it is time to sit together in a big circle. Sammy looks all around and sees his wonderful friends. But where should Sammy sit? He looks down at the floor and finds a sparkly green sitting spot with his name on it. Sammy gently bends his knees and sits right down on his spot. Cross applesauce, hands in your lap! Sammy takes a deep breath in through his nose, smelling the morning air, and breathes out through his mouth. Teacher Sarah smiles a big, warm smile and says, 'Thank you for sitting so nicely on your spot, Sammy.' Sammy feels so proud inside. Sitting nicely at Circle Time is a big-kid skill, and Sammy is doing it all by himself! Next, it is time for the hello song. Everyone waves their hands high in the air and sings hello to each other. Sammy waves to Lily, and Lily waves right back with a giggly grin. Circle Time Sunshine is full of warm feelings, happy songs, and sharing stories together. When Sammy listens with his big, open ears, he learns new things about the world. He learns about the weather outside, how the sun is shining down, and how today is going to be full of fun adventures. Sammy sits tall and straight, just like a strong, growing tree. He feels so happy to be part of the circle. When the song finishes, Sammy gives himself a gentle pat on the back. 'Good job, Sammy!' he says to himself. Learning how to wait, listen, and sit together makes Sammy feel like a true sunshine superstar. The day has only just begun, and Sammy is ready for whatever comes next with a happy heart and a bright smile.

stories.title: Mia’s Magic Listening Ears
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! It is time to get ready for a brand-new day filled with giggles and learning. Mia loves the morning routine. She eats her yummy breakfast, puts on her favorite red shoes, and gives her teddy bear a big hug goodbye. At the daycare center, the big clock on the wall ticks softly. Tock, tick, tock. Suddenly, the lovely sound of the singing bowl rings out. Bong! That is the magical chime for Circle Time Sunshine! Mia skips happily over to the soft blue rug where all her friends are gathering. Now, Mia has a very important job to do before she sits down. She needs to turn on her magic listening ears! Mia cups her little hands over her ears, twists them like knobs, and makes a funny 'beep-boop' sound. Her listening ears are officially turned on and ready to go. Mia sits down next to her best friend, Leo, and crosses her legs. She keeps her hands resting gently in her lap. Teacher Dave begins to talk about the weather, and Mia uses her listening ears to hear every single word. She hears the birds chirping in the story, and she hears the gentle rustle of the paper calendar. When Teacher Dave asks a question about what color the sky is today, Mia raises her hand high up into the air. She waits patiently, just like a good friend does, until Teacher Dave calls her name. 'Blue!' Mia says in a clear, happy voice. Teacher Dave beams with joy. 'That is right, Mia! The sky is bright blue today.' Mia feels a warm, cozy bubble of pride grow right inside her tummy. Listening carefully and sharing her thoughts makes her feel so grown-up. Circle Time Sunshine is a time for everyone to feel heard and loved. Mia loves hearing her friends talk, too. She looks right at them with kind, caring eyes while they share their favorite things. When Circle Time comes to a gentle close, Mia gives herself a happy little wiggle. She turns off her listening ears with another 'beep-boop' and stores them safely in her mind for later. Being a great listener is a superpower, and Mia is a super-listener every single day!

stories.title: Oliver’s Circle Time Song
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Rise and shine, time to make the world look fine! Oliver stretches out his arms wide like the morning sun. He had a wonderful night of sleep, and now he is ready for fun at preschool. The best part of the whole morning is getting to participate in Circle Time Sunshine. When Oliver walks into the classroom, the big circle rug is already waiting for him, looking like a rainbow on the floor. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple! Oliver chooses a lovely yellow spot to sit on, because yellow reminds him of the warm sun shining down from the sky. He sits down nice and cozy, folding his legs neatly together. Today, Oliver feels a little bit wiggly. His toes want to tap, and his fingers want to dance. But wait! Teacher Amy starts playing her cheerful guitar. Strum, strum, strum! Oliver takes a nice, deep breath and decides to use his wiggles for the Circle Time Sunshine song instead. The song is all about moving our bodies and then finding our calm. Oliver sings along in his sweetest voice, shaking his maraca when it is his turn. Shake, shake, shake! He passes the maraca gently to the friend sitting right next to him. Sharing with friends is such a kind thing to do, and Oliver loves making others smile. When the song changes to a quiet lullaby, Oliver brings his hands back to his lap and breathes softly. In and out, just like a sleeping kitten. Teacher Amy looks around the circle with so much love in her eyes. 'Thank you, everyone, for singing and sharing so beautifully today,' she says. Oliver feels so happy and proud of himself. He sat nicely, he shared his instrument, and he sang his heart out. Circle Time Sunshine brings all the friends together in a circle of kindness and joy. As everyone stands up to get ready for outdoor play, Oliver gives his sunshine spot a friendly little pat goodbye. What a wonderful way to start a bright and happy day!

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Today is a brand new day at preschool, and the big clock on the wall says it is almost time for Circle Time. Sammy the bunny rabbit backpack is tucked safely in his cubby, and Sammy the little toddler is ready for fun. 'BING-BONG!' goes the friendly classroom chime. That is our special song telling us it is time to gather on the big, soft rainbow rug. Sammy smiles a big, happy smile. He walks nicely with his walking feet over to the rug. Walking feet keep everyone safe and happy! Now, where should Sammy sit? There are so many bright colors! He sees a lovely spot right on the sunny yellow stripe. Sammy gently sits down, crossing his legs like a pretzel. Criss-cross, applesauce! That is the way we sit during circle time. Teacher Mia sits down too, holding a big storybook with a shiny star on the cover. She looks right at Sammy and says, 'Thank you for sitting so wonderfully, Sammy. You are a super listener!' Sammy feels a warm, proud bubble pop up inside his tummy. Sitting nicely at circle time makes him feel like a big boy. Next to him, his friend Lily drops her teddy bear. Sammy remembers to be kind. He picks up the bear and hands it back with a gentle pat. 'Thank you, Sammy!' whispers Lily. Teacher Mia begins to strum her little wooden guitar, and everyone starts to sing the good morning song. Sammy claps his hands to the happy beat. One, two, three, clap, clap, clap! He loves looking around at all his smiling friends. Circle time is such a cozy, wonderful place to be. When the song is all done, Teacher Mia holds up the magic pointer stick to see who is ready for the day's adventure. Sammy holds his hands politely in his lap, ready and eager. 'Good job waiting patiently,' Teacher Mia beams. Sammy beams right back, feeling like the brightest piece of sunshine in the whole room.

stories.title: Leo's Listening Ears
stories.text: Ring-a-ling-ling! Hear the happy bell ring! It is circle time, my little sunshine. Leo hears the bell and giggles. He loves circle time because that is when everyone comes together to share, sing, and learn. Leo finishes putting his blocks back in the red bin. Wow, what a great helper! Cleaning up before circle time is super important. Now, Leo skips over to the big round circle rug. It looks like a giant colorful flower on the floor. Leo finds a cozy green leaf to sit on. He sits down gently and gives his knees a big hug. Criss-cross, applesauce! Teacher Sarah smiles and holds her hands up to her ears. 'Time to turn on our listening ears, everyone!' she sings out. Leo cups his hands around his ears and makes a funny 'click-click' sound. 'Click! My listening ears are turned all the way up!' he whispers to his friend Maya. Maya giggles. During circle time, we listen with our ears, we look with our eyes, and we keep our hands in our laps. Teacher Sarah starts talking about today's weather. She holds up a picture of a big, smiling yellow sun. 'Is it raining today?' she asks. Leo raises his hand high up into the air. He remembers not to shout out, but to wait patiently until Teacher Sarah calls his name. 'Yes, Leo?' she asks kindly. 'It is sunny outside, Teacher Sarah! I can see the sunshine on the slide!' Leo says proudly. Teacher Sarah nods. 'Wonderful observing, Leo! You really are using your super listening eyes and ears today.' Leo feels so happy and proud. He gets a gold star sticker for being such a wonderful listener. Circle time is so much fun when we share our thoughts and listen to our friends. Leo cannot wait for tomorrow's circle time adventures!

stories.title: Mia's Magical Sharing Star
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! The classroom is buzzing with excitement because today is Show and Tell during circle time. Mia is holding her favorite toy very carefully. It is a sparkly purple star that twinkles in the light. Mia walks softly over to the big blue circle rug on the floor. She sits down right in the middle, crossing her little legs. Criss-cross, applesauce, nice and neat! Teacher Dan sits down with all the other toddlers in a lovely circle. Everyone looks eager and happy. 'Who would like to share first today?' Teacher Dan asks gently, looking around the room. Mia's heart does a little happy flutter. She raises her hand up high. 'I would, please!' she says in her sweetest voice. Teacher Dan smiles warmly. 'Go right ahead, Mia.' Mia stands up gently and walks to the center of the circle, holding her sparkly star with both hands. 'This is my star,' Mia says to her friends. 'It sparkles when the sun hits it, just like real sunshine.' The other children lean in close, their eyes wide with wonder. Leo says, 'Ooh, it is so pretty, Mia!' Mia feels so proud and happy inside. She remembers to use a kind, sharing voice. Sharing makes our hearts grow bigger! When she is all done talking, Mia says, 'Thank you for listening, friends.' She walks carefully back to her spot on the blue rug and sits down safely. Teacher Dan claps his hands, and everyone joins in. 'Great job sharing, Mia!' Mia beams a big, bright smile. Circle time is such a magical place where we can share the things we love with the people we care about. As the song begins, Mia sways gently, holding her sparkly star, feeling as warm and bright as the morning sun.

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Ring around the circle, big and bright! Good morning, little friends! It was time for Circle Time Sunshine at the cozy little preschool, and Sammy the bunny rabbit backpack was hanging safely on the hook. Sammy was a tiny little boy with soft brown curls and shiny blue shoes. Today, Sammy felt a little bit wiggly. His toes wanted to tap, and his fingers wanted to wiggle. But guess what? It was time for the special morning song! Miss Emma sat down on the big yellow rug and smiled a warm, sunny smile. 'Come find your spot, friends,' she sang softly. Sammy looked down at the floor. Right there, in the middle of the bright orange circle, was a shiny paper sun with his very own name on it. Sammy took a deep breath. One, two, three steps! He walked right over and sat down criss-cross applesauce. 'Wonderful listening, Sammy!' cheered Miss Emma. Sammy beamed with pride. He put his hands safely in his lap and looked all around. Maya was sitting to his left, and Leo was sitting to his right. Together, they held up their hands to make a big sunshine shape in the air. They stretched their arms up high, touching the imaginary warm rays. Sammy felt so happy and cozy. Sitting in the circle wasn't hard at all; it was just like being wrapped up in a warm, gentle blanket of sunshine. When the song finished, everyone clapped their hands softly. Sammy gave himself a gentle pat on the shoulder. He stayed sitting nice and tall, ready for the very next fun activity. Miss Emma pulled out a colorful storybook, and Sammy leaned forward, his eyes wide with wonder. Being a good listener made him feel like a bright, shining star. Hooray for Circle Time Sunshine!

stories.title: Mia's Magic Listening Ears
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine friends! The big golden sun was peeking right through the classroom window, painting little yellow patches on the soft blue carpet. It was time for Circle Time! Mia loved Circle Time because that was when everyone came together to share, sing, and play. But today, Mia had a little problem. She was playing with a shiny red block, and she didn't really want to put it away just yet. Her teacher, Mr. David, played a gentle chime on the little silver bell. Ding-dong! That was the magic sound that meant it was time to gather. Mia looked at her red block. Then, she looked up at Mr. David's kind, smiling face. 'Time to turn on our magic listening ears, everyone,' Mr. David whispered playfully, gently touching his own ears. Mia giggled. She reached up and touched her own cute little ears. Click, clack! She turned them on high. She carefully placed her red block back into the wooden toy box where it belonged. Then, she skipped happily over to the sunny yellow rug. She sat down right next to her best friend, Lily. 'I like how Mia put her toy away and found her spot so gently,' praised Mr. David. Mia felt a warm, happy bubble pop right inside her tummy. She sat up straight, put her hands in her lap, and opened her eyes wide. She listened to the birds singing outside the window. She listened to the soft strum of the guitar. Having magic listening ears made everything sound like music. Mia smiled a big, bright smile. She was ready for a wonderful day full of learning, sharing, and glowing just like the morning sun.

stories.title: Leo's Loving Sharing Star
stories.text: Shine on, little sunbeams! The classroom was buzzing with happy morning giggles. It was Circle Time Sunshine, the happiest part of the whole day. Today was a very special day because it was sharing day at the rug. Every child got a turn to hold the bright yellow Sharing Star and tell the group one thing that made them smile. Leo clutched his favorite smooth blue pebble tightly in his pocket. His turn was coming up soon, and his heart was beating a little fast, like a little fluttery butterfly. Thump, thump, thump! Leo looked down at his shoes. Was he ready to speak in front of all his friends? Miss Emma passed the sparkly yellow star to Maya, who shared that she loved fuzzy puppies. Then, Maya gently passed the star to Leo. Leo took a deep breath. The room was so quiet and safe, filled with loving, encouraging smiles from his friends and teacher. Leo gently pulled the blue pebble out of his pocket and held it up high for everyone to see. 'This is my happy pebble,' Leo said in a soft, clear voice. 'I found it in the garden with my daddy.' Miss Emma clapped her hands softly. 'Thank you for sharing your special treasure with us, Leo!' All the other children clapped too, their faces glowing with warmth. Leo felt a wonderful wave of sunshine wash right over him. He wasn't shy anymore; he felt brave and proud. He passed the star carefully to the next friend, feeling like a glowing ray of light. Circle Time Sunshine was truly the best place in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Today is a brand new day at preschool, and the clock says it is almost time for Circle Time. Sammy the little bunny loves Circle Time because it is a cozy place where everyone comes together to share big smiles and happy moments. Teacher Sarah rings her gentle silver bell, and the soft chime goes ding-dong, calling all the friends to the big colorful rug. Sammy hears the bell and smiles a bright, happy smile. He puts his building blocks away in the wooden bin, one by one, feeling very proud of his helpful hands. Now it is time to find a sitting spot. Sammy walks over to the bright yellow circle on the rug. He gently sits down and crosses his legs, making a little pretzel with his feet just like the big kids do. 'Criss-cross applesauce,' whispers Sammy to his fuzzy bear friend. Look at you sitting so tall and straight, Sammy! You are shining like a morning star. Soon, all the other friends join the circle, whispering and giggling happily. Teacher Sarah sits down right in the middle, smiling at every single child. She opens her big storybook, and the room gets wonderfully quiet. Sammy keeps his hands safely in his lap and listens with his big, open ears. He loves hearing the funny animal sounds in the story. When it is time to sing the hello song, Sammy's voice joins the cheerful group. He claps his hands to the happy rhythm, feeling so warm and safe inside the group hug of friends. Circle Time is such a wonderful, magical part of the day. You did a fantastic job finding your spot and listening so carefully today, Sammy. Give yourself a giant hug and a pat on the back. You are a wonderful Circle Time superstar, ready for all the fun adventures waiting for you!

stories.title: Mia's Magical Listening Ears
stories.text: Ring-a-ling-ling! Hear the happy bell sing? That is the wonderful sound telling all the children that Circle Time is beginning. Mia stops painting her pretty blue picture and carefully places her paintbrush in the jar of water. She washes her hands at the little sink, splashing a tiny bit of water and wiping them dry on her fluffy yellow towel. Great job keeping things clean, Mia! Now it is time to get those listening ears ready. Mia cups her hands around her little ears, just like soft bunny ears, and clicks them on. Click-clack, her listening ears are turned on high and ready to hear all the wonderful sounds. She walks gently across the room to the big rainbow rug. She finds a lovely spot right next to her best friend, Leo. Mia sits down nice and cozy, folding her legs in front of her. 'Good morning, Mia,' whispers Leo. 'Good morning, Leo,' whispers Mia back with a joyful giggle. Teacher Sarah holds up a basket filled with colorful rhythm sticks. Mia keeps her eyes right on the teacher, showing how much she cares and pays attention. When Teacher Sarah hands out two wooden sticks to Mia, Mia accepts them with both hands and says a polite, happy 'Thank you!' When everyone taps their sticks together, it makes a merry clatter that sounds like raindrops dancing on a roof. Mia taps softly, making a gentle rhythm all her own. She loves being part of the circle melody. Sitting together, sharing, and listening makes Mia's heart feel as warm as a sunbeam. You are doing such an amazing job being a super listener today, Mia. Your gentle ways make Circle Time extra bright and joyful for everyone around you!

stories.title: Leo's Loving Sharing Song
stories.text: The sun is shining outside, but inside the cozy classroom, the biggest sunshine of all is happening right on the circle rug. It is time for Circle Time! Leo hears the soft strum of Teacher Sarah's guitar, playing a sweet, welcoming tune. Time to clean up the train tracks, Leo. With a happy hum, Leo puts the red engine back in the basket and lines up the caboose. Your helper hands are shining so bright, Leo! He walks over to the big green circle on the rug and sits down carefully, making his legs into a comfortable pretzel shape. He rests his hands gently on his knees. Sitting nicely at Circle Time is such a wonderful way to show love to your classroom family. Today is sharing day, and Leo brought his favorite smooth brown pinecone from his backyard walk. Teacher Sarah gently asks if anyone would like to share something special. Leo raises his hand up high, reaching for the sky like a tall green tree. Teacher Sarah smiles and calls his name. Leo holds the pinecone safely in both hands and gently passes it to his friend sitting right next to him. 'Here you go, Maya,' Leo says in a sweet, kind voice. Maya takes the pinecone with a big grin and says, 'Thank you, Leo!' Sharing makes Leo feel so happy inside, like a warm cup of cocoa on a chilly day. Everyone sings a clapping song together, and Leo sings along in his cheerful voice, keeping time with his hands. Circle Time is a place of joy, friendship, and sharing smiles. You did a wonderful job sharing and singing today, Leo. You are a true sunshine helper, and your kind heart makes everyone around you beam with joy!

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Today is a brand new day at preschool, and the big clock on the wall says it is almost time for Circle Time! Sammy the squirrel loves Circle Time. It is a special time when all the friends come together to sit, share, and smile. Ding-dong! The gentle chime rings out across the colorful playroom. That is our cozy signal! Sammy puts away his shiny red blocks, placing them neatly back into their wooden bin. He gives himself a big, proud clap. What a great helper! Now, it is time to find the Circle Time Sunshine rug. The rug is bright yellow, just like a warm morning sun, with soft circles for every little friend to sit on. Sammy walks softly on his tiptoes—tippy-toe, tippy-toe—all the way over to the rug. He looks down and finds a lovely spot right next to his best friend, Maya. Slowly and carefully, Sammy bends his knees and sits right down. Criss-cross applesauce, spoons in a bowl! He rests his hands gently in his lap. Teacher Sarah smiles warmly and says, 'Thank you for sitting so wonderfully, Sammy.' Sammy beams with pride. He feels so safe, so happy, and so ready to learn. Around the circle, all the other friends find their special sitting spots too. Leo sits tall like a giraffe, and Chloe crosses her little legs just like a butterfly folding its wings. Together, everyone is ready. Teacher Sarah starts to strum her cheerful ukulele, and a sweet morning song begins to fill the air. Sammy sways gently from side to side, keeping the rhythm with a happy tap of his foot. He loves being part of the circle. Looking around at all the friendly faces, Sammy knows that every single day brings wonderful new adventures. Circle Time is warm, bright, and full of joy, just like a golden ray of sunshine shining right down on him. Hooray for Circle Time!

stories.title: Leo's Listening Ears
stories.text: Ring-a-ling-ling! Hear that happy sound? It is time to gather round, little friends! The big yellow sunshine rug is calling everyone for Circle Time. Leo the lion cub hears the music playing softly, and he knows just what to do. First, Leo stops what he is playing. He gives his toy train a gentle wave goodbye and whispers, 'See you later, choo-choo!' Then, Leo stands up tall and stretches his arms way up high toward the ceiling, touching the clouds! He takes a big, deep breath in, smelling the sweet morning air, and breathes it all out with a gentle sigh. Now, Leo is ready to walk like a careful little lion to the sunshine rug. He finds his very own spot right in the middle, sits down nice and cozy, and crosses his legs. But wait! There is something very important that Leo needs to turn on before Circle Time begins. Can you guess what it is? It is his super-duper, magical listening ears! Leo reaches up and gently touches his left ear. *Click!* Then he touches his right ear. *Click!* His listening ears are officially turned on and ready for action. Teacher Emma smiles and holds up a colorful picture book about bouncy little bunnies. Leo opens his eyes wide and focuses right on the pages. He keeps his quiet voice inside his tummy so his friends can hear every single word of the story. When Teacher Emma asks a question about the fluffy bunny, Leo raises his hand up high, waiting patiently for his turn to speak. 'Ribbit, ribbit,' goes a toy frog sitting nearby, and Leo giggles softly. He loves listening to all the fun sounds around him. Sitting together in the circle makes Leo feel so cozy and loved. He is a wonderful listener, and his heart feels as warm and bright as the morning sun.

stories.title: Maya's Morning Hello
stories.text: Good morning, sweet friends! The sun is peeking through the classroom window, painting bright yellow patches all across the floor. It is time for Circle Time Sunshine, and Maya is so excited! Maya loves mornings because mornings mean hugs, smiles, and singing together. When the gentle tambourine shakes—shake, shake, shake—Maya knows it is time to transition. She gently cleans up her puzzle pieces, making sure every single piece finds its home in the box. 'All done!' Maya says with a happy cheer. She skips lightly over to the big sunshine rug, her favorite place in the whole wide room. Maya chooses a lovely spot right at the front, where she can see everything. She sits down criss-cross applesauce and folds her hands in her lap, sitting as straight and tall as a lovely sunflower. Teacher Liam looks around the circle and beams a big, welcoming smile. 'Good morning, Maya,' he says softly. Maya smiles back and says, 'Good morning, Teacher Liam!' Now, it is time for the hello song, which is Maya's most favorite part of the whole day. Teacher Liam starts to sing a sweet tune, and one by one, everyone in the circle sings hello to each other. 'Hello to Maya, how are you today?' the class sings together. Maya feels a warm, tingly feeling of happiness spread all the way from the top of her head down to her tippy-toes. She waves her hand and sings back, 'Hello to my friends, I am doing great!' Maya loves how everyone belongs in the circle. No matter who you are, there is always a special place just for you on the sunshine rug. Maya takes a deep breath, feeling so peaceful and glad to be surrounded by her caring teachers and wonderful friends. Circle Time is truly a magical way to start the day, full of bright smiles and endless sunshine!

stories.title: Sammy's Magic Star
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! It is time to get ready for a wonderful day. Sammy the little bear stretches his arms way up high, touching the ceiling with his sleepy paws. Yawn! Big stretch! Time to get dressed in clothes as bright as a yellow daisy. Sammy puts on his soft blue socks, one and two, and pats his happy tummy. Mommy bear smiles and gives him a big warm hug. 'Are you ready for Circle Time Sunshine, Sammy?' she whispers. Sammy nods and does a little happy wiggle dance. Out the door they skip, step by step, all the way to preschool. At the circle rug, all the friends are sitting criss-cross applesauce like little frogs. Sammy finds his special spot right next to teacher Maya. The room is cozy and smells like fresh crayons and warm toast. It is time for Circle Time Sunshine! Teacher Maya rings a tiny silver bell. Ding-dong! That is the special sound for gathering together. Sammy sits up straight and tall, just like a mighty oak tree. First, they sing the good morning song, waving hello to every single friend in the room. 'Hello, Lily! Hello, Leo!' Sammy sings in his sweetest voice. Next comes the weather helper job. Today, it is Sammy's turn! He walks carefully to the big board and looks outside the window. He sees big, beautiful yellow sunshine smiling down from the blue sky. Sammy reaches up and places the shiny sun card right on the board. Everyone claps their hands. Yay, Sammy! You did it! Teacher Maya hands Sammy a golden paper star to hold during the story. Sammy holds it gently with both hands, feeling so proud. Sitting in the circle with his friends makes Sammy feel safe, warm, and happy inside. He loves learning together, sharing stories, and singing songs. When circle time is all done, Sammy gives teacher Maya a gentle high-five. What a wonderful way to start a bright new day!

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Yellow Hat
stories.text: Wake up, little sunshine! The morning birds are singing a sweet song outside your window. Mia opens her big brown eyes and smiles. Today is a special day because it is Circle Time Sunshine at her favorite playschool. Mia hops out of bed with a soft thud on the cozy rug. She brushes her teeth until they sparkle like pearls and puts on her favorite yellow hat, just like a bright beam of sunshine. Daddy makes yummy oatmeal for breakfast, and Mia eats every single bite, crunch, crunch, yum! Now it is time to put on shoes with sparkly velcro. Press down, peel up! One shoe, two shoes. Perfect. Mia and Daddy walk hand in hand down the sidewalk, counting happy little dogs along the way. 'One, two, three dogs!' laughs Mia. When they open the big wooden door of the classroom, teacher Sarah greets them with a loving smile. 'Good morning, sunshine Mia!' Mia hangs her backpack on her own little hook, right under the picture of a cute green frog. Then, she tiptoes over to the big rainbow rug. All the children are sitting down, getting ready for Circle Time Sunshine. Mia finds a soft purple cushion and sits right down, folding her hands in her lap. The teacher holds up a big storybook with shiny pictures. Everyone gets quiet and listens very closely to the wonderful tale about a friendly dragon who loved to share. Mia raises her hand high when the teacher asks a question. 'I know! The dragon shared his apples!' she says in a clear, happy voice. Teacher Sarah nods and gives her a gentle praise. 'Wonderful thinking, Mia!' During the song time, Mia plays the little wooden rhythm sticks, tapping them together. Clack, clack, clack! The music fills the room with joy. Mia looks around at all her kind friends and feels so glad to be part of the circle. Circle Time Sunshine is her most favorite part of the whole day.

stories.title: Leo's Bright Morning Circle
stories.text: Rise and shine, little ray of sunshine! The sun is peeking through the window curtains, painting the bedroom wall in shades of gold and orange. Little Leo stirs under his cozy dinosaur quilt. He stretches his legs and wiggles his toes. Good morning, feet! Good morning, hands! Today is a very exciting day because it is time for Circle Time Sunshine at the community center. Leo jumps up and puts on his bright yellow t-shirt with a happy smiley face right in the middle. He eats a sweet banana for breakfast, sliding the peel down just like a happy monkey. Mummy helps Leo pack his little red backpack with a water bottle and a healthy apple slice. Off they go on their little adventure! When they arrive, the classroom is buzzing with happy giggles and chatter. Leo takes off his jacket and hangs it up all by himself. He is growing so big! He walks over to the giant sun-shaped rug on the floor. Teacher Nina says, 'Come join the circle, friends!' Leo sits down cross-legged, smoothing his shirt down. For Circle Time Sunshine today, everyone gets to share something special they love. When it is Leo's turn, his heart does a little happy flutter. He gently holds up his favorite blue toy truck. 'This is my vroom-vroom truck. It goes fast!' Leo says proudly. All the children clap their hands and say, 'Cool truck, Leo!' Teacher Nina smiles and gives him a gentle pat on the shoulder. Then, they all stand up together to do some fun morning stretches. They reach up high to touch the fluffy clouds, then bend down low to tickle the green grass. Leo laughs out loud, feeling full of energy and happiness. Sitting together in the circle makes Leo feel like he belongs to a wonderful team of friends. Circle Time Sunshine is truly the best way to start the morning with a joyful heart.

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Today is a brand new day at preschool, and that means it is almost time for Circle Time! Sammy the squirrel wakes up, brushes his fluffy tail, and bounces all the way to the big colorful rug. The rug looks just like a giant rainbow made of squishy foam, waiting for tiny friends to sit down. As Sammy gets closer, Teacher Sarah smiles her warmest smile and sings a happy hello song. Sammy looks down at his feet. Should he stand? Should he spin? No, little friend, it is time to find our special sitting spot! Sammy bends his knees and sits right down criss-cross applesauce. 'Great job, Sammy!' whispers Teacher Sarah, giving him a gentle thumbs up. Sammy feels so proud inside his tummy, glowing like a warm little sunbeam. Soon, all of Sammy’s friends arrive. Lily hops over like a bunny and sits beside him, and Leo waddles up with a giggle. Everyone finds their special spot on the rainbow rug. Circle Time is a magical place where we all sit together, but sitting still can sometimes be tricky for wiggly legs. When Sammy feels a wiggle in his toes, he takes a big, deep breath, smelling the imaginary flowers in the air, and blows out the birthday candles. Phew! The wiggles float away. Next, it is time to sing the good morning song. Sammy claps his hands to the beat, tapping them gently on his knees. Clap, clap, clap, go his paws! He looks around at his happy friends and realizes how much fun it is to share this cozy space. Sitting together helps everyone hear the story, share our ideas, and feel like we belong. Teacher Sarah holds up a shiny brass bell, and we all listen to its quiet, singing chime. Ding-dong! That means Circle Time is starting, and we are ready to listen with our big, open ears. Sammy gives his knees one last pat and smiles. He did it! He found his special spot, calmed his wiggly toes, and helped make the room feel bright and sunny.

stories.title: Mila's Listening Ears
stories.text: Rise and shine, sleepy sunshine! It is time to get ready for preschool circle time, and Mila is as excited as a little ladybug. Mila loves circle time because that is when everyone gathers in a cozy circle to talk, sing, and play. But wait! Before circle time begins, Mila needs to turn on her super-duper listening ears. How do we turn them on? Mila gently touches her left earlobe and gives it a little wiggle, then touches her right earlobe and gives it a little wiggle. Click! Her listening ears are officially turned on and ready for action. She walks softly into the circle room, where the big yellow sun mat is spread out on the floor. Mila sits down carefully, crossing her legs just like a pretzel. Her friend Toby sits next to her, holding a wooden rhythm stick. Teacher Anna sits in the middle with a big basket of colorful storybooks. 'Good morning, circle family,' says Teacher Anna softly. Mila makes sure her mouth is quiet so her ears can do all the heavy lifting. When someone is speaking, Mila looks right at them with her kind, bright eyes. Looking at the speaker is like giving them a warm hug with your eyes! During circle time, Teacher Anna asks who brought a green toy today. Mila remembers she has a little green frog in her backpack, but she remembers to wait patiently until Teacher Anna calls her name. Waiting patiently is a big-kid superpower! When it is Mila’s turn to share, she speaks in a clear, happy voice, and all her friends turn their listening ears right toward her. Mila feels so special, like a glowing sunbeam in the center of the room. Listening to each other makes everyone feel heard and loved. When the circle time song comes to an end, Mila gives herself a gentle pat on the shoulder. She kept her body calm, her mouth quiet, and her listening ears turned all the way up. What a wonderful helper she is today!

stories.title: Leo's Loving Sharing Star
stories.text: Good morning, bright star! Today is a very special day in our classroom because it is Sharing Day during Circle Time! Leo the little lion cub has brought his favorite shiny yellow star toy from home. It is made of soft felt and sparkles just a tiny bit when the classroom lights hit it. Leo holds the star safely in his paws as he walks to the big circle rug. Everyone is sitting down, knees crossed, waiting patiently. Leo’s heart beats a little fast—thump, thump, thump! Sharing in front of friends can feel a little scary, but Leo remembers that his friends are his cheerleaders. Teacher Jen sees Leo standing at the edge of the rug and greets him with a joyful wave. 'Come on in, Leo! We have our circle ready for you.' Leo walks over and sits right down on the rug, hugging his star close. Teacher Jen explains that during circle time, we take turns holding the special Sharing Star. When you hold the star, it is your turn to speak, and when someone else holds it, it is our turn to practice super listening. Leo takes a deep breath and gently passes the star to his friend Maya. 'Here you go, Maya,' he says in a sweet, clear voice. Maya smiles brightly and takes the star, telling everyone about her pet cat. Leo watches Maya with gentle eyes, keeping his hands nicely in his lap. He feels so proud of himself for sharing the spotlight and being such a supportive friend. Soon, the star travels all the way around the circle, landing right in Leo's hands again. Now it is his turn! Leo holds up his shiny star and tells his friends how much he loves it. Everyone claps their hands softly, making a pitter-patter sound like gentle rain. Leo beams with happiness. Circle time is wonderful because sharing makes everyone feel like they belong to one big, happy sunshine family.

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
stories.text: Good morning, little sunbeams! It is time for Circle Time Sunshine, our very favorite part of the whole day. Ring-a-ling goes the little chime, calling all the happy friends to gather round the big, colorful rug. Today, Sammy the squirrel is feeling a little bit wiggly. His toes want to tap, and his hands want to clap. He looks all around the room and sees his teacher, Miss Daisy, smiling like a warm ray of light. Miss Daisy spreads out the big yellow circle rug. It looks just like a giant sun on the floor. Sammy takes a deep breath in. He breathes in the smell of fresh paper and crayons. Then, he lets it all out like a gentle breeze. He sits right down on the very edge of the rug. Cross-patch, applesauce! That is the special sitting way. Sammy folds his hands gently in his lap. He is doing such a wonderful job keeping his body calm and steady. Miss Daisy starts to strum her bright blue guitar. Plink, plink, strum! Everyone begins to sing the morning hello song. Sammy joins in, singing loud and clear. He waves his hand to his friend Maya sitting right next to him. Maya giggles and waves right back. Circle Time Sunshine is so much fun when we share it together. Sammy learns how to listen with his big, open ears. He hears the birds chirping outside the big classroom window. He hears his friends giggling as they pass the talking stick. When it is Sammy’s turn to hold the wooden sun, he holds it tight with both hands. He feels so proud. He did not give up when his legs felt wiggly. He remembered how to find his cozy sitting spot. Miss Daisy gives Sammy a gentle pat on the shoulder. She whispers, 'You are a shining star, Sammy.' Sammy beams with joy. His heart feels as warm as the sunshine pouring through the windowpanes. As the song comes to an end, Sammy takes one last look around the circle. Everyone is smiling, ready to learn and play. What a wonderful way to start a brand new day!

stories.title: Leo's Listening Ears
stories.text: Rise and shine, little friends! The golden morning light is peeking into the cozy classroom. It is time for Circle Time Sunshine, and everyone is getting ready. Leo the little lion cub is having a bit of trouble finding his listening ears today. They seem to be hiding underneath his fluffy orange hair! Leo wants to play with the blocks in the corner, but the chime says it is time for the rug. Oh, Leo sighs softly. He feels a little frustrated. But wait, teacher Mr. Ray is holding up the magic glitter wand. Swish, swish, sparkle! Leo watches the silver sparkles dance in the air. He takes a big breath. In goes the air, out goes the sigh. Leo remembers how to turn on his superpower: his big listening ears. He cups his hands right behind his fuzzy ears. Click, clack, ears are on! Leo walks softly over to the sunshine rug and sits down right in the front row. He crosses his legs just like a pretzel. He keeps his hands resting quietly in his lap. Mr. Ray begins to read a big picture book about a friendly little cloud. Leo listens very closely. He hears the soft, rhythmic sound of the teacher's voice. When the story asks a question about the fluffy cloud, Leo raises his hand up high. He waits patiently until Mr. Ray says his name. 'I think the cloud is going to rain tickles,' Leo says with a big, bright grin. All his friends laugh happily. Mr. Ray nods and says, 'What a wonderfully creative idea, Leo! Thank you for raising your hand.' Leo feels a warm glow of pride wash right over him. He did it! He found his listening ears and shared his happy thoughts with the group. Circle Time Sunshine is full of wonderful surprises when we pay attention. Leo looks around at his smiling friends and feels so glad he joined the circle today.

stories.title: Mia's Morning Wave
stories.text: Good morning, happy hearts! The sun is up, the sky is blue, and it is time for Circle Time Sunshine. Mia the little bunny hops right along the hallway, her sneakers squeaking a cheerful tune. Squeak, squeak, squeak! She arrives at the classroom door where the big golden sun cutout is hanging proudly. Mia loves this time of day because it is when everyone comes together to say hello. But today, Mia feels a little bit shy. She holds onto her colorful backpack and hides behind her mommy's leg for just a tiny second. Mommy gives Mia a reassuring squeeze and whispers, 'You are going to do great, sweet pea. Your friends are waiting to say hello.' Mia takes a brave little step forward. She looks at the bright circle rug where all her friends are sitting criss-cross. Teacher Sarah sees Mia and gives her a big, welcoming wave. 'Come on in, Mia! We saved a special spot right here in the sunshine line.' Mia’s shyness begins to melt away like an ice cube in the warm sun. She walks over to the rug and sits down gently on the yellow triangle. She crosses her legs and pats her knees. It is time for the greeting song! Mia feels the music start to play softly from the little speaker in the corner. When the song sings about saying hello to your neighbor, Mia turns to her left. There is Toby the turtle, smiling gently. Mia lifts her hand up high. She opens and closes her fingers, making a happy butterfly wave. 'Hello, Toby,' she says in a clear, sweet voice. Toby beams and waves right back. Mia feels a burst of confidence bloom inside her chest like a spring flower. She didn't let shyness stop her from being part of the group. She participated, she shared her beautiful smile, and she made a friend feel special. Circle Time Sunshine makes Mia feel safe, loved, and ready for all the adventures the day has in store.

stories.title: Good Morning, Yellow Circle!
stories.text: Ring-a-ling goes the friendly classroom bell! It is time for Circle Time Sunshine, my absolute favorite part of the whole preschool day. Little Leo hops off the colorful puzzle mat and hurries over to the big rug on the floor. Ms. Sarah is already sitting cross-legged, smiling as bright as a freshly picked daisy. 'Come find your special spot, Leo,' she sings out softly. Leo looks down at the floor and finds his favorite spot right on the shiny yellow circle. Sitting down nice and tall takes a tiny bit of balance, but Leo practices every single day. He crosses his little legs and rests his hands gently in his lap, just like a quiet frog on a lily pad. Around him, his friends Mia and Toby scurry over, giggling softly as they settle onto the blue and green shapes. Ms. Sarah takes out her sparkly music shaker and gives it a gentle shake. Shhh-shake, shhh-shake, goes the shiny plastic instrument. That is our special signal! It means it is time to look around and say hello to everyone in our cozy group. Leo takes a big, deep breath of the warm morning air. He feels so safe, so happy, and so ready to learn. 'Good morning, circle friends!' Ms. Sarah cheers. Leo raises his hand high in the air and waves enthusiastically. 'Good morning!' he calls out with a proud, beaming smile. Sitting nicely at circle time is a big-kid skill, and Leo is doing such a wonderful job mastering it today. He listens carefully as Ms. Sarah explains the plan for the morning adventures. There will be painting, block building, and outdoor sliding on the shiny green playground slide. But right now, it is time for our morning greeting song. Leo sways gently from side to side, keeping the steady rhythm with his little hands patting his knees. He loves being part of the group, sharing this warm moment of sunshine with all his favorite classmates. Great job sitting tall and getting ready, Leo!

stories.title: The Magic Sunshine Rug
stories.text: Good morning, little sunshine! Today is a brand new day full of fun and learning, and it all starts right here on the Circle Time Sunshine rug. Maya loves this big, fluffy carpet because it feels as warm and cozy as a giant hug from her teddy bear. When the song plays, Maya knows exactly what to do. She practices her gentle walking feet all the way from the cubbies to the rug, making sure not to rush. 'Slow and steady wins the race,' whispers her teacher, Mr. David. Maya nods and carefully lowers herself down to the soft red square. Sitting criss-cross applesauce can sometimes feel a bit tricky for wiggly little legs, but Maya tries her absolute best. She stretches her arms up high toward the ceiling like a tall, growing sunflower reaching for the morning sky, and then she brings them back down to rest quietly in her lap. This is her special listening posture. Looking around, Maya sees all her friends doing the exact same thing. It is wonderful to share this quiet, peaceful moment together before the busy day begins. Mr. David holds up a big picture book with a shiny gold cover. Maya opens her eyes extra wide to see what wonderful story awaits them today. She keeps her hands to herself and listens with her very best listening ears. When Mr. David asks a question about the friendly bunny in the story, Maya raises her hand so nicely without shouting out. Mr. David smiles right at her and nods. 'Yes, Maya?' he says. Maya takes a gentle breath and shares her thought in a clear, happy voice. Mr. David praises her for taking turns and being such a polite listener. Maya feels a warm glow of pride spread right through her tummy. Circle Time Sunshine is truly a magical place where everyone gets a turn to shine bright just like the morning sun. You are doing fantastic, Maya!

stories.title: A Rainbow of Friends
stories.text: The classroom clock ticks softly, and the bright morning sunbeams stream right through the large picture window, dancing across the floor. It is time for Circle Time Sunshine, the coziest gathering of the whole day! Noah skips happily across the room, his little shoes squeaking playfully on the linoleum. He looks at the rainbow rug and chooses the bright orange triangle today. Dropping gently to the floor, Noah folds his legs and sits up as straight as a young sapling tree. He practices his patience while the rest of the children find their special spots. Sometimes, waiting for everyone to arrive can test a little boy's patience, but Noah takes a deep breath in through his nose and blows it out slowly through his mouth, just like he practiced at home. 'Ready, set, glow!' whispers Ms. Clara with a twinkling eye. The children all giggle at her silly joke. Noah loves how everyone comes together to form a big, beautiful circle of friendship. Today is a very special day because it is sharing time! Noah brought his favorite smooth, blue ocean stone from his weekend walk in the park. As the stone gets passed from hand to hand around the circle, Noah watches it travel closer and closer to him. He practices gentle hands, holding the stone with the utmost care when it finally lands in his small palms. He feels its cool, smooth surface and smiles up at his friends. 'This is my stone,' Noah says bravely, sharing his favorite treasure with the group. Everyone claps their hands softly, encouraging his sweet voice. Noah's heart feels as light as a floating feather. Circle Time Sunshine teaches him how to share, how to listen, and how to be a wonderful friend to everyone in the room. What a proud moment for our little star, Noah!

stories.title: Sammy's Special Sitting Spot
