While Lily used the brush for a moment, Leo used his fingers to squiggly-wiggly trace a yellow sun in the air. He practiced his patience, and patience is like a superhero superpower. Then, ding-dong! The little frog timer let everyone know the turn was complete. Lily handed the brush right back to Leo with a happy grin. Leo beamed from ear to ear. He felt like a true sharing champion! Daddy cheered softly and clapped his hands. Sharing the purple paintbrush made their art project look even more beautiful because they made it together as a team.

stories.title: Mia and the Cozy Cuddle Bear
stories.text: It was a cozy afternoon, and the soft playroom rug was covered in fluffy pillows. Mia was snuggling with her very favorite toy in the whole wide world: Barnaby the Bear. Barnaby had the softest brown fur and wore a tiny yellow vest. He gave the best hugs! Soon, her playmate Noah walked over, looking a little sleepy and wishing for a comforting cuddle. Noah reached out his arms. 'Can Barnaby give me a cuddle too?' he asked softly. Mia squeezed Barnaby tight. She wanted to keep him all to herself. Grandma walked over with a warm, loving smile and a tiny blue hourglass timer. 'Let us share the cozy love,' Grandma said gently. 'We can flip the timer and watch the sparkly sand fall down.' Mia watched the sparkly blue sand trickle down. Sift, sift, sift. She decided she was ready to be a generous helper. She passed Barnaby to Noah. 'Here you go, Noah. He gives great hugs,' Mia said sweetly. While Noah snuggled Barnaby, Mia grabbed a fluffy star pillow and hugged it super tight. She counted the sparkly sand grains as they fell. One, two, three, down they go! Time passed quickly with happy thoughts. Soon, all the sand was at the bottom of the glass. Flip! Noah gently returned Barnaby to Mia. Mia felt a warm glow spread all through her heart. Sharing brought so much joy, and Barnaby was happy to give hugs to both of his best friends today.

stories.title: Sammy and the Shiny Red Truck
stories.text: Once upon a bright and sunny morning, little Sammy sat on the cozy living room rug. In his hands, he held the most magnificent toy in the whole wide world: a shiny red fire truck with wheels that spun round and round. Vroom, vroom! Went the little truck as it zoomed across the soft blue carpet. Sammy loved his fire truck so very much. Just then, his dear friend Maya toddled over with a gentle smile. 'Can I play with the truck, please, Sammy?' she asked softly. Sammy felt a little flutter in his tummy. Sharing was tricky, and he wanted the truck all to himself. But Mom walked over with a big, warm hug and a magical yellow box. 'Let us use the sharing timer!' Mom said cheerfully. 'When the little bell rings, it is time to switch.' Mom set the timer for two minutes and handed the red truck to Maya. Sammy felt sad for a tiny second, but then Mom gave him a cozy cuddle. 'Waiting is hard, but you are so strong, Sammy!' Mom cheered. Tick-tock, tick-tock went the friendly timer. Maya zoomed the truck, and Sammy practiced taking big, deep breaths in and out like a sleeping bear. Suddenly, the little timer sang out a happy melody. Ding-dong! Maya smiled brightly and handed the shiny red truck right back to Sammy. 'Thank you for waiting, Maya said sweetly. Sammy beamed with pride. He felt so happy and grown-up. He had shared his favorite toy, and it felt wonderful. 'My turn!' Sammy cheered, zooming his truck again while giving Maya a high-five. What a wonderful helper Sammy was.

stories.title: Leo and the Purple Puzzle
stories.text: The afternoon sun was streaming through the playroom window, making little dust motes dance in the air. Little Leo was sitting at the low wooden table, working very hard on a big purple dinosaur puzzle. Piece by piece, the friendly dinosaur was coming together. Snap! Went the green leaf piece into the corner. Suddenly, his little sister Lily walked up on tiptoes. 'Puzzle!' Lily squealed, pointing a tiny finger at the fun puzzle pieces. Leo shook his head and hugged the box close to his chest. 'Mine!' Leo whispered, feeling like he wanted to keep all the pieces in his own lap. Dad walked over with a soft, reassuring pat on Leo's back. 'Sharing can be a big job, Leo, but we have a special helper today,' Dad said with a warm smile. He brought out the cute blue egg-shaped sharing timer. 'Let us wind up the timer for a little turn, and then it will be your turn again.' Dad twisted the timer, and it began to tick gently. Whirrr, went the timer. Leo watched as Dad handed one easy piece to Lily, and Lily clapped her hands with glee. Leo took a deep breath, just like blowing out a birthday candle, and watched the sand fall in a pretend timer. He felt proud for being such a kind big brother. Dad gave him a big thumbs-up. 'Look how patient you are being, Leo! You are doing amazing!' Dad whispered. Soon enough, the timer went chimes-away! Ting-ting-ting! Lily handed the piece right back to Leo with a happy giggle. Leo smiled from ear to ear, placing the final tail piece into the puzzle. Hooray! He did it together, and sharing made playtime twice as fun.

stories.title: Zoe and the Bouncy Blue Ball
stories.text: Out in the green backyard, the grass felt tickly against little Zoe's toes. Zoe had a big, bouncy blue ball that bounced higher than a jumping frog. Boing, boing, boing! Went the ball as Zoe chased it across the lawn, laughing out loud. Her playmate Noah ran over, his eyes wide with excitement. 'Can I bounce the blue ball, Zoe?' Noah asked hopefully. Zoe clutched the ball tight against her tummy. She loved how bouncy it was, and letting go felt a little bit scary. Grandma walked over, wearing her sweetest apron, holding a friendly red tomato timer. 'Let us share the fun with our magical timer, little ones!' Grandma said with a joyful twinkle in her eye. Grandma turned the timer dial, and it started to tick a happy little rhythm. Tick-tock, tick-tock. Grandma handed the bouncy ball to Noah. Zoe felt a tiny pout coming, but Grandma gently squeezed her hand. 'You are learning how to share, Zoe, and that makes your heart grow so big and strong,' Grandma praised lovingly. Zoe watched Noah bounce the ball once, twice, three times. She practiced stomping her feet softly like a gentle elephant while she waited. She counted one, two, three in her head. Then, the timer gave a cheerful little ring! Ring-ring! Noah turned around with a radiant smile and rolled the ball right back to Zoe. 'Your turn, Zoe!' Noah said happily. Zoe caught the ball and gave it a giant bounce into the air. She felt so proud and wonderful inside. Sharing was an adventure, and Zoe was the best adventurer of all.

stories.title: Sammy and the Shiny Firetruck
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Sammy had a bright red firetruck. It rolled very fast across the soft carpet. Vroom, vroom! Went the little firetruck. Soon, Sammy’s good friend Maya walked over. Maya smiled big and asked, "Can I play with the firetruck too, please?" Sammy hugged the truck tight. He wanted to play with it all by himself. His mommy knelt down softly and gave him a gentle hug. She said, "I know you love your firetruck, Sammy. Sharing can be hard, but we can make it fun. Let us use the sharing timer!" Mommy brought over a cute little yellow timer shaped like a happy duck. "When we set this timer, you get to play first. When it goes ding-dong, it is Maya’s special turn." Sammy thought about this. He loved the happy duck timer. "Okay," Sammy whispered. Mommy turned the dial. Tick-tock, tick-tock went the friendly duck. Sammy zoomed the firetruck around the living room floor. He made loud siren noises. Weee-ooo! Weee-ooo! He was having so much fun. Then, suddenly, the timer went off. Ding-dong! Sammy smiled because he knew what that friendly sound meant. It was time for his friend Maya to have a turn. Sammy carefully rolled the shiny red firetruck right into Maya’s waiting hands. "Here you go, Maya!" Sammy said happily. Maya’s face lit up with a huge smile. "Thank you, Sammy!" she said. Sammy clapped his hands together. Sharing felt so good, and waiting for his next turn was easy peasy. Mommy smiled and gave Sammy a warm high-five. "Great job sharing, Sammy! You are a super star!" Sammy giggled and felt very proud of himself as he waited for the little duck timer to ding again.

stories.title: Bella and the Blue Paintbrush
stories.text: The sun was shining brightly outside, and it was arts and crafts time! Little Bella sat at the low wooden table with a big piece of white paper. She dipped her favorite brush into bright blue paint. Swish, swash, swish! She painted a lovely blue ocean. Her little brother Leo toddled over. He pointed his little finger at the brush and said, "Blue paint, please!" Bella shook her head. "No, Leo, it is my brush," she said softly. Leo looked a little bit sad and sat down on the floor. Teacher Sarah walked over with a warm, comforting smile. "Hello, Bella. Leo would love to use the blue paintbrush too. Would you like to try our special sharing timer?" Bella nodded her head. She loved the little green apple timer. Teacher Sarah set the timer for three minutes. "Bella, you get to paint your ocean first. When the timer rings, Leo gets to paint a sky." Bella agreed. She continued painting big blue waves on her paper. The timer sat right on the table, ticking softly. Tick-tock, tick-tock, tick-tock. Bella practiced being patient. She watched the little hand move around the green apple. Suddenly, the timer chimed a cheerful song. Ring-ring! Bella beamed with joy. She finished her last wave, wiped the brush gently on a paper towel, and handed it to her little brother. "Your turn, Leo!" Bella said with a sweet voice. Leo took the brush and made a happy little sound. "Yay! Blue sky!" he cheered. Bella clapped her hands and watched him paint. She felt so warm and happy inside. Teacher Sarah kissed the top of Bella’s head. "Wonderful sharing, Bella. You are so kind and helpful!" Bella smiled proudly at her beautiful ocean.

stories.title: Leo and the Roaring Dinosaur
stories.text: Roar! Went the big green dinosaur. Little Leo held the toy tightly in his hands. It was his absolute favorite toy in the whole playroom. Just then, his cousin Lily walked over. Lily loved dinosaurs just as much as Leo did. She reached out her hand and said, "Can I make the dinosaur roar, Leo?" Leo pulled the dinosaur back and frowned. He did not want to let go. Daddy walked over and sat down on the rug right beside them. He used his gentle voice to talk to Leo. "I see you are having so much fun with your dinosaur, Leo. It is hard to share your favorite things, isn't it?" Leo nodded. "Yes, Daddy." Daddy smiled and reached into his pocket. He pulled out a magical purple timer that looked like a friendly little alien. "We can use our sharing timer to help us take turns nicely," Daddy explained. "When the timer is running, Leo makes the dinosaur roar. When it goes beep-beep, Lily gets to make it roar." Leo thought that sounded like a fun game. Daddy turned the timer on. Beep-boop! The purple alien flashed a cute little light. Leo played with the dinosaur, making stomping noises on the carpet. Stomp, stomp, roar! Lily sat right beside him, clapping her hands and waiting patiently. The timer ticked quietly. Tick-tock, tick-tock. Then, the timer made a happy sound. Beep-beep! Leo knew what to do. He handed the big green dinosaur right to Lily. "Your turn to roar, Lily!" Leo said cheerfully. Lily took the dinosaur and let out a giant, silly roar. "Rawr!" Lily giggled. Leo laughed out loud. Waiting for his turn was so much fun, and sharing made playing together even better. Daddy hugged them both tightly. "You two are fantastic sharers! I am so proud of you both!" Leo felt like the happiest boy in the world.

stories.title: Sammy and the Shiny Red Firetruck
stories.text: Little Sammy loved the shiny red firetruck. It had big black wheels that rolled so smoothly across the living room rug. 'Woo-woo!' Sammy pushed it vroom-vroom all around the couch. Just then, his little sister, Mia, waddled over with her big brown eyes. She reached out her small hand and gently patted the firetruck. 'My turn?' she whispered softly, her bottom lip quivering just a tiny bit because she wanted to play too. Sammy hugged the firetruck close to his chest. He wasn't quite ready to let go yet. But mommy was right nearby with a big, warm smile, holding a special yellow egg timer that made a happy ticking sound. 'Let's use the sharing timer, Sammy,' mommy said gently, sitting down beside them. 'When the timer dings, it is Mia's turn to drive the firetruck.' Sammy looked at the bright yellow timer. Tick, tock, tick, tock went the little hand. Sammy took a deep breath and gave the firetruck one more special roll. 'Okay, just until the ding!' he said bravely. Mommy set the timer for three whole minutes. Sammy played while watching the little red hand move closer and closer to the top. He felt proud of himself for waiting so well. Ring-a-ling-ding! went the happy little timer bell. Sammy smiled a big, proud smile and gently rolled the firetruck right into his little sister's waiting hands. 'Here you go, Mia!' he said kindly. Mia clapped her hands with pure joy and pushed the truck back and forth. Sammy realized that sharing could actually be a lot of fun, especially when everyone got a turn. Mommy gave them both a giant bear hug and whispered that they were wonderful sharers. Sammy felt so warm and happy inside, knowing he was a big helper and a super nice brother.

stories.title: Leo and the Magical Puzzle
stories.text: Leo was sitting on the playroom floor working on a big floor puzzle of a smiling jungle lion. He had all the corner pieces in place and was searching for the lion's bright yellow nose. Suddenly, his best friend Toby walked over, looking down at the puzzle pieces with great interest. Toby pointed a little finger and said, 'Can I help put a piece in?' Leo felt a little flutter in his tummy. He loved this puzzle so much and wanted to finish the lion all by himself. He almost said no, but then he remembered what they practiced at preschool about being kind friends. Just at that moment, teacher Sarah walked by holding the polka-dot sharing timer. 'Would you like to share the puzzle time using our friendly timer?' teacher Sarah asked in a sweet, singsong voice. Leo nodded slowly, feeling a bit better. 'Yes, please,' Leo said in his gentle voice. Teacher Sarah turned the polka-dot timer. Tik-tok, tik-tok, tik-tok went the friendly little clock. While the timer ticked, Leo got to place the lion's big golden mane pieces. Toby cheered quietly and watched happily, waiting for his turn to come. Leo felt so good knowing he didn't have to keep the whole puzzle to himself forever. Then, ding-dong! went the cheerful chime of the timer. It was Toby's turn! Leo carefully slid the puzzle box over and handed Toby the very last piece—the lion's smiling mouth. Toby popped the final piece into place with a triumphant yay! Both boys jumped up and down, celebrating their teamwork. Teacher Sarah clapped for them and gave them high-fives. Leo learned that sharing didn't mean losing out on the fun; it meant doubling the happiness because they did it together. He felt like a wonderful friend and couldn't wait for their next puzzle adventure.

stories.title: Bella and the Crayon Box
stories.text: Bella loved drawing colorful pictures. Right in front of her was a brand new box of twenty-four crayons, smelling sweet like fresh paper and wax. She pulled out the bright pink crayon and started drawing a giant rainbow across her big white sheet of paper. Her cousin Chloe sat down next to her, looking longingly at the rainbow of colors. 'I want to draw a rainbow too, Bella,' Chloe said softly. Bella gripped the crayon box a little tighter. She wanted to use all the pretty colors herself. But then daddy knelt down beside them, holding a cute blue bunny timer with floppy ears. 'Do you want the floppy bunny timer to help you share your crayons?' daddy asked with a loving, encouraging twinkle in his eye. Bella looked at the bunny timer and then at Chloe's sad little face. She wanted Chloe to feel happy too. 'Okay, daddy. We can share,' Bella agreed in a sweet, helpful tone. Daddy wound up the bunny timer, and it began to soft-tick: tick-tock, tick-tock. For the first few minutes, Bella happily colored her sky with the bright blue crayon. Chloe patiently watched, waiting and practicing her deep breaths. When the bunny timer gave a cheerful ring—ding-ding-ding!—it was time to trade. Bella opened the box wide and gently pushed the crayons toward Chloe. 'Your turn for the colors, Chloe!' Bella said with a beaming smile. Chloe's face lit up like sunshine as she picked out the sparkly purple crayon to draw her own flowers. Bella watched her cousin draw and felt a warm, fuzzy feeling spread all through her heart. She realized that sharing made her feel even happier than keeping everything to herself. Daddy praised them both for being such cooperative and loving girls. Bella hugged her crayons, happy to share her colorful world.

stories.title: Sammy and the Shiny Red Firetruck
stories.text: Little Sammy loved the shiny red firetruck. It had big black wheels that went round and round, and a bright yellow ladder that reached all the way up to the sky. Sammy zoomed the truck across the playroom rug, making loud siren noises. 'Wee-woo! Wee-woo! Make way for the firetruck!' Then, his friend Maya walked over. Maya had her cute little hands clasped together, and she looked down at the firetruck with big, hopeful eyes. 'Can I play with the firetruck too, Sammy?' she asked softly. Sammy held the truck a little bit tighter. He really, really wanted to keep driving it all by himself. His mommy knelt down next to him, giving him a warm, gentle hug. 'Remember, Sammy, sharing makes playtime so much more fun. We can use the magic sharing timer!' Sammy thought about it. He took a deep breath. 'Okay,' he whispered. Mommy brought over the little yellow timer shaped like a friendly duck. *Tick-tock, tick-tock*, it went. 'Maya gets a turn until the timer rings, and then it is Sammy's turn again!' Mommy cheered. Sammy watched Maya zoom the truck. It felt a little hard to wait at first, so Sammy clapped his hands and counted the seconds. Before he even knew it, the timer made a happy little *DING-DONG* sound! Maya smiled brightly and handed the firetruck right back to Sammy. 'Thank you for sharing, Maya!' Sammy said happily. It was his turn again, and his heart felt so warm and proud. He realized that sharing wasn't losing a toy at all; it was making playtime twice as wonderful because he and Maya were playing together. Yay for the sharing timer!

stories.title: Bella Bear's Big Box of Crayons
stories.text: Bella Bear was sitting at the little round table with a giant box of brand-new, pointy crayons. There was bright yellow, ocean blue, leafy green, and fiery red. Bella loved to color pictures of fluffy clouds and happy suns. Just then, her little brother Leo toddled over. Leo reached out his chubby little hand and pointed right at the sparkly purple crayon. 'Purple, please!' Leo chirped. Bella pulled the box closer to her tummy. 'Mine! All mine!' she thought. But then Bella remembered how much she loved when Leo shared his yummy apple slices with her. Their daddy walked over with a big, encouraging smile. 'Bella, sharing is a wonderful way to show love to your brother. Would you like to use the little blue sharing timer?' Bella nodded gently. She placed the sparkly purple crayon right in the middle of the table. Daddy twisted the dial, and the timer began to hum softly. *Tick-tock, tick-tock, tick-tock.* Leo drew a funny purple squiggle on his paper, giggling the whole time. Bella watched him and smiled. She didn't feel sad anymore; she felt so nice inside. She used the green crayon to draw tall grass while she waited. Soon enough, the timer rang out with a sweet *DING-DING* sound! Leo looked up, his face glowing with joy, and handed the purple crayon right back to his big sister. 'My turn!' Bella cheered, taking the crayon. 'Good job sharing, Bella Bear!' said Daddy, giving her a gentle nose-boop. Bella felt like the best big sister in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Oliver's Awesome Dinosaur Day
stories.text: Oliver had a very important mission in the living room. He was building a gigantic green dinosaur made out of big plastic blocks. It had a long neck and a bumpy tail that reached all the way to the sofa. Oliver was so proud of his creation! Suddenly, his cousin Lily walked over, holding a cute little pink dinosaur. 'Roar!' said Lily. 'Can my dinosaur come visit your dinosaur?' Oliver hesitated. His block dinosaur was super fragile, and he was worried it might tumble down. But he also loved playing with Lily. Mommy knelt down beside them with a kind and encouraging look in her eyes. 'Oliver, building together is so much fun. Let's use the friendly orange sharing timer so everyone gets a turn to play with the big block dinosaur.' Oliver thought about it and gave a little nod. 'Okay, Lily can play with it first,' he said bravely. Mommy set the timer on the floor, and it began its happy little countdown. *Tick-tock, tick-tock, tick-tock.* Lily carefully moved the tail of the block dinosaur and made soft roaring sounds. Oliver practiced taking deep, calm breaths and helped build a little block fence while he waited. Before he knew it, the timer made a bright, cheery *CHIME-CHIME* sound! Lily gently patted the dinosaur and smiled at Oliver. 'Your turn, Oliver!' she said sweetly. Oliver took his place back by the dinosaur and beamed with happiness. He gave Lily a high-five. 'Thank you for waiting so nicely,' Mommy praised them both. Oliver learned that taking turns made playtime last even longer, and sharing felt like magic.

stories.title: Leo's Lovely Red Truck
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, little Leo sat on the cozy playroom rug. In his hands, he held a big, shiny, bright red toy truck. Vroom, vroom! went Leo, driving it all over the soft green carpet. It was his very favorite truck in the whole wide world. Soon, his little friend Mia walked over with a gentle smile. She looked at the shiny red truck and whispered, Can I have a turn, please, Leo? Leo hugged the truck a little closer. He loved his truck so much, and sharing felt a bit tricky today. Mommy walked over with a warm, loving hug and a magical little helper. It was a friendly blue sharing timer shaped like a happy round frog! Mommy smiled and said, Let us set the frog timer, Leo. When the little bell goes ring-ring, it is time to pass the truck to Mia. Sharing helps everyone have fun together! Leo blinked his big brown eyes and nodded softly. He placed the truck right in front of the frog timer and pushed the button. Tick-tock, tick-tock, went the friendly frog. Leo and Mia played together, building a wonderful tower of blocks while they waited. Suddenly, the frog timer went ring-ring! Oh, said Leo with a proud smile. My turn is done, and now it is Mia turn. He gently handed the red truck to Mia. Mia giggled with joy and said, Thank you, Leo! You are such a super sharer! Leo felt a warm, happy glow inside his tummy. Sharing was not scary at all; it was actually wonderful! The frog timer sat quietly, ready for the next fun turn. Leo clapped his hands and cheered. Hooray for sharing! It makes playtime so bright and happy for everyone.

stories.title: Daisy Dinosaur's Big Green Turn
stories.text: Deep in the colorful playroom, little Daisy Dinosaur stomped her feet. Stomp, stomp, stomp! She was holding a marvelous green bouncy ball that bounced higher than the clouds. Bounce, bounce, go, little ball! giggled Daisy. Just then, her sweet friend Sammy came hopping over like a little bunny. Sammy looked at the wonderful green bouncy ball with sparkling eyes. May I bounce the ball too, Daisy? asked Sammy softly. Daisy felt a little squeeze in her heart. She wanted to keep the bouncy ball all to herself forever and ever. Daddy knelt down beside Daisy with a warm, encouraging smile. He held up a bright yellow timer that looked just like a smiling sun. Daddy said, Let us use our sunny sharing timer, Daisy! When the timer sings its little song, we share the toy. This way, everyone gets a turn to play and smile. Daisy thought about it and gave a little nod. She liked the sunny timer because it was so cheerful. Daddy turned the dial, and the sunny timer began to tick softly. Tick-tock, tick-tock, went the sun. Daisy and Sammy played a game of rolling the ball back and forth, counting together. One, two, three! they cheered. Then, all of a sudden, the sunny timer sang out, Ding-dong! Time for a new turn! Daisy looked at the sun and remembered her promise. With a brave and happy heart, she rolled the green bouncy ball right over to Sammy. Sammy caught it and shouted, Yay! Thank you so much, Daisy! You are a sharing champion! Daisy beamed with pride. Her heart felt as warm as sunshine. Sharing made playing together twice as much fun, and she could not wait for her turn to come around again.

stories.title: Pip and Penny's Pastel Paint Party
stories.text: It was a wonderful craft day at the little blue table. Pip and Penny sat side by side, getting ready to make beautiful pictures. On the table sat one magnificent jar of sparkling purple finger paint. Oh, how it glittered in the light! Pip dipped his finger in first and made a lovely purple star. Then Penny wanted to make a purple star too, but there was only one jar of paint to share. Penny looked down at her hands, feeling a tiny bit sad. Grandma walked over with a gentle pat on the head and a very special purple timer shaped like a cute little owl. Hoot-hoot! said Grandma playfully. Let us use our wise owl sharing timer today! When the owl wakes up and says beep-beep, we swap the paint pot. That is how friends share with love and care. Pip smiled because he loved owls. He knew sharing meant caring for Penny, too. Grandma turned the little owl, and it began to tick happily. Tick-tock, tick-tock, sang the owl. Pip painted as fast as he could, making swirls and dots on his big white paper. Penny clapped her hands, cheering him on. Suddenly, the wise owl timer chirped, Beep-beep! Time to share! Pip looked at the timer, smiled brightly, and slid the glittery paint jar right in front of Penny. Here you go, Penny! Your turn! said Pip kindly. Penny painted a gorgeous purple butterfly and gave Pip a big hug. Thank you, Pip! You are the best sharing buddy ever! Pip giggled, feeling so proud and happy inside. The owl timer smiled from the table, watching the two happy friends create wonderful art together. Sharing was truly the best magic of all.

stories.title: Sammy and the Shiny Firetruck
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, little Sammy sat on the soft playroom rug. In his hands, he held the shiniest, reddest firetruck in the whole wide world. Vroom, vroom went the truck! Its little silver wheels rolled smoothly across the floor. Suddenly, his dear friend Lily walked over. Her big blue eyes sparkled as she looked at the wonderful firetruck. She gently asked, 'Sammy, can I play with the truck, too?' Sammy hugged the firetruck a little closer. He loved his firetruck so much, and letting go felt a bit hard in his tummy. But Mommy was right nearby with a bright, friendly smile. She knelt down and said, 'I know it is hard to share your favorite toy, Sammy. Let us use our special sharing timer! We can share and take turns.' Mommy brought over a cute little yellow timer shaped like a smiling duck. 'Tick-tock, tick-tock,' went the duck timer. 'When the timer rings, it is Lily's turn to drive the truck.' Sammy watched the little red hand move around. At first, he felt a tiny flutter of worry. But then, Mommy gently counted down: 'Three, two, one, beep-beep!' The happy timer gave a cheerful little ring. Sammy took a deep, brave breath. He smiled a big, proud smile and gently handed the shiny firetruck to Lily. 'Here you go, Lily!' he said sweetly. Lily clapped her hands with joy. 'Thank you, Sammy!' she giggled, rolling the truck back and forth. Sammy watched her play and felt a warm, happy glow right in his heart. Sharing felt so good! Soon, the timer beeped again, and it was Sammy's turn once more. They giggled and took turns all morning long, playing happily together as the kindest little friends.

stories.title: Bella Bear's Pastel Crayons
stories.text: Bright sunlight streamed through the cozy bedroom window, where Bella Bear sat at her little wooden art table. Spread out before her was a magnificent box of brand-new pastel crayons. There was pink like cotton candy, yellow like buttercups, and green like spring grass. Bella picked up the pink crayon and began to draw a giant, bouncy rabbit on her big white paper. Just then, her little brother Toby toddled into the room. He pointed a chubby little finger at the crayons and whispered, 'Crayons, please?' Bella paused. She loved her pretty pastel crayons so much, and she wanted to color her whole paper pink. A tiny frown touched her furry little face. Daddy walked over, offering a gentle hug and a warm, reassuring smile. 'It is wonderful to make beautiful art, Bella. Would you like to use our magic sharing timer so everyone gets a turn?' Bella nodded slowly. Daddy set down a friendly blue timer shaped like a round little bear. 'Let us set the timer for a fun turn,' Daddy said cheerfully. 'Tick-tock, tick-tock, the time goes round.' Bella looked at the timer and then at Toby's eager little face. She felt very brave inside. 'Okay, Toby, you can use the crayons when the timer rings,' Bella said gently. Toby sat right down beside her, clapping his hands softly. They waited together, watching the gentle hands move. Ring-a-ling went the little blue timer! Bella smiled warmly and passed the crayon box over to her brother. Toby carefully picked a bright yellow crayon and drew a big, shining sun. Bella felt a wonderful flutter of happiness in her tummy. Sharing her special crayons made art time twice as much fun. When the timer beeped again, it was Bella's turn to draw some more. They shared smiles, colors, and hugs all afternoon long.

stories.title: Leo's Lovely Block Castle
stories.text: On a cozy afternoon, little Leo was building the most amazing tower in the playroom. He stacked blue blocks, yellow blocks, and red blocks high up toward the ceiling. It looked just like a magical castle where a friendly dragon might live! Clatter, clatter went the blocks as they clicked together. His playmate Maya skipped over, holding a cute little toy horse in her hand. 'Can my horse visit your castle, Leo?' she asked sweetly. Leo looked at his tall, wonderful tower. He had worked so hard to balance every single block just right, and he wanted to keep it all to himself. A tiny sigh escaped his lips. Teacher Sarah walked over softly, kneeling down beside the lovely block castle with kind, understanding eyes. 'Building such a tall castle takes wonderful work, Leo,' Sarah said gently. 'Would you and Maya like to use our friendly sharing timer so you can play together?' Leo thought about it for a moment. He really wanted to be a good friend. 'Okay,' Leo whispered, feeling very brave. Sarah brought out a shiny green timer shaped like a happy little frog. 'Ribbit-ribbit, let's share and care!' Sarah cheered softly. She set the timer, and it began to tick gently. Maya waited patiently, gently petting her little toy horse while the timer counted down. When the friendly timer rang out with a happy chime, Leo beamed a bright smile. He carefully moved some blocks to make a wide, welcoming gate. 'Come on in, little horse!' Leo said happily. Maya trotted her horse right through the gate into the castle courtyard. Leo felt a warm, cozy feeling of joy fill him up from his toes to his head. Sharing his special castle made the playtime so much brighter, and they built even more towers together until it was time to tidy up.

stories.title: Sammy and the Shiny Red Truck
stories.text: Once upon a time, little Sammy had a shiny red toy truck. It was his very favorite toy in the whole wide world. Vroom, vroom! went the red truck across the soft green living room rug. Soon, his friend Maya waddled over with a big smile. 'Can I play with the truck, please?' Maya asked sweetly. Sammy hugged the truck a little bit tighter. He was not quite ready to let it go. Mommy walked over with a big, bright yellow kitchen timer shaped like a happy lemon. 'Let us use the sharing timer, little ones,' Mommy said in her softest, happiest voice. 'When we share, everyone gets a turn to play.' Mommy turned the top of the lemon timer until it clicked. *Tick-tock, tick-tock,* went the little lemon. Sammy held the truck and looked at the clock. 'You have the truck for now, Sammy, and when the timer dings, it is Maya's turn to drive,' Mommy explained with a gentle hug. Sammy felt his shoulders relax. The timer made taking turns feel like a fun game. He pushed the truck back and forth, watching the little hand tick around. *Ding-dong!* went the happy lemon timer. Sammy giggled. 'It is time!' he said cheerfully. He gently handed the shiny red truck to Maya. Maya's eyes lit up with joy. 'Thank you, Sammy!' she cheered. Sammy watched Maya drive the truck, and guess what? Waiting for his turn felt just as exciting as playing. When the timer dinged the next time, Maya gave the truck right back with a big cuddle. Sharing was wonderful, and the friendly lemon timer helped them take turns like big kids all morning long.

stories.title: Leo and the Purple Painting Party
stories.text: Little Leo loved to paint. Dip, swish, swirl went his paintbrush right into a pot of bright purple paint. He was making a magnificent masterpiece of a purple dinosaur on a large white piece of paper. His cousin Lily walked over, her eyes wide with wonder. 'Ooh, purple paint! Can I paint too, Leo?' she asked gently. Leo loved his purple paint very much. He wanted to use all of it by himself. Daddy kneeled down beside them, holding a magical blue dinosaur timer. 'Let us share the purple paint with the sharing timer,' Daddy suggested with a warm, encouraging smile. 'Sharing is a great way to make art together.' Daddy set the timer for a few minutes. *Blink, tick, tick, tick,* went the cute blue dinosaur. Leo dipped his brush once more and painted a big purple polka dot. 'Your turn is now, Leo, and when the timer sings its little song, Lily gets to paint her own dot,' Daddy whispered lovingly. Leo nodded. He understood the timer. It helped him know exactly when he would get the brush back. He painted a purple tail, and then—*beep, beep, beep!*—the blue dinosaur timer sang out a happy little tune. Leo smiled big. He wiped his brush off on a paper towel and handed it to Lily. 'Here you go, Lily! My turn is done,' Leo said proudly. Lily took the brush and painted a lovely purple star right next to Leo's dinosaur. 'Look what we made together!' Daddy cheered, giving them both a high-five. Leo felt so proud in his heart. The sharing timer made sharing feel easy, fair, and so much fun.

stories.title: Zoe and the Bouncing Blue Ball
stories.text: Bounce, bounce, bounce went the bright blue ball across the sunny backyard grass. Zoe loved her bouncing ball more than anything. She tossed it up high and caught it in her little hands. Her playmate Noah ran over, laughing gleefully. 'Can I bounce the blue ball, Zoe?' Noah asked, holding out his hands. Zoe paused. She wanted to keep bouncing it forever. Grandma walked over, carrying a cheerful pink pig timer that oinked softly when you wound it up. 'Let us play the sharing game with our little pig timer,' Grandma said, her voice full of sweet encouragement. 'That way, both Zoe and Noah get to bounce the happy blue ball.' Grandma twisted the pink pig's nose until it started its gentle *tick-tock* sound. 'Zoe gets to bounce it first, and when the little pig oinks, Noah gets a turn,' Grandma explained. Zoe hugged the ball tightly for just a second, then looked at the friendly pink pig. The timer made it easy because she knew her turn would come back again. She bounced the ball to Noah, and they played together until the timer went *oink, oink!* Noah smiled brightly, caught the ball, and gave it two big bounces before the timer dinged for Zoe again. Back and forth went the ball, and back and forth went the happy sharing timer. Zoe cheered, realizing that playing together was twice as fun as playing alone. Grandma clapped her hands for them both. They were becoming such wonderful sharers, one fun tick-tock at a time.

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Bell
rhymes.text:
It is time to share the toy,
Bring a smile and bring some joy.
Now it is your special turn,
Look at all the fun we learn!

Tick-tock goes the timer clock,
Round and round the little dock.
When it rings and says hello,
Off the happy toys will go.

Now my turn is done and through,
I will gently pass to you.
Thank you friend for sharing too,
Happy little me and you!

Keep the lovely sharing beat,
Playing nicely is so sweet.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Sharing makes a happy day!

rhymes.title: Tick-Tock Take a Turn
rhymes.text:
Red block, blue block, on the floor,
We have fun and so much more.
Let us set the timer bright,
Playing together feels just right.

Tick-tock, tick-tock, hear it ring,
Time to share and time to sing.
Pass the truck and pass the car,
You are sharing near and far!

Waiting is a little game,
Calling out a friendly name.
Soon the timer gives a beep,
Promises we always keep.

Now you hold the steering wheel,
Look how happy that can feel!
Sharing is the finest way,
To have a super duper day.

rhymes.title: The Timer Song
rhymes.text:
Ding-dong bell, the timer’s set,
Best friends sharing, don't forget!
Hold the dolly close and tight,
Soon it is your partner's right.

Tick-tock, tick-tock, counting down,
No one wears a grumpy frown.
When the beep goes beep-beep-beep,
Sharing is a prize to keep.

Give a smile and let it go,
Watch the friendly feelings grow.
Now you have the yellow bear,
Isn't it so nice to share?

Round we go from hand to hand,
Sharing in our toddler land.
Clap your hands and sing along,
This is our big sharing song!

rhymes.title: BEEP BEEP Sharing Time
rhymes.text:
BEEP BEEP goes the timer chime,
Look, it is our sharing time!
Hand the shovel to your mate,
Waiting at the sandbox gate.

Tick-tock, tick-tock, time flies fast,
Good friend habits built to last.
Now the timer starts to ping,
Time to do our sharing thing.

Take the bucket, scoop the sand,
Passing goodies hand to hand.
Smiling eyes and happy cheer,
Sharing time is finally here.

Every toddler learns to wait,
Passing things across the plate.
Now the fun is doubled twice,
Sharing toys is oh so nice!

rhymes.title: The Magic Timer Ring
rhymes.text:
Wind the timer, watch it spin,
Let the sharing game begin!
Hold the pony, brush its mane,
Riding on the sharing train.

Tick-tock, tick-tock, do not rush,
Give the fuzzy brush a push.
When the timer makes a sound,
Pass the pony all around.

Now it is another's place,
With a bright and sunny face.
Taking turns is easy-peasy,
Never hard and never squeezy.

Timer rings, we say goodbye,
To the toy for you and I.
Give a hug and pass it on,
Playing happily till dawn!

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Bell
rhymes.text:
It is time to share the toy,
Bring a smile and bring some joy.
Now the timer starts to beep,
Promises we always keep.
Tick-tock, tick-tock goes the clock,
We can share the building block.
My turn now, and then your turn,
This is how we share and learn.
Round and round the arrows go,
Friendly feelings start to glow.
Now the timer rings out loud,
Sharing makes us very proud.
Pass the toy with gentle grace,
Happy smiles upon each face.
Sharing time is so much fun,
Fair and happy for everyone.

rhymes.title: The Timer Song
rhymes.text:
Green light glowing, let us play,
Sharing makes a happy day.
Soon the timer gives a ring,
Then we pass the shiny thing.
One, two, three, it is time to switch,
Sharing is a joyful pitch.
Your turn now to take the car,
We can share near and afar.
Waiting patiently is sweet,
Making playtime quite a treat.
Tick-tock, tick-tock, hear it chime,
It is friendly sharing time.
Hand it over with a smile,
We will share a little while.
Now we give a cheerful cheer,
Sharing brings us close and dear.

rhymes.title: BEEP BEEP Time to Share
rhymes.text:
Little timer on the shelf,
Sharing is not just for self.
BEEP BEEP goes the timer bell,
Passing toys is going well.
Hold the puzzle, take a look,
Now we share the picture book.
My turn finished, here you go,
Watch the happy friendship grow.
Waiting is as easy as pie,
Give the sharing friend a high-five.
Round the dial the numbers run,
Sharing time is so much fun.
Take the crayons, draw a line,
Everything is going fine.
BEEP BEEP rings the little bell,
We can share so very well.

rhymes.title: Pass the Toy Today
rhymes.text:
Let us play with blocks of red,
Sharing is what Mummy said.
Soon the timer starts to chime,
It is taking turns-a-time.
Tick-tock, tick-tock, do not wait,
Passing toys is feeling great.
Now your fingers hold the bear,
Everybody gets a share.
Smiling faces all around,
Happiest kids can be found.
Ding-dong sounds the timer song,
Singing right along-a-long.
Give it back and take your turn,
This is how good toddlers learn.
Sharing makes our hearts so bright,
Everything is feeling right.

rhymes.title: The Sharing Chime
rhymes.text:
Hear the timer start to ding,
Time to share the funny thing.
Take a breath and count to three,
Sharing is for you and me.
Pass the truck across the floor,
We will love it even more.
Your turn, my turn, back and forth,
Friendship points us to the north.
Tick-tock, tick-tock, watch it go,
Friendly manners start to show.
Ding-dong, now the timer calls,
Catch the rolling bouncy balls.
Give a hug and pass it sweet,
Making sharing quite complete.
Now the timer goes to rest,
Sharing toddlers are the best.

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Timer
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock goes the little clock,
Time to share with friends on the block.
Give the truck a gentle push,
No more holding, give a tush.

Now it is my special turn,
Look at all the things I learn.
Waiting is so easy now,
I can do it, take a bow.

Beep-beep-beep the timer rings,
Time for happy sharing things.
Pass the bear across the floor,
Let us play a little more.

Sharing makes our faces glow,
Friends are best from head to toe.
 Hip-hooray for me and you,
Sharing is the thing to do!

rhymes.title: Tick-Tock Toy Swap
rhymes.text:
Ring-a-ling the timer goes,
Time to share from head to toes.
Give the block to sister dear,
Drop it softly, have no fear.

Now the timer counts to three,
One and two and three for me.
Waiting takes a little space,
With a smile upon my face.

Ding-dong rings the little bell,
Passing toys is going well.
Now the blocks come back my way,
Oh what fun we have today.

Sharing toys is so much fun,
Joy is shared for everyone.
Clap your hands and sing along,
This is our sweet sharing song.

rhymes.title: The Golden Minute
rhymes.text:
Look at the timer shining bright,
Making sure our sharing's right.
Hold the crayon, draw a tree,
Soon the timer calls for me.

Tick-tock, tick-tock, do not wait,
Passing colors on a plate.
Now it is my partner's spell,
Playing kindly is so swell.

Blink-blink-blink the light is green,
Best polite kids ever seen.
Take the marker, draw a star,
We can share from near and far.

Round and round the clock will go,
Sharing makes our friendship grow.
Cheer aloud and give a shout,
That is what good friends about!

rhymes.title: BEEP BEEP Sharing Time
rhymes.text:
Here is the timer round and red,
Resting softly on its bed.
Give the puzzle piece a spin,
Let another friend begin.

Wait a minute, count to four,
Then we play a little more.
Patience is a superpower,
Growing sweeter every hour.

Beep-beep goes the timer loud,
Making every toddler proud.
Hand the puzzle back to me,
Happy faces full of glee.

Sharing is a magic way,
To have fun throughout the day.
Sing a song and dance around,
Bestest friends that can be found.

rhymes.title: The Friendly Clock
rhymes.text:
Listen to the friendly clock,
Ticking softly on the block.
Share the train with baby bear,
Love is shown when we are fair.

Wait until the chime goes ring,
Then we pass the shiny thing.
Taking turns is easy peasy,
Keeping every toddler breezy.

Ding-dong goes the happy sound,
Passing treasures all around.
Now it is my turn to drive,
Glad to be so much alive.

Sharing brings a sunny day,
Hip-hooray for how we play.
Clap your hands and smile so wide,
Joy is bursting deep inside.

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Bell
rhymes.text:
Look at this bright shiny toy,
Full of laughter, full of joy.
Now it is my special turn,
Look at all the fun I learn!

Tick-tock goes the timer clock,
Round and round the little block.
When the beep begins to play,
We will share and start to play.

Now the timer makes a sound,
Pass the happy toy around.
Give a smile and let it go,
Watch the happy sharing grow!

My turn done, now it is new,
Here is the red truck for you.
Sharing brings a happy smile,
Let us play this way a while!

rhymes.title: Tick-Tock Take a Turn
rhymes.text:
Blocks are tall and blocks are high,
Reaching all the way sky-high.
Friend is waiting patiently,
Waiting very happily.

Set the timer, beep-beep-beep,
Promises are ours to keep.
While the timer counts the time,
Everything is going fine.

Ring-a-ling, the time is through,
Now the truck is back for you.
Take the toy and share the fun,
Sharing makes us everyone!

Clap our hands and shout hooray,
Sharing makes a sunny day.
Round and round the clock will go,
Watch the friendly feelings grow!

rhymes.title: The Beep-Beep Sharing Song
rhymes.text:
Teddy bear is soft and sweet,
Hugging him is such a treat.
Friend is standing close beside,
Waiting with a joy and pride.

Wind the timer, make it spin,
Let the sharing game begin!
Watch the little needle go,
Not too fast and not too slow.

Ding-dong goes the friendly bell,
Sharing magic works so well.
Pass the teddy, nice and slow,
Off to happy friend to go.

Now we take our turns so grand,
Hand to hand and friend to friend.
Every day is bright and new,
When I share my toys with you!

rhymes.title: Timer Time is Sharing Time
rhymes.text:
Crayons red and crayons blue,
Drawing pictures bright and new.
Coloring a happy star,
Traveling near and traveling far.

Timer rings with cheerful sound,
Passing yellow crayon round.
Now my friend can draw a tree,
Just as happy as can be.

Wait a minute, count to three,
One and two and then it is me.
Sharing is a joyful art,
Coming straight from every heart.

Now the timer chimes again,
Swap the paper with my friend.
Drawing pictures side by side,
Filled with happiness and pride!

rhymes.title: The Magic Sharing Clock
rhymes.text:
Puzzle pieces fit so neat,
Making pictures all complete.
Friend wants to put one piece in,
Let us let the game begin.

Turn the dial, set it right,
Timer flashes green and bright.
While it ticks away the space,
Smiles are shining on each face.

Beep-beep-beep, the time is up,
Like a little splashing pup.
Time to pass the puzzle frame,
Sharing is a happy game.

Thank you, friend, for waiting here,
Sharing brings such happy cheer.
Turn by turn we play the day,
In the kindest, sweetest way!

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Bell
rhymes.text:
Listen to the happy bell,
It has a little story to tell.
Now it is your special turn,
Look at all the fun we learn!

Tick-tock goes the timer clock,
We are sharing blocks and stock.
Count to five and then we say,
It is my friend's turn to play!

Round and round the hands will go,
Faster than a turtle goes slow.
Now the timer makes a beep,
Do not make a little weep.

Pass the toy with such a smile,
You can have it back in a while.
Sharing makes our hearts so bright,
Everything is feeling right!

rhymes.title: Tick Tock Timer Time
rhymes.text:
See the timer round and bright,
Flashing with a yellow light.
Time to share the shiny truck,
Look at us with so much luck!

One, two, three and four and five,
Watch the happy game come alive.
Now the timer gives a ring,
Let us dance and let us sing.

Give the bear a gentle hug,
Pass him like a little bug.
Now my friend can hold him tight,
Holding on with all their might.

Soon the bell will ring again,
Counting up to numbers ten.
Sharing is the best-loved way,
For us all to laugh and play!

rhymes.title: Beep Beep Share the Toy
rhymes.text:
Timer set and ready now,
We can share it, holy cow!
Give the puzzle pieces round,
Listen to the happy sound.

Tick-tock, tick-tock, hear the beat,
Sharing is a daily treat.
When the timer says we're done,
Sharing brings us double fun!

Hand it gently to your friend,
Games do not have to end.
Now they get to drive the car,
Faster than a shooting star.

Wait your turn and clap your hands,
Happiest kids in all the lands.
Beep beep goes the timer song,
Singing right along, ding-dong!

rhymes.title: The Sharing Circle Song
rhymes.text:
Circle up and hold your hands,
Best of all the little bands.
Timer spinning round and round,
Listen for the ding-dong sound.

Now you hold the crayons tall,
Draw a pretty picture wall.
When the timer starts to beep,
Do not make a grumpy peep.

Pass the crayons to your mate,
Waiting nicely is so great.
Now they draw a puppy dog,
Leaping like a happy frog.

Sharing turns is easy-peasy,
Even when the day is breezy.
Smile and let your buddy play,
Have a super duper day!

rhymes.title: Ding Dong Timer Magic
rhymes.text:
Magic timer, beep out loud,
Make our sharing circle proud.
Give the drum a little tap,
Now put on your thinking cap.

Tick-tock goes the little hand,
Bestest timer in the land.
When it rings a happy chime,
It is brand new sharing time!

Hand the drum to baby bear,
Show how much you love to share.
Now they play a boom-boom beat,
Tapping with their little feet.

Waiting is a piece of cake,
Look at all the friends we make.
Timer rests until tomorrow,
Sharing keeps away the sorrow!

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Bell
rhymes.text:
It is time to share the toy,
Bring a smile and bring some joy.
Now the timer starts to go,
Tick-tock, tick-tock, nice and slow.

Play together, hand in hand,
Building castles in the sand.
When you hear the funny chime,
It is someone else's turn and time.

Give the truck to your best friend,
Sharing fun that does not end.
Wait a minute, count to three,
Happy sharing, you and me.

Now the timer rings out clear,
Pass the toy with cozy cheer.
Taking turns is so much fun,
Smiles and giggles for everyone.

rhymes.title: Tick-Tock Toy Time
rhymes.text:
Look at the timer, bright and blue,
Waiting here for me and you.
 Hold the puzzle, piece by piece,
Till the little sounds increase.

Tick-tock goes the friendly clock,
Passing round the shiny block.
When the beep says it is through,
I have got a job to do.

Give the bear a gentle hug,
Pass him to the polka-rug.
Now your turn to hold him tight,
Everything is feeling right.

Sharing makes our hearts so wide,
Joy is sparkling deep inside.
Tick-tock finished, now we smile,
We will share a little while.

rhymes.title: The Golden Sharing Hour
rhymes.text:
The little timer starts to sing,
Let us share this lovely thing.
Crayons red and crayons blue,
Are for me and are for you.

Draw a circle, draw a star,
We can share them near and far.
When the timer chimes ding-dong,
Sing a happy sharing song.

Pass the yellow to your friend,
Joy is waiting at the bend.
Now it is your turn to trace,
With a big grin on your face.

Sharing is a superpower,
Growing brighter every hour.
Ding-dong goes the magic bell,
Playing nicely, oh so well.

rhymes.title: Beep-Beep Sharing Song
rhymes.text:
Beep-beep-beep the timer goes,
Touch your ears and touch your toes.
Hold the train and drive it slow,
Where the little tracks all go.

Soon the timer says hello,
Time to let the engine go.
Give the caboose to your mate,
Waiting nicely at the gate.

Taking turns is easy peasy,
Keeping every toddler breezy.
Count the numbers one, two, three,
Happy as a honeybee.

Now you grab the steering wheel,
How exciting does it feel?
Beep-beep-beep the timer sings,
Joy is what sharing brings.

rhymes.title: The Timer Turn-About
rhymes.text:
Spin the timer round and round,
Listen to the happy sound.
Blocks are stacking very high,
Reaching up into the sky.

When the little timer rings,
Watch the way that sharing brings.
Pass the tower to your pal,
Every boy and every gal.

Now you wait and now you see,
How much fun this game can be.
Counting fingers, counting toes,
On the wind the music blows.

Timer stops and timer starts,
Sharing fills our little hearts.
Spin the dial, take a turn,
That is how we play and learn.

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Bell
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock, tick-tock goes the clock,
We love our shiny building block.
It is my turn to play and zoom,
Around the cozy living room.

Tick-tock, the timer starts to ring,
It is a happy sharing thing!
I pass the block to my best friend,
Oh, sharing fun will never end.

Now it is your turn to build so high,
Reach way up into the sky.
I wait so patient and so sweet,
With happy hands and happy feet.

Soon the bell will ring once more,
We play together on the floor.
Sharing makes our hearts so bright,
Everything is feeling right!

rhymes.title: Beep-Beep Timer Song
rhymes.text:
Beep-beep, beep-beep goes the timer sound,
Best red truck that can be found!
I roll it fast, I roll it slow,
Watch the little red truck go.

The timer tells me when is best,
To give my sharing friend a rest.
I say 'Here you go, my friend,'
And watch the truck drive round the bend.

Now you drive it, beep, beep, beep,
While I hold the little sheep.
We take turns and play along,
Singing out our sharing song.

Beep-beep, timer, ring again,
So we can swap and play, amen.
Sharing brings us so much joy,
With every little game and toy!

rhymes.title: The Dinosaur Swap
rhymes.text:
Roar, roar, dinosaur so green,
Best little pet you've ever seen!
I hold him tight against my chest,
Of all the toys, he is the best.

Ring-a-ling, the timer chimes,
We swap around at sharing times.
I give the dino with a smile,
And rest my happy hands a while.

Now the dino goes to you,
With roaring sounds of green and blue.
I get the fluffy teddy bear,
Because we love to play and share.

Back and forth the toys will go,
We love our sharing friend, you know.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
We share our toys the livelong day!

rhymes.title: Puzzle Piece Parade
rhymes.text:
Puzzle pieces on the floor,
Let us do a dozen more!
I put the yellow duck in place,
With a giant happy face.

Ding-dong, the sharing timer sings,
Look at all the joy it brings!
I pass the box to sister dear,
With a gentle, loving cheer.

Now she finds a puzzle piece,
Making all the waiting cease.
I sit and clap a happy beat,
While she makes the picture sweet.

Sharing is a super power,
Every single minute, hour!
Ding-dong, time to swap again,
Best of friends, now and then.

rhymes.title: Crayon Color Ring
rhymes.text:
Crayons yellow, red, and blue,
I love drawing pictures, too!
I color circles round and bright,
In the lovely morning light.

Ding-dong-ding, the timer sings,
Look at what the sharing brings!
I hand the blue to brother near,
And whisper in his little ear.

Now he draws a shiny sea,
While he shares the red with me.
We color happy trees and skies,
Right before our very eyes.

Timer rings and round we go,
Sharing makes our friendship grow.
Draw a smile and sing a song,
Sharing time is where we belong!

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Bell
rhymes.text:
It is my turn to play today,
I love to watch the colorful clay.
Now the timer starts to beep,
Time to share and take a leap!

Tick-tock, tick-tock, hear it ring,
Let us dance and let us sing.
My turn is done, I give a smile,
I will wait a little while.

Now your turn to hold the bear,
We are learning how to share.
Back and forth we take our place,
With a happy, glowing face.

Sharing makes our friendship grow,
Watch the happy feeling show!
Sharing toys is so much fun,
Joy for me and joy for everyone.

rhymes.title: Ding-Dong Time to Share
rhymes.text:
Look at the timer, shiny and red,
Resting right by the big brown bed.
It tells us when to change our play,
And share our toys along the way.

Ding-dong, ding-dong, time is up,
Pass along the plastic cup.
I take a breath and count to three,
Sharing brings such joy to me.

Now you grab the racing car,
We can travel fast and far.
My turn was fun, but now it is through,
I am so glad to share with you.

Friends together side by side,
Sharing fills our hearts with pride.
When we share, we play as one,
Look how much we have just done!

rhymes.title: The Friendly Sharing Song
rhymes.text:
Blocks go high and blocks go low,
See the mighty tower grow.
Beep-beep-beep, the timer cries,
Look right here with happy eyes.

Time to pass the blocks along,
Singing out our sharing song.
One for you and one for me,
Sharing makes us wild and free.

Now you build the castle tall,
I will gently catch the ball.
Taking turns is easy to do,
When I play along with you.

Clap your hands and shout hooray,
We are sharing every day.
Friendship shines so bright and clear,
Best of friends throughout the year.

rhymes.title: Tick-Tock Turn Taking
rhymes.text:
Painting pictures on the pad,
Making mom and daddy glad.
Ring-a-ling, the timer goes,
Right down to my little toes.

Time to share the paints and brush,
There is never any rush.
Here is the brush, go take your hold,
Paint a story brave and bold.

Waiting is a gentle thing,
While the little songbirds sing.
Soon my turn will come right back,
Down upon the painting track.

We love sharing day and night,
Making everything feel right.
Turn by turn we learn and play,
Happily through all the day.

rhymes.title: The Golden Sharing Minute
rhymes.text:
Puzzles pieces fit so neat,
Making pictures all complete.
BEEP-BEEP-BEEP, the timer sings,
Look at all the joy it brings!

Now the minute has gone past,
Sharing time is here at last.
Give the puzzle to your friend,
Smiles and giggles without end.

Take the pieces, try your best,
Sharing is the very best!
I will wait and clap my hands,
Happiest kids in all the lands.

Round and round the clock goes round,
Best sharing friends that can be found.
Now we trade and play anew,
Happy, happy sharing crew!

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Bell
rhymes.text:
It is time to share the toy,
Bring a smile and bring some joy.
Now the timer starts to beep,
Promises we love to keep.

Tick-tock, tick-tock goes the clock,
Time to share with little block.
Give the truck to your best friend,
Sharing fun is here again.

Now it is your turn to play,
Have a happy, sharing day.
Pass the bear and give a grin,
Everybody has to win.

Sharing makes our hearts so bright,
Everything is feeling right.

rhymes.title: Beep Beep Sharing Song
rhymes.text:
Hear the timer ring its song,
Sharing time is right along.
Hold the puzzle in your hand,
Pass it to the happy band.

One, two, three and off it goes,
Right beneath the little nose.
Now your friend gets lots of turns,
Look at how the toddler learns.

Tick-tock, tick-tock, hear it ring,
Time to share a joyful thing.
Give the crayon to your mate,
Look how nice and look how great.

When the timer chimes anew,
Then the toy comes back to you.

rhymes.title: The Golden Timer Ring
rhymes.text:
Golden timer starts to chime,
It is friendly sharing time.
Take the train and let it go,
Make the wheels go round and slow.

Give the caboose to your peer,
Spread a little toddler cheer.
Timer says your turn is done,
Passing toys is so much fun.

Now the next one gets a ride,
Sitting safely right beside.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Sharing makes a sunny day.

Wait your turn and count to four,
Then you get to play some more.

rhymes.title: Tick Tock Share and Smile
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock goes the little bell,
Sharing toys is going well.
Hand the ball across the floor,
Let us play a little more.

When the timer makes a sound,
Pass the goodies all around.
Give the doll a gentle hug,
Sit upon the little rug.

Now your friend can take a turn,
That is how we share and learn.
Smile and let the timer ring,
Sharing is the finest thing.

Happy faces all about,
Hear the happy toddlers shout.

rhymes.title: The Sharing Timer Dance
rhymes.text:
Dance around the sharing space,
Put a smile upon your face.
When the timer gives a beep,
Promises we love to keep.

Give the blocks away to play,
Have a super lovely day.
Now your friend is building high,
Reaching up into the sky.

Wait until the timer sings,
Look at all the joy it brings.
Take the toy back in your hand,
Bestest sharers in the land.

Clap your hands and sing along,
Sharing is our favorite song.

rhymes.title: The Happy Sharing Timer
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock, tick-tock, hear it chime,
It is time to share and shine.
Give the truck a gentle slide,
Now it is your friend's sweet ride.

Timer beeps a happy song,
Sharing makes us all so strong.
Count to five and pass it back,
Put the blocks back in the sack.

Waiting is so easy now,
We can share and take a bow.
When the timer rings out loud,
Everyone is feeling proud.

Keep on sharing, day by day,
That is how we learn to play.
Tick-tock, timer, beep-beep-beep,
Promises we always keep.

rhymes.title: BEEP BEEP Time to Share
rhymes.text:
Look at the timer, shiny and red,
Resting right here by my little head.
It tells us when it is time to swap,
Playing together until we drop.

My turn now, and then your turn too,
Sharing is fun for me and you.
Pass the bear and give a hug,
Sit right down upon the rug.

Ring-a-ling goes the timer bell,
Playing together is going well.
Hand it over, give a smile,
Rest the toy for just a while.

Now it is your turn to go,
Watch the little truck roll slow.
Sharing times are bright and clear,
We love sharing all the year.

rhymes.title: The Golden Timer Song
rhymes.text:
Twirl the timer, round and round,
Waiting for the dinging sound.
Crayon box is so much fun,
We can share it everyone.

Yellow, blue, and shiny green,
Bestest colors ever seen.
When the little bell goes ring,
We can dance and we can sing.

Pass the crayon to your friend,
Joy is right around the bend.
Now it is their turn to draw,
Biggest smile you ever saw.

Sharing makes our hearts so big,
Like a happy little pig.
Tick-tock goes the timer clock,
Sharing is our favorite block.

rhymes.title: Tick-Tock Turn Time
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock goes the timer dear,
Let us give a happy cheer.
Playing with the puzzle parts,
Sharing warms our little hearts.

When the timer rings out bright,
Everything is feeling right.
Give the piece to brother now,
Say hello and take a bow.

Turns are fair for girls and boys,
Sharing all our favorite toys.
Now you wait and now you play,
Sunshine in our room today.

Timer resting on the shelf,
Sharing is a prize itself.
Bippity-boppity, time is through,
Now it is my turn for you.

rhymes.title: The Sharing Bell
rhymes.text:
Ring the bell and watch it go,
Sharing makes our friendship grow.
Train set chugging down the track,
Forward, backward, and right back.

Timer set for minutes five,
Glad and happy to be alive.
When it dings, we do not frown,
We pass the engine up and down.

Your turn, my turn, hand in hand,
Playing in our wonderland.
Smile and let the other play,
Bright and sunny is our day.

Clock says stop and clock says start,
Sharing is the finest art.
Ding-dong, timer says we're done,
Sharing brings us so much fun.

stories.title: Leo's Ready-Go Backpack
stories.text: Good morning, little Leo! Today is a brand-new day filled with lots of fun adventures at preschool. First, we need to get your super backpack ready so you can zoom right out the door like a happy little rocket ship. Are you ready? Let us go find your favorite red backpack hanging right on your special hook. Yay! Open wide, little zipper. Zip, zap, zoom! What is the very first thing that goes inside? It is your cozy, fluffy blue blankie for quiet rest time. Tuck it in nice and snug, just like a little bear going to sleep in a warm cave. Great job, Leo! Next, we need your bright green water bottle because playing and running makes you super thirsty. Let us slide it right into the side pocket. Click, clack, it is in place and ready to pour cool, refreshing water when you need a big gulp. Look at you go! Now, let us find your healthy snack box with the crunchy orange carrots inside. Slide that right in the middle, keeping it safe and sound. You are doing such an amazing job being a big helper today. We just need one more special treasure. Can you guess what it is? It is your favorite picture book about the bouncy little bunny! Let us tuck it gently on top. Now comes the most important part of all. Let us zip that zipper all the way from the bottom to the very top. Zip, zoo-oo-m! You did it, Leo! You packed your super backpack all by yourself. You are so strong, so smart, and so ready for your wonderful day. Give yourself a giant bear hug. Let us go have the best day ever!

stories.title: Mia's Magical Morning Pack
stories.text: Good morning, sweet Mia! The sun is shining a bright, happy yellow, and the little birds are singing outside your window. Today is a special day to learn, grow, and play with all your friends. But before we step outside, we have a very important mission: packing your magical butterfly backpack! Let us hop over to your chair where your sparkly pink bag is waiting for you. Open up, little zipper! Zip, zorp, yay! What wonderful things shall we put inside today? First comes your shiny purple lunchbox filled with yummy apple slices and a yummy cheese sandwich. Let us place it right at the bottom so it sits nice and flat. You are such a careful planner, Mia! Next, let us grab your polka-dot rain jacket, just in case a fluffy cloud decides to sprinkle a few raindrops during playtime. Fold it up small, like a sleeping kitty cat, and slide it right in. Wonderful! Oh, look over here! Here is your special show-and-share toy, the sparkly pink pony. She cannot wait to meet all your friends at school today. Let us tuck her safely inside the front pouch so she can peek out and see the world as we walk. You are doing phenomenal, Mia! Just one last thing: your softest blankie for nap time. In it goes, right on top. Now, let us use our superhero strength to zip that zipper closed. Pull, pull, pull, zip! Wow, look at that! Your backpack is ready, and you are ready, too. You are so clever, so capable, and so wonderfully kind. Let us put your backpack on your shoulders and get ready to soar into a magical day of fun!

stories.title: Sammy's Starry Backpack Adventure
stories.text: Wake up, sleepyhead Sammy! The morning breeze is blowing, and a brand-new day is waiting just for you. Today, you are going to the park and to art class, which means we get to pack your super-duper dinosaur backpack! Let us march over to your cubby like happy little marching ants. March, march, march! There is your roaring green dinosaur bag, and he looks extra hungry to carry all your treasures today. Let us open his big zipper mouth. Open wide, Mr. Dinosaur! Zip, zap, roar! What goes in first? Your bright yellow raincoat with the shiny buttons! Let us fold it neatly and tuck it deep inside so you stay dry if any little rain puddles splash around. Fantastic work, Sammy! Next, let us add your favorite art smock. We know how much you love painting big, beautiful blue skies and red fire engines, so your smock is super important. Slide it right in next to the raincoat. You are being such an incredible helper right now! Now, we need your shiny silver water bottle to keep you hydrated while you run and jump like a happy puppy. Let us pop it into the side mesh pocket. Pop! It is snug as a bug. Lastly, let us pack your favorite puzzle toy in the front pocket so your hands can play during journey time. Ready for the grand finale? Let us pull that zipper all the way shut together. Ready, set, zip! Hooray! You did it all by yourself, Sammy. Your backpack is fully loaded, and you are a superstar packing champion. Stand up tall, put your straps on your shoulders, and let us go conquer the world with a big, bright smile!

stories.title: Benny Bear's Shiny Red Backpack
stories.text:
Good morning, little Benny Bear! The sun is peeking through your window, saying hello with a warm golden smile. Today is a very special day at Woodland Preschool, and Benny Bear has a very special job to do. Can you guess what it is? It is time to pack your super-duper red backpack! 

Let us look at the shiny silver zipper. Pull! Open goes the big main pocket, waiting patiently for our treasures. First, let us find your cozy blue water bottle. It has little white stars painted all over it. Where does it go? Right inside the side mesh pocket! Click, snug and secure. Great job keeping hydrated, Benny!

Next, let us look at your favorite picture book about the bouncy green frog. It is time to slide it safely inside the big pocket. Push, slide, all the way down so the corners do not bend. You are taking such wonderful care of your books! You are growing up so fast.

Oh, what is this fluffy friend hiding under the blanket? It is Barnaby Bear, your blankie buddy! He wants to come to school for quiet time. Let us tuck him in gently right on top of the book. Make sure he can peek out and see all the fun things you will do today. 

Now, let us find your bright yellow snack box. Inside are yummy apple slices and crunchy crackers. We slide the snack box carefully to the bottom so it stays nice and flat. No squishing allowed! 

Look at you go! You did most of it all by yourself. Let us zip the big zipper up, up, up. Zzzzt! Give your backpack a big bear hug. You are ready to explore, learn, and play. Put your arms through the soft straps, one and two. Stand up tall. You look like a super backpack hero! Let us march out the door, ready for a wonderful day. Hooray for Benny Bear!

stories.title: Mia Mouse's Morning Mission
stories.text:
Squeak, squeak! Good morning, little Mia Mouse! The morning breeze is dancing outside, and the birds are singing a happy song. Today, Mia Mouse has an important mission. A big playground mission with all her furry friends! But before we can slide down the yellow slide and swing on the green swings, we have a very important helper to pack. Our super starry backpack!

Let us lay the purple backpack flat on the fuzzy rug. It has little glowing stars that match your pajamas. Time to open the mouth of the backpack. Wide, wider, wide! Perfect.

First on our checklist is your trusty green snack cup. Inside are delicious cheesy crackers shaped like little moons. We place the snack cup right in the center so it stays safe and sound. You are being so careful, Mia! 

Next, we need your painting smock. We fold it up like a tiny square. Fold, fold, and tuck! Into the front pocket it goes. Now you are ready to paint rainbows and flowers without getting your paws messy. High five for being prepared!

Wait, we almost forgot something very important! Your polka-dot raincoat. The fluffy clouds outside look like they might tickle us with a little sprinkle of rain later. Let us roll the raincoat up tightly, like a sleeping caterpillar, and slip it right beside your snack cup. You are ready for sunshine and raindrops!

Now comes the most fun part. The magic zipper! Pull it from the left side all the way to the right. Zzzzt! Zip! Give it a little pat. You did it, Mia! Sling the comfy straps over your tiny shoulders. One arm, two arms. You are wearing your super backpack like a crown. You are strong, you are smart, and you are ready to take on the whole wide world. Squeak-hooray!

stories.title: Leo Lion's Jungle Journey
stories.text:
Roar! Well, a very soft, happy little roar for a sunny morning! Good morning, Leo Lion. Stretch your paws up high to touch the ceiling, wiggle your lion tail, and shake out sleepiness. Today is adventure day at the jungle gym, and every brave little lion needs his trusty gear. It is time to pack the super sunshine backpack!

Let us grab your bright orange backpack with the happy lion face on the front. Look at his friendly smile! He is ready to help you carry your day. Unzip the zipper with a smooth slide. Zzzzt! Open wide, little bag.

First, let us find your roaring-cool water bottle with the orange straw. We push it gently into the side pocket. Click! It is locked in and ready to keep you cool when you run super fast across the grass.

Next, what do we need for sunny days? Your favorite safari hat! It has a wide brim to keep the warm sunshine out of your bright eyes. Let us fold it gently and tuck it inside the big pocket. You look just like a real explorer!

Do not forget your cozy comfort blanket for story circle. It is as soft as a cloud and smells like lavender. Let us place it right on top, keeping everything snug and warm. You are taking such wonderful care of your special things, Leo.

Time to close our backpack helper. Pull the zipper all the way to the top. Zzzzt! Pat, pat, pat. Give your backpack a mighty lion roar! Now, slip your arms through the padded straps, one and two. Stand proud and tall with your chest puffed out. You are brave, you are kind, and your super backpack is packed to perfection. Time to step outside and roar hello to the day!

stories.title: Leo's Bright Red Rocket Bag
stories.text: Good morning, little Leo! Today is a brand new day full of fun adventures at preschool. Do you know what helps us carry all our special treasures? It is your bright red rocket backpack! Let us go find it by the big yellow chair. Zip, zap, zoom! Time to get ready, little explorer. First, we need your cozy naptime blanket. It is soft like a fluffy cloud and smells just like lavender. Can you gently fold it up and give it a big cuddle? Perfect! Now, slide it right inside the biggest pocket of your rocket bag. Zip! Good job, superstar. Next up are your thirsty water bottles with the happy little dinosaur stickers. We must keep our energy high for running and jumping! Let us pop them safely into the side mesh pockets. Glug, glug, splash, ready for action! Wait, what is that hiding under the sofa? It is your favorite picture book about the sleepy little bear who loves honey. We definitely cannot leave him behind. Slide him in right next to the blanket so he can look out the window during car ride time. Look at you go, doing such big-kid things all by yourself! Now comes the most important part of all: your mighty roar. Give your backpack a giant hug and say, 'We are ready to conquer the day!' You did it, Leo. You packed your super backpack like a true champion. Your teachers and friends are going to be so happy to see you. Let us put our arms through the straps, one, two, and march right out the door with a huge smile. Have the most wonderful day playing, learning, and sharing your kind heart with everyone you meet. You are amazing!

stories.title: Mia's Magic Rainbow Pouch
stories.text: Rise and shine, sweet Mia! The morning sun is peeking through your window to say hello. Today is art and playground day, which means we need your magical rainbow backpack! It sparkles with pink and purple glitter every time you move. Are you ready to play packing helper today? I know you are! Let us lay your backpack flat on the soft bedroom rug, right beside your favorite stuffed bunny, Hoppy. First, Hoppy needs to come along for the ride so he can watch you swing on the big green swings. Tuck him in snugly inside the front pouch so his long ears peek out to say hello to the world. Peek-a-boo, Hoppy! Next, we need your shiny silver snack box filled with yummy apple slices and crunchy orange crackers. Slide it into the middle compartment carefully, keeping it nice and flat so the apples do not tumble out. Yum, yum, tummy time will be so much fun! Oh, look over here! Your extra pair of sparkly polka-dot socks in case you splash in the big sidewalk puddles. Let us roll them up like little sleeping caterpillars and tuck them right into the side pocket. You are doing such an incredible job, Mia. Every little zip and tuck shows how much you are growing up. Fasten the little chest buckle—click! Now your backpack feels like a warm hug on your shoulders. You look like a true rainbow fairy ready to spread joy everywhere you go. Take a deep breath in, and let it out. You are prepped, primed, and totally ready to take on the world. Let us grab our shoes and skip out the door together!

stories.title: Sam's Dinosaur Explorer Pack
stories.text: Good morning, Captain Sam! Hear the jungle birds chirping outside? Today we are going on a grand safari adventure at daycare, and every great explorer needs the right gear. Grab your trusty green dinosaur backpack with the friendly T-Rex scales on top! Roar! Let us get everything packed up nice and neat before we start our expedition. First, we need your trusty magnifying glass to look for ladybugs and shiny pebbles in the grass. Slide it safely into the zippered front pouch so it is ready for action. Next, we cannot forget your green dinosaur lunch box with the peanut butter and banana sandwich inside. Place it right at the bottom of the main section like a sturdy foundation. Squish, crunch, munch, ready for lunchtime! What else does a brave explorer need? Ah, yes! Your blue splash hat to keep the warm sunshine out of your bright brown eyes. Pop it right on top of the lunch box. Look at you following every single step with such a focused, happy face. I am so proud of your hard work today, Sam. Zip the zippers all the way from the bottom to the very top. Zzzzip! Now, swing the first soft strap over your left shoulder, and the second strap over your right shoulder. Adjust them just right so it fits snug like a turtle shell. Give a little wiggle—everything is secure and ready to roll. You are officially the coolest, smartest explorer in the entire neighborhood. Let us march to the front door, stomp our dinosaur feet, and shout, 'Let's go explore!' Have an absolute blast today, my sweet little adventurer!

stories.title: Benny Bear Packs For Preschool
stories.text: Good morning, little Benny Bear! The sun is peeking through the fluffy clouds, saying hello to a brand new day. Today is a very special day because Benny is going to preschool with all his animal friends. But before he can march out the door, he needs to get ready. What is the most important mission of the morning? Why, packing his super-duper green backpack, of course! Benny dances into his cozy bedroom and finds his backpack sitting right on his little wooden chair. It is waiting patiently for a big adventure. First, Benny reaches for his favorite red water bottle. It has shiny silver stars on it that sparkle in the light. "In you go, water bottle!" cheers Benny, tucking it snugly into the side pocket. Hydration is key for a busy day of playing and learning. Next, Benny wiggles over to his toy chest. He wants to bring something special for show-and-tell. After a quick think, he picks his favorite plush bunny, Barnaby. "Barnaby needs to see the classroom too," Benny whispers gently. He opens the big zipper of his backpack, which makes a happy 'zuzzzz' sound. In slides Barnaby, with just his long floppy ears sticking out so he can see where they are going. Now, what else? Ah, Benny’s cozy blue blankie for nap time! He folds it up carefully, patting it flat with his small paws, and places it right in the middle. Finally, Benny finds his shiny yellow lunchbox filled with yummy sliced apples and cheese cubes. That goes right on top. Benny pulls the zipper all the way around. Zuzzzz!
