Leo cheers, jumping up and down on his tiptoes. Mia catches the ball and giggles with delight. She rolls it right back across the rubber mat to Leo's shiny shoes. 'Thank you, Mia!' Leo says proudly, bending down to scoop up the ball. Taking turns makes Leo feel so happy and warm inside. When we share our toys, everyone gets to play and have a good time. Leo takes another turn, throwing the ball with care and gentleness. Every successful catch brings big smiles and happy claps. The playground is filled with laughter and bright colors. Leo feels so proud of his sharing skills today. He gives the ball one more gentle push toward Mia, knowing that sharing is caring and teamwork is the most fun of all.

stories.title: Zoe's Cozy Living Room Game
stories.text: The rain is tap-tapping softly against the living room window, making a cozy song inside the house. Little Zoe is sitting on the big, comfortable yellow rug with her cuddly teddy bear sitting right beside her. On the floor in front of her is a soft, green fabric ball that is very easy to catch. Zoe loves her green ball because it is super soft and squishy. Her big brother, Sam, is sitting on the couch, smiling down at her. Sam opens his arms wide and says, 'Zoe, can you pass the ball to me?' Zoe's eyes light up with excitement. She loves playing games with her big brother. She picks up the soft green ball with both hands, squeezing it just a little bit because it is so squishy. Then, with all her might, she gives it a gentle underhand roll across the yellow rug. 'Pass the ball to me!' Zoe says happily, using her sweetest voice. The green ball rolls smoothly past the wooden coffee table and bumps right into Sam's feet. Sam picks it up with a big cheer. 'Great pass, Zoe! You are getting so good at sharing!' Sam praises her with a warm, encouraging smile. Hearing those kind words makes Zoe feel proud and happy from her head to her toes. Sam rolls the soft ball back to Zoe, and she catches it safely against her chest. Back and forth goes the ball, sharing joy with every single roll. Rainy days are wonderful for playing gentle games indoors. Zoe hugs the ball for a second before rolling it back to Sam, practicing patience and taking turns all afternoon long.

stories.title: Bouncy Ball in the Backyard
stories.text: The sun is shining bright and warm, and little Leo is standing on the green grass in his backyard. Leo has a big, shiny red ball. It is super bouncy! Boing, boing, boing goes the ball as it hits the ground. Leo gives the ball a big hug. It feels round and happy in his little hands. His puppy friend, Pip, sits down on the grass. Pip wags his tail very fast. Thump, thump, thump goes Pip's tail on the dirt. Pip wants to play a very fun game! Leo remembers the magic words for playing together. He looks right at Pip with a big, bright smile. Leo says, 'Pass the ball to me, Pip!' Well, of course, a puppy cannot talk, but Pip barks a happy 'Woof!' to show he is ready. Leo holds the big red ball with both hands. He bends his knees down low. Then, with a gentle push, he rolls the ball across the grass. Wheeee! The red ball goes rolling, rolling, rolling right toward Pip. Pip uses his soft paws to stop the ball. Good job, Pip! Now it is time for Pip to share. Pip gives the ball a tiny nudge with his wet nose. The ball rolls back to Leo. Leo claps his hands together. Yay! 'You passed the ball to me!' cheers Leo. Sharing and playing together is so much fun. Leo and Pip take turns all afternoon long. They roll the ball back and forth, laughing and playing in the warm sunshine. Playing with friends makes Leo's heart feel warm and full. What a wonderful game of catch.

stories.title: Soft Ball in the Cozy Living Room
stories.text: Inside the cozy living room, the rug is as soft as a cloud. Maya is sitting right in the middle of the big rug with her favorite blue fuzzy ball. The blue ball is very soft, perfect for indoor play. Maya's big brother, Sam, sits down across from her. Sam opens his arms wide and smiles. Maya wants to play catch, but she needs to know how to ask nicely. She takes a deep breath and uses her sweetest voice. Maya looks at her brother and says, 'Pass the ball to me!' Sam nods his head up and down. 'Okay, Maya! I am ready!' Sam holds the soft blue ball gently in his hands. He gives it a underhand toss through the air. Whoosh! The ball sails softly through the air like a little blue bird. Maya keeps her eyes wide open, watching the ball fly. She reaches out her hands and catches the ball securely against her tummy. Got it! A huge grin spreads across Maya's face. 'I caught it!' she shouts happily. Sam claps his hands together. 'Wonderful catching, Maya!' Now it is Maya's turn to share the fun. She holds the soft blue ball tightly. She aims carefully at Sam. With a gentle push from her little hands, she sends the ball back across the rug. 'Pass the ball to me!' Sam says with a laugh as he catches it. They take turns back and forth, sharing and smiling together. Playing indoor games with family is peaceful, warm, and full of giggles.

stories.title: Park Playground Ball Fun
stories.text: At the big, colorful playground, the slide is shiny and the swings are swaying in the gentle breeze. Mia and her friend Noah are standing near the sandbox. Noah is holding a bright yellow playground ball. The ball looks just like a happy, smiling sun. Mia wants to play a wonderful game of catch with Noah. She waves her hands in the air to get his attention. Mia speaks in a clear, friendly voice. She says, 'Pass the ball to me, Noah!' Noah hears his friend calling. He turns around and sees Mia waiting patiently. Noah holds the sunny yellow ball tightly with both hands. He pulls his arms back, and then he pushes the ball forward. Zoom! The yellow ball rolls smoothly across the playground path. Mia runs over with quick little steps. She bends down and scoops the ball up into her arms. She gives the ball a big squeeze. 'Yay! You passed the ball to me!' Mia says, her eyes sparkling with joy. Noah comes running over, laughing loudly. 'Now it is my turn!' he says. Mia nods and holds the ball out. She gently rolls the sunny yellow ball back to her friend. Noah stops the ball with his shoe and picks it up. They take turns passing and sharing all morning long. Playing games outside makes them feel strong, happy, and connected. Sharing toys with friends is the best way to have a super fun day at the park.

stories.title: The Friendly Park Ball
stories.text: Leo the little lion loved going to the park. Today, he had a big red bouncy ball with him. It was shiny and round. Leo held the ball tightly in his paws. He looked at his friend Mia, the bunny, who was standing on the green grass a little bit away. Leo wanted to play a fun game with Mia. He remembered the magic words for today: pass the ball to me! Mia waved her long ears and smiled a big, happy smile. She got her hands ready to catch. Leo took a deep breath. He did not squeeze too hard, and he did not throw it too high. He gave the ball a gentle, friendly roll right across the soft grass. Wheee! The ball rolled straight toward Mia. Mia opened her hands wide and scooped up the ball. 'Yay! You did it, Leo!' cheered Mia. Leo clapped his paws together. He felt so proud. Sharing and playing together was the best part of the day. Then, it was Leo's turn to wait. Mia shouted with joy, 'Pass the ball to me, Leo!' Leo got his paws ready, waiting for the gentle roll back. It was so much fun to take turns. Back and forth went the red bouncy ball, bringing big giggles and happy hearts. Playing together takes teamwork and kindness. Every time they passed the ball, their friendship grew stronger. Leo learned that sharing makes playtime twice as fun. You are doing such a wonderful job learning how to share your toys, just like Leo and Mia. Sharing brings so many smiles to our friends.

stories.title: Sammy's Soft Yellow Ball
stories.text: Inside the cozy playroom, Sammy the puppy had a soft, yellow fabric ball. It was stuffed with fluffy cotton, making it safe and squishy for indoor play. Sammy sat on the warm yellow rug. Across the room sat his stuffed bear, but today Sammy wanted to play with his big sister, Penny. Penny was sitting near the toy chest. Sammy held the yellow ball in his paws. He wanted to practice his big-kid skills. He remembered how much fun it is to share. Sammy looked right at Penny and smiled. Penny opened her hands and said in a sweet voice, 'Pass the ball to me, Sammy!' Sammy nodded his furry head. He gave the soft yellow ball a gentle little toss through the air. It flew softly, making a tiny swoosh sound, right into Penny's lap. 'Good catch!' whispered Penny, giving Sammy a gentle hug. Sammy wagged his tail happily. His heart felt warm inside. Playing together and passing toys makes everyone feel included and loved. Now it was Penny's turn to share. Penny held the ball and said, 'Are you ready, Sammy?' Sammy nodded eagerly, opening his paws wide to catch. Penny tossed the ball back softly. Catch! Sammy held it tight. They took turns back and forth, practicing their coordination and sharing skills. Every single time they passed the ball, they giggled together. It was a wonderful way to spend the afternoon in their cozy room. You are learning how to share and play so nicely with others every single day.

stories.title: The Backyard Balloon Ball
stories.text: In the sunny backyard, Oliver and his dad were enjoying a warm afternoon. Oliver had a very special toy: a light, sparkly blue beach ball that looked just like a big bubble. Because it was so light, it floated gently in the breeze. Oliver hugged the big blue ball against his tummy. Dad sat on the grass a few steps away, stretching out his arms. Dad smiled warmly and said, 'Oliver, pass the ball to me!' Oliver wanted to be a big helper. He held the ball with both hands. He knew just how to do it. He stepped forward with one foot and gave the ball a friendly little push. Up, up, and away went the sparkly blue ball, floating through the warm air like a gentle cloud. Dad caught the ball safely against his chest. 'Fantastic pass, Oliver!' praised Dad, his eyes twinkling with happiness. Oliver did a little happy dance on the grass. Moving and playing outside was so much fun. Then, Dad got ready to send it back. Dad called out, 'Pass the ball to me, Oliver!' Oliver opened his arms wide, keeping his eyes right on the sparkly blue ball. Dad gave it a gentle tap. The ball floated back through the air, right into Oliver's waiting hands. Got it! Oliver squeezed the ball with joy. Taking turns made them both feel so happy. They played this wonderful game together, passing the ball back and forth under the bright blue sky. Sharing and playing nicely brings so much joy to our hearts. You are a wonderful friend when you share and play too.

stories.title: The Happy Bunny Bounce
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning in the soft green grass, Pip the little brown bunny sat with his shiny red ball. Pip loved his red ball very much. It was round and bouncy, just right for play. Across the garden path sat his best friend, Tess the turtle. Tess had a little green shell and a very big smile. Pip wanted to share the fun with Tess. He knew just what to say and do! Pip took a deep breath, looked right at Tess, and gave a gentle roll. 'Pass the ball to me!' called out Tess happily, her little feet tapping with joy. The red ball rolled softly across the grass, bump, bump, rolling right up to Tess's toes. Tess reached out and gently stopped the ball with her paws. 'Yay! You got it!' cheered Pip, clapping his fuzzy paws together. Positive reinforcement makes playtime so much brighter. Tess smiled warmly, feeling so proud. Now it was Tess's turn to share the fun. She looked at Pip, took a steady aim, and pushed the red ball back. 'Pass the ball to me!' squeaked Pip with a happy giggle. Back and forth went the bright red ball, a lovely game of sharing and caring. Sharing toys is a wonderful way to show love to our friends. Pip and Tess giggled together in the sunshine, playing their special passing game all morning long. Every time the ball went back and forth, they practiced being kind and working as a team. What a wonderful day for playing catch in the garden! When the sun started to get sleepy, they gave one last gentle roll and hugged their soft toys. It felt so good to play nicely together.

stories.title: Leo's Lovely Puppy Playtime
stories.text: High up in the blue sky, fluffy white clouds drifted by as Leo the little yellow puppy bounded into the sunny yard. Leo had a brand-new yellow tennis ball that squeaked when it bounced. Squeak, squeak, went the happy ball! Leo wagged his tail so fast it was like a happy little helicopter. Sitting on the wooden porch was his gentle pal, Mia the kitten. Mia had soft orange stripes and bright green eyes, watching the ball with curiosity. Leo wanted to play a wonderful sharing game with Mia. He trotted over, dropped the ball gently near the steps, and sat down patiently. 'Pass the ball to me!' meowed Mia softly, batting at the air with a playful paw. Leo barked a cheerful, friendly bark and nudged the yellow ball forward with his wet black nose. The ball rolled across the porch planks, clatter-clatter-roll, stopping right in front of Mia. 'Good job, Leo!' purred Mia, her tail swaying happily. Encouraging our friends helps everyone feel safe and happy. Mia used her soft paws to tap the ball back toward Leo. 'Pass the ball to me!' barked Leo, wagging his tail even harder. The ball rolled back across the warm wood. Leo caught it gently and did a little happy dance on his paws. Playing together takes teamwork and kind turns, and Leo and Mia were learning how to do it just right. They practiced passing the ball over and over, each time getting better and kinder. When playtime was done, they curled up side by side for a cozy nap in the warm afternoon sun, dreaming of happy yellow balls.

stories.title: Sammy's Soft Starry Ball
stories.text: Inside the cozy playroom, painted with stars and rainbows, Sammy the little bear sat on the fluffy blue rug. Sammy held a big, soft cloth ball with bright blue and yellow patches. It was the softest ball in the whole wide world! Across the room, his sweet friend Lily the lamb was building a tower of wooden blocks. Sammy wanted to include Lily in his fun game. He hugged the soft ball close and then gently placed it on the floor. 'Pass the ball to me!' whispered Lily with a sweet, happy baa. Sammy beamed with a big, joyful smile because sharing makes his heart feel warm and full. He gave the soft ball a gentle push with his paw. It rolled softly over the fluffy rug, making a tiny swishing sound, right up to Lily's little hooves. Lily caught the ball in her fluffy white wool and giggled with delight. 'Thank you, Sammy! You are a wonderful helper!' cheered Lily, praising her dear friend with kind, encouraging words. Positive words make playtime feel like magic! Now it was Lily's turn to share. She took the soft patch ball and rolled it back toward Sammy. 'Pass the ball to me!' called Sammy softly, reaching out his furry paws to catch it. Thump, soft and cozy, the ball landed right in Sammy's lap. They laughed and played together, passing the ball back and forth through the quiet, cozy afternoon. Every gentle roll was a new moment of friendship and love. When the room grew dim and evening stars began to peek outside, Sammy and Lily hugged their soft ball tightly, knowing that sharing and playing together is the best part of the whole day.

stories.title: Max and the Big Blue Ball
stories.text: Max loved his big blue bouncy ball. It was as round as the moon and just as shiny. Every morning, after Max ate his yummy toast, he would run outside to the soft green grass. Today, his puppy, Pip, wanted to play too! Pip trotted over, his little tail wagging very fast. Max smiled a big, happy smile and held the ball tightly in his two little hands. 'Ready, Pip?' Max called out in his cheerful voice. Max took a little step forward and gave the ball a gentle push. Roll, roll, roll went the big blue ball, right across the grass! Pip chased after it with happy barks. 'Yay, Pip!' cheered Max, clapping his hands together. Pip nudged the ball back with his soft black nose, but it stopped halfway. It was too far for Max to reach. 'Can you pass the ball to me, puppy?' asked Max kindly, stretching out his arms wide. Pip gave the ball one more little push with his paw. Whew! The ball rolled all the way into Max's waiting lap. 'Good job, Pip! You shared so well!' Max giggled, giving Pip a gentle pat on the head. Sharing makes playtime so much fun. Now it was time to roll again. Max held the ball high above his head and counted to three. One, two, three! He pushed it softly. Off went the ball again, dancing through the sunshine. Playing together was the best part of the whole morning. Max felt warm and cozy inside. Learning to share and ask for things nicely made him feel like a big boy. When the sun began to climb high in the sky, Max gave the ball one last hug. 'Time for a snack,' Max whispered to Pip. They walked inside together, happy and tired from their wonderful game of passing the ball.

stories.title: Lily's Garden Game
stories.text: In a cozy backyard filled with bright yellow daisies, little Lily sat on a colorful polka-dot blanket. Her fluffy teddy bear, Barnaby, sat right beside her. Lily had a special red ball that felt as smooth as an apple. It was time for a fun game in the sunshine! Lily picked up the red ball and hugged it close to her chest. She wanted to share her special toy. 'Do you want to play catch, Barnaby?' Lily asked her furry friend. She gently placed the ball on the grass right in front of Barnaby's paws. But teddy bears are very quiet and cannot move by themselves. Lily remembered what her mommy always said about asking for help and sharing nicely. She smiled her brightest smile and opened her hands wide. 'Please pass the ball to me, little bear,' Lily sang out sweetly, pretending Barnaby was nodding his head yes. Then, Lily gently tapped the ball so it rolled a tiny circle back to her toes. 'We did it! We are a great team!' Lily squealed with joy, her pigtails bouncing as she giggled. Playing with the ball was so much more fun when it went back and forth. Next, Lily rolled the ball toward the big oak tree. The ball stopped near a patch of clover. Lily crawled over on her hands and knees, moving as fast as a little ladybug. When she reached the ball, she picked it up and gave it a triumphant toss into the air, catching it in her hands. She practiced saying the magic words again. 'Pass the ball to me!' she whispered softly to the wind. The warm breeze rustled the leaves, as if the trees were playing along too. Lily felt so proud of her kind words and her sharing heart. It was a wonderful day for games in the garden.

stories.title: Sammy's Sunny Afternoon
stories.text: The afternoon sun cast long, friendly shadows across the living room rug. Sammy the bunny rabbit slippers were on his feet, tap-tapping against the floorboards. Sammy had a brand-new, striped green ball that bounced with a happy boing-boing sound. His big sister, Mia, was sitting on the comfy yellow sofa reading a storybook. Sammy wanted to play a wonderful game together. He scooped up the striped ball and walked over to the sofa. 'Mia, do you want to play?' Sammy asked politely, his eyes shining with excitement. Mia closed her book with a soft thump and smiled warmly down at her little brother. 'I would love to, Sammy,' Mia said in a gentle voice. Sammy stepped back a little bit to give her plenty of room. He held the ball steady and gave it a soft, careful roll across the smooth wooden floor. Click-clack went the ball as it traveled toward the sofa. Mia caught it easily in her lap. 'Thank you for the nice roll, Sammy!' Mia praised him, making Sammy feel as proud as could be. Now it was Sammy's turn to wait patiently. He stood with his toes behind an imaginary line and opened his hands like a little basket. 'Can you pass the ball back to me, please?' Sammy asked using his very best manners. Mia smiled, gave the ball a gentle push, and sent it rolling right back to his waiting toes. 'You got it!' she cheered. Sammy stopped the ball with his shoe and laughed out loud. Playing together by passing the ball back and forth was pure magic. They played for a long time, sharing smiles, kind words, and gentle rolls. Sammy learned that playing as a team made everything twice as bright and fun.

stories.title: The Big Red Ball in the Park
stories.text: Leo the little lion loved going to the big green park on sunny mornings. Today, he had his very favorite toy in the whole wide world: a big, shiny, red rubber ball. It bounced up and down with a happy boing-boing sound. Leo hugged the ball tight against his furry tummy. Across the soft green grass, his best friend Maya the monkey was sitting and waiting with a big, warm smile. Maya stretched her arms out wide and called out, 'Pass the ball to me, Leo! You can do it!' Leo looked at the ball, and then he looked at Maya. He took a tiny step forward and bent his knees. 'I am ready to share!' thought Leo. With a gentle push from his little paws, the big red ball rolled right across the grass. It went wheee, spinning round and round. Maya caught the ball in her hands and cheered, 'Yay! You passed the ball! Good job, Leo!' Leo clapped his paws together and jumped up and down. Sharing and playing together made his heart feel so warm and happy. Then, Maya rolled the ball back to Leo. 'Your turn to catch!' she giggled. Leo waited with his little hands open wide. Thump went the ball right into his tummy. 'I got it!' shouted Leo with a big happy grin. Taking turns and passing the ball back and forth was the most fun game in the whole wide world. They played all morning long, laughing under the bright blue sky. When it was time to go home for lunch, Leo gave the ball one last gentle hug. Playing together meant sharing, and sharing meant double the fun every single day.

stories.title: Sammy and the Stripey Ball
stories.text: Inside the cozy yellow playroom, Sammy the puppy was having a wonderful time. He had a brand new ball with bright blue and yellow stripes. It was round like the sun and bounced on the soft rug with a soft thump-thump sound. Sammy held the stripey ball between his paws. Over by the toy chest, his little sister Pip the kitten was sitting very patiently. Pip blinked her big green eyes and meowed softly, 'Pass the ball to me, Sammy! Let us play together.' Sammy wagged his tail from side to side. He loved his sister very much, and he loved sharing his favorite toys. Sammy took a deep breath, aimed carefully with his nose, and gave the stripey ball a gentle tap with his paw. Roll, roll, roll went the ball across the cozy floor. It traveled right up to Pip's tiny paws. Pip scooped up the ball and did a happy little dance. 'You passed it so nicely, Sammy! You are wonderful at sharing!' cheered Pip. Sammy felt so proud and happy inside. He gave a joyful bark. Playing together and waiting for your turn is such a wonderful way to play. Then, Pip rolled the stripey ball back across the floor. 'Here it comes back to you, Sammy!' she called out. Sammy waited patiently, keeping his eyes right on the ball. Catch! He scooped it up with his paws. 'I caught it!' he barked happily. They took turns passing the ball back and forth, one time for Sammy, and one time for Pip. Playing together was the best part of the whole day in the cozy playroom.

stories.title: The Backyard Ball Game
stories.text: The afternoon sun was shining brightly over the backyard garden, filling the air with the sweet smell of flowers. Oliver the bunny hopped out onto the soft grass, holding a light, spongy blue ball. It was just the right size for his little paws. Nearby, his friend Lily the bunny was resting under the shade of a big green leaf. Lily looked up and waved her long ears. 'Pass the ball to me, Oliver! Let us play a catch game!' Oliver smiled a big bunny smile. He loved playing catch with Lily. Oliver held the blue ball tightly, then he used his strong back legs to give it a gentle nudge. The soft blue ball bounced merrily across the grass, making a tiny boing sound with every hop. It rolled right up to Lily's cozy spot. Lily caught the ball gently with her paws and did a happy little hop. 'Wonderful pass, Oliver! You are doing such a great job sharing!' praised Lily. Oliver twitched his pink nose happily. It felt so good to share and make his friend smile. 'Now it is your turn to pass it back!' Oliver called out in his sweet voice. Lily rolled the spongy ball back across the garden path. It came rolling right toward Oliver's toes. Oliver stopped the ball with his paw and scooped it up safely. 'Got it!' he cheered. Back and forth went the blue ball, rolling through the sunshine and the gentle breeze. They practiced taking turns, waiting patiently, and cheering for each other. Playing together made their sunny afternoon feel magical, full of friendship, giggles, and fun.

stories.title: The Big Red Bouncy Ball
stories.text: Leo loves his big red bouncy ball. It is round like the warm sun and bounces up, up, up into the sky. Today, Leo is playing in the soft green grass with his puppy dog, Pip. Pip has floppy ears and a tail that wags fast when he is happy. Leo sits down on the cool grass and rolls the big red ball gently. He looks right at Pip and says, 'Pass the ball to me, Pip!' Pip gives a little happy bark. Woof! Pip uses his little black nose to give the ball a tiny nudge. Boop! The ball rolls right back to Leo’s toes. 'Yay! Good job, Pip!' Leo claps his hands together and smiles big. Sharing is so much fun, and playing together makes Leo’s heart feel warm and happy. Now it is Leo’s turn to roll the ball again. He holds it tight in his small hands, takes a deep breath, and gets ready. 'Ready, set, go!' whispers Leo. He gives the ball a soft, gentle push across the grass. Whee! The ball rolls through the clover and stops right near Pip’s paws. Pip wags his tail even faster now. He is so proud of his game with Leo. They play back and forth for a long, sunny time. Rolling the ball, waiting for a turn, and saying kind words makes playtime wonderful. Leo learns that taking turns is a wonderful way to show love to his furry best friend. Every time Pip sends the ball back, Leo cheers loudly. 'Pass the ball to me!' is such a magic phrase. It brings smiles and giggles all afternoon long. When the sun starts to dip low in the sky, Leo gives the big red ball one last hug. He knows they can play this wonderful game again tomorrow. What a lovely day of sharing and playing together.

stories.title: Mia and the Sparkly Star Ball
stories.text: Mia has a very special toy. It is a sparkly star ball that catches the bright morning light and twinkles like magic. Mia loves to play in her cozy living room with her big brother, Sam. Sam is sitting on the big yellow rug, ready to play too. Mia holds the sparkly star ball close to her tummy. She wants to play a game of catch with Sam. 'Look at my star ball, Sam!' she says in her sweetest voice. Sam smiles a warm, gentle smile and opens his arms wide. 'I see it, Mia! I am ready!' Mia sits criss-cross applesauce on the soft rug. She aims carefully with her tiny hands. She wants to share her favorite toy. 'Pass the ball to me, Mia!' cheers Sam, encouraging her with a happy wave. Mia takes a deep breath, counts to three in her head, and gives the ball a gentle push. Roll, roll, roll goes the sparkly star ball across the rug. It stops right in front of Sam’s hands. Sam catches it easily and laughs with joy. 'You did it! Amazing rolling, Mia!' praises Sam. Mia claps her hands together and giggles. She feels so proud of herself for sharing nicely. Now it is Sam’s turn to share. He holds the sparkly star ball and rolls it right back to his little sister. 'Pass the ball to me, Sam!' Mia says happily whenever it is her turn to catch. They practice taking turns over and over again. Sharing makes the game twice as fun. Mia learns that playing together means everyone gets a turn to play and smile. The sparkling ball goes back and forth across the room like a tiny shooting star. When mommy calls them for snack time, Mia gives the ball a gentle final hug. What a wonderful morning of playing, sharing, and loving teamwork with her brother.

stories.title: The Garden Ball Game
stories.text: The garden is full of bright yellow daisies and buzzing bumblebees. Toby is sitting on the warm patio with his favorite blue stripey ball. The blue ball is just the right size for Toby’s little hands. Grandma is sitting nearby in her rocking chair, smiling a sweet, cozy smile. Toby wants to play a fun game with Grandma in the garden. He holds the blue stripey ball tightly and stands up tall. 'Grandma, look what I have!' Toby calls out happily. Grandma looks over her glasses and nods. 'Oh, a wonderful blue ball, Toby! Would you like to play catch with me?' Toby nods his head up and down with excitement. 'Yes, please!' Toby takes two steps back so he has plenty of room. He holds the ball against his chest. Then, he gently tosses the blue ball through the air toward Grandma. Whee! The ball travels in a little arc and lands softly in Grandma’s lap. Grandma catches it and gives a joyful chuckle. 'Wonderful throw, my sweet boy!' she says. Toby beams with pride, showing all his teeth in a big, happy grin. Now it is Grandma’s turn to send the ball back. She gently rolls the blue stripey ball across the smooth patio stones. It glides smoothly toward Toby. Toby waits patiently for the ball to reach him, just like a big boy. 'Pass the ball to me!' Toby remembers to say, practicing his best sharing words. Grandma smiles lovingly at his polite manners. Toby stops the ball with his little shoes and picks it right up. They take turns tossing and rolling the ball all morning long. Playing together in the garden makes Toby feel so safe, loved, and happy. When it is time for lunch, Toby gently places the ball in its basket. He cannot wait to play his favorite ball game with Grandma again very soon.

stories.title: Maya's Big Red Ball
stories.text: Maya stood on the soft green grass in her backyard. The warm sun was giving her big, happy hugs. In her hands, she held a big, shiny red ball. It was round like the sun and bounced with a happy boing-boing sound. Across the yard stood her little brother, Leo. Leo reached out his tiny hands and giggled. Maya took a deep breath. She remembered the special game they loved to play together. It was time for a fun sharing game. Maya shouted with a big smile, 'Pass the ball to me, Leo!' Wait, no, Leo was waiting for Maya to share. Maya said, 'Here it comes!' She squeezed the big red ball and gave it a gentle push with her hands. Roll, roll, roll went the big red ball across the green grass. It rolled right past a little daisy flower. It rolled right past a tiny resting ladybug. Then, it bumped right into Leo's soft shoes. Leo let out a loud, joyful squeak. He scooped up the ball and gave it a big hug. 'Yay!' cheered Maya, clapping her hands together. 'You got it!' Leo tried to push the ball back. He rolled it all the way back to Maya's toes. Maya caught it tightly. 'Good job sharing, Leo!' Maya praised her little brother with a high-five. They took turns rolling the ball back and forth. Roll to Leo. Roll to Maya. Every time the ball moved, they giggled louder and louder. Sharing was such a wonderful way to play together outside. The sun smiled down on the happy siblings as they played their favorite rolling game all afternoon long. They felt so proud of being such good sharers.

stories.title: The Playground Puppy
stories.text: At the corner of the busy playground, a fluffy yellow dog named Barnaby trotted over to the sandbox. Barnaby had floppy ears and a tail that wagged non-stop, like a happy little windmill. In his mouth, Barnaby carried a bright yellow bouncy ball. It was just the right size for little hands to hold. Sam and Lily were sitting in the sand, building tall, sandy castles. When they saw Barnaby, their eyes lit up with excitement. Barnaby dropped the yellow ball right near Sam's red bucket. 'Woof!' barked Barnaby, nudging the ball with his wet black nose. Lily pointed at the ball and clapped her hands together. 'Look! Barnaby wants to play catch!' she said happily. Sam picked up the yellow ball. It felt warm from the sunny afternoon. Sam knew just what to do. He wanted to be a very good friend to the playful puppy. Sam held the ball out high. 'Pass the ball to me, Barnaby!' Sam called out in a gentle, singing voice. Barnaby gave a happy bark and sat down on his furry bottom. Sam gave the ball a soft toss through the air. Whew! The ball sailed in a little arc and landed right on the grass near Barnaby's paws. Barnaby trotted over, grabbed the ball gently, and wagged his tail even faster. 'Good catch, Barnaby!' cheered Lily, clapping her hands. Barnaby brought the ball right back to them, dropping it softly in the sand. Sam and Lily took turns tossing the ball, and Barnaby happily fetched it every single time. Playing together with their furry friend made their hearts feel warm and full of joy.

stories.title: Bear's Cozy Indoor Catch
stories.text: Outside, the rain was going pitter-patter against the windowpane. Tap, tap, tap, went the little raindrops. Inside the cozy living room, Oliver and his favorite stuffed toy, Brown Bear, sat on the soft blue rug. Oliver had a squishy blue foam ball that was super soft and safe for indoor play. It was as soft as a marshmallow and bounced very quietly on the carpet. Oliver wanted to practice his throwing and catching skills. He propped Brown Bear up against the big sofa pillows so the bear could sit up straight. Brown Bear had button eyes that twinkled in the warm lamp light. Oliver held the squishy blue ball tightly in both hands. He looked right at Brown Bear's fuzzy paws. 'Are you ready, Brown Bear?' Oliver whispered softly. Oliver pulled his hands back and gave the ball a gentle push. Thud, thud went the ball as it traveled across the blue rug. It rolled right up to Brown Bear's plush paws. Oliver clapped his hands together with a big grin. 'Good job, Brown Bear!' Oliver cheered loudly, using an encouraging voice. Since Brown Bear couldn't move by himself, Oliver crawled over to the bear. He picked up the ball and placed it right back into the bear's fuzzy paws. Then Oliver scooted backward, sitting criss-cross applesauce on the floor. 'Now, pass the ball to me, please!' Oliver said politely, pretending to be the bear talking back in a deep, silly voice. Oliver gently nudged the ball toward himself. He caught it with a happy hug. 'I got it!' Oliver laughed, feeling so proud of his wonderful imagination. Playing indoor catch on a rainy day was so much fun.

stories.title: The Big Red Ball in the Sunshine
stories.text: Leo the little lion loves playing outside in the warm, sunny yard. Today, Leo has a big, shiny red ball. It bounces up and down. Boing! Boing! Boing! Leo holds the ball tight in his paws. He looks across the soft green grass and sees his very best friend, Mia the monkey, sitting near the sandbox. Leo wants to share the fun. Sharing is such a wonderful thing to do! Leo smiles a big, happy smile and calls out, 'Pass the ball to me, Leo!' Wait, no, Mia says, 'Pass the ball to me, please!' Leo giggles. He knows just what to do. Leo takes a big step forward. He looks right at Mia's friendly hands, which are open and ready to catch. With a gentle push, Leo rolls the big red ball across the grass. Roll, roll, roll! The ball goes straight to Mia. Mia catches it safely and claps her hands with joy. 'Yay! You did it, Leo! Great pass!' Mia cheers. Leo feels so proud inside his heart. Passing the ball feels amazing because it makes playing together twice as fun. Now it is Mia's turn. Mia holds the ball and gets ready. Leo opens his little hands wide and waits right where he is. He is ready to catch. 'Pass the ball to me!' Leo says happily. Mia gives the ball a gentle push, and it rolls right back into Leo's waiting paws. Catch! Wow, what a wonderful game of teamwork. Leo and Mia take turns rolling the ball back and forth, laughing and playing together in the lovely sunshine. Every time they pass the ball, they say nice words and give each other high-fives. Playing together is the best part of the whole day. Leo learns that sharing a toy makes the fun grow bigger and bigger for everyone. What a happy day in the sunny yard.

stories.title: Pip's Soft Bunny Hop
stories.text: Inside the cozy playroom, Pip the bunny has a lovely, fluffy blue ball. It is super soft and squishy, perfect for little hands. Pip sits on the soft polka-dot rug. Over by the toy chest, Pip's dear friend Oliver the bear is sitting down. Oliver loves the blue ball too. Pip wants to play a special game with Oliver. The game is all about taking turns and sharing. Pip holds the squishy ball close to his tummy. He takes a deep breath and gets ready. Oliver opens his big, furry paws wide. Oliver says in a gentle voice, 'Pass the ball to me, Pip!' Pip nods his head up and down. 'Okay, Oliver! Here it comes!' Pip gives the ball a gentle little toss through the air. Whee! The soft blue ball flies gently over the rug and lands right in Oliver's lap. Thud! Oliver hugs the ball tight and smiles from ear to ear. 'Thank you so much, Pip! That was a wonderful pass!' Oliver says with a happy rumble. Pip does a little happy hop on the rug. He loves making his friend smile. Now it is Oliver's turn to share. Oliver holds the soft blue ball and looks at Pip. Pip sits up tall, opens his little paws, and waits patiently. Pip says, 'Pass the ball to me, Oliver!' Oliver gives a gentle push, sending the ball rolling across the floor. Roll, roll, roll! Pip catches it safely right away. 'Yay! Good catch!' Oliver cheers. They play this lovely game over and over again. Passing the ball teaches them how to share and care for each other. The playroom is filled with giggles and warmth. Pip and Oliver are the best of friends, and they know that playing together makes every single moment bright and beautiful.

stories.title: Sammy's Starry Playground Game
stories.text: The afternoon breeze is cool and sweet at the neighborhood park. Sammy the puppy is wearing his favorite yellow shoes. Sammy is holding a bright yellow bouncy ball that has little white stars painted all over it. It looks just like a tiny piece of the sky! Sammy runs over to the green slide. His friend Bella the bunny is waiting by the sandbox. Bella loves the star ball. Sammy stops, stands nice and tall, and holds the ball with both paws. He knows that playing together means sharing with a friend. Bella holds out her paws, making a cozy little basket with her hands. Bella calls out sweetly, 'Pass the ball to me, Sammy!' Sammy's tail wags fast and happy. 'I am going to pass it now!' Sammy says. He takes a little step and gently rolls the star ball across the smooth pavement. Roll, roll, go! The star ball spins around and around, glittering in the afternoon light. It goes straight toward Bella. Bella cups her paws and scoops up the ball. 'Got it! Thank you, Sammy!' Bella says with a joyful cheer. Sammy claps his paws together. He feels so proud of his good sharing skills. Now it is Bella's turn to share the starry ball. Sammy backs up a few steps to give plenty of room. He opens his hands wide and gets ready. Sammy says, 'Pass the ball to me, Bella!' Bella smiles brightly and gives the ball a gentle kick with her foot. Tap! The ball rolls smoothly back across the ground toward Sammy. Sammy bends down and scoops it up into his arms. 'Hooray! Great pass!' Sammy shouts with glee. They take turns passing the star ball back and forth, practicing their coordination and having so much fun. Sharing makes their friendship grow stronger every day. Sammy and Bella smile, knowing that playing together is the most wonderful gift in the whole wide world.

rhymes.title: Little Hands Ready
rhymes.text:
Hold the big red bouncy ball,
Roll it gently down the hall.
Look at me and count to three,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Round and round it rolls so fast,
Catch it safely at the last.
Up and down and in the air,
Throwing catches everywhere!

Step a little closer now,
Make a happy puppy bow.
Hold your hands out nice and wide,
Keep the yellow ball inside.

Now we laugh and clap and play,
Having fun throughout the day.
Drop it in the basket, wee!
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: The Friendly Bounce
rhymes.text:
Bouncing, bouncing on the floor,
Rolling right up to the door.
Take the ball and take a stand,
Hold it tightly in your hand.

Time to share and time to play,
We are having fun today.
Point your finger, bend your knee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Whoops a daisy, watch it go,
Send it fast or send it slow.
Catching is a special treat,
Stamping happy little feet.

Round the circle, take a turn,
This is how we share and learn.
Smile and shout a joyful 'whee!'
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Roll It, Catch It
rhymes.text:
Bright blue ball of shiny blue,
Now I want to share with you.
Sit criss-cross upon the mat,
Give the fuzzy ball a pat.

Push it gently on the floor,
Send it sliding out the door.
Watch it travel happily,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Grab it with your tiny hands,
Just like in the circus lands.
Hold it high above your head,
Time to march instead!

Now we pass it side to side,
With our arms stretched open wide.
 Shout hurray and shout out 'whee!'
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Sunny Day Toss
rhymes.text:
Golden sun is shining down,
No one wears a sleepy frown.
Take the yellow bouncy ball,
Catch it when I give a call.

Softly toss it through the air,
Catch it gently with great care.
One, two, three and off we go,
Throw it high or throw it low.

Now you have it in your grip,
Do a little wiggle flip.
Turn around and count to three,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Sharing toys is so much fun,
We are playing everyone.
Give a cheer so loud and free,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: The Happy Circle Game
rhymes.text:
We are sitting in a ring,
Clapping hands and maids who sing.
Take the polka-dotted sphere,
Bring it close and hold it near.

Give a push and let it glide,
Across the carpet, far and wide.
Open up your arms so free,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Tick-tock goes the passing clock,
Steady as a steady rock.
Catch it right inside your lap,
Give it quick a little tap.

Now the game is almost done,
Wasn't playing oh so fun?
Wave goodbye and shout out 'whee!'
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Little Hands Ready
rhymes.text:
Hold the big red bouncy ball,
Roll it softly down the hall.
Stand up straight and count to three,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Catch it gently in your hand,
Stand upon the magic land.
Give a giggle, give a shout,
That is what this game's about!

Round and round the circle goes,
Right down to your little toes.
Throw it high up in the air,
Catch it safely over there.

Time to roll it back again,
Just like all our special friends.
Pass the ball and give a cheer,
Playing games is joyful here!

rhymes.title: Bounce and Play Today
rhymes.text:
See the yellow rubber ball,
Bouncing softly by the wall.
Open up your arms so wide,
Keep the happy smiles inside.

Take a step and take a bend,
Give it to your tiny friend.
Pass the ball across the floor,
Then we will go ask for more.

Tap it gently with your knee,
Show the shiny ball to me.
Push it forward, let it go,
Watch it travel nice and slow.

Clap your hands and stamp your feet,
Playing together is so sweet.
Pass the ball and shout out loud,
Make us all so very proud!

rhymes.title: Rolling Down the Track
rhymes.text:
Blue ball, green ball, shiny bright,
Catching every ray of light.
Hold it tight and do not drop,
Wait a second, then we stop.

Bend your knees and make a arch,
Marching like a little march.
Pass the ball to waiting hands,
Bestest game in all the lands.

Send it zooming down the track,
Catch it when it bounces back.
Share the fun with everyone,
Playing games is so much fun.

Now the game is almost through,
I am so proud of what you do.
Pass the ball one final time,
Listen to our happy rhyme!

rhymes.title: Catch It If You Can
rhymes.text:
Pitter-patter goes the feet,
Running down the playroom street.
Hold the spotted polka ball,
Standing tall against the wall.

Look at me and look at you,
See the fun things we can do.
Pass the ball and take a turn,
That is how we play and learn.

Throw it low or throw it high,
Reaching upward to the sky.
Catch it with a happy grin,
Let the winning game begin.

Share the toys and share the space,
Smiles upon each little face.
Pass the ball with love and glee,
Always share your toys with me!

rhymes.title: The Friendly Circle Game
rhymes.text:
Sit in circle on the floor,
We do not need any more.
Take the purple bouncy sphere,
Glad that everybody's here.

Roll it left and roll it right,
Holding onto it so tight.
Pass the ball and say hello,
Watch the little center glow.

Give a push and let it slide,
Feeling happy deep inside.
Catch it safely in your lap,
Give yourself a little clap.

Time to pack the toys away,
For another brand new day.
Pass the ball and wave goodbye,
Underneath the big blue sky!

rhymes.title: The Big Red Ball
rhymes.text:
See the big red ball so bright,
Holding it with all your might.
Take a step and count to three,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Roll it low or toss it high,
Watch it gently through the sky.
Clap your hands and shout out glee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Now you catch it in your lap,
Give yourself a happy clap.
Ready, steady, look and see,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Round and round the circle goes,
Right down to your little toes.
Laugh and play so happily,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Sunny Day Toss
rhymes.text:
Sun is shining in the sky,
Watch the yellow sphere go by.
Give a smile and bend your knee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Softly roll it on the floor,
Let us roll it more and more.
Happy sounds for you and me,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Catch it fast and hold it tight,
Everything is feeling right.
Jump up high and shout out wee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Time to play our favorite game,
Everybody does the same.
Friends are smiling as can be,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Bounce and Catch
rhymes.text:
Bounce the ball upon the ground,
Hear the happy bouding sound.
Stretch your arms out wide and free,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Little hands can catch it fast,
Hold it close and make it last.
Now you share it joyfully,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Spin it round just like a top,
Make sure that it does not drop.
Sing along our little tune,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Night or day we love to play,
Smiling all the livelong day.
Best of friends are we, you see,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Roll, Roll, Roll
rhymes.text:
Roll the ball across the rug,
Give your teddy bear a hug.
Look at you and look at me,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Push it gently with your hand,
Bestest player in the land.
Dance around so merrily,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Catch the ball and take your turn,
That is how we play and learn.
Cheer aloud with energy,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Time to pack the toys away,
We had such a lovely day.
One more toss before we flee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Little Hands, Big Joy
rhymes.text:
Little hands can toss so far,
 Shining like a little star.
Count the numbers one, two, three,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Catch it gently on the fly,
Wave a friendly hand goodbye.
Giggle, wiggle, run with glee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Hold it steady, do not fall,
You are great at playing ball.
Singing out so cheerfully,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Now the game is nearly done,
We had such amazing fun.
Say hello and hug the tree,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Little Hands Ready
rhymes.text:
Hold the big red ball so bright,
Hold it tight with all your might.
Look at me and count to three,
Pass the ball right over here to me!

Roll it on the rug so low,
Watch it slide and watch it go.
Catch it with a happy shout,
That is what this game's about.

Now I hold it in my hands,
Standing safely where I stand.
Ready for another try,
Send it spinning through the sky.

Give a grin and give a cheer,
Playing with my playmate here.
Sharing toys is so much fun,
Joy for everyone is done.

rhymes.title: Roll and Catch
rhymes.text:
Sit down on the fluffy floor,
We can play this game some more.
Got a shiny plastic ball,
Big and bouncy, round and tall.

Roll it gently on the ground,
Hear the happy rolling sound.
Pass the ball to me, my friend,
Right up to the very end.

Got it! I am holding tight,
Now my smile is extra bright.
Time to send it back to you,
Just like happy birdies do.

Push it softly with your toes,
See where now the red ball goes.
We can play the live-long day,
Laughing all our cares away.

rhymes.title: Bouncy Balloon
rhymes.text:
Up and down the ball will go,
Faster now or nice and slow.
Keep your eyes upon the prize,
Open up your sleepy eyes.

Pass the ball to me right now,
Take a bow and say meow!
Catch it in your lap so sweet,
Sitting nicely on your seat.

Throw it high up in the air,
Catch it falling everywhere.
Pass the ball to me, oh please,
Breeze is blowing through the trees.

Now we share the shiny toy,
Every girl and every boy.
Clap your hands and sing our song,
Singing right along-along.

rhymes.title: Circle of Friends
rhymes.text:
Sit in circle on the mat,
Listen to the pitter-pat.
Pass the ball around the ring,
Listen to the song we sing.

Pass the ball to me today,
Help me learn the proper way.
Take a turn and do not pout,
That is what we're all about.

Got it safe inside my grip,
Hope it doesn't take a slip!
Push it back across the floor,
Let's go rolling round some more.

Friends together, hand in hand,
Happiest kids in all the land.
Pass the ball and count to ten,
Let us play the game again.

rhymes.title: Toss and Giggle
rhymes.text:
Giggle giggle, time to play,
Bright and sunny is the day.
Hold the polka-dot delight,
Hold it safely, hold it tight.

Pass the ball to me, my sweet,
Stamp your little toddler feet.
Toss it softly through the air,
Catch it sitting on the chair.

Oops it tumbled on the rug,
Give the happy ball a hug!
Pass the ball to me once more,
Rolling across the wooden floor.

Now we both are smiling wide,
Sitting closely side by side.
Sharing is a lovely treat,
Making playtime so complete.

rhymes.title: The Big Red Ball
rhymes.text:
See the big red bouncy ball,
Rolling down the playroom hall!
Hold your hands out wide and wide,
Catch it safely close inside.

Now I hold it in my hands,
Ready for our newest plans.
One, two, three, let's count to four,
Roll it right across the floor.

Pass the ball to me, my friend,
Right up to the very end.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
This is how we learn to play.

Take a bow and give a cheer,
Playing with our small balls here!

rhymes.title: Little Hands Waiting
rhymes.text:
Little hands are waiting here,
Waiting for the ball, my dear.
Show me where your fingers stay,
Ready for a game today.

Toss it high or roll it low,
Watch the shiny circle go.
Catch it tight and hold it fast,
Make the happy moment last.

Pass the ball to me so sweet,
Right here at my little feet.
Now I take a little turn,
That is how we share and learn.

Back and forth the red ball flies,
Underneath the sunny skies!

rhymes.title: Roll and Catch
rhymes.text:
Roll the ball across the rug,
Give the happy toy a hug.
Now it is your turn to share,
Throw it gently in the air.

Catch it, catch it if you can,
Running like a little fan.
Keep your eyes upon the prize,
Wonder shining in your eyes.

Pass the ball to me right now,
Take a happy toddler bow.
We are partners in the game,
Shouting out each other's name.

Round and round the playtime goes,
Tickling our little toes.

rhymes.title: Bounce to My Friend
rhymes.text:
Bounce the ball and watch it spring,
Like a happy bird on wing.
Push it gently with your hand,
Bestest player in the land.

Wait your turn and count to three,
Look and smile right back at me.
Ready, steady, off it goes,
Right up to your tiny nose.

Pass the ball to me today,
We can share our favorite way.
Catch it with a joyful shout,
That is what our game is about.

Spin around and clap your hands,
Happiest in all the lands.

rhymes.title: The Friendly Circle
rhymes.text:
Sit in circle on the floor,
We do not need any more.
Just a ball of shiny blue,
Waiting here for me and you.

Push it softly down the lane,
Like a choo-choo on a train.
Grab it quickly with a grin,
Let the circle game begin.

Pass the ball to me and smile,
We will keep it for a while.
Now I roll it back to you,
Doing what big children do.

Time to pack the toys away,
We will share another day!

rhymes.title: The Big Red Ball
rhymes.text:
See the big red ball so bright,
Holding it with all your might.
Take a step and count to three,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Roll it low or toss it high,
Watch it gently through the sky.
Laugh and giggle with great glee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Catch it neatly in your hands,
Nod your head and clap your bands.
Now you're smiling happily,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Round and round the circle goes,
Right down to your little toes.
Time to shout out loud and free,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Ready, Set, Roll!
rhymes.text:
Sitting on the playroom rug,
Giving little bears a hug.
Grab the sphere and wait and see,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Push it softly on the floor,
Rolling right up to the door.
1 and 2 and 3 and D,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Up above your curly head,
Standing safely by the bed.
Now you drop it playfully,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Catch it fast and hold it tight,
Everything is feeling right.
Say hooray for you and me,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Bounce, Catch, and Pass
rhymes.text:
Bounce the yellow ball today,
Time to have some active play.
Show me how you bend your knee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Catch it with a happy grin,
Let the funny game begin.
Send it zooming across the sea,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Spin around and tap your shoe,
Tell me what you love to do.
Share the toy so joyfully,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Now we put it on the shelf,
Doing such a job yourself.
Give a clap of victory,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Little Hands, Big Toss
rhymes.text:
Little hands can hold a ball,
Big or tiny, short or tall.
Look at how it flies so free,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Aim it straight into my arms,
Safe away from any harms.
You are growing strong and free,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Pat it gently like a cat,
Look at that, oh look at that!
Smile as bright as you can be,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Now the game is almost done,
We have had so much good fun.
Wave goodbye and count to three,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Roll It to Your Friend
rhymes.text:
Sit across upon the floor,
We will play a game and more.
Keep your eyes right here to see,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Push it with a gentle shove,
Send a little bit of love.
As happy as a bumblebee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Catch it right inside your lap,
Give your happy hands a clap.
Now you slide it on your knee,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Greatest player in the land,
Holding magic in your hand.
Shout a happy loud decree,
Pass the ball right back to me!

rhymes.title: Little Hands Ready
rhymes.text:
Hold the big red ball so bright,
Hold it tight and hold it right!
Roll it down the living floor,
Roll it right up to my door.

Now I catch it with a cheer,
Now I hold the big ball near.
Take a step and count to three,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Back and forth we play the game,
Saying every happy name.
Up so high and down so low,
Watch the bouncing red ball go.

Clap your hands and shout hooray,
This is such a fun-filled day!
Give a wiggle, bend your knee,
Pass the ball to me, oh me!

rhymes.title: Roll and Catch
rhymes.text:
Sit down on the carpet square,
We can play and we can share.
Take the yellow ball of sun,
Now our game has just begun.

Push it softly on the ground,
Hear the happy rolling sound.
Catch it fast with fingers wide,
Keep the yellow ball inside.

Take a turn and send it back,
Right along the living track.
Smile and giggle, play along,
Sing our little rolling song.

Drop it softly, catch it fast,
Make the happy moments last.
One, two, three and off it goes,
Right down to your little toes.

rhymes.title: The Friendly Bounce
rhymes.text:
Bounce the ball up in the air,
Bounce it here and bounce it there.
Look at how it leaps and springs,
Like a bird with happy wings.

Catch it gently in your hand,
Best little player in the land.
Now it is my turn to play,
While we sing our cheerful lay.

Pass the ball across the space,
With a big smile on your face.
Round and round the circle goes,
Stopping right at tiny toes.

Ready steady, here it flies,
Underneath the sunny skies.
Catch it quick and shout out glee,
Pass the ball to me, yes me!

rhymes.title: Circle of Friends
rhymes.text:
Sit in a circle on the mat,
Have a little friendly chat.
Hold the shiny sphere so round,
Keep it safely off the ground.

Give a gentle little shove,
Send it with a bit of love.
Watch it rolling on its way,
To brighten up our happy day.

Reach your little fingers out,
Hear the happy children shout.
Grab it tight and hold it fast,
Look at how the ball has passed!

Now you give a gentle push,
Quiet as a sleeping bush.
Back and forth for all to see,
Pass the ball right back to me.

rhymes.title: Sunny Day Toss
rhymes.text:
Step outside into the sun,
Time to have some active fun.
Hold the bouncing ball of blue,
Waiting here to play with you.

Toss it softly through the air,
Catch it safely over there.
Spin around and turn about,
With a happy little shout.

Now it's time to send it back,
Along the grassy garden track.
Aim it straight and make it fly,
Up beneath the open sky.

Catch it with a happy grin,
Let the tossing game begin.
One and two and joyful three,
Pass the ball to me!

rhymes.title: Little Hands Ready
rhymes.text:
Hold the big red ball so bright,
Hold it tight with all your might.
Look at me and count to three,
Pass the ball right over here to me!

Roll it on the floor so low,
Watch it spin and watch it go.
Catch it with a happy shout,
That is what we're playing about!

Now I hold it in my hands,
Standing safely where I stand.
Time to send it back to you,
Let us see what we can do.

Push it softly, let it slide,
Catch it with a arms open wide.
Playing games is such great fun,
Happy playing everyone!

rhymes.title: Bounce and Catch
rhymes.text:
Bounce the ball up in the air,
Throw it lightly, do not scare.
Catch it quick before it drops,
Right here where the music stops.

Now you have it, hold it fast,
Make this joyful moment last.
Pass the ball to me, my friend,
Round and round and round again.

Here it comes across the floor,
 Rolling right up to my door.
I am ready, waiting here,
With a happy little cheer.

Take your turn and share the play,
We will have a sunny day.
Pass the ball and smile and grin,
Everybody can help win!

rhymes.title: The Friendly Circle Game
rhymes.text:
Sit in a circle on the rug,
Give the giant ball a hug.
Roll it softly, do not throw,
Watch the colors as they go.

Pass the ball to me, I say,
We are learning how to play.
Catching things is lots of fun,
Sharing makes it good for everyone.

Now it rests inside my lap,
While I do a little clap.
Send it back across the space,
With a smile upon your face.

Round and round the circle goes,
Stopping right at little toes.
Pass the ball and shout out loud,
We are such a happy crowd!

rhymes.title: Roll, Roll, Roll Today
rhymes.text:
Roll the yellow ball around,
Keep it safely on the ground.
Look at me and wave your hand,
Bestest players in the land.

Pass the ball to me right now,
We can do it, holy cow!
Catch it nicely, hold it tight,
Everything is going right.

Push it gently towards my feet,
This is such a happy treat.
Now I have it in my hold,
As we watch the hours unfold.

Back and forth the ball will slide,
Playing right here side by side.
Pass the ball and laugh and play,
We love games on every day!

rhymes.title: Catch the Soft Blue Ball
rhymes.text:
Soft blue ball of fuzzy stuff,
Playing games is nevers tough.
Give a toss and give a cheer,
Now the happy time is here.

Pass the ball to me, oh please,
Catch it floating on the breeze.
Arms are open, fingers wide,
Joy is bouncing deep inside.

Got it now, I hold it high,
Reaching upward to the sky.
Time to share and take a turn,
This is how we grow and learn.

Send it back across the floor,
Roll it right up to my door.
Pass the ball with all your might,
Playing softly through the light!

rhymes.title: Little Hands Ready
rhymes.text:
Hold the big red bouncy ball,
Roll it gently down the hall.
Look at me and count to three,
Pass the ball right back to me!

Round and round it rolls so fast,
Catch it safely at the last.
Hold it up high in the air,
Throw it gently over there.

Now you have it, squeeze it tight,
Hold it up and shine so bright.
Ready, steady, let it go,
Send it flying nice and slow.

 Clap your hands and shout hooray,
This is how we love to play!
Pass the ball and share the fun,
Happy playing everyone!

rhymes.title: Roll and Catch
rhymes.text:
Sit down nicely on the rug,
Give the yellow ball a hug.
Now it is your turn to share,
Send it floating through the air.

Push it softly with your hand,
Bestest helper in the land.
Watch it rolling on the floor,
Right up to my open door.

Catch it quick and hold it fast,
Look how long the rolling last.
Ready now to do your part,
Play the game right from the heart.

Push it back across the space,
With a big smile on your face.
Pass the ball to me my friend,
We can play until the end.

rhymes.title: The Magic Bounce
rhymes.text:
Bounce the ball up to the sky,
Watch the pretty colors fly.
Hand it over, do not drop,
Make the bouncy movement stop.

Now we hold it palm to palm,
Singing out a happy psalm.
Pass the ball to me today,
This is how we learn to play.

Take a step and take a bend,
Give it to your special friend.
Roll it low or throw it high,
Wave a happy little bye.

Catching is a skill we share,
Showing that we really care.
Pass the ball so we can see,
Just how happy we can be.

rhymes.title: Circle Time Fun
rhymes.text:
Sit in circle on the ground,
Pass the shiny sphere around.
Hold it tight and do not fall,
Look at our sweet little ball.

Send it zooming like a train,
Out across the indoor lane.
Pass the ball to me right now,
We can do it with a bow.

Catch it, grasp it, hold it near,
Bring it to your mommy dear.
Now send back across the ring,
Hear the little children sing.

Back and forth the circle goes,
Tickling everybody's toes.
Pass the ball and take a turn,
This is how we play and learn.

rhymes.title: Ready, Set, Go!
rhymes.text:
Toss the ball into the air,
Catch it without any scare.
Pass the ball to me right now,
Listen to the happy cow.

Green and blue and shiny bright,
Holding onto it so tight.
Roll it quickly on the floor,
Right inside the playroom door.

Pick it up and lift it high,
Wave hello and say goodbye.
Pass the ball across the floor,
Let us play a little more.

Stomp your feet and turn around,
Put the ball back on the ground.
Pass the ball and share your smile,
We will play a little while.

rhymes.title: Roll and Catch
rhymes.text:
See the shiny big red ball,
Let us play a game for all.
Sit upon the soft playroom,
Chase away the heavy gloom.

Roll it gently on the floor,
Right up to the playroom door.
Watch it rolling fast and free,
Pass the ball right over me!

I am ready with my hands,
Just like in the story stands.
Catch it tight and hold it fast,
This fun game is made to last.

Now I roll it back to you,
We can do the things we do!

rhymes.title: Bounce High, Pass Low
rhymes.text:
Bounce the ball up to the sky,
Watch it gently floating high.
Catch it nicely in your lap,
Give your hands a happy clap.

Now it is time to share the fun,
Play together everyone.
Look at me and count to three,
Pass the ball to little me!

Here it comes across the space,
Smiles upon each little face.
Got it safely, safe and sound,
Sitting nicely on the ground.

Time to toss it back to you,
Playing catch is what we do!

rhymes.title: The Friendly Toss
rhymes.text:
Hold the yellow ball so tight,
Shining in the morning light.
We can play out in the yard,
Nothing here is very hard.

Take a step and bend your knee,
Throw the yellow ball to me.
Aim it nicely, soft and sweet,
Right up to my tiny feet.

I can catch it in my arms,
Safe away from any harms.
Now my turn to throw it back,
Right along the grassy track.

Round and round the game will go,
Faster now and sometimes slow.

rhymes.title: Kick and Pass
rhymes.text:
Bring the striped ball outside,
Where the gentle breezes glide.
Put it down upon the grass,
Watch the happy moments pass.

Give a gentle little kick,
Make your movements nice and quick.
Send it sliding down the tree,
Pass the ball right up to me!

I can stop it with my shoe,
Just like all the big kids do.
Now I aim it back your way,
All throughout the sunny day.

We are sharing every time,
Playing games is quite sublime.

rhymes.title: Circle of Friends
rhymes.text:
We are sitting in a ring,
Happy little birds that sing.
Pass the polka-dot delight,
Holding on with all our might.

Turn around and look and see,
Who is waiting patiently.
Shout a joyful little plea,
Pass the ball to me, oh me!

Catch it quick and giggle loud,
Standing proud among the crowd.
Roll it softly to your friend,
Games of sharing never end.

Everybody takes a turn,
That is how we play and learn.

stories.title: Sammy and the Shiny Snail
stories.text: Leo put on his bright yellow safari hat. It had a floppy brim and made him feel like a real explorer. Today, Leo was going on a backyard bug safari! He grabbed his favorite magnifying glass, which made everything look as big as a giant pancake. Step by step, Leo tiptoed onto the green grass. He bent down low, making his knees go creak-creak-creak like a sleepy door. "Let's find a tiny friend," Leo whispered with a big happy smile. Underneath a smooth, cool rock, something silver and sparkly caught his eye. It was Sammy the Snail! Sammy moved oh-so-slowly, carrying a little brown spiral house right on his back. Leo did not touch Sammy because bugs like gentle neighbors. Instead, Leo held his magnifying glass very still and whispered, "Good morning, little snail." Sammy wiggled his tiny eye-stalks, as if to say hello right back to the brave explorer. Leo felt so proud for being gentle and quiet. Being a bug safari explorer takes patience, and Leo had plenty of it. He watched Sammy glide across a green leaf, leaving a shiny silver trail behind him like magic. "You are wonderful, Sammy," Leo cheered softly. When it was time to go inside for snack time, Leo gave a polite wave to the garden. He knew Sammy and all the other tiny creatures would be right here waiting for his next big outdoor adventure. What a wonderful day to explore the backyard world!

stories.title: Maya and the Busy Bumblebee
stories.text: Maya clicked her shiny red explorer badge onto her shirt. Today was a very special day because the backyard was full of buzzing sounds. Maya held her clipboard and a yellow crayon. She was ready to draw every cool bug she could find. "Time for safari!" Maya cheered softly, opening the back screen door. The sun felt warm and cozy on her shoulders. Maya walked carefully past the garden hose and stopped by the tall yellow sunflowers. BZZZ! BZZZ! went a fluffy black and yellow bumblebee. Maya stood as still as a wooden fence post so she would not scare the buzzing visitor. The bee landed right on a soft flower petal, dancing in a circle to collect sweet golden pollen. Maya giggled quietly. She used her crayons to draw a fluffy bee on her paper, giving it big, happy wings. "Great job staying so still and calm, Maya!" she whispered to herself with positive pride. Being a kind explorer means giving bugs space to do their important work. The bumblebee buzzed happily, jumping from flower to flower, helping the garden grow big and strong. Maya felt so happy to watch nature up close. She learned that even the smallest bugs have very important jobs to do every single day. When the bee flew away toward the blue sky, Maya waved and smiled. Her safari page was filled with love and bright colors. What a super-duper explorer she was turning out to be!

stories.title: Oliver and the Crimson Ant
stories.text: Oliver zipped up his blue explorer vest. It had four big pockets for holding treasures like smooth pebbles and fallen leaves. Today, Oliver was on a mega bug safari near the old oak tree. He knelt down in the soft dirt, getting his knees a little bit dusty, which is the sign of a true adventurer. "Let's look low to the ground," Oliver said in his quiet detective voice. Right near a dandelion root, a busy line of red ants was marching along. One, two, three, four—they carried tiny green leaf bits like little circus performers hauling heavy flags. Oliver gasped in wonder. He did not step on them or poke them; instead, he watched their teamwork with wide, sparkling eyes. "Look at you go! You are so strong!" Oliver encouraged the hardworking ants in a sweet, gentle whisper. He tracked their path all the way to a tiny mound of sandy soil. The ants worked together, helping each other carry their loads inside their cozy underground home. Oliver clapped his hands together silently so he would not startle them. He felt wonderful inside for being such a caring and observant safari guide. Taking care of backyard friends meant respecting their busy day. Oliver stood up and dusted off his pants with a proud grin. He was learning so much about the wonderful world right outside his back door. Every little bug had a story, and Oliver was ready to listen to them all.

stories.title: Sammy and the Shining Snail
stories.text: Leo put on his biggest yellow sun hat and his sparkly green explorer vest. Today was a very special day because Leo was going on a backyard bug safari! He grabbed his trusty magnifying glass, which made everything look as big as a giant pancake. Step by tiny step, Leo crept over to the big wooden fence where the soft moss grew like a green carpet. 'Let's go find some tiny friends,' Leo whispered to his favorite stuffed bear, Barnaby, who was safely tucked into his backpack pocket. Suddenly, right on a smooth grey stone, Leo saw something shiny and wonderful. It was a little garden snail with a swirly-twirly brown shell on its back! The snail was moving oh-so-slowly, leaving a sparkly silver trail behind it in the warm sunshine. Leo gasped with happy excitement. He bent down real low, making sure not to make a sound that would scare his new friend. 'Good morning, Mr. Snail,' Leo said in his softest, kindest voice. 'You are doing a wonderful job exploring today.' Leo held his magnifying glass super steady and watched the snail stretch out its tiny feelers to say hello to the breeze. Leo felt so proud of himself for being gentle and patient. Waiting quietly lets the most magical things happen in nature! He gently patted the grass and whispered goodbye, ready for his next little adventure by the big garden hose. Being a kind explorer is the best feeling in the whole wide world, and Leo knew he was doing a super job taking care of all the tiny creatures in his own backyard.

stories.title: Mia's Busy Bee Discovery
stories.text: Mia tied her bright red shoelaces into double-knots because today she was an official backyard safari leader! She carried a small yellow bucket for collecting fallen leaves and pinecones. The sun was smiling down from the bright blue sky, warming Mia’s nose as she tip-toed across the soft, squishy lawn. 'Shh, shh, listen closely,' Mia whispered to herself. Bzzzzz! Bzzzzz! There was a happy buzzing sound coming from the patch of bright yellow dandelions near the old apple tree. Mia walked very softly, like a fluffy kitten on velvet paws, until she reached the golden flowers. Sitting right on top of a big dandelion was a busy little bumblebee with fuzzy yellow and black stripes. The bee was dancing from flower to flower, collecting sweet yellow dust on its tiny feet. Mia remembered to keep her hands behind her back, just like her mommy taught her. 'Look at you go, busy bee! You are working so hard!' Mia cheered softly, her face glowing with a warm, proud smile. She watched the bee zoom away toward the lovely pink roses by the porch. Mia clapped her hands gently, so happy she got to see such a wonderful helper in nature. Being gentle and respectful of all living things made Mia’s heart feel as big and bright as the sunshine. She picked up a smooth round pebble to remember this special moment and kept on walking her safari path with joy.

stories.title: The Ant Parade Adventure
stories.text: Toby marched across the backyard patio, wearing his shiny blue rain boots even though the ground was totally dry. He held a cardboard tube up to his eye like a telescope. 'Time for the great backyard bug safari!' Toby announced to the tall sunflowers. He crouched down near the garden bricks where the patio met the dirt. Right there, marching in a straight, busy line, was a whole parade of tiny black ants! They were carrying little bits of green leaf crumbs, working together like a super-strong construction crew. Toby sat down cross-legged on the warm grass, smiling from ear to ear. He didn't touch them; he just watched them go, step by tiny step. 'Left, right, left, right! Keep on going, little ants!' Toby encouraged them in a cheerful whisper. One ant stopped for a second, wiggled its little feelers, and then scurried right along to catch up with its friends. Toby felt so proud of his careful watching skills. Being a great explorer meant being a great watcher who respects every living creature, no matter how small they are. The sun felt cozy on his back, and the breeze tickled his nose. Toby gave the ants a friendly little wave goodbye as they disappeared under a smooth brown twig. He stood up tall, brushed the grass off his knees, and whispered, 'That was the best safari ever.' His heart was full of happy giggles as he skipped back inside for snack time.

stories.title: Sammy's Sneaky Snail Search
stories.text: Good morning, little explorer! Today is a very special day because we are going on a backyard bug safari. Are you ready for an adventure? First, every great explorer needs the right gear. Let us put on our imaginary safari hats, snap them under our chins, and grab our shiny magnifying glasses. Click, click! Now, tiptoe, tiptoe, tiptoe out the backdoor into the warm, green grass. Look down low near the flower bed. Do you see something moving ever so slowly? Wow, look at that! It is a tiny garden snail carrying its very own cozy spiral house on its back. Can you say hello to the snail? 'Hello, little snail!' Snails love the damp soil because it helps them slide smoothly. Let us squat down nice and low to watch it glide over a smooth green leaf. See how patient you are? Being gentle and quiet helps us see the most amazing secret things in nature. You are doing such a wonderful job observing our tiny outdoor neighbors today. The snail pokes out its tiny little horns, saying hello right back to you in its own quiet way. Look at you go, using your big listening ears and gentle eyes. After watching the snail finish its morning stroll, we stand up slowly and stretch our arms up high like tall trees reaching for the warm yellow sun. You are such a caring and brilliant nature explorer. Taking your time to notice the small wonders in the backyard makes you super special. Let us take one more deep breath of the fresh, sweet garden air. What a wonderful start to our bug safari adventure together today! You did an amazing job being so kind to our little shelled friend.

stories.title: The Bouncy Bumblebee's Busy Day
stories.text: Hello again, brave little bug hunter! Are you ready for stop number two on our backyard safari? Let us check our safari maps. Today, we are off to the bright yellow sunflower patch near the back fence. Buzz, buzz, buzz! Listen closely. Do you hear that happy humming sound coming from the petals? It is a fluffy little bumblebee wearing a fuzzy yellow and black striped coat. Look how hard it is working! The bee flies from flower to flower, collecting sweet yellow pollen on its tiny fuzzy legs. Can you buzz gently like a happy little bee? Let us buzz together: bzzzz, bzzzz! Bees are our very special insect friends because they help the flowers grow big and strong. We must remember to keep our hands safely in our pockets so the bee can do its important work without being disturbed. Look how good you are at keeping a safe, respectful distance while watching nature in action! Your eyes are as sharp as an eagle's. The bee dances in the warm afternoon breeze, dipping into a bright pink blossom and then zooming back up into the blue sky. You are learning so much about how all the creatures in the backyard help each other out. That is such a smart thing to notice. Let us give ourselves a big pat on the back for being such thoughtful and careful explorers. You are doing brilliantly! Now, let us flutter our arms like butterfly wings and float over to the old wooden tree trunk to see what else might be waiting for us in our magnificent backyard wonderland.

stories.title: Penny's Polite Roly-Poly Patrol
stories.text: Welcome to the final stop on our exciting backyard bug safari, superstar explorer! You have walked so carefully and paid such wonderful attention today. Let us kneel down by the big grey rock near the garden hose. Look underneath! If we lift the rock up very gently, like this... oh, look! There is a whole family of little grey roly-poly bugs resting in the cool shade. When they feel a little bit surprised, what do they do? They curl right up into tight little polka-dot balls to keep themselves safe! Can you curl up into a tiny round ball just like a roly-poly bug? Let us try: curl, curl, curl into a little ball! And now, pop back up with a big happy smile! Roly-polies are so helpful because they munch on old leaves and turn them into super food for the garden soil. Aren't nature's helpers just fascinating? When we are done looking at them, we place the big rock back down ever so gently to keep their cozy little home safe and dark again. You are such a kind, responsible, and caring friend to all the backyard bugs. Mommy and Daddy are so proud of the wonderful explorer you have become today. You showed patience, gentleness, and so much curiosity. Let us take a final bow together for a successful bug safari. Give yourself a huge hug. You did a fantastic job exploring the big, beautiful world right in your own backyard!

stories.title: Sammy's Sneaky Snail Search
stories.text: Sammy wakes up with a big stretch. Yawn! Today is a very special day. It is time for a backyard bug safari! Sammy puts on bright red shiny boots. Stomp, stomp, go the boots! Next, Sammy puts on a big yellow safari hat. Tap, tap, goes the hat on Sammy's head. You look just like a real explorer, Sammy! Safari gear is ready.
