Today was the day for a visit to the family doctor, and Leo was feeling a tiny bit nervous about what might happen. Mama knelt down to his level and gave him a comforting hug. "I know it can feel scary to visit the clinic when you are not feeling your best, Leo. But remember how brave you are? Let's take your special toy, Dr. Bear, and his play stethoscope so we can practice being the doctor first!" Leo brightened up just a little bit and ran to grab his favorite stuffed bear. In the living room, Leo sat on the fluffy rug and carefully wrapped Dr. Bear's toy stethoscope around his own neck just like a real medical professional. "Now, Dr. Bear, we are going to check everything to make sure you are okay," Leo said in his most important doctor voice. He pressed the plastic listening disk to Dr. Bear's furry paw. "Beep-boop! All clear!" Leo declared with a proud smile. Playing the game made the real medical visit feel much less mysterious and scary. When they arrived at the doctor's office, the friendly receptionist handed Leo a colorful sticker of a smiling dinosaur. Dr. Anita welcomed them into her brightly painted room, which was filled with fascinating animal posters. "Good morning, Leo and Dr. Bear!" Dr. Anita said cheerfully. "I hear you have a tickly nose today. May I use my special listening tool to check your breathing?" Leo remembered how he had been the doctor just a moment ago. He nodded bravely and held still like a statue. Dr. Anita gently placed the stethoscope against his chest. It felt cool for just a second, but then it tickled a little, making Leo giggle. "Your lungs sound like the wind in the trees," Dr. Anita praised warmly. "You are doing such a fantastic job taking care of your health today, Leo!" Leo beamed with absolute pride. He held Dr. Bear high in the air as they walked out of the clinic with their dinosaur sticker proudly displayed on Leo's shirt. Being brave was hard work, but Leo knew he could do anything with a little practice and his trusted friend by his side.

stories.title: Sammy's First Checkup
stories.text: Little Sammy Bunny was holding his favorite green blankie very tightly. Today was checkup day at Dr. Bear’s cozy clinic. Sammy’s tummy felt a little bit fluttery, just like a butterfly trying to fly out. Mommy Bunny gently rubbed Sammy’s soft ears and whispered, 'Dr. Bear is the kindest bear in the whole forest. He helps us stay big and strong.' When they walked into the bright, cheerful exam room, Dr. Bear smiled warmly. He had soft brown fur, round spectacles perched on his nose, and a shiny silver stethoscope hanging right around his neck. 'Hello there, little Sammy,' Dr. Bear said in a deep, rumbling, friendly voice. 'Are you ready for your special health adventure today?' Sammy nodded shyly and climbed up onto the big crinkly paper table. 'Now,' Dr. Bear said softly, holding up the cold-looking metal circle of his stethoscope, 'this is my magic listening tool. Would you like to touch it first?' Sammy reached out a tiny paw and tapped the cool metal. It wasn't scary at all! 'This is just a little chilly,' Dr. Bear explained with a reassuring wink, 'and it helps me hear the wonderful music your healthy body makes.' Sammy took a big, brave breath as Dr. Bear gently placed the round disk right against the center of his furry chest. 'Lub-dub, lub-dub!' Dr. Bear whispered happily, leaning in close. 'Hear that? That is your happy heart singing a sweet little song, Sammy! And it tells me you are growing up so wonderfully.' Sammy’s eyes went wide with wonder. A proud, happy smile spread across his little bunny face. He wasn't nervous anymore. Dr. Bear checked his knees, looked in his ears with a tiny light, and handed him a sparkly star sticker. Sammy clapped his paws together with absolute joy. He showed Mommy his sticker and whispered, 'My heart makes music!' Walking home, Sammy skipped happily, feeling so proud of his healthy, singing heart and his wonderful friend Dr. Bear.

stories.title: Leo Bear Learns to Listen
stories.text: Little Leo Bear was usually a very brave cub, but today he was the patient! It was time for his annual visit with Dr. Owl, the wisest doctor in the woodland. Leo held tightly to his shiny red toy truck as he sat on the exam table. The paper under him went crinkle-crackle whenever he wiggled his toes. Dr. Owl flew down softly, adjusting her round glasses and smiling with her beak. 'Good morning, little Leo,' hooted Dr. Owl gently. 'Are you ready to see how strong your growing body is?' Leo nodded, though he pulled his fuzzy shoulders up near his ears. 'I brought my special stethoscope today,' Dr. Owl said, showing him the long black tubing and the shiny metal bell. 'Do you know what this does?' Leo shook his head, his little black nose twitching. 'It is a special helper tool that listens to your breathing and your heart beats,' Dr. Owl explained warmly. 'Would you like to try being the doctor first?' Leo’s eyes lit up with excitement. He took the stethoscope, held the cool metal piece carefully in his paws, and pressed it right against his favorite stuffed teddy bear, Barnaby. 'I hear you, Barnaby!' Leo whispered seriously. 'Your tummy is quiet!' Dr. Owl chuckled happily. 'You are a natural healer, Leo! Now, it is my turn to listen to your big, strong cub heart.' Leo took a deep, brave breath. Dr. Owl warmed the metal disk in her feathered wings for just a second before placing it gently against Leo’s furry chest. 'Thump-thump, thump-thump!' went the rhythm inside. Dr. Owl beamed with delight. 'My goodness, Leo Bear, that is the sound of a very healthy, energetic, happy little cub who loves to run and jump!' Leo giggled, feeling so proud and brave. When Dr. Owl gave him a shiny golden bravery badge, Leo pinned it proudly to his shirt. He couldn't wait to play doctor with all his woodland friends tomorrow.

stories.title: Daisy Duck’s Listening Day
stories.text: Quack, quack! Little Daisy Duck was waddling happily down the hallway of the sunshine clinic. Today was her wellness checkup with Dr. Badger. Daisy loved wearing her bright yellow polka-dot bow, and today she wanted everything to match her cheerful mood. When Dr. Badger opened the door, his kind black-and-white face crinkled into a big, welcoming smile. 'Well hello, Miss Daisy Duck! Welcome to our clinic,' Dr. Badger greeted her warmly. Daisy hopped right up onto the examining table, swinging her yellow-webbed feet back and forth. 'Today we are going to listen to your wonderful body engine,' Dr. Badger said cheerfully, picking up his shiny silver stethoscope. Daisy tilted her head, her feathers fluffing up with curiosity. 'Does it tick-tock like a clock?' she asked brightly. Dr. Badger laughed a gentle, rumbling laugh. 'Let us find out together!' he said. He handed the ear pieces to Daisy so she could put them on, and placed the cool metal bell right against his own furry chest. Daisy’s eyes grew as big as saucers as she heard a deep, steady 'Thump-thump, thump-thump!' inside Dr. Badger. 'I hear it!' Daisy squeaked happily. 'It sounds like a giant drum!' Dr. Badger smiled. 'Now it is your turn to let your body play its music for us.' Daisy nodded eagerly. She sat up extra straight and tall like a ballerina duck. Dr. Badger placed the stethoscope gently against her feathered chest. 'Tap, tap, tap, quack—well, no quacks inside!' Dr. Badger joked playfully. 'Just the most wonderful, steady, healthy heartbeat in the whole pond.' Daisy beamed from ear to ear, feeling so proud of her strong little body. Dr. Badger handed her a bright blue star sticker and a big warm hug. Daisy fluttered her wings with delight, ready to tell everyone how much fun it is to listen to the happy music inside your heart.

stories.title: Leo's Brave Heartbeat
stories.text: Little Leo woke up feeling a little bit warm and very, very tired. He did not want to get out of his cozy bed. Mama Bear smiled softly and said, "Good morning, my sweet cub. Let us invite Dr. Bear to come and check on you today!" Leo rubbed his eyes. Dr. Bear was not a real grizzly; he was Leo's favorite fluffy stuffed animal with a bright red paper stethoscope taped to his tummy. Leo gently picked up Dr. Bear and held the cold paper end right against his own chest. "Thump-thump, thump-thump," whispered Leo, pretending to be the doctor. Then, he placed the stethoscope against Dr. Bear’s furry chest to listen to the toy's heartbeat, too. "Your heartbeat sounds strong and happy, Dr. Bear!" Leo giggled. Suddenly, playing doctor made Leo feel much better. He sat up tall and stretched his arms high up toward the ceiling. Mama Bear clapped her paws together and cheered, "Look at my brave little cub! Using your stethoscope helped you feel safe and brave." Leo nodded proudly. He decided that going to the real doctor for his check-up would be just like playing with Dr. Bear. He put on his favorite yellow socks, ate a warm bowl of honey oatmeal, and drank every drop of his apple water. By the time they walked out the door, Leo was smiling from ear to ear. He even brought Dr. Bear along in his backpack so his fluffy friend could help him stay brave at the clinic. When the kind nurse used her real stethoscope, Leo just closed his eyes and remembered his own game. He knew that listening to his heartbeat was just a way for his body to say hello. You are doing such a wonderful job growing big and strong, just like Leo!

stories.title: Mia and the Magic Listening Tube
stories.text: Today was a very special day because Mia was going to visit Dr. Owl for her yearly check-up. At first, Mia felt butterflies fluttering in her tummy. She held tightly to her Papa’s hand as they walked into the bright waiting room. To help Mia feel brave, Papa whispered, "Remember our game? We are just like Dr. Bear with his magical listening tube." Mia’s eyes lit up. She loved playing Dr. Bear! She reached into her little pink bag and pulled out her toy stethoscope, placing the round metal piece gently against Papa’s arm. "I hear a big, loud, happy rumble!" Mia whispered playfully, making Papa laugh out loud. When the friendly nurse called their names, Mia skipped right into the examination room with a big grin. Dr. Owl was very gentle and wore colorful polka-dot glasses. She picked up a shiny stethoscope and said, "May I listen to your wonderful heart, Mia?" Mia remembered Dr. Bear and nodded bravely. She took a deep breath in and blew it out slowly, like she was cooling down a hot cup of cocoa. Dr. Owl listened carefully and smiled. "Your heart sounds like a happy little drum keeping the best beat in the whole wide world!" Dr. Owl cheered. Mia felt so proud of herself. She even got to listen to her own heartbeat through the special tubes, hearing the lovely rhythm go thump, thump, thump. After the check-up, Dr. Owl gave Mia a shiny star sticker that sparkled in the light. Mia stuck it right onto her toy stethoscope when they got home. She was so proud of how brave she had been during her visit. Every time she played with Dr. Bear after that day, she remembered her special trip to the doctor and smiled. You are so brave and wonderful, just like Mia!

stories.title: Pip's Check-Up Buddy
stories.text: Pip the rabbit was getting ready for his afternoon nap, but first, he wanted to play hospital with his favorite stuffed animal, Dr. Bear. Pip wrapped a long blue ribbon around his neck to act as a stethoscope. He sat on the fluffy rug and gave Dr. Bear a very important check-up. "First, we must check your ears, Dr. Bear," Pip announced in his most serious voice. He gently looked inside the toy's furry ears and gave him a gentle pat on the head. "All clear!" Pip giggled. Next, it was time for the best part. Pip pressed the middle of his ribbon stethoscope right against Dr. Bear’s soft belly. "Now let us listen to that tummy. Have you been eating enough carrots today?" Pip asked the toy with a cheeky smile. Playing doctor always made Pip feel so calm and relaxed. Just then, Mama Rabbit walked into the sunny room carrying a fresh cup of warm strawberry milk. "How is our patient doing today, Dr. Pip?" Mama asked warmly. Pip hopped up on his hind legs and proudly adjusted his blue ribbon. "Dr. Bear is doing fantastic, Mama! His heart is beating super fast because he loves jumping so much." Mama laughed and kissed the top of Pip’s furry head. "Just like your heart, my sweet little bunny." Pip sat down and sipped his milk, feeling cozy and happy. He realized that visiting the doctor was just like playing with Dr. Bear—it was all about making sure his body had everything it needed to run, jump, and play every single day. Pip hugged his toy tightly and whispered, "Thank you for being my best check-up buddy." You are growing up to be so healthy and strong, just like Pip!

rhymes.title: The Happy Doctor Bear
rhymes.text:
Doctor Bear is here today,
To check your heart and help you play.
Put the cold scope on your chest,
Dr. Bear will do his best.

Big breath in and let it blow,
Watch the happy tummy grow.
Tap-a-tap goes on your knee,
Healthy as can ever be!

Open wide and say hello,
Smile and let the sparkle show.
Ears are clear and feeling fine,
Everything is right in line.

Now the check-up time is through,
Proud of little sweet old you!
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Ready for a fun-filled day!

rhymes.title: Listen to the Tick-Tock
rhymes.text:
Time to see the fuzzy bear,
Climbing up the doctor's chair.
He has got a shiny tool,
Shiny, silver, sweet and cool.

Put it on your chest so neat,
Feel the tick-tock of your beat.
Lub-dub, lub-dub, hear it sound,
Happiest heart in the town!

Now he checks your little arm,
Keeping you away from harm.
Time to check your tippy-toes,
Right up to your button nose.

Dr. Bear gives stickers bright,
Everything is going right.
Hold them up and give a cheer,
Best check-up of all the year!

rhymes.title: Stethoscope Song
rhymes.text:
Round and round the office go,
Saying hello to Dr. Bear so slow.
He puts on his little hat,
Ready for a chat-a-chat.

Cold round circle on your back,
Tap, tap, tap, go-click-a-clack.
Breathe right in and breathe right out,
That is what a check's about!

Is your engine running strong?
Listen to the happy song.
Lub-dub beats inside your chest,
Little baby, you are best.

Now the check is done and sweet,
Stomp your happy little feet.
Give a hug to Dr. Bear,
Glad he is so loving there.

rhymes.title: Tickle on the Tummy
rhymes.text:
Doctor Bear is listening now,
Waving with a friendly bow.
Can he hear your motor beat?
Sounding steady, sounding sweet.

Tickle on your tummy here,
Nothing in the world to fear.
Stethoscope is shiny gold,
Bestest story ever told.

Breathe in deeply like a whale,
Wiggle like a little snail.
Now you blow a bubble breeze,
Bigger than the highest trees.

All done with the listening part,
Doctor Bear loves every heart.
Wave goodbye with all your might,
Sleep and play into the night.

rhymes.title: Brave Little Patient
rhymes.text:
Sit up tall upon the bed,
With a pat upon your head.
Dr. Bear is coming round,
Making not a scary sound.

Silver tube goes in his ear,
So your heartbeat he can hear.
Tap your knee to test reflex,
What is coming to us next?

Look inside your ears and nose,
All the way down to your toes.
Every little part is great,
Never need to rush or wait.

Brave and strong all through the test,
Little one, you pass the best.
Get a sticker for your shirt,
Nothing happened here to hurt!

rhymes.title: Dr. Bear and the Tickle
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is here today,
Time to check and time to play.
Hold the shiny silver scope,
Full of giggles and of hope.
Place it gently on your chest,
Dr. Bear will do his best.
Can you hear the drumbeat go?
Thump-a-thump, it beat so slow.
Deep breath in and blow it out,
That is what we're all about.
No more worries, no more tears,
Wave away those little fears.
Now the check-up time is done,
Being healthy is such fun.
Give a high-five to Dr. Bear,
Happy hugs are everywhere.

rhymes.title: Listen to the Heartbeat
rhymes.text:
Little cub, come sit right here,
Dr. Bear is drawing near.
He has got a magic tool,
Looking shiny and so cool.
It's a special listening ear,
So your heartbeat he can hear.
Put it right upon your tum,
Listen to the tick-tock drum.
Thump-a-thump and boom-boom-boom,
Echoing around the room.
Take a breath and count to three,
Breathe out happy as can be.
Dr. Bear smiles wide and bright,
Everything is feeling right.
You are growing big and strong,
Singing out a happy song.

rhymes.title: The Shiny Silver Scope
rhymes.text:
Round and round the office spins,
That is where the magic begins.
Dr. Bear puts on his hat,
Talking to the friendly cat.
Then he picks the stethoscope,
Filling up the room with hope.
Touch the metal, is it cold?
Watch the story now unfold.
Press it softly on your back,
Tap it gently, click-clack-clack.
Hear the engine chugging round,
Making such a lovely sound.
Now your chest is listening too,
Saying hello friend to you.
Dr. Bear gives out a prize,
Twinkling in his furry eyes.

rhymes.title: Breathe In, Breathe Out
rhymes.text:
Open up your mouth and say,
Doctor check-up starts today.
Dr. Bear is wearing green,
Smartest doctor ever seen.
He holds up the silver wire,
Taking little jumps up higher.
Place the circle on your skin,
Time to breathe and start again.
In and out just like the wind,
See the happy grin that grinned.
Heart says pump and lungs say sigh,
Clouds are floating in the sky.
Dr. Bear says you did great,
Never have to fear or wait.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
For a healthy check-up day.

rhymes.title: A Hug from Dr. Bear
rhymes.text:
Soft brown fur and cozy paws,
Following the wellness laws.
Dr. Bear has lots of care,
Waiting in his doctor chair.
Take the stethoscope and smile,
We will rest here for a while.
Press it gently on your side,
Where the tiny heartbeats hide.
Lub-dub, lub-dub goes the beat,
Marching right along your feet.
Take a breath of apple pie,
Watch the happy bubbles fly.
Dr. Bear is shaking hands,
 Happiest in all the lands.
You are brave and you are sweet,
From your head down to your feet.

rhymes.title: The Happy Heart Check
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is here today,
To chase all the sick bugs away.
He puts the cold metal on your chest,
Let's see whose heart beats the best.

Lub-dub, lub-dub goes the drum,
Tickle, tickle on your thumb.
Dr. Bear listens with a smile,
We will rest and wait a while.

Take a deep breath in and out,
There is never any doubt.
Your big heart is strong and true,
Ready for a day that's new.

Clean and healthy every day,
Now it's time to go and play!

rhymes.title: The Magic Silver Tube
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear has a magic tool,
He is calm and he is cool.
A silver tube with ear-pieces two,
Just to check and look at you.

Put it here upon your knee,
Does it tickle? Tee-hee-hee!
Put it on your tummy now,
Can you make a funny cow?

Dr. Bear says you are so brave,
Watch the happy doctor wave.
Medicine is not so bad,
When it makes you feel so glad.

Rest your head upon the bed,
Pat your soft and furry head.

rhymes.title: Breathe In Deep
rhymes.text:
Little cub, don't fuss or cry,
Dr. Bear is standing by.
He will check your little lungs,
While you stick out pinkish tongues.

Breathe in deep and let it out,
No need to worry or to pout.
The stethoscope is shiny bright,
Everything is going right.

Listen to the rhythmic beat,
Stamping happy little feet.
Dr. Bear gives stickers too,
Just to say a job well do.

Snuggle in your cozy coat,
Wrap a scarf around your throat.

rhymes.title: Tickly Metal Disks
rhymes.text:
Doctor Bear in coat of white,
Makes the checkup feel so light.
He pulls out his listening glass,
Watches all the hours pass.

Cold at first, but warming fast,
Checking that you're well at last.
Tap a toe and wiggle toes,
Touch your little button nose.

Dr. Bear nods with a grin,
Let the healing warmth begin.
Drink your water, eat your snack,
Health and energy are back.

Give the friendly bear a hug,
Drinking juice out of a mug.

rhymes.title: The Checkup Song
rhymes.text:
Up upon the table high,
Staring at the mobile sky.
Dr. Bear is checking ears,
Making sure there are no fears.

Now the chest piece comes around,
Listening for a steady sound.
Lub-dub, lub-dub, hear it go,
Beating fast and beating slow.

Dr. Bear writes on his pad,
You're the best he's ever had.
Put your jacket on your arm,
Safe and cozy out of harm.

Time to skip and time to run,
Doctor visits can be fun!

rhymes.title: The Magic Listening Horn
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is here today,
To chase the little germs away.
He puts the cold metal on your chest,
To see if your breathing is the best.

First he says a friendly hello,
Watch the shiny silver circle go.
It is chilly to the touch,
But it does not hurt very much.

Breathe in deeply through your nose,
Right down to your tiny toes.
Breathe out softly like the wind,
With a happy little grin.

Dr. Bear hears a thump-thump-thump,
Like a little racing rabbit jump.
Your heart is strong and beating true,
He is so very proud of you!

rhymes.title: Tickle on the Tummy
rhymes.text:
Time to see Dr. Bear care,
Up upon the table there.
He has a stethoscope to wear,
Floating softly in the air.

He wants to listen to your tummy,
Did you eat something yummy?
It might tickle when it lands,
Warm up in his furry hands.

Listen closely, what can he hear?
Sounds of giggles drawing near.
Rumbly-tum and tummy-tum,
Here the happy noises come.

Brave little toddler, shining bright,
Everything is feeling right.
Dr. Bear smiles and gives a cheer,
Best patient of the whole year!

rhymes.title: Following the Heartbeat
rhymes.text:
Tap-tap-tap goes Dr. Bear,
Checking every patient there.
He wears a ribbon round his neck,
For a quick and easy check.

Put the earpieces in place,
With a big and smiling face.
Now he hears a steady beat,
From your head down to your feet.

Lub-dub, lub-dub goes the drum,
See the happy toddlers come.
Your motor runs so smooth and fast,
Growing taller all at last.

Dr. Bear takes it off with care,
Waving in the office air.
You did such a super job,
Here is a sticker for your knob!

rhymes.title: The Whisper Tube
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear has a special tube,
Not a square and not a cube.
It is shiny, long and round,
To catch every little sound.

Place it gently on your back,
On the soft and cozy sack.
Can he hear a little sigh?
As the wind goes whistling by.

Say ah-wooo and say ah-bee,
Let the doctor look and see.
He is listening all around,
For a healthy, happy sound.

All done now, the check is through,
Dr. Bear is clapping for you.
Such a strong and healthy kid,
Look at everything you did!

rhymes.title: Dr. Bear's Shiny Ears
rhymes.text:
Soft brown fur and gentle paws,
Following the doctor laws.
Dr. Bear is on the scene,
Best physician ever seen.

He holds the stethoscope so bright,
Catching all the morning light.
It is time to check your lung,
While you stick out your little tongue.

In and out the air will flow,
Watch your little chest up grow.
Dr. Bear nods his fuzzy head,
Everything is well ahead.

Off he goes to help a friend,
Happy routine to the end.
Give a hug and wave goodbye,
Reaching up to touch the sky!

rhymes.title: Dr. Bear's Shiny Scope
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is here today,
To help us feel okay and play.
He holds a shiny silver scope,
And fills our hearts with happy hope.

Now sit up straight and count to three,
As happy as a bumblebee.
He puts it on your chest so neat,
To hear your engine beat a beat.

Thump-a-thump, it goes so loud,
Dr. Bear is very proud.
Your healthy heart is strong and grand,
The finest ticker in the land.

No need to frown or shed a tear,
When Dr. Bear is checking here.
You did a super, brave routine,
The very best we've ever seen!

rhymes.title: Tick-Tock Heartbeat Song
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock, tick-tock, listen in,
Put a smile upon your chin.
Dr. Bear has got his tool,
Following the doctor rule.

Cold and round, but do not fear,
It's just to listen, loud and clear.
Right beside your cozy vest,
Dr. Bear tests out your chest.

Boom-boom, boom-boom, hear it go,
Beating fast or beating slow.
It's the rhythm of your life,
 Free of trouble and of strife.

Give a clap and give a cheer,
For Dr. Bear who helps us here.
Now your check-up time is through,
Time to play and romp anew!

rhymes.title: The Magic Listening Horn
rhymes.text:
Look at Dr. Bear so bright,
Wearing shoes of shiny white.
He wears a magic listening horn,
Ever since the break of morn.

It helps him hear your tummy say,
What you ate for lunch today.
Gurgle-gurgle, rumble-tum,
Eating yummy sugar-plum.

Now he moves it up so high,
Right beneath your sleepy eye.
Listening to your breathing deep,
While you wake or while you sleep.

In and out, the breezes blow,
Watch your little chest grow slow.
Dr. Bear says you're all right,
Ready for a day so bright!

rhymes.title: Tap-Tap with Dr. Bear
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is at the door,
Walking softly on the floor.
He has a stethoscope to share,
Floating gently through the air.

Tap-tap softly on your back,
 Keeping up the gentle track.
Listening to your lungs and chest,
Knowing you are doing best.

Say ah-wooo and take a breath,
Chasing any bug to death.
Now your lungs are clear and wide,
Filled with joy and warmth inside.

Dr. Bear puts down his gear,
Wiping every little tear.
Give a hug and shake a paw,
Best check-up you ever saw!

rhymes.title: Listen to the Music Inside
rhymes.text:
Every body has a song,
Singing all the whole day long.
Dr. Bear is here to hear,
Music playing loud and clear.

Stethoscope is on his ears,
Washing all away your fears.
Reaching for your little chest,
Putting every doubt to rest.

Lub-dub, lub-dub, hear the tune,
Dancing underneath the moon.
It's your steady heart so true,
Beating just for lovely you.

Dr. Bear gives out a smile,
Resting for a little while.
You are healthy, strong, and tall,
Our favorite patient of them all!

rhymes.title: The Happy Heartbeat
rhymes.text:
Time to check your chest today,
Dr. Bear is on the way!
Bring your tummy, bring your toes,
Point right to your little nose.

Dr. Bear has ears so bright,
Holding up the shiny light.
Let us listen, big and deep,
While the little bunnies sleep.

Thump-thump-thump goes every beat,
From your head down to your feet.
Healthy heart is strong and wide,
With so much good love inside.

Now the check-up time is done,
Clap your hands, let's have some fun!
Dr. Bear says you did great,
Time to jump and celebrate!

rhymes.title: The Magic Silver Scope
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is looking grand,
Silver scope is in his hand.
Touch it softly, nice and cold,
Like a treasure of pure gold.

Put it gently on your arm,
Keeping everybody calm.
Listen to the whispers near,
Sounds of happiness are here.

Breathe in slowly, count to three,
As happy as a buzzing bee.
Breathe out gently, watch it go,
Swinging to and fro, just so.

Dr. Bear gives out a smile,
Rest your happy bones a while.
You are brave and you are strong,
Singing out this little song!

rhymes.title: Listen to the Tummy Drum
rhymes.text:
Tap your tummy, beat the drum,
See what Dr. Bear has come!
He has got his helper tool,
Making doctor visits cool.

Giggle giggle, it may tickle,
Like a shiny silver nickel.
Hear the tummy rumble low,
Ready, steady, off we go!

Apples, juice, and yummy bread,
Nourish all the way ahead.
Dr. Bear says things sound grand,
Best digestion in the land.

Give a high-five, nice and high,
Waving to the clouds so high.
Doctor check is through today,
Hooray, hooray, hip-hip-hooray!

rhymes.title: Breathe In Big with Dr. Bear
rhymes.text:
Take a breath and puff your chest,
Dr. Bear is here, the best!
Put the circle on your back,
On our healthy little track.

Take a deep breath, way up high,
Reaching up to touch the sky.
Let it out and make a sound,
As your feet stay on the ground.

Lungs are working day and night,
Keeping everything just right.
Dr. Bear is nodding now,
Taking such a polite bow.

You did wonderful today,
Time to go outside and play.
Dr. Bear is proud of you,
Shining bright just like the dew!

rhymes.title: Check-Up Cheer
rhymes.text:
Time for check-up, don't you fret,
Best experience you'll get!
Dr. Bear puts on his hat,
Sitting on the doctor mat.

Scope is warming in his paw,
Biggest smile you ever saw.
Checking knees and checking toes,
Right up to your button nose.

Thump-thump goes the happy heart,
Right here at the very start.
Everything is working fine,
Healthy as a tree and vine.

Sticker goes upon your shirt,
So you know it didn't hurt!
Dr. Bear says see you soon,
Singing underneath the moon.

rhymes.title: The Happy Heart Check
rhymes.text:
Time to see the doctor bear,
Climbing up the big green chair.
Dr. Bear puts on his hat,
Says hello and greets you flat.

Now he takes his silver tool,
Listening is the golden rule.
Cold and shiny, round and bright,
Checking that you're doing right.

Put it right upon your chest,
Dr. Bear will do the rest.
Lub-dub, lub-dub, hear it beat,
Sounding steady, sounding sweet.

Breathe in deeply, let it out,
No more worry, no more doubt.
All done now, let's give a cheer,
Healthy heart is working here!

rhymes.title: Cold Metal, Warm Smile
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is very tall,
Helping children great and small.
Brings his stethoscope along,
Humming out a happy song.

It is chilly when it starts,
Made to listen to our hearts.
Tap the metal on your knee,
So it's not a mystery.

Hold still like a statue now,
Dr. Bear will show you how.
Listen close and hear the sound,
Happiest heart in all the town.

Take a bow and pat your head,
Time to jump back off the bed.
Brave and strong through every test,
Little bear you did your best!

rhymes.title: Listen to the Ticky-Tack
rhymes.text:
Doctor bear has fuzzy ears,
Chasing all the scary fears.
Stethoscope is round and cool,
Best invention in his school.

Put the earpieces in place,
Put a smile upon your face.
Touch the chest so soft and wide,
Feel the magic deep inside.

Ticky-tack and thump-thump-thump,
Hear the little motor jump.
Working hard both night and day,
Pumping blood while babies play.

All finished with the shiny wire,
Dr. Bear goes climbing higher.
Wave goodbye and shout hooray,
Healthy check-up for today!

rhymes.title: The Magic Listening Tube
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is ready now,
Taking patient number cow.
No, it's you upon the mat,
Right beside the office cat.

Stethoscope is hanging down,
Shiny metal, golden brown.
Tube is long and tube is black,
Loops around his furry back.

Place it gently on your ribs,
Past your buttons and your bibs.
Can you hear the ocean roar?
No, it's something to adore.

Thump-a-thump goes ticker-ticker,
Making little spirits quicker.
Dr. Bear says you are fine,
Shining like a star so divine!

rhymes.title: Brave Little Patient
rhymes.text:
Up you go and up you slide,
Doctor bear is full of pride.
Stethoscope is in his hand,
Nicest doctor in the land.

Take a breath and count to three,
Look at Dr. Bear and me.
He will check your lungs so clear,
Whispering a word of cheer.

Press the circle on your chest,
This is really not a test.
Just to see if you are strong,
Singing out a little song.

All done now, you did so great,
Never have to fear or wait.
Stethoscope goes in the drawer,
Time to play upon the floor!

rhymes.title: Dr. Bear and the Tickle Scope
rhymes.text:
Time to see the doctor bear,
Sitting in the rocking chair.
Bring your tummy, bring your toes,
Dr. Bear is on his toes!

Take the silver stethoscope,
Hang it from a fluffy rope.
Cold and shiny, beep, beep, beep,
Do not make a little peep!

Place it gently on your chest,
Dr. Bear will do the test.
Listen to the tickly beat,
Marching on your little feet.

Now the checkup all is done,
Being healthy is so fun!

rhymes.title: Breathe In Deep with Dr. Bear
rhymes.text:
Teddy doctor brings his bag,
Not a single thing to lag.
Open up the shiny case,
Smiles upon each little face.

Stethoscope is round and cool,
Best medical fuzzy tool.
Put it right upon your heart,
Now the listening can start.

Breathe in deeply, nice and slow,
Watch your little tummy grow.
Breathe out now, a happy sigh,
Wave a friendly wave goodbye.

Healthy bodies, strong and bright,
Ready for a sunny light!

rhymes.title: The Happy Heart Song
rhymes.text:
Doctor bear puts on his hat,
Looking very wise at that.
Takes his stethoscope so neat,
Makes the checkup twice as sweet.

Tap-a-tap upon the back,
Reaching in his furry pack.
Listen to the rhythm now,
Listen to the great 'bow-wow'!

Thump-thump-thump goes every heart,
Ready for the day to start.
Dr. Bear says you are grand,
Bestest patient in the land.

Clap your hands and shout hooray,
We are healthy every day!

rhymes.title: Listen to the Thump-Thump
rhymes.text:
Little cub is feeling great,
At the doctor's office gate.
Dr. Bear is waiting near,
With a smile and hearty cheer.

Grab the silver listening tube,
Not a single cry or snub.
Press it softly on the skin,
Let the magic song begin.

Thump-thump-thump, it beats so true,
Making happy sounds for you.
Dr. Bear gives out a prize,
Twinkling in his furry eyes.

All done with the big routine,
 cleanest paws you've ever seen!

rhymes.title: Stethoscope Symphony
rhymes.text:
Rise and shine for Dr. Bear,
Brushing up his fuzzy hair.
Gets his clipboard and his pen,
Ready for checkups again.

Stethoscope is hanging low,
Watch the shiny circles glow.
Put the ear-pieces in place,
Joy is lighting up his face.

Listen to the motor hum,
Beat of a internal drum.
Dr. Bear nods with a grin,
Let the playground games begin!

Strong and steady day and night,
Everything is feeling right.

rhymes.title: Dr. Bear and the Tickly Check
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is here today,
To help us feel so strong and gay!
Put the shiny stethoscope,
On your chest and hear it scope.

Lub-dub, lub-dub goes the beat,
Marching on your happy feet!
Breathe in deeply, nice and slow,
Watch your little tummy grow.

Dr. Bear will check your knee,
Are you healthy? Yes, sirree!
Open up your mouth and say,
'Ahhh' to start a brand new day.

Now the checkup all is done,
Taking care of health is fun!
Give a cheer for Dr. Bear,
Spreading love and health everywhere.

rhymes.title: The Shiny Metal Scope
rhymes.text:
Time to meet our furry friend,
On whom we can always depend.
Dr. Bear puts on his coat,
With a smile and happy note.

Hold the stethoscope so bright,
Catching morning's golden light.
Place it gently on the chest,
Where the heart beats best and best.

Listen close and hear the sound,
As it bounces all around.
Lub-dub, lub-dub, hear it go,
Soft and steady, sweet and slow.

Now your heart is beating strong,
Singing out a happy song.
Dr. Bear is proud of you,
For all the healthy things you do.

rhymes.title: Listen to the Heartbeat
rhymes.text:
Little friend, don't be afraid,
Dr. Bear has got it made!
Stethoscope is round and cool,
Best invention in the school.

Let us listen to your chest,
Giving all your organs rest.
Lub-dub, lub-dub, hear the drum,
Beat is steady, here we come.

Take a breath and count to three,
Look how brave you are to me!
Now we check your elbow too,
Doing all the checkups new.

Health is wealth and feeling great,
Dr. Bear thinks you are first-rate.
Wave goodbye with happy cheer,
Glad that Dr. Bear is here.

rhymes.title: A Checkup with Dr. Bear
rhymes.text:
Sun is shining in the sky,
Dr. Bear is walking by.
Stethoscope around his neck,
Ready for a health check-check!

Sit up straight upon the chair,
Combing down your fuzzy hair.
Place the circle on your back,
On the healthy track-track-track.

Breathe out now and let it breeze,
Louder than a buzzy bees.
Lub-dub, lub-dub in your chest,
That is where the love is best.

Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Checkups keep the germs away!
Dr. Bear gives stickers too,
Just for being brave and you.

rhymes.title: The Magic Listening Tube
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear has magic ears,
Chasing all the little fears.
Stethoscope is shiny too,
Just the proper tool for you.

Press it gently, oh so light,
Everything is feeling right.
Lub-dub rhythm in the beat,
Making life so warm and sweet.

Check your tummy, check your arm,
Keeping you so safe from harm.
Smile a big and happy grin,
Let the healthy days begin!

Strong and growing every day,
Ready now to run and play.
Dr. Bear is waving bye,
'Keep your happy spirits high!'

rhymes.title: Dr. Bear's Happy Ears
rhymes.text:
Dr. Bear is here today,
To check your heartbeat, hip hooray!
He puts his stethoscope in place,
With a big and friendly face.

Cold and shiny, round and bright,
Hold it up and squeeze it tight.
Put it softly on your chest,
Dr. Bear is simply best!

Lub-dub, lub-dub, hear it go,
Beating fast or beating slow.
Now he checks your tummy too,
Just to see how you do!

Breathe in deeply, let it out,
That is what it's all about.
Clap your hands and shout aloud,
Dr. Bear is very proud!

rhymes.title: The Stethoscope Song
rhymes.text:
Tick-tock, tick-tock, morning light,
Dr. Bear will make you right.
Bring the stethoscope along,
Singing out a happy song.

Silver circle, tubing long,
Listening to your healthy song.
Place it gently on the skin,
Let the check-up now begin!

Can you hear the engine beat?
Thump-thump marching down the street.
Dr. Bear says you are strong,
Nothing here could go so wrong.

Take a bow and give a cheer,
Best check-up of all the year.
Dr. Bear is waving bye,
Wave your little hands on high.

rhymes.title: Listen to the Heartbeat
rhymes.text:
Time for check-up, big and small,
Dr. Bear is friend to all.
He has got his helper tool,
Following the doctor rule.

Stethoscope is cool and neat,
Checking from your head to feet.
Put the earpieces in place,
Smile a happy toddler face.

Listen to the thumping sound,
Bestest rhythm to be found.
Lub-dub, lub-dub, hear it play,
Just like music every day.

Pat your tummy, pat your knee,
As healthy as can ever be.
Dr. Bear says you did great,
Time to go and celebrate!

rhymes.title: Check-Up Time with Dr. Bear
rhymes.text:
Up you sit upon the chair,
Waiting now for Dr. Bear.
He is wearing shiny shoes,
And a coat of cozy blues.

Stethoscope is hanging low,
Ready for a fun hello.
Place it gently on your back,
On the very proper track.

Breathe in like a sleepy bear,
Sniffing up the morning air.
Breathe out like a puppy dog,
Resting on a woody log.

Everything is looking fine,
Everything is right in line.
Dr. Bear gives stickers too,
Just because he cares for you!

rhymes.title: Heartbeat Drum
rhymes.text:
Drum, drum, drum goes the little heart,
Dr. Bear is super smart.
He can hear it loud and clear,
With his stethoscope right here.

Rubber tube goes twist and bend,
Dr. Bear is your best friend.
Press it softly on the rib,
Not too heavy, just a nib.

Thump-thump, thump-thump goes the beat,
Marching down the little street.
Doctor smiles and nods his head,
Time to jump up from the bed.

You are growing tall and strong,
Singing out this happy song.
Give a hug and say goodbye,
To our fuzzy bear so high!

stories.title: Leo's Bright Red Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with a big stretch, ready for a brand new day. But today, the hallway to the big bathroom looked a little bit long. And brushing teeth with the buzzing toothbrush felt a little bit loud. Leo stopped and thought, 'Hmm, what do I need today?' Then, he remembered his special helper hanging right on his doorknob. It was the Cape of Courage! It was shiny blue with a bright red star right in the middle. Leo's big person helped him tie the soft ribbons around his neck. Suddenly, a warm, cozy feeling tickled his tummy. 'Whoosh!' whispered Leo, pretending to fly. With his Cape of Courage fluttering behind him, Leo felt brave and strong. He marched right into the bathroom, one, two, three steps! He picked up his buzzing toothbrush all by himself. 'Bzzzz,' went the brush, just like a friendly little bee. Leo brushed his top teeth, and he brushed his bottom teeth, smiling big in the mirror. When he rinsed with water, he felt so proud. His Cape of Courage helped him do a big-kid job all on his own. Next came getting dressed. Leo put on his yellow shirt and his stretchy green pants. Every time a button felt tricky, he looked down at his bright red star and took a deep breath. 'I can do hard things,' Leo whispered, and pop! The button went right through the hole. He folded his cozy cape and placed it gently on his chair, ready for the next adventure. At breakfast, Leo ate every single bite of his yummy oatmeal and drank his whole cup of milk. He even wiped his own mouth with a napkin. His mommy gave him a giant hug and whispered, 'You are so brave, my sweet boy.' Leo beamed from ear to ear. Wearing his brave heart inside, and his imaginary cape on his shoulders, Leo was ready to play, laugh, and explore the whole wide world all day long.

stories.title: Maya and the Whispering Cape
stories.text: The morning sun was shining bright outside Maya's window, painting yellow squares on her bedroom rug. It was time to put on shoes and go outside for a fun morning walk in the park. But Maya's shoes felt tight, and putting them on made her feel a little bit shy. She wanted to stay inside where everything was quiet and safe. Mommy smiled gently and reached into the basket of dress-up clothes. She pulled out a magical garment: the Cape of Courage. It was made of the softest purple velvet, smelling faintly of sunshine and lavender. 'Would you like to wear the Cape of Courage today, Maya?' Mommy asked softly. Maya nodded, her big brown eyes lighting up. Mommy tied the cape snugly around Maya's shoulders. The moment the fabric touched her back, Maya heard a little whisper in her ear: 'You are safe, you are strong, and you can do anything.' Maya giggled because it tickled, but she also felt a warm wave of bravery wash all the way down to her tippy-toes. With her purple cape flowing behind her like a royal princess, Maya walked over to her shoes. She picked up her pink sneaker all by herself. 'Squeak,' went the tongue of the shoe. Maya pushed her foot inside. It was a little snug, but she didn't give up. She remembered the whisper from her cape. With a gentle wiggle of her toes and a little push, her foot slipped right in. She pressed the Velcro strap down with a satisfying 'CRACK!' sound. 'Yay!' cheered Maya, clapping her hands together. She put on her other shoe just as fast. Standing tall, Maya felt like she could leap over mountains and touch the fluffy white clouds. She held Mommy's hand as they walked out the front door, stepping boldly into the bright, beautiful day. The Cape of Courage stayed right on her shoulders, reminding her that every little step is a big adventure.

stories.title: Sam's Bedtime Cape
stories.text: The moon was peeking up into the evening sky, painting the clouds with splashes of sleepy lavender and pink. It was time for Sam to brush his teeth, put on his soft pajamas, and get ready for bed. But the big bedroom shadows looked a little bit long, and Sam felt a tiny flutter of worry in his tummy. He didn't want the lights to go out just yet. Daddy walked into the room carrying a very special folded blanket. 'Ah, I think it is time for your Cape of Courage, Captain Sam,' Daddy said with a warm, comforting smile. Sam's eyes grew wide. The Cape of Courage was midnight blue, covered in shiny silver stars that sparkled in the dim evening light. Daddy wrapped the soft cape gently around Sam's shoulders, buttoning the top button with care. Instantly, Sam felt like a brave nighttime explorer sailing through the starry galaxy. The worries in his tummy melted away like ice cream on a warm day. 'Are you ready for bedtime exploration?' Daddy asked. Sam nodded bravely. 'Yes, Captain Sam is ready!' he whispered in a strong voice. First, Sam marched into the bathroom with his shiny green toothbrush. He brushed his teeth until they were sparkling clean, spitting into the sink with a big grin. Next, he walked back to his cozy bed, pulling back the soft blue blankets all by himself. He climbed in, tucking his stuffed bear safely under his arm. Daddy sat on the edge of the bed and read a wonderful story about a little bear who loved the moon. Sam listened happily, feeling safe, warm, and wonderfully brave inside his starry cape. When the story ended, Daddy kissed Sam on the forehead and gently removed the cape, placing it neatly on the nightstand so it would be ready for tomorrow. Sam closed his eyes, drifting off to sleep with sweet dreams of flying high among the stars, knowing he was brave, loved, and ready for whatever tomorrow would bring.

stories.title: Leo's Doctor Visit Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with the sun shining brightly on his toes. Today was a very big day because Leo had to visit Dr. Sara for a checkup. Leo looked at his shiny green shoes and felt a little fluttery feeling in his tummy. He held his mommy's hand tightly. Mommy smiled a warm, gentle smile and said, 'Leo, I think you need something special today.' She walked over to his dress-up box and pulled out a bright red silky cloth. 'It is the Cape of Courage!' Mommy tied it softly around Leo's little shoulders. As soon as the red cape touched his back, Leo felt a warm, cozy wave of bravery wash all the way down to his wiggly toes. 'Woosh!' whispered Leo, feeling strong and mighty. At the doctor's office, Dr. Sara smiled and brought out a shiny stethoscope. Instead of hiding behind Mommy, Leo puffed out his chest so the Cape of Courage could catch the air. 'Can my cape listen too?' Leo asked bravely. Dr. Sara let Leo listen to his own heartbeat first. Thump-thump, thump-thump! It sounded like a happy little drum. Leo sat still like a brave superhero while Dr. Sara checked his ears and counted his teeth. He did an amazing job. When it was all done, Dr. Sara gave him a shiny star sticker that sparkled like gold. Leo gently pressed the sticker right onto his red cape. On the walk home, Leo zoomed around the sidewalk, his red cape fluttering in the afternoon breeze. He wasn't scared of the doctor's office at all anymore, because he knew his bravery was always right there inside him, waiting to fly.

stories.title: Maya's Bedtime Cape
stories.text: The moon was peeking through Maya's bedroom window, painting soft silver patterns on the floor. It was time for bed, but Maya's room suddenly looked very big and a little bit shadowy. Shadows can look tricky when the lights go down. Maya pulled the soft blanket up to her chin and felt a tiny sleepy frown on her face. Daddy walked in carrying a shimmering, sparkly blue blanket. 'Ah, I see a tired little star,' Daddy whispered softly. 'Do you need the Cape of Courage for nighttime adventures?' Maya nodded sleepily. Daddy draped the sparkly blue blanket gently over Maya's shoulders like a cozy superhero cape. The tiny silver threads on the blanket twinkled just like real nighttime stars. Maya touched the soft fabric and felt a lovely, peaceful calm wrap all around her. 'Goodnight, shadows,' Maya whispered with a brave little giggle. The Cape of Courage made her feel safe, warm, and ready for dreamland. Daddy tucked her in tight, making sure her special cape was resting right across her chest. Maya closed her eyes and took a big, deep breath, smelling the lavender soap from her bath. She listened to the quiet, gentle sounds of the house. With her Cape of Courage keeping watch, Maya knew she was safe and loved. She drifted off to sleep with a happy smile, dreaming of flying over rainbow clouds and sparkling oceans, all tucked safely inside her cozy bed.

stories.title: Sam's Haircut Cape
stories.text: Sam sat in the big bouncy chair at the hair salon, looking at the shiny scissors on the counter. Snip, snip, went the hairdresser's shiny silver tools. Sam blinked his big brown eyes and clutched his stuffed bunny tightly. The cape on the chair felt a little heavy, and Sam wasn't sure he liked the buzzing sound of the clippers. The kind hairdresser knelt down and said, 'Hello there, little buddy. Are you ready for a magical transformation?' Sam wasn't so sure. Just then, Mommy pulled a bright yellow handkerchief from her pocket. 'Look, Sam! It’s your very own pocket Cape of Courage!' She tied it gently around Sam's stuffed bunny's neck, and then tied a matching yellow ribbon around Sam's wrist like a tiny bravery bracelet. Sam looked at his yellow ribbon and felt a big burst of happy energy. 'Look, Bunny, we are a team!' Sam giggled, giving his bunny a gentle squeeze. The Cape of Courage made Sam feel like he could do anything. When the hairdresser started to trim his curls, Sam closed his eyes and imagined he was a brave lion sitting on a sunny rock. He stayed very still, listening to the gentle snip-snip sounds. The hairdresser smiled and said, 'You are the most patient and brave lion I have ever seen!' When it was finished, Sam looked in the big mirror and saw a handsome boy with neat hair smiling right back at him. Sam puffed out his chest, touched his yellow bravery bracelet, and gave a proud little roar. He was ready for his next big adventure.

stories.title: Leo's Roaring Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with the morning sun, but today, his little tummy felt a tiny bit fluttery. It was his very first day at the big-kid swimming pool, and the water looked very big and very wide. Oh, Leo wanted to splash and play like a happy little frog, but his feet felt stuck right to the soft bedroom rug. He gave a soft whimper. Just then, Mama walked in carrying a wonderful surprise. It was a shiny, bright blue towel, draped over her shoulders just like a superhero cape! 'Look, Leo,' Mama whispered with a big, warm smile. 'This is the Cape of Courage. Whenever you wear it, your brave heart grows twice as big.' Leo’s eyes went wide with wonder. He reached out his hands and wrapped the soft, fluffy blue towel around his shoulders. He felt a warm hug from his special cape. 'Can it help me roar like a lion?' Leo asked bravely. 'It sure can,' Mama nodded. Leo took a deep, deep breath. He puffed out his chest, stood up tall, and gave a tiny, fierce, 'Roar!' Suddenly, the fluttery feeling in his tummy turned into happy, tickly bubbles. He marched all the way to the bathroom to brush his teeth, feeling mighty and strong. When they arrived at the pool, the big blue water still looked a little chilly, but Leo held tight to his shiny blue cape. He dipped one tiny toe into the water. Brrr! It was cool, but it felt so nice. With a giggle, Leo let go of Mama’s hand, stepped down the bright yellow stairs, and splashed the water with both hands. 'Look at me, Mama!' he cheered. 'I am swimming!' Mama clapped her hands with joy. Leo realized the bravery had been inside him all along, just waiting for the right moment to shine, wrapped up in his cozy, wonderful cape.

stories.title: Mia and the Magic Cape of Sharing
stories.text: The afternoon sunlight danced across the living room rug, where Mia sat surrounded by her favorite wooden blocks. She was building a magnificent castle with four tall towers and a sparkly red roof. It was the best castle in the whole wide world! Just then, her little baby brother, Toby, wobbled into the room on his chunky baby legs. He let out a happy squeal and reached out a chubby hand to grab a shiny yellow block right from Mia’s tower. Oh, no! Mia’s face scrunched up. She wanted to pull the block back and hug her castle tight so nobody else could touch it. Her bottom lip trembled, and she felt a hot, grumpy puff in her chest. But then, Grandma walked over, holding a golden silk scarf that danced in the breeze like a autumn leaf. 'Ah, Mia,' Grandma said softly, wrapping the scarf gently around Mia’s shoulders. 'This is the Cape of Sharing. It is made of kindness and big-kid hugs. When you wear it, sharing feels as warm as sunshine.' Mia looked down at the shimmering golden fabric. She took a deep breath, letting the grumpy puff float right out of her nose. She looked at Toby, who was looking up at her with big, wide, curious eyes. Mia smiled a gentle, sweet smile. Instead of hiding her blocks, she picked up a smooth blue triangle and placed it right in Toby’s tiny hands. Toby giggled and clapped his hands together with delight, stacking his very first block right beside Mia’s big castle. Mia’s heart felt so full, glowing brighter than the afternoon sun. Wearing her magic cape made her feel like the kindest, most wonderful big sister in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Sam's Nighttime Shield
stories.text: The moon was peeking through Sam’s bedroom window, painting soft silver shapes on the wall. It was bedtime, and the big, cozy bed was waiting. But Sam didn't want to get under the covers just yet. The room looked a little bit shadowy, and the hallway light was turned off. Sam held tightly to his stuffed bear, Barnaby, and felt a tiny wobble in his chin. He was growing up fast, but the dark still felt a bit too big. Daddy walked into the room carrying a dark green blanket that smelled like lavender and warm hugs. 'Ah, Sam,' Daddy whispered gently. 'I think you need your special Cape of Courage tonight. It keeps the room safe and cozy until the morning sun comes back.' Daddy draped the soft green blanket over Sam’s shoulders like a superhero ready for flight. Sam wrapped his hands tightly around the cozy fabric. It felt heavy and warm, like a gentle bear hug that wouldn't let go. 'Does it keep the shadows away?' Sam asked in a quiet voice. 'It chases them right out the window,' Daddy promised with a reassuring wink. Sam climbed into his big bed, pulling the green cape right up to his chin. He tucked Barnaby in safely beside him. The shadows on the wall didn't look scary anymore; they just looked like sleepy dancing trees. Sam closed his eyes, listening to the quiet sounds of the house. He felt so safe, so warm, and so very brave, wrapped tightly in his wonderful cape of courage, ready to drift off into sweet, happy dreams.

stories.title: Leo's Roaring Red Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with the morning sun, but today, his tummy felt a little bit fluttery. It was time for his very first day at the big-kid swimming pool, and the water looked so big and blue! Leo held onto his favorite stuffed bunny and whispered, 'I am not sure I want to go.' Just then, his big sister Maya walked in holding a magical square of sparkly red fabric. 'Look, Leo!' she whispered with a big smile. 'It is the Cape of Courage! When you wear it, your worries turn into brave little bubbles.' Leo touched the soft, shiny cloth. He tied it gently around his neck. Suddenly, he felt a warm, cozy tingle all the way down to his tiptoes. 'Can it help me splash?' Leo asked, his eyes wide with wonder. 'It helps you try anything new,' Maya cheered softly. Together, they walked down the hallway. With every step, Leo heard the gentle swish of his cape behind him. Swish, swoosh, swish! When they reached the noisy pool area, Leo took a deep breath. The water looked a little less scary now that he was a superhero. He dipped his tiny toes into the warm water. Brrr! It was chilly, but Leo just puffed out his chest and felt his red cape resting against his back. 'I can do this,' he whispered to himself. He took his mother's hand and stepped down the blue stairs. One step. Two steps. Three steps! Before he knew it, the water came up to his tummy, and he was giggling with joy. He blew big bubbles like a happy little fish. 'Look at me, Maya! I am swimming!' Leo beamed proudly. When it was time to go home, Leo folded his cape very carefully and placed it on his dresser. He knew that the magic cape was wonderful, but the bravest part was actually inside of him all along. He gave his bunny a big hug and smiled, ready for whatever wonderful adventures tomorrow would bring.

stories.title: Mia and the Midnight Cape
stories.text: The moon was peeking through Mia's bedroom window, painting silver stripes across her soft white rug. It was bedtime, but Mia's eyes were wide open like little saucers. The shadows in the corner of her room looked a little bit long and a little bit spooky tonight. Mia pulled the blankets all the way up to her chin and called out softly, 'Daddy?' Her daddy walked into the room with gentle footsteps and a warm, glowing nightlight. 'Are the shadows visiting again, sweet pea?' he asked softly. Mia nodded, her lip trembling just a little bit. Daddy smiled and reached behind the rocking chair. He pulled out a dark blue blanket covered in shiny, silver glow-in-the-dark stars. 'Ah, I think you need to wear the Midnight Cape of Courage tonight,' Daddy whispered. He draped the starry blanket gently over Mia's shoulders, tying the soft corners together in a neat little bow. 'This cape collects all the daytime sunshine and turns it into a shield of nighttime bravery,' Daddy explained. Mia touched the glowing silver stars. They felt warm and comforting against her pajamas. 'Does it keep the shadows away?' Mia asked in a tiny whisper. 'It makes the shadows turn into friendly dancing shapes,' Daddy promised, kissing her forehead. Mia snuggled down under her fluffy covers, keeping her special cape wrapped snugly around her shoulders. She watched the little stars glow softly on the blue fabric. One shadow by the bookshelf looked a little bit like a sleeping teddy bear, and another looked like a dancing bunny. Mia giggled quietly to herself. The room did not feel spooky anymore; it felt cozy and magical. She closed her heavy eyes, listening to the quiet sounds of the house. With her starry cape protecting her dreams, Mia drifted off to sleep, knowing she was safe, loved, and as brave as the night sky.

stories.title: Sam's Sunny Yellow Cape
stories.text: Sam stood at the very top of the big orange slide at the park. Below him, the slide stretched down, down, down like a twisty yellow river. Sam took one look down and felt his tummy do a little flip-flop. 'Too high,' he whispered, backing up a tiny step. Other children were laughing and zooming past him, but Sam just gripped the shiny green safety rails. Just then, his mommy walked over and knelt down beside him. She opened her bag and pulled out a bright, sunny yellow scarf that smelled like lavender soap. 'Is this the Cape of Courage?' Sam asked eagerly, his eyes sparkling. 'It sure is,' Mommy said warmly. 'This cape is woven from sunshine and happy giggles. Whenever you wear it, your feet get the zoomies for adventure.' Mommy wrapped the yellow scarf around Sam's neck, tying it into a lovely bow that fluttered in the afternoon breeze. Sam touched the soft fabric and felt a sudden rush of happy energy. 'Sunshine power activate!' Sam declared in a brave voice. He walked back to the top of the slide and sat down, holding onto the edges with his hands. He took a deep, happy breath of fresh air. He looked at the slide, and instead of looking scary, it looked like a fun yellow roller coaster. 'Ready, set, zoom!' Sam cheered. Whoosh! Down, down, down he went, flying as fast as the wind. The air tickled his nose and his laughter bubbled up and spilled out into the sunny afternoon. When he reached the bottom, he landed softly in the woodchips with a giant grin plastered across his face. He jumped right up, did a little happy dance, and yelled, 'Mommy, did you see me? I flew!' Sam kept his yellow cape on all the way to the car, feeling like the happiest, bravest little explorer in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Leo's Doctor Visit Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with a big stretch. Today was a very special day because Leo and Mommy were going to the doctor for a check-up! But sometimes, big doctor rooms and shiny little lights made Leo feel a tiny bit shy and nervous in his tummy. Mommy smiled her warmest smile and said, I have a surprise for you, brave explorer! She pulled out a bright, shiny blue cape. It felt super soft like a warm hug. This is the Cape of Courage, Mommy whispered gently. Whenever you wear it, your brave heart grows twice as big! Leo gasped with sparkling eyes. He slipped his little arms through the loops, and the cape fluttered right behind him like superhero wings. Wow, I feel so strong! Leo giggled, doing a happy little spin in the hallway. On the car ride to the clinic, Leo held onto his cape tightly. When they walked inside, the waiting room looked a little big and bright. Leo squeezed his cape and took a deep, steady breath. I am wearing my Cape of Courage, he whispered to himself. Soon, the kind nurse called his name. Nurse Sarah had a warm smile and a friendly wave. Hello there, Leo! Are you ready for a fun check-up today? Nurse Sarah asked sweetly. Leo nodded, feeling the soft blue fabric against his back. He hopped right up onto the big crinkly paper table all by himself. That deserves a high-five! Nurse Sarah cheered. Next, it was time to check his heartbeat with the cool stethoscope. It was a little bit cold, but Leo remembered his cape. He took another big breath and stayed as still as a statue. You did such an amazing job, Leo, Mommy praised, giving him a big, proud cuddle. When the visit was all done, Nurse Sarah handed Leo a shiny star sticker. Leo grinned from ear to ear and stuck it right on his shirt. Walking back to the car, Leo flapped his cape proudly in the gentle breeze. He wasn't nervous at all anymore. He was a real-life superhero who could do hard things with a brave smile.

stories.title: Mia's First Haircut Cape
stories.text: The sun was shining brightly through Mia's bedroom window, and today was haircut day! Mia looked in the mirror and touched her lovely curls. Her hair was getting so wonderfully long that it tickled her little nose whenever she giggled. But sitting in a big salon chair with buzzing sounds could sometimes feel a little overwhelming for a tiny toddler. Daddy knew just what to do. He tiptoed into the room holding a magical swirling purple cape covered in sparkling silver stars. Mia, look what the hair fairies left just for you! Daddy said in an excited whisper. It’s the magical Cape of Courage! Mia’s eyes widened with pure delight. She clapped her hands together and reached out. Oh! It sparkles just like magic dust! Mia cheered. Daddy carefully tied the soft purple cape around her neck, making sure she felt safe, cozy, and extra special. Together, they walked hand-in-hand to the friendly neighborhood salon where Miss Jessica was waiting with a big, welcoming smile. Good morning, Princess Mia! Are you ready for your fabulous royal trim? Miss Jessica asked kindly. Mia climbed up into the big red booster seat, patting her sparkling cape to make sure it was still there. I am very brave because of my cape, Mia announced proudly. Miss Jessica gently misted Mia’s curls with a spray bottle that smelled just like sweet strawberries. Mia giggled as the cool mist kissed her hair. Snip, snip, went the shiny scissors, making tiny dancing curls fall softly to the floor. Mia watched happily in the big mirror, playing with the starry fabric of her cape. You are sitting as still as a majestic queen, Daddy whispered, kissing the top of her head. In no time at all, the haircut was completely finished. Miss Jessica brushed off the cape and handed Mia a pink lollipop. Mia hopped down, spun around, and watched her cape swirl in a gorgeous circle. She felt so proud and happy. Mommy and Daddy cheered loudly for their superstar girl, who had conquered a brand new adventure with a brave, smiling heart.

stories.title: Sam's First Day at Preschool Cape
stories.text: The morning birds were singing outside, and Sam’s little yellow backpack was packed tight with a yummy apple and a brand new box of colorful crayons. Today was Sam’s very first day at preschool! It was a brand new place with brand new friends, and Sam suddenly felt a tiny flutter of butterflies right in his tummy. He held onto Mommy’s hand a little bit tighter. Mommy knelt down so she was right at Sam’s eye level and gave him a gentle, loving squeeze. I know today is big and new, my sweet boy, Mommy said softly. But remember, you always carry magic inside you. And to help it shine, I made something just for you. Mommy opened a colorful fabric pouch and pulled out a bright green cape. It had a big golden star stitched right in the very center. This is your Cape of Courage, Mommy explained tenderly. Whenever you wear it, you are ready for any fun adventure that comes your way. Sam’s face lit up with a huge grin. He put his arms through the straps, and the green cape draped gently over his shoulders. I can do anything now! Sam declared bravely, feeling like a daring forest ranger. When they arrived at the cheery preschool classroom, Teacher Anna greeted them with open arms and a warm, joyful hello. Welcome, Sam! We are so happy you are here today! Sam looked around at the fun toy blocks, the cozy reading corner, and the bright painting easel. He felt a wave of excitement wash away his butterflies. Mommy gave him one last snug hug. Have the best day ever, my brave explorer! she whispered. Sam waved goodbye with a confident smile, holding the edges of his green cape proudly. During storytime, he sat criss-cross applesauce right up front. At playtime, he shared his favorite red building block with a new friend named Lily. Whenever he felt just a tiny bit unsure, he gently touched the golden star on his cape and took a happy breath. By the time afternoon arrived, Sam ran into Mommy’s arms with a joyful laugh. I played with blocks, I painted a dinosaur, and I was so brave all day long! Sam cheered happily, his green cape fluttering in the afternoon breeze as they skipped all the way home together.

stories.title: Leo's Roaring Red Cape
stories.text: Leo was a very sweet little boy, but sometimes mornings felt a bit too big and busy. Today, Leo felt like staying hidden under his cozy yellow blanket. 'Good morning, my brave little lion,' said Mama with a warm smile. She gently unfolded a bright, shiny red scarf. 'Look what I found. It is the Cape of Courage! Whenever you wear it, your brave heart grows super strong.' Leo’s eyes went wide. He sat right up. 'Can I wear it?' he whispered. 'Of course,' said Mama, tying the soft red fabric gently around his little shoulders. 'Let us see what wonders it can do.' The first big adventure was brushing teeth. Usually, Leo did not like the tickly mint bubbles. But today, with his red cape swishing behind him, Leo stood extra tall. 'Roar!' he giggled, brushing his teeth like a fierce, happy dragon. Next came getting dressed. Putting on socks can sometimes make little toes wiggle with frustration. But Leo just smoothed his red cape and took a deep breath. 'I can do hard things,' he said proudly. He popped his feet right into his blue socks all by himself. Mama clapped her hands. 'Look at you go, superhero!' Breakfast was the next big mission. There was a bowl of warm, yummy oatmeal waiting at the table. Leo used his big spoon like a brave builder, scooping up every single bite. Whenever he felt a little tired, he just touched the soft red fabric on his back and felt a warm, happy wiggle of confidence inside his tummy. Soon, his shoes were tied, and he was ready for the big world outside. Leo looked in the mirror and gave a big, proud grin. He was not just a little boy anymore; he was Leo the Brave, ready to conquer the whole wide day with a smile.

stories.title: Mia and the Starry Blue Cape
stories.text: The sun was peeking through Mia’s bedroom window, painting the walls with golden morning light. Mia rubbed her sleepy eyes and gave a big stretch. Today was a very important day because Mia had to tidy up her playroom, and sometimes, putting toys away felt like a huge mountain to climb. Daddy walked in carrying a sparkly blue towel. 'Are you ready for your mission today, Captain Mia?' he asked cheerfully. 'I have a very special gift for you.' He draped the soft, starry blue towel over her shoulders. 'This is the Cape of Courage. It helps little hands do big, helpful jobs.' Mia touched the shiny silver stars printed on the fabric. A wave of happy energy tickled her toes. 'My cape!' she cheered. First stop: the towering mountain of colorful blocks. Usually, picking them all up took forever. But today, Captain Mia stood tall with her starry cape fluttering behind her. 'Time to fly!' she whispered. One by one, the red, green, and yellow blocks zoomed through the air and landed right inside their big wooden toy chest. Zoom! Whee! Cleaning up was actually turning into a fun game. Next, it was time to put the soft teddy bears to bed. Mia tucked each sleepy bear snugly onto the pink rug, making sure they were warm and cozy. 'Goodnight, bears,' she whispered softly, feeling so proud of how hard she was working. Daddy walked back in and gasped in amazement. 'Look at this sparkling clean room! You did it all by yourself!' Mia puffed out her chest, her blue cape shining in the sunlight. She gave Daddy a giant hug. Wearing the Cape of Courage made her feel like she could do absolutely anything in the whole world, one happy step at a time.

stories.title: Sammy and the Green Leaf Cape
stories.text: Afternoon sunlight danced across the grass, and it was time for Sammy to take a bath. Now, Sammy loved splashing in the water, but washing his hair with shampoo always made him worry about bubbles getting in his eyes. He sat on the edge of the tub, hugging his knees. Grandma smiled gently and reached for a fluffy green bath towel. 'Do you know what this is, Sammy?' she asked softly. 'It is the magical Cape of Courage made from soft forest leaves.' She wrapped the green towel around his shoulders like a superhero cape. 'Whenever you wear it, you are as brave as a little green frog hopping over lily pads.' Sammy blinked and touched the cozy green cotton. He felt a little bubble of bravery pop inside his heart. 'I am a brave frog?' he asked with a tiny smile. 'The bravest one in the whole pond,' Grandma answered. Sammy bravely climbed into the warm, bubbly water. Splash! He watched the little soap bubbles float up toward the ceiling like white clouds. When it was time to wash his hair, Sammy remembered his special cape. Instead of squeezing his eyes shut in a panic, he leaned his head back just a little bit and looked up at the bathroom ceiling. Grandma used a soft, wet washcloth to gently wipe away the soap, singing a happy little song while she worked. Sammy did not even cry once! He just held onto the corners of his green towel and smiled. When bath time was finally over, Sammy stepped out feeling fresh, clean, and wonderfully proud. He wrapped the green cape tightly around himself and did a happy little dance on the fluffy bath mat. He was clean, he was cozy, and he was the bravest little boy in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Leo's Roaring Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with the morning sun, but today, his tummy felt a little bit fluttery. It was his first day at the big-kid swimming pool, and the water looked very, very big. Leo sat on the edge of his bed and gave a quiet little sigh. Mama smiled softly and walked over, holding something very special behind her back. 'I think you might need this today, little lion,' she whispered. She wrapped a bright, shiny blue towel around his shoulders like a superhero cape. 'This is the Cape of Courage,' Mama said gently. 'Whenever you feel scared, just touch the soft fabric, and remember how brave you are inside.' Leo touched the blue towel. It felt warm and cozy. He stood up tall, and suddenly, he felt like he could do anything. At the pool, the water splashed and bubbled. Leo held onto his cape tightly as he walked down the steps. The water felt cold at first, but Leo squeezed his cape and took a big breath. 'I am brave!' he whispered to himself. He let go of the edge and splashed his feet. Splash, splash, splash! The fluttery feeling in his tummy went away, replaced by big, bubbly giggles. Mama cheered from the side, clapping her hands. 'Look at you go, Leo! Such a brave swimmer!' Leo beamed with pride. He didn't even need to hold his cape anymore because the bravery was right inside his heart. When it was time to go home, Leo folded his blue cape neatly and put it in his backpack. He learned that being brave doesn't mean you never feel scared; it means you try anyway, even when your tummy has fluttery butterflies. He could not wait to show his teddy bear his brand-new superpower tomorrow.

stories.title: Mia's Midnight Cape
stories.text: Nighttime was settling over the little yellow house, painting the sky in deep shades of purple and blue. Mia loved playing during the day, but when the lights turned off, her bedroom looked a little bit different. Shadows danced softly on the wall, and the big, dark room felt too quiet. Mia pulled the blankets up to her chin and felt a tiny tear at the corner of her eye. Papa peeked in through the doorway with a warm, loving smile. He walked softly across the rug and held up a cozy, golden blanket. 'Ah, I think it is time for the bedtime Cape of Courage,' Papa whispered softly. He draped the golden blanket gently over Mia's shoulders, tying it loosely so she could snuggle right inside. 'This cape is filled with day-sunshine and sweet dreams,' Papa explained. 'It keeps you safe and warm all through the night.' Mia touched the soft, velvety fabric. It felt like a gentle hug from the sun. She felt the warmth spread all the way to her tippy-toes. 'Will you stay close, Papa?' Mia asked softly. 'Always,' Papa promised, kissing her forehead. Mia snuggled into her golden cape and closed her eyes. The shadows on the wall didn't look scary anymore; now they looked like friendly little dancing stars. She listened to the gentle hum of the night-light and took a long, slow, sleepy breath. The day was done, and she had played so hard. With her special cape wrapped snugly around her, Mia felt completely safe and loved. She drifted off to sleep with a happy little smile on her face, ready to dream big, beautiful dreams until the morning light woke her up for a brand-new day of fun and little adventures.

stories.title: Sam's Sharing Cape
stories.text: The park was buzzing with bright laughter and the squeaks of swinging playground chains. Sam loved his shiny red fire truck toy more than anything in the whole wide world. He clutched it tightly in his hands as a little boy with curly hair walked up, looking at the truck with big, hopeful eyes. 'Can I play too?' the boy asked softly. Sam felt a sudden clutch in his tummy. His fingers gripped the fire truck a little tighter. Share? But it was his favorite! Sam looked down at the ground, feeling unsure. Nana knelt beside him and gently placed a bright yellow scarf around his neck. 'This is your Cape of Courage, sweet boy,' Nana whispered with a loving smile. 'Sharing can feel hard sometimes, but sharing makes happy hearts.' Sam touched the yellow silk. It fluttered gently in the afternoon breeze. He took a deep breath, remembering how good it felt when other kids shared their sidewalk chalk with him. Sam looked up at the little boy and smiled a brave, bright smile. 'We can take turns with the siren,' Sam said, his voice strong and clear. He held out the red fire truck. The little boy's face lit up like a birthday candle. They zoomed the fire truck down the slide together, making loud *neener-neener* sounds that echoed across the park. Sam felt a warm, bubbly feeling of pride bubble up inside his chest. Sharing wasn't losing a toy at all; it was making a brand-new friend. Nana clapped softly from the bench, her eyes shining with love. Sam touched his yellow cape and stood a little taller, knowing he had conquered a big toddler challenge all by himself.

stories.title: Leo's Roaring Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with a big stretch, feeling tiny. Today was a very big day because it was Leo's first day at the big swimming pool! But when Leo thought about the big water splashing all around, his tummy felt a little bit fluttery, like a tiny butterfly flapping its wings inside. 'Oh dear,' whispered Leo, pulling the cozy blanket up to his chin. Mama smiled a warm, gentle smile and walked over with something extra special draped gently over her arm. 'Do you know what this is, Leo?' she asked softly. Leo shook his head. 'It is the Cape of Courage!' Mama said. It was a bright, shimmering blue cape made of the softest fleece in the whole wide world, with shiny silver stars sewn right along the edges. Mama tied the soft ribbons gently around Leo's neck. As soon as the cape touched his shoulders, Leo felt a cozy, warm magic hug him tightly. 'This cape is filled with brave bubbles,' Mama whispered into his ear. 'Whenever you wear it, you can do hard things.' Leo looked down at the shiny silver stars. He took a big, deep breath in, smelling Mama's sweet lavender soap, and let it out slowly like a sleepy dragon. The fluttery feeling in his tummy started to slow down. 'I have my Cape of Courage,' Leo said proudly, his voice sounding much bigger and stronger now. With a happy hop, Leo jumped out of bed and stomped his little feet on the floor. Stomp, stomp, stomp! He felt as brave as a mighty lion and as strong as a jumping frog. Together, Leo and Mama walked to the bathroom to brush his teeth, and then down the hallway to put on his brand-new swim trunks. Every single step he took, the blue cape swished gently behind him like a quiet, friendly wave. When they finally reached the big swimming pool, the water looked huge, and the splashing sounded loud. Leo swallowed hard, but then he reached up and touched the soft fabric of his cape. The stars felt cool and magical under his little fingertips. 'I am brave,' Leo whispered to himself. With a giant smile, Leo walked right up to the edge of the blue water and held Mama's hand tightly. He wasn't scared anymore because his special cape was right there with him, keeping him safe and strong all day long.

stories.title: Maya and the Midnight Cape
stories.text: The sun was hiding behind the big green hills, painting the sky in pretty colors of pink and orange. It was almost bedtime in Maya's cozy yellow room. The moon was peeking through the window like a sleepy silver eye. Maya loved playtime, but she did not love the dark shadows that crept across her bedroom floor when the lights went out. 'Bedtime is too dark,' Maya whimpered, hugging her stuffed bunny so tightly that bunny's long ears squished. Papa sat down on the edge of the soft white bed and opened up a small, mysterious wooden box. 'Maya, my sweet little star,' Papa said in a voice as soothing as a gentle breeze, 'I have something very important for you.' Inside the box rested the Midnight Cape. It was a deep purple color, sprinkled all over with tiny, glowing yellow stars that seemed to twinkle even when the room lights were turned off. Papa lifted the cape and fastened the soft, velvety buttons underneath Maya's chin. The moment the cape settled on her shoulders, a wonderful, warm feeling spread all the way to her wiggly toes. 'This is the Cape of Courage,' Papa explained gently. 'It turns the dark shadows into friendly sleeping shadows. It holds all the bravery of the night sky.' Maya looked at her bedroom wall. The shadow that usually looked like a scary monster now looked just like a funny, sleeping teddy bear wearing a hat. The glowing stars on her cape seemed to shine a little bit brighter, whispering cozy secrets to her heart. 'I have my cape,' Maya said, her eyes growing wide and bright with wonder. She snuggled deep under the heavy, warm blankets, feeling completely safe and snug like a tiny baby bird in a high tree nest. Papa gave her a warm kiss on her forehead and turned off the big overhead light, leaving only the soft glow of her star-shaped nightlight. Maya touched the shiny yellow stars on her cape one by one, counting them softly to herself. One star, two stars, three stars. With every star she touched, her eyelids felt heavier and heavier, just like soft cotton.
