Maya closed her eyes, smiling happily in the dark, knowing her magical cape would protect her dreams all through the peaceful night until the bright morning sun came back to say hello.

stories.title: Sam's Superhero Cape
stories.text: The playground was loud and very busy. There were big kids running fast, swings flying high up into the clouds, and a tall slide that twisted around like a giant green snake. Sam stood right at the gate, holding tightly to Daddy's hand. His little red shoes stayed glued to the sidewalk. His heart went thump, thump, thump inside his chest. The other children looked so big, and Sam felt very small indeed. 'It is okay to feel shy,' Daddy said, kneeling down so his eyes were right at Sam's eye level. 'Let us put on your secret weapon.' Daddy reached into his big backpack and pulled out a brilliant, golden-yellow cape. It was the color of a warm morning sunbeam. Daddy tied it securely around Sam's neck, making sure the bow was neat and comfortable. 'Behold!' Daddy announced with a big, happy grin. 'The Cape of Courage!' Sam looked down at the bright yellow fabric fluttering gently in the playground breeze. As soon as he wore it, a tickly, happy feeling danced across his shoulders. It felt like a warm hug from the inside out. 'Does this make me fast?' Sam asked, his eyes sparkling with sudden excitement. 'It makes you brave enough to try anything,' Daddy answered encouragingly. Sam took a deep breath, puffed out his little chest, and took one big step through the gate. Swish went the golden cape behind him. He walked over to the sandbox where two friendly children were building a tall castle with wet brown sand. Sam walked right up to them, holding his head high. 'Can I help make the castle taller?' Sam asked, his voice sounding brave and clear. The children smiled and handed him a blue plastic shovel. Sam scooped up the sand, laughing as the grains slipped through his chubby fingers. He wasn't worried about the big kids or the tall slide anymore. He was too busy having fun. Whenever he felt a tiny bit nervous, he just reached back to touch the soft yellow cloth of his cape. It reminded him that he was strong, he was capable, and he could do wonderful things all by himself.

stories.title: Leo and the Brave New Shoes
stories.text:
Leo woke up with a big stretch. Today was a very special day because Leo was going to try something completely new. He was going to put on his brand new, shiny red shoes all by himself! But when Leo looked at the shoes, his tummy felt a little bit fluttery. The laces looked very long, and the shoes looked very big. Leo wanted to crawl right back under his cozy blanket and stay there.

Just then, Mama walked in with a big, bright smile. She was holding a sparkly piece of soft blue cloth. 'Good morning, my little explorer,' Mama whispered softly. 'I brought you something very special. This is the Cape of Courage. Whenever a new task feels too big, this cape gives you super-duper brave powers!'

Leo gasped. His eyes grew wide with wonder. He let Mama tie the soft blue cape gently around his neck. It felt warm like a hug from the sun. Suddenly, the fluttery feeling in Leo's tummy started to go away. He felt a little spark of power right in his toes!

'Okay,' Leo said in a big, brave voice. 'I am ready.' 

Leo sat down on his little blue rug. He grabbed the left shoe. With a little push and a wiggle, his foot slid right inside! 'Yay!' cheered Mama. Next, Leo grabbed the right shoe. He pulled the tongue up and wiggled his toes. Pop! His foot went right in.

Leo stood up tall. He looked down at his shiny red shoes. He did not need to hide under the blanket anymore because he was wearing his Cape of Courage. Leo stomped his feet on the floor. Stomp, stomp, stomp! He felt like a brave lion ready to take on the whole world. 

'Look, Mama! I did it all by myself!' Leo shouted happily. 

Mana clapped her hands. 'You certainly did, Leo. You showed so much bravery today. I am so proud of you.' Leo puffed out his chest, feeling happy and strong. Putting on shoes was not scary at all when you had a magical cape and a little bit of patience. Leo was ready for breakfast, ready to play, and ready for whatever fun adventures waited for him outside today!

stories.title: Mia’s Mighty Toothbrush
stories.text:
The sun was peeking through Mia’s bedroom window, painting little yellow squares on her fluffy rug. It was time for bed, which meant it was time for teeth-brushing. Mia loved the bubbles, but tonight, she felt very tired. Her eyes were droopy, and her little pink toothbrush looked as heavy as a giant tree trunk.

'Do I have to brush tonight?' Mia asked with a little sleepy sigh. She rubbed her eyes and curled up on the bathroom step.

Papa knelt down beside her with a gentle, loving smile. He was holding a shimmering golden towel. 'I know you are tired, sweet Mia,' Papa said gently. 'But remember, your teeth worked so hard today. They chewed yummy apples, crunchy carrots, and sweet strawberries. Now it is time to keep them sparkling clean. And I have just the thing to help.'

Papa draped the shimmering towel around Mia’s shoulders like a superhero cape. 'Behold,' Papa whispered playfully, 'The Cape of Courage! This cape gives you the power of the Mighty Sparkle Brush!'

Mia touched the soft, shiny fabric. A warm, happy feeling bubbled up inside her chest. She giggled. 'Does it give me superhero powers?' she asked.

'The very best kind,' Papa nodded. 

Mia stood up, feeling much taller and much stronger than before. She grabbed her little blue toothbrush and squeezed a tiny, pea-sized dot of sparkly mint toothpaste onto the bristles. She looked in the mirror and gave a fierce, brave growl. 

'Time to clean!' Mia announced. 

She opened her mouth wide. Up and down went the toothbrush. Brush, brush, brush! Around and around in little circles. She brushed the tops, she brushed the bottoms, and she even tickled her back molars. Papa sang a silly brushing song while Mia worked her magic. 

When she was all done, Mia rinsed with a big cup of water and spit into the sink. She flashed a big, wide grin in the mirror. Her teeth were shining like tiny white stars.

'Look, Papa! I did it!' Mia beamed with pride. 

Papa wrapped her in a big bear hug. 'You were so brave and strong tonight, Mia. Your smile is brighter than ever.' Mia climbed into her cozy bed feeling like a true nighttime hero, ready for sweet dreams.

stories.title: Oliver’s Clean-Up Adventure
stories.text:
The playroom floor was covered in a giant mountain of colorful toys. There were red blocks, blue trucks, soft teddy bears, and yellow plastic dinosaurs scattered everywhere you looked. It was time to clean up, but Oliver sat right in the middle of the mess and crossed his arms. A little frown appeared on his face.

'There are too many toys,' Oliver muttered, shaking his head. 'It is too hard.'

Grandma walked into the room holding a bright green, silky scarf that fluttered in the breeze like a leaf. She noticed Oliver’s little frown and smiled warmly. She sat down on the rug right beside him. 

'Ah, I see a mighty explorer who has encountered a giant mountain,' Grandma said softly. 'Every great explorer needs special gear. Here, put this on.' 

Grandma gently tied the green scarf around Oliver's neck. 'This is the Cape of Courage,' Grandma whispered. 'When you wear this, big messes shrink down to tiny, easy puzzles. You can conquer any mountain!'

Oliver touched the soft green fabric. He felt a warm, tingly feeling wash over his hands and toes. The messy room suddenly did not look quite so scary anymore. Oliver unfolded his arms and put his hands on his hips. 

'Okay,' Oliver said, feeling a surge of bravery. 'Let's clean!'

Grandma smiled. 'Where should we start?'

'The red blocks!' Oliver decided. 

With his Cape of Courage flapping softly behind him, Oliver crawled over to the red blocks. One by one, he picked them up and dropped them into their special wooden box. Clatter, clatter, crash! That was fun. Next, Oliver rescued the yellow dinosaurs. He marched them in a straight line right into their toy basket, making happy dinosaur noises as he went. Roar!

Step by step, toy by toy, the giant mountain of mess began to disappear. Oliver worked with big focus and a happy heart. Whenever he felt tired, he just touched his magical green cape and felt strong again.

Finally, the very last teddy bear was tucked safely into the toy chest. The playroom floor was completely clean and clear!

Oliver stood up and cheered, throwing his arms wide in the air. 'We did it, Grandma! The mountain is gone!'

Grandma hugged him tightly. 'You showed so much perseverance and courage today, Oliver. Look at this wonderful, tidy space! You are my favorite superhero.' Oliver smiled proudly, ready for his next fun adventure.

stories.title: Leo's Roaring Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with a big stretch, ready for a brand new day. But today, the hallway to the bathroom looked very, very long. And the potty chair looked a little bit scary and too big. Leo's tummy felt fluttery. He looked down at his favorite blue blanket, folded neatly on his bed. 'Hmm,' whispered Leo. 'I need some extra help today.' Mommy smiled a warm, cozy smile and brought over a shiny, sparkly blue cape. 'Is it time for magic?' asked Leo, his eyes going wide with excitement. 'It is time for the Cape of Courage,' Mommy said gently, tying the soft blue fabric around his little shoulders. 'Whenever you wear this, you have the biggest bravery in the whole wide world.' Leo stood up straighter. He puffed out his chest just like a brave lion. 'Roar!' he whispered. The fluttery feeling in his tummy began to turn into happy wiggles. With his blue cape swooshing behind him, Leo took one big step, then another. He walked right down the hallway, all by himself! He sat down on the big potty chair, feeling as tall and strong as a mountain. 'I did it!' cheered Leo, clapping his hands together. Mommy cheered too, giving him a huge, warm hug. 'You were so brave, my superhero!' Leo felt the biggest smile spread across his face. He washed his little hands with bubbly soap, watching the tiny bubbles dance in the sink. Wearing his special cape, everyday routines felt like grand adventures. He was ready for whatever came next. Breakfast, shoes, and playtime were waiting. With his cape tied securely, Leo knew he could try anything new today. He was a brave explorer of the morning, and nothing could stop his happy feet.

stories.title: Maya and the Brushing Dragon
stories.text: The sun was peeking through Maya's bedroom window, painting bright yellow stripes on her fluffy rug. It was time to brush her teeth, but Maya crossed her arms and shook her head. 'No brushies today,' she pouted. The bathroom sink felt too high, and the minty toothpaste tasted a little bit too strong. Daddy knelt down beside her with a twinkle in his eye. 'Ah,' said Daddy softly. 'I think someone needs a special helper today.' He gently draped a bright yellow towel like a superhero cape over Maya's shoulders. 'Behold!' Daddy whispered. 'The Cape of Sparkling Courage!' Maya touched the soft yellow fabric. It felt warm and cozy. 'Does this make me strong?' she asked. 'The strongest tooth-brusher in the land,' Daddy promised. Maya giggled and grabbed her purple toothbrush. She looked in the mirror and made a fierce dragon face. 'Grrr!' she growled, feeling a warm wave of bravery wash all the way from her toes to the top of her head. With her cape swoishing proudly, Maya climbed up on her step-stool. She opened her mouth wide. 'Time to chase away the sugar bugs!' she announced. Up and down went the bristles, round and round, tickling her teeth. She brushed the front, she brushed the back, and she even brushed her tongue. Daddy hummed a happy little song while she worked. When she was all done, Maya rinsed with cool water and spit into the sink. She looked in the mirror and flashed a big, wide grin. Her teeth sparkled like little pearls in the morning light. 'Look, Daddy! All the sugar bugs are gone!' she cheered, spinning around so her yellow cape fluttered in the air. Daddy clapped and kissed her forehead. Maya felt so proud. Brushing her teeth wasn't scary at all when she wore her cape of courage.

stories.title: Oliver's Shoe-Lacing Hero
stories.text: The morning air smelled like warm toast and fresh apples. It was time to get dressed and go to the park to feed the ducks. Oliver sat on the rug, pulling on his favorite red sneakers. But his shoes had laces, and laces were tricky. They twisted into messy knots, and Oliver felt a little grumpy puff of air escape his lips. 'These shoes are too hard,' Oliver mumbled, looking down at his feet. Grandma walked over, holding a bright green sparkly scarf. 'Do not worry, little helper,' Grandma said in her sweetest voice. 'Every hero needs a little magic.' She draped the green scarf around Oliver's shoulders like a superhero cape. 'This is the Cape of Patient Courage,' Grandma explained. 'It helps your fingers turn into clever little birds.' Oliver touched the soft green fabric and took a nice, deep breath. The grumpy feeling floated away like a little gray cloud. He looked at his shoelaces with new hope. 'Okay, clever bird fingers, let's go!' Oliver whispered. He crossed the two laces like bunny ears. He tucked one ear under the bridge and pulled it snug. Then, he made a loop just like Grandma showed him, wrapping the other lace around like a cozy blanket. With a little wiggle and a careful tug, a perfect bow popped up on his shoe! Oliver gasped in delight and clapped his hands together. 'I did it! Look, Grandma, I made a butterfly bow!' Grandma beamed with pride. 'You worked so hard and showed such wonderful patience!' Oliver proudly stood up, his green cape fluttering behind him as he walked to the door. He felt ready to conquer the day, one shoelace at a time. The ducks at the park were waiting, and Oliver was ready to walk right to them all by himself.

stories.title: The Cape of Courage and the Big Blue Tub
stories.text: Leo was a very smart, very sweet little boy who was almost three years old. Every evening, when the sun started to go down and painted the sky in soft pink and sleepy orange, it was time for Leo’s least favorite part of the day. It was bath time. Leo did not like the water splashing near his eyes. He did not like the big, bubbly bubbles that tickled his nose. When Mommy said, "Bath time, Leo!" Leo would cross his little arms, shake his head "no," and hide behind the living room sofa. But tonight was going to be different. Mommy walked over with a big smile and a special package wrapped in shiny silver paper. "For you, my brave little explorer," Mommy whispered softly. Leo tore off the paper and gasped. Inside was a magnificent, shimmering cape made of the softest blue cloth, sparkling with little silver stars. "It is the Cape of Courage," Mommy explained gently. "Whenever you wear it, you can do hard things." Leo’s eyes went wide. He put the shiny cape around his shoulders, and it tied with a cozy yellow ribbon. Suddenly, Leo stood up very tall. He felt a warm, tingly feeling right inside his tummy. He wasn’t just Leo anymore. He was Captain Leo, the bravest captain in the whole wide world. Captain Leo marched down the hallway with big, stomping footsteps. Thump, thump, thump! When he reached the big white bathroom, the giant tub looked a little bit scary, but Captain Leo touched his sparkly cape and remembered he was brave. "I can do it!" he cheered in a strong voice. Mommy filled the tub with warm, cozy water and gentle bubbles that looked like fluffy clouds. Captain Leo stepped right in. Instead of crying, he pretended the bubbles were sea foam and his washcloth was a magical sponge. He washed his arms, he washed his legs, and when it was time to wash his hair, he tilted his head way back and giggled as the water washed away. "Horray for the Captain!" Mommy cheered, wrapping him in a big, warm towel that felt like a hug. Leo dried off and gave Mommy the biggest cuddle. He knew that the Cape of Courage was special, but the true bravery came right from his own sweet heart. As he climbed into his cozy bed with his favorite teddy bear, Leo smiled in the dark. He couldn't wait to see what brave adventure tomorrow would bring.

stories.title: Maya and the Cape of Courage at the Playground
stories.text: Maya was a bright and joyful four-year-old girl who loved to run, jump, and giggle. But today, Maya was standing by the big playground slide, and her tummy felt all fluttery and nervous. The slide was very tall—almost as tall as the oak tree! It twisted and turned like a yellow snake, and some of the bigger kids were zooming down so fast that they shouted with glee. Maya took one step backward, held onto her pink jacket, and whispered, "It's too high, Daddy. I don't want to go." Daddy knelt down on the soft woodchips so he was right at Maya’s eye level. He reached into his backpack and pulled out a bright red piece of silky cloth. "Maya, my sweet girl, I have something magical for you," Daddy said warmly. "This is the Cape of Courage. When you wear it, your fears fly away like little birds." Maya gently touched the red fabric. It felt as soft as a bunny's ear. She slipped it over her head, and Daddy tied the ends loosely around her neck. Maya took a deep breath. She puffed out her chest and felt a surge of happy, confident energy tickle her fingers and toes. She was no longer just Maya; she was Maya the Magnificent, the bravest jumper in the universe. With her red cape fluttering gently in the afternoon breeze, Maya walked right up the wooden steps. One step, two steps, three steps! She held onto the smooth wooden railing and looked down at Daddy, who gave her a big thumbs-up and a proud smile. When she reached the very top, she sat down carefully at the edge of the yellow slide. For just a second, she felt a little flutter, but then she touched her cape and remembered how strong she was. "Here I go!" Maya squeled happily. Whoosh! Down she slid, faster and faster, her blonde curls bouncing behind her. When she landed in the soft woodchips at the bottom, she popped right up with a huge, beaming grin and threw her arms wide open. "I did it, Daddy! I was brave!" she shouted, clapping her hands together. Daddy scooped her up into a giant bear hug and spun her around in a circle. They walked home hand-in-hand, Maya’s red cape glowing brightly in the golden sunset. She knew that whenever she felt scared, courage was always inside her, just waiting for her to let it shine.

stories.title: The Cape of Courage and the Dentist's Chair
stories.text: Oliver was a very happy little boy who loved eating crunchy red apples and sweet, juicy strawberries. Because he used his teeth so much, it was time for him to go visit Dr. Smiles for a routine check-up. Oliver had never been to the dentist before, and the waiting room had big, shiny metal chairs and strange little lights that made him feel a little bit shy. He grabbed Grandpa’s hand very tightly and hid behind his favorite stuffed dinosaur toy. "I think the dentist is scary, Grandpa," Oliver whispered, his lower lip trembling just a tiny bit. Grandpa smiled a kind, gentle smile and gently rubbed Oliver's back. "I know it looks different, Oliver, but Dr. Smiles is a super-helper. And I have something that will help you feel extra strong." Grandpa opened his leather jacket and pulled out a brilliant, emerald-green cape that sparkled like shiny grass in the morning dew. "This is the Cape of Courage," Grandpa whispered mysteriously. "It was made just for mighty little boys who need a little boost of bravery." Oliver’s eyes went wide with wonder. He let go of his dinosaur and let Grandpa tie the emerald cape around his shoulders. The green cloth felt cool and comforting. Oliver stood up tall, straightened his cape, and felt a wave of green, glowing courage fill him right up to his tippy-toes. "I am Oliver the Brave Knight!" he announced in a proud, clear voice. Just then, a friendly nurse with a cheerful pink scrub top opened the door and called, "Oliver, are you ready for your adventure?" Oliver nodded bravely. He marched into the room and hopped right up into the big reclining chair, which felt just like a spaceship pilot's seat. Dr. Smiles walked in wearing a friendly smile and a funny paper mask. "Hello, Oliver! Can you open your mouth wide like a roaring lion?" Dr. Smiles asked playfully. Oliver remembered his green cape, puffed out his chest, and opened his mouth wide: "Roarrr!" Dr. Smiles used a little mirror that counted his teeth like hidden treasure. One, two, three, four, sparkling clean! It didn’t hurt at all. When it was finished, Dr. Smiles handed Oliver a shiny blue sticker shaped like a star. "You were the bravest patient of the day, Oliver!" the dentist cheered. Oliver beamed with pride, holding his star high in the air. On the walk home, Oliver skipped down the sidewalk, his green cape floating behind him like a banner of victory. He learned that being brave doesn’t mean you never feel scared; it means you do the right thing even when your tummy feels a little bit shy.

stories.title: Leo's Bright Red Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with a big stretch. Today was a very big day. It was the day Leo had to go to the dentist. Leo’s tummy felt a little bit fluttery, like a tiny bird flapping its wings inside. He held his favorite blue blanket close, but then he remembered something special. Today, he had his very own Cape of Courage! The cape wasn't made of magic cloth; it was a shimmering, sparkly gold towel that his big sister tied gently around his neck. 'This cape makes you brave, Leo,' she whispered with a warm smile. Leo touched the soft fabric and felt a warm, cozy feeling tickle his heart. When they got to the big dentist chair, Leo climbed right up. The friendly dentist smiled and held up a tiny mirror. Leo pulled his golden cape tight around his shoulders. 'Look at that super cape!' said the dentist. 'Are you a superhero today?' Leo nodded proudly. He opened his mouth wide and let the dentist count his shiny white teeth. One, two, three, four! He didn't even need to squeeze his eyes shut. He just breathed in deeply and pictured himself flying high above the clouds like a brave superhero. When it was all done, the dentist gave him a bright green sticker shaped like a star. Leo skipped all the way to the car, holding his star high in the air. He flapped his golden towel-cape in the gentle breeze and giggled. 'I did it!' Leo cheered. Mommy clapped her hands and gave him a huge, squeezing hug. 'You were so brave, my superhero!' Back home, Leo hung his Cape of Courage carefully on the doorknob, ready for the next big adventure. He learned that being brave doesn't mean you never feel scared. Being brave means you do the hard things anyway, especially when you have a little bit of magic tucked right inside your heart, and maybe a sparkly gold cape to help you along the way.

stories.title: Mia's Shiny Blue Cape
stories.text: The sun was peeking through Mia’s bedroom window, painting bright yellow squares on the soft blue carpet. It was time to wake up, but Mia wanted to hide under the covers. Today was her very first day at the big park playground, and there were going to be big kids everywhere, zooming down giant slides and swinging high into the sky. Mia felt shy. Her feet felt heavy like they were filled with mud. Daddy walked into the room carrying a magical item. It was a bright blue silky scarf, just the right size to be a Cape of Courage. 'For the bravest little girl in the whole wide world,' Daddy said softly as he draped it over Mia’s shoulders. Mia touched the cool, smooth fabric. A little spark of joy popped inside her tummy. She stood up tall and took a deep breath. At the park, the sounds were very loud. Kids were laughing and running fast. Mia held tightly to the edge of her blue cape. She walked over to the sandbox, where a little boy was building a tall, wonky tower. Mia’s cape rustled in the wind, cheering her on. 'Can I help?' Mia asked in a small, polite voice. The little boy beamed and handed her a bright yellow shovel. Soon, they were building a magnificent castle with a deep moat and a sandy bridge. Mia forgot all about being shy. She climbed up the little stairs to the slide, her blue cape trailing behind her like a superhero's flag. Wheee! She slid all the way down, laughing out loud with pure delight. When it was time to go home, Mia gave Daddy a giant hug. 'Did you like the park?' Daddy asked. Mia nodded happily, patting her blue cape. 'I was super brave today!' she declared proudly. Daddy smiled and kissed her forehead. Mia knew that whenever she felt shy, her Cape of Courage would always be there to help her shine bright.

stories.title: Toby's Green Adventure Cape
stories.text: Nighttime was coming, and the bedroom lights were turned down low. It was time for Toby to sleep in his big-boy bed all by himself for the very first time. Toby looked at his cozy bed. It looked so big, and the shadows on the wall looked a little bit wiggly and strange. Toby grabbed Mommy’s hand and whispered, 'I think I want to sleep in my crib again.' Mommy knelt down beside him and gave him a gentle cuddle. 'I understand, sweet boy. But remember what we made today?' Mommy reached over and picked up a soft, fuzzy green blanket. Together, they draped it gently over Toby’s shoulders like a superhero cape. 'This is your Cape of Courage, Toby,' Mommy explained. 'It keeps you safe and cozy, no matter what.' Toby touched the green fuzz. It felt warm and friendly against his skin. He climbed into his big-boy bed, tucking his arms inside his green cape just like a cozy caterpillar in a leaf. The room was quiet, but Toby didn't feel lonely anymore. He felt like he was wrapped in a big, comforting hug from Mommy and Daddy. He looked at the shadows on the wall, and with his cape keeping him safe, he saw that one shadow looked just like a funny jumping frog! Toby giggled softly into his pillow. He closed his eyes and listened to the quiet sounds of the house. His tummy felt calm and peaceful. Mommy peeked in through the doorway and whispered, 'Are you okay, my superhero?' Toby smiled in the dark, pulling his green cape up to his chin. 'I'm very okay, Mommy,' he whispered back. He drifted off to sleep, dreaming of flying through starry green skies, knowing he was brave, strong, and deeply loved, all wrapped up in his special cape.

stories.title: Leo's Roaring First Day
stories.text: Little Leo woke up with the biggest yawn in the whole wide world. Today was his very first day at preschool, and his tummy felt a little bit fluttery, like a butterfly trying to tickle him from the inside. He pulled the cozy blanket up to his chin and whispered, 'I'm not so sure I want to go.' Mommy walked in with a big, bright smile, holding a shiny, shimmering blue fabric that sparkled in the morning light. 'Look what I found in the magic basket,' Mommy said softly. 'It is the Cape of Courage!' Leo sat right up. The cape was soft as a cloud and smelled like sweet strawberries. 'When you wear this special cape,' Mommy explained gently, 'it helps you find the brave lion that lives right inside your heart.' Leo carefully slipped the shiny blue cape over his shoulders. As the silky fabric touched his back, he felt a warm, cozy tingle spread all the way down to his toes. He stood up tall and let out a little 'Roar!' just like a strong, happy lion. At preschool, there were so many new toys, towering wooden blocks, and fingerpaints in every color of the rainbow. Leo wanted to play with the big red fire truck, but another little boy was already holding it. For a second, Leo felt his fluttery tummy again. Then, he touched the soft fabric of his Cape of Courage. He took a deep, steady breath, walked right over, and asked with a sweet smile, 'Can I be the firefighter too?' The other boy beamed and handed him a shiny yellow helmet. Leo's heart did a happy dance. He didn't even need Mommy to stay because his magical cape was helping him shine so bright. When it was time to go home, Leo gave Mommy the biggest hug ever and whispered, 'My cape made me super brave today!' Mommy kissed his forehead and said, 'You were brave all by yourself, sweet boy. The cape just helped you remember.' Leo skipped all the way to the car, feeling proud, happy, and ready for whatever adventure tomorrow would bring.

stories.title: Maya and the Dark-Time Bedtime
stories.text: The sun was sinking low, painting the sky in lovely shades of pink and sleepy purple. It was time for bedtime, but Maya wanted to keep playing with her fluffy teddy bear. When Daddy turned off the big overhead light, the bedroom suddenly looked a little too shadowy and big. Strange shapes danced gently on the wall. Maya pulled the blankets tightly over her knees and whispered, 'It is too dark, Daddy. I want the light.' Daddy smiled warmly, sat on the edge of the bed, and reached into his pocket. 'Ah,' Daddy whispered. 'I almost forgot. You need your bedtime Cape of Courage.' He pulled out a tiny, glowing cape made of soft, starry fabric that twinkled just like the night sky. Maya gasped. It was the most beautiful thing she had ever seen. Daddy draped the starry cape carefully over Maya's shoulders. 'This cape is filled with moonlight and brave wishes,' Daddy whispered softly. 'It chases away the silly shadows and keeps you safe all through the night.' Maya touched the shiny silver stars sewn onto the fabric. Instantly, she felt a wave of cozy warmth wrap around her like a giant, loving hug. She laid her head down on her soft pillow and hugged her teddy bear tight. 'Thank you, starry cape,' she whispered. She looked at the shadows on the wall again, but this time, they didn't look scary at all. One shadow looked like a dancing bunny, and another looked like a sleepy cat. Maya closed her heavy eyes, feeling safe, loved, and wonderfully brave in the dark. Daddy stroked her soft curls and sang a sweet lullaby. Maya drifted off to sleep with a happy smile on her face, dreaming of flying high above the stars in her very own magical cape, knowing morning would bring a brand new day full of sunshine and fun.

stories.title: Sam's Big Splash at the Pool
stories.text: Splish, splash, went the water in the big blue swimming pool. Sam stood at the edge with his brand new swim trunks, holding tightly to Daddy's hand. The water looked enormous, and the big blue slide looked like a giant slippery mountain. Sam took one tiny step back and shook his head. 'No thank you, Daddy. The water is too loud,' Sam said, hiding behind Daddy's leg. Daddy knelt down to Sam's eye level and gave his nose a gentle boop. 'I understand, little buddy. New things can feel very big and surprising,' Daddy said with a kind, reassuring smile. 'Let's see if we have a secret helper.' Daddy opened Sam's bright green beach bag and pulled out a sunshine-yellow towel. But wait—it wasn't just a towel! Daddy tied the corner gently around Sam's neck, turning it into a brilliant Cape of Courage. 'This is the Splash-Hero Cape,' Daddy whispered proudly. 'It gives tiny tots the power of a happy little dolphin.' Sam looked down at the bright yellow cape fluttering in the gentle breeze. He touched the soft cotton and felt a sudden burst of wiggly excitement. A dolphin? He loved dolphins! Sam puffed out his chest, wiggled his toes, and made a happy dolphin sound: 'Eee-ee-ee!' With his sunshine cape protecting him, Sam walked right up to the shallow step. He dipped one little toe into the cool, sparkling water. It felt refreshing and fun, not scary at all. He took another step, and then a little splash! Before he knew it, Sam was kicking his feet and making huge, joyful splashes that sent sparkling water droplets flying everywhere. 'Look at me, Daddy! I'm a brave dolphin!' Sam giggled, his laughter ringing out across the sunny pool deck. When it was time to get out, Sam wrapped himself in his yellow cape and gave Daddy a giant, dripping hug. He had conquered the big blue pool, and his heart felt as warm and bright as the summer sun.

stories.title: Leo's Doctor Visit Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with the sun shining brightly on his fuzzy blanket. Today was a very big day because Leo had to visit Dr. Sara for a check-up. Sometimes, big places with big machines and loud noises could feel a little bit scary for a little boy. Leo sat on the edge of his bed and looked down at his tiny toes. He wanted to feel brave, but his tummy felt full of fluttering butterflies. Just then, his big sister Maya walked into the room holding something sparkly and bright. It was a shiny blue cape made from a silky pillowcase! 'For you, superhero Leo,' Maya whispered with a warm, gentle smile. Leo took the cape and tied the soft ribbons carefully around his neck. As the silky blue fabric fluttered behind him, Leo felt a wonderful whoosh of warm courage fill up his chest. 'I am Captain Brave-Heart,' Leo said in his strongest, proudest voice. When they got to the doctor's office, the room smelled like rubbing alcohol and paper rolls. Leo held tight to his cape. When Dr. Sara smiled and asked if she could listen to his heartbeat with the cold stethoscope, Leo looked at his cape and remembered how strong he was. He took a deep, brave breath. 'Okay,' Leo said. The stethoscope felt cold for just one tiny second, and then it was all done! Dr. Sara clapped her hands and gave him a shiny star sticker. On the way home, Leo skipped down the sidewalk, his blue cape billowing in the afternoon breeze. He had done it! He faced the big doctor's office all by himself, and he felt like the proudest little boy in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Mia's Dark Room Adventure
stories.text: The sun was dipping down behind the hills, painting the sky in lovely shades of sleepy purple and orange. It was bedtime for Mia. Usually, bedtime was cozy and warm, but tonight, the shadows in the corner of her bedroom looked just a little bit too tall and a little bit too spooky. Mia pulled her fluffy yellow blanket all the way up to her chin and blinked big, watery eyes. She did not want the lights to go out. Her mommy sat gently on the edge of the mattress and brushed Mia's soft curls away from her forehead. 'Are you feeling a little nervous about the dark, sweet girl?' Mommy asked softly. Mia nodded and pointed at the dancing shadows. Mommy smiled and reached into Mia's toy chest. She pulled out a bright red superhero cape that Mia had made out of an old scarf. 'Every great explorer needs a special cape for nighttime missions,' Mommy said, wrapping it around Mia's shoulders. Mia touched the soft red fabric. Suddenly, she did not feel so small anymore. She felt like a brave space voyager exploring a quiet, starry galaxy. 'I am Commander Mia,' she whispered bravely to the shadows. Mommy kissed her forehead, turned on her friendly glowing star nightlight, and whispered goodnight. The shadows did not look spooky anymore; they looked like sleeping friends resting on the walls. Mia snuggled down into her pillows, holding the corner of her red cape tightly. She closed her eyes, ready to dream wonderful, heroic dreams, knowing she was safe, cozy, and wonderfully brave all through the quiet night.

stories.title: Sam's First Day at Preschool
stories.text: Sam stood right by the big front door of the preschool, holding tightly to his daddy's hand. His brand-new yellow backpack was zipped up tight, and his brand-new shoes were squeaking softly against the shiny floor. But Sam's feet felt like they were glued firmly to the welcome mat. There were so many new children playing with blocks and laughing loudly. It was very loud and very busy. Sam hid behind his daddy's leg and sucked his thumb. He wasn't quite sure he was ready for all of this. Daddy knelt down to Sam's eye level and gave him a gentle squeeze. 'Remember what we packed in your backpack, buddy?' Daddy asked with an encouraging wink. Sam’s eyes lit up. He remembered! He quickly unzipped his bag and pulled out a shimmering green cape made from a shiny party tablecloth. With Daddy's help, Sam tied the green cape around his neck. Instantly, the magic green fabric gave him a super-powered boost of confidence. 'I am the Green Guardian,' Sam announced, standing up as tall as a mighty oak tree. His shyness melted away like a snowflake on a warm mitten. Daddy walked him over to the puzzle table, where a little boy was trying to build a tall tower. Sam marched right up, his green cape swoishing behind him. 'Do you need help with that rocket ship?' Sam asked the little boy cheerfully. The boy smiled and nodded, handing Sam a bright red puzzle piece. Sam snapped it right into place, feeling like a true master builder. When Daddy waved goodbye later, Sam didn't cry at all. He just smiled, patted his green cape, and went off to explore his very first, wonderful day of school.

stories.title: Leo's Roaring Cape
stories.text: Leo woke up with a big stretch. Today was a very special day because Leo was going to try something new. He was going to put on his big boy shoes all by himself, without any help from Mommy or Daddy. But when Leo looked at his tiny sneakers, his tummy felt a little bit fluttery. It felt like a tiny butterfly was doing a somersault right inside. The laces looked so long, and the shoes looked so tricky! Mommy smiled and gave Leo a magical blue blanket. 'Here is your Cape of Courage, Leo,' she whispered softly. Leo wrapped the soft, cozy blue blanket around his little shoulders. Suddenly, he did not feel so small anymore. He felt as big and strong as a roaring lion. 'I am brave,' Leo whispered to himself. He sat right down on the soft bedroom rug and grabbed his left shoe. He pulled and tugged with all his might. Pop! His little foot went right inside. Yay! Leo clapped his hands with pure joy. Then, he grabbed his right shoe. It was a little bit stubborn, but Leo was stronger. He wiggled his toes, pushed his heel down, and secured the velcro straps with a loud, happy *CRACKLE*. Leo stood up tall in the middle of his bedroom. He stomped his feet on the floor. Stomp, stomp, stomp! He was a brave lion wearing his Cape of Courage. Mommy cheered, and Leo gave her a giant, proud hug. He had done it all by himself! Putting on shoes was not scary at all when you wore a magical cape. Leo skipped down the hallway for breakfast, ready for whatever wonderful adventures the day would bring. The end.

stories.title: Maya and the Superhero Spoon
stories.text: It was lunchtime at Maya's house, and the kitchen smelled wonderfully yummy. Daddy had made bright orange carrot soup and warm, cheesy bread. Maya loved yummy food, but today there was a green vegetable on her plate that looked a little bit fierce. It was a single, bumpy green broccoli tree. Maya looked at the broccoli tree, and the broccoli tree looked right back at her. Maya blinked. The broccoli did not look very friendly. Her mouth clamped shut like a little turtle shell, and she shook her head. 'No thank you,' she said in her quietest voice. Daddy knelt down beside her chair. He did not rush her. Instead, he smiled and handed her a shiny yellow napkin to tuck right under her chin. 'Ah, I think you need a Cape of Courage for this big mission, Maya,' Daddy said gently. Maya tucked the bright yellow napkin securely around her neck. *Whoosh!* Just like that, she was not just Maya anymore. She was Super Maya, protector of the lunch table, and nothing could defeat her! Super Maya took a deep breath. She picked up her shiny silver spoon. She looked at the green broccoli tree with brave, sparkling eyes. 'I am a strong superhero,' Maya declared proudly. She scooped up the little broccoli tree. It was very brave of her to try something new. Maya opened her mouth and took a little bite. Crunch! It tasted fresh, and not scary at all. In fact, it tasted pretty good with a little bit of cheese! Daddy clapped his hands together and cheered. 'You did it, Super Maya!' Maya giggled and ate another bite. With her yellow Cape of Courage on, trying new foods was just another fun adventure. The end.

stories.title: Sam's Starry Bedtime Cape
stories.text: The moon was shining brightly outside Sam's bedroom window, painting soft silver patterns on the floor. It was time for sleepy-time, but Sam did not want to close his eyes just yet. The shadows in the corner of his room looked a little bit long, and his big bed felt awfully big all by itself. Sam let out a little sigh and cuddled close to his stuffed bear, Barnaby. Daddy walked into the room, holding Sam's favorite red cardigan. It was soft, warm, and smelled like lavender soap. 'Is it a little hard to say goodnight to the toys, Sam?' Daddy asked kindly. Sam nodded, resting his heavy head against Barnaby. Daddy smiled and gently placed the red cardigan over Sam's shoulders backwards, so it looked just like a superhero's cape. 'This is your Cape of Courage, Captain Sam. It keeps you safe and brave all through the starry night,' Daddy whispered. Sam touched the soft red fabric. He could feel a warm, cozy feeling spreading all the way from his shoulders down to his toes. The long shadows did not look scary anymore; they just looked like sleepy giants resting. Captain Sam climbed into his cozy bed and pulled the soft quilt up to his chin. He held Barnaby tightly in his arms. 'Goodnight, moon,' Sam said in a brave, steady voice. He closed his eyes, feeling safe and protected inside his wonderful red cape. Daddy softly patted his head and whispered goodnight. Sam drifted off to sleep, dreaming of flying high above the clouds on his next big adventure. The end.

stories.title: Leo and the Brave Cape
stories.text: Leo was a sweet little boy who was getting ready for his very first day at preschool. His tummy felt full of wiggly, giggly butterflies. He stood by the front door, clutching his favorite blue shoes, feeling very small and a little bit shy. Mama smiled warmly and knelt down beside him. She held up a bright, shiny yellow towel. 'Look, Leo,' Mama whispered softly. 'This is your special Cape of Courage. Whenever you feel shy or unsure, you can wear this, and it will help you find your brave inside.' Leo’s eyes went wide with wonder. He let Mama gently tie the soft yellow towel around his little neck. As the gentle fabric touched his shoulders, Leo felt a warm, cozy bubble of safety and strength pop right inside his heart. He took a deep, happy breath. 'I am wearing my Cape of Courage!' Leo giggled, standing up tall and proud. With his head held high and a big brave smile, Leo walked right out the front door and down the sunny sidewalk. At the preschool gate, he waved a cheerful goodbye to Mama and marched right into the colorful classroom to play with the blocks. He shared his toys with a new friend, built a giant tower all the way to the ceiling, and clapped his hands when it fell down with a fun crash. Leo learned that the cape was wonderful, but the brave feelings had been hiding right inside his own kind heart the whole time. He was so proud of himself for trying something new. When Mama came to pick him up later that afternoon, Leo ran into her open arms, spinning around in his imaginary yellow cape. 'Mama, I was so brave today!' he cheered happily. Mama hugged him tight, kissing the top of his head. 'Yes, my sweet boy, you were the bravest explorer of all.' They walked home hand in hand, ready for all the wonderful adventures waiting for them tomorrow.

stories.title: Mia’s Nighttime Magic
stories.text: When the sun went down and painted the sky in shades of sleepy purple and pink, it was time for little Mia to go to sleep. But Mia’s bedroom felt a tiny bit big, and the shadows on the wall looked like funny, dancing giants. Mia pulled her cozy blankets right up to her chin, feeling a little flutter of worry in her chest. Papa walked into the room holding a special green blanket. 'Ah, I see someone needs a little extra sparkle tonight,' Papa said with a loving grin. 'This is your Cape of Courage, Mia.' Papa draped the soft green blanket gently over Mia’s shoulders like a superhero cape. Mia touched the velvety fabric, and instantly, her shoulders relaxed. 'Does it keep the shadows away?' Mia asked in a sleepy whisper. 'It does even better than that,' Papa explained softly. 'It reminds you of how strong, safe, and deeply loved you are.' Mia smiled, feeling a wave of gentle courage warm her up from her toes to the top of her curls. She snuggled down deep into her bed, hugging her favorite stuffed bunny tightly. Papa turned on the soft star nightlight, which painted tiny glowing stars all over the ceiling. Mia watched the gentle lights dance above her head. She knew that even when the room was dark and quiet, she was completely safe in her cozy bed. Her eyelids began to feel heavy, like two warm little pillows. 'Goodnight, my brave little star,' Papa whispered, kissing her forehead. Mia closed her eyes with a peaceful sigh, dreaming of flying high through the starry night sky wrapped in her magical green cape. She slept soundly all through the night, waking up bright and early the next morning feeling rested, happy, and ready for a brand new day full of fun and discovery.

stories.title: Sam Tries Something New
stories.text: It was lunchtime at the little green kitchen table, and Nana had made a brand new food for Sam: bright orange sweet potato cubes. Sam looked at the orange cubes on his plate and frowned. He shook his head and crossed his little arms. 'No thank you,' Sam mumbled, hiding his face in his hands. He liked his familiar foods, and this new food looked a little bit strange. Nana didn't get upset. Instead, she reached into her apron pocket and pulled out a magical, sparkly red napkin. 'Wait a minute, Sam,' Nana said with a twinkling eye. 'I think you need your Cape of Courage today.' She gently tucked the red napkin around the collar of Sam’s shirt. Sam touched the sparkly napkin and giggled. 'Is this for my magic powers?' Sam asked, his big brown eyes sparkling with sudden curiosity. 'It certainly is,' Nana nodded gently. 'It gives you the superpower to try new things and discover how yummy the world can be.' Sam took a deep breath, feeling his brave energy grow inside him. He picked up his shiny spoon with his strong hand. He scooped up just one little orange cube and brought it carefully to his mouth. He closed his eyes and took a tiny, brave nibble. To his absolute surprise, it tasted sweet, soft, and delicious, just like a warm hug! Sam opened his eyes wide and smiled a huge, proud smile. 'Nana, it’s yummy!' Sam cheered happily, taking another big bite all by himself. Nana clapped her hands with joy. 'Look at you go, my brave little champion!' Sam finished every single bite of his sweet potatoes, feeling like the strongest, most adventurous boy in the whole wide world. He learned that trying something new is never as scary as it looks, especially when you have a little bit of courage and someone special cheering you on.

stories.title: Leo's Bright Yellow Cape
stories.text: Leo was a sweet little boy who was getting ready for his very first day at preschool. But today, his tummy felt a little bit fluttery. It felt like a tiny bird was flapping its wings inside! Leo looked at his big yellow backpack and whispered, 'I am not sure I want to go.' Mommy knelt down on the soft rug and gave him a warm, cozy hug. 'I know you feel a little nervous, Leo, and that is okay. But guess what? I have a special secret just for brave explorers like you.' Mommy went to the couch and picked up a bright, shiny yellow cape made from a soft towel. She gently tied it around Leo's shoulders. 'This is the Cape of Courage,' Mommy whispered with a loving smile. 'Whenever you wear it, it fills you up with giant-sized bravery so you can try new things.' Leo touched the soft yellow fabric. He felt a warm tingle start at his neck and spread all the way down to his toes. The fluttery feeling in his tummy began to turn into bouncy, happy bubbles. 'Can I wear my cape to preschool?' Leo asked, his eyes sparkling with excitement. 'Of course you can,' Mommy said gently. With his shiny yellow cape flowing behind him like a superhero, Leo walked right out the front door. He held Mommy’s hand tightly, took a big deep breath, and stepped onto the sunny sidewalk. When they reached the classroom, Leo saw the big room filled with toys, paints, and friendly new friends. The teacher waved hello with a big, happy smile. Leo looked down at his bright yellow cape and felt strong and brave. He let go of Mommy’s hand, gave her a big goodbye hug, and walked proudly into the room to build the tallest block tower ever. You did it, Leo! You are a brave superhero!

stories.title: Mia and the Midnight Cape
stories.text: The moon was peeking softly through Mia’s bedroom window, painting the walls with gentle silver light. It was time for bedtime, but Mia’s big brown eyes were wide open. Her favorite teddy bear, Barnaby, sat quietly on the pillow. 'The dark is too big,' Mia whispered, pulling her cozy blankets up tight around her chin. Daddy walked into the room, holding something very special in his hands. It was a dark blue blanket covered in tiny, glowing silver stars. 'Is it time for sleep?' Daddy asked softly, sitting on the edge of the bed. 'I am scared of the dark shadows,' Mia said, her lower lip trembling just a little bit. Daddy smiled and gently draped the starry blanket over Mia’s shoulders like a superhero cape. 'This is the Midnight Cape of Courage,' Daddy told her in a soothing, quiet voice. 'It is made of magic starlight. Whenever you wear it, the dark cannot scare you because you carry your own bright light right inside.' Mia touched the soft fabric and looked at the glowing silver stars. She felt a warm, cozy bubble of safety wrap all around her. The spooky shadows in the corner suddenly looked like dancing friendly giants. 'My cape is magic,' Mia whispered proudly. 'It is the most magic cape in the whole wide world,' Daddy agreed, kissing her forehead. Mia snuggled down under the covers, keeping her starry cape wrapped securely around her shoulders. She felt safe, she felt cozy, and most of all, she felt brave. Barnaby the bear snuggled right beside her. Mia closed her eyes, ready to drift off to sleep for sweet, happy dreams. Sleep tight, brave little Mia, under your starry sky.

stories.title: Oliver's Doctor Visit Cape
stories.text: Oliver loved playing outside, running fast, and jumping over little rocks in the backyard. But today was a very different kind of day. Today was the day to visit Dr. Sarah for a checkup. Oliver sat on the edge of the examining table, holding his toy puppy very tightly. His heart was beating thump-thump, thump-thump. He did not want the doctor to look in his ears or check his heartbeat with the cold stethoscope. Grandma noticed that Oliver looked worried, so she reached into her big canvas bag with a gentle smile. 'Close your eyes, Oliver,' Grandma whispered. Oliver squeezed his eyes shut. When he opened them, Grandma was tying a bright red cape around his neck. It tied gently with a soft yellow ribbon. 'What is this?' Oliver asked, giggling a little bit. 'That,' Grandma said proudly, 'is the Super Checkup Cape of Courage. Doctors love helpers who wear this cape because it gives them super-strength and super-listening ears.' Oliver felt the soft red fabric resting on his back. A big wave of confidence washed over him. Just then, Dr. Sarah walked into the room wearing a friendly smile and holding a funny-looking tool. 'Hello, Oliver! Wow, I see a superhero in my room today!' Dr. Sarah said cheerfully. Oliver puffed out his chest, feeling as strong as a mountain. 'I am wearing my Cape of Courage,' Oliver announced bravely. Dr. Sarah used her stethoscope to listen to his heart, and it tickled so much that Oliver burst into a fit of happy giggles. It did not hurt at all! He opened his mouth wide to say 'Ahhh' just like a roaring lion. When the checkup was all done, Dr. Sarah gave him a shiny gold star sticker for being so brave. Oliver stuck it right onto his red cape. You are the bravest superhero in the whole world, Oliver!

rhymes.title: The Shiny Red Cape
rhymes.text:
Look inside the closet door,
Find a treasure on the floor!
It is bright and shiny red,
Put it on your back instead.

Tie the ribbon, nice and tight,
Now you look so brave and bright!
Are you ready for the day?
Time to lead the fun and play.

Step outside and count to three,
Who is strong as they can be?
It is you, my little star,
Travelling near and travelling far.

No more fears and no more tears,
Courage is what brings good cheers.
Fly away and do your best,
You can conquer every test.

rhymes.title: The Morning Super-Hero
rhymes.text:
Wake up, wake up, little bear,
Brush your teeth and brush your hair.
Then the magic comes in sight,
Wrap the cape on shoulders light.

Gold and purple, soft and grand,
Bestest cape in all the land!
When you wear it, you can try,
Reach your fingers to the sky.

Shoes are on the proper feet,
Walking down the morning street.
Nothing scary comes your way,
When you wear your cape today.

Twirl around and shout out loud,
Make your family very proud.
Brave and bold in everything,
Hear the little song you sing.

rhymes.title: The Magic Cloak of Blue
rhymes.text:
Morning sun begins to glow,
Time to get up and not be slow.
Grab your cloak of ocean blue,
Made of special stuff for you.

Snap the button at the neck,
Give your superhero check!
Are your hands washed super clean?
Bestest helper ever seen.

Walking to the kitchen chair,
Eating breakfast with such flair.
Drinking up your milk so tall,
Standing proud and never small.

Cape of courage keeps you brave,
Like a captain on a wave.
Off to school or out to play,
You will have a super day.

rhymes.title: The Golden Wings of Might
rhymes.text:
When the room is dark and grey,
And you want to hide away,
There is something you can do,
Bring your courage out anew.

Take the yellow cape of gold,
Be so happy, be so bold!
 Drape it softly on your back,
Ready for the morning track.

Tie a bow that holds up fast,
Now your little doubts have passed.
Wash your face and put on socks,
Climb the playground climbing rocks.

Flying high just like a bird,
Speaking every happy word.
Cape of courage shines so bright,
Guiding you with all its might.

rhymes.title: The Green Leaf Cape
rhymes.text:
Little leaves upon the tree,
Dance around so wild and free.
Here is your own cape of green,
Softest fabric ever seen.

Put it on and feel the breeze,
Whispering among the trees.
Time to tidy up your room,
Chase away the heavy gloom.

Pick up blocks and toys and books,
Give them all joyful looks.
With your cape, you are so strong,
Singing out a happy song.

Pat your back and give a cheer,
There is nothing you can fear.
Ready for the brand new task,
All the courage you could ask.

rhymes.title: The Magic Cloak
rhymes.text:
Time to wake and start the day,
We can chase the sleep away.
Look right here upon the chair,
A special magic waiting there!

It is shiny, bright, and bold,
Worth a million pots of gold.
Lift it up and hold it high,
Reach your fingers to the sky.

Put it gently on your back,
Zip it tight and don't look slack.
Now your superpowers gleam,
Louder than a waking scream!

Be so brave and feel so strong,
Sing our happy morning song.
With your cape, you'll bravely go,
Ready for the world, hello!

rhymes.title: The Super-Kid Shield
rhymes.text:
Every morning brings a test,
Time to look and feel your best.
Put on shoes and brush your hair,
Show the world how much you care.

Now the time has come at last,
Tie the ribbons very fast.
It's your cape of courage now,
Take a bow and say hello, wow!

Fears and worries run away,
When you wear this through the day.
Shoulders back and head up high,
Watch the little troubles fly.

You can share and you can play,
Laugh and smile along the way.
Nothing scary can get in,
Super hero, time to win!

rhymes.title: Little Hero Flying High
rhymes.text:
Little hero, look right here,
Cast aside your little fear.
On your shoulders, soft and sweet,
Sits a cape that can't be beat.

Red and yellow, green and blue,
Made of special stuff for you.
When you wear it, you are bold,
Brave as knights of knights of old.

Step outside into the breeze,
Climb the jungle gym with ease.
Try new things you haven't tried,
With your courage as your guide.

When the stars begin to peep,
And it's time to go to sleep,
Fold your cape up on the chair,
Knowing bravery stays there.

rhymes.title: Brave Little Bear
rhymes.text:
Are you feeling kind of shy?
Do you want to start and cry?
Wait a minute, dry your tear,
Look at what is waiting here!

It's a cape of courage bright,
Keeping all the shadows light.
Wrap it round you nice and warm,
Safe inside a gentle storm.

Take a step and count to three,
As brave as brave can ever be.
Now your feet can skip and run,
Basking in the golden sun.

Nothing's hard when you are strong,
Singing out a happy song.
With your cape upon your back,
Nothing is a scary track!

rhymes.title: The Cape of Big Dreams
rhymes.text:
Morning light is shining down,
No more sleepy heavy frown.
Time to put your armor on,
Now that sleepy time is gone.

It's a cape made out of dreams,
Stitched together at the seams.
Put it on and feel the power,
Growing bigger by the hour.

Doors will open, you will see,
All the things that you can be.
Doctor, dancer, builder too,
All these dreams belong to you.

Marching forward, left and right,
Shining like a beacon bright.
Wear your courage every day,
Hip hooray, hip hooray!

rhymes.title: The Shiny Red Cape
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Time to start our day just right.
Look what hangs upon the chair,
A magic cape just waiting there.

Snap it here and snap it there,
Feel the courage in the air!
Red and shiny, bold and new,
Made for little ones like you.

Now you're ready for the floor,
Walking through the big brave door.
Step by step and day by day,
Chasing all the dark away.

Cape of courage on your back,
Ready for a fun new track.
Smile and shout a happy cheer,
There is nothing you can fear!

rhymes.title: Super Kid Cape
rhymes.text:
Put your arms up in the air,
Time to wear our special gear.
Soft and cozy, bright and sweet,
From your head down to your feet.

Ties around your little neck,
Time to check and double check.
Super hero ready now,
Take a bow and show me how.

When the stairs look big and tall,
You won't stumble, you won't fall.
With your cape of courage near,
Every single thing is clear.

Spin around and give a shout,
That is what this day's about!
Strong and steady, brave and true,
All because of what you do.

rhymes.title: The Golden Star Cape
rhymes.text:
Up you get and stretch up high,
Reaching up to touch the sky.
Golden stars upon your chest,
Today you are the very best.

Wrap the fabric nice and tight,
Making everything feel right.
It's a cape of courage grand,
Bestest helper in the land.

Time to tidy up the room,
Sweep away the morning gloom.
Blocks and toys are put away,
Ready for a brand new play.

Nothing is too hard to do,
When this magic cape is you.
Wear your courage every day,
Hip hooray and hip hooray!

rhymes.title: The Gentle Blue Cape
rhymes.text:
Soft blue fabric, soft and deep,
Watch the little brave one leap.
Jump up high and land below,
Ready for the day to go.

Button up and pull it straight,
Now you never have to wait.
Cape of courage, soft and blue,
Brings a happy smile to you.

Wash your hands and brush your teeth,
Wear your courage underneath.
Ready now to eat your snack,
With your cape upon your back.

Deep inside your heart so mild,
You are such a fearless child.
Sing a song and laugh out loud,
Making all the grown-ups proud.

rhymes.title: The Rainbow Cape
rhymes.text:
Colors bright in every hue,
Yellow, green, and pink, and blue.
Wrap the rainbow all around,
Listen to the happy sound.

It's the cape of courage bold,
Worth a million pots of gold.
Wear it walking down the street,
Marching with your little feet.

If you tumble, do not cry,
Just dust off and wave goodbye.
Stand right up and try again,
Sun will always follow rain.

Rainbow cape is shining bright,
Keeping you so safe tonight.
Clap your hands and sing this song,
All day long where you belong!

rhymes.title: The Magic Cloak
rhymes.text:
Time to wake and start the day,
Chase the sleepy blues away.
Look right here upon the chair,
A magic cloak is waiting there!
Put it on and give a twirl,
Every little boy and girl.
Tie the ribbons, nice and tight,
Watch it shine with golden light.
It's the cape of courage now,
Help us make a happy bow.
Step outside and bravely go,
Ready for the world to show.
No more crying, feeling shy,
We can touch the bright blue sky!
With our magic cape so grand,
We are bravest in the land.

rhymes.title: Superhero Sparkle
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Turn on every waking light.
Time to wear our special gear,
There is nothing we can fear!
Find the fabric soft and blue,
Made of bravery for you.
Snap the buttons in a row,
Watch the happy feeling grow.
Cape of courage on our back,
Ready for a brand new track!
Stomp your feet and give a shout,
That is what this day's about.
Walk right out the nursery door,
Ready to explore and more.
Super heroes, strong and tall,
We can do and try it all!

rhymes.title: Brave Little Bear
rhymes.text:
Little bear woke up today,
Wanted courage for his play.
Mommy brought a little cape,
Just the right and cozy shape.
Slip it over fuzzy head,
Time to leave the sleepy bed.
Red as strawberries in the tree,
Just as happy as can be.
Now the bear is strong and bold,
Warming up against the cold.
Walks outside into the yard,
Nothing here is too too hard.
Climbs the ladder, takes a slide,
With his shiny cape spread wide.
Brave little bear can shout hooray,
He's a hero all the day!

rhymes.title: The Starry Shield
rhymes.text:
When the morning comes around,
Feet are dancing on the ground.
Look what fell down from the stars,
Past the moon and flying cars!
A shiny cape of golden thread,
To put upon our shoulders head.
Tie it fast and stand up straight,
Being brave is feeling great.
Fears and worries fly away,
We are ready for the day.
Marching left and marching right,
Shining like a beacon bright.
Open up the heavy door,
Let us wander, let us soar.
With our starry shield of might,
Everything will turn out right!

rhymes.title: Fly Away Friends
rhymes.text:
Put your arms up in the air,
Spin around upon the chair.
Here comes something soft and green,
Finest cape you've ever seen!
Tucked inside a little box,
Right beside your fuzzy socks.
Wrap it round you nice and warm,
Safe and cozy from the storm.
Now you have a steady friend,
With you right unto the end.
Step down softly to the floor,
Ready for what lies in store.
Wave goodbye and start to roam,
Even when you step from home.
Cape of courage helps you try,
Spread your little wings and fly!

rhymes.title: The Magic Cloak
rhymes.text:
Time to wake and start the day,
Chase the sleepy blues away.
Look right here upon the chair,
A magic cloak is waiting there!

Slip your arm into the sleeve,
Watch it make you brave, believe!
Tie the ribbons, nice and tight,
Now you shine so big and bright.

Is the morning looking tall?
Does it seem a bit too small?
Don't you worry, don't you fret,
You're the bravest hero yet!

Walk the hallway, march and sing,
You can do almost anything!
Cape of courage, soft and grand,
Bestest hero in the land!

rhymes.title: Super Hero Shoes and Cape
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining bright,
Time to suit up for the flight.
First we find the shiny cape,
Ready for a hero's shape.

Wrap it gently round your neck,
Give yourself a happy check.
Red and blue or pink and gold,
Watch the magic now unfold!

Now your feet begin to prance,
Do a little hero dance.
Step outside to greet the street,
Hero boots upon your feet.

Nothing scary comes your way,
When you wear your cape today.
Spread your arms and fly so high,
Reaching all the way to sky!

rhymes.title: The Brave Little Knight
rhymes.text:
Listen to the morning chime,
It is getting dressing time.
Do not hide beneath the bed,
Put your hero cape on head!

Drape it softly down your back,
Ready for a joyful track.
Buttons fastened, looking neat,
Smiles from your head to feet.

Are you feeling small today?
Shall we chase the fears away?
With this cape you are so strong,
Nothing, nothing can go wrong.

Marching forward, left and right,
Little hero, brave and bright.
Wear your courage all day long,
Singing out a happy song!

rhymes.title: Fluttering Wings
rhymes.text:
Time to put your armor on,
Now that sleepy time is gone.
Here is something special made,
So you never are afraid.

It's a cape of courage true,
Made especially for you.
Tie it gently at the top,
Dancing till you have to stop.

Flutter, flutter like a bird,
Saying every happy word.
Going out to learn and play,
Making friends along the way.

If a scary shadow calls,
Dancing on the playroom walls,
Just remember what you wear,
Courage floating in the air!

rhymes.title: The Shield of Smiles
rhymes.text:
Wake up, sleeper, rise and gleam,
Time to chase a happy dream.
Every day is brand new fun,
Greeting now the morning sun.

Let us find your cloak of might,
Making everything feel right.
Put it on and give a shout,
That is what a day's about!

Spinning round and round you go,
Bestest cape we all do know.
Tough as nails and soft as silk,
Drinking up your morning milk.

Out the door and off you run,
Playing underneath the sun.
Cape of courage, shining bright,
Keeping you so safe all night!

rhymes.title: The Magic Cloak
rhymes.text:
Time to wake and start the day,
Chase the sleepy blues away!
Look right here upon the bed,
A shiny cape of bright red.

Slip it on your tiny arm,
Keep you safe and free from harm.
Tie the ribbons nice and neat,
Now you are a hero sweet!

Can you stomp your happy feet?
Walking down the morning street.
Nothing scary, nothing new,
When this magic cape is you.

Time to shine and time to play,
We will have a super day!

rhymes.title: Brave Little Hero
rhymes.text:
Morning light is shining bright,
Time to stand up in your might.
Grab the cape of royal blue,
Made especially for you.

Put it round your little neck,
Give a happy little check.
Now you're ready for the hall,
Never fear a thing at all.

Brush your teeth and wash your face,
Moving at a speedy pace.
With your cape so proud and grand,
You can conquer all the land.

Off to school or out to play,
You are mighty all the way!

rhymes.title: The Golden Shield
rhymes.text:
Sun is up and skies are clear,
No more waiting, do not fear.
Here is something gold and bright,
To make everything feel right.

Wrap the cape around your back,
Ready for a fun attack.
It's a cape of courage strong,
Help you as you walk along.

Put your little shoes on fast,
We are having fun at last.
Step outside and take a breath,
Leave behind your little frets.

You are brave and you are bold,
Worth a million pots of gold!

rhymes.title: Green Leaf Flight
rhymes.text:
Little bird outside will sing,
Greeting what the morn will bring.
You can wear your cape of green,
 Finest hero ever seen.

Snap it fast and button tight,
Ready for a gentle flight.
Through the kitchen, past the chair,
You are zooming everywhere!

New adventures wait outside,
With your courage as your guide.
Nothing hard can block your way,
When you wear your cape today.

Smile and laugh and jump up high,
Touching all the morning sky!

rhymes.title: Purple Power Cape
rhymes.text:
Purple cape of velvet soft,
Flying high up in the loft.
Put it on and feel the power,
Growing stronger every hour.

Time to pack your little bag,
Never let your spirits lag.
With this fabric full of cheer,
You can conquer any fear.

Wash your hands and eat your snack,
With your cape upon your back.
You can do big things today,
In your own special way.

Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Heroes do not run away!

rhymes.title: The Magic Cloak
rhymes.text:
Time to wake up, start the day,
Chase the sleepy blues away.
Look right here upon the chair,
Something special waiting there.

It is shiny, soft, and bright,
Ready for the morning light.
Tie the ribbons, nice and sweet,
Stand up tall upon your feet.

Now you have a magic view,
There is nothing you can't do!
Walk the hallway, big and bold,
Like a hero in a hold.

Fear and worry go away,
We are ready for the day!
Spin around and give a cheer,
Brave and happy you appear.

rhymes.title: Super Hero Red
rhymes.text:
Little shoulders, put it on,
Now the shadows all are gone.
It is red and very grand,
Bestest cape in all the land.

Step right up and climb the stairs,
Show it to the fuzzy bears.
Wash your hands and brush your teeth,
With this armor underneath.

Time to put your shoes on fast,
Trouble days are in the past.
Out the door and down the street,
Marching with your dancing feet.

Every puddle you can leap,
Picking up the toys to keep.
With your cape so bright and true,
All the world is cheering you!

rhymes.title: The Golden Star
rhymes.text:
When the morning feels too tall,
And you do not want to crawl,
Grab your cape of yellow gold,
Let its shiny wings unfold.

Wrap it gently, snug and tight,
Watch it sparkle in the light.
Now you feel so very strong,
Singing out a happy song.

Brush your hair and eat your snack,
With your armor on your back.
Nothing scary comes around,
When your cape is safe and sound.

Off to school or out to play,
Conquering the brand new day.
Give a wave and shout hooray,
Smiling all the hours away.

rhymes.title: Blue Sky Flier
rhymes.text:
Soft as velvet, blue as sky,
Time to make your spirit fly.
Put it round your little neck,
Check your pockets, double check.

Now you are a captain bold,
Braver than the knights of old.
Tidying your blocks and toys,
Making happy little joys.

Climb into the big red chair,
Read a story sitting there.
Even when the lights grow dim,
You can always swim and swim.

Nothing makes your courage small,
You can stand so proud and tall.
With your cape of courage near,
There is nothing you can fear.

rhymes.title: The Brave Little Bear
rhymes.text:
Time to try a brand new thing,
Hear the little songbirds sing.
Put your green cape on your back,
Pack your little zipper pack.

Take a breath and count to three,
As brave as any bird or bee.
Wash your face and make it shine,
Everything is going fine.

Step outside into the breeze,
Say hello to all the trees.
You are growing big and strong,
Never fear to sing along.

Wear your cape throughout the day,
Helping others on your way.
Clap your hands and shout with glee,
The bravest toddler ever to be!

rhymes.title: The Magic Cloak
rhymes.text:
Time to get up with the sun,
Our day has just begun.
Look what hangs upon the chair,
A magic cloak is waiting there!
Slip it on and pull it tight,
Watch it sparkle in the light.
It is the Cape of Courage bold,
Brighter than a pot of gold.
Are you scared to try something new?
This special cape is made for you!
Stand up tall and take a stride,
Feel the bravery deep inside.
Step right out and play your part,
With a strong and happy heart.
Up the stairs and off we go,
Ready, steady, watch us grow!

rhymes.title: Super Kid Cape
rhymes.text:
Every morning when we wake,
Choices we are going to make.
Sometimes things look big and tall,
Making little ones feel small.
Do not worry, do not fear,
Your superhero gear is here!
Tie the ribbons round your neck,
Give yourself a happy check.
It is the Cape of Courage bright,
Keeping all the shadows light.
Now your feet can skip and run,
Jumping right into the sun.
Try a puzzle, try a game,
Nothing ever stays the same.
You are mighty, you are grand,
The bravest kid in all the land!

rhymes.title: The Brave Little Cloak
rhymes.text:
Put your arms into the sleeves,
Rustling like the autumn leaves.
This is not a blanket warm,
It protects you from the storm.
It is the Cape of Courage true,
Made for little heroes like you.
When your shoes are hard to tie,
Or you have to wave goodbye,
Just remember what you wear,
Courage floating in the air!
Take a breath and count to three,
As happy as a bumblebee.
Now you ready for the day,
Ready for a brand new play.
Spin around and give a cheer,
There is nothing left to fear!

rhymes.title: Shining Shield
rhymes.text:
Drape it gently on your back,
Ready for a brand new track.
It is soft and it is red,
Like a lion's friendly head.
It is the Cape of Courage grand,
Best invention in the land.
Does the water look too wide?
Do you want to run and hide?
Do not fret and do not pout,
That is what the cape is about!
Swish the fabric, hear the sound,
Feet are dancing on the ground.
Walk right up and take the test,
Little children do their best.
Now you shine so bright and clear,
Spreading gladness far and near.

rhymes.title: The Cape of Smiles
rhymes.text:
Morning light is peeking through,
Calling out to me and you.
Time to dress and time to play,
Making sunshine every day.
Fetch the Cape of Courage now,
We can do it, take a bow!
Button up and zip away,
Greeting this delightful day.
When you feel a little shy,
Look up at the open sky.
Your brave cape is strong and wide,
With big courage deep inside.
Now you bravely walk ahead,
Leaving troubles in your bed.
Clap your hands and sing a song,
Being brave is where you belong!

rhymes.title: The Shiny Red Cape
rhymes.text:
Look inside the closet door,
Find a treasure on the floor.
It is bright and shiny red,
Put it gently on your head.

Now it rests upon your back,
Ready for a daily track.
Tie the ribbons, nice and tight,
Everything is feeling right.

Are you ready for the day?
Time to run and time to play!
With this cape, you have the might,
To make every challenge bright.

Steping out into the sun,
Look at you, you've just begun.
Brave and strong in every way,
You will conquer all today.

rhymes.title: Flying High Today
rhymes.text:
Every morning when we wake,
Choices we are going to make.
Grab the cape of gold and blue,
It is waiting just for you.

Wrap it round your little chest,
Now you're dressed to do your best.
Brush your teeth and comb your hair,
Magic is already there.

Stretch your arms up to the sky,
Watch your courage start to fly.
Nothing bad can block your way,
When you wear your cape today.

Shoes are on and socks fit tight,
Soaring forward in the light.
Cheer aloud and give a shout,
That is what this cape's about.

rhymes.title: The Magic Cloak of Green
rhymes.text:
Green as grass and soft as wool,
Making every moment full.
It's the cape of gentle grace,
Bringing smiles to every face.

Put it on your shoulders now,
Give a very proper bow.
Wash your hands and eat your snack,
With your cape upon your back.

If you tumble, do not cry,
Just remember you can fly.
Dust your knees and stand up tall,
You are stronger than them all.

Marching through the living room,
Chasing off the sleepy gloom.
With your green cape floating free,
Bravest kiddo we can see.

rhymes.title: Starry Night and Morning Sun
rhymes.text:
Yellow cape of morning sun,
Now the day has just begun.
Wrap it cozy, wrap it warm,
Safe from any little storm.

Time to pack your toys away,
Helping out is fun today.
With your cape, you know the way,
Sorting blocks and cleaning clay.

Climb the stairs and wash your face,
Moving at a steady pace.
No more tears and no more fuss,
You are super-brave with us.

Twirl around and take a bow,
You are acting bravely now.
Wear your yellow cape with pride,
With such courage deep inside.

rhymes.title: The Purple Power Shield
rhymes.text:
Purple cape with silver stars,
Flying past the moon and Mars.
Put it on and feel the power,
Growing bolder every hour.

Time to try something so new,
Tie your shoes and count to two.
Open up the heavy door,
Ready to explore some more.

If you feel a little shy,
Just look up into the sky.
Take a breath and feel the might,
Of your cape so soft and light.

Now you're ready for the park,
Dancing till it's getting dark.
Brave and bold and full of glee,
As proud as a cape can be.

rhymes.title: The Shiny Red Cape
rhymes.text:
Time to wake and start the day,
Put all sleepy thoughts away.
Look right here upon the chair,
A magic cape is waiting there!

Slip your arms right through the slots,
Tied together with two knots.
Red as fire, bright and bold,
Now you're brave and strong, I'm told.

Walk into the kitchen floor,
Ready to explore much more.
Brush your teeth and eat your snack,
With your cape upon your back.

Nothing scary, big or tall,
You can bravely face it all.
Spin around and give a cheer,
For the hero who is here!

rhymes.title: The Golden Superhero
rhymes.text:
When the morning sun shines bright,
We put on our cape of light.
Gold and shimmering, soft and grand,
Bestest cape in all the land.

Put it on your shoulders small,
Now you're ten feet proud and tall.
Tie the ribbon, nice and neat,
Stamp your little marching feet.

Time to put your toys away,
That is what the heroes say.
Clean up blocks and puzzle parts,
With our brave and happy hearts.

When the job is fully done,
We have so much noble fun.
Wear your cape all through the day,
Hip, hooray, hip, hip, hooray!

rhymes.title: The Blue Sky Flying Cape
rhymes.text:
Out of bed and on the floor,
We are walking out the door.
Grab the cape of sky-blue hue,
Made especially for you.

Snap the button at the top,
Now you never have to stop.
Flying high above the trees,
Dancing in the gentle breeze.

Time to wash your hands and face,
In this happy little place.
Soap up bubbles, splash and clean,
 Bravest kid we've ever seen!

Wear your cape into the car,
Travel near and travel far.
Smile so big and shout out loud,
Making all the grown-ups proud!

rhymes.title: The Green Dragon Wings
rhymes.text:
Green as grass and soft as moss,
Boss of day and never bossed!
It's your special courage cape,
Shaped just like a dragon's shape.

Drape it gently round your neck,
Check your shoes and double-check.
Now you're fearless, strong and free,
As can ever, ever be.

Time to try new foods to eat,
Making dinner quite a treat!
Take a bite and chew it slow,
Watch your mighty powers grow.

Wear your cape into your dreams,
Or so friendly magic seems.
Dragon strength is in your soul,
Now you're happy, brave and whole!

rhymes.title: The Purple Starry Cape
rhymes.text:
Purple cape with yellow stars,
Flying past the moon and Mars.
Put it on and give a shout,
That is what the day's about!

Wrap it round you like a hug,
Snug as any little bug.
Now you're ready for the park,
Even if it's getting dark.

Time to put your shoes on tight,
Lace them up and get them right.
Jump up high into the air,
Show the magic everywhere.

Cape of courage, cape of cheer,
Glad to have you with us here.
Clap your hands and sing this song,
All day long, all day long!

stories.title: Leo's Brave Little Bear
stories.text:
Leo was running super-duper fast across the soft green grass in the backyard. Zoom, zoom, went Leo, pretending to be a speedy little rocket ship zooming up to the moon! But oh dear, ouchie! Leo tripped over a tiny bump in the grass and went plop right on his knees. A little tiny scrape appeared, and a big tear rolled down Leo’s chubby cheek. Mommy came running over with her loving, warm hugs and a very special box. It was the Magic Bandage box! Mommy opened it up, and inside were shiny bandages covered in smiling yellow stars and happy little bears. 

Mommy gently washed the little scrape with warm, tickly water and gave the knee a soft kiss to make it feel better. Then, she pulled out a bright yellow star bandage. 'Look, Leo,' Mommy whispered softly, 'this is a magical bravery bandage. It holds a tiny little hug right on your knee to help the healing magic work super fast.' Leo stopped crying and sniffled.
