'It protects your skin like armor and makes you even stronger.' Sammy’s eyes went wide with wonder. He loved superheroes! Grandma wrapped the sparkly shield right over his elbow. It twinkled every time he moved his arm. Sammy flexed his arm like a mighty superhero saving the day. The sting went completely away, replaced by the magic feeling of the shiny shield. 'I am ready to help again, Grandma!' Sammy cheered. He picked up his watering can with his protected arm and continued making the flowers happy, feeling like the bravest, happiest little helper in the whole garden.

stories.title: The Brave Little Dinosaur
stories.text: Once upon a sunny morning, a little green dinosaur named Pip was running very fast in the soft grass. Pip loved to chase floating dandelion seeds. Whoosh! Pip zoomed past a friendly yellow butterfly. Suddenly, Pip tripped over a little bump in the ground. Oh no! Down went Pip with a gentle thud. Pip looked down at one tiny green knee. There was a little tiny scratch, and a little tiny tear rolled down Pip's cheek. Just then, Mama Dinosaur came walking over with a big, warm smile. She carried a very special box. It had shiny blue stars painted all over it. 'Do you know what this is, Pip?' asked Mama softly. 'It is a magic bandage! It has superhero power.' Pip sniffled and wiped the tear away. 'Does it make the ouch go away?' Mama nodded and gently wiped the knee clean with a warm cloth. Then, she peeled open the wrapper of the sparkly blue bandage. It had pictures of flying rockets on it. Carefully, Mama placed the magic bandage right over the little scratch. 'Abra-cadabra, ouchie gone!' whispered Mama. Pip blinked, looked down at the knee, and wiggled the leg. Wow! The magic bandage felt so soft and cozy, like a little hug for the knee. Pip did not feel sad anymore. Instead, Pip felt brave and strong, just like a superhero in space. 'Thank you, Mama,' cheered Pip, jumping right back up to chase the floating seeds. The magic bandage stayed on all day long, reminding Pip how brave little dinosaurs can be when they fall down and get right back up again.

stories.title: Leo's Starry Shield
stories.text: Little Leo was helping his big brother build a towering tower of wooden blocks. One block, two blocks, three blocks high! The tower reached all the way up to Leo's chin. 'Look how tall!' giggled Leo, clapping his hands together. But oh dear, wibble-wobble went the blocks. Crash! Down came the tower in a noisy pile. Leo reached out to catch a falling block, and ouch! A tiny pinch happened on his little finger. Leo squeezed his eyes shut and let out a quick little cry. Daddy rushed over right away, scooping Leo up into a warm, cozy lap. 'Let me see your finger, champion,' said Daddy gently. Leo held out his hand. There was just a tiny red mark, but it still felt a little bit hurty. Daddy smiled a big, reassuring smile and reached into his pocket. Out came a bright yellow bandage covered in shining golden stars. 'This is no ordinary bandage,' Daddy whispered. 'This is a starry shield. It protects your finger and sends happy magic straight to your heart.' Leo watched with wide eyes as Daddy carefully wrapped the yellow star bandage around the little finger. It fit snugly and looked just like a glowing bracelet. Leo touched it gently with his other hand. Suddenly, the hurty feeling started to float away, replaced by a warm, tickly feeling. Leo giggled. 'Look, Daddy! I have a star on my hand!' Daddy kissed the top of Leo's head. 'You sure do, and you are my brightest star.' Feeling all better, Leo smiled and helped Daddy put the wooden blocks away, ready to build a brand new, even taller tower.

stories.title: Mia's Flutterby Friend
stories.text: Mia was exploring the backyard garden with her pink watering can. The little pink flowers were so thirsty, and Mia was a very good helper. She watered the daisies and she watered the green ferns. Then, Mia saw a pretty red ladybug sitting on a shiny green leaf. She crouched down low for a closer look. Oops! Mia lost her balance and tipped right over onto the soft garden mulch. 'Aww,' said Mia, sitting up with a little pout. She looked at her elbow. There was a tiny smudge of dirt and a little pink scratch. It stung just a little bit. Grandma came walking down the garden path with a basket of fresh strawberries and a very special pouch. 'Did you take a little tumble, my sweet flower?' asked Grandma gently. Mia nodded and pointed to her elbow. Grandma sat down on the grass next to Mia and gave her a gentle hug. 'I have just the thing to fix that right up,' Grandma said with a wink. She opened the pouch and pulled out a lovely purple bandage with friendly little butterflies printed all over it. 'This is a flutterby bandage. It brings soft butterfly kisses to make your skin happy again.' Grandma carefully wiped the elbow clean with a cool, damp paper towel. Then, she peeled the paper off the purple bandage and pressed it gently over the scratch. The butterflies seemed to dance right on Mia's arm! Mia touched the soft bandage and smiled. The smarting feeling was completely gone. 'Hi, flutterby friends,' Mia whispered to the bandage. Grandma smiled and handed Mia a sweet strawberry. Mia ate her treat and skipped happily back to her garden, her butterfly friend keeping her company all afternoon long.

rhymes.title: The Magic Bandage Song
rhymes.text:
Ouchie on my little knee,
Let us make it happy, see!
Bring the box with colors bright,
Everything will soon be right.

Time to pick a sticker star,
Flying on a rocket car.
Peel it gently off the sheet,
Make the boo-boo super sweet.

Place it softly on the spot,
Hurts a little, but not a lot.
Magic bandage, hold it tight,
Keep it safe and out of sight.

Now the boo-boo starts to fade,
Happiest kid ever made!
Dance around and jump and play,
Magic made it go away!

rhymes.title: Brave Little Hero
rhymes.text:
Uh oh, look a tiny tear,
Hero, there is naught to fear!
Wash it clean with water cool,
Acting like a mighty rule.

Pat it dry so soft and neat,
Resting on your little feet.
Open up the treasure case,
Find a smile to fit your face.

Dinosaurs or puppies blue,
Pick the one best made for you.
Wrap it round with gentle care,
Floating softly in the air.

Give a clap and give a cheer,
Bravest kid is standing here!
Now the owie goes to sleep,
Promises the pledge to keep.

rhymes.title: Bandage Hug
rhymes.text:
Little bump and little scrape,
Flying like a speedy cape.
Time to fix it on the run,
Underneath the golden sun.

First we give a healing blow,
Make the gentle breezes blow.
Then a bandage soft and red,
Like a pillow for your bed.

Stick it on and count to three,
One and two and three for me!
Feel the magic sinking deep,
While the tiny owies sleep.

All better now, let's sing a song,
Clapping all the way along.
Running fast and feeling grand,
Best kid in the whole wide land.

rhymes.title: Rainbow Patch
rhymes.text:
Spot of red and spot of blue,
Got a little scratch on you?
Do not worry, do not cry,
We can touch the glowing sky.

Let us find a magic patch,
That is such a happy match.
Peel the paper, shiny gold,
Bestest secret to be told.

Press it down with fingers sweet,
Look down at your busy feet.
Rainbow colors shining bright,
Making everything feel right.

Twinkle twinkle little star,
No more owies where you are.
Smile again and give a hug,
Snuggling like a fuzzy bug.

rhymes.title: The Boo-Boo Doctor
rhymes.text:
Doctor daddy coming through,
With a special patch for you.
Clean the spot and make it shine,
Everything is feeling fine.

Take the wrapper, tear it slow,
Watch the pretty colors glow.
Place it right upon the place,
Bringing sunshine to your face.

Magic glue is holding fast,
Making all the sad times past.
Give a wiggle, give a shake,
For the happy moments' sake.

Now you're ready for the day,
Time to go outside and play.
Bandage badge of bravery,
Shining bright for all to see.

rhymes.title: The Magic Bandage Song
rhymes.text:
Oh no, a little scratch today,
We kissed the boo-boo all away.
Now open up the little box,
To find the one with happy rocks.

A shiny star is on my knee,
A magic sticker just for me!
It keeps the owie safe and tight,
And makes my day so big and bright.

We press it down with gentle care,
And blow a gentle healing air.
No tears will fall, no tears will stay,
We dance and skip and go to play!

So wear your badge so proud and tall,
Because you bravely faced it all!
It's magic paper, soft and grand,
The finest bandage in the land.

rhymes.title: Bandage Brave and Bright
rhymes.text:
A tiny bump upon your arm,
We'll keep you safe from any harm.
No need to frown, no need to cry,
We'll make the sad face flutter by.

Let's get a bandage from the shelf,
So you can help to heal yourself!
With dino prints in green and blue,
It knows exactly what to do.

We wrap it round your little hand,
The coolest badge in all the land.
It gives a hug so warm and sweet,
From tiny head to tiny feet.

And when the day is done and through,
We'll take it off, both me and you.
You were so brave, your smile is wide,
With joy and courage deep inside.

rhymes.title: Rainbow Patch
rhymes.text:
Oopsie daisy, down you go,
Just a little pinch, we know.
Let's wash the owie nice and clean,
The cleanest knee you've ever seen!

Now pick a bandage from the row,
Which pretty color should we go?
A rainbow strip of red and blue,
To stick right on top of you.

Peel the paper, count to three,
Stick it firmly on your knee!
It's a shield of shiny might,
Making everything feel right.

Give a clap and give a cheer,
There is nothing left to fear.
Your magic patch is strong and true,
And proudly worn right here by you.

rhymes.title: The Owie Hug
rhymes.text:
A little trip, a little fall,
It is not a worry, not at all!
We pick you up and brush you down,
And chase away that grumpy frown.

We have a helper soft and cool,
Our trusty little bandage tool.
With smiling puppies in a row,
Ready for a sticker show.

Put it gently on the spot,
Even if it hurts a lot.
It wraps it up in cozy grace,
And brings a smile upon your face.

Now go and run outside to play,
You chased the little cloud away!
A superstar, so brave and grand,
The happiest toddler in the land.

rhymes.title: Bandage Bear's Big Help
rhymes.text:
Hold your finger, let me see,
Just a scratch as small as can be.
We will fix it in a flash,
With a special bandage dash!

Bandage Bear is standing by,
To help you reach up to the sky.
With stripes of yellow, pink, and green,
The prettiest patch you've ever seen.

Press it down and give a pat,
We love a magic trick like that!
It holds the owie fast and tight,
Until the morning, pure and bright.

You did so great, you didn't weep,
Now off to play or off to sleep.
A badge of honor on your skin,
Where happy feelings start again.

rhymes.title: The Boo-Boo Crown
rhymes.text:
Oh no, a little scratch today,
We kissed the hurt and chased away!
Now look inside the shiny box,
Right under fluffy polka-dots.

A magic bandage comes to view,
In pink and green and bright sky blue.
We peel the paper, oh so slow,
And watch the little sticker glow.

We place it gently on the knee,
As happy as a honeybee!
It wraps around with hugs so tight,
And makes the booboo feel just right.

So skip and jump and hop around,
The bravest toddler in the town!
Your magic badge is shining bright,
Everything is feeling right!

rhymes.title: Superhero Shield
rhymes.text:
A tiny bump upon your arm,
We'll keep you safe and out of harm.
No need to frown or shed a tear,
Your trusty helper now is here.

We found a sticker from the stars,
To heal up bumps and little scars.
It sparkles silver in the light,
And stays so cozy through the night.

Press it down from left to right,
Hold it close and hug it tight.
It is a shield for heroes bold,
A magic story to be told.

Now flex your arm and show your might,
You saved the day and won the fight!
The bandage stays until you play,
And helps you conquer all the day.

rhymes.title: Dinosaur Patch
rhymes.text:
Roar goes the little dinosaur,
Right across the bedroom floor!
Whoops a daisy, down you fell,
Let us ring the healing bell.

Fetch the bandage from the shelf,
Put it on all by yourself.
It has a green T-Rex so grand,
The coolest sticker in the land.

Peel the tab and count to three,
Stick it right below your knee.
Pat it softly, pat it down,
Say goodbye to any frown.

Now stomp your feet and give a roar,
Just like on the jungle floor!
The magic patch is strong and true,
Ready for a game or two.

rhymes.title: Rainbow Kiss
rhymes.text:
A tiny scrape upon your toe,
Time to make the healing grow.
Let mommy give a gentle kiss,
To make you feel complete and bliss.

Look inside the magic case,
Find a smile to match your face.
A rainbow bandage, red and bright,
Shining with a lovely light.

We lay it smooth across the spot,
Whether it is cold or hot.
It wraps your finger like a bow,
And helps the happy feelings flow.

Wave your hand up in the air,
Rainbow colors everywhere!
The booboo's gone, you're looking great,
Let us celebrate your state.

rhymes.title: Puppy Dog Comfort
rhymes.text:
A little trip upon the rug,
Needs a happy little hug.
Sit right down upon my knee,
Take a breath and count to three.

Here's a puppy on a strip,
To help you on your little trip.
He wiggles with a happy smile,
To stay with you a little while.

Peel the cover off the back,
Place it on the paper track.
Smooth it out from side to side,
Wear it with a puppy pride.

Bark out loud and wag your tail,
Ready for a sunny trail!
The magic bandage does the trick,
Making everything feel quick.

rhymes.title: The Boo-Boo Star
rhymes.text:
Oh no, a scrape upon your knee,
A little ouch for you to see.
Do not worry, do not cry,
We will make the boo-boo bye.

Bring the box with shiny blue,
I have got a fix for you.
Open up and look inside,
Where the magic stars reside.

Peel the wrapper, soft and neat,
Press it down upon your feet.
Wait, your knee is where it goes,
Right above your little toes.

Now the magic star is set,
Best sticker you have ever met!
Give a cheer and give a hug,
Time to give your knees a tug.

rhymes.title: Bandage Brave and Bright
rhymes.text:
Little bump upon your arm,
We will keep you safe from harm.
Time to heal it right away,
Make it better for our play.

Fetch the bandage from the shelf,
You can help me do it self.
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Pick the one that fits for you.

Peel the paper, pull it slow,
Watch the magic sticker glow.
Press it gently, count to three,
Look how happy you can be!

All fixed up and feeling fine,
Smiling little friend of mine.
Run and jump and skip and play,
Have a super duper day!

rhymes.title: The Dinosaur Wrap
rhymes.text:
Roar goes the T-Rex in the tree,
Oh look, a scratch upon your knee!
We need a bandage strong and bold,
A story waiting to be told.

Snap the box and pull it out,
Hear the happy toddler shout!
It has spikes and it has scale,
Like a happy dinosaur tail.

Stick it on the tender spot,
Wrap it up and tie a knot.
Well, just press it with your hand,
Bestest bandage in the land.

Now you are a dinosaur so grand,
The mightiest in all the land.
Stamp your feet and let out a roar,
Ready to explore some more!

rhymes.title: Magic Shielding Patch
rhymes.text:
Time for a fix on your little hand,
We have the bestest in the land.
A tiny scratch, a tiny tear,
We will make it disappear.

Grab the magic shielding patch,
Just the right and proper match.
Peel the back side off with care,
Float it gently in the air.

Place it right upon the place,
Put a smile upon your face.
Rub it warm and rub it tight,
Making everything all right.

Now the boo-boo has a shield,
Resting softly in the field.
Wave goodbye to every tear,
There is nothing left to fear!

rhymes.title: Rainbow on the Cut
rhymes.text:
Oopsie daisy, dropped your toy,
Oh my precious little boy.
Let us dry those water drops,
Till the little crying stops.

Look what we have found today,
Chasing all the frowns away.
A bandage painted like a bow,
Watch the pretty colors glow.

Peel the tab and hold it high,
Reach it upward to the sky.
Place it gently on the skin,
Let the healing now begin.

Rainbow shining on your arm,
Safe and cozy, free from harm.
Give a clap and sing a song,
Nothing here can go wrong!

rhymes.title: The Magic Bandage Song
rhymes.text:
Ouchie on my little knee,
Let us make it happy, see?
Wash it gently with a tear,
Magic bandage, you are here!

Peel the wrapper, stick it down,
Turn that little upside frown.
Shiny stars upon my skin,
Now the healing has begun!

Blow a kiss and make it strong,
Sing our happy healing song.
Walk and jump and skip around,
Bestest bandage ever found!

All better now, we shout aloud,
Little helper feeling proud.
Take a bow and clap your hands,
Magic healing of the bands!

rhymes.title: Bandaid Bear's Big Day
rhymes.text:
Little scratch and little sigh,
Bandaid Bear, please do not cry.
We will fix it in a flash,
Dash, dash, dash, go get the stash!

Strip of blue and strip of red,
Place it softly on the head.
No, not head, upon the toe,
Watch the hurt place start to glow.

Now the magic work is done,
Time to play beneath the sun.
Run and jump with all your might,
Bandaid makes it feel just right.

Happy feet and happy heart,
Time to do another part.
Peel and stick and giggle deep,
Bandaid puts the owies to sleep.

rhymes.title: The Sticker Shield
rhymes.text:
Oh dear me, a little drop,
Time to make the crying stop.
Bring the magic shield of white,
Everything will soon be right.

Dinosaurs upon the strip,
Helping with a little slip.
Press it gently, count to three,
Look how brave you get to be!

It is like a badge of pride,
Nothing left to go and hide.
Stronger than a super hero,
Making all the owies zero.

Wear your sticker to the park,
Shining brightly in the dark.
Wave goodbye to every tear,
Magic bandage brings good cheer.

rhymes.title: Flutterby Bandage
rhymes.text:
Butterfly wings soft and light,
Land upon the scratch just right.
Hold still now, don't even twitch,
Fixing up this tiny glitch.

Pink and purple stripes so neat,
Making little kids complete.
Pat it once and pat it twice,
Bandage magic is so nice.

Now the owie goes away,
Time to have a sunny day.
Dance around and twirl and spin,
Happy feelings rushing in.

Every tear is washed and dried,
Smiles are shining far and wide.
Flutterby has done her job,
No more tears and no more sob.

rhymes.title: The Brave Little Patch
rhymes.text:
Little bump upon the thumb,
Time for magic aid to come.
Open up the shiny box,
Soft as wool and safe as socks.

Wrap it round and press it tight,
Making everything feel right.
Now you have a shiny star,
Travel near and travel far.

Brave explorer of the floor,
Ready for adventures more.
Owies vanish in the air,
Magic bandage everywhere.

Clap your hands and shout hooray,
We can conquer all the day.
Safe and sound and feeling grand,
Bestest magic in the land.

rhymes.title: The Magic Bandage Song
rhymes.text:
Ouchie on my little knee,
Time to patch it up, you see.
Bring the box with shiny star,
Bestest helpers near and far.

Peel the wrapper nice and slow,
Watch the magic colors glow.
Place it gently on the spot,
Does it hurt? No, it does not!

Blow a kiss to make it better,
Safe from wind and rainy weather.
Now my leg is good as new,
Ready for a game or two.

Jump up high and dance around,
Happiest kid in the town!
Bandage shining like a gem,
We are brave and strong like them.

rhymes.title: Booboo Bear's Plaster
rhymes.text:
Teddy bumped his fuzzy head,
Time to tuck him into bed.
Wait, we have a special cure,
That will make him well, I'm sure.

Pick a sticker bright and red,
Place it softly on his head.
Press it down with gentle pat,
Teddy smiles and likes just that.

Magic bandage on the bear,
Showing how much we both care.
Now he's ready for some play,
Running through the sunny day.

Kiss the booboo, say goodbye,
We can touch the glowing sky.
Every tear is washed away,
Hip hooray for a happy day!

rhymes.title: Little Shield of Joy
rhymes.text:
Scrape my finger, oh oh oh,
Time to put a shield in glow.
Fetch the box of colors grand,
Held so gently in my hand.

Peel the sticky paper back,
Ready for our happy track.
Wrap it round my finger tight,
Making everything feel right.

It's a badge of bravery too,
Just for little stars like you.
Wear it proudly on your arm,
Keeping you so safe from harm.

Wave goodbye to little pain,
Sunshine coming through the rain.
Clap your hands and shout aloud,
Little hero, brave and proud!

rhymes.title: The Happy Healing Patch
rhymes.text:
Little tumble on the floor,
Time to even up the score.
Get the patch with puppies on,
Watch the grumpy frowns be gone.

Clean the scrape with gentle wipe,
Everything is feeling ripe.
Lay the bandage on the skin,
Let the magic games begin!

Press the edges all around,
Best sticker that can be found.
Now the ouchie went away,
Saved to fight another day.

Spin around and shout hooray,
We are shining bright today.
Healing fast and feeling grand,
Happiest kid in all the land!

rhymes.title: Starry Night Bandage
rhymes.text:
Tiny bump upon my arm,
We will keep you safe from harm.
Bring the bandage with the moon,
Healing will be starting soon.

Peel the strip of sticky white,
Shining like a starry night.
Place it right across the trace,
Bringing smiles upon my face.

Rub it softly, count to three,
Look how happy I can be.
No more crying, only cheer,
Now that magic patch is here.

March along and beat the drum,
Happy times are sure to come.
With my bandage shining bright,
Everything is feeling right!

rhymes.title: The Magic Bandage Song
rhymes.text:
Oh no, a little scratch today,
We kissed the hurt and chased away!
Now look inside our magic box,
We pick the one with little fox.

It sticks up high, it sticks down low,
And helps our boo-boo gently grow.
A shiny star right on the knee,
As happy as a bumblebee!

We press it down with fingertips,
And put a smile upon our lips.
No tears at all, we jump and play,
The magic bandage saves the day!

So bounce around and clap your hands,
The greatest sticker in all the lands!

rhymes.title: Sticker Star Smiles
rhymes.text:
A tiny bump upon the toe,
We tell the owie time to go!
Let's find a bandage bright and red,
To tuck our little friend to bed.

We peel the paper, oh so slow,
And watch the shiny colors glow.
Across the knee, we lay it flat,
And give a gentle pat-a-pat.

It wraps around and gives a hug,
As cozy as a little bug.
The tear drops dry, we feel so brave,
With all the happy hugs we gave.

Now off we run to slide and swing,
And dance and play and sweetly sing!

rhymes.title: Brave Little Bear's Bandage
rhymes.text:
Who got a bump upon their arm?
We'll keep you safe from any harm!
Bring out the badge of bravery,
For such a happy kid like thee.

With stripes of blue and yellow sun,
This magic band is such good fun.
We press it tight and count to three,
One, two, three, and look and see!

The hurt is gone, it flew away,
We're ready for another day.
So stomp your feet and give a cheer,
There is no reason now for fear.

A sticker shield for champions bold,
The finest story ever told!

rhymes.title: Rainbow Patch Parade
rhymes.text:
A little scrape, a little fall,
We are the bravest of them all!
Let's get the rainbow patch so bright,
To make the boo-boo feel alright.

It has some pink and purple glow,
The prettiest you've ever so.
We smooth it down from left to right,
And hold our tiny hands up tight.

A magic seal of happy care,
To show how well we love to share.
We tap it once, we tap it twice,
And everything is feeling nice.

Now march around the living room,
And chase away the rainy gloom!

rhymes.title: Dinosaur Dino Patch
rhymes.text:
Roar goes the little dinosaur,
We don't need any tears no more!
A friendly patch with dino scales,
And little happy smiling tails.

We place it gently on the spot,
And tell the owie it forgot.
It stays right there like armor strong,
While we are dancing all day long.

So pat your knee and give a grin,
That's how the happy days begin.
The bandage works its magic spell,
And makes us feel so very well.

Three cheers for stickers in a row,
Where all the happy feelings go!

rhymes.title: The Magic Bandage Song
rhymes.text:
Ouchie on my little knee,
Let us fix it, you and me.
Find a sticker bright and new,
Red and yellow, green and blue.

Clean the scrape up nice and light,
Pat it till it feels just right.
Peel the wrapper, don't delay,
Chase the ouchie all away!

Put the magic patch right here,
Watch it make the boo-boo clear.
Super hero, strong and brave,
All the happy smiles we save.

Kiss it softly, give a cheer,
Nothing left to worry here!
Now we're ready for our play,
Running through the sunny day.

rhymes.title: Flutterby Fix
rhymes.text:
Little bump upon my arm,
We will keep you safe from harm.
Bring the box with pictures sweet,
Every sticker is a treat.

Pick a butterfly so bright,
With its wings of pink and white.
Press it gently, count to three,
Look how pretty it can be!

Magic bandage on the spot,
Helps a lot and lots and lot.
No more tears to fall today,
Time to chase the blues away.

Dance around the living room,
Sweep away the little gloom.
Feel so better, jump up high,
Wave a happy, cheerful bye.

rhymes.title: Starry Night Care
rhymes.text:
Scratch upon my finger-tip,
Time to make a healing trip.
Sit right down upon my knee,
Listen now and sing with me.

Bring a star of silver light,
Sticking it on very tight.
Twinkle bandage, shining down,
Turn around and lose the frown.

Breathe it in and breathe it out,
That is what the cure's about.
Feel the magic sinking deep,
While the quiet shadows creep.

All better now, the work is done,
Ready for a brand new run.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
For another lovely day.

rhymes.title: Dinosaur Shield
rhymes.text:
Little stub upon my toe,
Where did all the happy go?
Right back here with dinosaurs,
Stomping loudly on the floors!

Take a bandage green and grand,
Best protector in the land.
Wrap it round so snug and neat,
Now we have the happiest feet.

Roar like T-Rex, loud and proud,
Sing our healing song aloud.
Magic shield is holding tight,
Making everything all right.

Give a high-five, nice and sweet,
Victory is quite complete.
Stomp away to build our towers,
Playing happy for hours.

rhymes.title: Rainbow Patch
rhymes.text:
Scrape upon my little hand,
Bestest helper in the land.
Let us find a cure so neat,
To make the tummy happy, sweet.

Colors arching in the sky,
Watch the magic rainbow fly.
Red and orange, violet hue,
Waiting specially for you.

Stick it on and smooth it down,
Say goodbye to any frown.
Feel the comfort start to grow,
Making all the warmth to glow.

Spin around and take a bow,
All is better, look at now!
Ready for the slides and swings,
Happy heart that laughs and sings.

rhymes.title: The Boo-Boo Star
rhymes.text:
Oh no, a little scratch today,
Right while we were running to play.
Let's clean it up and dry the tear,
We have a special helper here!

A magic bandage red and bright,
Will stick on nicely, snug and tight.
It holds a smiling sticker star,
The very bestest by so far!

We wash the knee with water cold,
And watch the happy story unfold.
So brave and strong, you did so great,
Now we are ready, let's go wait!

The boo-boo sleeps beneath the shield,
Until the little scratch is healed.
Horay for you, my little star,
You are the bravest near and far!

rhymes.title: Tiger Stripes
rhymes.text:
A tiny bump upon your arm,
We'll keep it safe from any harm.
No need to frown, no need to cry,
We'll patch it up and say goodbye!

A strip of orange, bright and bold,
A tiger story to be told.
It wraps around your little limb,
With energy and puppy vim.

Now look at how it helps you grow,
With stripes to show off as we go.
A fierce little tiger strong and true,
Can do whatever they want to do!

The bandage stays until the night,
Keeping the little owie right.
Roar like a tiger, soft and sweet,
From tiny head to walking feet!

rhymes.title: The Dinosaur Wrap
rhymes.text:
A little trip upon the floor,
Let's count to three and hear you roar!
We found a scrape, but do not fear,
The magic sticker doctors are here.

We wrap it with a green design,
Where happy little dinosaurs dine.
It hugs your finger nice and warm,
Safe from any clumsy storm.

Dino power for your day,
To help you hurry back to play.
You stamped your foot and shook your head,
And hopped right back into your bed.

The bandage stays to watch and guard,
Even in the big back yard.
Be a dino, big and tall,
Who never lets a trip appall!

rhymes.title: Rainbow Shield
rhymes.text:
When something hurts a tiny bit,
We find a bandage that will fit.
A gentle touch, a happy song,
And nothing in the world is wrong.

It has a rainbow glowing bright,
To make the darkest moment light.
Red and orange, yellow too,
All picked out especially for you.

Press it down and count to four,
Then open up the playroom door.
The magic shield is working fast,
Making all the ouchies past.

Dance around the kitchen floor,
We do not need to cry no more.
Your rainbow shield is shining through,
And bringing sunny smiles to you!

rhymes.title: Super Hero Patch
rhymes.text:
A little tumble on the mat,
We'll put a funny sticker pat.
Dry the eyes and take a breath,
We will conquer pain and death!

A super hero patch of blue,
Is waiting here to rescue you.
It flies right on your little knee,
As happy as a honeybee.

Now you have a power sign,
Everything is looking fine.
Fly around the living room,
Chasing off the rainy gloom.

The bandage is your cape so grand,
The greatest hero in the land.
Soar up high and touch the sky,
With happy songs that flutter by!

rhymes.title: The Magic Bandage Song
rhymes.text:
Oh no, a little scratch upon your knee,
Let's wipe the tiny tears away and see.
We have a special helper in the box,
As bright and happy as our fuzzy socks.

A magic bandage makes the boo-boo smile,
We'll wear it bravely for a little while.
It gives a hug and keeps the skin so dry,
So wave those little grumpy tears goodbye!

Jump up and down, your knee is feeling grand,
Protected by a sticker from our hand.
We wash it clean and kiss the spot so sweet,
From top of head to tiny dancing feet.

The magic bandage did its special trick,
And healed your little leg up very quick.
Now go and play outside into the sun,
The healing time is finished and we're done!

rhymes.title: Brave Little Hero
rhymes.text:
A tiny ouch is hiding on your arm,
We'll keep you safe and keep you out of harm.
Go grab the colorful and shiny wrap,
And put it gently in its happy lap.

The magic bandage comes to save the day,
To chase the little prickly hurts away.
It holds on tight just like a cozy bear,
And shows how very brave and strong you are.

Now stretch your arms and wiggle every toe,
It's time for our great hero outside to go.
The silly scratch is covered up and green,
The coolest bandage that you've ever seen.

We clap our hands for being so so bold,
A story of your bravery we'll be told.
The magic bandage sticks until the night,
And makes the world look cheerful and so bright.

rhymes.title: Flutterby Bandage
rhymes.text:
A butterfly flew down and kissed your hand,
The softest creature in the healing land.
And left a mark to show that she was near,
To dry away your little heavy tear.

Here comes a magic bandage for your skin,
With little smiling bugs that dance and spin.
We peel the paper back with gentle care,
And place the pretty sticker right up there.

It wraps around your finger like a bow,
And helps your special healing magic grow.
You do not need to worry or to frown,
The sweetest little patient in the town.

Now flex your finger and pretend to fly,
Up to the fluffy clouds inside the sky.
The magic bandage fixed the little sting,
And let your joyful spirit start to sing!

rhymes.title: Dinosaur Shield
rhymes.text:
A little bump can happen when we run,
When playing games and having lots of fun.
We stop and breathe and count up to our three,
Then find a shield as strong as it can be.

A magic bandage with a dinosaur scale,
With giant teeth and such a bumpy tail!
It covers up the scratch and makes it strong,
As we begin to sing our happy song.

Roar like a T-Rex stomp across the floor,
You do not need to shed a teardrop more.
The magic armor keeps the boo-boo safe,
Inside this cheerful and exciting place.

The hurt is gone and now it's time to play,
We brush the little dust right off away.
The magic bandage stays to guard your knee,
As strong and brave as any beast can be.

rhymes.title: Starry Night Healing
rhymes.text:
The day is busy and we take a fall,
Against the playground's bouncy rubber wall.
A little graze upon your tender hand,
Is easy for our magic to command.

A magic bandage glowing with a star,
Will travel with you near and travel far.
We place it softly on the tender spot,
And show the ouchie that it's quite forgot.

It sparkles in the light just like the moon,
And gets you back to playing games real soon.
With silver stripes and little golden dots,
It covers up all kinds of sleepy spots.

You give a giggle and your smile returns,
As every little lesson gently learns.
The magic bandage did its soothing job,
Without a single tear or heavy sob.

stories.title: Leo's Magic Sticky Hand
stories.text: Beep, beep! Zoom, zoom! Little Leo loved playing with his shiny red toy car on the living room rug. But today, it was time to go outside. Mama put on Leo’s soft blue jacket and zipped it all the way up to his chin. 'Time to go to the park, Leo! But remember our special rule before we step outside the big glass doors.' Leo knew the rule by heart. It was time for the Parking Lot Super-Hold! Mama knelt down so her eyes were right at Leo's level. She held out her hand, and Leo placed his little fingers right inside her big warm palm. 'Look at this,' Mama whispered with a big, happy smile. 'You have a magic sticky hand. When we are in the parking lot where the big cars move, your hand stays super-glued to mine.' Leo nodded seriously. He loved being a big boy. The big automatic doors slid open, and the bright, sunny parking lot came into view. Vroom! A big blue truck drove slowly by. Leo felt a little wiggle in his tummy, but he looked down at their connected hands. He squeezed Mama's hand tightly. 'Super-hold, Mama!' he cheered. 'That is right, my superhero,' Mama praised, giving his hand a gentle squeeze back. They walked safely between the parked cars, stepping carefully on the painted white lines. Leo pretended they were walking on a secret moon path. Because he kept his hand safely locked in Mama's super-hold, they reached the green park grass in no time at all. 'We did it!' Mama cheered, and Leo raised his free hand high into the air. He was so proud. They played on the swings and slid down the yellow slide, knowing that the Parking Lot Super-Hold kept him safe on every great adventure.

stories.title: Mia and the Robot Grip
stories.text: Clack, clack, clack went Mia’s sparkly pink shoes as she danced across the kitchen floor. Today was grocery day, and Mia’s helper job was very important. Papa grabbed his shopping bags and opened the front door. 'Ready, Mia-bee?' Papa asked. Mia stopped dancing and clapped her hands together. 'Ready, Papa! Time for the Parking Lot Super-Hold!' Mia loved this part of going out. To make it extra fun, Mia and Papa always turned their arms into strong, mighty robots. 'BEEP BOOP,' whispered Papa. 'Activating Robot Grip.' Mia giggled and wiggled her fingers. She pressed her hand firmly against Papa's hand. Their fingers locked together like puzzle pieces. 'Robot grip engaged!' Mia announced in her silliest robot voice. Together, the two mighty robots marched out the door and into the big, busy parking lot. Cars were backing out, and people were pushing carts full of apples and crackers. It was a very busy place, but Mia felt so safe inside her robot grip. She kept her eyes focused right on Papa's hand, making sure not to let go for even a single second. 'Beep boop, walking safely,' Mia sang quietly to herself. Papa looked down and gave her hand a warm, proud pat. 'Such a wonderful helper you are, Mia. Your super-hold is stronger than a bridge!' Mia puffed out her chest, feeling as brave as a lion. They walked right up to the sliding glass doors of the store, safely away from all the moving cars. Mia let go of the robot grip and gave Papa a high-five. They had conquered the parking lot together like a true team!

stories.title: The Super-Hero Sticky Stars
stories.text: Tiptoe, tiptoe, tiptoe! Toby the tiger was ready to pounce. He wore his favorite yellow sneakers with the easy-to-use velcro straps. Today, Toby and Grandma were going to the bakery to buy warm, yummy blueberry muffins. But first, they had to cross the big parking lot where the cars lived. Grandma stopped by the exit door and smiled down at Toby. 'Toby, do you remember our special superpower for today?' she asked gently. Toby’s eyes went wide. 'Yes! The Parking Lot Super-Hold!' Grandma nodded. 'That’s right. When our hands are locked together, we turn into Super-Hold Heroes.' Toby reached out and grabbed Grandma's hand, pressing his palm flat against hers. He imagined invisible golden stars glowing all around their fingers, sticking them together with super-hero glue. Grandma stepped outside first, and Toby stepped right beside her, keeping his sticky-star hand locked on tight. A red car drove past, making a friendly 'vroom' sound. Toby watched it go by, feeling safe and cozy right next to Grandma. He didn't need to run or let go, because being a Super-Hold Hero was much cooler. 'Look at us go, Grandma!' Toby beamed, taking big, proud steps. 'We are unstoppable!' Grandma laughed, squeezing his hand happily. 'We sure are, my sweet hero.' They walked side-by-side all the way across the pavement, keeping their sticky stars connected until they reached the safe sidewalk outside the bakery. Toby smelled the sweet muffins waiting inside and knew that his super-hold had made it all possible. He was the best parking lot hero in the whole wide world!

stories.title: Leo's Magic Sticky Hand
stories.text: Brisk autumn wind blew across the big parking lot, swirling colorful leaves around Leo's bright red shoes. Leo stood right by the shiny silver car door, his tummy doing a tiny flutter of excitement. This was a very important place. Cars zoomed softly like sleeping tigers, and big delivery trucks rolled by with a low rumble. Mommy smiled down at him, her eyes crinkling warmly. 'Time for the Parking Lot Super-Hold, my little explorer!' she announced. Leo knew exactly what to do. He reached out his right hand and wiggled his fingers. *Zap!* Magic super-glue power activated! He pressed his palm firmly against Mommy’s strong, warm hand. Their fingers locked together like puzzle pieces, snug and secure. 'Locked in!' Leo giggled, his voice bubbling with happy pride. Mommy praised him, 'Wonderful grip, Leo! You are holding on super strong.' Together, they began their grand journey across the vast expanse of asphalt. Left foot, right foot, step by step. Leo kept his eyes up, walking right beside Mommy. He practiced the superpower with every single step, squeezing just a little bit to feel the safety of her hand. A big blue van drove past slowly, but Leo felt brave because his Super-Hold was unbreakable. He was not just walking; he was being a superhero of safety. When they finally reached the sidewalk in front of the grocery store doors, Mommy gave his hand a happy wiggle. 'Mission accomplished!' she cheered. Leo beamed from ear to ear, feeling so grown-up and capable. He had successfully navigated the parking lot using his very own Magic Sticky Hand. Entering the sliding glass doors, he puffed out his chest proudly, ready for their shopping adventure, knowing he was Mommy's best helper and the champion of the Parking Lot Super-Hold.

stories.title: Mia and the Dinosaur Claw
stories.text: The shiny yellow school bus rumbled in the distance, but first, Mia and Daddy had to cross the big parking lot to get to the park. Mia loved the park, but she loved the parking lot rules even more because they made her feel like a mighty T-Rex! Daddy crouched down to her eye level and whispered, 'Are you ready for the Dinosaur Claw grip today, Mia?' Mia roared a tiny, happy dinosaur roar—*Rawr!*—and nodded fiercely. Instead of just holding hands normally, they did the Parking Lot Super-Hold. Mia curled her fingers just like a friendly dinosaur's big, safe claw, and clamped onto Daddy’s thumb. Daddy’s thumb was the sturdy tree trunk, and Mia’s hand was the strong dinosaur grip wrapped tightly around it. 'Claw engaged!' whispered Mia. Daddy praised her with a big thumbs-up with his other hand. 'Such a fierce and safe dinosaur grip, Mia! You are doing amazing.' They started walking across the gray pavement. Left foot stomp, right foot stomp. Mia kept her eyes on the cars parked neatly in their stalls, watching to make sure they stayed fast asleep. She kept her Dinosaur Claw locked securely onto Daddy, never letting go for even a single second. A gentle breeze ruffled her curls, but she didn't get distracted. She was a focused, safety-smart dinosaur on a very important mission. Daddy walked right beside her, keeping her safe from the big driveway lanes. When they stepped safely onto the grassy green park border, Mia let out a triumphant cheer and uncurled her fingers. 'We made it!' she shouted, jumping up and down. Daddy high-fived her. 'You mastered the Parking Lot Super-Hold like a true pro, Mia!' Mia smiled proudly, her heart full of joy, ready to swing on the monkey bars.

stories.title: Sam's Super-Safe Anchor
stories.text: The sun was shining brightly as Sam and Grandma stepped out of the bakery with a box of warm cookies. Between them and Grandma’s silver car lay the busy parking lot, filled with shiny vehicles and buzzing engines. Sam knew this was the time for the Parking Lot Super-Hold, his absolute favorite daily adventure. Grandma stopped at the edge of the curb and looked down at Sam with a loving smile. 'Shall we drop our anchor, Sam?' she asked. Sam nodded enthusiastically. 'Yes, Grandma! My hand is the super-safe anchor!' Sam opened his hand wide and then wrapped his fingers securely around Grandma’s index finger. He squeezed gently, imagining his hand was a heavy, safe anchor dropping deep down into the ocean floor, holding everything steady and secure. Grandma squeezed back gently to let him know she was holding on too. 'Anchor is set and super secure!' Sam announced proudly. Grandma beamed at him. 'Wonderful job, Sam. You are keeping us both so safe.' Together, they walked steadily across the parking lot. Sam practiced keeping his steps even and slow, right by Grandma’s side. He loved how warm her hand felt, and he loved knowing that his Super-Hold job was super important. A red car backed out slowly a few rows away, but Sam felt completely calm and brave because his anchor was locked in tight. He was paying great attention to the world around him, just like a big kid. When they finally reached the car door, Grandma unlocked it with a cheerful *beep-beep*. Sam released his anchor with a happy pop and stretched his fingers. 'We did it!' he cheered. Grandma opened the door and kissed his forehead. 'You are the greatest Parking Lot Super-Hold champion ever.' Sam climbed into his car seat, beaming with happiness and ready for the sweet ride home.

stories.title: Leo's Magic Sticky Hand
stories.text: Brisk autumn wind blew across the big parking lot, swirling red and yellow leaves in a joyful dance. Leo stood right at the automatic sliding doors of the grocery store, taking a deep, brave breath. Today was a very big day because today, Leo was going to master the Parking Lot Super-Hold! Mom knelt down to his eye level and smiled her warmest, most encouraging smile. She held up her hand, spreading her fingers wide like a starfish. 'Are you ready, Super Leo?' she asked gently. Leo nodded eagerly, his eyes shining with pride. 'I am ready, Mama!' he chimed. He reached out his own little hand and pressed it firmly against hers, skin to skin, finger to finger. Just like that, a magical connection was made. 'Super-Hold engaged!' whispered Mom in a playful, secret-agent voice. Together, they stepped out into the open space where cars drove by. Leo felt so strong and important. Vroom, vroom went a red car far away, but Leo wasn't scared at all because his hand was locked securely with Mama's warm grip. They walked steadily past the shiny blue sedan and the big green truck. Whenever a car's engine hummed softly, Leo gave Mama’s hand a proud little squeeze to show he was doing his super job. Mama squeezed right back, letting him know what a wonderful helper he was being. 'Look at you walking so safely and holding on so tightly,' Mama cheered softly. 'You are doing amazing, buddy!' Leo beamed from ear to ear. His chest puffed out with confidence as they crunched over a stray leaf on the asphalt. Walking through a parking lot used to feel a little bit too big and busy, but with his magic sticky hand activated, Leo felt like he could conquer the whole wide world. Finally, they reached the cart corral and stepped up onto the safety of the sidewalk. They stopped and let go, shaking their hands out with a funny giggle. 'Mission accomplished!' declared Mom. Leo jumped up and down with glee. He had done it. He was a true Parking Lot Super-Hold champion, keeping safe and staying close every single step of the way. Hooray for Leo!

stories.title: Maya and the Super-Hold Star
stories.text: The afternoon sun danced brightly off the windshields of dozens of parked cars, making the whole lot look like a glittering sea of diamonds. Maya stood right at the exit of the library, holding her favorite picture book tight against her chest with one arm. With her other hand, she was preparing for the most important mission of the afternoon: the Parking Lot Super-Hold! Dad walked up beside her and offered his thumb. 'My hand is a safe anchor, Maya,' Dad said in his kindest, most reassuring voice. 'Whenever we are where cars move, our hands stay together like glue.' Maya tucked her book under her armpit and reached out her hand, wrapping her small fingers securely around Dad’s thumb. 'Super-Hold ready!' Maya announced happily. Dad grinned down at her, his eyes crinkling at the corners. 'Let's go, Captain Maya.' Step by step, they ventured into the parking lot. Around them, doors clicked shut and engines started with quiet purrs. Maya kept her eyes forward and her grip nice and firm, remembering the secret rule of the Super-Hold. She knew that holding Dad’s hand wasn't just a rule; it was a special team-up that kept her safe and sound. A friendly beep echoed in the distance as someone locked their car, and Maya gave Dad's thumb an extra squeeze. Dad squeezed back warmly, sending a wave of cozy encouragement straight to her toes. 'You are holding on so wonderfully, sweet girl,' whispered Dad. 'I love our walking team.' Maya felt a warm glow of pride bubble up inside her tummy. She walked tall and proud, navigating around a painted white parking line like it was a tightrope in a circus. She loved how strong her grip felt, and how safe she was inside the loving circle of Dad's protection. Before long, they reached their own car safely. Dad unlocked the door with a cheery beep-beep, and Maya finally let go of her anchor, giving her fingers a wiggle. 'We did it! Super-Hold success!' she cheered, climbing happily into her car seat. Dad gave her a gentle high-five through the open door, celebrating her fantastic focus and wonderful listening skills.

stories.title: Sammy’s Superhero Grip
stories.text: The park gates swung open, revealing a vast parking lot that stretched out toward the street like a giant gray puzzle board. Sammy paused on the pavement, adjusting his pretend superhero cape over his shoulders. Today, he wasn't just Sammy; he was Super Sammy, protector of the sidewalk! But even superheroes needed a trusty sidekick, and Nana was right there by his side, ready for action. Nana knelt down so they were nose-to-nose. 'Are you ready to use your superhero grip for our walk to the car?' Nana asked with a joyful twinkle in her eye. Sammy nodded fiercely, his curls bouncing with energy. 'Yes! Super-grip activated!' he declared in his mightiest voice. Sammy reached out and grabbed hold of Nana’s index finger with both of his hands, wrapping his fingers all the way around like a little koala bear. Nana chuckled softly, her touch gentle and secure. Together, they stepped off the curb and into the bustling parking lot. Cars were parked neatly in rows, and a distant delivery truck rumbled softly. Sammy didn't mind the noises at all because his superhero grip was locked in tight. He walked carefully beside Nana, keeping his steps steady and focused. Whenever a car drove slowly by, Sammy gave Nana’s finger a brave little wiggle-squeeze to show he was paying super-duper attention. Nana beamed down at him with endless love and pride. 'Look at my strong superhero keeping safe,' Nana praised gently. 'You are doing such a brilliant job, Sammy.' Sammy felt like he could walk all the way to the moon and back. The parking lot was big, but his handhold was mighty. He concentrated on every single step, making sure his boots stayed right beside Nana’s shoes. Soon enough, they reached Nana's blue car parked near the very end of the row. Sammy let go of her finger and struck a big superhero pose next to the car door, hands on his hips and a huge grin on his face. 'We crossed the parking lot safely!' Sammy cheered triumphantly. Nana clapped her hands with delight. 'Fantastic job, Super Sammy! You are the best parking lot helper in the whole wide world!'

stories.title: Leo and the Super-Hold
stories.text: Beep, beep! Vroom, vroom! Leo and Mommy were at the big grocery store. It was time to go back to the car. The parking lot was very big, and lots of big vroom-vroom cars were driving around. Mommy kneeled right down to Leo's eye level. She gave him a big, warm smile. 'Leo, my sweet helper,' Mommy said gently, 'it is time for The Parking Lot Super-Hold! Are you ready?' Leo giggled and clapped his little hands. 'Yes, Mommy! Super-Hold time!' Mommy reached out her hand, and Leo reached out his strong little fingers. He wrapped his hand right around Mommy's thumb. He squeezed it tight, just like a little koala bear hugging a branch. 'I have you!' Leo cheered proudly. Mommy praised him with a bright, happy voice, 'Wonderful holding, Leo! You are keeping your body safe.' Together, they walked step-by-step across the gray pavement. Tap, tap, tap went their shoes. They looked left, and they looked right. A red car drove softly by, but Leo was not scared at all because he had his special Super-Hold. He felt so safe and so brave walking right next to Mommy. When they reached their shiny blue car, Mommy unlocked the door with a beep-beep sound. 'We made it!' Mommy cheered. She scooped Leo up for a giant hug. 'Thank you for doing such an amazing Super-Hold, Leo. You are growing up so strong!' Leo beamed with happiness. He loved being Mommy's safe little helper in the big parking lot.

stories.title: Maya's Magic Super-Hold
stories.text: The park was so much fun! Maya had whooshed down the slide and swung high up into the clouds. But now, the sun was starting to go down, and it was time to walk back to Daddy's car. Daddy smiled down at Maya and opened both of his hands. 'Maya, superstar,' Daddy said in a warm, cozy voice, 'we are about to enter the parking lot. That means it is time to turn on our magic Super-Hold.' Maya’s eyes sparkled. She loved magic games! 'Magic Super-Hold activated!' she whispered excitedly. Maya reached out and grabbed Daddy’s pointer finger with both of her hands. She squeezed super-duper tight, like a little puppy holding onto a favorite toy. 'I'm holding on tight, Daddy!' Maya announced. Daddy nodded and gave her hand a gentle squeeze back. 'I feel you, Maya! We are a team. Let's practice our safety steps.' As they walked across the parking lot, Daddy and Maya played a fun counting game. One, two, three steps by the yellow lines! Four, five, six steps near the silver truck! Maya kept her feet right next to Daddy's feet, holding on like super-glue. She felt so proud and independent, yet completely safe. When they finally reached their car, Daddy opened the door and cheered, 'Ta-da! Super-Hold champions!' Maya climbed into her car seat with a proud grin. She knew that holding hands in the parking lot was a very smart, big-kid thing to do, and it always kept her safe and sound.

stories.title: Sammy's Superhero Hold
stories.text: Whoosh! Zoom! Sammy was a speedy superhero flying all around the library parking lot. But wait! Superheroes always follow safety rules. Grandma paused by the glass doors and looked out at the rows and rows of cars. 'Calling Captain Sammy!' Grandma said playfully. 'Are you ready for your important mission today?' Sammy put his hands on his hips and puffed out his chest. 'Yes, Grandma! What is my mission?' Grandma smiled lovingly and held out her hand. 'Your mission is The Parking Lot Super-Hold. We must walk together, hand-in-hand, all the way to the green car.' Sammy's face lit up. He loved being a superhero. 'Okay! Super-Hold engaged!' Sammy grasped Grandma's hand firmly. He wrapped his fingers all the way around hers. 'I am holding on with superhero strength!' he declared. Grandma beamed at him with so much love. 'You certainly are, Sammy. That is the best holding I have ever seen!' With their hands linked tightly together, the brave duo started their journey. Step, step, step went their boots on the pavement. Sammy looked all around, keeping his eyes open and staying right by Grandma's side. He didn't let go for even a single second, because superheroes are always focused and careful. When they arrived safely at the green car, Grandma popped the trunk and gave Sammy a high-five. 'Mission accomplished!' Grandma said happily. Sammy giggled, feeling like the strongest, safest little boy in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Leo and the Magic Magnet Hand
stories.text: Beep, beep! Zoom, zoom! Today was the best day ever at the park. Leo loved the big blue slide. He loved the crunchy leaves. But then, Mommy said the magic words. 'Time to go to the car, Leo!' Leo knew what that meant. It was time for a very important mission. It was time for... The Parking Lot Super-Hold! Outside the playground gate was a big, wide parking lot. Big cars and trucks lived out here. They had big wheels and went vroooom! Leo puffed out his chest. He knew he had a super job to do. 'Mommy,' Leo whispered proudly, 'I am ready for my super-hold.' Mommy smiled and held out her hand. 'Ready, superhero?' she asked. Leo reached out his little fingers and grabbed Mommy’s thumb. He squeezed it tight, just like a super-strong magnet! Click! They were connected. Step by step, Leo and Mommy walked together. Left foot, right foot, left foot, right foot. A red car drove by, rumbly-rumble-rumble. Leo didn't let go. He held on extra close because his hand was a super-magnet. 'Look at you walking so safely!' cheered Mommy. Leo felt like a giant standing tall. He kept his eyes looking right ahead, following Mommy like a brave little duckling. They walked past a big silver van and a shiny green truck. Leo giggled as they took giant superhero steps over the painted white lines on the pavement. 'One, two, three, big step!' he counted. Before he knew it, they reached their very own car. Beep-beep went the keys! Leo opened his fingers slowly. 'Mission complete!' cheered Mommy. Leo clapped his hands together. He had kept himself safe in the big parking lot all by himself, just like a true superhero. Mommy gave him a giant bear hug and a high-five. 'You are my favorite parking lot hero, Leo!' she said. Leo beamed with pride as he climbed into his big-kid car seat. He couldn’t wait for his next big parking lot adventure tomorrow!

stories.title: Maya’s Super-Hold Star Power
stories.text: Splash, splash, go the paints! Maya loved painting at Grandma’s house. She painted a purple kitty and a green sun. But then the kitchen clock went tick-tock. Grandma said, 'Time to pack up, sweet pea. We have to go to the parking lot to find our car.' Maya put her crayons away nicely. She knew the parking lot was a busy place with lots of cars driving by. That meant it was time to turn on her special parking lot star power. 'Grandma, I’m ready for the Super-Hold!' Maya said with a big grin. Grandma held out her hand, and Maya placed her palm right against Grandma’s. Interlock! Finger to finger, hand to hand. They were locked together like strong, happy puzzle pieces. Grandma walked slowly, and Maya walked right beside her. They looked left, and they looked right. No cars were moving right now, but Maya still held on super tight. 'Hold on to the star power!' whispered Grandma. Maya squeezed gently. 'Locked in!' she giggled. A big delivery truck rumbled by, making a loud vroom-vroom sound. Maya didn't get scared. She just held Grandma's hand even tighter, feeling safe and cozy. They walked past the grocery carts and the shiny blue sedans. Maya pretended she was a brave astronaut walking on a brand new planet. Every step they took was steady and strong. 'Left foot, right foot, superstar march!' Maya whispered to herself. Grandma smiled down at her. 'You are doing such a wonderful job staying right by my side, Maya. I am so proud of you.' Maya beamed like the sun she had painted earlier. Walking safely in the parking lot wasn't scary at all when you had super-hold star power. Soon, they were standing right next to Grandma's red car. Maya let go of Grandma's hand and did a happy little victory dance. 'We did it!' she cheered. Grandma opened the car door and gave Maya a big, warm tickle hug. Maya hopped into her seat, feeling like the smartest, safest little girl in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Sam and the Super-Hold Anchor
stories.text: The library was Sam’s favorite place in the whole world. He had found a wonderful book about friendly dinosaurs. But soon, it was time to leave. Mommy looked down at Sam and said, 'Time to head out to the car, buddy. Time for our parking lot routine!' Sam nodded solemnly. He loved books, but he also loved doing big-boy things. He knew that the parking lot was like a busy river of cars. And to cross a busy river safely, you need a very strong anchor. Sam looked at Mommy’s hand. 'I am the anchor!' Sam declared proudly. Mommy laughed. 'You sure are, Captain Sam!' Sam grabbed hold of Mommy’s index finger with both of his little hands. He held on as tightly as a monkey swinging on a branch. Cling! They were ready. Mommy started walking, and Sam walked right with her, step for step, marching like a tiny soldier. Vroom-vroom went a silver car backing out of its spot. Sam watched it carefully, keeping his anchor grip nice and steady. He didn't run, and he didn't let go, even for a second. He was focused and strong. 'Anchor engaged!' Sam whispered softly. Mommy looked down with a loving smile. 'Thank you for holding on so safely, Sam. You are keeping us both so safe.' Sam puffed out his chest. Helping Mommy felt amazing. They passed the big yellow light pole and the white painted lines on the dark pavement. Sam counted the stripes as they walked. 'One stripe, two stripe, three!' Finally, they reached the car door. Sam released his grip slowly, opening his fingers wide like a flower blooming in the sun. 'Anchor released!' he announced. Mommy beeped the car locks and scooped Sam up for a huge cuddle. 'What a fantastic parking lot super-hold!' she praised him. Sam giggled and climbed into his booster seat, ready for the fun ride home, feeling like a very big boy indeed.

stories.title: Leo and the Super-Hold Starship
stories.text: Beep, beep! Vroom, vroom! Leo stood right by the big, shiny family car, ready for a very important mission. Today, Mommy and Leo were going on a grocery adventure to pick out yummy berries and crunchy crackers. But first, they had to cross the big, busy parking lot. Mommy knelt down with a wonderful, magical smile. 'Are you ready for our special mission, Captain Leo?' she whispered. 'It is time for the Parking Lot Super-Hold!' Leo’s eyes went wide with excitement. He knew just what to do! He reached out his strong, little hand and wrapped his fingers tightly around Mommy’s thumb. 'Super-hold engaged!' Leo giggled, making his best spaceship sound. Whoosh! Mommy and Leo walked side by side across the wide, gray pavement. Big cars were resting in their parking spots, and some were driving slowly by, but Leo felt as brave as a lion. He held on extra tight, keeping his super-hold strong and steady. 'Look at my super-hold strength!' Leo cheered happily. Mommy beamed down at him with so much love and pride. 'You are holding on so safely, sweet boy. You are my very best helper.' Step by step, they walked safely between the white lines. Leo looked down at his hand holding Mommy’s thumb, feeling like a true superhero. They reached the sidewalk safely, and Leo gave a little victory cheer. 'We did it! Mission accomplished!' Mommy gave him a gentle high-five and a warm hug. Inside the bright grocery store, Leo walked proudly beside the shopping cart, still feeling the warm glow of his super-hold success. Every time they had to cross a parking lot after that, Leo always remembered his important job, holding on tight and keeping safe right by Mommy's side.

stories.title: Mia and the Magic Bubble Shield
stories.text: The sun was shining brightly in the sky, and Mia was ready to go to the park with Daddy. They walked out of the sliding glass doors of the apartment building and stepped right up to the edge of the parking lot. Cars were everywhere—red ones, blue ones, and big silver ones too. Daddy stopped right at the curb and looked down at Mia. 'Time to turn on our invisible magic bubble shield, Mia-bee,' Daddy said softly. Mia giggled and clapped her hands. 'Yes, Daddy! The magic bubble shield!' To make the magic bubble work, Mia had to do the most important part of all: the Parking Lot Super-Hold. Mia reached out her little hand and held onto Daddy’s pointer finger with all her might. Her fingers squeezed gently, making sure she was securely attached. 'Shield activated!' Mia whispered loudly. With Daddy guiding the way, they stepped out into the parking lot together. Mia imagined a big, shimmering, sparkly bubble wrapping all around the two of them, keeping them super safe. A gentle breeze blew through her curls as they walked steadily across the asphalt. 'You are holding on so wonderfully, Mia,' Daddy praised, giving her hand a gentle squeeze back. Mia smiled from ear to ear, feeling so proud of her super-hold skills. She walked carefully, keeping her eyes up and staying right by Daddy’s hip. When they finally reached the green grass of the park, Mia let out a happy sigh. 'We made it through the parking lot safely!' she cheered, doing a little happy dance. Daddy laughed and scooped her up for a quick, joyful spin. Mia knew that whenever they had to cross a parking lot again, her super-hold and her magic bubble shield would always keep her safe and sound.

stories.title: Sammy and the Super-Hold Anchor
stories.text: Clack, click! Sammy buckled his favorite red shoes. Today was a very special day because Sammy and Grandma were going to the library to find dinosaur books. But first, they had to walk across the big parking lot where the cars lived when they were parked. Grandma paused right by the door and smiled down at Sammy. 'Sammy, sweetie, remember our parking lot rule?' she asked gently. Sammy nodded very seriously. 'Yes! The Parking Lot Super-Hold!' Sammy loved this part of the trip. He pretended he was a big, strong pirate ship, and Grandma's hand was his trusty anchor. Sammy reached out and held onto Grandma’s hand, wrapping his fingers securely around hers. 'Anchor is down!' Sammy announced in a deep, pirate voice. Grandma chuckled warmly. 'Anchor is secure, little pirate. Let’s set sail!' Together, they stepped off the sidewalk and into the parking lot. Sammy kept his feet moving right beside Grandma’s steps. He didn't let go for even a single second, keeping his super-hold strong just like a real anchor holding a ship steady in the harbor. A car nearby made a polite beep-beep sound, but Sammy didn't worry at all because he was safe with Grandma. 'You are doing such an amazing job holding my hand, Sammy. I am so proud of you,' Grandma said lovingly. Sammy puffed out his chest with pride. Walking safely across the lot was the best feeling in the world. When they reached the other side, right at the library steps, Sammy carefully let go of his anchor. 'We are safely in port!' Sammy cheered. Grandma smiled and patted his head. Inside the quiet, book-filled library, Sammy picked out three big dinosaur books, still feeling like the bravest little explorer in the whole wide world.

stories.title: Leo and the Magic Parking Grip
stories.text: Beep, beep! Vroom, vroom! Leo loved driving his toy cars across the living room rug, but today was a very special day. It was time to go to the park! Mommy put on Leo's shiny blue shoes, and Leo put on his biggest, brightest smile. But before they could open the front door, Mommy stopped and knelt down right next to him. 'Leo,' Mommy said softly, 'we are about to go into a big parking lot. Cars and trucks drive here. That means we have a very important mission today. Do you know what it is?' Leo shook his head, his curls bouncing. 'It is time for the Parking Lot Super-Hold!' Mommy cheered. Leo clapped his hands. He knew just what to do. He stretched out his little hand, wiggled his fingers like little wiggly worms, and pressed his hand right into Mommy’s big, warm palm. Grip! They held on super-duper tight. 'Hand in hand, safe in the land,' whispered Mommy, which was their favorite rhyme. Together, they walked out of the house and down the sidewalk. The big parking lot stretched out in front of them like a giant gray puzzle. Cars were backing up, and engines were humming. A red car drove by slowly. 'Vroom,' whispered Leo, but he did not let go. Not even for a second! His super-hold was as strong as a mighty superhero's cape. Mommy smiled down at him and squeezed his hand back. 'Look at you, Leo! You are holding on so safely. You are a true Parking Lot Superhero!' Leo beamed with pride. He kept his feet walking right beside Mommy, never running ahead, keeping his super-hold locked in tight. When they reached the safe green grass of the park, Mommy cheered again. 'We did it! Super-hold mission accomplished!' Leo giggled and danced a little happy jig. He loved being safe with Mommy, and he could not wait to try his super-hold again on the way back home.

stories.title: Mia's Sticky-Monkey Super-Hold
stories.text: The grocery store doors slid open with a soft swish, and Mia took a deep breath. She could smell yummy bakery cookies, but before she could run inside, Daddy held out his hand. 'Stop, pause, and check our paws!' Daddy sang out in his silliest voice. Mia giggled. It was time for her absolute favorite routine: The Parking Lot Super-Hold! Mia looked at Daddy’s hand, then looked at her own hand. 'Time to be a sticky monkey!' Mia announced. She wrapped her fingers around Daddy’s thumb just like a little monkey swinging from a jungle tree vine. Curl, wrap, squeeze! Her grip was super-duper strong, just like Gorilla glue, but way more fun. Outside, the parking lot was bustling with shoppers pushing carts full of apples and bananas. A big blue van backed out of its parking space with a beep-beep sound. Mia watched it carefully, but she felt completely safe because her sticky-monkey hand was glued safely to Daddy. 'Hold on tight, monkey bright,' Daddy encouraged, squeezing her little fingers gently. Mia took big, proud steps. She didn't let go when a lady walked past with a squeaky shopping cart, and she didn't let go when a friendly dog barked in the distance. She kept her eyes forward and her sticky-monkey grip locked in place. Daddy praised her every step of the way. 'Such wonderful listening, Mia. You are keeping yourself so safe!' When they finally stepped safely onto the sidewalk right outside the automatic grocery doors, Mia let out a happy sigh. She let go of Daddy’s hand and stretched her fingers wide. 'We made it, Daddy! The parking lot is conquered!' Daddy nodded and gave her a high-five. Mia felt like the smartest, safest little girl in the whole wide world, ready to help pick out the very best fruit inside.

stories.title: Sammy and the Starship Super-Hold
stories.text: Three, two, one, blast off! Sammy zoomed his toy spaceship through the hallway and right to the front door. Today, Sammy and Grandma were going on an adventure to the library to pick out dinosaur books. But first, they had to cross the big, busy parking lot where real cars rolled around like sleeping metal beasts. Grandma knelt down so she was eye-to-eye with Sammy. 'Captain Sammy,' Grandma said with a twinkle in her eye, 'our starship has a special rule for landing in parking lot space. Are you ready?' Sammy puffed out his chest. 'Ready, Grandma! Starship Super-Hold engaged!' Sammy raised his hand, forming the special clamp. Grandma opened her hand, and together, their fingers locked together like puzzle pieces. Click! There was no breaking this connection. It was stronger than robot steel. As they stepped outside into the bright afternoon sun, Sammy looked all around. He saw silver cars, red cars, and a big black truck. But Sammy wasn't scared for even a tiny second. He knew his hand was safe in Grandma’s hand. They walked side-by-side, marching like brave astronauts exploring a new planet. 'Left, right, left, right,' Sammy whispered to himself, keeping his feet right next to Grandma's sensible walking shoes. Grandma smiled warmly down at him. 'Look at my wonderful co-pilot. You are doing such a brilliant job keeping our super-hold secure.' Sammy beamed, feeling like a giant tower of strength. When they reached the safety of the library porch, they finally unlinked their fingers and did a silly little wiggle dance to celebrate. Sammy high-fived the library door handle. The parking lot had been completely mastered, and now it was time for dinosaurs!

stories.title: Leo's Magic Airplane Hand
stories.text: Buzzzzz! Zoom! Leo and Mommy were getting ready to step out of the big red car and into the busy grocery store. But wait! The parking lot was not just a parking lot today. Oh no. It was a giant, magical cloud sky! And to fly safely through the cloud sky, Leo had a very important job. He needed to activate his Magic Airplane Hand. 'Are your engines ready, Captain Leo?' asked Mommy with a warm, gentle smile. Leo giggled and wiggled his fingers. 'Vroooom! My engines are super ready, Mommy!' Leo placed his little hand right inside Mommy’s big, warm hand. Together, they made a locked-in spaceship grip. This was the Parking Lot Super-Hold! It kept Leo safe and steady just like a rocket ship on a track. 'Click-clack, locked on track!' whispered Mommy encouragingly. As they walked across the shiny pavement, Leo pretended they were flying past fluffy white clouds. He made soft airplane noises, keeping his feet moving safely right beside Mommy. Other cars drove by, but Leo didn't worry for even a tiny second. He knew his Super-Hold was the strongest in the whole wide world. When they reached the automatic sliding doors of the store, Mommy stopped and cheered, 'Mission accomplished, Captain Leo! We flew all the way through the clouds safely!' Leo beamed with pride. He unclicked his hand and gave Mommy a high-five. Walking through the parking lot was so much fun when you had a Super-Hold and a magic airplane hand. He couldn't wait to do it again on the way back to the car.

stories.title: Mia and the Puppy Paws
stories.text: Click, clack, unbuckle! Mia was stepping out of the car into the big, wide parking lot. It was time for a very special adventure. Today, Mia wasn't just a little girl; she was a bouncy, playful puppy exploring a brand new park! But every good puppy needs a trusted leader to walk beside. That meant it was time for the Parking Lot Super-Hold. Daddy knelt down to Mia’s eye level and held out his hand. 'Paw ready for the Super-Hold, little puppy?' Daddy asked softly. Mia giggled, held up her hand, and pressed it tight against Daddy’s palm. 'Woof! My paw is ready!' she answered happily. With their fingers intertwined in a cozy, unbreakable grip, they began their journey across the asphalt. 'Trot, trot, trot, go the puppy paws,' sang Daddy in a cheerful voice. Mia matched her steps to Daddy's rhythm, making sure she stayed right by his side. She looked at all the big cars parked in their rows, feeling so brave and secure. Whenever they had to walk past an empty parking space, Mia gave Daddy’s hand an extra squeeze. Daddy squeezed right back, letting her know she was doing a super-duper job. Positive reinforcement made Mia feel like she could do anything. 'Such a good helper and a wonderful walker,' Daddy praised gently. Soon, they reached the safe sidewalk outside the building. Mia let go of Daddy’s hand and did a happy puppy spin. 'We did the Super-Hold, Daddy!' she cheered, ready for the rest of their wonderful day together.

stories.title: Sammy’s Superhero Glue
stories.text: Beep-beep! The car engine turned off, and the doors opened wide. Sammy and Grandma were ready for a fun afternoon adventure, but first, they had to cross the parking lot. Grandma smiled down at Sammy and said, 'Time to activate our Superhero Glue!' Sammy’s eyes went wide with excitement. 'Superhero Glue! Yay!' Sammy held out his little hand, and Grandma pressed her hand right on top. Their hands squished together like they were covered in invisible, super-strong, giggly glue. This was the Parking Lot Super-Hold, and nothing could break it apart! With their hands glued safely together, Sammy and Grandma stepped out onto the ground. 'Superheroes walk together, side by side, keeping our eyes open wide,' Grandma chanted in a sweet, encouraging rhythm. Sammy puffed out his chest, feeling brave and strong just like a comic book hero. He looked left, he looked right, and he made sure his feet marched proudly beside Grandma’s shoes. A big truck rumbled nearby, but Sammy felt completely safe because his Superhero Glue was holding tight. Grandma gave his hand a gentle wiggle to remind him how proud she was. 'Look at my amazing superhero crossing the parking lot,' Grandma whispered lovingly. Sammy beamed from ear to ear, soaking up all the warmth and praise. When they reached the safety of the sidewalk, Grandma announced, 'Superhero Glue, release!' They pulled their hands apart and giggled. Sammy loved the Parking Lot Super-Hold because it made him feel like the strongest, safest superhero in the whole neighborhood.

stories.title: Leo's Magic Airplane Hand
stories.text: Buzzzzz! Zoom! Here comes pilot Leo, getting ready for the biggest adventure of the day: the great big parking lot! Parking lots can be very busy places, full of big metal cars and zooming delivery trucks. But Leo is not worried at all, because he has his very own secret superpower. It is called The Parking Lot Super-Hold! Before Leo and his mommy open the big grocery store doors, mommy stops and looks right into Leo's happy eyes. She says, 'Time for the Super-Hold, little pilot!' Leo smiles his biggest smile and reaches out his strong, steady hand. He wraps his little fingers tightly around mommy's thumb like a little koala bear hugging a tree branch. 'Locked in!' giggles Leo. Suddenly, mommy’s hand transforms into the strongest landing gear in the whole wide world. Together, they start walking across the gray asphalt. Tap, tap, tap go their shoes. As a big red car drives by slowly, Leo gives the thumb a gentle squeeze. 'Safe and sound,' whispers mommy. Leo feels so proud and brave keeping his Super-Hold locked on tight. He spots a yellow shopping cart corral up ahead and uses his pilot vision to steer them right toward it. Walking in the parking lot requires teamwork, and Leo is the best teammate ever. When they finally reach the sliding glass doors of the store, mommy gives Leo a warm high-five. 'We did it! Super-Hold mastered!' Leo does a little happy dance with his feet. He loves being so grown-up and responsible. Every time they visit the store now, Leo looks forward to activating his magic Super-Hold. It keeps him safe, keeps mommy happy, and makes him feel like a superhero starting a grand mission. Way to go, Leo! You are a parking lot champion of safety and fun.

stories.title: Maya and the Velvety Anchor
stories.text: Click, clack, goes the car seat buckle! Maya is finally out of the car and standing right on the edge of the bustling parking lot. Whirrr, beep-beep! A silver minivan is backing up carefully. Maya knows just what to do. She holds up her hand and waits for daddy. Daddy kneels down to her eye level and says, 'Maya, my sweet star, are you ready for our special Super-Hold?' Maya nods eagerly. 'Yes, daddy! Super-Hold time!' She reaches out her palm and grips daddy's index finger as if it were a velvety anchor holding her steady in a sea of motion. Daddy's hand is big, warm, and comforting. With her Super-Hold firmly engaged, Maya takes her first step onto the pavement. Step-by-step, they walk side by side. Daddy points out the white painted lines on the ground. 'Look, Maya, we are walking on the safe pathway together!' Maya looks down at her shiny red shoes marching right along the lines. She keeps her fingers wrapped securely around daddy's finger, never letting go for even a single second. When another shopper walks past carrying grocery bags, Maya squeezes the anchor a little bit tighter, feeling completely protected and secure. Daddy smiles down at her and says, 'Thank you for holding on so well, Maya. You are showing such wonderful safety skills.' Maya puffs out her chest with pride. She loves how the Super-Hold makes her feel like she has a superpower keeping her safe from all the zooming cars. When they reach the safety of the sidewalk right outside the bakery, daddy gently releases her hand with a tickle. 'Anchor lifted!' he laughs. Maya claps her hands in delight. She is learning how to navigate the big world safely, one loving Super-Hold at a time. What a wonderful adventure!

stories.title: Sam's Super-Hold Safari
stories.text: Welcome to the parking lot safari! Today, explorer Sam and his grandpa are on a very important quest to find the grocery store entrance. But before they can explore, Sam has to power up his favorite tool: The Parking Lot Super-Hold! Grandpa stops right by the car door and opens his hand wide like a bridge. 'Ready for the grip, Captain Sam?' he asks with a joyful twinkle in his eye. 'Ready!' shouts Sam cheerfully. Sam reaches out and locks his fingers securely around Grandpa’s palm. This isn't just an ordinary hold; it is a mighty Super-Hold that connects them together like two puzzle pieces. As they set off across the parking lot, Sam pretends they are walking through a jungle full of friendly metal beasts. Vroom goes a blue sedan! Honk-honk goes a little white hatchback! But Sam isn't scared at all, because his Super-Hold is keeping him right by Grandpa's side where it is safe and cozy. They practice their marching steps together. Left, right, left, right! Sam makes sure his fingers stay wrapped tightly around Grandpa's thumb, like a little monkey swinging safely through the trees. Grandpa praises him softly, saying, 'Such a fantastic grip, Sam.
