Maya puts the pretzel right on top of the oranges. It smells so delicious! Maya takes tiny, careful steps because she wants to protect her special load. She walks past the flowers, sniffing the sweet lavender in the air. When it is time to pay, Maya hands the basket proudly to Daddy so he can place the items on the counter. The baker gives Maya a high-five and says, 'Thank you for being such a wonderful helper!' Maya giggles and taps the baker's hand with her tiny fingers. Walking home, Maya holds Daddy's hand, feeling so proud of her important job. Helping out is so much fun when you are a growing toddler!

stories.title: Leo and the Rolling Wagon
stories.text: Rise and shine, sleepyhead! Today is shopping day for Leo and Grandma. Leo puts on his blue dinosaur sweater, zipping it up all by himself. Zzzzt! Good job, Leo! Grandma has a special little red pull-wagon just for him. When they arrive at the store, Grandma kneels down to Leo's eye level. 'Leo, my sweet boy, would you like to pull our cart wagon today?' Grandma asks gently. Leo nods very fast. 'I pull the wagon, Grandma!' he says with excitement. Grandma places the long wooden handle right in Leo's hand. Leo wraps his fingers around the smooth red wood. He pulls back, and the little wheels go click-clack, click-clack across the floor. It is the best sound in the whole wide world! Grandma needs to find some soft yellow bananas. Leo pulls his wagon over to the fruit stand, making a wide turn like a big red fire truck. Beep, beep! He backs up gently until he is right next to Grandma. Grandma places a bunch of yellow bananas inside the wagon bed. Leo watches them settle in. Then, they find a box of yummy oatmeal. Leo places the box inside too. Pushing and pulling takes a little bit of energy, but Leo is a big boy now. He takes slow, steady steps, making sure his wagon follows right behind Grandma like a cute little duckling. Every time they turn a corner, Leo looks back to check on his cargo. 'Such a wonderful driver!' Grandma praises, clapping her hands softly. Leo smiles a big, toothy smile. When they reach the front of the store, Leo helps Grandma empty the wagon into the big black belt at the register. The friendly cashier smiles and says, 'You did such an amazing job helping today!' Leo puffs out his tummy and feels as big as a mountain. Back home, Leo helps Grandma put the fruit away in the bowl. Grandma gives Leo a sweet kiss on his forehead and a star-shaped sticker for his shirt. Leo points to his sticker and does a happy little dance in the kitchen!

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to help and push the cart,
We are ready, let us start!
Wheels go round and wheels go fast,
We will load them up at last.

First we put the apples in,
Make a happy, smiling grin.
Next the carrots, long and bright,
Packing everything just right.

Push it softly down the floor,
We are heading to the door.
Helper hands are strong and grand,
Best young helpers in the land.

Now we unload piece by piece,
Watch the happy helpers cease.
Job is done and we did great,
Close the cart and shut the gate.

rhymes.title: Grocery Train
rhymes.text:
Chugga chugga, hear the sound,
Push the cart all round and round.
It is time to shop today,
Helping out is so much play.

Box of crackers goes right here,
Bananas make us give a cheer.
Milk goes gently in the base,
Big sweet smiles upon each face.

Hold the handle, grip it tight,
Steer the cart to left and right.
Walking slowly, nice and neat,
Moving down the market street.

We have got our items all,
Big and heavy, short and tall.
Time to pay and say goodbye,
Wave a happy hand on high.

rhymes.title: Toy Cart Parade
rhymes.text:
Get the play cart off the shelf,
We can do it by ourself.
Teddy bear and fuzzy cat,
Sit right down and stay like that.

Blocks of yellow, blocks of blue,
We have got a job to do.
Stack them neatly in the tray,
Cleaning up the toys today.

Marching forward in a line,
Everything looks looking fine.
Wheels are spinning on the rug,
Give the teddy bear a hug.

Cart is full of treasures now,
Take a bow and say meow.
Time to rest our busy feet,
Cleaning up is quite a treat.

rhymes.title: Roll the Cart Along
rhymes.text:
Roll the cart and roll it slow,
That is the way the helpers go.
Look for items on the shelf,
Reach and grab them by yourself.

Bread is soft and squishy too,
Put it in for me and you.
Eggs are fragile, handle nice,
Listen to the helper's advice.

Pushing forward, step by step,
Full of energy and pep.
Turning corners with a beep,
While the little babies sleep.

Now the basket is quite full,
Give it one more gentle pull.
We are done and we are glad,
Best assistant mom ever had.

rhymes.title: Helper Wheels
rhymes.text:
Hear the squeaky wheel go squeak,
We are helpers strong and meek.
Grabbing cart and holding on,
Working till the day is gone.

Cereal box and noodle pack,
Loading up the rolling rack.
Tissue paper, soft and white,
Everything is feeling right.

Pushing to the counter now,
Look at us and take a bow.
Putting items on the belt,
Best we have ever felt.

Cart is empty, ready more,
Time to leave the grocery store.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
We helped out so well today.

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to help and time to play,
We have errands here today.
Look at our big helper cart,
Come along and do your part!
Push it slow and push it straight,
We have so much in our crate.
Put the apples in the bin,
Look at all the snacks we win!
Tinkly bells and wheels go round,
Making such a happy sound.
Bananas yellow, milk so cold,
Look at all the food we hold.
Walking down the market aisle,
Wearing such a happy smile.
Now we roll it to the door,
We don't need to push it more!

rhymes.title: Cart Ride Home
rhymes.text:
Hold the handle, grip it tight,
Pushing cart is such a sight!
Wheels are turning left and right,
Making everything so bright.
Boxes heavy, bags so tall,
Helper toddler catches all.
Step by step we walk along,
Singing out our helper song.
Grocery store is lots of fun,
Working hard until it's done.
Cart is full of yummy treat,
Walking down the quiet street.
Almost home and almost there,
Floating softly on the air.
Park the cart and give a cheer,
Helper toddler we hold dear!

rhymes.title: Roll the Cart
rhymes.text:
Get the cart and roll it out,
Hear the happy toddler shout!
Help mommy and help daddy too,
There is so much work to do.
Put the bread right on the shelf,
Helper wants to do it self.
Cereal boxes stacked so high,
Reaching up into the sky.
Wheels go squeak and wheels go squeal,
Helping out is such a deal.
Plop the berries in the tray,
Saving sunshine for the day.
Push it down the shiny floor,
Right up to the kitchen door.
Good job, helper, take a bow,
Time to rest and settle now!

rhymes.title: The Grocery Helper
rhymes.text:
Time to shop and time to glide,
With our trusty cart beside.
Little hands upon the bar,
We can travel very far.
Carrot bunches, orange and bright,
Pack them neatly out of sight.
Cart is heavy, cart is grand,
Guided by a little hand.
Up the ramp and past the fruit,
Wearing boots and muddy suit.
Cart is rolling down the hall,
Helper toddler saves the fall.
Crackers crunching in the sack,
Happy helpers coming back.
Park the cart beside the wall,
You're the greatest help of all!

rhymes.title: Push and Smile
rhymes.text:
Push the cart with all your might,
Making everything just right.
Wheels go round and wheels go fast,
Helper toddler leads at last.
Milk goes clink and cans go thud,
Walking through the garden mud.
Load it up with things we need,
Moving at a happy speed.
Smile and laugh along the way,
This is such a joyful day.
Cart is heavy, cart is neat,
Walking with two tiny feet.
Almost to the register line,
Everything is looking fine.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
Cart is empty for today!

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to shop, time to go,
Pushing wheels so nice and slow.
Grab the handle, hold it tight,
Guide the big red cart aright.

apples round and bananas sweet,
Walking down the grocery street.
Put the milk upon the floor,
Rolling through the sliding door.

Boxes here and cartons there,
We can lift them with such care.
Helper hands are strong and grand,
Best assistant in the land.

Now we pay and then we breeze,
Push the cart back, if you please.
Job is done, we played our part,
Hurrah for the helper and the cart!

rhymes.title: Rolling Down the Aisle
rhymes.text:
See the basket on four wheels,
Look at how it turns and squeals!
Little helper by my side,
Ready for a grocery ride.

Crackers crisp and yummy bread,
Put them safely by your head.
Nothing heavy, nice and light,
Stacking everything just right.

Round the corner, beep-beep-beep,
While the tiny babies sleep.
We have apples, juice, and pears,
Climbing up the shiny stairs.

At the counter, time to pay,
We did such a super day.
Wave goodbye and give a start,
We love pushing our bright cart!

rhymes.title: My Little Cart Buddy
rhymes.text:
Wheels go click and wheels go clack,
With my buddy at the back.
Pushing forward, nice and neat,
Walking on my tiny feet.

Carrots orange, broccoli green,
Cutest helper ever seen.
Drop them in the basket deep,
While the tiny mice fall asleep.

Mommy smiles and daddy too,
Look at all the work we do!
Keep it steady, don't go fast,
Making sure our trip will last.

Checkout time is almost here,
Clap your hands and give a cheer.
Take the bags and do your part,
Thank you for your helper cart!

rhymes.title: Push and Smile
rhymes.text:
Time to help at the store,
Walking on the shiny floor.
Hands upon the plastic bar,
Pushing like a shiny car.

One box, two box, in they go,
Moving fast or moving slow.
Yummy yogurt, berries blue,
We can find them all for you.

Steering left and steering right,
Keeping everything in sight.
Such a helper, brave and strong,
Singing out our happy song.

Now the basket's getting full,
Give it just a gentle pull.
Rest the wheels and stop the start,
Good job with the helper cart!

rhymes.title: The Happy Helper Cart
rhymes.text:
Hop along, don't be late,
Grocery shopping is so great!
Grab the handle, stand up tall,
Helper cart is best of all.

Cheese and crackers, juice and meat,
Walking down the friendly street.
Place them gently in the bin,
See our happy little grin.

Push it softly, watch the way,
Helping out is fun today.
No bumps allowed, keep it clear,
Store is full of things so dear.

Finished shopping, time to go,
Wasn't that a lovely show?
Wave goodbye before we part,
We adore our helper cart!

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to shop, time to go,
Pushing wheels so nice and slow.
Grab the handle, big and tall,
Helpful toddler, best of all!

Apples red and bananas bright,
We will pack them just right.
Cart is heavy, wheels go spin,
Put the tasty goodies in.

Boxes here and cartons there,
We can carry with such care.
Walking down the grocery aisle,
Every shopper wears a smile.

Now we push right to the front,
Happy help is what we want!

rhymes.title: Little Push
rhymes.text:
Hold the cart with both your hands,
Travel through our storeland lands.
Step by step and toe to toe,
Watch the cart begin to go.

Milk and bread and tasty cheese,
Put them in the basket, please.
Working hard and doing great,
Helpful toddler loves the weight.

Round the corner, beep beep beep,
While the little veggies sleep.
Pushing hard from side to side,
What a fun and happy ride!

All done shopping, time to pay,
We saved all the food today!

rhymes.title: Cart Helper Chug
rhymes.text:
Chugga chugga, push along,
Singing out our helper song.
Cart is rolling down the floor,
Heading for the grocery door.

Pick an orange, pick a pear,
Put them gently in the square.
Toddler power, strong and sweet,
Helping out is such a treat.

Wheels are squeaking, left and right,
Making everything so bright.
Keep on pushing, do not stop,
We are helpers of the shop!

Now the cart is full and grand,
Best young helper in the land!

rhymes.title: Roll the Cart
rhymes.text:
Roll the cart and hold it tight,
Everything is going right.
Follow mom and follow dad,
Helper child is very glad.

Crackers crisp and yogurt cup,
We are scooping helpers up.
Pushing steady, looking down,
Best assistant in the town.

Turn the corner, beep the horn,
Best helper ever to be born.
Wheels go round and wheels go fast,
We are at the check-out last.

Cart is empty, cart is filled,
Look at how our job is billed!

rhymes.title: The Grocery Train
rhymes.text:
All aboard the grocery train,
Sun is shining through the pane.
Pushing cart so big and wide,
With our helper right inside.

Cereal boxes stacked so high,
Wave to people passing by.
Drop them in with gentle care,
Helper magic everywhere.

Pushing forward, don't look back,
Staying right upon our track.
Toddler muscles, firm and strong,
Help us sing our helper song.

Now we put the items down,
Best helper in the whole wide town!

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to shop, let's grab the cart,
We are ready, very smart!
Pushing forward, hand in hand,
Best helpers in all the land.

Look at shelves so high and wide,
Sit right safely by my side?
No, we walk and help mom choose,
Following the golden clues.

An apple red, a banana too,
Placing gently, just for you.
Wheels go round and wheels go fast,
Making sure nothing is last.

Now we roll right to the front,
Finishing our market hunt!
Pat your back, you did so great,
Helper superstar is fate.

rhymes.title: Roll the Cart Along
rhymes.text:
Grocery day is here once more,
We are walking through the door.
Grab the handle, hold it tight,
Pushing wheels with all your might!

Round the corner, beep-beep-beep,
While the little babies sleep.
We find milk and we find bread,
Happy thoughts inside our head.

Put the boxes in the tray,
Helping out the grown-up way.
Clap your hands and sing a song,
As we roll the cart along.

Heavy things and light ones too,
Look at all the work we do!
Time to pay and time to go,
Fast and steady, not too slow.

rhymes.title: Little Cart Rider
rhymes.text:
Up we step and in we sit,
Buckle up a little bit.
Here is our chariot on wheels,
Look at how happy it feels!

Off we go to find the treats,
Passing by the yummy sweets.
Point to carrots, point to peas,
Saying thank you and good please.

Watch the basket fill right up,
Like a happy puppy pup.
We are partners, you and I,
Wave to people passing by.

Cart is full and we are done,
Shopping is so full of fun.
Time to steer us to the car,
Our bright shining helper star!

rhymes.title: Cart Helper March
rhymes.text:
Marching feet and rolling wheels,
That is how a helper feels.
Keep your hands upon the bar,
We can travel very far.

Find the cereal on the rack,
Put it safely in the sack?
Put it gently in the cart,
Now we play our special part!

Red tomato, yellow pear,
We make sure there's plenty there.
Sing a little marching tune,
We will finish up so soon.

Pushing steady, left and right,
Making everything so bright.
Helper medal on your chest,
Little shopper, you're the best!

rhymes.title: The Grocery Train
rhymes.text:
Choo-choo train upon four wheels,
Listen how the metal squeals!
We are driving down the aisle,
Wearing such a happy smile.

Stop at crackers, stop at cheese,
Taking orders if you please.
Load them carefully inside,
For a very bumpy ride.

Not too fast and not too slow,
Watch the yellow arrows glow.
You are strong and you are brave,
All the items we will save.

Park the train and empty out,
Give a happy helper shout!
Job is finished, time for home,
No more grocery stores to roam.

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to help us shop today,
Roll the cart and lead the way!
Hold the handle nice and tight,
Push it forward, left and right.

Apples red and bananas yellow,
Put them in, you little fellow.
Boxes heavy, boxes light,
Stack them up and make them right.

Walk so slowly, step by step,
Keep the cart in happy step.
Round the corner, look ahead,
Time to roll, just like we said.

At the counter, stop and wait,
Help unload upon the plate.
Give a clap, you did your part,
Helper of the shopping cart!

rhymes.title: Roll the Cart Along
rhymes.text:
Wheels are spinning on the floor,
We are walking through the store.
Grab the cart and give a cheer,
Shopping day is finally here!

Find the milk and find the bread,
Put them safely in their bed.
Cereal boxes tall and grand,
Fit right in your tiny hand.

Push it softly, watch your toes,
Follow where the mother goes.
Not too fast and not too slow,
Watch the little cart wheels go.

All done shopping, time to pay,
We did such a super day.
Give a smile and play your part,
Such a helpful shopping cart!

rhymes.title: Little Cart Helper
rhymes.text:
Little helper, big routine,
Best young shopper ever seen!
Grip the bars and stand up tall,
Push the cart so proud and small.

Carrots orange, broccoli green,
Cutest helper ever seen.
Drop them in the basket deep,
While the grocery aisles we keep.

Turn the corners nice and neat,
Moving fast your little feet.
Watch out cart, don't bump the wall,
You are doing great through all!

Checkout time is nearly here,
Give the cashier all our cheer.
Take a bow and touch your heart,
Master of the helpful cart!

rhymes.title: Push and Smile
rhymes.text:
Hear the wheels go squeak and squeal,
Helping out is such a deal!
Grab the basket, take your place,
Happy smile upon your face.

Eggs are fragile, handle slow,
Where the cart and helper go.
Soup cans stacked in rows of four,
Rolling down the grocery floor.

Up and down the aisles we glide,
With the big cart right beside.
Safe and steady, push along,
Singing out our helper song.

Bag it up and roll away,
We are finished for the day.
Clap your hands and do your part,
Champion of the helper cart!

rhymes.title: The Grocery Train
rhymes.text:
Choo choo train goes down the aisle,
Pushing carts with style and smile!
Hold on steady, do not let go,
Moving like a train so slow.

Cheese and crackers, juice and meat,
Find the items that are sweet.
Into basket, drop them down,
Best young helper in the town.

Steer it left and steer it right,
Keep the shopping cart in sight.
Every item safely stored,
All aboard the grocery board!

Now we put the cart away,
Thank you for your help today.
Time to rest and time to start,
Loving every shopping cart!

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to help us shop today,
We will work and we will play.
Grab the cart and hold on tight,
Pushing forward left and right.

Apples red and bananas sweet,
Walking down the grocery street.
Put them in and count to four,
We love going to the store.

Boxes tall and cartons too,
Look at all the things we do!
Mommy smiles and claps her hand,
Helper of the toddler land.

Now we push it to the line,
Helping out is so much fine!
Wheels go round and wheels go round,
Best helper that can be found.

rhymes.title: Grocery Adventure
rhymes.text:
See the cart so big and wide,
With a toddler right inside?
No, we walk beside and push,
Past the green broccoli bush.

One big box of cereal flake,
And the cookies we will bake.
Drop them in with gentle care,
Helper skills are everywhere.

Bread goes soft upon the top,
Make sure that the cart don't stop.
Push it slow and push it straight,
Helper badge looks simply great.

Round the corner we will glide,
With our helper gear and pride.
Time to pay and time to go,
Best helper that we all know.

rhymes.title: Wheel Around the Store
rhymes.text:
Wheels go squeak and wheels go round,
Best helper in the whole wide town.
Hold the handle, grip it tight,
Keep the big cart moving right.

Cart is getting full and neat,
Walking on our little feet.
Carrots orange, berries blue,
Helper, I am proud of you!

Heavy cans go down below,
Watch the cart go nice and slow.
Top shelf holds the juicy pear,
Helper puts it safely there.

Almost done with shopping day,
Time to pack and time to pay.
Wave goodbye to wheels and store,
Ready for a helper more!

rhymes.title: Push the Cart Today
rhymes.text:
Up we get and off we go,
To the market, row by row.
Grab the handle, be so brave,
Helper helpers, wave and wave.

Milk for baby, eggs for lunch,
Put them in a happy bunch.
Push the cart with all your might,
Making sure it travels right.

Look at how it rolls along,
Singing out a helper song.
Nothing falls and nothing breaks,
See the happy path it takes.

Shopping mission now is done,
Helping out is so much fun.
Push it proudly to the car,
Our little helper superstar!

rhymes.title: Helper at the Market
rhymes.text:
Time to get the items neat,
Marching on our steady feet.
Cart is waiting, shiny bright,
Helper grabs it with delight.

Drop the pasta in the bay,
We are shopping here today.
Cheese and yogurt in a row,
Watch the heavy cart now go.

Steering left and steering right,
Helper is a shining light.
Mommy says a thankful word,
Sweetest helper ever heard.

Park the cart and let it rest,
Helping out is simply best.
High five for a job well done,
Shopping is our favorite fun.

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to help us shop today,
We will work and we will play.
Grab the cart and hold on tight,
Pushing forward left and right.

Apples red and bananas sweet,
Walking down the grocery street.
Put them in and tuck them low,
Watch our little basket grow.

Crackers crisp and milk so cold,
Look at all the food we hold!
Step by step we walk along,
Singing out our helper song.

At the checkout we are done,
Helping out is so much fun!

rhymes.title: Wheels Go Round
rhymes.text:
Hear the wheels go round and round,
Rolling softly on the ground.
We can push with all our might,
Keep the cart go shining bright.

Bread and butter on the shelf,
I can reach it by myself.
In the basket it will go,
Moving very, very slow.

Carrots orange, broccoli green,
Best helper you've ever seen.
Up the aisle and past the door,
Looking for a little more.

Now the cart is full and neat,
Helping out is such a treat!

rhymes.title: Little Push and Pull
rhymes.text:
Little hands upon the bar,
We are going very far.
Pushing carts is what we do,
I am helping, are you too?

Cereal boxes stacking high,
While the shoppers wander by.
Gentle push and careful steer,
Mom and Dad are standing near.

Into every corner nook,
Let us take another look.
Juice boxes and berries sweet,
Making up our shopping treat.

Time to pay and time to ride,
With the cart right by our side!

rhymes.title: Grocery Train
rhymes.text:
Choo choo train goes down the aisle,
Every shopper wears a smile.
We are driving through the store,
Looking for some items more.

Eggs are safe and placed up high,
As the cart goes rolling by.
Cheese and yogurt in the back,
Ready for our shopping pack.

Push it softly, do not run,
Shopping is a lot of fun.
Keep the wheels in line so straight,
Our cart helper does look great.

Now we roll right to the car,
We are superstars by far!

rhymes.title: The Cart-Helper Song
rhymes.text:
Grab the handle, take a stand,
Hold the cart with steady hand.
Down the grocery rows we go,
Walking fast or walking slow.

Soap and sponges, paper towels,
No one frowns and no one growls.
Everything is neat and square,
Placed with love and tender care.

We can count the items three,
Just my helper friend and me.
Pushing heavy loads with pride,
With our family by our side.

Now the mission now is through,
Good job little helper, you!

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to shop, let's go, go, go!
Push the big red cart, nice and slow.
Put the apples in the bin,
Look at all the food within!

Cart helper, helper, strong and bright,
Pushing wheels with all your might.
Milk goes here and bread goes there,
Helping out is very fair.

Down the aisle we gently steer,
Mommy and daddy are right here.
Look at oranges round and sweet,
Making grocery trips a treat!

Now we reach the very end,
Wave goodbye to our cart friend.
Great job helper, clap, clap, clap,
Time for lunch and then a nap!

rhymes.title: Wheels Go Round
rhymes.text:
See the basket on four wheels,
Look how happy little squeals!
Grab the handle, hold it tight,
Guide the cart with all your might.

Bananas yellow, tall and high,
Wave as we go rolling by.
Put the cereal on the shelf,
Helper does it by themself!

Watch the corners, turn around,
Hear the happy rolling sound.
Carrots crunch and berries blue,
All picked out by clever you.

Pushing carts is such great fun,
Look at everything we've done.
Smile and cheer from toes to head,
Time to roll towards home instead.

rhymes.title: Little Shopper
rhymes.text:
Put your hands upon the bar,
We are driving in a car!
No, it is a shopping cart,
And you play a special part.

Find the pasta, find the rice,
Everything is looking nice.
Drop the crackers in the back,
Don't forget the cookie pack!

Steer to left and steer to right,
Keep the silver wheels in sight.
Helper hands are helping me,
As busy as a honeybee.

Now we pay and we are through,
So proud of the things you do.
Give a hug and give a cheer,
Best little shopper of the year!

rhymes.title: Cart Buddy
rhymes.text:
Wake up cart, it is time to roll,
Helping mommy is our goal.
Hold the handle, push it through,
I am so proud of you.

Cheese and yogurt, eggs so white,
Pack them safely, nice and tight.
Every item in its place,
With a smile upon your face.

Round the corner, beep, beep, beep!
While the little babies sleep.
We are shopping, you and I,
Watch the friendly people by.

Empty out the cart today,
Put the groceries all away.
Give a cheer for helper dear,
Best helper of the entire year!

rhymes.title: Rolling Along
rhymes.text:
Push the cart both near and far,
Shining like a little star.
Walking down the grocery aisle,
With a big and happy smile.

Pick a box of oatmeal square,
Put it safely right in there.
Helper muscles, big and strong,
Help us sing our shopping song.

Watch out feet and watch out toes,
Where the silver wagon goes.
Bread goes up and juice goes down,
Best cart helper in the town.

Checkout time is here at last,
Time has gone by very fast.
Clap your hands and shout hooray,
For our helper here today!

rhymes.title: The Big Red Cart
rhymes.text:
Time to shop, let's play a part,
We will push the big red cart!
Hold the handle, nice and slow,
Look at all the places we go.

First we find some yummy bread,
Pop it in and go ahead.
Grab the apples, shiny and red,
Time to stock the cart instead!

Milk goes here, bananas too,
Cart is getting full for you.
Pushing hard with all our might,
Everything is looking right.

Now we roll right to the front,
We have finished our grand hunt!
Helpful hands are shining bright,
Cart helper, you did it right!

rhymes.title: Grocery Train Chug
rhymes.text:
Chug-a-lug, the grocery train,
Rolling down the grocery lane!
Beep, beep, watch us steer,
The helper cart is coming near.

Put the crackers on the floor,
Then we look for something more.
Boxes stacking up so high,
Wave to people passing by.

Wheels are spinning round and round,
Making not a single sound.
Cheese and carrots, in they fall,
Our little cart can hold them all.

Now the aisles are left behind,
Best helper we could ever find!
Park the cart and give a cheer,
We are the helper champions here!

rhymes.title: Push and Count
rhymes.text:
Grab the cart and take a stand,
Hold the metal with your hand.
One, two, three, let us count,
Look at all the things about!

Find a box of cereal sweet,
Put it where the helpers meet.
Find some pasta in a sack,
Put it safely in the back.

Keep on pushing, do not stop,
We are heading to the top.
Four and five and six and seven,
Shopping feels just like a heaven.

Cart is full, our job is done,
Helping out is so much fun!
Smile big and wave goodbye,
Helper stars up in the sky!

rhymes.title: The Helper's Wheels
rhymes.text:
Hear the little wheels go squeak,
We are helpers bold and meek!
Steer it left and steer it right,
Keeping all the groceries tight.

Reach up high to grab the pear,
Place it gently with great care.
Yogurt cups go in the side,
Come along for such a ride!

Push it steady, push it strong,
Singing out our helper song.
Not a bump can make us trip,
What a super shopping trip!

Done with shopping, time to pay,
We saved the day in every way.
Pat your back and give a shout,
That is what helpers are about!

rhymes.title: Roll Around the Store
rhymes.text:
Roll the cart around the floor,
Walking through the giant door.
Little helper, big routine,
Best worker we have ever seen.

Pick a melon, round and green,
Biggest fruit we have ever seen.
Slide it in the basket low,
Watch the pile start to grow.

Keep our hands upon the bar,
We can travel very far.
Round the corner, past the meat,
Marching with our happy feet.

Cart is parked, we did our chore,
Time to head outside the door.
Great big hugs for helper grace,
Bringing smiles to every place!

stories.title: The Little Red Car Gets Buckled
stories.text: Beep beep! Wake up, little explorer! Today is a big adventure day with Mama and Papa. First, we need to put on our shoes, grab our favorite teddy bear, and head out the front door. The sun is smiling warmly in the sky, and the birds are singing a happy morning song. Now it is time to go to the driveway where our shiny blue car is waiting patiently for us. Open the door, climb up into the big red car seat, and give a giant stretch. Cozy! Now, before our car can drive vroom-vroom to the park, we need to do our very special magic trick. Can you help me find the straps? Here is the left strap, and here is the right strap. They want to give you a big hug! Bring them together right over your tummy. Are you ready? Listen closely. One, two, three... Click! Clack! Yay! You did it! The buckle is locked tight and safe. Let us check our work. Tug-tug on the straps. Are they nice and snug? Yes, they are! You look just like a brave race car driver ready for the track. Papa gives you a high-five, and Mama smiles big, saying, 'Look at my safe and snug helper!' Being buckled up properly means you can enjoy the bumpy roads and the sharp turns without even wobbling. It keeps you safe inside your special seat. Now that we are all snug as a bug in a rug, the engine starts to purr. Vroom-vroom, off we go! You wave goodbye to the driveway and giggle as the car rolls down the street. You did such a wonderful job listening and getting ready for our trip. Whenever we get into the car, we always remember our magic rule: Click-clack, safe and snug! You are growing up so big and smart. Let us sing our favorite car song together all the way to the park!

stories.title: Bus Ride Buddies
stories.text: Chug-chug, chug-chug! Here comes the big yellow school bus rolling down the street, stopping right at the corner. Good morning, friendly bus driver! Today, Leo gets to ride the bus all the way to Grandma’s house. He holds tightly to Grandma’s warm hand as they step up the big stairs one, two, three. Look at all the fluffy seats inside! Leo finds a lovely window seat with a wonderful view of the tall green trees and the fluffy white clouds floating by. But wait! Before the bus can rumble and tumble down the road, Leo knows just what he needs to do. He sits all the way back in his seat, bottom against the cushions. Then, he reaches across his tummy to find the two seatbelt ends. They are waiting just for him. He pulls the left side over his lap and connects it to the buckle on the right. Are you ready for the magic sound, Leo? Let us listen together. Click! Clack! Oh, that is such a satisfying sound! It means everything is locked into place. Leo tugs gently on the belt to make sure it is snug and secure, hugging him tightly just like a warm blanket. Grandma claps her hands and whispers, 'Safe and snug, my sweet little bug!' The bus driver looks in the big rearview mirror and gives Leo a cheerful thumbs-up. Leo beams with pride because he knows how to take care of himself and be a safe passenger. The bus starts to move, swaying gently from side to side. Leo looks out the window, waving happily to a puppy on the sidewalk. Because he is clicked, clacked, safe, and snug, he can enjoy the wonderful ride without any worries at all. Riding the big bus is so much fun when you do the safety check first. Hooray for smart little bus riders!

stories.title: The Airplane Journey to Dreamland
stories.text: Zoom! Up into the clouds flies Maya’s toy airplane, and today, Maya is pretending she is a real pilot flying all the way to the moon. But first, she has to get ready for takeoff in the big passenger airplane with her family. They walk down the long aisle of the airplane and find rows and rows of cozy seats. Maya climbs up into her very own seat by the window. She can see the luggage carts zooming around outside. The friendly flight attendant walks by and gives Maya a big, encouraging smile. Now, it is time for the most important pilot rule of the day. Maya picks up the heavy metal seatbelt ends. They feel cool and smooth in her small hands. She places the belt low across her lap, right over her legs. She pulls the two pieces together, pushing them into the buckle until her ears catch the magic sound. Click! Clack! Just like that! Maya giggles with delight. The belt holds her gently, keeping her safe and snug in her seat, ready for any bumpy air up in the sky. Her big brother watches and says, 'Wow, you are ready to fly, Captain Maya!' Maya tests the belt by giving it a little tug. Yep, nice and tight! The pilot's voice comes over the loudspeaker, welcoming everyone aboard and telling the passengers to make sure their seatbelts are fastened securely. Maya proudly taps her belt and says, 'All safe and snug!' The engines roar to life with a mighty sound, and the airplane races down the long runway. Faster and faster it goes until—whoosh!—they lift right up into the bright blue sky. Maya presses her face against the window, watching the houses turn into tiny toy blocks below. Because she clicked and clacked her belt, she feels like a brave, secure explorer soaring through the clouds. What a wonderful, safe adventure!

stories.title: The Car Seat Adventure
stories.text: Beep, beep! Time for a fun ride in the red car today, little Leo! But before the wheels go round and round, we have a very important helper job to do. It is time to climb up into your big-kid car seat. Up, up, up you go, settling right down into the cozy, soft cushion. Look at those strong shoulders! Now, let's look down for the special safety straps. Here comes the left strap over your shoulder, and here comes the right strap, resting just right. Now comes the best part of the whole trip—the wonderful sound! Can you help me find the buckle? Push it down gently. Click! Did you hear that? Click-Clack, safe and snug! You did it all by yourself, Leo! That wonderful sound means your seat is hugging you tight and keeping you safe while we drive to the park. Let's give a happy little cheer for our safe car ride. Yay! Your arms are free to wiggle, your legs are ready for the swings, but your tummy is safely tucked in. The engine purrs, vroom vroom, and off we go on our sunny day adventure. You are such a smart traveler, always making sure you are buckled up tight before the car moves. When we arrive at the park, you wait patiently while mommy helps you unbuckle with a soft pop. Click goes the button, and out you slide, ready to run and play in the green grass. But you always remember how good it felt to be safe and snug in your special seat. Being safe is the best way to start any journey, big or small. Give yourself a high-five for being such a safe traveler today, Leo. You are growing up so fast, learning how to take care of your body every single day. Let's get ready for more fun tomorrow!

stories.title: The Magic Stroller Ride
stories.text: Good morning, sweet Mia! The sun is peeking through your bedroom window, and the birds are singing outside. It is time for our morning walk to see the big, fluffy clouds and the tall trees in the neighborhood. But first, let's hop into your magical rolling chariot—your stroller! Step one, two, into the comfy seat you go. Ah, stretch those little toes and lean back against the soft padding. Now, Mommy needs to pull out the shiny safety belt to make sure you are ready for a smooth journey. We wrap the cozy strap across your lap, just like a superhero belt. Ready? Let's listen closely for the magic sound. Push the two ends together. Click! There it is, the sweetest sound in the world. Click-Clack, safe and snug! You are locked in, perfectly cozy, and ready to see the world. The stroller wheels begin to turn, rolling smoothly down the sidewalk. Whish, whish, go the wheels. You point your little finger at a passing butterfly and giggle with pure joy. Because you are safely buckled, you can wave at the neighbor's friendly dog without wobbling at all. Being safe and snug lets you enjoy the ride with total peace and happiness. When our walk is all done and we roll back up to our front porch, it is time to open the magic belt. Mommy presses the center button, and pop, it opens right up. You stretch your little arms up high, ready to give the biggest hug. You love your strolls, and you love knowing that being safe makes every single trip twice as fun. You are our favorite little explorer!

stories.title: The High Chair Feast
stories.text: Sniff, sniff! Mmm, what is that wonderful smell coming from the kitchen? It is yummy banana pancakes and warm milk, just for you, baby Sam! tummy rumbles, and it is time for a delicious meal. But before we can take even one tiny bite of our tasty breakfast, we have a special safety rule to follow. Up, up into the big wooden high chair you climb, sitting as tall as a mountain. You wiggle your toes in anticipation of the yummy treats. Now, let's get our little body ready for sitting still while we eat. Pull the soft waist straps around your tummy. Snap the left side, and snap the right side together. Click! Oh, wonderful! Click-Clack, safe and snug! Now you are secure in your special dining spot, ready for your morning feast. Mommy places the bright blue plate right in front of you. You pick up a soft piece of banana pancake with your sticky little fingers and take a happy bite. Yum, yum, delicious! Because you are safely buckled in your chair, you won't wobble or slide while you happily munch away. You can use both hands to explore your food, squishing and tasting to your heart's content. When your tummy is full and happy, and your fingers are all sticky, we wipe your face with a warm washcloth. Then it is time for the magic release. Mommy presses the buckle, pop, and you are free to hop down for playtime. You always know that being safe and snug helps you enjoy your meals safely. Good job being such a wonderful listener, Sam! Time for some fun toys.

stories.title: The Little Red Shoes
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! It is time to get ready for a big, fun day of exploring. First, we need to put on our clothes. Look at the bright yellow shirt! Up it goes over your head, pop! Your arms come out like happy little tree branches. Next comes your favorite part: shoes! Here are your shiny red shoes. They are waiting patiently by the door. Let us sit right down on the cozy rug. You pick up the left shoe and slide your little toes all the way inside. Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle! They fit just right. Now for the magic trick of the day. Do you hear that sound? Click-clack! That is the sound of your buckle locking in tight to keep you safe and snug. Let us do the other one. Slide the foot in, pull the strap across, and press down. Click-clack! Yay! Both shoes are on and ready for action. You stand up tall and stamp your feet on the floor. Stomp, stomp, stomp! Your shoes feel so sturdy. They are ready to walk to the park, hop over sidewalk cracks, and run through the green grass. Mommy and Daddy are so proud of how big you are getting. You did such a wonderful job putting on your shoes all by yourself today. Every single step you take is a safe step because you fastened them nice and tight. Now, let us go outside and see what adventures are waiting for us in the big, beautiful world. Click-clack, safe and snug, off we go to play!

stories.title: Buckle Up, Bear Cub
stories.text: Beep, beep! All aboard the family car! Today, we are going on a magical journey to visit Grandma's house. But before our car can roll down the street, we have to follow a very important rule to stay safe and snug. Can you guess what it is? It is time to buckle up! You climb up into your big-kid car seat and get as cozy as can be. You lean your back against the soft cushion and pull your knees in. Now, reach your hands out wide. Here comes the sturdy seatbelt strap, stretching all the way across your tummy like a warm, safe hug. You hold it tight with both hands. Pull it down, down, down, right over your lap. Now comes the best part of all. Look at the little plastic piece in your hand. Bring it over to the buckle on the side. Push it in until you hear that wonderful sound. Click-clack! Oh, listen to that! Click-clack means you are locked in tight, just like a baby bear in a cozy winter cave. You test it out by giving a little wiggle. You are secure, protected, and ready to ride. The engine starts up with a gentle hum. Vroom, vroom! Mommy turns around from the front seat and gives you a big smile. You smile right back, feeling so proud and responsible. You know that wearing your seatbelt is the best way to travel. The car rolls smoothly down the sunny road, and you look out the window at the passing trees. Click-clack, safe and snug, we are on our way to fun!

stories.title: The Helmet Super-Hero
stories.text: Ring, ring! There goes the bicycle bell, calling you to your afternoon ride. You have your shiny blue tricycle waiting on the driveway, and it is gleaming in the afternoon sun. But wait! Before our wheels start spinning, every super-hero needs their special gear. Do you know what gear we need? A superhero helmet! You pick up the bright blue helmet with the cool star sticker right on the front. You hold it up high and place it right on top of your head. It sits there like a crown fit for royalty. Now, we just need to make sure it stays put while we zoom around the neighborhood. You pull the two soft straps down from the sides. Bring them together right underneath your little chin. Are you ready for the magic sound? Here it comes. Push them together until they connect. Click-clack! You did it! That sound means your super helmet is locked in safely and snugly, protecting your precious head. You give a little nod up and down. The helmet stays right in place, feeling like a warm hug for your noggin. You hop onto your tricycle seat and place your sneakers on the pedals. You look down at your chin and beam with pride. You look just like a real stunt rider, ready to conquer the sidewalk track. Daddy gives your bike a gentle push, and you start pedaling. Whirr, whirr, go the wheels! The wind blows through your hair, and you feel brave, strong, and completely secure. Click-clack, safe and snug, you are zooming into a wonderful afternoon of play!

stories.title: The Car Seat Adventure
stories.text: Beep, beep! Time for a fun ride, little explorer! Today is a big day, and we are going on a magical journey to the park. But first, we need to get ready. Just like superheroes put on their capes, we get to buckle up! Look at your special big-kid seat waiting just for you. Climb right on up, wiggle your toes, and get super comfy. Ah, cozy and warm! Now, it is time for the best part. Reach your hand out and grab the shiny black strap. Pull it gently across your tummy. It goes across your lap just like a seatbelt hug. Now comes the most satisfying sound in the whole wide world. Ready? Let's listen together. Click! Did you hear that? Click-clack! Wow, you did it all by yourself! That is the sound of safety, sweet friend. That means you are snug as a bug in a rug, ready for any adventure down the road. You give the strap a little tug, and it holds you safe and secure. Mommy and Daddy smile so big because you are growing up to be so smart and capable. Look at your strong hands! You know just how to keep yourself safe. The car engine purrs softly, and the wheels begin to turn. We wave goodbye to the driveway and hello to the sky. You look out the window at the fluffy white clouds floating by, feeling so proud and secure in your snug little seat. The music plays a gentle, happy tune as we drive along. You are safe, you are loved, and you are ready for fun. Every time we go somewhere new, you know the routine. Reach, pull, and click-clack! You are a superstar passenger. The journey is smooth, the day is bright, and your heart is happy. When we finally arrive at the park, you unbuckle with a happy pop and bounce down with glee. What a wonderful traveler you are! Time to play, little hero, knowing you are always safe and snug.

stories.title: The Stroller Voyage
stories.text: The sun is shining, and the birds are singing outside the window. It is time for our morning stroll around the neighborhood! Let's put on your walking shoes, grab your favorite stuffed bunny, and head out the door. Waiting for you right on the porch is your trusty red stroller, ready to carry you like a royal carriage. Up you go into the soft, cushioned seat! You stretch your legs out and lean your back against the cozy padding. Bunny gets tucked right next to you so he can see all the sights too. Now, we have to make sure you are nice and secure for our bumpy sidewalk adventure. Here comes the safety harness over your shoulders. It wraps around your tummy like a gentle, warm embrace. Reach down with your little fingers and grab the two clips. Push them together until you hear the happiest sound. Click-clack! Oh, wonderful job! You are locked in and ready to roll. That click-clack sound is magic. It means you can relax, look around, and enjoy the ride without a single worry. The breeze whispers through the trees as we start moving down the sidewalk. You point at a cute little doggie walking with his owner, and you wave hello. You point at a shiny red leaf fluttering down from a tall oak tree. Because you are buckled in safely, you can point and look and giggle as much as you want. Mommy holds the handles and pushes smoothly, guiding our little chariot along the path. You feel so cozy, so protected, and so independent knowing you helped click-clack your way into your seat. Being safe and snug makes every walk an exciting expedition. When we finally turn back toward home, you let out a little yawn. The gentle motion of the stroller and the comfort of your safe harness make you feel so sleepy. You snuggle Bunny a little tighter, resting your heavy eyelids. What a lovely morning it has been, all thanks to a safe start and a happy click-clack.

stories.title: The High Chair Banquet
stories.text: Ding-dong, dinner bell rings! Smells like something yummy is cooking in the kitchen. It is time for a grand feast, little chef! Your tummy is rumbling, and mommy is plating up some delicious warm yummies just for you. But before we dig into our tasty meal, we have an important job to do. Time to hop into your special high chair throne! This is where all the magical eating happens. You climb up with your wiggly legs and sit down nice and tall. Look at the big wooden tray in front of you, just waiting for your cup and spoon. But wait! We need to make sure you stay safe and comfy while you eat your yummy food. Just like a pilot in an airplane, you need your safety belt fastened tight. Reach down and find the soft straps resting on the seat. Bring them together across your lap. Now, let's listen for the special sound. Ready? Click-clack! Yay! You did it! The buckles locked together with a happy little snap. You are safe and snug, ready to explore all the flavors on your plate. Mommy places a colorful bowl of mashed peas and sweet carrots right in front of you. You pick up your spoon with your whole fist and scoop up a big bite. Delicious! Because you are secure in your high chair, you can wiggle your arms and kick your feet with joy without sliding around at all. You take another bite and smile a big, happy smile with green peas on your nose. You are doing such a wonderful job feeding yourself today. Eating is so much fun when you are comfy, safe, and snug in your special seat. When dinner is all done and your tummy is happy and full, you help us unlock the buckle. Pop! It opens right up. You slide down, ready to play with your blocks. You are growing up so fast, always learning how to take care of yourself, one click-clack at a time.

stories.title: The Car Seat Adventure
stories.text: Beep, beep! Time for a fun ride in the red car, little Leo! Today, we are going to the park to slide down the big green slide and swing high up into the fluffy white clouds. But first, before the wheels can start to spin and roll, Leo needs to get ready. Are you ready for your special travel hug, Leo? Let us check! Here comes your cozy car seat, waiting just for you. Up, up, up you go into your soft seat. Now comes the very best part of getting ready. Can you hear that? Listen closely. Click! That is the sound of safety! The buckle goes click, snug and tight, keeping Leo safe and bright. Mommy and Daddy clap their hands and smile big. Yay! Leo is all buckled in and ready for fun! Your arms are free to wave goodbye to the house, and your legs can wiggle happy wiggles. Click-clack, safe and snug! That is the way to ride in the car. The engine purrs a happy song, and the wheels begin to turn. Round and round they go, rolling down the sunny street. Look at the big brown dog walking with his person. Look at the yellow flowers nodding in the gentle breeze. Leo points his little finger and giggles. It is so much fun to look out the window when you are safe and secure in your special seat. Being big means knowing how to take care of yourself, and buckling up is a super-duper big kid job. You did it all by yourself, with just a little help from Mommy. Click-clack, safe and snug, every single time we go for a ride. The car bumps gently over a little hill, whee! Leo holds his toy bear tightly and smiles a big, toothy smile. When we get to the park, we will unclick and run, but for now, we enjoy the cozy ride. Good job being a safe traveler today, sweet Leo! The park is getting closer and closer, and our happy journey is just beginning. Let us count the red stop signs together as we go. One, two, three! You are so smart. Click-clack, safe and snug, all day long.

stories.title: Stomping Shoes Go Out to Play
stories.text: Good morning, sunshine! The birds are singing a sweet morning song outside the window, and Mia is ready to start a brand new day of exploring. Today, there are leaves to crunch and bubbles to chase in the backyard! But before Mia can open the back door and step out into the wonderful world, she needs her trusty stomping shoes. Where are they hiding? Ah, there they are! Two shiny red sneakers with magic velcro straps, waiting right by the rug. Mia sits down on the little blue chair and stretches out her toes. Wiggle, toes, wiggle! Time to put on your cozy houses. One foot goes in, slip! Two feet go in, slide! Now comes the magical part of putting on shoes. Can you hear the sound? Press down the strap and listen. Crinkle-clack! That is the sound of getting ready for an adventure. Press them down nice and firm so your feet stay happy while you run and jump. Mia pats her shoes proudly. They look so cool! Click-clack, safe and snug, her feet are ready to hug the ground. No tripping, no slipping, just steady little steps for a busy explorer. Mia stands up and tests her balance. Stomp, stomp, stomp! Hear the happy noise her shoes make on the wooden floor. That means they are working just right. Daddy smiles and gives Mia a high-five. You are ready to conquer the backyard, superstar! Mia opens the door, and a rush of fresh morning air tickles her nose. The grass is damp with sparkly morning dew, and a tiny butterfly dances past her ear. Mia steps out carefully, her red shoes keeping her steady and secure. She runs toward the yellow slide, her feet moving fast and free. Being safe means you can play harder and laugh louder because you know you are protected. Click-clack, safe and snug, her shoes protect her toes as she hops over a little stick. What a wonderful morning for a run outside! Mia stops to look at a ladybug on a leaf, bending down slowly in her sturdy shoes. Everything is brighter and happier when you start your day the safe and cozy way. Let us go find some more fun things to do, little runner!

stories.title: The Little Explorer Helmet
stories.text: Ring-ring! The bicycle bell is calling out to Toby. Today is the day for a speedy bicycle ride down the smooth sidewalk. The sun is shining, the sky is bright blue, and Toby’s blue-and-yellow bicycle is polished and gleaming. But wait! Before Toby’s feet can reach the pedals, there is a very important friend we need to invite along. Can you guess who it is? It is Toby’s shiny blue superhero helmet! This special helmet is like a magical shield for Toby’s smart head. Toby picks up the helmet with both hands and places it right on top of his head, tilting it just a little bit. Now, we have to make sure our helmet is hugged tight so it stays right where it belongs. Toby pulls the straps down gently under his chin. Ready? Let us do the magic fastening trick. Click! There is that wonderful sound again! Click-clack, safe and snug, the helmet gives Toby’s head a warm, safe hug. Toby shakes his head left and right. Does the helmet wobble? Nope! It sits proudly like a crown on a king. Mommy leans down and checks the strap with one finger. Just right! Not too tight, not too loose, just perfectly cozy. Toby giggles because the helmet makes him feel like an astronaut ready to blast off into space. Three, two, one, blast off! Toby swings his leg over the bicycle seat and grabs the handlebars with both hands. His fingers curl nicely around the rubber grips. Click-clack, safe and snug, Toby is ready to roll. He pushes down with his foot, and the bicycle moves forward with a smooth, magical glide. Whirrrr goes the tire. Toby pedals around the big oak tree, feeling the cool breeze rush past his ears. The helmet keeps him safe and brave as he goes on his grand outdoor journey. Whenever Toby rides, his helmet is right there with him, protecting his happy thoughts and big ideas. Being safe is the coolest superpower a kid can have. Toby rings his bicycle bell again, ding-dong, so happy and free. Click-clack, safe and snug, every ride is a joyful adventure when you are ready to roll safely!

stories.title: The Car Seat Adventure
stories.text: Beep, beep! Time for a fun ride, little explorer! Today is a big day, and we have places to go. But first, before the wheels go round and round, we need to get ready in our special big-kid chair. Can you hop up into your car seat? Yay! Up you go, nice and comfy. Now, it is time for the most important part of our journey. Can you find your straps? Here comes the left one, and here comes the right one. They hug you tight like a warm, cozy bear hug. Now listen closely. Are your ears ready? Click! Clack! Did you hear that wonderful sound? Click-Clack! That means you are safe, snug, and ready for adventure. Look at you sitting so tall and proud. You did such a super job getting buckled in all by yourself today. When the car goes zooming down the street, or stops at a red light, you are safe and secure in your special spot. Mommy and Daddy are so proud of how well you listen and follow directions. Riding in the car is so much fun when we are safe and snug. Look out the window! There is a fluffy white cloud shaped like a puppy dog. There is a big green tree waving hello to us as we drive past. Every little turn and bump in the road is a new thing to see. And all the while, you are safe, snug, and happy in your seat. When we reach our fun destination, park the car and turn off the engine, we will undo the buckle. Ready? Pop! But until then, we enjoy the ride together. You are growing up to be such a smart, careful little helper. Thank you for making safety so much fun every single day. Let's clap our hands for a wonderful car ride and a job well done. Yay for being safe and snug in the car!

stories.title: The Stroller Safari
stories.text: Time for a safari walk in the bright, sunny park! Let's put on our walking shoes and get ready to see some birds, bugs, and maybe even a friendly doggie. But before we open the front door to go outside, we have to hop into our comfy stroller chariot. Step up, little adventurer! Sit right down on the soft cushion. Ah, perfect. Now, the stroller needs to give you a big hug to keep you safe on the bumpy sidewalk paths. Pull the straps over your little shoulders, just like putting on a tiny backpack. Now comes the magic moment. Bring the two clips together right in front of your tummy. Are you ready? Let's listen together. Click! Clack! Hooray! Click-Clack means you are safe and snug, ready to zoom down the sidewalk. The wheels start to roll, squeak-squeak, rolling along the pavement. Look up at the leafy green trees dancing in the gentle breeze. Look down at the little brown sparrow hopping in the grass. You are riding like a little king or queen in your magical chariot. When we go over a tiny bump in the sidewalk, you don't have to worry at all because you are clicked in tight and secure. Being safe means you can look all around and enjoy the big, beautiful world without a single care. You are learning how to take care of your body and stay safe wherever you go. That is what makes you such a big kid now. Mommy and Daddy love walking with you on these sunny afternoon adventures. We can wave to the neighbors and smile at the blooming flowers together. When our walk is all done and we reach our front porch, we will go click-pop to open the straps. But for now, we just enjoy the breeze. You are doing an amazing job. Click-Clack, safe and snug all day long!

stories.title: The Shopping Cart Rocket
stories.text: Vroom, vroom! Blast off into the big grocery store supermarket! Today we are on a top-secret mission to find yummy bananas, crunchy apples, and maybe a sweet treat for dessert. To steer this big shopping cart rocket, we need a brave pilot. And that lucky pilot is you! Climb on up into the big silver seat. Look at you sitting way up high with the best view in the whole store. But wait, space pilots need to be extra safe when their rocket ship moves fast down the aisle. We need our special safety belt locked in tight. Pull the strap across your lap. Make sure it is nice and comfy. Now, reach out your little hands and connect the buckle pieces together. Listen closely... Click! Clack! Wow, what a fantastic sound! Click-Clack means you are safe and snug in your rocket ship seat. Now we are ready to steer around the corners. Beep, beep! Watch out for the pyramid of bright red apples! Steering the cart is so much fun when you are safely buckled in. You get to point at all the delicious food on the shelves and help us pick out the best dinner ingredients. Whenever the cart turns a corner, you stay right in place, safe and cozy like a bug in a rug. You are such a helpful co-pilot, and everyone at the store can see what a big, responsible kid you are becoming. Safety first, fun second, that's our special rule! When we pay for our groceries and head back to the car, we will unbuckle your seat. But until then, enjoy the starry-eyed supermarket flight. You are doing a stellar job, little one. Click-Clack, safe and snug on our shopping journey today!

stories.title: The Car Seat Adventure
stories.text: BEEP, BEEP! Goes the little red car, waiting in the driveway. Today, Leo and Mommy are going on a big adventure to the park! But first, it is time for Leo’s most important job. It is time to get safe and snug. Leo climbs up, up, up into his big boy car seat. He wiggles his bottom all the way back. 'Time to buckle up!' says Mommy with a big, happy smile. Leo pulls his straps over his shoulders. They feel nice and cozy, like a giant bear hug keeping him safe. Now for the best part. Leo reaches for the two black clips. He holds them tight in his little hands. He pushes them together. CLICK! Then, he pushes the bottom buckle. CLACK! 'Click-clack, safe and snug!' cheers Leo, clapping his hands together. Mommy leans over and gives his cheek a gentle kiss. 'Wonderful job, Leo! You are ready to roll.' Leo looks out the shiny window. He waves bye-bye to the mailbox as the car rolls smoothly down the street. He feels so proud. Wearing his seatbelt makes him feel like a brave superhero flying through the sky. He knows that staying buckled up keeps him safe on every single trip. The car hums a happy song as they drive past tall green trees and fluffy white clouds. When they finally arrive at the park, Leo waits patiently while Mommy unbuckles him. 'All done!' says Mommy. Leo hops out, ready to swing on the swings and slide down the slide. But he always remembers how wonderful it felt to do his special job. Click-clack, safe and snug, ready for fun, every single day!

stories.title: The Magic Stroller Ride
stories.text: The sun is shining, and the birds are singing a morning song. Mia’s tummy is full of yummy oatmeal, and her favorite blankie is tucked right beside her. It is time for a neighborhood walk! Mia's big blue stroller is waiting by the front door, looking ready for a fun journey. 'Shall we go, Mia?' asks Daddy. Mia giggles and claps her hands. She climbs right into the soft, padded seat. She rests her back against the cozy cushion. Now, it is time for safety magic! Daddy pulls the straps over Mia’s shoulders and around her waist. Mia helps by holding her arms up high just like a strong tree. Daddy brings the left buckle around. CLICK! Then he brings the right buckle around. CLACK! 'Click-clack, safe and snug!' sings Daddy. Mia loves that magical sound. It means she is locked in her cozy little spaceship, ready to explore the world. Daddy pushes the stroller gently down the sidewalk. Mia watches a friendly orange kitty stretch in the grass. She points at a buzzing bumblebee dancing over a pink flower. 'Bee!' she says happily. The straps keep her sitting nice and tall so she can see everything. She never has to worry about falling because her safe seat holds her just right. When the wind blows softly, Mia snuggles deeper into her cozy spot. She feels so peaceful and secure. Daddy stops to check on her, and Mia gives him a big thumbs-up. 'Safe and snug!' she repeats in her sweet little voice. Walking with Daddy is the best part of the morning, and being buckled in safely makes it even better. Click-clack, safe and snug, let's explore!

stories.title: The Shopping Cart Rocket
stories.text: ZOOM! Today, Noah is a brave astronaut exploring the grocery store galaxy. The shopping cart is his very own shiny silver rocket ship, ready to blast off down the cereal aisle. But before any rocket can fly to the moon, the pilot must be securely strapped in! 'Are you ready for blastoff, Captain Noah?' asks Grandma. Noah nods his head with big, wide eyes. 'Yes, Grandma!' he whispers excitedly. He hops into the little seat inside the cart and stretches his legs right through the leg holes. He feels the smooth plastic seat beneath him. Grandma pulls the bright red safety belt across Noah’s lap. Noah holds his tummy in tight. Grandma brings the two ends together. CLICK! She fastens the sturdy clip. CLACK! 'Click-clack, safe and snug!' Grandma says with a cheerful grin. Noah looks down at his belt. It holds him securely just like a real space suit. 'I am ready!' shouts Noah softly so he doesn't wake the sleeping vegetables. Grandma pushes the cart forward, and the wheels squeak a happy tune. Noah helps steer by holding onto the handle bar. They zoom past towers of bright red apples and mountains of yellow bananas. Whenever Grandma turns a corner, Noah stays safely in his seat, feeling as snug as a bug in a rug. He waves at a baby in the next aisle, feeling like the happiest astronaut in the whole universe. Being buckled up means he can enjoy the ride without any worries. When their shopping cart is finally full of yummy treats, Grandma stops the rocket. She unclicks the belt. 'We have landed safely!' says Grandma. Noah steps out with a hop and a skip, ready to help unload the groceries. Click-clack, safe and snug, what a wonderful trip!

stories.title: The Mighty Car Seat Adventure
stories.text: Ring-ring! Goes the happy morning alarm clock, and little Leo stretches up high like a tall, sleepy sunflower. Today is a very special day because Leo gets to go on a big adventure to the park with Mommy and Daddy. But wait! Before the wheels on the car can go round and round, Leo has a very important job to do. It is time for the Click-Clack, Safe and Snug routine! Leo climbs up, up, up into his big-kid car seat. It feels like a cozy captain’s chair made just for him. He pulls his arms through the soft, friendly straps, just like putting on a warm hug. Mommy holds the two special buckles together. They look like two best friends wanting to hold hands. Then, Mommy pushes them down into the base. Click! Clack! Such a happy sound! 'Yay!' cheers Leo, clapping his little hands together. Daddy checks the straps to make sure they are nice and snug, giving Leo a gentle high-five. 'You are locked in safely, Captain Leo!' Daddy says with a big smile. Leo feels so proud and strong. He knows that being buckled up keeps his body safe while the car zooms down the street past the green trees and fluffy white clouds. Click-Clack, Safe and Snug! Now Leo is ready for anything. He looks out the window, waving hello to a friendly puppy walking on the sidewalk. Being safe in the car is the best way to start a fun day. When the car finally stops at the park, Leo waits patiently while Mommy unlocks the buckle. Click! It opens right up. Leo climbs down, feeling happy, safe, and ready to play on the big yellow slide. What a wonderful journey it was, all because Leo practiced his safe car seat routine like a super star!

stories.title: Little Bear's Buggy Ride
stories.text: The sun is shining brightly, and little Mia Bear is waking up from her morning nap. Today, Grandma Bear is taking Mia to the bustling farmers market to pick out some yummy red strawberries. Mia loves strawberries! She stretches her paws and gives a big, sleepy yawn. 'Time to get ready for our walk, little cub,' says Grandma with a warm, gentle voice. Mia hops down from her cozy bed and runs over to her favorite stroller. It is shiny, blue, and waits patiently for her. Climbing into the stroller is like hopping into a little rolling boat. Mia settles back against the soft, cushiony seat. But before Grandma can push the stroller down the garden path, they must do their favorite daily song and dance. The Click-Clack, Safe and Snug routine! Grandma pulls the shiny black straps across Mia’s tummy and over her shoulders. Mia holds out her arms like a soaring eagle. Grandma brings the two buckles together. Click! Then she snaps the side straps into place. Clack! 'Click-Clack, Safe and Snug!' sings Grandma, giving Mia's nose a playful little boop. Mia giggles loudly, showing her two tiny front teeth. She feels wonderfully secure, like a little bird tucked safely inside its nest. The straps are snug and comfortable, hugging her gently while leaving plenty of room for her to wiggle her toes. Grandma starts pushing the stroller forward, and the wheels make a happy rolling sound on the pavement. Mia looks all around at the colorful flowers, the buzzing bees, and the bright blue sky. She feels so safe and happy on her little journey. When they finally reach the market, Grandma unlatches the buckles. Click! Mia steps out to choose the biggest, juiciest strawberries, feeling proud that she always rides Click-Clack, Safe and Snug!

stories.title: Max's Ride to Grandma's House
stories.text: Beep-beep! Goes the toy horn on the living room rug. Little Max is pretending to drive a big red fire truck all around the house. But soon, it is time for a real-life ride! Max and Papa are getting ready to drive over to Grandma’s house for a fun afternoon of playing with blocks and eating warm banana bread. Max runs over to the front door, wearing his favorite dinosaur shoes. 'Hold on, little driver,' says Papa with a jolly laugh. 'We need to get our special travel armor on first!' Max knows exactly what Papa means. It is time for the Click-Clack, Safe and Snug routine in the car! Max scampers to the back seat and climbs right into his royal throne. He scoots his bottom all the way back so he is sitting nice and straight. Papa brings the cool black seatbelt over Max’s shoulder. Max holds his tummy in just like a strong superhero. Papa clicks the metal tab into the buckle. Click! Then he pulls the belt across Max's lap until it fits just right. Clack! Everything is snug and secure. 'All safe?' asks Papa with a loving smile. 'All safe!' shouts Max happily, holding up his strong little arms to show how ready he is. The seatbelt hugs him tight like a warm, protective shield, making sure he stays safe while Papa drives over the hills and around the corners. Max looks out the window, singing his favorite alphabet song as the houses zip by. He loves looking at all the red cars and green mailboxes. Riding in the car is so much fun when you are buckled up correctly. When they pull into Grandma’s driveway, Papa helps unlatch the belt. Click! Max hops out with a joyful bound, ready to run inside and give Grandma the biggest hug ever, knowing he always travels Click-Clack, Safe and Snug.

stories.title: The Car Seat Adventure
stories.text: Beep, beep! Time to ride in the big red car today, little Leo! Leo clapped his hands with joy because car ride days are super-duper fun days. First, we have to open the car door and climb up high into your special big-boy seat. Up, up, up goes Leo, settling right into the cozy, soft cushion. Now, it is time for our very important magic trick. Can you help me find the straps, Leo? Here is the left strap, and here is the right strap. They are like friendly little hug-arms waiting just for you. Snug against your tummy, safe and secure. Are you ready? Let us listen closely. Click! Went the left side into the buckle. Clack! Went the right side into the buckle. Click-Clack, safe and snug! You did it, Leo! You are locked in tight like a happy little bug in a rug. I gave your shoulders a gentle check to make sure everything feels just right. Strong and steady, ready for the road. 'Are we ready to roll?' asked Mommy. 'Yes!' cheered Leo, giving a big thumbs up with a bright, proud smile. The engine purred a happy hum, and off we went on our merry way. We drove past the tall green trees, waved hello to a friendly brown dog walking on the sidewalk, and even spotted a big yellow school bus rumbling down the street. Leo sat tall and straight in his wonderful seat, feeling so safe, so protected, and so very loved. Every time the car went around a corner, Leo felt the warm, comforting hug of his safety straps keeping him right where he belonged. When we finally arrived at Grandma's house, it was time to unbuckle. With a friendly press of the red button, the magic straps opened up wide. 'All done!' cheered Leo, stretching his arms up high. You are such a big helper, Leo, always remembering that safety comes first. Being safe means we get to have more fun exploring the big wide world together. What a wonderful traveler you are every single day!

stories.title: The Stroller Journey
stories.text: Sunbeams are dancing on the kitchen floor, and it is time for a bright morning walk in the neighborhood, sweet Mia! Mia jumped up and down, eager to put on her pink walking shoes. But before our wheels can start rolling down the sidewalk, we have a very special routine to do. Time to get snug in the stroller! Mia climbed right into her cozy stroller seat, leaning back against the soft padded pillow. 'Time for the magic buckle, Mia!' whispered Daddy with a playful grin. Mia held up her hands and waited patiently. First came the lap belt, going softly across her tummy. Then came the shoulder straps, keeping her sitting nice and tall. Are you ready to hear the magic sound, Mia? Let us listen together! Click! Went the first side. Clack! Went the second side. Click-Clack, safe and snug! Mia giggled as she patted her belly. 'Safe and snug!' she repeated in her happiest voice. Daddy gently checked the straps to make sure they gave the best hug possible. Perfect! Now Mia was ready for her grand journey. Daddy pushed the stroller gently down the walkway, and the wheels sang a happy song: whirrrr, whirrrr, crunch, crunch over the autumn leaves. A little blue bird fluttered by, singing a sweet morning song, and Mia waved her tiny hand, calling out, 'Hi birdie!' She felt so secure and comfy in her moving chariot. The gentle breeze brushed against her cheeks, but she stayed warm and safe inside her cozy seat. They walked all the way to the corner park, where the green grass smelled fresh and sweet. When it was time to get out and play on the swings, Daddy pressed the release button, and the buckles opened up with a friendly pop. 'Free!' cheered Mia, hopping down to chase butterflies. You are always so good at buckling up, Mia. Safety is our superhero cape, making every journey secure and joyful!

stories.title: The Grocery Cart Ride
stories.text: Bippity-boppity-boo! Today we are off to the big bustling grocery store, little Oliver! Oliver loved the grocery store because the shiny floors made his squeaky shoes echo, and the colorful fruits looked like a rainbow. But before we pick out any crunchy apples or yummy bananas, we have to hop into the shopping cart chariot. Oliver reached for Mommy's hands and stepped up into the little seat inside the basket. 'Up we go!' cheered Mommy. Oliver sat down on the metal seat, wiggling his toes in his fun dinosaur socks. Now, it is time for our safety adventure! Can we find the special shopping cart belt, Oliver? There it is! Mommy pulled the shiny gray strap across Oliver's lap. It keeps our little explorer safe while we zoom down the aisles looking for treats. Let us listen for the magic sound together. Ready, set, listen! Click! Went the buckle as it locked into place. Clack! Went the safety latch making it super secure. Click-Clack, safe and snug! Oliver beamed with pride, patting the strap. 'Safe and snug, Mommy!' he said. Mommy gave the belt a gentle tug to make sure it was strong and steady, just like a seatbelt on a rocket ship. 'Three, two, one, blast off!' whispered Mommy, and they rolled smoothly past the towering pyramids of bright red strawberries and round green melons. Oliver helped Mommy pick out the best bunch of bananas and pointed excitedly at the cart full of groceries. Because he was safely buckled in, he could enjoy the ride without any worries, looking at all the busy shoppers and stacking cans. When Mommy paid for the groceries at the register, Oliver waited patiently, sitting tall and proud in his seat. When they reached the car, the buckle opened easily with a soft click. You did such an amazing job staying safe today, Oliver! Being a safe traveler makes you a superstar every single day!

stories.title: The Mighty Car Seat Adventure
stories.text: Ring-a-ling! Morning sunbeams are dancing on the wall, little ones. Time to wake up and get ready for a big day of exploring! Leo stretches his arms way up high, touching the sky, and yawns a big, sleepy yawn. 'Yaaaaawn!' Today, Leo and Mommy are going on a grand journey to the park to see the big green swings. But first, we have a very important mission. We need to get ready for the car! Leo puts on his favorite shiny red shoes. Tap, tap, go the shoes. Next, it is time for the most important helper of all: the car seat! Mommy opens the car door. 'Hop in, Captain Leo!' Leo climbs up into his cozy big-boy seat. It feels like a throne fit for a brave explorer. Now, it is time for the magical sound. Can you guess what it is? Click! That is the sound of safety! Leo pulls the straps snug over his shoulders. Then comes the second magical sound. Clack! There goes the buckle, locking in place just like a secret agent's lock. 'Click-clack, safe and snug!' cheers Mommy, giving Leo a warm, happy high-five. Leo smiles brightly, feeling so strong and secure. He can wiggle his toes, he can wiggle his fingers, and he can look out the window at the fluffy white clouds floating by. The car starts up with a gentle, rumbling hum. Vroom, vroom! They are ready to roll. Being safe in the car means Leo is ready for all the fun waiting at the park. He holds his favorite stuffed puppy tight and sings a happy little song as the wheels turn round and round. Good job, Leo! Being safe is the best way to start a wonderful day.

stories.title: Maya’s Cozy Bus Ride
stories.text: BEEP, BEEP! The yellow school bus is rolling down the street, and it is stopping right in front of Maya’s house. Maya claps her hands together with glee. Today is a field trip to the big petting zoo to see the fluffy little bunnies! Maya puts on her bright yellow backpack. It is packed with a yummy apple and her favorite blue water bottle. 'Are you ready, Maya?' asks Grandma with a big, loving smile. Maya nods enthusiastically. 'Ready, Grandma!' Out the front door they go, stepping onto the soft green grass. The big yellow bus opens its folding doors with a friendly swoosh. Up the tall steps Maya climbs, holding tightly to the shiny metal handrail. One step, two steps, three steps! She looks inside and sees all her happy friends waving hello. Now, it is time to find the best seat. Maya chooses a window seat where she can see everything outside. She sits all the way back, resting her head against the soft, squishy cushion. But wait! There is one very important thing to do before the bus moves. Buckle up! Maya reaches across her tummy and pulls the shiny seatbelt strap. Pull, pull, click! There is the first wonderful sound. Then she clicks the other side into place. Clack! Click-clack, safe and snug! Maya giggles as she pats her tummy. 'I am safe and snug!' says Maya proudly. The friendly bus driver smiles in the big rearview mirror and gives a cheerful wave. The bus starts to drive, gently rocking side to side like a boat on the water. Maya looks out the window, watching the trees wave goodbye. She feels so cozy, so happy, and so ready for her big adventure at the zoo. Way to go, Maya!

stories.title: Sam’s Superhero Stroller Ride
stories.text: Zoom, zoom! Who is zooming down the hallway? It is Sam the Superhero, zooming super fast in his bright blue socks! Today, Sam and Daddy are going on a special mission to the corner market to pick out some delicious, juicy strawberries. Sam zooms into the mudroom and stops. 'Halt, superhero!' laughs Daddy. 'It is time to ride in the super-stroller!' Sam loves his stroller because it has big wheels that can roll over any bumps in the sidewalk. But before Sam can save the day at the market, he needs to get buckled into his special superhero cockpit. Sam climbs right into the comfortable seat, tucking his legs in. 'Beep, beep, spaceship ready!' says Sam, making zooming noises with his mouth. Daddy pulls the soft grey straps over Sam’s shoulders. Sam helps too, holding the little buckle pieces just like a true helper. He pushes them together until he hears the magic sound. Click! Then comes the lap strap. Clack! Click-clack, safe and snug! Sam leans back against the soft padding, feeling like he is ready to blast off into outer space. 'Click-clack, safe and snug, ready for a hug!' sings Daddy, leaning down to give Sam a tickly kiss on his cheek. Sam giggles and hugs his stuffed dinosaur friend, Rex.
