Just a second, wait and see,
Safe as safe can ever be.

All clear now, we shout aloud,
Daddy and the rest are proud.
Marching back to get our toys,
Happy little girls and boys.

rhymes.title: Freeze Like Ice
rhymes.text:
Stir the pot and mix the dough,
Watch the yummy bubbles go.
Moving round the cooking space,
Big smiles shining on each face.

Then the magic word is said,
Catch it right above your head.
Hot stove, freeze your feet like ice,
Following the rules is nice.

Freeze your fingers, freeze your toes,
Freeze the tip-top of your nose.
Not a muscle out of place,
Frozen in a smiling space.

Now the food is off the heat,
Time to find a booster seat.
Clapping hands and feeling grand,
Best young cook in all the land!

rhymes.title: Hot Stove, Freeze Feet!
rhymes.text:
Walking to the kitchen floor,
Coming near the cooking door.
Dinner smells so good and sweet,
Stop right now and freeze your feet!

Red hot burners start to glow,
Little toes must stay below.
Reach up high to touch the air,
Safe and happy sitting there.

Stove is hot, oh yes indeed,
Listening is what we need.
Clap your hands and count to three,
Safe as safe can ever be!

Now we step back with a smile,
Rest our dancing feet a while.
Good job listening, time to eat,
Warm and happy, safe and sweet.

rhymes.title: Red Hot Buttons
rhymes.text:
Time to help make yummy soup,
Gather in a happy group.
Walking past the kitchen heat,
Hear the call to freeze your feet!

Stove is working, making fire,
Flames are dancing high and higher.
Keep our hands down by our side,
Walking with our steps so wide.

Hot stove means we do not touch,
We love safety very much.
Freeze your toes and count to four,
Then we safely cross the floor.

Now the cooking time is done,
Safety check was so much fun.
Wash your hands and take a seat,
Time to taste the yummy treat.

rhymes.title: The Kitchen Freeze Dance
rhymes.text:
Dancing through the kitchen door,
Happy feet upon the floor.
Mommy's cooking something neat,
Wait a second, freeze your feet!

Hot stove sitting big and tall,
Must be careful, one and all.
Keep your fingers to yourself,
Safe upon the kitchen shelf.

That is how we keep away,
Safe and healthy through the day.
Now the freezing game is through,
Look at all the things we do!

Give a cheer for being smart,
Keeping safety in our heart.
Stove is hot, we play it cool,
Following the golden rule.

rhymes.title: Little Chef Safety Step
rhymes.text:
Little chef is walking by,
Watching steam go to the sky.
Kitchen is a busy street,
When we hear to freeze our feet!

Stove is hot and very bright,
Keep our little fingers tight.
Step around and give a wave,
Little chefs are strong and brave.

We know how to keep from harm,
Walking with a steady arm.
Freeze your toes and hold your breath,
Safety is our happy path.

Now we're past the cooking space,
Big smiles on each little face.
Time to play and time to eat,
Happy hands and happy feet.

rhymes.title: Stop and Freeze
rhymes.text:
Pot of water starts to steam,
Shining like a little dream.
Walking down the little street,
Stop right now and freeze your feet!

Stove is hot, we know the rule,
Keeping every toddler cool.
Hands behind your back so neat,
Standing safely on your feet.

Look around and see the glow,
Why we stop and why we slow.
Nod your head and say okay,
We are safe in every way.

Cooking time is almost through,
Proud of everything we do.
Turn around and take a seat,
Safe and happy, clear of heat.

rhymes.title: Hot Stove, Freeze Feet!
rhymes.text:
Time to cook, time to play,
We are busy every day.
In the kitchen, step with care,
Delicious food is cooking there.
Hot stove, hot stove, shiny bright,
We must keep a careful sight.
Stop right now and take a seat,
Hot stove, freeze your feet!
Toes like statues, do not wiggle,
Even when you want to giggle.
Count to three and then we go,
Walking safely nice and slow.
Mama stirs the yummy pot,
Careful now, because it's hot.
Good job stopping, what a treat,
Now you can unfreeze your feet!

rhymes.title: Kitchen Safety Dance
rhymes.text:
Marching round the kitchen floor,
We love snack time evermore.
Smell the soup, it is so good,
Doing just the things we should.
Look ahead and watch the wall,
So we never slip or fall.
Hot stove, hot stove, shining bright,
Turn on every safety light!
Hot stove, freeze your feet right down,
Wear your little safety crown.
Not a wiggle, not a hop,
When you hear the warning stop!
Now the danger time is past,
Moving safely, not too fast.
Give a cheer and skip a beat,
Now you can unfreeze your feet!

rhymes.title: Stop and Freeze
rhymes.text:
Little boots go tap, tap, tap,
Soon it time to take a nap.
First we help to set the table,
Doing all that we are able.
Big stove glowing, red and high,
Baking yummy apple pie.
Hot stove, hot stove, watch out now,
Take a bow and say a chow.
Hot stove, freeze your little feet,
Make your body still and neat.
Frozen statues in a row,
Ready when I tell you go!
Danger zone is left behind,
Little helpers are so kind.
 Clap your hands and take a seat,
Now you can unfreeze your feet!

rhymes.title: The Safety Freeze
rhymes.text:
Pot of water starting to bubble,
Moving fast can cause us trouble.
Dance around but keep your eyes,
On the stove of giant size.
Hot stove, hot stove, burning red,
Keep away, that's what I said.
Hot stove, freeze your clever feet,
Drop right down and take a seat!
Frozen hands and frozen toes,
Not a wiggle in your nose.
Count to four and hold your breath,
Living safe is what is best.
Now the soup is in the bowl,
Keeping everyone so whole.
Jump up high and skip a beat,
Now you can unfreeze your feet!

rhymes.title: Freeze Feet Song
rhymes.text:
Morning sun is shining down,
Happiest kid in the town.
Walking by the cooking space,
Moving at a steady pace.
Hot stove, hot stove, warming air,
We will show how much we care.
Hot stove, freeze your busy feet,
Stop right here upon the street!
Freeze your knees and freeze your toes,
Freeze the tip of your cute nose.
Not a wiggle, not a shake,
For safety's very own sweet sake.
All done waiting, time to run,
Safely playing in the sun.
Cheer aloud and skip a beat,
Now you can unfreeze your feet!
